lun_bawang: Idi Allah nepebala, "Do' inan acang." Idi acang pana' mangun.
english: God said, “I want light to shine!” And light shone.

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh neneten acang ineh "Maco" idi dacem ineh titenNeh "Malem." Pangeh ineh inan malem idi pekak, ieh ineh aco luk pun-pun.
english: He gave to the light the name ‘day’, and he gave to the darkness the name ‘night’. After that, there was an evening which was followed by a morning. He called that whole period of time ‘the first day’.

lun_bawang: Idi Allah nepebala, "Do' inan su luk pa luun abpa' ineh luk peringuned, pelé mabpat abpa' pad inan dueh babpat.”
english: Then God said, “I command that there be an empty space like a huge dome to separate the water that is above it from the water on the earth that is below it!”

lun_bawang: Idi Allah neneten su luk pa luun abpa' ineh "Langit." Pangeh ineh inan malem idi pekak, ieh ineh aco luk kedueh.
english: Then there was another evening, which was followed by another morning. He called that period of time ‘the second day’.

lun_bawang: Idi Allah nepebala, "Do' amung-amung abpa' luk pa liang langit ineh mepamung bang sebuleng luk inan, pad inan su luk tekering." Idi pangeh mangun mepad kudeng ineh.
english: Then God said, “I want the water that is below the sky to come together, and dry ground to appear and rise above the water.” And that is what happened.

lun_bawang: Idi Allah neneten su luk tekering ineh "Tana'", idi abpa' luk nepamung ineh titenNeh "Abpa' Rayeh." Idi Allah nenier amung luk inau'Neh idi Ieh mawang niat.
english: God gave to the ground the name ‘earth’, and he gave to the water that came together the name ‘oceans’. God was pleased with the earth and the oceans.

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nepebala, "Do' tana' ngeruat uduh, irin luk inan ilung, idi puar-puar lawa luk kebua' luk inan ilung bang ineh, maya' ayudeh." Idi pangeh mangun mepad kudeng ineh.
english: Then God said, “I want the earth to produce plants, including plants that will produce seeds and trees that will produce fruit. Each kind of tree will bear its own kind of fruit.”

lun_bawang: Idi Allah nepebala, "Do' inan tuda'-tuda' acang bang langit, pad ngatad acang ratnan dacem, idi mangun ku tanu' tuda'-tuda' kareb, aco, idi lak.
english: Then God said, “I want a sun, a moon, and many stars to shine in the sky. The sun will shine in the daytime and the moon and stars will shine during the nighttime. By the changes in their appearance they will indicate the various seasons (OR, the times for special celebrations), and will enable people to know when days and years begin.

lun_bawang: Idi Allah nepebala, "Do' amung-amung abpa' ngeruat mula' pudut luk inan niat. Idi do' inan suit-suit temulud arang gawa'.”
english: Then God said, “I want many creatures to live in all the oceans, and I also want birds to fly in the sky above the earth.”

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nemaré peruan kuandeh, kebalaNeh, "Do' muyuh ngeruat anak idi iuk amé' mula' idi manu' abpa' rayeh, idi do' amung-amung suit pana' amé'- amé' mula'.”
english: God blessed them. He said, “Produce offspring and become very numerous. I want the creatures in the water to live in all the oceans, and birds also to become very numerous.” And that is what happened.

lun_bawang: Idi Allah nepebala, "Do' tana' ineh ngeruat puar-puar pung luk melayo idi puar-puar pung luk meliput, luk rayeh idi luk isuut teh." Idi pangeh mangun luk kudeng ineh.
english: Then God said, “I want various kinds of creatures to appear on the earth. There will be many kinds of ◄livestock/domestic animals►, creatures that scurry across the ground, and large wild animals.” And that is what happened.

lun_bawang: Idi Allah nemaré peruan kuan didueh. Idi kebala Allah nedidueh, "Do' medueh mula' anak, pad inul medueh manu' tana' ini idi ngimet neneh, idi ngimet amung-amung lawid, idi suit, idi pung luk meliput, luk rayeh idi luk isuut teh.”
english: God blessed them, saying, “Produce many children, who will live all over the earth and rule over it. I want them to rule over the fish and the birds and over all creatures that scurry across the ground.”

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Allah, "Ui maré nemedueh puar-puar pimara, idi puar-puar bua' luk miak kenen medueh.
english: God said to the humans, “Listen! I have given you all the plants that produce seeds, all over the earth, and all the trees that have seeds in their fruit. All these things are for you to eat.

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nengecuk neneh, kebalaNeh, "Iko miak kuman bua' lawa luk bang kabun ini pad pianmu;
english: But Yahweh said to him, “You must not eat the fruit of the tree that will enable you to know what actions are good to do and what actions are evil to do. If you eat any fruit from that tree, on that day your relationship with me will end. But I will permit you to eat the fruit of any of the other trees in the park/garden.”

lun_bawang: Idi teh Tuhan Allah nepebala, "Na do' lemulun ineh sebuleng mo'. Idi Ui pian nganau' kuanneh seburur rurumneh luk ngedengan neneh.”
english: Yahweh God had taken some soil and had formed from it all kinds of animals and birds, and he brought them to the man to hear what names he would give them.

lun_bawang: Idi lemulun ineh nepebala, "Idi nekini tulang ini ratnan tulangku Idi uang ini ratnan uangku. Idi ieh miak tetanen decur, ngaceku ieh pangeh rinuat ratnan seburur deléi.”
english: The first woman was taken from the man’s body, so that is why when a man and a woman marry, they must leave their parents. The man will join very closely to his wife, so that the two of them will be as though they are one person.

lun_bawang: Idi menipeh ineh meluun ileh ratnan amung-amung pung luk pangeh inau' Tuhan Allah luun tana'. Idi kebalaneh nan decur ineh, "Matuké Allah nepebala, kudeng ini, 'Aleg medueh kuman bua' amung-amung lawa luk bang kabun ini'?”
english: The snake was more cunning than all the other wild animals that Yahweh God had made. One day Satan gave to the snake the ability to talk to the woman. The snake said to her, “Did God really say to you, ‘Do not eat the fruit from any of the trees in the park/garden’?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala decur nan menipeh ineh, "Miak kai kuman amung-amung bua' luk bang kabun ini.
english: The woman replied, “What God said was, ‘Do not eat the fruit from the tree that is in the middle of the park/garden or touch it. If you do that, you will die. But you can eat fruit from any of the other trees.’”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala menipeh nan decur ineh, "Bala ineh na matu. Kali' rungen medueh na maté.
english: only because he knows that when you eat fruit from that tree, you will understand new things. It will be as though your eyes are opened MET, and you will know what is good to do and what is evil to do, just as God does.”

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan Allah nenawar deléi ineh, kebalaNeh, "Iapehké iko?”
english: The man replied, “I heard the sound of your footsteps/walking in the garden, and I was naked, so I was afraid and I hid myself.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala deléi ineh, "Ui neninger garaMu bang kabun, idi ui matot, ngaceku ui lubpa, ineh punneh ui sigapung.”
english: God said, “How did you find out you were naked RHQ? It must be because you ate some of the fruit from the tree that I told you, ‘Do not eat its fruit.’” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi Allah nepebala, "Idéké nemaré kali namu ratnan iko lubpa? Pangehké iko nekuman bua' luk bibpengKu na miak kenen?”
english: The man said, “You gave me this woman to be with me. She is the one who gave me some of the fruit from that tree, and so I ate it.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala deléi ineh, "Decur luk pangeh biréMu negku ineh, ieh luk nemaré bua' ineh kinanku.”
english: Then Yahweh God said to the woman, “Why did you do such a thing?” The woman replied, “I ate some of the fruit because the snake deceived me.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan Allah nan decur ineh, "Anunké luk pangeh inau'mu ineh?" Idi kebala decur ineh, "Menipeh nenaluk negku idi ui nekuman ineh.”
english: Then Yahweh God said to the snake, “Because you did this, of all the livestock and the wild animals, I will curse/punish you alone. As a result, you and all other snakes will scurry across the ground on your bellies, and so what you eat will have dirt on it as long as you live.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan nan decur ineh, "Ui miak ngula' derehmu kareb iko mali', idi dengan derehmu iko miak nenganak, idi teh iko geregan ku awanmu, idi ieh pana' pa luunmu.”
english: Then Yahweh said to the man, “You heeded what your wife said, and you ate some of the fruit of the tree concerning which I commanded you saying, ‘Do not eat it.’ So I will make it difficult to grow things in the ground because of what you did. You will have to work hard as long as you live to produce things from the ground to eat.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan Allah, "Nekini lemulun ini pangeh mangun mepad kudeng Tau, ngaceku ieh kali' do' idi dat. Idi na miak kuman bua' ratnan lawa kayuh ulun ineh idi na ieh mulun ruked-ruked.”
english: So Yahweh God expelled the man and his wife from the garden of Eden. Yahweh God had created Adam from the ground, but now he forced him to till that ground so that he could grow food to eat.

lun_bawang: Idi Adam nepamung dengan awanneh Hawa. Idi ieh mali' idi nenganak aceh anak deléi, ieh ineh Kain. Idi kebalaneh, "Ui pangeh nengalap aceh anak deléi ngaceku Tuhan ngedengan negku.”
english: Adam ◄had sex/slept► with his wife Eve, and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son whom she named Cain, which sounds like the word that means ‘produce’, because, she said, “By Yahweh’s help I have produced a son.” Some time later she gave birth to another son, and she named him Abel.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Kain, "Ngudeh iko museh idi tekedamut?
english: Yahweh said to Cain, “◄You should not be angry!/Why are you angry?► RHQ ◄You should not scowl like that!/Why do you scowl like that?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Kain ni Abil, kinanakneh ineh, "Do' kiteh amé' bang pulung." Idi kareb didueh nalan bang pulung ineh, petacu Kain nenecat ni Abil, idi ieh nengaté neneh.
english: But one day, Cain said to his younger brother Abel, “Let’s go for a walk in the fields.” So they went together. And when they were in the countryside, suddenly Cain attacked Abel and killed him.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Kain, "Iapehké Abil, kinanakmu ineh?" Idi kebala Kain, "Na kali'ku. Uiké luk matar kinanakku?”
english: Later, even though Yahweh knew what Cain had done, he said to Cain, “Do you know where Abel, your younger brother, is?” Cain replied, “No, I do not know. ◄My job is not to guard my younger brother!/Am I supposed to take care of my younger brother?►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan, "Ngudehké iko nenganau' kudeng ineh? Arod dara' kinanakmu pindengerKu ngitang ratnan tana', mepad kudeng tang luk sikal ngua'.
english: Yahweh said, “You have done a terrible thing RHQ! So now it is as though your younger brother’s voice is crying to me from the ground, demanding that his death must be avenged.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Kain nan Tuhan, "Ukumku ini pelaba berat kuanku.
english: Cain replied, “You are punishing me more then I can endure.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Kain, "Ngacheku ineh idé luk ngaté Kain ineh miak uen ngua' tudu' kua'." Idi Tuhan nenganau' aceh etu luun Kain, pad ieh na miak pitayen idé-idé luk papu' neneh.
english: But Yahweh said to him, “No, that will not happen. I will put a mark on you to warn anyone who sees you that I will punish him severely if he kills you. I will punish that person seven times as severely as I am punishing you.” Then Yahweh put a mark on Cain’s forehead.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Lamék kuan dueh awanneh ineh, "Ada idi Sila, ninger medueh ratnan balaku. Ui pangeh nengaté seburur anak adi', ngaceku ieh nemepag negku.
english: One day Lamech said to his two wives, “Adah and Zillah, listen carefully to what I am saying. A young man struck me and wounded me, so I killed him.

lun_bawang: Idi Adam nepamung dengan awanneh teh, idi awanneh nenganak aceh anak deléi, idi anak ineh titenneh Set, kebalaneh, "Allah pangeh nemaré kuanku aceh inul luk baken, ku libal Abil ngaceku ieh pangeh pinaté Kain ineh.”
english: Adam continued to ◄have sex/sleep► with EUP his wife, and she became pregnant and gave birth to another son, whom she named Seth, which sounds like the Hebrew word that means ‘given’, because, she said, “God has given me another child to take the place of Abel, since Cain killed him.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh neneten ngadanneh Noh, kebalaneh, "Anak ini luk miak ngubuk netau bang erur tau idi bang ét ticu' tau ngaceku ratnan tana' ini luk pangeh kidiman Tuhan.”
english: whom he named Noah, which sounds like the Hebrew word that means ‘relief’, because he said, “He will bring us relief from all the hard work we have been doing to produce food from the ground that Yahweh cursed.”

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nepebala, "RohKu na miak mudeng bang niat lemulun macing ruked-ruked, ngaceku ieh ratnan ulun tana' ini, iamo' ieh miak mulun 120 lak mo'.”
english: Then Yahweh said, “I will not allow  my Spirit to keep people alive forever (OR, the breath of life will not remain in people forever). They will die eventually. They will live not more than 120 years before they die (OR, there will be only 120 more years before they die).”

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nepebala, "Ui pian ngaté lemulun luk pangeh inau'Ku luun tana'. Idi Ui pian ngaté amung-amung pung idi suit teh. Ui nginuud ngaceku Ui pangeh nemudut nedeh.”
english: So he said, “I will completely destroy the people I made. I will also destroy all the animals and the creatures that scurry across the ground and the birds. None of them will remain on the earth, because I regret that I made them.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Allah ni Noh, "Ui pian ngaté amung-amung lemulun, ngaceku tana' ini pangeh pinu'deh ku sala'deh.
english: So God said to Noah, “I have decided to destroy everyone, because all over the earth people are acting violently toward each other. So I am about to get rid of them as well as everything else on the earth.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan Allah ni Noh, "Semuet iko dengan amung uang tetek ruma'mu bang alud rayeh ineh, ngaceku iko mo' luk matu pa kiungKu arang amung-amung lemulun luk luun tana' ini.
english: Then Yahweh said to Noah, “I have seen that out of everyone who is now living, you alone always act righteously. So you and all your family go into the boat.

lun_bawang: "Remuat iko rat bang alud ineh, dengan awanmu idi anak-anakmu, idi awandeh.
english: “Leave the boat, along with your wife and your sons and their wives.

lun_bawang: Idi Allah nengeperuan ni Noh dengan anak-anakneh, idi kebalaNeh nedeh, "Do' muyuh mula' anak idi iuk amé mula', pad manu' tana' ini.
english: Then God blessed Noah and his sons, saying to them, “I want you to have many children who will live all over the earth.

lun_bawang: "Ngerawé do'-do', Ui ini ngeletep pejani'Ku kuan muyuh idi kuan inul muyuh,
english: “Listen carefully. I am now making a solemn promise to you and with your descendants,

english: Then God said to Noah, “The rainbow will be the sign of the promise that I have made to all the creatures that live on the earth.”

lun_bawang: Kabalaneh, "Kediman kuan Kanaan! Ieh mangun ku demulun amung kinanakneh.
english: He said, “I am cursing Ham’s youngest son, Canaan, and his descendants. They will be like slaves to their uncles.

lun_bawang: Ubur kuan Tuhan, luk Allah Sem! Kanaan ineh mangun ku demulunneh.
english: I will ask God to enlarge the territory that belongs to Japheth, and allow his descendants to live peacefully among the descendants of Shem MTY.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh seburur lun nganup luk meluun tueh pa kiung Tuhan; ngaceku ineh pangeh bila, "Do' iko mepad kudeng Nimrod, seburur lun nganup luk meluun tueh pa kiung Tuhan.”
english: Yahweh saw that he had become (OR, caused him to become) a great hunter. That is why people say to a great hunter, “Yahweh ◄sees that you are/has caused you to be► a great hunter like Nimrod.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh seburur dengan seburur, "Do' tau nganau' tana' mangun ku batu bata idi ngeseb ineh do'-do'." Idi batu bata ineh mangun ku libal batu idi amut mangun ku libal tana' salit.
english: Then they said to each other, “◄Hey/Come on►, let’s form bricks and bake them to make them hard, for building!” So they used bricks instead of stones, and used tar instead of ◄mortar/a mixture of cement, sand and lime► to hold them together.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebaladeh, "Do' tau mudut aceh bawang idi aceh pudut luk medita', idi budukneh macing déi' langit, idi ratnan ineh tau miak mebala, pad tau na mepatad bang aput tana' ini.”
english: They said, “Hey, let’s build a city for ourselves! We also ought to build a very high tower that reaches up to the sky! In that way we will become famous! If we do not do this, we will be scattered all over the earth!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh, "Siruh, amung-amung lemulun ini mepad, idi amung- amungdeh mepad buri' teh! Idi ini luk pun-pun inau'deh; idi nekini na luk mebpeng nedeh na nganau' anun-anun luk piandeh.
english: Yahweh said, “These people are one group that all speak the same language. If they have begun to do this now, then ◄there is nothing that they will decide to do that will be impossible for them/they will be able to do whatever they decide to do► LIT!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Abram, "Remuat iko ratnan bawangmu, pupumu, idi ruma' tamanmu, amé' bawang luk badénKu namu.
english: Then Yahweh said to Abram, “Leave this country where you are now living. Leave your father’s clan and his family. Go to a land that I will show you.

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nesilagan ni Abram, kebalaNeh, "Ui maré tana' ini kuan inulmu." Idi su ineh Abram nemudut aceh bubpun kuan Tuhan luk pangeh nesilagan neneh.
english: Then Yahweh appeared to Abram and said to him, “I will give this land to your descendants.” Then Abram built a stone altar to offer a sacrifice to Yahweh because Yahweh had appeared to him.

lun_bawang: Idi kareb ieh lélé macing déi' Masir, idi kebalaneh nan awanneh ineh, "Ui kali' namu seburur decur luk metaga.
english: Just as they were about to enter Egypt, Abram said to his wife Sarai, “Listen, I know that you are a very beautiful woman.

lun_bawang: Idi raca' nenawar ni Abram, idi kebalaneh, "Kudeng apeh luk inau'mu negku? Ngudeh iko na maré kali' negku ratnan decur ineh awanmu?
english: When the king realized why that was happening, he summoned Abram and said to him, “Why did you do this to me? Why did you not tell me that she was your wife?

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Abram ni Lut, "Kiteh ini dingetameh. Na do' demulun kiteh pekedaluh.
english: So Abram said to Lot, “Since we are close relatives, it is not good for us two to quarrel, or for the men who take care of your animals to quarrel with the men who take care of my animals.

lun_bawang: Pangeh Lut nepatad rat ni Abram, kebala Tuhan ni Abram, "Do' iko nier libut-libut rat su luk inanmu tuped ineh.
english: After Abram and Lot separated, Yahweh said to Abram, “Look around at this whole area where you are. Look north and south, look east and west.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengeperuan ni Abram, kebalaneh, "Allah luk Meluun Dita', ieh ineh Allah luk nemudut langit idi tana' ngeperuan ni Abram.
english: Then he blessed Abram, saying “I ask the Supreme God, the one who created heaven and earth, to bless you.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' Sodom ni Abram, "Maré kuanku amung-amung lun ineh, iamo' amung-amung binaweh lapenmu.”
english: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “You can keep all the goods you recovered. Just let me take back the people from my city whom you rescued.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Abram, "Ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan Allah luk Meluun Dita', luk nemudut langit idi tana',
english: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have solemnly promised MTY to Yahweh, the Supreme God, the one who created heaven and earth,

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh, bala Tuhan nacing kuan Abram bang aceh luk sinierneh. "Aleg iko matot, Abram, ngaceku Ui luk utapmu. Idi rayeh tu tabparmu.”
english: Some time later, Abram had a vision in which Yahweh spoke to him and said, “Do not be afraid of ◄anything/your enemies►. I will protect you MTY, and I will give a great reward.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Abram, "O Tuhan Allah, anunké ulek tabparMu kuanku, ngaceku ui na anak? Idi Elieser lun Damsik ineh luk ngalap binawehku.
english: But Abram replied, “Yahweh God, how can you give me what I truly want, because I have no children, and the one who will be like a son and inherit all my possessions is my servant Eliezer from Damascus!”

lun_bawang: Idi Iko na nemaré anak kuanku, iamo' seburur demulunku luk miak ngalap amung-amung luk ui kuan.”
english: Abram added, “You have not given me any children, so think about this: A servant in my household will inherit all I own!”

lun_bawang: Idi teh, kebala Tuhan neneh, "Demulun ineh na miak ngalap binawehmu, iamo' anak bururmu sebuleng luk ngalap ineh.”
english: Yahweh replied, “No! He will not be the one who will inherit it. Instead, you yourself will be the father of the one who will inherit everything you own.”

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nenguit neneh remuat idi nepebala, "Tengook iko déi' langit, ngiap amung-amung gituen, kudeng iko miak ngiap amung-amungdeh. Kudeng ineh teh inulmu.”
english: Then Yahweh took Abram outside of his tent and said, “Look up at the sky! Can you count the stars? No, you cannot count them because there are so many of them, and your descendants will be as numerous as the stars.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Ui ini Tuhan luk nenated namu remuat rat bang bawang Ur Kasdim, pad maré tana' ini ku babpatmu ruked-ruked.”
english: Yahweh also said to him, “I am Yahweh. I am the one who brought you from Ur in Chaldea land. I brought you here to give you this land to possess.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Abram, "O Tuhan Allah, kudeng apehké ui kali' tana' ini mangun ku babpatku ruked-ruked?”
english: But Abram replied, “Yahweh God, how can I know for sure that this land will belong to me?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Do' nguit kuanKu sebuleng sapi' tineh, sebuleng amék tineh teh, sebuleng dumba deléi luk teluh lak ulunneh, idi suit sukur sebuleng, idi sebuleng anak suit limun.”
english: God said to him, “Bring a three-year-old heifer and a three-year-old goat to me, and a dove and a pigeon.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Abram, "Inulmu ineh miak mangun ku lun sakai bang bawang dulun. Idi ideh miak mangun ku demulun lun bang bawang ineh, idi ruendeh ngedereh apat ngeratu lak kinioneh.
english: Then God said to Abram, “I want you to know that your descendants will become foreigners living in a land that does not belong to them. They will become slaves of the owners of that land. The owners of the land will mistreat them for 400 years.

lun_bawang: Idi bang aco sineh teh Tuhan nepejani' ni Abram, kebalaNeh, "Ui pejani' maré tana' ini kuan inulmu, ieh ineh rat lakan Masir macing déi' Abpa' Pirat,

lun_bawang: kebalaneh, "Kudeng muyuh maré negku nanem awanku su ini, idi do' muyuh mutuh ni Epron Sohar lun Hiti ineh,

english: So, just to make the customary reply to start the real discussion about a price, Ephron said, “No, sir, listen to me. I will give to you the field and the cave in it, without charge, with the people here as witnesses.”

lun_bawang: "O tuan, na mekudeh ratnan raga tana' ineh, luk apat ngeratu balad pirak. Nanem mo' awanmu su ineh.”
english: “Sir, listen to me. The land is worth 400 pieces of silver. But the price is not important to you and me. Give me the money and bury your wife’s body there.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Ibrahim neneh, "Aleg tu-tu iko nguit anakku lemubed amé' déi'.
english: Abraham replied to him, “No! Be certain that you don’t take my son there!

english: After she had finished giving him a drink, she said, “I will also get some water for your camels, until they have had enough to drink.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh, "Anak idé iko ini? Do' mada' negku. Inanké luk inan kai ucu' déi' bang ruma' tamanmu?”
english: Then he said, “Tell me whose daughter you are. Also, tell me, is there room in your father’s house for me and my men to sleep there tonight?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala decur ineh neneh, "Ui ini anak Betuil Nahor didueh Milka.

lun_bawang: Kai inan uduh luk tekering idi luk kenen unta pana' inan petap, idi luk inan ucu' pana' inan.”
english: Yes, we have room where you all can sleep tonight, and we also have plenty of straw and grain to feed the camels.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Laban, "Do' umak bang ruma'ku. Iko seburur lemulun luk inan Tuhan pangeh nemaré peruan. Ngudeh iko tuped déi' liang? Ui pangeh nganau' temina' luk inan kuanmu idi kuan amung unta ineh pana'.”
english: He said to the man, “You who have been blessed by Yahweh, come with me! ◄Why are standing out here?/You should not keep standing out here!► RHQ I have prepared a room for you in the house, and a place for the camels to stay.”

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh ideh nemaré akan. Iamo' keburi' lemulun ineh, "Na ui miak kuman kareb nateh ui pangeh nemada' amung-amung balaku atun." Idi kebala Laban, "Do' mada' ineh.”

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "Ui ini demulun Ibrahim.

lun_bawang: Siruh, ui tuped iring subuk ini. Kareb seburur anak adi' decur remuat ngalap abpa' idi ui pebala neneh, "Maré sesuut abpa' rupenku rat bang sidangurmu ineh,”
english: Listen to me. I am standing beside a well. A young woman may come to draw water. I will say to her, “Please, give me a little water to drink from your jar.”

lun_bawang: idi kudeng decur ineh pebala, "Ngirup iko idi ui miak ngalap abpa' rupen amung-amung untamu pana'," do' ieh mangun ku decur luk pinili' Tuhan kuan anak tuanku.'
english: If she says to me, “Certainly, drink some! And I will also draw some water for your camels,” that will be the woman whom you have chosen for my master’s son!’

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Laban idi Betuil, "Amung ini ratnan Tuhan; idi na kai miak mutut ini.
english: Laban and Bethuel answered, “It is clear that Yahweh has caused this to happen. So we two cannot say anything more.

lun_bawang: Idi lun duken ineh nekuman idi nengirup, dengan amung lun luk maya' neneh, idi ideh rudap sedacem déi'. Kareb ideh nekulat pekak idi kebala lun duken ineh, "Do' maré negku muli' amé' inan tuanku.”
english: Then they ate a meal together. The men who were with Abraham’s servant also slept there that night. The next morning, the servant said, “Allow me now to return to my master.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala kinanakneh, idi tinanneh, "Nima' Yamu tudo dengan kai pulu' aco teh. Pangeh ineh ieh miak amé'.”
english: But her brother and her mother replied, “Let the girl remain with us for about ten days. After that, you may take her and go.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebalaneh nedeh, "Aleg muyuh ngimet negku, ngaceku Tuhan pangeh nengeperuan lawéku. Do' nima' negku muli' amé' inan tuanku.”
english: But he replied to them, “Yahweh has made my journey successful, so do not detain me. Let me take her back to my master now!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh neneh, "Do' tau nawar ni Yamu idi ngitun neneh.”
english: They said, “Let’s call Rebekah and ask her what she wants to do.” MTY

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nenawar Ribeka, kebaladeh neneh, "Sikalké iko amé' maya' lemulun ini?" Idi kebalaneh, "Ui sikal amé'.”
english: So they summoned Rebekah and asked her, “Will you go with this man now?” She replied, “Yes, I will go.”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengeperuan ni Ribeka, kebaladeh, "Do' kinanak kai mangun ku tinan tuda'-tuda' juta lemulun. Idi do' anak inulmu metueh ratnan amung- amung bunu'deh!”
english: Before they all left, they asked God to bless Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, we ask that Yahweh will cause you to have millions of descendants, and allow them to completely defeat MET all those that hate them.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nan lun duken ineh, "Idéké deléi luk nalan déi' natad ineh luk amé' matun netau?" Idi kebala lun duken ineh, "Ieh ineh tuanku." Idi Ribeka nengalap ebpu uluhneh idi nemapen kiungneh.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Inan dueh pupu bang nakanmu. Iko miak nenganak dueh pupu luk pekedaluh. Sebuleng meluun tueh ratnan sebuleng. Seluk isuut miak ngimet seluk rayeh.”
english: Yahweh said to her, “The older one of your twins will serve the younger one. The twins will be ancestors of two nations. And those two people-groups will separate from each other.” CHI

english: He said to Jacob, “Give me some of that red stew to eat right now, because I am very hungry!” That is why Esau’s other name was Edom, which sounds like the Hebrew word that means ‘red’.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yakub, "Ui maré ineh namu, kudeng iko maré negku babpat anak luk atun.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yakub, "Do' iko pebulung negku atun." Idi ieh pana' nepebulung kuanneh, idi nemaré babpat anak luk atun ineh kuan Yakub.

So Isaac named it Rehoboth, which means ‘uninhabited place’, saying, “Yahweh has given us an uninhabited place to live in, a place that is not wanted by other people, and we will become very prosperous here.”

english: The first night that he was there, Yahweh appeared to him and said, “I am God, whom your father Abraham worshiped. Do not be afraid of anything. I will help you and bless you, and because of what I promised my servant Abraham, I will greatly increase the number of your descendants.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Isak nediteluh, "Anunké punneh meteluh amé' negku, ngaceku muyuh megateh negku idi muyuh pangeh nengecuk negku buro rat nemuyuh?”

english: One of them answered, “We have seen that Yahweh helps you. So we said to each other, ‘We should have an agreement between us and you. We should make a peace treaty with you,

english: That day Isaac’s servants came to him and told him about the well that they had finished digging. They said, “We found water in the well!”

english: Jacob took it to his father and said, “My father!” Isaac replied, “I’m here; which of my sons are you?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yakub kuan tamanneh, "Ui ini Esau, anakmu luk rayeh, idi ui pangeh nenganau' mepad kudeng luk bilamu. Nekini do' iko tumui idi tudo kuman pung luk ilapku, pad iko maré peruan negku.”
english: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau, your firstborn son. I did what you told me to do. Sit up and eat some of the meat so that you can then bless me.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Isak, "Kudeng apehké iko mesaget nengalap ineh, Asi?" Idi kebalaneh, "Ngaceku Tuhan Allahmu nengedengan negku.”
english: But Isaac asked his son, “My son, how is it that you were able to find and kill an animal so quickly?” Jacob replied, “Because Yahweh, whom you worship, enabled me to be successful.”

english: Isaac said to Jacob, “Come near to me, my son, so that I can touch you and determine whether you are really my son Esau.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yakub iné' muneng nan tamanneh, idi Isak nengakem neneh, kebalaneh, "Balamu kudeng bala Yakub, iamo' ticu' ini ticu' Esau.”
english: So Jacob went close to him. Isaac. Isaac touched him and said, “Your voice sounds like Jacob, but your hands feel hairy, like the hands of your older brother, Esau.”

english: But first Isaac asked, “Are you really my son Esau?” Jacob replied, “Yes, I am.”

english: Isaac said, “My son, bring me some of the meat that you have cooked, so that I may eat it and then give you my blessing.” So Jacob brought him some, and he ate it. Jacob also brought him some wine, and he drank it.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala tamanneh neneh, "O Asi, do' iko amé' muneng idi muen negku.”

english: Esau cooked some tasty meat and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “My father, please sit up and eat some of the meat that I have cooked, so that you can then give me your blessing!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Isak, "Idéké iko ini?" Idi kebalaneh, "Ui ini Esau, anakmu luk atun.”
english: His father, Isaac, said to him, “Who are you?” He answered, “I am Esau, your firstborn son!”

lun_bawang: Idi Isak pelaba gegker, kebalaneh, "Idéké luk nengeret pung ineh idi luk nenguit ineh iné' negku? Ui nekuman ineh kareb nateh iko nacing. Idi ui pangeh nengeperuan neneh. Idi kali' rungen peruan ineh kuanneh macing ruked-ruked.”
english: Then Isaac, realizing that it was not Esau who had come earlier, trembled very violently. He said, “Then who is it that brought me some meat from an animal that he had hunted and killed, and I ate it all? He was here just before you came. I blessed him, and I cannot ◄take back that blessing/declare that those things will not happen to him►.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Esau neninger bala tamanneh, idi ieh nengitang idi mesusa' niat, kebalaneh kuan tamanneh, "O Ama', maré peruan kuanku teh.”
english: When Esau heard those words of his father, he cried loudly. He was very disappointed. He said to his father, “My father, bless me, too!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Isak, "Kinanakmu nacing dengan naluk, idi nengalap peruanmu ineh.”
english: But his father said, “Your brother came deceitfully and took your blessing!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Esau, "Naké ieh matu titen lun, Yakub? Ngaceku nekini dueh kua' ieh pangeh nenaluk negku. Idi ieh pangeh nengaro babpatku luk rayeh. Idi nekini peruanku pana' ilapneh." Idi kebala Esau, "Naké iko maré peruan kuanku teh?”
english: Esau said, “It is right RHQ that his name is Jacob, which means ‘cheat,’ because he deceived me two times. The first time he took my rights from being his firstborn son, and this time he took my blessing!” Then he asked, “Do you not have any blessing left for me?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Isak neneh, "Ui pangeh nengiding neneh mangun ku tuanmu, idi ui pangeh nenganau' amung-amung pupuneh mangun ku demulunneh. Ui pangeh nemaré kuanneh padé idi abpa' anggur teh. Anunké luk barénku namu peh?”
english: Isaac answered and said to Esau, “I have declared that your younger brother will rule over you, and declared that all his relatives will serve him. And I have said that God will give him plenty of grain and grapes for wine. So, my son, ◄what can I do for you?/There is nothing more that I can do for you!►” RHQ

english: Esau said to his father, “My father, do you have only one blessing? My father, bless me, too!” Then Esau cried very loudly.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Isak neneh, "Luk inanmu tebawang na tana' mebaleng, idi na luk idi ipup kuan lati'mu.
english: His father Isaac answered and said to him, “The place where you will live will be far from the fertile soil and from the dew that God sends from heaven to water the fields.

english: So, because his father had given a blessing to Jacob, and not to him, Esau hated his younger brother. Esau thought to himself, “After my father dies and we finish mourning for him, I will kill Jacob!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Ribeka nekali' ratnan terawé Esau ineh, idi ieh nengecuk nawar ni Yakub, kebalaneh, "Do' iko ninger, kinanakmu Esau pian ngua' datmu idi ngaté namu.
english: But Rebekah found out what her older son, Esau, was thinking. So she summoned her younger son, Jacob, and said to him, “Listen to me. Your older brother, Esau, is comforting himself by planning to kill you, to get revenge because of your deceiving your father.

lun_bawang: Idi Isak nenawar ni Yakub idi nepetabi' neneh, kebalaneh, "Aleg iko ngalap awan ratnan decur lun Kanaani.
english: Then Isaac summoned Jacob, and gave him a blessing. He told him, “Do not marry a woman of the Canaan people-group.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nenier Tuhan tuped iringneh. Idi kebala Allah, "Ui ini Tuhan, Allah Ibrahim idi Isak; idi tana' su luk inanmu telubid ineh pana' Ui miak maré kuanmu idi inulmu.
english: And he was surprised to see Yahweh standing at the top of the stairway, saying “I am Yahweh God, whom your grandfather Abraham worshiped, and whom Isaac worships. I will give to you and to your descendants the land on which you are lying.

lun_bawang: Idi Yakub nekulat, idi kebalaneh, "Tuhan idi ieni, idi na ui nekali' Neneh.”
english: During the night, when Jacob woke up from sleeping, he thought, “Surely Yahweh is in this place, and until now I was not aware of it!”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh matot, kebalaneh, "Su ini inan luk katot! Kali' rungen ini ruma' Allah, idi tanga' surga teh.”
english: He was afraid, and he said, “This place is very awesome! This is surely the place where God lives, and this is the entrance to heaven!”

lun_bawang: Idi Yakub nepejani', kebalaneh, "Kudeng Iko idi denganku idi matar negku bang amung lawéku, idi maré akan idi ayungku,
english: Jacob solemnly promised God, saying, “God, if you will help me and protect me while I am taking this journey, and if you give me enough food to eat and clothes to wear,

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yakub nedeh, "O kinanak-kinanakku, rat iapeh muyuh?" Kebaladeh, "Kai rat Haran.”
english: On that day, Jacob asked the shepherds who were sitting there, “Where are you from?” They replied, “We are from Haran.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nedeh, "Kali' muyuh Laban Nahor?" "Kali'.”
english: He asked them, “Do you know Laban, the grandson of Nahor?” They replied, “Yes, we know him.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yakub nedeh, "Do' ieh?" Idi kebaladeh, "Do'. Siruh, ineh anakneh, Rakel macing dengan aya'neh!”
english: Jacob asked them, “Is Laban well?” They replied, “Yes, he is well. Look! Here comes his daughter Rachel with the sheep!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yakub, "Siruh, aco ini macang teh. Nateh karebneh miak inan ngamung dumba. Do' maré nedeh ngirup, idi nguit nedeh amé' luun laman.”
english: Jacob said, “Hey! The sun is still high in the sky. It is not time for the flocks to be gathered for nighttime. Give the sheep some water and then take them back to ◄graze/eat grass► in the pastures!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "Na kai miak nganau' kudeng ineh, kareb nateh amung riudan aya' ineh imung idi lemulun ngelubid batu luk munung subuk ineh, pad kai maré luk rupen amung-amung dumba ineh.”
english: They replied, “No, we cannot do that until all the flocks are gathered here and the stone is removed from the top of the well. After that, we will give water to the sheep.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Laban neneh, "Matu iko pupuku luk muneng!" Idi Yakub netudo sebulan su ineh.
english: Then Laban said to him, “Truly, you are part of my family!” After Jacob had stayed there and worked for Laban for a month,

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Laban ni Yakub "Na petulu iko ngakem kuanku mo'-mo' sagan tu pana' iko pupuku. Anun luk pianmu ku tabparmu?”
english: Laban said to him “◄You should not work for me for nothing just because you are a relative of mine!/Why should you work for me for nothing just because you are a relative of mine?► RHQ Tell me how much you want me to pay you.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yakub mawa ni Rakel, idi kebalaneh ni Laban, "Ui ngakem tudu' lak kuanmu kudeng iko nima' negku ngalap ni Rakel ku awanku.”
english: Jacob ◄was in love with/wanted very much to be married to► Rachel, and he said, “I will work for you for seven years. That will be my payment for your letting me marry your younger daughter, Rachel.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Laban, "Meluun do' ui maré neneh namu ratnan ui maré neneh nelun baken. Do' iko tudo denganku.”
english: Laban replied, “It is better for me to let you marry her than for her to marry some other man!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yakub ni Laban, "Do' maré anakmu negku, ngaceku pangeh petap karebneh.”
english: After the seven years were ended, Jacob said to Laban, “Let me marry Rachel now, because the time we agreed upon for me to work for you is ended, and I want to marry her. EUP”

lun_bawang: Kareb pekak uka-uka Yakub nenier ni Lia. Idi kebala Yakub ni Laban, "Ngudeh iko nenganau' luk kudeng ini kuanku? Ui pangeh nengakem pad ui ngalap ni Rakel? Ngudeh iko nenaluk negku?”
english: The next morning, Jacob was shocked to see that it was Leah who was with him! So he went to Laban and told him very angrily, “◄What you have done to me is disgusting!/What is this that you have done to me?► RHQ I worked for you to get Rachel, did I not? So why did you deceive me?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Laban, "Bang bawang ini kai na miak maré anak luk isuut ngaweh atun ratnan seluk rayeh.
english: Laban replied, “In this land, it is not our custom to give a younger daughter to be married before we let someone marry our firstborn daughter.

lun_bawang: Idi Lia mali' idi nenganak seburur anak deléi, idi ieh nenganau' ngadanneh Rubin, kebalaneh, "Tuhan pangeh nenier derehku, pad deléiku mawa negku.”
english: Leah gave birth to a son, whom she named Reuben, which sounds like the Hebrew words that mean ‘Look, a son!’ She said, “Yahweh has seen that I was miserable, and because of that he has given me a son. Now, surely my husband will love me for giving birth to a son for him.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh mali' teh idi nenganak aceh anak deléi, idi kebalaneh, "Tuhan nekali' negku na inan Yakub mawa, idi Ieh nemaré anak ini kuanku." Idi ieh nenganau' ngadanneh Simion.
english: Later she became pregnant again and gave birth to another son. She said, “Because Yahweh has heard that my husband doesn’t love me, he has given me this son, too.” So she named him Simeon, which means ‘someone who hears’.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh mali' teh idi nenganak aceh anak deléi, idi kebalaneh, "Nekini deléiku muneng negku lek, ngaceku ui pangeh nenganak teluh anak deléi kuanneh.”
english: Later she became pregnant again, and gave birth to another son. She said, “Now, finally, my husband will hold me close to him.” So she named him Levi, which means ‘hold close’.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh mali' teh, idi nenganak aceh anak deléi, kebalaneh, "Sekua' ini ui sikal ngubur Tuhan." Idi ieh nenganau' ngadan anak ineh Yehuda. Idi ieh nugka' na akan peh.
english: Later she became pregnant again and gave birth to another son. She said, “◄This time/Now► I will praise Yahweh.” So she called his name Judah, which sounds like the Hebrew word that means ‘praise’. After that, she did not give birth to any more children for several years.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Rakel na anak, idi ieh temaruh inan kinanakneh luk rayeh, idi kebalaneh ni Yakub, "Maré negku inan anak, kudeng na luk idi, maté ui!”
english: Rachel realized that she was not becoming pregnant and giving birth to any children for Jacob. So she became jealous of her older sister, Leah, because Leah had given birth to four sons. She said to Jacob, “Enable me to become pregnant and give birth to children. If you do not do that, I think I will die!”

lun_bawang: Idi Yakub museh neneh, kebalaneh, "Miakké ui ngelibal Allah luk maré namu na anak?”
english: Jacob became angry with Rachel and said, “◄I am not God!/Am I God?► RHQ He is the one who has prevented you from becoming pregnant!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Rakel, "Siruh, ini demulunku Bilha. Do' iko pamung neneh, idi ieh inan anak kuanku, pad ui pana' ngalap anak rat neneh.”
english: Then she said, “Look, here is my female slave, Bilhah. ◄Sleep with/Have sex with► EUP her, so that she may become pregnant and give birth to children for me. In that way it will be as though ◄I have children/her children are mine►.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Rakel, "Allah pangeh nengamo luk pianku. Ieh pangeh neninger putuhku idi nemaré seburur anak deléi kuanku." Idi ieh nenganau' ngadan anakneh Dan.
english: Rachel said, “God has ◄vindicated me/judged my case and has decided that what I have done is right►. He has also heard my requests and has given me a son.” So she named him Dan, which sounds like the Hebrew word that means ‘he judged’.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Rakel, "Idi ui sikal metueh ratnan kinanakku, pad ui nengelaya' neneh." Idi ieh nenganau' ngadan anak ineh Naptali.
english: Then Rachel said, “I have had a great struggle to have children like my older sister, but truly I have a son.” So she named him Naphtali, which sounds like the Hebrew word that means ‘struggle’.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Lia, "Samal kuanku!" Idi ieh nenganau' ngadan anak ineh Gad.
english: Leah said, “I am truly fortunate!” So she named him Gad, which means ‘fortunate’.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Lia, "Samal kuanku, ngaceku amung decur miak ngesamal negku." Idi ieh nenganau' ngadan anak ineh Aser.
english: Leah said, “Now I am very happy, and people will call me happy.” So she named him Asher, which means ‘happy.’

lun_bawang: Kareb uned ngeranih padé, idi Rubin neremuat idi nengalap uduh pelamai déi' bang pulung, idi ieh nenguit ineh kuan tinanneh Lia, idi kebala Rakel ni Lia, "Maré aceh uduh pelamai luk ilap anakmu ineh.”
english: When it was time to harvest wheat, Reuben went out into the fields and saw some ◄mandrakes/plants that women eat to help them to become pregnant►. He brought some of them to his mother Leah. But Rachel saw them and said to Leah, “Please give me some of those plants that your son brought to you!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Lia neneh, "Iko pangeh nengalap deléiku? Nekini iko pian ngalap pelamai anakku teh?" Idi kebala Rakel, "Kudeng iko maré pelamai anakmu negku, idi iko miak pamung rudap dengan Yakub dacem ini.”
english: But Leah said to her, “No! ◄It was bad that you stole my husband!/Is it not bad enough that you stole my husband?► RHQ Now ◄are you going to take my son’s mandrake plants?/You want to take my son’s mandrake plants also, so that you can become pregnant!►” RHQ So Rachel said, “All right, Jacob can sleep with you tonight, if you give me some of your son’s mandrake plants.” So Leah ◄agreed/gave her some►.

lun_bawang: Kareb Yakub nacing rat luun lati' kareb malem aco, idi Lia iné' papu' neneh, kebalaneh, "Do' iko amé' rudap denganku dacem ini, ngaceku ui pangeh nenabpar namu ku pelamai anakku." Idi ieh nepamung neneh bang dacem ineh.
english: When Jacob returned from the wheat fields that evening, Leah went out to meet him. She said, “You must sleep with me tonight, because I gave Rachel some of my son’s mandrakes that enable women to become pregnant, to pay her for allowing us to do that.” So Jacob slept with her that night.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Lia, "Allah pangeh nemaré samal kuanku, ngaceku ui nemaré demulunku kuan deléiku." Idi ieh nenganau' ngadan anak ineh Iskar.
english: Leah said, “God has rewarded me for giving my slave to my husband to be another wife for him.” So she named him Issachar, which sounds like the Hebrew word that means ‘reward’.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Lia, "Allah pangeh nemaré aceh samal luk do' kuanku. Nekini deléiku miak tudo denganku, ngaceku ui pangeh nenganak anem anak deléi kuanneh." Idi ieh nenganau' ngadan anak ineh Sebulon.
english: Leah said, “God has given me a precious gift. ◄This time/Now► my husband will honor/respect me, because I have given birth to six sons for him.” So she named him Zebulon, which sounds like the Hebrew word that means ‘accepted gift’.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh mali' idi nenganak aceh anak deléi, kebalaneh, "Allah pangeh nengagka' igu'ku.”
english: She became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She said, “God has caused that no longer will I be ashamed for not having children.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nenganau' ngadan anak ineh Yusup, kebalaneh, "Do' Tuhan maré aceh anak deléi baruh teh kuanku!”
english: She named him Joseph, which sounds like the Hebrew words that mean ‘may he give another’  and she said, ‘ want Yahweh to give me another son.’

lun_bawang: Kareb Rakel pangeh nenganak Yusup, idi kebala Yakub ni Laban, "Nima' negku muli'.
english: After Rachel had given birth to Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Now allow me to quit working for you and let me return to my own land.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Laban neneh, "Nima' negku pebala: Ui pangeh nesibada' ratnan luk ginala' kuanku; ui kali' Tuhan nengeperuan negku ngaceku iko.
english: But Laban said to him, “If you are pleased with me, stay here, because I have found out by performing a magic ritual that Yahweh has blessed me because of what you have done for me.

lun_bawang: Do' ngegala' tabparmu, idi ui miak maré ineh.”
english: Tell me what you want me to pay you for continuing to work for me, and that is what I will pay you.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yakub, "Iko kali' ratnan kélku ngakem kuanmu, idi kudeng apeh do' amung aya'mu luk bang paladku.
english: Jacob replied, “You know how I have worked for you, and you know that your livestock have increased greatly as I have taken care of them.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Laban, "Anunké luk barénku namu?" Idi kebala Yakub, "Na ui pian ngalap tabpar anun-anun. Ui lutep maman idi matar amung-amung aya'mu baruh teh, kudeng iko maya' balaku.
english: Laban replied, “What do you want me to give you?” Jacob replied, “I do not want you to pay me anything. But if you will do this one thing for me, I will continue to take care of your flocks and protect them.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Laban, "Do'! Miak kiteh nganau' kudeng luk bilamu.”
english: Laban agreed and said, “Okay, we will do as you have said.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yakub neninger bala anak-anak Laban, kebaladeh, "Yakub pangeh nengalap amung-amung binaweh taman tau. Idi ratnan binaweh taman tau ieh mangun ku lun do'.”
english: Someone told Jacob that Laban’s sons were complaining and saying, “Jacob has become very rich by taking everything HYP that belonged to our father.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Yakub, "Muli' iko amé' bawang tepunmu idi matun pupumu. Ui miak ngedengan namu.”
english: Then Yahweh said to Jacob, “Go back to your country and your relatives, and I will help you there.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yakub nedidueh, "Pangeh ui nekali' kiung taman medueh, na ieh do' negku kudeng luk atun. Iamo' Allah tamanku idi denganku.
english: When they arrived, he said to them, “I see that your father does not act friendly toward me as he did previously. But God, whom my father worshiped, has helped me.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Rakel idi Lia ni Yakub, "Na luk idi babpat luk lapen kai ratnan taman kai teh.
english: Rachel and Leah replied, “Our father will not give us anything more when he dies RHQ.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Allah nesilagan ni Laban kareb medacem bang nupineh, kebalaNeh, "Matar do'-do', pad iko na ngesusa' ni Yakub.”
english: Then God appeared to Laban in a dream at night, and said to him, “When you catch up to Jacob, be sure that you do not say anything at all HYP to him in an angry manner!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Laban ni Yakub, "Ngudeh iko naluk negku, idi nenguit anak- anakku buro mepad kudeng lun luk tiban baweh?
english: Then Laban went to Jacob and said to him, “Why have you done this? You have deceived me by carrying away my daughters as though you had captured them in a war MTY!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yakub, "Ui matot, ngaceku ui ngerawé kali' rungen iko ngalap anak-anakmu rat negku.
english: Jacob replied to Laban, saying, “I did not tell you that we were planning to leave, because I was afraid. I thought that if I told you, you would forcefully take your daughters away from me.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Rakel nan tamanneh, "Aleg iko museh negku. Na ui miak tuped pa kiungmu, ngaceku ui macing bulan." Idi Laban nenakap akang ineh, iamo' na luk nekali'neh.
english: Rachel said to her father, “Do not be angry with me, sir, but I cannot get up in your presence to show respect for you, because I am having my monthly menstrual period. EUP” So when Laban searched some more, he did not find the wooden idols.

lun_bawang: Idi Yakub megateh niat, kebalahen, "Anun sala'ku idi datku pad iko nengerada' negku?
english: Then Jacob became angry. He rebuked Laban, saying, “What crime did I commit? For what sin that I committed have you pursued me?

lun_bawang: Idi pangeh dueh ngepulu' lak ini ui nepamung namu, idi dumbamu, idi amékmu iuk amé' mula' idi luk deléi bang riudan dumbamu pana' na luk kinanku.
english: I was with you for 20 years. In all that time, your sheep and goats have ◄not miscarried/always given birth to animals safely►. I have not killed and eaten any rams from your flocks.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengecuk anak itinneh ngamung batu ku aceh bubpun. Idi ideh nekuman iring bubpun batu ineh.
english: Then Jacob said to his relatives, “You also gather some stones.” So they gathered some rocks and put them in a heap, and they ate some food there near the heap.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Laban ni Yakub, "Bubpun batu ini mangun ku aceh terawé arang kiteh." Idi ngaceku ineh ngadan natad ineh Galid.
english: Laban said to Jacob, “This pile of rocks we have put here today will help us to remember our agreement.” That is why Jacob called it Galeed.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Laban, "Do' Tuhan matar arang kiteh, kareb kiteh mepatad seburur dengan seburur." Idi ngaceku ineh natad ineh titen Mispa teh.
english: They also named the place Mizpah, which sounds like the Hebrew word that means ‘watchtower’, because Laban said, “We will ask Yahweh to watch you and me while we are separated from each other, so that we do not try to harm each other.

lun_bawang: Siruh, bubpun batu luk ku terawé ini luk tipedku arangku denganmu.
english: Laban also said to Jacob, “You see this large stone and this pile of rocks that we have set up to be between us.

lun_bawang: Kareb Yakub nenier nedeh, kebalaneh, "Ini baweh Allah!" Idi ieh nenganau' ngadan su ineh Mahanaim.
english: When Jacob saw them, he said, “This is God’s army camp!” So he named that place Mahanaim, which means ‘two camps’.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh neperiteteng nedeh, kebalaneh, "Kudeng ini balamu ni Esau, tuanku: Idi kebala demulunmu Yakub, kudeng ini, 'Ui pangeh netudo dengan Laban macing nekini.
english: He told them, “This is what I want you to say to Esau: 'I, Jacob, want to be your servant and I want you to be my master. I have been living with our uncle Laban, and I have stayed there until now.

lun_bawang: Kareb lun luk icuk ineh nelemubed matun ni Yakub, idi kebaladeh, "Kai pangeh nepapu' ni Esau kinanakmu, idi ieh macing papu' namu, idi inan teh apat ngeratu lemulun maya' neneh.”
english: The messengers went and gave that message to Esau. When they returned to Jacob, they said, “We went to your older brother Esau. Now he is coming to you, and 400 men are coming with him.”

lun_bawang: Ngaceku keterawéneh, "Kudeng Esau macing inan sebuleng babpat idi ngelaya' nedeh, idi babpat luk baken ineh miak buro.”
english: He was thinking, “If Esau and his men come and attack us, perhaps one of the groups will be left and will be able to escape.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yakub nesembayang, "O Allah tepunku Ibrahim, luk Allah tamanku Isak, O Tuhan luk pangeh nepebala negku kudeng ini, 'Muli' iko amé' inan bawangmu idi matun pupumu, idi Ui nganau' do' kuanmu.'
english: Then Jacob prayed, “O Yahweh God, whom my grandfather Abraham worshiped and my father Isaac worships, you said to me, ‘Go back to your own land and to your relatives, and I will ◄cause good things happen to/do good things for► you.’

lun_bawang: Amung-amung pung ineh biréneh inan demulunneh, manid sengeriudan pitarindeh. Idi kebala Yakub nedeh, "Nalan muyuh atun, idi nganau' riudan pung ineh petala-petala.”
english: He divided them into small herds, and put each herd into the care of one of his servants. He said to his servants, “Go ahead of me, one group at a time, and keep some space between each herd.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nepebala nan luk pun-pun, "Kareb kinanakku Esau ineh papu' namu, kudeng ieh ngitun namu kudeng ini, 'Idéké kuan namu ini? idi 'Amé' iapeh iko?' idi 'Idéké kuan amung-amung luk pa atunmu ini?'
english: He said to the servant who was going with the first group, “When my brother Esau meets you, and he asks you, ‘To whom do you belong, and where are you going, and to whom do these animals in front of you belong?’

lun_bawang: Kudeng ineh teh balaneh kuan luk kedueh idi luk keteluh, idi kuan amung- amung luk nenguyut riudan pung ineh, kebalaneh, "Kudeng ineh luk miak belén muyuh kuan Esau kareb muyuh mepapu' neneh.
english: He also said the same thing to the servants who were taking care of the second and third groups, and to the other herdsmen. He said to them, “When you meet Esau, I want you to say to him the same thing that I told the first servant.

lun_bawang: Idi muyuh miak pebala teh, 'Matu Yakub demulunmu ineh idi pa puet.' " Ngaceku keterawé Yakub, "Ui sikal ngagka' usehneh ku baré luk tinated atun rat negku. Kareb ui papu' neneh, merapet neneh do' negku.”
english: And be sure to say ‘Jacob, who wants to serve you, is coming behind us.’” Jacob told them to say that because he was thinking, “Perhaps these gifts that I am sending ahead of me will cause him to ◄act peacefully toward/stop being angry with► me. Then later, when I see him, perhaps he will be kind to me.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh, "Do' ngelegkan Negku, ngaceku malé aco macang." Iamo' kebala Yakub, "Na ui sikal ngelegkan Namu kudeng Iko na ngeperuan negku.”
english: Then the man said, “Let me go, because it will soon be daylight.” Then Jacob realized who he was really wrestling with. So he replied, “No, if you will not bless me, I will not let you go!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh neneh, "Idé ngadanmu?" "Yakub," kebalaneh.
english: The man said to him, “What is your name?” He replied, “Jacob.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Lemulun ineh, "Na iko miak tetanen Yakub peh, iamo' Israil, ngaceku iko pangeh mangun kudeng aceh raca' pa kiung Allah, idi pa kiung lemulun pana', idi iko pangeh metueh.”
english: The man said, “Your name will no longer be Jacob. Your name will be Israel, which means ‘he struggles with God’, because you have struggled with God and with people, and you have won.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yakub, "Do' Iko mada' ngadanMu." Iamo' keburi'Neh, "Anunké punmu ngitun ngadanKu?" Idi Ieh nengeperuan ni Yakub su ineh.
english: Jacob said, “Now, please tell me your name!” The man replied, “◄Why do you ask me what my name is?/You should not have to ask me what my name is!►” RHQ But he blessed Jacob there.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yakub, "Ui pangeh nenier Allah kiung dengan kiung, idi ui mulun teh." Idi ieh neneten ngadan su ineh Peniel.
english: So Jacob named the place Peniel, which means ‘God’s face’, saying “I looked directly at God, but I did not die because of doing that.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yakub, "Na miak kudeng ineh, ui mutuh namu, kudeng iko méi' negku, do' ngalap baréku ini; ngaceku ui pangeh nenier kiungmu mepad kudeng nier ayu Allah, idi iko mawang niat negku.
english: But Jacob said, “No, please, if you feel good toward me, accept these gifts from me. You have greeted me very kindly. Seeing your smiling face assures me that you have forgiven me. It is like seeing the face of God!

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh neneh, "Na kai miak nganau' luk kudeng ineh, ieh ineh maré kinanak kai kuan lemulun luk na sinunat, ngaceku ini mangun ku sala' kuan kai.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala didueh ineh, "Na tau miak nima' kinanak kai uen ngigu', ayu- ayuneh ieh decur luk ngedeléi.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh neneh, "Ui ini Allah luk Meluun Lalud. Do' iko mula' anak. Idi pupu luk mula', idi raca'-raca' pana' miak mangun rat namu.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yakub neneh, "Do' iko amé' matun kinanak-kinanakmu, idi nier kudeng ideh do', dengan amung aya' ineh teh, idi iko miak nguit bala kuanku teh." Kudeng ineh Yakub nengecuk neneh nalan rat Ruan Hebron. Idi Yusup iné' dei' Sikem.
english: Jacob said, “Go and see if they are doing okay, and if the flocks are doing okay. Then come back and give me a report.” So Jacob sent Joseph from the valley where they were living, the valley where Hebron is located, to go north to find his brothers. When Joseph arrived near Shechem city,

lun_bawang: Idi inan seburur lemulun luk nepapu' neneh déi' kareb ieh nalan-nalan déi' bang laman ineh. Idi kebalaneh neneh, "Anunké luk tekapenmu?”

english: Joseph replied, “I am looking for my older brothers. Can you tell me where they are taking care of their sheep and goats?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lemulun ineh, "Ideh pangeh nenalan rat ieni, ngaceku ui neninger baladeh kudeng ini, 'Do' tau amé' déi' Dotan.' " Idi Yusup iné' nakap kinanak- kinanakneh, idi ieh nepapu' nedeh déi' Dotan.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yahuda nan kinanak-kinanakneh, "Anunké ulek tau ngaté kinanak tau idi ngapung neneh?
english: Judah said to his older and younger brothers, “If we kill our younger brother and hide his body, ◄what will we gain?/we will not gain anything!► RHQ

english: They took that pretty robe back to their father and said, “We found this robe! Look at it. Is it your son’s robe?”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengiti ineh, kebalaneh, "Ini kuyu' anakku. Kali' rungen ieh pinaté pung luk mesangit. Kali' rungen Yusup ineh inita' pung.”
english: He recognized it, and he said, “Yes, it is my son’s robe! Some ferocious/wild animal must have attacked and killed him! I am sure that the animal has torn Joseph to pieces!”

lun_bawang: Idi amung-amung anakneh luk deléi idi decur nacing ngubuk neneh. Iamo' na ieh sikal buken, kebalaneh, "Ngaceku anakku ini na idi, ui temido pad macing bang su inan até." Idi kudeng ineh tangi' tamanneh neneh.
english: All of his children came to try to comfort him, but he did not pay attention to what they said. He said, “No, I will still be mourning/crying when I die and go to be with my son.” So Joseph’s father continued to cry because of what had happened to his son.

lun_bawang: Idi Yahuda neguta dalan su luk inan decur ineh, idi kebalaneh, "Do', anun luk pianmu?" Idi na ieh kali' decur ineh ibanneh. Idi kebala decur ineh, "Anunké luk barénmu negku?”

english: He replied, “I will send you a young goat from my flock of goats.” She asked, “Will you give me something now for me to keep until you send the goat?”

lun_bawang: Idi Yahuda nengitun neneh, "Anunké taan luk barénku namu?" Idi kebala decur ineh, "Do' maré susing etumu dengan abetneh idi rukud luk bang paladmu ineh." Idi ieh nemaré amung ineh neneh. Idi ieh nepamung neneh. Pangeh ineh Tamar mali'.

Then he had sex EUP with her, and she became pregnant.

english: So he asked the men who lived there, “Where is the prostitute who was sitting by the road at Enaim?” They replied, “There has never been a prostitute here!”

english: So he went back to Judah and said, “I did not find her. Furthermore, the men who live in that town said, ‘There has never been a prostitute here.’”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yahuda, "Nima' neneh ngimet binaweh ineh kuanneh, pad ideh na situnga netau. Ui nenutun maré amék ini kuanneh, iamo' na iko nepapu' neneh.”
english: Judah said, “She can keep the things that I gave to her. If we continued to search for her, people would ridicule us. I tried to send this young goat to her, but you could not find her to give it to her.”

lun_bawang: Pangeh teluh bulan, idi lun nemada' ni Yahuda, kebaladeh, "Tamar, ibanmu ineh pangeh pasét, idi nekini ieh kebatek." Idi kebala Yahuda, "Do' nguit neneh remuat idi ngeseb neneh.”

lun_bawang: Kareb ieh inuitdeh, idi decur ineh nengecuk seburur matun ibanneh, kebalaneh, "Ui kebatek ratnan lemulun luk kuan binaweh ini. Siruh, idéké luk kuan susing etu ineh dengan abetneh idi rukud ini?”
english: But as they were taking her outside of the city, she gave the ring and walking stick to someone, and told him to take them to Judah, and say to him, “The man who owns these things is the one who caused me to become pregnant.” She also said to tell him, “Look at this ring, and the cord that is attached to it, and this walking stick. Whose are they?”

lun_bawang: Idi Yahuda nengamo, kebalaneh, "Decur ini meluun siri rat negku, ngaceku na ui maré neneh ku awan anakku Sela." Idi na Yahuda pamung rudap neneh peh.

english: As she was giving birth, one of them put out his hand. So the midwife fastened a scarlet thread around his wrist, saying, “This one came out first.”

english: But he pulled his hand back inside the womb, and his brother came out first. So she said, “So this is how you break your way out first!” So she named him Perez, which sounds like the Hebrew word that means ‘breaking out.’

lun_bawang: Mio rat pangeh ineh idi awan tuanneh ineh nileng neneh, kebalaneh, "Do' iko pamung rudap denganku.”
english: Because of that, after a while, his master’s wife started to look fondly at Joseph. So one day she said to him, “Have sex EUP with me!”

english: But he refused, saying to his master’s wife, “Listen! My master is not concerned about anything in this house. He has appointed me to take care of everything that he owns.

english: Then she told him this story: “That Hebrew slave whom you brought here came into my room and tried to rape me!

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nedidueh, "Ngudehké ayu medueh mesusa' bang aco sini?”
english: So he asked them, “Why do you look so sad today?”

english: One of them answered, “We both had dreams last night, but there is no one who can tell us the meaning of the dreams.” Joseph said to them, “God is the only one who can RHQ tell the meaning of dreams. So tell me what you dreamed, and God will tell me the meaning.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' neneh, "Ui pangeh nenginupi, idi seburur pana' nateh luk miak mada' ilungneh negku. Idi ui pangeh neninger, iko mileh mada' ilung nupi.”
english: The king said to Joseph, “I had two dreams, and no one can tell me what they mean. But someone told me that when you hear someone tell about a dream he has had, you can tell that person what the dream means.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusup, "Na ui mileh, O raca'; iamo' Allah miak maré or luk do' namu.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Bang nupiku, ui tuped tangeb Abpa' Nil.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' nedeh, "Tau na miak mili' seburur luk meluun do' ratnan Yusup luk inan Roh Allah bang neneh.”

english: Then he arranged for Joseph to ride around in the chariot that showed that he was the second-most important man in the country. When Joseph rode in the chariot, men shouted to the people who were on the road in front of him, “Get off the road!” So the king put Joseph in charge of everything in the country.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' neneh, "Ui ini raca', iamo' kudeng iko na pian, seburur pana' na miak nganau' anun-anun bang aput tana' Masir.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh, "Allah pangeh nenganau' negku kelupan amung-amung dereh, idi uang telek ruma' tamanku." Idi ieh nenganau' ngadan anakneh luk atun ineh Manasé'.
english: Joseph named the first one Manasseh, which sounds like the Hebrew word that means ‘forget’, because, he said, “God has caused me to forget all my troubles and all my father’s family.”

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebalaneh, "Allah pangeh nemaré anak kuanku bang bawang luk inanku medereh." Idi ieh nenganau' ngadan anakneh luk kedueh ineh Epraim.
english: He named his second son Ephraim, which means ‘to have children’, because, he said, “God has given me children here in this land where I have suffered.”

lun_bawang: Kareb lun Masir melau, idi ideh nengitang mutuh akan nan raca'. Idi kebalaneh nelun bawang Masir ineh, "Do' muyuh amé' ni Yusup, idi nganau' anun-anun luk belénneh nemuyuh.”
english: When all the people of MTY Egypt had eaten all of their own food and were still hungry, they begged the king for food. So the king told all the people of Egypt, “Go to Joseph, and do what he tells you to do.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yakub neninger ratnan bawang Masir inan akan, idi kebalaneh nan anak-anakneh, "Ngudeh muyuh tudo mo'-mo'?

lun_bawang: Ui pangeh neninger bala' déi' Masir inan akan. Do' muyuh amé' mulé kuan tau pad tau na maté.”

english: As soon as Joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them. But he pretended that he did not know them. He spoke harshly to them, saying, “Where do you come from?” One of them replied, “We have come from Canaan, to buy some grain.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yusup nengerawé ratnan nupineh nedeh. Idi kebalaneh nedeh, "Muyuh ini lun luk amé' nier bawang, idi kudeng apeh laya' bawang ini.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh neneh, "Na, iamo' kai ini demulunmu luk macing sikal melih akan.
english: One of them replied, “No, sir! We have come to buy grain.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusup nedeh, "Na, iamo' muyuh nacing nier laya' bawang.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "Amung kai ini pulu' dueh dinganak luk sebuleng taman déi' bang bawang Kanaan. Iamo' luk isuut ineh idi dengan taman kai, idi sebuleng na idi.”
english: But one of them replied, “No, that is not true! Originally there were twelve of us who were brothers, the sons of one man. Our younger brother is with our father. One younger brother has died. EUP”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yusup nedeh, "Matu balaku nemuyuh, muyuh ini lun luk amé' nier.
english: Joseph replied, “You are lying! I think it is just as I told you. You are spies!

lun_bawang: Bang aco luk keteluh kebala Yusup nedeh, "Ui ini matot inan Allah, idi muyuh miak mulun kudeng muyuh nganau' kudeng ini:

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh seburur dengan seburur, "Idi matu tau ini mesala' ratnan kinanak tau. Kareb tau nenier neneh bang dereh, idi kareb ieh nemutuh éi' rat netau, idi na tau neninger. Idi ini punneh dereh ini macing netau.”
english: They said to each other, “It is surely because of what we did to our younger brother that ◄we are being punished/God is punishing us►! We saw that he SYN was very distressed when he pleaded with us not to harm him. But we did not pay any attention to him, and that is why we are having this trouble!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Rubin nedeh, "Ui nemebpeng nemuyuh na ngesusa' anak ineh. Iamo' na muyuh neninger. Siruh nekini ua' dara'neh macing.”
english: Reuben said to them, “I told you not to harm the boy RHQ, but you did not pay attention to what I said! Now we are being ◄paid back/punished► for killing him MTY!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nan kinanak-kinanakneh, "Usinku ini linubed. Ini ieh munung tebpungku!" Idi ideh pelaba rapang peh, idi ideh megegker, ekbaladeh seburur dengan seburur, "Kudeng apehké luk inau' Allah ini kuan tau?”
english: He exclaimed to his brothers, “Someone has returned my money! Here it is in my sack!” They started shaking with fear, and said to each other, “What is this that God has done to us?”

lun_bawang: "Lun rayeh bawang ineh pelaba tueh balaneh nekai, ieh nengerawé nekai lun luk iné' ier bawang.
english: “The man who governs the whole land of Egypt talked very harshly to us. He acted toward us as though we were spying on his country.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yakub nedeh, "Muyuh ngesusa' negku. Na mio teh mabud anakku. Ngaceku Yusup na idi, idi Simion pana' na idi teh. Nekini muyuh sikal ngalap Beniamin teh. Ui luk medereh ku ineh.”
english: Their father Jacob said to them, “You have caused two of my children to be taken from me! Joseph is dead, and Simeon is gone! And now you want to take Benjamin from me! It is I who am suffering because of all these things that are happening!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Rubin nan tamanneh, "Miak iko ngaté dueh anakku luk deléi, kudeng ui na ngelubed anak ini kuanmu. Do' maré neneh kuanku mo' kali' rungen ui nguit neneh lemubed amé' namu.”
english: Reuben said to his father, “I will be responsible for Benjamin. I will take him to Egypt and bring him back to you. Let me take care of him. If I do not bring Benjamin back to you, you may kill both of my sons.”

lun_bawang: Kareb pangeh nabud amung-amung padé luk inuitdeh rat déi bawang Masir ineh, idi kebala Yakub nan anak-anakneh, "Amé muyuh teh, melih sesuut akan kuan tau.”
english: Finally, when Jacob and his family had eaten all the grain they had brought from Egypt, Jacob said to them, “Go back to Egypt and buy some more grain for us!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yahuda neneh, "Idi lun rayeh bawang ineh nepebala nekai dengan megateh, kebalaneh, 'Muyuh na miak nier kiungku teh, kudeng na muyuh nguit kinanak muyuh luk isuut ineh amé' negku.'
english: But Judah said to him, “The man who sold us the grain warned us sternly, ‘I will not let you see me SYN again if you come and your younger brother is not with you.’

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yakub, "Ngudeh muyuh ngesusa' negku idi mada' lun rayeh ineh ratnan kinanak muyuh?”
english: Jacob asked, “Why did you cause me to have this trouble by telling the man that you had a younger brother?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yahuda nan tamanneh, "Do' maré anak ini maya' negku, idi kai sikal nalan, pelé amung tau na maté.
english: Then Judah said to his father Jacob, “Send the boy with me, and we will go immediately, in order that we and you and our children may get grain and not die from hunger.

lun_bawang: Kareb Yusup nenier Beniamin maya' nedeh, idi kebalaneh kuan lun luk ngimet ruma'neh, "Nguit lemulun ini amé' déi' ruma', idi ngeret sebuleng pung idi nanek neneh. Ngaceku ideh kuman denganku kareb muned aco napeh.”
english: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the man who ◄was in charge of/supervised► things in his house, “Take these men to my house. Slaughter an animal and prepare a meal, because I want them to eat with me at noon.” And he told him in what order they were to be seated.

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh, "O tuan, kai nacing pun-pun sikal melih akan;
english: one of them said to him, “Please, sir, listen to me. We came down here previously and bought some grain.

lun_bawang: Kebala lun luk ngasa' ineh nedeh, "Samal kuan muyuh, aleg matot; idi Allah muyuh idi Allah taman muyuh luk nenganau' usin bang tebpung muyuh ineh. Usin muyuh di pangeh ilapku." Idi ieh iné' nengeruat Simion kuandeh.
english: The man replied, “Relax! Do not worry about it! I received the silver that you brought. Your God, the God your father worships, must have put it in your sacks.” And then he brought Simeon to them from the prison.

lun_bawang: Idi Yusup nengitun ratnan ulundeh, kebalaneh, "Do'ké taman muyuh, lun rayeh luk bila muyuh ineh? Mulunké ieh teh?”
english: He asked them if they were ◄well/in good health►, and then he asked, “How is the health of your old father, the one that you told me about? Is he still living?”

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh, "Taman kai demulunmu ineh mulun idi metueh teh." Idi ideh netekeradung idi nengerayeh neneh.
english: One of them replied, “Yes, our father, who is willing to be your servant, is still alive, and he is well.” Then again they bowed down in front of him.

lun_bawang: Kareb Yusup nenier kinanakneh Beniamin luk sebuleng tinan denganneh, idi kebalaneh, "Iniké kinanak muyuh luk isuut luk pangeh bila muyuh negku? Do' Allah méi' namu, O Asi!”
english: Then he saw his younger brother Benjamin, his own mother’s other son. He asked them, “Is this your youngest brother, the one whom you told me about?” After they said “Yes,” he said to Benjamin, “Young man, I pray that God will act kindly toward you.”

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh ieh nemaru' kiungneh idi neremuat; dengan ngagka' tangi'neh, kebalaneh, "Do' nguit luk kenen.”
english: Then, after he washed the tears from his face, he came out, and controlling his emotions, he said to the servants, “Serve the food!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusup nelun luk ngasa' ruma'neh, "Do' muang amung-amung tebpungdeh ineh ku padé, pad petap luk itendeh, idi nipa usindeh munung tebpungdeh anid-anid.
english: When his brothers were ready to return home, Joseph said to the man who was in charge of things in his house, “Fill the sacks of those men with as much grain as they can carry on their donkeys. And put in the top of each man’s sack the silver that he paid for the grain.

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh pangeh nenalan rat bang bawang ineh, na mado tu, idi kebala Yusup nelunluk ngasa' ruma'neh, "Nalan iko idi ngerada' nedeh ineh. Kareb iko mepigket nedeh, do' iko ngitun nedeh kudeng ini, 'Ngudeh muyuh ngua' luk do' ineh dengan luk dat?
english: When they had not gone far from the city, Joseph said to the servant in charge of things in his house, “Pursue those men immediately. When you catch up to them, say to them, ‘We did good things for you! Why have you paid us back by doing something bad to us?

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh neneh, "Anunké punneh iko mala luk kudeng ineh? Na kai nenganau' luk kudeng ineh!
english: But one of them replied to him, “Sir, why do you say such things? We are your servants, and we would never do anything like that!

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "Do'. Nidé luk inan sangkir ineh nekali', ieh ineh mangun ku demulunku, iamo' muyuh luk baken na sala'.”
english: The man replied, “Okay, I will do what you say. But the one who has the cup will not be executed. Instead, he will become my slave, and the rest of you may return home.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusup nedeh, "Kudeng apehké luk inau' muyuh ineh? Naké muyuh kali' lemulun luk kudeng ui ini miak ngegala' anun-anun luk inalum ineh?”
english: He said to them, “Why did you do this? Do you not know that a man like me can find out things that nobody knows?” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusup, "Na ui miak nganau' kudeng ineh! Iamo' lemulun luk nengalap sangkir ineh mo' mangun ku demulunku. Iamo' muyuh luk baken, nalan dengan do' amé' inan taman muyuh.”
english: But Joseph replied, “No, I could never do anything like that. Only the man in whose sack the cup was found will become my slave. The rest of you can return to your father peacefully.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yahuda nacing muneng inan Yusu, kebalaneh, "O tuan, nima' negku pebala namu sebuleng, idi aleg iko museh negku; ngaceku iko mepad teh dengan raca'.
english: Then Judah came near to Joseph and said, “Sir, please let me say something to you. You are equal to the king himself, so you could command that I be executed; but do not be angry with me for speaking to you.

lun_bawang: Sebuleng pangeh nenecan negku, idi kali' rungen ieh pangeh dirak pung; ngaceku na ui kali' neneh pad macing nekini.
english: One of them disappeared, and I said, “A wild animal has surely torn him to pieces.” And I have not seen him since then.

lun_bawang: Idi Yusup na miak tuman pa kiung amung-amung lun dukenneh; idi ieh nengecuk nedeh buro. Idi na seburur pana' ketecan denganneh kareb Yusup nengegala' bururneh kuan amung kinanakneh.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusup nan kinanak-kinanakneh, "Ui ini Yusup. Mulun tamanku teh?" Iamo' kinanakneh pelaba tot neneh, pad ideh na miak ngor balaneh.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusup nedeh, "Amé' muyuh muneng negku." Idi ideh iné' neneh. Idi kebalaneh, "Ui ini Yusup, kinanak muyuh luk pangeh pinasui muyuh kuan lun luk amé' Masir.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ni Yusup, "Do' ngecuk kinanakmu nganau' babeh luun keladaideh idi muli' amé' déi' bawang Kanaan.
english: The king said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers this: ‘Put loads of grain on your animals and return to the Canaan region.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengecuk kinanak-kinanakneh muli', idi ideh pana' nuli'. Idi kebala Yusup nedeh, "Aleg muyuh pekedaluh arang dalan.”
english: Then he sent his brothers on their way, saying to them “Do not quarrel along the way!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh neneh, "Yusup mulun teh, idi ieh luk mangun ku nguyut bang amung-amung bawang Masir." Idi Yakub megegker niat, ngaceku na ieh manu ku baladeh ineh.
english: One of them told him, “Joseph is still alive! In fact, he is the governor over all of Egypt!” Jacob was extremely astonished; he could not believe that it was true.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh, "Pangeh petap; anakku Yusup mulun teh! Ui pian amé' papu' neneh kareb nateh ui maté."
english: He said, “What you have said is enough to convince me! My son Joseph is still alive, and I will go and see him before I die!”

lun_bawang: Idi Allah nepebala neneh bang aceh luk sinierneh kareb malem, kebalaneh, "O Yakub, Yakub!" Idi kebala Yakub, "Anun idi, Tuhan?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' neneh, "Tuda' lak ulunmu?”
english: Jacob replied, “I have been traveling around for 130 years. I have not lived as long as my ancestors, but my life has been full of troubles.”

lun_bawang: Kareb amung-amung usin bang bawang Masir idi bawang Kanaan pangeh mabud, idi lun Masir iné' ni Yusup kebaladeh, "Do' maré akan kuan kai, pad kai ini na maté. Do' iko ngedengan nekai, ngaceku amung usin kai pangeh mabud.”
