lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusup, "Do' nguit aya' muyuh, pad ui maré akan kuan muyuh ku libal ineh, kudeng usin muyuh mabud.”
english: So they brought their livestock to Joseph. He gave them food in exchange for their horses, their sheep and goats, their cattle, and their donkeys.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusup nelun mula' ineh, "Nekini ui pangeh nemelih burur muyuh idi tana' muyuh kuan raca'. Siruh, ini ilung luk tibuen muyuh bang tana' ini.
english: But when you harvest the crop, you must give one-fifth of the crop to the king. The rest of the crop you can keep, to be seed to plant in the fields, and to be food for you and your children and for everyone else in your household to eat.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "Iko pangeh nengulun nekai, O tuan, idi iko do' nekai, idi amung-amung kai miak mangun ku demulun raca'.”

lun_bawang: Ui pian tinamen dengan tepunku. Do' nguit butungku rat bawang Masir ini, idi nanem negku bang lengutandeh." Idi kebala Yusup, "Miak ui nganau' kudeng luk bilamu ineh.”
english: Jacob said, “◄Swear/Solemnly promise► to me that you will do it!” So Joseph swore to do it. Then Jacob turned over in bed, bowed his head, and worshiped God.

english: Some time later, someone told Joseph, “Hey, your father is ill.” When Joseph heard that, he took his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim, to see his father.

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh ni Yakub, "Anakmu Yusup ineh nacing nier namu." Idi Yakub pana' netemueh, idi netudo luun pagauneh.

english: He said to Joseph, “When I was at Luz in Canaan, God Almighty appeared to me. He blessed me

english: Joseph replied, “They are the sons that God has given to me here in Egypt.” Jacob said, “Bring them close to me so that I can bless them.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yakub ni Yusup, "Idi na ui ngerawé miak nier kiungmu teh; iamo' Allah nemaré negku nier kiung anakmu pana'.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yakub nengeperuan ni Yusup, kebalaneh, "Idi do' Allah ngeperuan dueh anak ini, ieh ineh Allah luk inan tepunku Ibrahim idi tamanku Isak merapet. Do' Allah luk pangeh nenguyut negku macing aco sini ngeperuan nedidueh,

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nan tamanneh, "Aleg kudeng ineh, O Ama' ngaceku ini anak luk atun, do' ngerareng ticu'mu pa tinueh luun uluhneh.”
english: Joseph said to him, “My father, that is not right! The one on whom you put your left hand is my older son. Put your right hand on his head.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yakub nengeperuan nedidueh bang aco sineh, kebalaneh, "Lun Israil miak neten ngadan medueh kareb ideh maré peruan, kebaladeh, 'Do' Allah nganau' namu mangun mepad kudeng Epraim idi Manasé.' " Idi Yakub nengeluun Epraim ineh ratnan Manasé'.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yakub ni Yusup, "Na mio teh ui maté. Iamo' Allah miak ngedengan nemuyuh pad Ieh nguit nemuyuh muli' amé' bang bawang tepun muyuh.
english: Then Jacob said to Joseph, “I am about to die. But I know that God will help/protect you. And some day he will take your descendants back to the land of their ancestors.

lun_bawang: Yakub nenawar amung-amugn anakneh, kebalaneh, "Pamung muyuh, idi ui miak mada' nemuyuh ratnan luk miak mangun kuan muyuh bang aco luk muci:
english: Jacob summoned all his sons, and said to them,

lun_bawang: "O Rubin, iko anakku luk rayeh, tuehku idi bua' laludku luk pun-pun, luk pelaba do' uburneh, idi pelaba do' tuehneh.
english: Reuben, you are my oldest son. You were born when I was young and energetic/strong. You are prouder and stronger than all the rest of my sons.

lun_bawang: "Simion idi Liwi ini dinganak. Pelapet didueh ineh ku ngaté lemulun.
english: Simeon and Levi, you have both acted like criminals. You use your swords to act violently.

lun_bawang: "O Yahuda, kinanakmu miak ngubur namu. Idi ticu'mu miak merek dier bunu'mu. Idi amung kinanakmu miak tekunal pa kiungmu.
english: Judah, your older and younger brothers will praise you. They will bow down before you, because you will thoroughly defeat MTY your enemies.

lun_bawang: "Sebulon miak tudo tangeb abpa' rayeh. Idi ieh miak mangun ku su luk inan kapal mapit. Idi lakanneh macing déi' Sidon.
english: Zebulun, your descendants will live by the seashore where there will be a safe harbor for ships. Their land will extend north as far as Sidon city.

lun_bawang: "Iskar ineh mepad kudeng keladai luk metueh, luk tekeradung arang dueh babehneh.
english: Issachar, your descendants will be like strong donkeys that are lying down on the ground between their loads, so tired that they cannot get up!

lun_bawang: "Dan miak ngimet pupuneh, luk mepad kudeng pupu Israil luk baken.
english: Dan, although your tribe will be small, their leaders will rule their people just like the leaders of other tribes of Israel will rule their people.

lun_bawang: "Gad ineh dinakin aceh babpat bunu'. Iamo' muci ieh miak ngerada' nedeh.
english: Then Jacob continued telling his sons what would happen in the future. He said, “Gad, your tribe/descendants will be attacked by a group of bandits, but your tribe/descendants will pursue and attack them MTY.

lun_bawang: "Idi luk kenen Aser ineh pelaba én. Ieh maré luk do' én kuan raca'-raca'.
english: Asher, your descendants will eat good-tasting food; they will produce food that is delicious enough for kings to eat.

lun_bawang: "Naptali ineh mepad kudeng payo tineh luk meliput, luk nenganak tuda'- tuda' anak luk do' ayu.
english: Naphtali, your descendants will be like deer MET that are ◄free to/not tied down and can► run wherever they wish. They will give birth to children who are good-looking like ◄fawns/baby deer► MET.

lun_bawang: "Yusup mepad kudeng aceh angat luk kebua', ieh ineh sebuleng lawa luk mulun iring bued abpa'. Idi angat-angatneh rubpé pa luun ar luk medita'.
english: Joseph, you will have many descendants MET. Their children will be as many as the fruit on a vine near a spring of water, whose branches extend over a wall.

lun_bawang: "Beniamin ineh mepad kudeng aceh bungalé luk manga, luk kuman bunu'neh kareb pekak, idi mabpat-mabpat luk ilapneh kareb malem.”
english: Benjamin, your descendants will be like MET vicious/fierce wolves: In the morning they will kill their enemies like a wolf devours ◄its prey/the animals that it has killed►, and in the evening they will divide among their warriors the spoils that they seized from their enemies.”

lun_bawang: Idi pangeh ineh ieh neperiteteng nan anak-anakneh, kebalaneh, "Ui lélé amé' matun tepunku. Do' nanem negku su luk inan tepunku bang lubang luk déi' luun tana' Epron lun Hiti ineh;
english: Then Jacob said to his sons, “I will soon die. Bury my body where some of my ancestors are buried, in the cave that is in the field that was bought from Ephron, who belonged to the Heth people-group.

lun_bawang: Kareb aco temido pangeh nepelaba, idi kebala Yusup nelun tareh raca', "Do' nated balaku ini kuan raca':
english: When the time of mourning was finished, Joseph said to the king’s officials, “If you are pleased with me, please take this message to the king:

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Nalan iko idi nanem tamanmu, maya' kudeng jani'mu neneh.”
english: After they gave the king the message, he replied, “Tell Joseph, ‘Go up and bury your father’s body, as you ◄swore/solemnly promised► that you would do.’”

lun_bawang: Kareb lun luk bang bawang Kanaan nekali' tidodeh déi' Atad, kebaladeh, "Ini aceh tido lun Masir luk pelaba rayeh." Ngaceku ineh ideh neneten su ineh Abel Misraim.
english: When the Canaan people-group who lived there saw them mourning like that, they said, “This is a sad mourning place for the people of Egypt!” So they named the place Abel-Mizraim, which sounds like the Hebrew words that mean ‘mourning of the Egyptians.’

lun_bawang: Kareb tamandeh pangeh naté, idi kebala kinanak-kinanak Yusup, "Kian, Yusup megateh netau lek idi pian ngua' netau ngaceku amung-amung dat tau neneh.”
english: After Jacob died, Joseph’s brothers became worried. They realized what might happen. They said, “Suppose Joseph hates us and tries to get revenge for all the evil things that we did to him many years ago?”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nemaré bala ni Yusup, kebaladeh, "Kareb nateh tamanmu naté, kebalaneh kuanmu,
english: So they sent someone to tell this to Joseph for them: “Before our father died, he told us this:

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh amung-amung kinanak Yusup nacing idi netekeradung pa kiungneh, kebaladeh, "Nekini pian kai ini mangun ku demulunmu.”
english: Then his older brothers themselves came and threw themselves on the ground in front of Joseph, and one of them said, “Please listen. We will just be your servants.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusup nedeh, "Aleg muyuh matot! Miakké ui ini mangun ku libal Allah?
english: But Joseph replied to them, “Do not be afraid! God is the one who punishes people; ◄am I God?/I am not God!► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nan kinanak-kinanakneh, "Ui lélé maté, iamo' Allah miak ngasa' nemuyuh, idi nguit nemuyuh remuat rat bang bawang ini amé' inan tana' luk pinaji'Neh kuan Ibrahim, Isak idi Yakub.”
english: One day Joseph said to his older brothers, “I am about to die. But God will certainly ◄help/take care of► you. And some day he will lead your descendants up out of this land and take them to Canaan, the land that he solemnly promised to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yusup nemutuh nelun Israil pebulung, kebalaneh, "Do' muyuh pejani' nguit tulangku kareb Allah nated nemuyuh amé' bang bawang ineh.”
english: Then Joseph said, “When God enables you to do that, you must take my body back to Canaan.” He made his older brothers solemnly promise to do that.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nelun Masir, "Lun Israil pelaba ula' idi ideh meluun rat netau.
english: He said to his people, “Look at what has happened! The Israeli people have become so numerous and so powerful that they now might conquer us!

lun_bawang: Idi raca' nenawar bidan ineh. Idi kebalaneh nedidueh, "Ngudeh medueh nganau' luk kudeng ineh, idi ngudeh medueh ngulun anak deléi?”
english: So the king summoned the two midwives and said to them, “Why are you doing this? Why are you letting the baby boys live?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala didueh ni raca', "Decur lun Iberani baken ratnan decur Masir. Ideh malé nenganak. Anak mebpeh kareb nateh bidan macing.”
english: One of the midwives replied to the king, “You need to realize that the Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women. The Hebrew women are very strong/healthy. They give birth to their babies before we can get to them to help them.”

lun_bawang: Idi raca' Masir nengecuk amung anak itinneh, kebalaneh, "Do' muyuh nala' amung anak deléi lun Iberani bang Abpa' Nil, iamo' amung anak decurdeh uen ngulun."
english: Then the king commanded all ◄the Egyptian people/his advisors►: “You must throw into the Nile River every baby boy born that the Hebrew women give birth to! But you can allow the baby girls to live.”

lun_bawang: Kareb ieh nengukab ineh idi ieh nenier aceh anak deléi, idi anak ineh nangi'. Idi anak raca' ineh pelaba éi' neneh, kebalaneh, "Ini anak lun Iberani.”
english: When the servant brought the basket to her, she opened it, and was surprised to see ◄a baby that was/me►, crying. She felt sorry for him/me, and said, “This must be one of the Hebrews’ babies.”

lun_bawang: Idi kinanak anak ineh nengitun neneh, "Miakké ui amé' mada' aceh decur lun Iberani luk miak niti' anak ineh kuanmu?”
english: Then ◄the baby’s/my► older sister approached the king’s daughter and said, “Do you want me to go and find someone from among the Hebrew women who will be able to nurse the baby for you?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala anak raca' neneh, "Miak." Idi decur ineh iné' kidi inan tinan anak ineh.
english: The king’s daughter said to her, “Yes, go and find one.” So the girl went and summoned ◄the baby’s/my► mother.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala anak raca' neneh, "Itenmu anak ini, tetienmu kuanku. Ui miak maré tabpar namu." Idi decur ineh nengalap anak ineh idi neniti' neneh.
english: The king’s daughter said to her, “Please take this baby and nurse him for me. I will pay you for doing that.” So ◄the woman/my mother► took him/me and nursed him/me.

lun_bawang: Kareb anak ineh pangeh rayeh, idi ieh inuitneh amé' matun anak raca' ineh. Idi ieh nengasa' neneh mangun ku anakneh. Idi ieh nenganau' ngadanneh Musa, kebalaneh, ngaceku ieh luk ilapku rat bang abpa'.”
english: ◄A few years later/when ◄the child/I► grew older►, she brought him/me to the king’s daughter. She adopted him/me as though I was her own son. She named him/me Moses, which sounds like the Hebrew words ‘pull out’, because she said “I pulled him out of the water.”

lun_bawang: Idi kenebpa ieh iné' baruh teh. Idi ieh nenier dueh lun Iberani uned pekedaluh. Idi kebalaneh kuan luk sala' ineh, "Dedatenmu ku anun lun denganmu?”
english: The next day he/I returned to the same place. He/I was surprised to see two Hebrew men who were fighting each other. He/I said to the man who started the fight, “Why are you ◄you should not be► striking your fellow Hebrew.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengor balaneh, "Idéké luk nenganau' namu mangun ku raca' idi lun luk mutut ukum kuan kai? Iko pian ngaté negku teh kudeng patému nelun Masir luk atun di?" Idi Musa matot. Ieh ngerawé ieh pangeh nekali'deh nengaté.
english: The man replied, “◄Who made you our ruler and judge?/No one made you our ruler and judge!► RHQ You have no right to interfere with us Are you going to kill me just like you killed that Egyptian man yesterday?” Then Moses/I was afraid, because he/I thought, “Since that man knows what I did, surely other people know, too.”

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh nacing inan tamandeh, kebalaneh nedeh, "Ngudeh muyuh muka muli' aco sini?”
english: When the girls returned to their father Jethro, whose other name is Reuel, he asked them, “How is it that you were able to give water to the sheep and come home so quickly today?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "Inan aceh lun Masir luk nemuit nekai rat nelun matar aya' ineh. Idi teh ieh nengook abpa' kuan kai, idi ieh nemaré abpa' rupen aya' pana'.”
english: They replied, “A man from Egypt kept MTY other shepherds from sending us away. He also got water for us from the well and gave water to the flock of sheep.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Ruel nedeh, "Iapehké ieh? Ngudeh muyuh nima' neneh déi'? Nawar neneh kuman dengan tau.”
english: He said to his daughters, “Where is he? ◄Why did you leave him out there?/You should not leave him out there!► RHQ Invite him in, so he can have something to eat MTY!”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nenganak aceh anak deléi. Idi Musa neneten ngadanneh Gersom, kebalaneh, "Ngaceku pangeh ui mangun ku aceh lun sakai bang bawang baken.”
english: Later she gave birth to a son, and Moses/I named him Gershom, which sounds like the Hebrew words that mean ‘foreigner’, because he/I said, “I am living as a foreigner in this land.”

lun_bawang: Idi keterawé Musa, "Mawa ui! Ngudeh kayuh ineh na meseb? Do' ui amé' nier ineh.”
english: Moses/I thought, “I will go closer and try to see this strange sight! Why is the bush not burning up?”

lun_bawang: Kareb Tuhan nenier ni Musa amé' muneng, idi Ieh nenawar neneh rat bang ineh, kebalaNeh, "O Musa, Musa!" Idi kebala Musa, "Anun idi, Tuhan?”
english: When Yahweh saw that he/I had come closer, he called to Moses/me from the middle of the bush, saying, “Moses! Moses!” He/I replied, “Yes, here I am.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Allah, "Aleg iko amé' muneng. Takanmu kasut ratnan kukudmu. Ngaceku su luk inanmu tuped ineh tana' luk meligan.
english: Yahweh said, “Do not come closer! Because I am God, the ground on which you are standing is holy/taboo. So take off your sandals to show respect to me.”

lun_bawang: Ui ini Allah tepunmu, Ibrahim, Isak, idi Yakub." Idi Musa nengebpu kiungneh, ngaceku matot nier Allah.
english: Then he said, “I am God, whom your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob worshiped.” So Moses/I covered his/my face, because he/I was afraid that God would kill him/me if he/I looked at him.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Tuhan, "Ui pangeh nenier amung dereh pupuKu luk icing lun Masir nedeh. Ui pangeh neninger aroddeh mutuh puatin rat nelun luk metueh ngimet nedeh. Ui kali' amung derehdeh.
english: Then Yahweh said, “I have seen how cruelly they are treating my people in Egypt. I have heard them ◄wailing/crying out► for help because of what the slave-drivers are forcing them to do. I know how my people are suffering.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa nan Allah, "Kudeng apehké ui miak amé' papu' raca' idi nguit nelun Israil remuat rat bang bawang Masir?”
english: But Moses/I replied, “I am not a well-known person RHQ! ◄I cannot go to the king and ask him to permit me to bring the Israeli people out of Egypt!/How can I go to the king and ask him to allow me to bring the Israeli people out of Egypt?►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan, "Ui ngedengan namu. Idi ini miak mangun ku tanu' kuanmu, ratnan tawarKu namu. Kareb pupuKu inuitmu remuat rat bang bawang Masir, idi muyuh miak sembayang inan Allah luun surud ini.”
english: God replied, “I will be with you. And when you bring my people out of Egypt, all of you will worship me right here on this mountain. That will prove that I am the one who sent you to them.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa, "Kareb ui amé' papu' nelun Israil idi kebalaku nedeh, 'Allah tepun muyuh nengecuk negku amé' nemuyuh,' idi ideh ngitun negku, 'Idéké ngadanNeh?' kudeng apeh ui ngor baladeh?”
english: Moses/I said to God, “If I go to the Israeli people and say to them, ‘God, the one your ancestors worshiped, has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is his name?’, what shall I say to them?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Allah, "Ui Idi Luk Ui Idi." Idi teh kebalaNeh, "Do' mala kudeng ini kuan lun Israil: 'UI IDI pangeh nengecuk negku amé' nemuyuh.'
english: God replied, “I AM who I AM.” And he said, “Tell the Israeli people that the one who is named ‘I AM’ has sent me to you.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa, "Iamo' kudeng lun Israil na manu negku, idi na ninger balaku, anunké luk ruenku, kudeng ideh pebala, 'Na Tuhan nesilagan namu'?”
english: Moses/I replied, “But what if the Israeli people ◄do not believe me/are not convinced► or not do what I tell them? What if they say, ‘Yahweh did not appear to you!’”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Anunké luk bang paladmu?" Idi kebala Musa, "Rukud.”
english: Yahweh said to him/me, “Look at that thing you are holding in your hand. What is it?” He/I replied, “A ◄walking stick/shepherd’s stick►.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Patuh ieh luun tana'." Idi ieh nemepet ineh luun tana'. Petacu ieh nisu' ku menipeh. Idi Musa neburo rat ieneh.
english: He said, “Throw it down on the ground!” So, he/I threw it on the ground, and it became a snake! And he/I ran/jumped away from it.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Ngimet iurneh." Idi Musa nengimet iurneh, idi ieh nisu' ku rukud baruh peh.
english: But Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Reach down and pick it up by its tail!” So he/I reached down and caught it, and when he/I picked it up, it became a stick in his/my hand again.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan, "Nganau' kudeng ini pad ideh manu Tuhan pangeh nesilagan namu, ieh ineh Allah tepundeh, Ibrahim, Isak, idi Yakub.”
english: Yahweh said, “Do the same thing in front of the Israeli people, in order that they may believe that I, Yahweh God, the one Abraham and Isaac and Jacob worshiped, truly appeared to you.”

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Nuet ticu'mu pa liang kuyu'mu." Idi ieh nenganau' kudeng ineh. Pangeh ineh ieh nenginat ticu'neh. Idi ticu'neh nekaneh ku ét susud idi mebuda' mepad kudeng salju.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses/me again, saying “Put your hand inside your robe MTY!” He/I did that. And when he/I took it out again, surprisingly, his/my hand was white. It had a skin disease that made it as white as snow.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Nuet ticu'mu pa liang kuyu'mu teh." Idi ieh nenganau' kudeng ineh teh. Idi ieh nenginat neneh, idi ticu'neh mepad kudeng ayuneh luk atun.
english: Then God said, “Put your hand back inside your robe MTY!” So he/I did that, and when he/I took it out again, surprisingly, it was normal again, just like the rest of his/my body!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan, "Kudeng ideh na manu namu idi na merapet ku tanu' seluk pun ineh, idi ideh miak manu ku tanu' luk muci.
english: God said, “You can do that in front of the Israeli people, too. If they do not pay attention to what you say because of seeing the first miracle, they will ◄believe you/be convinced► when you perform the second miracle.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa, "Mutuh do' Tuhan, ui ini lemulun luk na mileh pebala rat mon idi macing nekini. Kareb Tuhan pebala negku pana' meteh teh balaku.”
english: Moses/I replied, “O Yahweh! I am not an eloquent speaker! I was not an eloquent speaker before, and I have not become one since you started talking to me! I am not a good speaker MTY, and I speak very slowly.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Idéké luk nenganau' tang lemulun? Idéké luk nenganau' lun mebegkeh idi mebengel, nganau' lemulun nier idi mebuser? Ieh ineh Ui ini Tuhan.
english: Then Yahweh said to him/me, “You seem to forget who it is that makes people able to speak RHQ! Who is it that enables people to be unable to speak or unable to hear, or able to see or not to see? It is I, Yahweh RHQ!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa, "Mutuh do' Tuhan, ngecuk nelun baken.”
english: But he/I replied, “O, Yahweh, I ask you, please send someone else instead!”

lun_bawang: Idi Musa nelemubed iné' nan ibanneh Yitro, kebalaneh, "Nima' negku lemubed amé' inan kinanakku luk déi' Masir, ku idi teh ideh mulun." Idi kebala Yitro ni Musa, "Mesaget iko amé'.”
english: Moses/I returned to his/my father-in-law Jethro and said to him, “Please let me go back to Egypt, to see my fellow Israelis there. I want to know if they are still alive.” Jethro said to Moses/me, “Go, and may God give you inner peace.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, kareb ieh idi déi' Midian, "Muli' iko amé' bawang Masir. Amung lemulun luk pian ngaté namu ineh pangeh naté.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses/me before he/I left Midian, “You can safely return to Egypt, because the men who were wanting to kill you MTY are now dead.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Kareb iko lemubed amé' bawang Masir, do' iko nganau' tanu' luk pangeh biréKu namu pa kiung raca'. Iamo' Ui ngetueh niatneh pad ieh na maré pupu ini nalan.
english: Yahweh said to Moses/me, “When you return to Egypt, be sure to perform all the miracles that I have given you power to do, while the king is watching. But I will make him stubborn IDM, with the result that he will not let the Israeli people leave Egypt.

lun_bawang: Idi Ui pebala namu, nima' anakKu ineh nalan, pad ieh miak sembayang Negku. Iamo' kudeng iko na nima' neneh nalan Ui miak ngaté anakmu luk rayeh.' “
english: I told you to let my people MTY leave Egypt, in order that they may worship me in the desert. If you refuse to let them go, I warn you, I will kill your firstborn son!”’”

lun_bawang: Idi Sipora nengalap aceh iyu batu idi ieh nenunat anakneh luk deléi, idi nemepet kubilneh luun kukud Musa, kebalaneh, "Iko nepaweh negku ratnan dara' ineh.”
english: Then his/my wife Zipporah took a flint knife and circumcised her son. Then she touched the boy’s feet (OR, genitals) with the piece of skin she had cut off, and she said, “The blood which flowed when I circumcised you will protect you from being harmed by Yahweh MET.”

lun_bawang: Sipora nepebala kudeng ineh ngaceku sunat ineh. Idi Tuhan nenima' Musa mulun.
english: She said to him, “You are safe now MET because you have been circumcised.” So Yahweh did not harm her son.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Arun, "Amé' iko ni Musa déi' su luk ali-ali." Idi ieh iné' neneh déi' luun pegkung Allah, idi ieh nemuen neneh.
english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “Go into the desert to meet/see Moses!” So he went there from Egypt and met him/me at Sinai, the mountain dedicated to God, and greeted him/me by kissing him/me on the cheek.

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh Musa idi Arun iné' papu' Raca' Masir, idi kebala didueh neneh, "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah lun Israil. 'Nima' pupuKu ini nalan pad ideh ngeletep aceh aco rayeh kuanKu déi' su luk ali-ali.' “
english: Then Aaron and Moses/I went to the king and one of them/us said, “Yahweh God, whom we Israeli people worship, says this to you: ‘Let my people go to the desert, in order that they may have a feast to honor me!’”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala raca', "Idé-ké Tuhan luk miak bénku bala, pad ui nima' nelun Israil ineh nalan? Na ui kali' Tuhan ineh, idi na ui maré lun Israil nalan.”
english: But the king said, “Who is Yahweh? Why should I pay attention to what he says and let the Israeli people MTY go? I do not know Yahweh! And furthermore, I will not let the Israeli people go!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala didueh, "Allah lun Iberani pangeh nesilagan nekai. Do' nima' nekai nalan tap delanin teluh aco déi' su luk ali-ali, pad kai maré luk barén kuan Tuhan Allah kai, pelé Ieh na ngacing ét idi bunu' kuan kai.”
english: They/we replied, “Yahweh God, the one we Hebrews worship, has ◄revealed himself/appeared► to us and told us what to tell you. So we ask you to please let us go on a three day journey into the desert. We must offer sacrifices to Yahweh God there. If we do not do that, he will cause us to die IDM from diseases or from attacks by our enemies MTY.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' nedidueh, "O Musa idi Arun, ngudeh medueh ngesabeng kekamen pupu ini? Ngecuk nedeh lemubed ngakem teh!”
english: But the king of Egypt said to them/us, “Moses and Aaron, ◄stop trying to keep the Israeli people from working/why are you preventing the Israeli people from working?► RHQ Tell those slaves to return to work!”

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala raca', "Pupu ini pelaba ula' bang bawang ini. Idi nekini muyuh pian ugka' ratnan kekamen muyuh!”
english: The king also said, “Listen to me! You  people who now live in this land are now more numerous, and you want them to stop working and rest!”

lun_bawang: "Aleg maré uduh luk tekering peh, ku nganau' batu bata pinudut ratnan tana' salit kudeng luk atun. Nima' nedeh nakap kuandeh sebuleng.
english: “Do not continue to give the Israeli people straw for making bricks, as you have done previously. Make them go into the fields and gather straw for themselves.

lun_bawang: Idi lun luk icuk ngatur kekamen demulun, idi lun luk ngimet kekamen lun Israil neremuat idi nepebala nelun mula', "Kebala raca', 'Na ui miak maré uduh luk tekering nemuyuh.
english: So the slave bosses and supervisors of the slaves went to where the Israeli people were and said to them, “The king has said that he will no longer give you any straw.

lun_bawang: Idi lun luk icuk ineh mesaad ngecuk nedeh, pad ideh nganau' batu bata mepad kinula' kudeng luk pekalai anid-anid aco kareb inan uduh tekering teh.
english: The slave bosses kept telling them insistently, “Finish the work you are required to do each day, making the same amount of bricks as you did before, when we gave you straw!”

lun_bawang: Idi amung lun luk ngimet kekamen lun Israil luk kinikit ku kekamen ineh dicatdeh, kebaladeh, "Ngudeh muyuh na nemangeh babpat muyuh nganau' batu bata aco sini mepad kudeng luk atun?”
english: When they were not able to do that, the slave bosses had the Israeli supervisors beaten with sticks, and they asked them, “Why have all the men you are supervising not been able to make the same number of bricks today/now as they did before RHQ?”

lun_bawang: Idi amung lun luk ngimet kekamen lun Israil iné' papu' raca' dengan megateh niat, kebaladeh, "Anun punneh iko ngedereh nekai,
english: Then the Israeli supervisors went to the king and complained, saying “Your Majesty, why are you treating us this way?

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Mekupé muyuh ini, mekupé tu-tu! Ini punneh muyuh pebala, 'Amé' kai maré luk barén inan Tuhan.'
english: But the king said, “You are lazy and do not want to work! That is why you keep saying, ‘Allow us to go to the desert and offer sacrifices to Yahweh.’

lun_bawang: Idi lun luk ngimet kekamen lun Israil kali' susa' idi dat ngaceku bala raca' nedeh ineh, ratnan na ngurang kinula' batu bata ineh anid-anid aco, iamo' nganau' mepad kudeng luk atun.
english: The Israeli supervisors realized that they were in a difficult situation, because they had been told, “We are not going to decrease the number of bricks you must make each day.”

lun_bawang: Idi Musa nenawar Tuhan teh, kesembayangneh, "O Tuhan, ngudeh Iko ngedereh pupuMu ini? Anun punneh Tuhan ngecuk negku amé' tungé'?
english: Moses/I left them and prayed to Yahweh again, saying, “O Yahweh, why have you caused all these evil things to happen to your people RHQ? And why did you send me here RHQ?

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Nekini miak iko nier luk ruenKu kuan raca'. Dengan tueh laludKu Ui miak ngecuk raca' ngusu nedeh rat bawangneh.”
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Now you will see what I will do to the king and his people. I will powerfully MTY compel him to let my people go. In fact, by my power MTY I will force him to expel them from his land!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Allah ni Musa, "Ui ini Tuhan.
english: God also said to Moses/me, “I am Yahweh.

lun_bawang: "Amé' iko idi ngecuk raca' Masir ineh maré nelun Israil remuat rat bang bawang Masir.”
english: “Go and tell the king of Egypt again that he must allow the Israeli people to leave his land!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Musa nan Tuhan, "Lun Israil pana' na ninger balaku. Meluun teh raca' na ninger. Ui selemulun luk meteh buri!”
english: But Moses/I said to Yahweh, “Listen to what I am saying. Even the Israeli people have not paid attention to what I told them. But I am a poor speaker. MET, MTY So ◄why should the king pay attention to what I tell him?/the king will certainly not pay attention to what I tell him!►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Ini Arun idi Musa luk inan Tuhan Allah nepebala, "Nguit nelun Israil remuat rat bang bawang Masir, maya' ruyuddeh.”
english: Aaron and Moses/I were the ones to whom Yahweh said, “Lead all the families and clans of the Israeli people out of Egypt.”

lun_bawang: kebalaNeh, "Ui ini Tuhan. Do' mada' raca' Masir amung bala luk bilaKu namu ineh.”
english: he said, “I am Yahweh. You must tell the king everything that I say to you.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa, "Iko kali' ui ini selemulun luk meteh buri'. Kudeng apehké raca' ninger balaku?"
english: But Moses/I said to Yahweh, “Listen to me. I am not a good speaker. MET, MTY So ◄the king will certainly not pay attention to what I say/why should the king pay attention to what I tell him?►!” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan, "Ui ngikit namu mepad kudeng Allah kuan raca'. Idi Arun kinanakmu miak mangun ku nabimu.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Listen carefully. Just like I enabled prophet to speak my messages, I will cause the king to consider that you are like a god, and that Aaron is like a prophet.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng raca' ngecuk nemedueh nganau' aceh tanu' luk melalud, idi do' iko ngecuk ni Arun mepet rukudneh pa kiung raca', pad ineh misu' ku menipeh.”
english: “If the king says to you, ‘Prove that God sent you by performing a miracle,’ then say to Aaron, ‘Throw your stick down in front of the king, in order that it may become a snake.’”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Niat raca' pelaba tueh. Na ieh nima' pupu ini nalan.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “The king is very stubborn IDM. He refuses to allow my people to go.

lun_bawang: Idi pebala neneh, 'Tuhan, ieh ineh Allah lun Iberani, nengecuk negku amé' namu dengan bala ini, "Nima' pupuKu ini nalan idi amé' sembayang Negku déi' su luk ali-ali." Iamo' macing nekini nateh iko neninger balaku.
english: Say to him, ‘Yahweh God, the one we Hebrews worship, sent me to you to tell you to let my people go, in order that they may worship him in the desert. We told you that, but you have not paid any attention to it.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Tuhan, O raca', ratnan ini miak iko kali' Ui ini Tuhan. Nier rukud ini luk bang paladku uenku mabpet Abpa' Nil ini, idi abpa' ineh misu' ku dara'.
english: So now Yahweh says this: “This is the way you will know that I, Yahweh, have the power to do what I say that I will do. Watch this: I am going to strike the water that is in the Nile River with the stick that is in my hand. When I do that, the water will become blood (OR, red like blood MTY).

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Amé' iko papu' raca', idi pebala neneh, 'Ini bala Tuhan: Nima' pupuKu nalan amé' sembayang Negku.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Go back to the king and tell him, ‘Yahweh says that you must let my people go, in order that they can worship me in the desert.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Ngecuk ni Arun ngegenang rukudneh ineh pa luun amung abpa', turuk, idi takungdeh, pad atit umak bang bawang Masir.”
english: Yahweh also said to Moses/me, “Say this to Aaron: ‘Hold your stick in your hand and stretch it out as though you were stretching it over the river, the canals, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up from all this water and cover the land of Egypt.’”

lun_bawang: Idi raca' nenawar ni Musa idi Arun, kebalaneh, "Do' sembayang mutuh Tuhan ngusu amung atit ini, idi ui miak nima' pupu ineh nalan amé' maré luk barén inan Tuhan.”
english: Then the king summoned Moses/me and said, “Ask Yahweh to take away these frogs from me and my people. After that happens, I will allow your people to go, in order that they can offer sacrifices to Yahweh.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Sembayang kuanku nebpa." Idi kebala Musa, "Ui miak nganau' kudeng luk icukmu, pad iko kali' na luk mepad kudeng Tuhan Allah kai.
english: He replied, “Tomorrow.” So Moses/I said, “I will do what you say, and then you will know that Yahweh God, the one we worship, is the only true god, and that there is no other god like him.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Ngecuk ni Arun necat tana' ku rukudneh, pad abuh tana' ineh misu' ku tukung aput bawang Masir.”
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Tell Aaron to strike the ground with his stick. When he does that, all the fine particles of ground/dust will become gnats, all over the land of Egypt.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala amung lemulun luk mileh mangun ni raca', "Ini aceh tanu' ratnan lalud Allah!" Iamo' niat raca' pelaba tueh. Idi na ieh ninger baladeh, maya' kudeng luk bila Tuhan.
english: The men who worked magic said to the king, “It is God who has done this with his power MTY!” But the king continued to be stubborn IDM, and he would not pay attention to us, just as Yahweh had predicted.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Kulat iko uka-uka, idi amé' papu' raca' kareb ieh amé' tangeb abpa', idi pebala neneh, 'Kudeng ini bala Tuhan: Nima' pupuKu nalan pad ideh sembayang Negku.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Get up early tomorrow morning. Go down to the river and wait for the king. When he comes to bathe MTY, say to him, ‘This is what Yahweh says to you: “Let my people go, in order that they may worship me in the desert.

lun_bawang: Idi raca' nenawar ni Musa idi Arun, kebalaneh, "Amé' muyuh. Nguit luk barén kuan Allah muyuh bang bawang ini.”
english: Then the king summoned Aaron and Moses/me and said, “You Israeli people can go and offer sacrifices to your god, but you must do it here in this land.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa, "Na kai miak nganau' kudeng ineh, ngaceku pung luk kereten kai kuan Tuhan Allah kai luk ku ali' lun Masir. Kudeng kai maré luk ku ali' lun Masir su sirendeh, kali' rungen ideh mitung nekai ku batu.
english: But Moses/I replied, “It would not be right for us to do that, because we will be offering sacrifices that are very offensive to the Egyptian people. If we offer sacrifices that the Egyptian people think are disgusting, they will kill us by throwing stones at us RHQ!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Ui nima' nemuyuh nalan pad nguit luk barén kuan Tuhan Allah muyuh déi' su luk ali-ali. Iamo' aleg muyuh nalan mado. Do' muyuh sembayang kuanku.”
english: So the king said, “I will let your people go to offer sacrifices to Yahweh, your god, in the desert. But you must not go very far. Now pray for me!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Amé' papu' raca', idi pebala neneh, 'Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah lun Iberani: Nima' pupuKu nalan, pad ideh miak sembayang Negku.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Go to the king and say to him, ‘This is what Yahweh, the God we Hebrews worship, says: “Allow my people to go, in order that they may worship me.

lun_bawang: Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nengeletep karebneh, ieh ineh nebpa.”
english: Tell him that I have determined/decided that tomorrow is the day that I will do this in this land.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa idi Arun, "Lapenmu abuh rat luun tetel, panu' tuda'- tuda' ragam, idi do' i Musa ngisak ineh arang gawa' pa kiung raca'.
english: Then Yahweh said to Aaron and Moses/me, “Take a few handfuls of ashes/soot from ◄a furnace/an oven where they burn lime►, and let Moses throw them up into the air, in front of the king.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Do' iko amé' papu' raca' pekak uka-uka, idi pebala neneh, Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah lun Iberani: Nima' pupuKu ini nalan, pad ideh sembayang Negku.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Get up early tomorrow morning. Go and stand in front of the king and tell him that Yahweh God, the one that the Hebrew people worship, says this: ‘Let my people go, in order that they may worship me in the desert.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Ngiding langenmu pad inan udan batu maput bawang Masir, idi pa luun lemulun, idi pung, idi amung-amung tibu aput bawang Masir.”
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Raise your hand up toward the sky, in order that hail will fall all over the land of Egypt—on the people and on their animals and on all the plants in the fields.”

lun_bawang: Idi raca' nengecuk nawar ni Musa idi Arun, idi kebalaneh nedidueh, "Idi ui sala' tu-tu sekua' ini. Tuhan ineh luk matu. Iamo' ui ini idi anak itinku mesala'.
english: Then the king sent someone to summon Aaron and Moses/me. When they/we came to the king, he said to them/us, “This time I admit that I have sinned. What Yahweh has done is right, and what I and my people have done is wrong.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Amé' iko papu' raca'. Ui pangeh nengetueh niatneh idi niat amung lun tarehneh pana', pad Ui miak nganau' tanu'Ku ini arangdeh,
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Go to the king again. I have made him and his officials stubborn IDM. I have done that in order that I would have a good reason to perform all these plagues among them,

lun_bawang: Musa idi Arun iné' papu' raca', idi kebala didueh neneh, "Kebala Tuhan Allah lun Iberani, 'Tuda' io teh iko ara' maya' bala Allah. Nima' pupuKu ini nalan idi sembayang Negku.
english: So Aaron and Moses/I went into the king’s palace and said to him, “Yahweh God, whom we Hebrews worship, says this: ‘How long will you stubbornly refuse to do what I tell you MTY? Let my people go, in order that they may worship me in the desert

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun tareh raca' neneh, "Tuda' io lun ini ngesusa' netau? Do' iko maré nedeh nalan, pelé ideh sembayang inan Tuhan Allah! Naké iko nekali' bawang Masir ini pangeh nekedat?”
english: The king’s officials said to him, “◄How long is this man going to continue to bring disasters on us?/We must not let this man continue to cause trouble for us!► RHQ Let the Israeli men leave, in order that they may worship Yahweh, their god. ◄Do you not yet understand that this man has ruined Egypt?/You ought to realize by now that this man has ruined Egypt!►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nenguit ni Musa idi Arun lemubed amé' pa kiung raca', idi kebalaneh nedidueh, "Nalan muyuh idi sembayang inan Tuhan Allah muyuh! Iamo' idé luk pian amé'?”
english: So they brought Aaron and Moses/me back to the king. He said to them/us, “All right, you can go and worship Yahweh your god. But who are the ones who will go?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa, "Amung kai amé' dengan anak-anak dari idi lun rayeh teh. Kai pian nguit anak-anak kai luk deléi idi decur dengan dumba, amék, idi sapi' kai teh, ngaceku kai pian nganau' aceh irau pad ngerayeh Tuhan.”
english: Moses/I replied, “We all need to go, everyone, including those who are young and those who are old. We need to take our sons and our daughters and our flocks of sheep and goats and herds of livestock, because we must have a festival to honor Yahweh.”

lun_bawang: Idi raca' nepebala nedidueh, "Ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan: Na ui maré nemuyuh nguit decur idi anak-anak muyuh. Nekini megala' muyuh pian nganau' luk dat.
english: Moses/I really did not intend that the Israelis would ever return to Egypt, and the king knew that also. So the king replied sarcastically, “If you all leave, it will be clear that Yahweh has helped you, but I myself will never let you take your children and your wives when you go! It is clear that you are wickedly planning not to return.

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nepebala ni Musa, "Ngegenang langenmu pa luun bawang Masir, pad kato ineh umak idi kuman amung-amung tibu luk ketecan luun tana' pangeh udan batu ineh.”
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Reach out your hand as though you were stretching it over the land to welcome the locusts. They will come to the country of Egypt and eat every plant that is left in the land, every plant that the hail has not destroyed.”

lun_bawang: Idi dengan mesagat raca' nenawar ni Musa idi Arun, kebalaneh, "Ui pangeh mesala' inan Tuhan Allah muyuh idi nemuyuh pana'.
english: The king quickly summoned Aaron and Moses/me and said, “I have sinned against Yahweh, your god, and against you two.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Ngegenang langenmu idi mangun medacem bang bawang Masir, pad lemulun perikekap bang dacem ineh.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Reach your hand up toward the sky, in order that there will be darkness over all the land of Egypt, a darkness so complete that people will have to grope around to know where to walk.”

lun_bawang: Idi raca' nenawar ni Musa, kebalaneh, "Nalan muyuh idi sembayang inan Tuhan. Iamo' amung-amung aya' muyuh aga'deh ketecan ieni. Iamo' decur idi anak-anak muyuh miak amé' maya' nemuyuh.”
english: The king summoned Moses/me and said, “All right, you may go and worship Yahweh. Your wives and your children may go with you. But your flocks of sheep and goats and your herds of cattle must remain here.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Musa, "Na miak na iko maré pung luk kereten iten kai luk miak barén kai inan Tuhan Allah kai.
english: But Moses/I replied, “No, you must let us take along the sheep and goats, in order that we may have some of them to sacrifice and give as burned offerings to Yahweh, our God.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ni Musa, "Buro iko rat pa kiungku. Aleg iko papu' negku baruh peh. Ngaceku kareb iko nier negku, iko miak maté.”
english: The king said to me, “Get out of here! Make sure that you never come to see me SYN again! The day you see me again, I will have you executed!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa, "Pad pianmu. Na tu-tu iko miak nier negku peh!"
english: Moses/I replied, “You are correct! You will never see me SYN again!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Sebuleng teh dereh luk ruenKu ngacing kuan raca' Masir idi anak itinneh. Pangeh ineh ieh miak nima' nemuyuh nalan. Setuneh ieh miak ngusu nemuyuh rat ieni.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “I will cause one more disaster to strike the king of Egypt and all his people MTY. After that, he will let you leave. In fact, he will expel you all.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa nan raca', "Bala Tuhan kudeng ini: Kareb tangal dacem Ui sikal remuat ngelibut bawang Masir.
english: Then Moses/I went to the king and said, “This is what Yahweh says: ‘About midnight tonight I will go throughout Egypt,

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Raca' na tu sikal maya' balamu, pad tanu'-tanu'Ku luk melalud meluun mula' bang bawang Masir.”
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “The king will not pay any attention to what you say. The result will be that I will perform more plagues in the land of Egypt.”

lun_bawang: "Bulan ini mangun ku bulan luk pun-pun kuan muyuh bang anid-anid lak.
english: “From now on, this month will be the first month of the year for you.

lun_bawang: Musa nenawar amung lun rayeh-rayeh Israil, idi kebalaneh nedeh, "Mili' anak dumba kian amék lek, kuan anid-anid ruma' muyuh, kereten ku Irau Paska ineh.
english: Let the lamb’s blood drain into a basin. Get a bunch/sprig of ◄hyssop/a very leafy plant► and dip it in the blood. Then smear some of the blood on the doorposts and the ◄lintels/beams above the doorways► of your houses. The people in each house must all stay inside the house until the next morning.

lun_bawang: Idi raca' nenawar ni Musa idi Arun bang alem ineh, kebalaneh, "Gugkang muyuh idi nalan rat arang anak itinku, do' muyuh idi lun Israil, idi sembayang inan Tuhan, maya' kudeng luk pinutuh muyuh.
english: Take your flocks of sheep and goats and herds of cattle, and leave! And ask Yahweh to bless me, also!”

lun_bawang: Idi lun Masir nengecuk nelun mula' ineh remuat rat bang bawang Masir dengan mesaget, kebaladeh, "Kai maté kudeng muyuh na nalan.”
english: Yahweh caused the Egyptian people to greatly respect the Israeli people, so they gave them what they asked for. In that way, they carried away the wealth of the Egyptian people.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa idi Arun, "Ini ukum Paska ineh: Lun pupu baken na miak kuman ineh,
english: Do not let people who are living among you temporarily, or servants whom you have hired, eat the Passover meal.

lun_bawang: "Ngeligan amung anak deléi luk atun kuanKu. Anid anak deléi lun Israil luk atun, idi anak pung luk atun pana', Ui luk kuan nedeh.”
english: “Set apart all the firstborn males in order that they may belong to me. The firstborn males of the Israeli people and of their animals will be mine.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa nelun mula', "Ngerawé muyuh aco sini, ieh ineh aco luk inan muyuh mepura' rat Masir, rat su luk inan muyuh tiban. Dengan laludNeh Tuhan nguit nemuyuh mepura' rat ieni. Ruti luk pinuar ku lamud ineh na miak kenen.
english: Moses/I said to the people, “Do not forget this day! This is the day that you are leaving Egypt. This is the day you are freed from being their slaves. Yahweh has brought you out of Egypt by his great power MTY. Do not eat any bread that has yeast in it whenever you celebrate this day.

lun_bawang: "Tuhan miak nguit nemuyuh semuet bang bawang lun Kanaani, maya' kudeng luk pijani' inan tepun muyuh. Kareb bawang ineh pangeh biréNeh nemuyuh,
english: Yahweh will bring you into the land where the descendants of Canaan live, just as he promised you and your ancestors that he would do. When he gives that land to you,

lun_bawang: Idi Musa nenguit amung tulang Yusup maya' nedeh. Ngaceku Yusup neperiteteng nelun Israil, pad ideh nepejani' nganau' kudeng ineh. Kebala Yusup, "Kareb Allah muit nemuyuh, do' muyuh nguit tulangku maya' nemuyuh rat ieni.”
english: Moses/I had them take along the bones of Joseph with them/us, because Joseph long ago had made the Israeli people promise solemnly that they would do that. He had said to them, “God will enable your descendants to leave Egypt. When that happens, you must carry my bones with you.”

lun_bawang: "Ngecuk nelun Israil lemubed idi lupo pa atun Pi Hakirot, arang Migedol idi Abpa' Pisui, muneng ku Baal Sepon.
english: “Tell the Israeli people to turn around and go back and set up their tents in front of Pi-Hahiroth town. That town is between Migdol and the sea, across from Baal-Zephon town. Set up your tents there, close to the sea.

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh ni Musa, "Naké inan tanem déi' Masir, pad iko nguit nekai maté déi' su luk ali-ali? Anunk'e luk inau'mu nekai, pad iko nguit nekai remuat rat bang bawang Masir?
english: Then they said to Moses/me, “Is it because there were no places in Egypt where we could be buried that you have brought us here to die in this desert RHQ? Look what you have done to us by bringing us out of Egypt RHQ!

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Musa nedeh, "Aleg muyuh matot! Tuped meraben, idi nier puit luk ratnan Tuhan luk Ieh maré aco sini kuan muyuh. Ngaceku lun Masir luk muyuh nier aco sini, na muyuh miak nier nedeh ruked-ruked.
english: Moses/I replied to the people, “Do not be afraid! Be brave, and see how Yahweh will rescue you! He will save you today, and the result will be that the Egyptians that you are looking at today—you will never see them again!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Ngudehké iko ngitang mutuh pedengan? Ngecuk nelun Israil nalan.
english: Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Tell the people to stop crying out for me to help them, and tell them to go forward. Lift up your stick and stretch it out toward the sea. The water will divide, so that all you Israeli people can go in the middle of the sea, walking on dry ground.

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nengagka' roda amung kerétadeh, pad na miak mawer. Idi kebala lun Masir, "Do' tau buro rat pa kiung lun Israil, ngaceku Tuhan luk pebunu' netau ku libaldeh.”
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Stretch out your arm toward the sea again. Then the water will come back on the Egyptians and on their chariots and their horsemen.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Ngegenang langenmu pa luun abpa', pad abpa' ineh lemubed pa luun amung lun Masir dengan amung kerétadeh idi lun luk ngimet keréta ineh.”
english: So Moses/I stretched out his/my arm, and as the sun was rising, the water returned to its normal level. The Egyptians tried to escape, but Yahweh hurled them back into the sea.

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh Musa idi lun Israil nemenani nani ini kuan Tuhan: "Ui sikal menani kuan Tuhan, ngaceku rayeh tu laludNeh; pangeh Ieh nemepet kuda dengan lun luk maya' ineh bang abpa'.
english: Then Moses/I sang this song, and the Israeli people sang with him: “I will sing to Yahweh, because he has triumphed gloriously; He has thrown the horses and their riders into the sea!

lun_bawang: Dengan awaMu Iko nguyut pupu luk pangeh inuli'Mu. Dengan tuehMu Iko nguyut nedeh macing inan su luk inanMu luk meligan.
english: You faithfully loved the people you rescued; with your power you are leading them to the land that you have set apart.

lun_bawang: Idi Miriam menani kuandeh, kenanineh, "Ngubur Tuhan ngaceku pelaba rayeh laludNeh. Kuda idi lun luk tudo luunneh, pangeh tila'Neh bang abpa'.”
english: and she sang this song to Yahweh: “Sing to Yahweh, because he has triumphed gloriously over his enemies. He has thrown the horses and their riders into the sea.”

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh idi pupu ineh ngedureng ni Musa, kebaladeh, "Anunké luk rupen tau?”
english: The people complained to Moses/me, saying, “What are we going to drink?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa idi Arun nelun Israil, "Malem ini muyuh miak kali' Tuhan luk pangeh nenguit nemuyuh remuat rat bang bawang Masir,
english: So Aaron and Moses/I said to all the Israeli people, “This evening you will know that it was Yahweh, not we, who brought you out of Egypt.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa ni Arun, "Ngecuk amung lun Israil tuped pa kiung Tuhan, ngaceku Ieh pangeh neninger durengdeh.”
english: Then Moses/I said to Aaron, “Tell all the Israeli people, ‘Come and stand here in the presence of Yahweh, because he has heard what you have been complaining about.’”

lun_bawang: "Ui pangeh neninger dureng lun Israil. Mada' nedeh, kebalamu, 'Idi kareb pun malem, muyuh miak kuman uang, idi kareb pa pekak muyuh miak kuman ruti pad macing mebor, pelé muyuh kali' Ui ini Tuhan Allah muyuh!”
english: “I have heard what the Israeli people have been complaining about. So say to them, ‘From now on, each evening, you will have meat to eat. And each morning you will have something that will take the place of bread. You will have all you want of it to eat.’ Then you will know that I, Yahweh, have the power to do what I say that I will do.”

lun_bawang: Kareb lun Israil nenier ineh, idi kebaladeh seburur inan seburur, "Anunké ini?" Kebala Musa nedeh, "Ini akan luk biré Tuhan kuan muyuh.
english: When the Israeli people saw it, since they had never seen it before and did not know what it was, they said to each other, “What is it?” Moses/I replied to them, “It is something Yahweh has given you to eat, to take the place of bread.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa nedeh, "Seburur pana' na miak necan elaneh macing pekak.”
english: Moses/I said to them, “Do not leave any of it to eat tomorrow morning!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa, "Kuman ineh aco sini, ngaceku aco sini Aco Rayeh kuan Tuhan. Aco sini na muyuh miak ngalap ineh déi' natad.
english: On that day, Moses/I said, “Eat today what you have saved from yesterday, because today is a day dedicated to Yahweh. Today you will not find any of that food outside.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Tuda' io muyuh na maya' balaKu?
english: Then Yahweh told Moses/me to say this to the people: “How long will you people refuse to do all the things that I tell you?

lun_bawang: Idi lun Israil neneten ngadan akan ineh manna. Ayuneh mepad kudeng aceh ilung luk medari idi mebuda', idi ieh mén mepad kudeng pinaram luk pinuar ku duru'.
english: The Israeli people called this food manna, which sounds like the words in their language that mean ‘what is it?’ It looked like small seeds called coriander, but it was white, and it tasted like thin wafers/biscuits made with honey.

lun_bawang: Kebala Musa ni Arun, "Ngalap aceh sidangur, idi nganau' setangal manna bang ineh. Idi ngerareng ineh pa kiung Tuhan, nugen kuan inul tau.”
english: And he/I said to Aaron, “Take a jar, and put two quarts of manna in it. Then put it in a place where Yahweh can see it. It is to be kept like that for all future generations.”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengedureng ni Musa, kebaladeh, "Maré abpa' rupen kai." Iamo' kebala Musa nedeh, "Ngudeh muyuh ngedureng negku? Ngudeh muyuh nutun Tuhan?”
english: So the people complained to Moses/me again, saying, “Give us water to drink!” Moses/I replied to them, “Why are you ◄criticizing/arguing with► me RHQ? And why are you trying to determine whether Yahweh has the power to provide for you?”

lun_bawang: Idi lun Israil pelaba paring. Idi ideh nengedureng ni Musa, kebaladeh, "Ngudehké iko nguit nekai remuat rat bang bawang Masir, pad ngaté nekai, dengan anak-anak kai idi aya' kai ku paring?”
english: But the people were very thirsty, and they continued to complain to Moses/me. They were saying things like “Why did you bring us out of Egypt?”, and “Did you bring us here to cause us and our children and livestock to die ◄from thirst/because we had no water to drink► RHQ?”

lun_bawang: Idi Musa nesembayang inan Tuhan, kesembayangneh, "Anun luk ruenku kuan pupu ini? Na mio ideh mitung negku ku batu!”
english: So Moses/I prayed earnestly to Yahweh. He/I said, “◄How shall I deal with these people?/I do not know how to deal with these people!► RHQ They are almost ready to kill me by throwing stones at me!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Nalan rat pa kiung pupu ineh idi nguit pebaya' namu tuda'-tuda' lun rayeh rat arang lun Israil ineh. Idi teh nguit rukudmu luk nepimabpet Abpa' Nil idi nalan.
english: Yahweh replied to Moses/me, “Take some of the elders/leaders of the Israeli people with you and tell the rest of the people to follow you to Sinai Mountain. Take along the stick with which you struck the Nile River.

lun_bawang: Idi su ineh titen "Tutun" idi "Kedaluh," ngaceku lun Israil pangeh nepekedaluh idi nenutun Tuhan, kebaladeh, "Inanké Tuhan arang tau, kian na?”
english: Moses/I gave that place two names in the Hebrew language: Massah, which means ‘testing’, and Meribah, which means ‘complaining’. He/I gave it the name Massah because the Israeli people were testing Yahweh, saying “Is Yahweh really among us and able to help us, or not?”, and he/I gave it the name Meribah because they were continually complaining.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa ni Yusak, "Mili' tuda'-tuda' burur iten tau, idi amé' pebunu' nelun Amalek nebpa. Ui miak tuped luun buduk surud ineh, idi ngimet rukud luk biré Allah kuanku.”
english: Moses/I said to Joshua, who was one of our army/Israeli leaders, “Choose some men to go out and fight against the Amalek people-group tomorrow. I will stand on the top of the hill, holding the stick that God told me to carry.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Ngayud amung ini mangun ku aceh terawé, idi mada' ni Yusak: Ui miak ngelaya' nelun Amalek pad ideh na teruayen!”
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Write an account of this battle, and then read it to Joshua. Also write that some day I will completely get rid of the Amalek people-group.”

lun_bawang: Idi Musa nemudut aceh bubpun idi neneten ineh, "Tuhan ineh bedéraKu.”
english: Then Moses/I built a stone altar there and named it ‘Yahweh is like my flag’.

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "Ngegenang ticu'mu pa luun bedéra Tuhan! Tuhan pebunu' nelun Amalek ineh macing ruked-ruked."
english: He/I said, “Hold high Yahweh’s flag! Yahweh will continue to fight against the Amalek people-group ◄forever/in all future generations►!”

lun_bawang: idi anak deléineh luk dueh, ieh ineh Gersom idi Elieser. (Kebala Musa, "Ui ini mangun ku lun sakai bang bawang baken"; idi ieh neneten ngadan sebuleng anakneh, Gersom.
english: bringing Zipporah and their/our two sons. One son was named Gershom, which sounds like the Hebrew word that means ‘foreigner’, because he/I had said, “I have been a foreigner living in another land.”

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebalaneh, "Allah tamanku nengedengan negku, pad ui nepuit ratnan pelapet raca' Masir"; idi ieh neneten ngadan sebuleng anakneh, Elieser.)
english: Her other son was named Eliezer, which sounds like the Hebrew words that mean ‘God helps me’, because he/I had said “God, whom my father worshiped, has helped me and saved me from being killed MTY by the king of Egypt.”

lun_bawang: Ieh pangeh nengecuk mada' ni Musa, "Ui, ibanmu Yitro, amé' namu idi nguit awanmu dengan anakneh luk dueh.”
english: Jethro had sent a message to Moses/me, “I, your father-in-law, Jethro, am coming to see you, bringing along your wife and your two sons!”

lun_bawang: kebalaneh, "Ngubur Tuhan luk pangeh nemuit nemuyuh ratnan imet raca' Masir idi anak itinneh luk nenaban nemuyuh.
english: He said, “Praise Yahweh, who has rescued you from the powerful MTY Egyptian king and his army!

lun_bawang: Kareb Yitro nenier amung kekamen Musa ineh, idi keburi'neh, "Anun luk ruenmu kuan lun mula' ineh? Ngudeh iko sebuleng mo' mutut ukum ini, idi amungdeh tuped pa kiungmu rat pekak macing malem?”
english: When Jethro saw everything that Moses/I was doing for the people, he said, “◄Why are you doing all this for the people?/You should not be doing all this for the people!► RHQ Why are you doing this by yourself, and all the people are crowding around you, from morning until evening, asking you to make decisions for them RHQ?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa, "Ui nganau' kudeng ini, ngaceku lun mula' macing negku pad kali' pian Allah.
english: Moses/I replied, “I am doing this because the people keep coming to me to find out what God desires.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yitro, "Na do' kudeng luk inau' mineh.
english: Jethro said to him/me, “What you are doing is not good for you or for the people.

lun_bawang: Idi Musa uké surud amé' papu' Allah. Idi Tuhan nenawar neneh rat luun surud, kebalaNeh, "Mada' nelun Israil, ieh ineh inul Yakub, kudeng ini,
english: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians. You have seen what I did for all of you and how I brought you here to me. It was as though I lifted you up as an eagle carries its young eaglets on its wings MET.

lun_bawang: Idi amungdeh ineh peranga' nengor, kebaladeh, "Amung bala luk biré Tuhan, ieh ineh bén kai!" Idi Musa nengacing amung bala lun mula' inan Tuhan.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Listen carefully: I am going to appear to you from inside a thick cloud. When I am speaking to you, the people will hear it, and they will always trust in you.” Then Moses/I went down the mountain and reported to the people what Yahweh said. Then he/I went back up the mountain and told Yahweh what the people replied.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Ui temurun amé' namu bang aceh laput luk mekapal, idi lun mula' miak ninger kareb Ui pebala namu, pad ideh merapet namu macing ruked-ruked." Idi Musa nengacing amung bala lun mula' ineh inan Tuhan.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Go back down to the people again. Tell them to purify themselves today and tomorrow. Tell them to wash their clothes, too.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Amé' iko nelun mula' ineh. Do' ideh temina' aco sini idi nebpa teh, idi mupu' ayungdeh,
english: They must do that to be ready on the day after tomorrow. On that day I will come down to Sinai Mountain to where all the people can see me.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa nelun mula' ineh, "Temina' muyuh aco luk keteluh. Seburur pana' na miak pamung inan decur.”
english: Two days later, during the morning, there was thunder and lightning, and a very dark cloud on the mountain. A trumpet sounded very loudly, with the result that the people in the camp shook/trembled because they were very afraid.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Temurun iko ngecuk lun mula' ineh aleg ngusag ar idi amé' muneng inan Tuhan sikal nier Neneh, pad lemulun na maté.
english: Also, the priests who habitually come near me must purify themselves. If they do not do that, I will punish them.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa inan Tuhan, "Lun mula' na miak uké Pegkung Sinai ini, ngaceku Tuhan pangeh nepebala negku kudeng ini, 'Nganau' ibpeng pekelibut pegkung ineh idi ngeligan neneh.' “
english: Yahweh replied, “Go down the mountain, and bring Aaron back up with you. But do not allow the priests or other people to cross the boundary to come up to me. If they cross it, I will punish them.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Temurun iko. Muci iko lemubed dengan Arun. Iamo' amung imam idi lun mula' ineh aleg ngusag ar pian amé' matun Tuhan pad ideh na inan Tuhan museh.”
english: So Moses/I went down the mountain again and told the people what Yahweh had said.

lun_bawang: "Ui ini Tuhan Allahmu luk pangeh nenguyut namu remuat rat bang bawang Masir, rat su luk inanmu tiban ineh.
english: “I am Yahweh God, the one you worship. I am the one who brought you out of Egypt. I am the one who freed you from being slaves there.

lun_bawang: "Aleg iko maya' allah baken rat Negku.
english: So you must worship only me; you must not worship any other god.

lun_bawang: "Aleg iko nganau' akang maya' ayu anun-anun luk i langit, idi luk bang tana', idi luk bang abpa' pana'.
english: You must not carve/make for yourselves any idol that represents anything in the sky or that is on the ground or that is in the water under the ground/earth.

lun_bawang: "Aleg neten ngadan Tuhan Allahmu mo'-mo', ngaceku Ui miak ngukum idé'- idé' luk neten ngadanKu mo'-mo'.
english: Do not use my name carelessly (OR, for wrong/evil purposes), because I am Yahweh God, the one whom you should worship, and I will certainly punish those who use my name for wrong/evil purposes LIT.

lun_bawang: "Nginita iko Aco luk inan Mudeng pad iko ngeligan neneh kuan Tuhan.
english: Do not forget that the seventh day of every week is mine, so dedicate those days to me.

lun_bawang: "Do' ngedita' tamanmu idi tinanmu, pad ulunmu mekadang bang bawang luk barén Tuhan Allah namu.
english: Honor/Respect your fathers and your mothers, in order that you may live a long time in the land that I, Yahweh God, will give you.

lun_bawang: "Aleg iko pasét.
english: Do not ◄commit adultery/have sex with anyone other than your spouse►.

lun_bawang: "Aleg iko ngadu' nelun denganmu dengan mebalih.
english: Do not falsely accuse anyone of committing a crime.

lun_bawang: "Aleg iko melili ku ruma' lun denganmu. Aleg iko melili ku awanneh, lun tebarinneh, sapi'neh, keladaineh, idi anun-anun binaweh lun luk denganmu.”
english: Do not ◄covet/desire to have► someone else’s house, someone else’s wife, someone else’s male or female slave, someone else’s livestock, someone else’s donkeys, or anything else that some other person owns.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh ni Musa, "Do' iko sebuleng pebala nekai idi kai miak ninger. Iamo' aleg Allah pebala nekai, pad kai na maté.”
english: and said to Moses/me, “If you speak to us, we will listen. But do not let God speak any more to us. We are afraid that if he speaks any more to us, we will die.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa nedeh, "Aleg matot, ngaceku Allah pangeh netemurun sikal nutun nemuyuh, pad tot inan Tuhan idi kidi-kidi pa kiung muyuh, pelé muyuh na nganau' sala'.”
english: Moses/I replied, “Do not be afraid! God has come to determine/test how you will behave. He wants you to revere him, and to not sin.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Do' iko mala kuan lun Israil kudeng ini: 'Muyuh pangeh nenier Negku nepebala nemuyuh rat langit.
english: Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Say this to the Israeli people: ‘You have heard how I, Yahweh, have spoken to you from heaven. I told you that you must not make any idols of silver or gold that you will worship instead of me.

lun_bawang: "Do' maré nelun Israil amung ukum ini:
english: “Here are some other instructions to give to the Israeli people:

lun_bawang: Kudeng iko melih aceh demulun lun Iberani, anem lak kinioneh ieh miak ngakem kuanmu. Iamo' bang lak luk ketudu' do' ieh puatin, dengan na ngua' anun-anun.
english: When/If you buy a Hebrew slave, he is to serve you for only six years. In the seventh year you must free him from being your slave, and he is not required to pay you anything for setting him free.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng selemulun masui anakneh luk decur, idi na ieh miak mepad kudeng demulun deléi.
english: If a man sells his daughter to become a slave, she should not be set free after six years, as the male slaves are.

lun_bawang: "Idé'-idé luk necat seburur lemulun macing maté, na miak na ieh pitayen.
english: You must execute anyone who strikes another person with the result that the person who is struck dies.

lun_bawang: "Idé-idé luk necat taman kian tinanneh, kali' rungen ieh pitayen.
english: Anyone who strikes his father or mother must surely be executed.

lun_bawang: "Idé-idé luk naban lemulun, kudeng ieh masui neneh, kian kudeng ieh ngimet neneh ku demulunneh, na miak na ieh pitayen.
english: Anyone who kidnaps another person, either in order to sell that person or to keep him as a slave, must be executed.

lun_bawang: "Idé-idé luk ngediman taman kian tinanneh, na miak na ieh pitayen.
english: Anyone who reviles/curses his father or his mother must be executed.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng inan lemulun luk pekedaluh idi seburur mitung seburur ku batu kian mukut neneh lek, kudeng ieh na maté, na lun luk ngedereh neneh ineh pitayen. Iamo' kudeng léi luk pidereh ineh mét,
english: Suppose two people fight, and one strikes the other with a stone or with his fist. And suppose the person he strikes does not die but is injured and has to stay in bed for a while,

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng selemulun mebal demulunneh deléi, kian decur lek, pad ieh maté, na miak na ieh kumin.
english: If someone strikes his male or female slave with a stick, if the slave dies ◄immediately/as a result► IDM, the one who struck him must be punished.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng inan lun luk pekedaluh idi necat sebuleng decur luk mali' pad anakneh musul, iamo' na uratneh baken, na miak na lun luk nenecat neneh ineh kumin maya' putuh awanneh, idi luk uen lun luk mutut besara' ngeletep.
english: Suppose two people are fighting and they hurt a pregnant woman with the result that ◄she has a miscarriage/her baby is born prematurely and dies►. If the woman is not harmed in any other way, the one who injured her must pay a fine. He must pay whatever the woman’s husband demands, after a judge approves of the fine.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng selemulun necat mateh demulunneh luk deléi kian decur lek pad mateh demulunneh nedat, na miak na demulun ineh puatin ku ua' matehneh.
english: If someone knocks out one of his slave’s teeth, he must free the slave because of what he did to the slave’s tooth.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng aceh sapi' ngegkul aceh lemulun pad ieh maté, na miak na sapi' ineh bitungin ku batu macing maté. Uangneh na miak kenen. Iamo' luk kuan sapi' ineh na kumin.
english: But suppose the bull had attacked people several times before, and its owner had been warned, but he did not keep the bull inside a fence. Then you must kill the bull by throwing stones at it, but you must also execute its owner.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng aceh lubang bang tana' sinima' lun tekerubab, idi lemulun luk ngukat lubang na ngakeb ineh, idi petacu aceh sapi' kian keladai lek peturun bang ineh,
english: Then the owner of the pit/cistern must pay for the animal that died. He must give the money to the animal’s owner, but then he can take away the animal that died and do whatever he wants to with it.

lun_bawang: Idi kudeng sapi' seburur ngurat sapi' lun denganneh pad ieh maté, na miak na sapi' luk mulun ineh pisuen, idi usin raganeh uen mabpat dueh. Kudeng ineh teh babpat uang sapi' seluk naté ineh.
english: However, if people know that the bull often attacked other animals previously, and its owner did not keep it inside a fence, then the owner of that bull must give the owner of the bull that died one of his own bulls, but he can take away the animal that died and do with it whatever he wants to do.”

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng selemulun mano aceh sapi', kian dumba lek, idi ieh ngeret neneh idi masui neneh, na miak na ieh libalen sebuleng sapi' ineh ku limeh sapi', idi sebuleng dumba libalneh apat dumba.
english: Yahweh also said, “If someone steals a bull or a sheep, and then slaughters it to sell it or to sacrifice it or sells its meat to someone else, he must pay five bulls for the bull that he stole, and he must pay four sheep for the sheep that he stole.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng inan apui luk mulun idi ngeseb budud, idi apui ineh meperuit idi ngeseb padé luk tibuduk, idi luk nateh piranih idi maput lati' ineh neseb, do' lemulun luk pun nengimun apui ineh ngelibal luk iseb ineh dengan petap.
english: Suppose someone starts a fire in his own field, and the fire spreads through the grass and starts burning in someone else’s field, and the fire burns grain that is growing or grain that is already cut and stacked. Then the person who started the fire must pay completely for the damage.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng selemulun maré usin idi binaweh-binaweh nugen lun denganneh, idi ieh pino rat bang ruma' lun ineh, kudeng luk nemano ineh nekali', na miak na ieh mayar dueh kua' kinula'neh.
english: Suppose someone gives to another person some money or other valuable goods and asks him to guard them in his house for a while. If those things are stolen from that person’s house, if the thief is caught, he must pay back twice as much as he stole.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng aceh lemulun maré nelun denganneh sebuleng keladai, kian sapi', dumba, aya' luk baken-baken lek, luk ruenneh ngasa', idi aya' ineh maté idi nurat idi pino dengan na lun nekali',
english: Suppose someone gives his donkey or bull or sheep or some other animal to someone else and asks him to take care of it for a while, and the animal dies or is injured or is stolen while no one is watching.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng selemulun mutuh ngiceh sebuleng aya' rat nelun denganneh, idi aya' ineh murat kian maté lek kareb lemulun luk kuan ineh na idi, idi do' ieh ngelibal ineh dengan petap.
english: If someone borrows an animal, and if that animal is hurt or dies when its owner is not there, the one who borrowed it must pay the owner for the animal.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng seburur deléi ngubuk anak luk pun mebaruh luk na inan tuduk idi pamung denganneh, na miak na didueh paweh idi ieh mayar purut.
english: “If a man persuades a girl/woman to have sex with him, a girl/woman who ◄is a virgin/has never had sex with any man► and who is not engaged to be married, he must pay the bride price for her and marry her.

lun_bawang: "Aleg iko nima' decur luk mangun ineh mulun.
english: You must execute any woman who ◄practices sorcery/is a shaman►.

lun_bawang: "Idé-idé luk pamung dengan pung na miak na ieh pitayen.
english: You must execute any person who has sex with an animal.

lun_bawang: "Idé-idé luk maré luk sabpen kuan allah baken ratnan Tuhan, do' ieh pitayen.
english: You must offer sacrifices only to Yahweh. You must execute anyone who offers a sacrifice to any other god.

lun_bawang: "Idi aleg iko ngedereh lun sakai idi ngesusa' neneh. Muyuh pana' pangeh mangun ku lun sakai bang bawang Masir.
english: You must not mistreat a foreigner who comes to live among you. Do not forget that you were previously foreigners in Egypt.

lun_bawang: Aleg muyuh ngedereh decur tinula' idi anak maté.
english: You must not mistreat any widow or any orphan.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng iko maré usin kebiten lun pupuKu luk masi', aleg iko mupud ineh dengan mesaad. Idi aleg ngalap bunga'neh teh.
english: If you lend money to any of my people who are poor, do not act like a moneylender and require him to pay interest on the money.

lun_bawang: "Aleg iko nguyo Allah, idi aleg iko ngediman aceh lun rayeh pupumu.
english: Do not ◄revile/speak evil about► me, and do not ◄curse/ask me to do harmful things to► any ruler of your people.

lun_bawang: "Aleg ngisiden maré babpat pulu' padému, anggurmu, idi umaumu. "Idi do' iko maré kuanKu anak deléimu luk atun.
english: ◄Do not withhold from/Give► me the best parts of the grain that you harvest and of the olive oil and the wine that you produce.

lun_bawang: "Muyuh ini pupuKu. Ngaceku ineh aleg muyuh kuman uang pung luk kikem pung luk meliput bang pulung. Do' muyuh maré ineh kuan uko'.
english: You are people who are ◄completely dedicated to/set apart for► me. And I detest the meat of any animal that has been killed by wild animals. Therefore you should not eat such meat. Instead, throw it where the dogs can eat it.”

lun_bawang: "Aleg iko nguit bala luk mebalih. Idi aleg iko ngedengan lemulun luk dat idi mangun ku lun nekali' luk na matu.
english: “Do not tell to others ◄false rumors/untrue reports► about other people. Do not help someone who is guilty by ◄testifying falsely/lying► about what happened.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko maya' bala lun mula' nganau' luk dat. Idi aleg iko mangun ku lun nekali' luk mebaken maya' lun mula' ineh, pad na maya' luk matu.
english: Do not join a group of people who are planning to do something evil. Do not testify the way the crowd wants you to, if that will prevent the judge from deciding the case justly/fairly.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng iko kali' sapi' lun luk museh namu idi keladai luk meraruh, do' iko ngelubed neneh dengan mesaget.
english: If you see someone’s bull or donkey when it is wandering away loose, take it back to its owner, even if the owner is your enemy.

lun_bawang: "Aleg mutut besara' lun masi' maya' dalan luk na mesiri.
english: Decide the cases of poor people who are on trial as fairly as you decide the cases of other people.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko ngadu' lemulun dengan mebalih. Idi aleg maré ukum maté kuan lemulun luk na mesala' idi luk matu. Ngaceku Ui ngukum lemulun luk nganau' luk kudeng ineh.
english: Do not accuse people falsely. Do not decide that innocent and righteous DOU people should be executed, because I will ◄punish/not forgive► people who do such an evil thing.

lun_bawang: Idi teh aleg iko ngalap suap, ngaceku suap ineh muser mateh lemulun luk mileh, idi ngekilu' bala lemulun luk matu.
english: Do not accept money that is a bribe, because officials who accept bribes are not able to MTY decide what is right to do, and they do not allow innocent people to be treated fairly.

lun_bawang: "Idi teh, aleg iko ngedereh nelun sakai. Muyuh kali' niat lun sakai, ngaceku muyuh pana' mangun ku lun sakai bang bawang Masir atun.
english: Do not mistreat foreigners who live among you. You know how people often treat foreigners, because the Egyptians did not treat you well when you were foreigners there.

lun_bawang: "Idi anem lak kinioneh do' iko nganau' lati' idi kabun pana', idi ngalap uli'neh.
english: Plant seeds in your ground and gather the harvest for six years.

lun_bawang: "Do' iko ngakem anem aco kinioneh. Iamo' aco luk ketudu' aleg iko ngadem, pad sapi' idi keladaimu pana' miak ucu'. Idi demulun idi sakaimu pana' miak ngato erurdeh.
english: You may work for six days each week, but on the seventh day you must rest and not work. And on the seventh day you must allow your work animals and your slaves and the foreigners who live among you also to rest and be refreshed.

lun_bawang: "Ui ini Tuhan. Do' ninger amung balaKu. Aleg sembayang nan allah luk baken, idi aleg neten ngadandeh.
english: Make certain that you obey everything that I have commanded you to do. Do not pray to MTY other gods. Do not even mention their names.”

lun_bawang: "Teluh kua' selak do' iko nganau' aco rayeh kuanKu.
english: “Every year you must celebrate three festivals to honor me.

lun_bawang: "Aleg iko maré ruti luk inan lamud dengan pung luk kereten kuanKu. Idi aleg nima' lemak ratnan luk biré Negku ketecan macing kenebpa.
english: When you sacrifice an animal and offer it to me, you must not offer bread that has been baked with yeast. When you offer sacrifices, burn the fat from the animals on that same day. Do not allow any fat to remain until the next morning.

lun_bawang: "Amung bua' luk pun ilap ratnan lati'mu do' nguit semuet bang ruma' Tuhan Allahmu. "Aleg iko nanek anak dumba kian amék ku rata tinanneh.
english: Each year, when you harvest your crops, bring to the place where you worship me, Yahweh God, the first part of what you harvest. When you kill a ◄young animal/kid or lamb or calf►, do not prepare to eat it by boiling it in its mother’s milk.”

lun_bawang: "Ui ngecuk aceh melaikat amé' pa kiungmu pad matar namu idi nguit namu macing su luk tinina'Ku ineh.
english: “Note this: I am going to send an angel ahead of you, to guard you as you travel and to bring you safely to the place that I have prepared for you. Pay attention to what he says and obey him. Do not rebel against him, because he will have my authority MTY and he will ◄punish/not forgive► LIT you if you rebel against him.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Mudik iko idi amé' papu' Negku dengan Arun, Nadab, Abihu, idi tudu' ngepulu' lun rayeh Israil, idi tekeradung sembayang rat mado.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Come to me, up on top of this mountain, you and Aaron and his sons Nadab and Abihu. Also take along 70 of the Israeli elders/leaders. While you are still some distance from the top of the mountain, prostrate yourselves on the ground and worship me.

lun_bawang: Musa iné' mada' nelun mula' amung bala Tuhan. Idi amungdeh peranga' nengor bala ineh, kebaladeh, "Amung ukum ini luk bila Tuhan, kai miak maya'!”
english: Moses/I went and told the people everything that Yahweh had said and all that he had commanded. The people all replied together, saying, “We will do everything that Yahweh has told us to do.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengalap surat pejani' ineh, idi ieh nemaca' ineh pedingeren pupu ineh. Idi kebaladeh, "Amung luk bida' Tuhan ineh, kai miak maya'.”
english: Then he/I took the scroll on which he/I had written everything that Yahweh had commanded in the agreement that he had made, and he/I read it aloud, while all the people were listening. Then all the people said, “We will do all that Yahweh has told us to do. We will obey everything.”

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh Musa nengalap dara' ineh, idi ieh nengisak ineh luun pupu ineh, idi nepebala, "Ini dara' pejani' luk litep Tuhan kuan muyuh kareb Ieh nemaré amung ukum ini.”
