english: Then Moses/I took the blood that was in the bowls and threw/splashed it on the people. He/I said, “This is the blood that ◄confirms/puts into effect► the agreement that Yahweh made with you when he gave you all these commands.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Mudik iko teh amé' papu' Negku, idi tudo tungé'. Ui sikal maré namu dueh batu tebalad, ieh ineh bala idi ukum luk pangeh inayudKu ku mada' nedeh.”
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Come up to me again on top of this mountain. While you are here, I will give you two stone slabs on which I have written all the laws DOU that I have given to you to instruct/teach the people.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa nelun rayeh-rayeh ineh, "Nganét ieni muyuh pad kai lemubed. Arun idi Hur idi dengan muyuh. Idé luk inan luk tunin, do' amé' matun nedidueh.”
english: Then Moses/I went the rest of the way up the mountain. A cloud covered the mountain.

lun_bawang: "Ngecuk nelun Israil ngamung tuda'-tuda' baré kuanKu ratnan anid-anid lun luk pian maré ineh, idi ngalap ineh kuanKu.
english: Tell them that they must give offerings/gifts to me. Receive from the people every offering/gift that they want to give to me.

lun_bawang: "Ngecuk nelun mula' nganau' aceh pati' ratnan kayuh pirur, kikadangneh dueh sikuh setangal, pipangneh sesikuh setangal, idi kidita'neh semikuh setangal.
english: “Tell the people to make a sacred chest from acacia wood. It is to be ◄45 in./110 cm.► long, ◄27 in./66 cm.► wide, and ◄27 in./66 cm.► high.

lun_bawang: "Idi teh do' iko mudut méja ratnan kayuh pirur, dueh sikuh kikadangneh, semikuh pipangneh, idi semikuh setangal kidita'neh.
english: “Tell them to make a table from acacia wood. It is to be ◄36 in./88 cm.► long, ◄18 in./66 cm.► wide, and ◄27 in./66 cm.► high.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' iko nganau' aceh kukud dawan ratnan amas luk do'. Nganau' puet idi batangneh ratnan amas luk tinuno, idi busak-busakneh, dengan busak luk nateh nelusad pana', tekapit nan batang ineh.
english: “Tell them to make a lampstand from pure gold. They must hammer one large lump of gold to make its base and its shaft. The branches of the lampstand, the cups for holding the oil, the flower buds and the flower petals that decorate the branches of the lamp, the base, and the shaft are all to be hammered from one big lump of gold.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' nganau' Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan ratnan pulu' pekatu kibung ratnan kibung pu luk inuper idi luk do'. Idi ayuneh mebata' melaco, sia' merirem, idi sia' melidang luk tibaruh do'-do' dengan melaikat karub.
english: “Tell the people to make the Sacred Tent using ten long strips of fine linen. They must take blue, purple, and red thread (OR, weave the strips from blue, purple, and red thread), and a skilled craftsman must embroider these strips with designs that represent the winged creatures that are above the chest.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' nganau' ducungneh ratnan pulu' aceh pekatu kibung luk inau' ratnan buluh amék.
english: Also, tell them to make a cover for the Sacred Tent from eleven pieces of cloth made from goats’ hair.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' nganau' tuda'-tuda' kayuh ku tulang ratnan kayuh pirur kuan Lepo ineh.
english: “Tell them to make 48 frames from acacia wood, frames that will be set up from which to hang the Sacred Tent covers.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' nganau' pulu' limeh atang ratnan kayuh pirur, limeh pekatu kuan selipa Lepo ineh,
english: Tell them to make 15 crossbars from acacia wood.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' nganau' aceh dicing ratnan kibung luk do', idi kibung pu luk inuper, idi luk ayu bata' melaco, sia' merirem, idi sia' melidang, tibaruh do'-do' ku melaikat karub.
english: “Tell them to make a curtain from fine linen. A skilled craftsman must embroider it with blue, purple, and red yarn/thread, making designs to represent the winged creatures that are above the chest.

lun_bawang: "Idi munung tanga' Lepo ineh do' nganau' aceh dicing, ratnan kibung pu luk do', idi luk inuper, ayuneh bata' melaco, sia' merirem, idi sia' melidang; idi luk tibaruh.
english: Tell them to make a curtain to cover the entrance of the Sacred Tent. They must make it from fine linen, and a skilled weaver must embroider it with blue, purple, and red yarn/thread.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' nganau' aceh bubpun luk apat lebping ratnan kayuh pirur, limeh sikuh kadangneh, idi limeh sikuh pipangneh, idi teh teluh sikuh dita'neh.
english: “Tell them to make an altar from acacia wood. It is to be square, ◄7-1/2 feet/2.2 meters► on each side, and make it ◄4-1/2 feet/1.3 meters► high.

lun_bawang: "Do' nganau' natad Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan, idi ngalad ineh ku dicing ratnan kibung pu luk inuper. Kikadang dicing luk pa kabing busat aco, dueh ngepulu' limeh depeh.
english: “Around the Sacred Tent there is to be a courtyard. To form the courtyard, tell them to make curtains of fine linen. On the south side, the curtain is to be ◄50 yards/44 meters► long.

lun_bawang: "Do' iko ngecuk nelun Israil nguit amé' namu umau saitun luk meluun do' ku umau lapung, pad lapung ineh miak uen nutud anid alem.
english: They must put the lampstand outside of the curtain which is in front of the sacred chest which contains the stone slabs on which I have written my commandments. Aaron must take care of the lamps. After he dies, his descendants must do this work. The lamps are to burn every night, from evening until morning. The Israeli people must obey this regulation throughout all future generations.”

lun_bawang: "Do' neteng kinanakmu Arun, idi anak-anakneh, ieh ineh Nadab, Abihu, Eliasar, idi Itamar. Ngatad nedeh ratnan pupu Israil, pad ideh mangun ku imam kuanKu.
english: “Summon your older brother Aaron and his sons—Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. ◄Set them apart/They are the ones whom I have chosen► from the rest of the Israeli people, in order that they can serve me by being priests.

lun_bawang: "Do' ideh nganau' kuyu' imam ineh, ratnan buluh dumba luk bata' melaco, sia' merirem, idi sia' melidang, idi gitian luk inau' ratnan amas, idi kibung pu luk do', idi do' ieh uen ngebaruh.
english: “The skilled workmen must make the sacred apron from fine linen, and skillfully embroider it with blue, purple, and red yarn/thread.

lun_bawang: "Do' nganau' aceh kakeb ruuk luk pimada' pian Allah, aceh luk mepad kudeng ayu kuyu' luk tibaruh.
english: “Tell the skilled workman to make a sacred pouch for Aaron to wear over his chest. He will use the things he puts into the pouch to determine my answers to the questions he asks. It must be made of the same materials as the sacred apron, and embroidered in the same way.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' iko nganau' kuyu' buyor imam ineh ratnan buluh dumba luk bata' melaco amung.
english: “Tell the workmen to use only blue cloth to make the robe that is to be worn underneath the priest’s sacred apron.

lun_bawang: "Idi teh do' iko nganau' aceh balad amas luk do' idi ngayud luun ineh, 'Linigan Kuan Tuhan.'
english: “Tell them to make a tiny ornament of pure gold, and tell a ◄skilled workman/gem-cutter► to engrave on it the words, ‘Dedicated to Yahweh.’

lun_bawang: "Idi teh do' nganau' kuyu'-kuyu', abet awa', idi aduk ku abet uluh kuan anak-anak Arun mangun ku ubur idi tagadeh.
english: “Tell them to make beautiful long-sleeved tunics/gowns, sashes, and caps for Aaron’s sons. Make ones that will be suitable for those who have this dignified work.

lun_bawang: "Idi ini luk ruenmu kuan Arun idi anak-anakneh ku ngeligan nedeh, pad ideh mangun ku imam kuanKu. Ngalap aceh sapi' deléi luk pegawa' idi dueh dumba deléi luk do'.
english: “This is what you must do to dedicate Aaron and his sons to serve me by being priests: Select one young bull and two rams that do not have any defects.

lun_bawang: Do' nguit sapi' pa atun Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan, idi ngecuk Arun idi anak-anakneh ngerareng ticu'deh luun uluhneh.
english: “Then bring the young bull to the entrance of the Sacred Tent. Tell Aaron and his sons to put their hands on the head of the young bull.

lun_bawang: "Do' iko ngalap sebuleng dumba deléi ineh, idi ngecuk Arun idi anak- anakneh ngerareng ticu'deh luun uluhneh.
english: “Then select one of the rams, and tell Aaron and his sons to put their hands on the head of the ram.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' iko ngalap dumba deléi luk baken ineh, idi ngecuk Arun idi anak- anakneh ngerareng ticu'deh luun uluhneh.
english: “Take the other ram that was selected for these rituals, and tell Aaron and his sons to put their hands on the ram’s head.

lun_bawang: "Do' ngalap ruuk dumba deléi ineh, idi nicul ineh ku aceh baré pa kiungKu. Babpat ini kuanmu.
english: Then take the meat of the ribs of the second ram that was killed, and lift it up high as an offering to me. But then this part of the animal will be for you to eat.

lun_bawang: "Do' ayung Arun luk meligan ineh pinul macing ku anak-anakneh luk muci, pad ideh miak ngayung ku ineh kareb ideh uen ngeletep.
english: “After Aaron dies, the special clothes that he wore will belong to his sons. They are to wear those clothes when they are ◄set apart/dedicated► to become priests.

lun_bawang: "Do' ngalap uang dumba deléi luk baré ku ngeletep Arun idi anak-anakneh, idi nanek ineh su apeh luk meligan.
english: “Take the meat of the other ram that was sacrificed to ◄set apart/dedicate► Aaron and his sons, and boil it in the courtyard.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' nganau' kudeng ineh kuan Arun idi anak-anakneh, maya' kudeng luk bida'Ku namu. Seruked tudu' aco do' iko ngeletep nedeh.
english: “Those are the rituals that you(sg) must perform during those seven days when you dedicate Aaron and his sons for this work. You must do everything that I have commanded you.

lun_bawang: "Anid-anid aco, macing ruked-ruked, do' maré luun bubpun dueh anak dumba luk ulun selak.
english: “You must also sacrifice lambs and burn them on the altar. Each of those seven days you must sacrifice two lambs.

lun_bawang: "Do' iko nganau' aceh méja luk inan ngeseb uar luk do' buen ratnan kayuh pirur.
english: “Tell the skilled workers to make an altar from acacia wood, for burning incense.

lun_bawang: "Do' iko nganau' aceh bigan ratnan tekaling, idi kukudneh pana' tekaling. Idi nganau' ineh arang Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan dengan bubpun. Idi nganau' abpa' bang ineh.
english: “Tell the skilled workers to make a bronze washbasin and a bronze base for it. They must put it between the Sacred Tent and the altar, and fill it with water.

lun_bawang: "Do' iko ngalap luk do' buen, ieh ineh umau mur luk mepulut, iwa' kati, idi anit kayuh luk mepaci' luk do' buen, apat kati setangal, keriburo luk do' buen apat kati setangal,
english: “Tell the people to collect some of the finest spices— ◄12 pounds/6 kg.► of ◄liquid myrrh/sweet-smelling sap named myrrh►, ◄6 pounds/3 kg.► of sweet-smelling cinnamon, ◄6 pounds/3 kg.► of a sweet-smelling cane/reed,

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Lapenmu luk do' buen, ieh ineh ilu' para', kerukub girig, idi ilu' luk mebuen dengan tutud uar, amung ineh mepad kinula'.
english: Yahweh also said to Moses/me, “Tell the people to take equal parts of several sweet spices—stacte, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense—

lun_bawang: "Ui pangeh nemili' ni Besalel Uri ratnan inul Hur luk pupu Yahuda.
english: I have caused him to be completely controlled/empowered by my Spirit, and I have given him special ability to make things and have enabled him to know how to do very skilled work.

lun_bawang: "Mada' nelun Israil, 'Matar do'-do' AcoKu luk inan Mudeng, ngaceku ineh aceh tanu' arangKu dengan muyuh idi amung inulmu, Ui ini Tuhan luk ngeligan nemuyuh.
english: You must obey my rules about the Sabbath days because they are holy/sacred. Those who treat those days in an irreverent way by working on those days must be executed to show that I no longer consider them to belong to my people.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Arun nedeh, "Neka amung abé amas luk i lalid awan muyuh idi anak muyuh luk deléi idi decur, idi nguit amé' negku.”
english: Aaron replied to them, “All right, I will do that, but tell your wives and your sons and your daughters to take off all their gold earrings and bring them to me.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengalap abé ineh rat nedeh ineh, idi ieh nengurai ineh mangun ku ayu mepad kudeng anak sapi'. Idi kebala lun mula', "O lun Israil, ini allah tau luk nenguit netau remuat rat bang bawang Masir!”
english: He took all those gold earrings and melted them in a fire. He poured the gold into a mold and made a statue that looked like a young bull. The people saw it and said, “This is the god of us Israeli people! This is the one who brought us up from the land of Egypt!”

lun_bawang: Idi Arun nenganau' aceh bubpun pa atun anak sapi' ineh, idi kebalaneh, "Pekak nebpa inan aceh irau rayeh kuan Tuhan!”
english: When Aaron saw what was happening, he built an altar in front of the statue of the young bull. Then he announced, “Tomorrow we will have a festival to honor Yahweh!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Saget lemubed, ngaceku pupumu luk inuitmu rat bawang Masir, pangeh nenganau' sala' idi nengelegkan Negku.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Go back down from the mountain, because your people, the ones that you brought up here from Egypt, have already ◄become very depraved/wicked►!

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Ui pangeh nekali' pupu ini pelaba tueh niat.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “I have seen that these people are very stubborn.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kesembayang Musa pa kiung Tuhan Allahneh, "O Tuhan, ngudeh Iko ngacing useh kuan pupuMu luk pangeh inuitMu remuat rat bang bawang Masir dengan tueh idi laludMu?
english: But Moses/I pleaded with his/my God, Yahweh, and said, “Yahweh, ◄you should not be very angry with your people!/why are you so angry with your people RHQ?► These are the people whom you rescued from Egypt with very great power MTY, DOU!

lun_bawang: Idi Yusak neninger arod lun mula' ineh, idi kebalaneh ni Musa, "Ui ninger arod kudeng ayu lun pebunu' su luk inan nelupo.”
english: Joshua heard the very loud noise of the people shouting. So when he and I got near the camp, Joshua said, “There is a noise in the camp that sounds like the noise of a battle!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Musa, "Baken ini arod metueh, idi baken ini arod luk melaya', iamo' pedingerenku kudeng tang lemulun menani!”
english: But Moses/I replied, “No, that is not the shouting that people do when they have won a victory or when they have been defeated in a battle What I hear is the sound of loud singing!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa ni Arun, "Anun luk inau' pupu ini kuanmu, pad iko nengacing sala' luk rayeh ineh kuandeh?”
english: Then he/I said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, with the result that you have made them commit such a terrible sin?”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Arun, "Aleg iko museh negku. Iko sebuleng kali' pupu ini pian nganau' luk dat.
english: Aaron replied, “Please do not be angry with me, sir. You know that these people are very determined to do evil things.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh netuped munung tanga' su inandeh nelupo, idi kebalaneh, "Idé luk merapet inan Tuhan do' amé' negku!" Idi amung lun Liwi nepamung neneh.
english: So he/I stood at the entrance to the camp and shouted, “Everyone who is loyal to Yahweh should come closer to me!” So the descendants of Levi gathered around him/me.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa nelun Liwi, "Aco sini muyuh pangeh nengeletep burur muyuh mangun ku imam kuan Tuhan, idi muyuh pangeh nengaté anak muyuh luk deléi idi kinanak muyuh, pad muyuh miak ngalap peruan Tuhan aco sini.”
english: Moses/I said to the descendants of Levi, “Today you have dedicated yourselves to serving Yahweh by ◄killing/not sparing► even your own sons and brothers, and as a result Yahweh will bless you.”

lun_bawang: Idi pekak kenebpa Musa nepebala kuan pupu ini, "Muyuh ini pangeh nenganau' sala' luk rayeh. Iamo' nekini ui mudik pegkung amé' inan Tuhan. Kian miak ui ngalap pedo' ngaceku sala' muyuh ineh lek.”
english: The next day, Moses/I said to the people, “You have committed a terrible sin. But I will now climb up the mountain again to talk with Yahweh. Perhaps I can persuade him to forgive you for sinning like this.”

lun_bawang: Idi Musa iné' matun Tuhan idi nepebala, "Pupu ini pangeh nenganau' aceh sala' luk rayeh, ngaceku ideh pangeh nenganau' akang ratnan amas pad sembayang neneh.
english: So Moses/I went back up the mountain and said to Yahweh, “I am sorry to admit that these people have committed a terrible sin. They have made for themselves a gold idol and have worshiped it.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Tuhan, "Idé luk mesala' pa kiungKu, ngadanneh ineh luk ruenKu ngiu' rat bang suratKu.
english: But Yahweh said to Moses/me, “It is only those who have sinned against me whose names I will erase from that book.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan, "Ui sebuleng ngedengan namu pad maré namu metueh.”
english: Moses/I replied, “If you do not go with me, do not force us to leave this place.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa Neneh, "Kudeng Iko na idi dengan kai, aleg ngecuk nekai nalan rat ieni.
english: The only way that other people will know that you are pleased with me and with your people is if you go with us RHQ! ◄If you go with us, that will show that we are different from all the other people on the earth./If you do not go with us, what will show that we are different from all the other people on the earth?►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Kali' rungen Ui nganau' luk pinutuhmu ineh. Ngaceku Ui miti namu, idi Ui mawang niat namu.”
english: Then Moses/I said, “Please let me see your glorious presence!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Musa, "Do' nima' negku nier rayehMu!”
english: Yahweh replied, “I will let you see how great and glorious I am, and I will tell you clearly that my name is Yahweh. I will act very kindly and be merciful to all those whom I choose.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Tuhan, "Ui ngetacu do'Ku pa kiungmu, idi neten ngadanKu pa kiungmu, ieh ineh Tuhan. Idi Ui méi' kuan idé luk inanKu méi', idi maré katuKu kuan idé luk pimaranKu katu ineh.
english: But you are not allowed to see my face, because anyone who sees my face will ◄die/not continue to stay alive►.

lun_bawang: Na iko miak nier kiungKu, ngaceku na lun luk nier Negku miak mulun.
english: But look! Here is a place close to me where you can stand on a large rock.

lun_bawang: Siruh, aceh luk inan iringKu, idi ieneh iko tuped luun batu.
english: When my glorious presence comes past you, I will put you in a large crevice/opening in the rock, and I will cover your face with my hand until I have passed by.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Ngelapag dueh balad batu baruh, mepad kudeng luk atun, idi Ui ngayud luun ineh amung bala luk luun dueh balad batu luk atun luk pangeh binila'mu.
english: Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Cut two slabs of stone that will be like the first slabs, the ones that you broke. Then I will engrave on them the words that were on the first slabs.

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nenalan lemaba pa kiungneh, idi Ieh nengitang, "Ui ini Tuhan, Ieh ineh Allah, luk méi' idi mekatu, luk mekadang niat, luk meluun awa idi lutep maya' jani'.
english: Then Yahweh passed in front of him/me and proclaimed, “I am Yahweh God. I always act mercifully and kindly toward people. I do not get angry quickly. I truly love people and I do what I promise to do for them, without changing.

lun_bawang: kesembayangneh, "O Tuhan, kudeng Iko méi' negku, do' Iko nalan arang kai. Sagan pana' pupu ini metueh niat, iamo' maré do' ku kuyo idi sala' kai, idi ngalap nekai mangun ku pupuMu.”
english: He/I said, “Yahweh, if you are now pleased with me, I ask that you go with us. These people are very stubborn IDM, but forgive us for all our sins DOU, and accept us to be people who belong to you forever.”

lun_bawang: Idi aleg iko pejani' nelun luk bang bawang ineh. Ngaceku kareb ideh sembayang idi nguit luk barén inan allahdeh, idi kali' rungen ideh nguit namu, idi iko pana' kuman luk baréndeh lek.
english: If you take some of their women to be wives for your sons, and these women worship their own gods, they will persuade your sons also to worship their gods.

lun_bawang: "Idi aleg iko nganau' kuanmu sebuleng akang luk inurai.
english: Each year, during the month of/named Abib, celebrate the Festival of Eating Bread Made Without Yeast. During that festival, for seven days you must not eat bread made with yeast, as I commanded you, because it was in that month that you left Egypt.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' iko ngimet Aco Rayeh Ruti luk Na Lamud. Tudu' aco kinioneh do' iko kuman ruti luk na lamud, maya' kudeng luk bilaKu, ieh ineh bang bulan Abib. Ngaceku bang bulan ineh iko nenalan rat bawang Masir.
english: Your firstborn sons and the firstborn male animals of your cattle and sheep and goats belong to me.

lun_bawang: "Idi amung anak deléi lemulun idi aya' luk atun ineh Ui kuan.
english: The firstborn of your male donkeys also belong to me. But you may buy them back by offering to me lambs in their place. If you do not do that, you must kill these animals by breaking their necks. You must also buy back your firstborn sons. You must bring an offering to me LIT each time you come to worship me.

lun_bawang: "Anem aco mo' kinioneh iko ngakem. Iamo' aco luk ketudu' ineh, do' iko ucu'. Do' kareb ngelusu', do' kareb ngeranih, kudeng ieh aco sineh do' ucu'.
english: Each year celebrate the Harvest Festival, when you begin to harvest the first crop of wheat, and also celebrate the Festival of Living in Temporary Shelters, when you finish harvesting the grain and fruit.

lun_bawang: "Idi teh do' iko ngimet Irau pun Ngeranih, idi teh Irau Lepo kareb ngamung bua'.
english: Three times each year all the men must come to worship me, Yahweh, the God of the Israeli people.

lun_bawang: "Idi aleg dara' baré luk kuanKu barénmu dengan aceh luk inan lamud. Idi aleg baré luk kirat kareb aco rayeh ketecan macing pekak.
english: I am Yahweh God. You must bring to my Sacred Tent the first part of the grain that you harvest each year. When you kill a young animal/kid either a lamb or a calf, do not prepare to eat it by boiling it in its mother’s milk.”

lun_bawang: "Luk meluun do' ratnan peranih luk pun ratnan uli' tana'mu, do' itenmu amé' bang ruma' Tuhan. "Idi aleg iko nanek anak amék ku rata tinehneh.”
english: Yahweh also said to Moses/me, “Write down the words that I have told you. By giving you these commands, I have made a solemn agreement with you and with the other Israeli people.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Iuden amung bala ini, ngaceku maya' uni bala ini, Ui pejani' namu idi nelun Israil.”
english: Moses/I was there on the top of the mountain with Yahweh for 40 days and nights. During that time he/I did not eat or drink anything SYN. He/I engraved on the stone slabs the words of the Ten Commandments, which were part of Yahweh’s solemn agreement.

lun_bawang: Musa nengecuk amung lun Israil mepamung, idi kebalaneh nedeh, "Ini amung bala luk icuk Tuhan ruen muyuh.
english: Moses/I gathered all the Israeli people together and said to them, “This is what Yahweh has commanded you to do:

lun_bawang: Idi Musa nepebala kuan amung lun Israil, "Ini luk bila Tuhan:
english: Moses/I also said to all the Israeli people, “This is also what Yahweh has commanded:

lun_bawang: "Idi amung tukang luk mileh arang muyuh, do' amé' idi nganau' amung luk bida' Tuhan:
english: “All the skilled workers among you should come and make all the things that Yahweh has commanded:

lun_bawang: Kebala Musa nelun Israil, "Tuhan pangeh nemili' besalel Uri ratnan inul Hur, luk pupu Yahuda.
english: Moses/I said to the Israeli people, “Listen carefully. Yahweh has chosen Bezalel, the son of Uri and grandson of Hur, from the tribe of Judah.

lun_bawang: "Do' Besalel, Aholiab idi amung lun luk mileh luk nepimaran Tuhan ileh pad nganau' amung kekamen luk do' ayu bang Su luk Meligan ineh, ngimun ngakem maya' amung luk icuk Tuhan.”
english: “Bezalel and Oholiab, and all the other men to whom Yahweh has given ability and enabled them to understand how to do all the work to make the Sacred Tent, must make everything just as Yahweh has commanded.”

lun_bawang: idi kebaladeh ni Musa, "Lun ini pelaba ula' uit, mela ratnan luk icuk Tuhan.”
english: and said, “The people are bringing more than we need to do the work that Yahweh has commanded us!”

lun_bawang: Idi Musa nengecuk nelun mula' ineh ugka' maré baré kuan Su luk Meligan ineh. Idi ideh nugka' maré.
english: So Moses/I gave the skilled men this message that was proclaimed throughout the camp: “No one should bring anything more as an offering to make the Sacred Tent!” When the people heard that, they did not bring anything more.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nenganau' balad amas luk meligan ratnan amas luk do' luk inarit, "Linigan Kuan Tuhan.”
english: They also made the tiny ornament of pure gold and had a skilled workman engrave on it the words, ‘Dedicated to Yahweh’.

lun_bawang: "Aceh aco bulan aceh, do' iko nganau' Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan.
english: “On the first day of the first month next year, tell the people to set up the Sacred Tent.

lun_bawang: Idi nganau' bubpun luk inan ngeseb baré ineh pa atun Lepo ineh.
english: Put the altar for burning sacrifices in front of the Sacred Tent.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' ngumau Lepo idi amung repapehneh ku umau luk ku ngumau ineh, pad amung ineh meligan.
english: Then take the oil for anointing, and anoint the Sacred Tent and everything that is in it, to ◄set it apart/dedicate it► to me. Then it will be holy/sacred.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' nguit ni Arun idi anak-anakneh amé' munung tanga' Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan, idi maru' nedeh ku abpa'.
english: Then bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the Sacred Tent, and wash them ritually with water.

lun_bawang: "Do' lun Israil maya' bala ini: Kudeng idé rat arang muyuh pian maré aceh baré ratnan aya'neh, ieh ineh sapi', dumba, kian amék lek,
english: “Tell this to the Israeli people: ‘When any of you brings an offering to Yahweh, bring one of your sheep or goats or cattle.

lun_bawang: idi kudeng baré ineh aceh baré luk sabpen ratnan sapi' ineh, do' ieh maré aceh sapi' deléi luk do'. Do nguit neneh macing pa atun tanga' Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan, pelé Tuhan ngalap ineh.
english: ‘If what you are offering is a bull that will be completely burned on the altar, it must not have any defects. You must take it to the entrance to the Sacred Tent, in order that it will be acceptable to Yahweh.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng luk barén ineh ratnan aya' dumba, kian amék lek, do' ieh maré deléi luk do'.
english: ‘If you are offering a sheep or a goat, it must be a male without any defect.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng luk barén sabpen ineh ratnan suit, idi do' ieh maré suit sukur, kian suit limun lek.
english: ‘If what you are offering to Yahweh is a bird, you must offer a dove or a young pigeon.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng idé luk maré inan Tuhan aceh baré luk kenen, do' ieh maré banak luk rinaburneh ku umau saitun perapu dengan umau luk do' buen.
english: ‘If you bring to Yahweh an offering of grain, it must consist of finely-ground flour. You must pour olive oil on it, and put some incense on it,

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng baré ineh pinaram luk uen nadang luun tetel, idi do' ieh na uen ngelamud. Miak muyuh nganau' pinaram luk mekapal luk rinabur ku umau saitun, idi teh pinaram luk melipi luk linusi ku umau saitun.
english: ‘If you bring an offering that is made from grain, something that is baked in an oven, it must be made from finely-ground flour. You may bring loaves made from flour mixed with olive oil but without yeast, or you may bring wafers with olive oil smeared on them, but also made without yeast.

lun_bawang: "Idi aleg muyuh maré baré akan luk linamud kuan Tuhan. Idi aleg muyuh maré luk linamud idi luk inan duru' kuan Tuhan.
english: ‘Every offering that is made from grain and that you bring to Yahweh must be made without yeast, because you must not put any yeast or honey in any offering to Yahweh that is burned on the altar.

lun_bawang: Kareb muyuh maré inan Tuhan aceh baré akan ratnan peranih luk pun-pun, idi do' muyuh maré ilung padé luk mebaruh idi luk didang ku apui, idi teh ilung luk tapen dari-dari.
english: ‘If you bring to Yahweh an offering of the first part of your harvest of grain, offer some new grain that has been crushed and roasted in a fire.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng idé rat arang muyuh maré aceh baré luk nguit pedo', ieh ineh sapi', idi do' ieh maré deléi, kian tineh lek, luk do'.
english: “Also tell the people, ‘When the offering that you bring to Yahweh is to maintain good fellowship with him, you may bring a bull or a cow from your herd of cattle, but what you present to Yahweh must be an animal that has no defects.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng ieh maré dumba kian amék lek ku baré luk nguit pedo', ieh miak maré deléi idi tineh luk do'.
english: If that offering to maintain good fellowship with Yahweh is a sheep or a goat, it must also be an animal that has no defects.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng amék luk barénneh,
english: ‘If your offering is a goat, you must take/present it to Yahweh.

lun_bawang: Idi lun Israil bibpeng na miak kuman lemak idi dara'. Idi ini aceh ukum luk meruked kuan lun Israil iapeh-iapeh pana'."
english: ‘This is a command that must be obeyed by you and your descendants forever, wherever you live: You must not eat the fat or the blood of any animal.’ ”

lun_bawang: "Kudeng idé rat arang lun Israil mesala' ngaceku ieh nganau' luk bibpeng Tuhan na miak ruen, iamo' na sala' ineh inau' rungen, do' ieh maya' lawé ini.
english: “Say this to the Israeli people: This is what must be done if someone sins without intending to sin, doing something that is forbidden in any of Yahweh’s commands.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng amung lun Israil mesala' ngaceku ideh nganau' luk bibpeng Tuhan na miak ruen, iamo' na sala' ineh inau' rungen;
english: ‘If all the Israeli people sin without intending to sin, doing something that is forbidden in any of Yahweh’s commands, they will be guilty, even if they do not realize that they have sinned.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng seburur lun rayeh mesala' ngaceku ieh nganau' luk bibpeng Tuhan na miak ruen, iamo' na sala' ineh inau' rungen;
english: ‘When one of the leaders sins without intending to sin, doing something that is forbidden in any of the commands of Yahweh his God, he will be guilty.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng seburur lemun rat arang lun mula' mesala' ngaceku ieh nganau' luk bibpeng Tuhan na miak ruen, iamo' na sala' ineh inau' rungen;
english: ‘If one of the Israeli people who is not a priest sins without intending to sin, and does something that is forbidden in any of the commands of Yahweh his God, he will be guilty.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng aceh dumba barénneh ngaceku sala'neh, do' ieh maré aceh tineh luk do'.
english: ‘If that person brings a lamb to be his offering for sin, he must bring a female lamb that has no defects.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng seburur lemulun pangeh tinawar mangun ku lun nekali' ratnan luk sinierneh idi luk nekali'neh, idi na ieh maré kali', ieh mesala' peh.
english: Yahweh also said to tell the people, “If a judge orders any of you to tell in court something that you have seen or something that you heard someone say, if you refuse to say what you know is true, you must ◄pay a penalty/be punished► MTY for refusing to tell what you know.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng seburur lemulun megani' ku anun-anun pana' luk ratnan lemulun, idi ieh ineh na nekali'neh, iamo' muci ineh megala' kuanneh, ieh mesala' peh.
english: If you touch any human feces, even if you do not intend to do that, when you realize what you have done, you must ◄pay a penalty/be punished►.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' kudeng seburur lemulun masi' pad ieh na miak maré dumba idi amék, do' ieh maré inan Tuhan dueh suit sukur, kian dueh suit limun lek barén ngaceku sala'neh, ieh ineh sebuleng baré ngaceku sala' idi sebuleng baré luk sabpen.
english: If you are poor and cannot afford to bring a lamb, you must bring to Yahweh two doves or two young pigeons. One will be an offering for your sin and one will be an offering that will be completely burned on the altar.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng seburur lemulun mesala' ngaceku ieh nganau' luk bibpeng Tuhan na miak ruen, iamo' na sala' ineh inau' rungen, ieh mesala' peh, idi ieh teh mabeh ineh.
english: If you sin by doing something that is forbidden by any of Yahweh’s commands, even if you do not know that you have disobeyed one of my commands, you are guilty and must pay a penalty to me.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng seburur lemulun nganau' sala' pa kiung Tuhan, ngaceku ieh naluk lun denganneh ku binaweh duduk, kian binaweh luk biré nan ticu'neh, kian binaweh luk pino, kian binaweh luk inaroneh rat nelun denganneh,
english: “If any one of you you sins against me by deceiving someone—if you refuse to return what someone has lent you, or if you steal something of his, or if you find something and claim that you do not have it,

lun_bawang: "Idi ini dalan maré baré akan. Ieh ineh baré anak-anak Arun kuan Tuhan, pa atun bubpun.
english: “These are the regulations concerning the offerings made from grain: Aaron’s sons must bring them to me in front of the altar.

lun_bawang: "Mada' Arun idi anak-anakneh ratnan dalan baré ngaceku sala' ineh: "Baré ngaceku sala' kereten pa kiung Tuhan, iring bubpun su luk inan ngeret baré luk sabpen. Ieh ineh baré luk meluun ligan.
english: “Tell Aaron and his sons: These are the regulations concerning the offerings that people must bring to me so that I will forgive the people for the sins they have committed:

lun_bawang: "Idi ini dalan baré luk pingetap. Ieh ineh baré luk meluun ligan.
english: “These are the regulations concerning the offerings to be made by people who are guilty of not giving to me the things that are required to be given to me. Those are very sacred offerings.

lun_bawang: "Do' baré luk pingetap ineh mepad kudeng baré ngaceku sala'. Idi uangneh mangun ku babpat imam, luk pangeh nemaré baré ineh luk nguit pedo'.
english: “The regulation is the same for the offerings to enable people to be forgiven for the sins they have committed  and the offerings for when they are guilty of not giving to me the things that are required to be given to me. The meat of those offerings belongs to the priest who offers them in order that the people will be forgiven.

lun_bawang: "Idi ini dalan baré luk nguit pedo' luk miak barén kuan Tuhan.
english: These are the regulations concerning the offerings that people make to maintain fellowship with Yahweh:

lun_bawang: "Iamo' kudeng seburur lemulun maré aceh baré maya' jani'neh, kian aceh baré maya' awang niatneh, idi miak ieh kenen kareb aco luk inanneh biré. Idi elaneh miak kenen pekak kenebpa.
english: “However, if your offering is the result of a solemn promise that you made to Yahweh, or if it is an offering that you make ◄voluntarily/without being required to►, you are permitted to eat some of the meat on the day it is offered, but anything that is left may be eaten on the next day.

lun_bawang: "Idi teh uang luk petulu ku aceh luk inan megani', ineh pana' na miak kenen. Iamo' do' ieh sabpen. Iamo' uang luk baken ineh, idé-idé luk meligan miak kuman ineh.
english: “Meat that touches something that God considers to be impure must not be eaten; it must be completely burned. Anyone who has performed the rituals to become acceptable to God is allowed to eat other meat which has been offered as a sacrifice.

lun_bawang: "Mada' kuan lun Israil: Aleg muyuh kuman lemak sapi', dumba, idi amék.
english: “Say this to the Israeli people: ‘Do not eat any of the fat of cattle or sheep or goats.

lun_bawang: "Mada' kuan lun Israil kudeng ini: Idé luk maré aceh baré pedo', do' ieh sebuleng maré sebabpat baré ineh kuan Tuhan.
english: “Tell the Israeli people this: ‘Anyone who brings an offering to maintain fellowship with Yahweh must bring part of it to be a sacrifice to Yahweh.

lun_bawang: "Do' iko nated Arun idi anak-anakneh amé' munung tanga' Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan, idi nguit ayung imam, umau luk ku ngumau, aceh sapi' luk pegawa' luk barén ngaceku sala', dueh dumba deléi dengan aceh tayen pinaram luk na linamud ineh.
english: “Bring Aaron and his sons, and bring their ◄special clothes/clothes that they will wear while they do the work of priests►, the oil for anointing them, the bull to be offered to cause them to become forgiven for the sins they have committed, the two rams to be slaughtered, and the basket containing bread made without yeast.

lun_bawang: idi kebala Musa nedeh, "Kudeng ini luk icuk Tuhan.”
english: Then Moses/I said to the people, “This is what Yahweh has commanded us to do.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ni Arun, "Ngalap aceh sapi' deléi luk pegawa' luk do', barén ngaceku sala', idi aceh dumba deléi luk do' mangun ku baré luk sabpen, pa kiung Tuhan.
english: Then he/I said to Aaron, “Take a young bull for the offering to enable you leaders to be forgiven for the sins you have committed, and a ram to be completely burned on the altar, both of them without any defects, and offer them to Yahweh.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa, "Kudeng ini ecuk Tuhan nemuyuh, pad ubur Tuhan miak silagan nemuyuh.”
english: Then Moses/I said, “This is what Yahweh has commanded you to do, in order that his glory will appear to you.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa ni Arun, "Ini luk pangeh bida' Tuhan, kebalaNeh, 'Ui pian mada' liganKu siren lemulun luk muneng Negku, idi Ui pian uen ngerayeh pa kiung amung-amung lemulun.' " Idi Arun pirud.
english: Then Moses/I said to Aaron, “That is what Yahweh predicted. He said, ‘Those priests who come near to me, I will show them that they must ◄respect me/treat me as being holy►; in the presence of all the people I am the one who must be honored.’” But Aaron said nothing.

lun_bawang: Idi Musa nenawar Misail idi Elsapan, anak-anak Usel taman pinaken Arun. Kebalaneh nedeh, "Amé' medueh nguit butung kinanak medueh remuat rat pa atun Su luk Meligan ini idi rat su luk inan nelupo.”
english: Then Moses/I summoned Mishael and Elzaphan, who were the sons of Aaron’s uncle Uzziel, and said to them, “Take the corpses of your cousins outside the camp, away from the front of the Sacred Tent.”

lun_bawang: "Aleg iko idi anak-anakmu ngirup abpa' anggur idi luk megalih kareb muyuh semuet bang Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan, pad muyuh na maté. Idi ini aceh dalan luk meruked macing ku anak inul.
english: “You and your two sons who are still alive must not drink wine or other fermented drinks before you enter the Sacred Tent; if you do that, you will die. That is a command that you and your descendants must obey forever.

lun_bawang: "Ngudeh muyuh na kuman baré ngaceku sala' ineh bang Su luk Meligan? Ngaceku ieh ineh luk meluun ligan, idi pangeh biré kuan muyuh, pelé muyuh miak mabeh sala' lun mula' ineh idi muyuh nganau' luk nguit pedo' kuandeh pa kiung Tuhan?
english: “Why did you not eat near the Sacred Tent the meat of the offering for sin? It was very holy, and it was given to you to enable the Israeli people to no longer be guilty for their sins and to be forgiven for their sins.

lun_bawang: "Mada' ukum ini kuan lun Israil. Ini pung luk miak kenen muyuh rat arang amung pung luk luun tana'.
english: “Tell the Israeli people that this is what Yahweh says: From all the animals that live on the land, these are the ones that you are permitted to eat:

lun_bawang: -6Iamo' muyuh na miak kuman ratnan amung luk ngagat idi ngelua' mo', kian luk dueh lisun mo': kudeng unta, sapan, idi arnab. Amung pung ineh mangun ku gani' kuan muyuh.
english: There are some animals that chew their cuds but do not have split hooves, and some animals that have split hooves but do not chew their cuds. You must not eat any of those animals. For example, camels chew their cuds but do not have split hooves, so they are unacceptable for you to eat.

lun_bawang: "Muyuh miak kuman amung lawid luk inan ragi idi rara, do' luk bang abpa' rayeh idi bang arur pana'.
english: From all the creatures that live in the oceans and the streams, you are permitted to eat any that have fins and scales.

lun_bawang: -19"Idi aleg muyuh kuman amung-amung suit ini: amung-amung kanui, amung-amung puek, amung-amung bungkak, suit unta, suit luk mebuda' tangeb abpa' rayeh, manuuk, lal lakui, kekalit, idi pawat.
english: There are some birds that you must detest and not eat. They include eagles, bearded vultures, black vultures,

lun_bawang: "Idi amung pung luk inan ilad luk nalan dengan apat kukud mangun ku gani' kuan muyuh.
english: You must detest and not eat flying insects that sometimes walk on the ground MTY.

lun_bawang: -28"Idé-idé luk ngakem butung pung ini mangun melutak macing aco macep: amung pung luk na dueh lisun idi na ngagat luk linua', idi amung pung luk nalan ku palad rat arang pung luk apat kukud. Idé-idé luk mabeh butungdeh, do' ieh mupu' ayungneh, idi ieh melutak macing aco macep.
english: ‘There are certain creatures that if you touch their carcasses you will become defiled. Anyone who touches their carcasses must not touch other people until that evening.

lun_bawang: -30"Amung-amung labo, amung-amung alé, buayeh, kabuk, kedarat, idi garang, mangun ku gani' kuan muyuh.
english: ‘From all the animals that walk on the ground, these are the ones that ◄defile you/cause you to become unacceptable to me► if you touch them: Moles, rats, any kind of lizard,

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng pung luk miak kenen muyuh maté, idé luk ngakem butung ineh, ieh mangun ku gani' macing aco macep.
english: ‘If an animal whose meat you are permitted to eat dies, anyone who touches its carcass must not touch other people until that evening.

lun_bawang: "Idi aleg muyuh kuman pung luk medari luk tekamang idi suloi luun tana',
english: ‘All creatures that scurry across the ground, including those that move on their bellies and those that crawl, are detestable, and they must not be eaten.

lun_bawang: "Idi ini ukum ratnan amung pung, suit, idi pudut luk mulun bang abpa' idi luk nalan luun tana',
english: You must learn what things I say are acceptable to me and what things are not, and learn what things you are permitted to eat and what things you are not permitted to eat.’”

lun_bawang: "Mada' ini kuan amung lun Israil: Kareb aceh decur nenganak anak luk deléi, idi ieh mangun ku gani' macing tudu' aco kinioneh, maya' kudeng acing bulan luk inanneh pekalai.
english: “Tell this to the Israeli people: ‘If a woman gives birth to a son, she must be avoided for seven days, like she must be avoided when she is menstruating each month.

lun_bawang: Idi imam maré ineh pa kiung Tuhan, idi nganau' luk nguit pedo' kuanneh. Idi ieh meligan ratnan dara'neh. Kudeng ineh ukum kuan decur luk nenganak anak deléi, kian decur lek.
english: The priest will offer them to Yahweh in order that she may be forgiven for any sins she has committed. Then she will be purified from her loss of blood when the baby was born. ‘Those are the regulations for women who give birth to a son or daughter.

lun_bawang: "Idi idé luk neketukan susud ineh, do' ieh iten amé' papu' imam.
english: When anyone has a contagious skin disease, he must be brought to the priest.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kudeng susud ineh maput luun bururneh, ratnan uluh macing ku kukudneh, su luk sinier imam,
english: ‘If the disease spreads all over someone’s body, and the priest examines that person and sees that it is covering his skin from his head to his feet,

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng seburur lemulun mekimuh idi kimuh ineh mepali',
english: ‘Then someone has a boil on his skin and it has healed,

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng kubil seburur lemulun nelupuk ku apui, idi piletneh mebuda' puar mesia' kian pelaba buda' lek,
english: ‘Then someone has a burn on his skin and a bright/shiny or white spot appears, and the flesh in that area is sensitive/painful,

lun_bawang: "Kudeng aceh deléi kian decur neketukan ét luun uluhneh kian luun adaneh,
english: ‘If a man or a woman has a sore on his head or on his chin,

lun_bawang: "Kudeng seburur deléi kian decur lek, mebelita' kubil bururneh, idi putok mebuda',
english: ‘Then a man or a woman has white spots on the skin,

lun_bawang: "Idi teh kudeng abpuk selemulun nebubput pad ieh mebutal, idi ieh meligan.
english: ‘If a man loses the hair on any part of his head, he does not need to stay away from other people.

lun_bawang: "Idi lun luk mét susud luk neketukan ineh dengan matu, do ayungneh deraken idi ngesasung abpukneh idi ngebpu bibirneh. Do' ieh ngitang, 'Megani'! Megani'!'
english: He is not allowed to be with other people as long as he has the disease. He must live alone, outside the camp.’”

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng rapung nepisit luun aceh ayung, do' kibung buluh amék idi buluh kibung pu,
english: If the contaminated/mildewed part is greenish or reddish, it is a spreading mildew, and it must be shown to the priest.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' kudeng imam nier dat ineh na neperuit luun amung ineh,
english: Then the priest will examine it again. If the color of the mildew has not changed, even though it has not spread, that item must not be worn again. It does not matter if the mildew is on the inside of the clothing or on the outside; it must be burned.

lun_bawang: "Ini mangun ku ukum lemulun luk mét susud. Kareb aco luk inanneh uen ngeligan, idi do' ieh iten amé' papu' imam.
english: “These are the regulations for anyone who has been healed of a contagious skin disease.

lun_bawang: "Idi aco luk kewaluh, do' ieh ngalap dueh anak dumba deléi luk do', idi sebuleng dumba tineh luk uluhneh selak, idi luk do', idi teh segatang setangal banak luk rinabur ku umau mangun ku baré akan, idi setangal seréi' umau.
english: “The next day that person must bring two male lambs and one female lamb that is one year old, all of them with no defects. He must also bring six quarts/liters of fine flour, mixed with olive oil, to be an offering, and ◄0.6 pint/0.3 liter► of olive oil.

lun_bawang: Idi do' imam ineh ngalap sebuleng anak dumba deléi, idi maré neneh perapu dengan umau luk setangal seréi' ineh ku baré luk pingetap, idi nicul ineh ku baré luk tidulen pa kiung Tuhan.
english: “Then the priest must take one of the male lambs and lift it up, along with the olive oil, in front of me, to be a guilt offering—an offering for his being guilty for not giving to me the things that he was required to give me.

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh do' imam maré baré ngaceku sala', idi nganau' luk nguit pedo' kuan lemulun luk uen ngeligan ratnan lutakneh. Pangeh ineh do' ngeret baré luk sabpen ineh.
english: “Then the priest must slaughter one of the other two animals, to show that the one who has been healed of the skin disease has been forgiven for having sinned, and that he has become acceptable to Yahweh. Then the priest will slaughter the animal that will be completely burned on the altar.

lun_bawang: Idi aco luk kewaluh do' ieh nguit ineh kuan imam, mangun ku liganneh pa kiung Tuhan, pa atun tanga' Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan.
english: “On that same day, that person must take those things to the priest at the entrance of the Sacred Tent, to offer them to Yahweh.

lun_bawang: "Kareb muyuh semuet bang bawang Kanaan luk barénKu ku babpat muyuh, kareb Ui ngacing rapung kuan sebuleng ruma' bang bawang luk ku babpat muyuh ineh,
english: “I am about to give you Canaan land to belong to your people permanently. When you enter that land, there will be times when I cause/allow mildew to appear inside one of your houses.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng luk dat ineh mulun bang ruma' ineh, pangeh ideh nenakul batu idi nemekud ruma' ineh, idi nenguda apur,
english: “If the mildew appears again in the house after that is done,

lun_bawang: Idé-idé luk semuet bang ruma' ineh seruked ruma' ineh initek, lemulun ineh mangun ku gani' macing aco macep.
english: “Anyone who goes into that house while it is locked up will not be allowed to be with other people until sunset of that day.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' kudeng imam pangeh semuet idi nier, kudeng ét ineh na mulun baruh bang ruma' ineh rat pangeh ruma' ini inuda ku apur, idi do' imam mala ruma' ineh meligan, ngaceku ét ineh pangeh neburo.
english: “But when the priest comes to examine the house after it has been plastered, if the mildew has not spread, he shall declare that people may live in it, because the mildew is gone.

lun_bawang: "Mada' kuan lun Israil: Kudeng aceh deléi luk mekebabpa', ineh mangun ku gani' kuanneh.
english: “Tell this to the Israelis: When an infected discharge comes out of a man’s sexual organs EUP, that fluid should not be touched.

lun_bawang: Idi amung pagau idi su luk inan lemulun luk mekebabpa' telubid, ieh ineh ku gani', idi su luk inanneh tudo pana' melutak teh.
english: “And any bed that such a man lies on should not be touched, and anything that he sits on should not be touched.

lun_bawang: Idi idé luk ngakem burur lun luk mekebabpa' ineh, do' ieh mupu' ayungneh idi ngediu' bururneh ku abpa'. Idi ieh mangun ku gani' macing aco macep.
english: “Anyone who touches such a man must wash his clothes and bathe, and no one should touch him until that evening.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kudeng lun luk mekebabpa' ineh ngelica' aceh lun luk meligan, idi do' lun luk linica' ineh mupu' ayungneh, idi ngediu' bururneh, idi ieh mangun ku gani' macing aco macep.
english: “If such a man spits on someone else, that person who is spit upon should not be touched. He must wash his clothes, and no one should touch him until that evening.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ineh teh amung su luk inanneh tudo luun keted keladai, ieh ineh mangun ku gani'.
english: “Everything that a man who has such a discharge of fluid sits on while he is riding a horse or a donkey should not be touched,

lun_bawang: Idé luk pangeh kikem lun luk mekebabpa' ineh dengan na nesibaru' ticu'neh bang abpa' atun, do' ieh mupu' ayungneh idi ngediu' bururneh. Idi ieh mangun ku gani' macing aco macep.
english: Anyone whom the man with such a discharge of fluid from his body touches without first rinsing his hands in water must wash his clothes and bathe, and no one should touch him until that evening.

lun_bawang: Idi teh binaweh ratnan tana' kuden luk pangeh kikem lun luk mekebabpa' ineh, do' ieh uen mila'. Iamo' amung repapeh kayuh, do' ieh uen maru' ku abpa'.
english: “If such a man touches a clay pot, that pot must be broken into pieces. Anything made from wood that he touches must be rinsed in water.

lun_bawang: "Idi kareb lun luk mekebabpa' ineh do' ratnan mekebabpa', idi do' ieh ngiap tudu' aco rat pun aco ieh nedo'. Idi do' ieh mupu' ayungneh idi ngediu' bururneh ku abpa' luk metaro. Idi ieh meligan.
english: “If such a man is healed from his flow of fluid, he must wait for seven days. Then he must wash his clothes and bathe in water from a spring. Then he will be able to be with others.

lun_bawang: Kareb aco luk kewaluh ineh, idi do' ieh ngalap dueh suit sukur, kian dueh anak limun lek. Do' ieh amé' pa kiung Tuhan pa atun tanga' Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan idi maré suit ineh kuan imam.
english: On the eighth/next day, he must take two doves or two young pigeons and come in front of Yahweh at the entrance of the Sacred Tent, and give them to the priest.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng seburur deléi ngeruat luk ku inulneh, do' ieh ngediu' amung bururneh bang abpa'. Idi ieh mangun ku gani' macing aco macep.
english: “Then semen accidentally flows from a man’s sexual organs EUP, he must bathe his whole body, and no one should touch him until that evening.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng seburur decur macing bulan, do' ieh utad tudu' aco kinioneh. Idi idé luk ngakem neneh ieh mangun ku gani' macing aco macep.
english: “Then a woman has her monthly menstrual period, no one should touch her for seven days. If anyone touches her during that time, no one should touch the person who touched her until that evening.

lun_bawang: Idi amung su luk inanneh telubid idi tudo kareb ieh macing bulan, ieh ineh mangun ku gani'.
english: No one should touch anything that she lies on or sits on during that time.

lun_bawang: Kudeng aceh deléi pamung neneh kareb ieh macing bulan, idi tudu' aco kinioneh ieh mangun ku gani'. Idi amung su luk inanneh rudap, idi su luk inanneh telubid pana' mangun ku gani'.
english: “Then a woman has a vaginal discharge of blood for ◄many days/a long time►, which is not her monthly flow of blood, or if her flow of blood continues after her monthly flow ends, no one should touch her until it stops.

lun_bawang: Idi kareb ieh do' ratnan mérat dara'neh do' ieh ngiap tudu' aco. Pangeh ineh idi ieh meligan.
english: On the eighth/next day, she must take two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the entrance of the Sacred Tent.

lun_bawang: Tuhan nengecuk ni Musa mada' kuan lun Israil ineh, pad ideh mepatad ratnan luk ku gani', pelé ideh na ngelutak Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan luk uned su luk inandeh nelupo ineh, pad ideh na maté.
english: “Those are the regulations for a man who has a fluid that flows from his sexual organs or who should not be touched because some of his semen spills out while having sex with a woman,

lun_bawang: Idi Arun miak semuet bang Su luk Meluun Ligan ineh kudeng ieh nguit binaweh ini: aceh sapi' deléi luk pegawa' barén ngaceku sala', idi sebuleng dumba deléi barén sabpen.
english: “When Aaron enters the Sacred Tent area, he must bring a bull that will be killed to become an offering/sacrifice for sins, and a ram to be killed to be an offering that will be completely burned on the altar.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' Arun maré sapi' deléi barén ngaceku sala' bururneh sebuleng, pad nganau' luk nguit pedo' kuan bururneh sebuleng idi kuan uang ruma'neh pana'.
english: “Aaron must offer the bull to me to be a sacrifice in order that ◄I will forgive his sins and the sins of his family/his sins and the sins of his family will be forgiven►.

lun_bawang: "Kareb Arun maré sapi' deléi luk barén ngaceku sala' bururneh sebuleng idi uang ruma'neh pana',
english: “Then Aaron must bring the young bull to me, to be an offering/sacrifice for himself and for his family. He must slaughter that bull to be an offering for their sins, and he must drain the blood into a basin.

lun_bawang: Idi do' ieh remuat amé' inan bubpun luk pa kiung Tuhan idi nganau' luk nguit pedo' kuan ineh, idi do' ieh ngalap sebuang dara' sapi' deléi, idi sebuang dara' amék deléi ineh, idi ngukit ineh luun unga bubpun ineh pekelibut.
english: “Then Aaron must go outside the tent to purify my altar. He must do this by smearing some of the blood from the bull and some of the blood from the goat on each of the projections at the corners of the altar.

lun_bawang: "Kareb Arun pangeh nenganau' luk nguit pedo' kuan Su luk Meluun Ligan idi kuan Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan idi bubpun ineh, idi do' ieh nguit amék deléi luk mulun ineh, pa kiung Tuhan.
english: “When Aaron has finished purifying the Very Holy Place inside the Sacred Tent and all of the Sacred Tent and the altar, he must bring the goat that was chosen to be set free.

lun_bawang: "Pangeh ineh idi do' Arun semuet bang Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan. Idi ieh ngelengu ayung kibung pu luk iungen kareb ieh semuet bang Su luk Meluun Ligan idi necan ineh ieneh.
english: “When Aaron approaches the Sacred Tent, he must take off the linen clothes that he wore when he previously entered the Very Holy Place, and he must leave those clothes there.

lun_bawang: Idi lun luk nenguit amék deléi luk inusu ineh, do' ieh mupu' ayungneh idi diu', kareb nateh ieh semuet bang su luk inan nelupo ineh.
english: “The man who was chosen to send the other goat into the desert and free it there must afterwards wash his clothes and bathe. Then he may return to the camp.

lun_bawang: Idi ini mangun ku aceh ukum luk meruked kuan muyuh, ieh ineh selak sekua' do' muyuh nganau' luk nguit pedo' kuan amung lun Israil ngaceku amung sala'deh.”
english: This will be a permanent command/law for you to obey once every year, to enable me to forgive you Israeli people for the sins that you have committed.” Moses/I obeyed all those instructions/commands that Yahweh had given to him/me.

lun_bawang: "Mada' kuan Arun idi anak-anakneh, idi kuan amung lun Israil pana' kudeng ini. Ini bala luk bida' Tuhan:
english: “Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the other Israeli people, and say this to them: ‘This is what Yahweh has commanded:

lun_bawang: "Idé-idé rat arang lun Israil idi rat arang amung lun sakai luk mudeng arang muyuh, kareb ideh maré aceh baré sabpen kian baré kereten lek,
english: “And tell this to the people: ‘If any Israeli or any foreigner who is living among them brings an offering that is to be completely burned on the altar, or any other sacrifice,

lun_bawang: Idi ngaceku ineh Ui pangeh nepebala kuan amung lun Israil ini, rat arang muyuh seburur pana' aleg kuman dara'. Idi aceh sakai pana' luk tudo arang muyuh aleg kuman dara' teh.
english: That is why I say that you Israelis must not eat blood, and the foreigners who live among you must also not eat blood.

lun_bawang: "Mada' iko kuan amung lun Israil kudeng ini: Ui ini Tuhan Allah muyuh.
english: “Speak to the Israeli people and tell them that I, Yahweh, say this this: I am Yahweh, your God.

lun_bawang: "Seburur pana' aleg pelengit inan pupuneh luk muneng pian pasét neneh. Ui ini Tuhan.
english: “Do not have sex with any of your close relatives. It is I, Yahweh, who am commanding that.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko pasét inan tinanmu idi ngigu' tamanmu, ngaceku ieh luk tinanmu. Aleg iko ngigu' neneh.
english: “Do not disgrace your father by having sex with your mother DOU.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko pasét inan awan tamanmu, ngaceku ieh pamung rudap dengan tamanmu.
english: “Do not have sex with any of your father’s other wives, because that would disgrace your father.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko pasét inan kinanak decurmu, ieh ineh anak tamanmu idi anak tinanmu, do' kieh tinganak bang rumamu, kian tinganak mado lek. Aleg iko ngigu' nedeh.
english: “Do not have sex with your sister or your stepsister; it does not matter whether she was born in your house or somewhere else.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko pasét inan mupunmu luk decur. Ngaceku ini luk ngigu' namu.
english: “Do not have sex with your granddaughter, because that would disgrace you.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko pasét inan anak decur awan tamanmu luk tinganak kuan tamanmu, ngaceku ieh kinanakmu luk decur. Aleg iko ngigu' neneh.
english: “Do not have sex with your half-sister, because she is your sister.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko pasét inan kinanak decur tamanmu ngaceku ieh sebuleng dara' dengan tamanmu.
english: “Do not have sex with your father’s sister, because she is your father’s close relative.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko pasét inan kinanak decur tinanmu. Ngaceku ieh sebuleng dara' dengan tinanmu.
english: “Do not have sex with your mother’s sister, because she is your mother’s close relative.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko ngigu' kinanak deléi tamanmu ngaceku pasét inan awanneh. Ngaceku ieh tinan pinakenmu.
english: “Do not disgrace your ◄uncle/father’s brother► by having sex with his wife, because she is your aunt.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko pasét inan ibanmu luk decur. Ngaceku ieh awan anakmu. Aleg iko ngigu' neneh.
english: “Do not have sex with DOU your daughter-in-law, because she is your son’s wife.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko pasét inan awam kinanakmu. Ngaceku ieh pamung rudap dengan kinanakmu.
english: “Do not have sex with your brother’s wife, because that would disgrace your brother.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko ngalap aceh decur perapu ku anakneh. Aleg iko ngalap mupunneh, ngaceku ideh sebuleng dara' denganmu. Ineh mangun ku aceh gani' luk pelaba dat.
english: “Do not have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman whom you have previously had sex with; they are her (OR, your) close relatives. Having sex with any of them would be a wicked thing to do.

lun_bawang: Idi aleg iko ngalap aceh decur kinanak awanmu ku awanmu, pad ieh temaruh, idi pamung neneh kareb awanmu mulun.
english: “While your wife is still living, do not marry your wife’s sister and have sex with her.

lun_bawang: "Aleg iko pamung inan aceh decur kareb ieh macing bulan,
english: “Do not have sex with any woman while she is having her monthly menstrual period.

lun_bawang: idi aleg iko pesipu dengan awan lun denganmu, pad iko mangun melutak ku ieh.
english: “Do not ◄defile yourself/make yourself unacceptable to me► by having sex with someone else’s wife.

lun_bawang: Idi aleg iko maré aceh anakmu kuan akang Molek, idi ngedat ngadan Allahmu. Ngaceku Ui ini Tuhan.
english: “Do not give any of your children to be burned to be a sacrifice to the god Molech, because that would show that you do not revere me MTY, Yahweh, your God.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko pamung dengan aceh deléi maya' ayu decur. Ngaceku ieh ineh aceh dalan luk pelaba dat.
english: “No man should have sex with another man; that is detestable.

lun_bawang: Idi teh aleg iko ngegani' bururmu ngaceku pamung dengan pung. Idi seburur decur pana', aleg pamung dengan pung. Ngaceku ieh ineh aceh dalan luk pelaba dat.
english: “No one, man or woman, should ◄defile himself/cause himself to become unacceptable to me► by having sex with an animal; that is a perverse act.

lun_bawang: "Aleg muyuh ngegani' burur muyuh ratnan dalan luk kudeng ini. Ngaceku kekamen luk kudeng ineh ngegani' burur amung pupu baken luk dukenKu buro pa kiung muyuh.
english: “Do not ◄defile yourselves/cause yourselves to become unacceptable to me► in any of those ways, because doing those things is how the people of the nations that I expelled as you advanced became ◄unacceptable to me/defiled►.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku kudeng idé luk nganau' aceh dalan luk kudeng ineh dat, ieh ineh duken buro rat arang pupuneh.
english: “You must not allow people who do any of those detestable things to associate with you who are my people.

lun_bawang: "Do' iko mada' kuan amung lun Israil kudeng ini: Do' muyuh meligan, ngaceku Ui ini Tuhan Allah muyuh luk meligan.
english: “Speak to all the people of Israel and tell them this: You must be holy, because I, Yahweh your God, am holy, and I want you to be like me.

lun_bawang: Idi do' anid-anid lemulun ngedita' taman-tinanneh, idi matar aco luk inanKu mudeng. Ui ini Tuhan Allah muyuh.
english: ‘Each of you must respect your father and your mother. And you must ◄honor/treat respectfully► the Sabbath days. I am Yahweh, your God, and that is what I am commanding you to do.

lun_bawang: Aleg muyuh lumi ku akang-akang. Idi aleg muyuh nganau' akang pudut luk inurai. Ui ini Tuhan Allah muyuh.
english: ‘Do not worship idols or make metal statues of gods for yourselves. I am Yahweh, your God, and I am the only one you must worship.

lun_bawang: "Idi kareb muyuh maré kuan Tuhan baré luk nguit pedo', do' muyuh maré ineh maya' bala Tuhan pad Ieh mawang niat nemuyuh.
english: ‘Then you bring an offering to maintain fellowship with me, offer it in a way that will cause me to accept it.

lun_bawang: "Idi kareb muyuh ngeranih, aleg muyuh ngeranih macing iring lati' muyuh. Idi aleg muyuh ngamung luk neketecan ratnan perinien muyuh ineh.
english: ‘Then you harvest your grain, leave the grain at the very edge of the field, and do not pick up the grain that has fallen on the ground.

lun_bawang: "Aleg muyuh mano, idi aleg muyuh mebalih. Idi aleg muyuh naluk seburur dengan seburur.
english: ‘Do not steal anything. ‘Do not tell lies. ‘Do not deceive each other.

lun_bawang: Aleg muyuh pebulung ku ngadanKu pad naluk seburur lemulun. Ngaceku kudeng ineh muyuh ngedat ngadan Allah muyuh. Ui ini Tuhan.
english: ‘Do not show that you do not respect me by using/saying my name to falsely promise that you will do something. Do not forget that I am Yahweh, your God.

lun_bawang: "Aleg iko ngedereh nelun denganmu idi ngaro binawehneh. Aleg maleh tabpar lun tebarinmu macing pekak nebpa.
english: ‘Do not cheat anyone or steal from anyone. ‘If you have agreed to pay your workers at the end of the day, do what you have promised; do not keep those wages until the next day.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko mulung lun luk mebengel, idi aleg ngerareng luk inan metebaceng pa atun lun mebuser. Iamo' do' iko matot inan Allahmu. Ui ini Tuhan.
english: ‘Do not curse deaf people, and do not put things in the path of blind people to cause them to stumble.

lun_bawang: "Aleg mutut besara' dengan na mesiri, idi aleg ngerurum nelun dat idi lun do' kareb iko mutut besara'deh. Iamo' do' iko mutut besara' lun denganmu dengan mepad.
english: ‘Always LIT judge people fairly DOU. Do not do special favors for either poor people or rich people.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko nalan amé' ngeruma' arang pupumu mepad kudeng lun luk ngatum bala. Idi aleg iko ngalap peruan ku até lun denganmu. Ui ini Tuhan.
english: ‘Do not spread false rumors about other people. ‘Do not say anything in court that would result in some innocent person being executed. I, Yahweh, am commanding this.

lun_bawang: "Idi aleg megateh niat inan kinanakmu. Iamo' do' iko mada' nelun denganmu dengan gala'-gala', pad iko na mabeh sala' ngaceku ieh.
english: ‘Do not hate anyone. Instead, honestly rebuke those who ought to be rebuked, in order that you also will not be guilty.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko ngua' luk dat idi tekedamut inan pupumu. Iamo' do' iko méi' nelun denganmu mepad kudeng bururmu sebuleng. Ui ini Tuhan.
english: ‘Do not try to get revenge against someone or be angry with someone for a long time. Instead, love other people like you love yourself. I, Yahweh your God, am commanding this.

lun_bawang: "Do' muyuh maya' ukumKu. Aleg muyuh nima' aya' muyuh ngebaneh pung luk baken. Idi aleg muyuh ngisak lati' muyuh ku dueh ayu ilung. Aleg muyuh ngayung ku ayung tebaruh luk dueh ayu nuper.
english: ‘Obey my laws. ‘Do not allow two different kinds of animals to mate with each other. ‘Do not plant two different kinds of seed in the same field. ‘Do not wear clothing made from two different kinds of material.

lun_bawang: "Kareb muyuh semuet bang bawang Kanaan, idi muyuh nibu puar-puar bua', idi do' bua' ineh mangun ku ali' teluh lak kinioneh, idi na miak kenen.
english: ‘When you enter the land that I have promised to give to you, and when you plant various kinds of fruit trees, you must not eat any of their fruit for three years DOU.

lun_bawang: "Aleg muyuh kuman uang luk inan dara'. Aleg muyuh mangun idi ngelimu'.
english: ‘Do not eat any meat that still has the animal’s blood in it. ‘Do not consult spirits to find out what will happen in the future, and do not practice sorcery.

lun_bawang: Aleg muyuh ngiki abpuk muyuh pekelibut pad necan buduk uluh. Aleg muyuh nangal paped buluh ada muyuh.
english: ‘Do not shave the hair at the sides of your heads like pagan people do.

lun_bawang: Aleg muyuh ngurat burur muyuh kareb lemulun maté. Idi aleg muyuh matik burur muyuh ku aceh arit. Ui ini Tuhan.
english: ‘Do not cut your bodies when you are mourning for people who have died, and do not put tattoos on your bodies. I, Yahweh your God, am commanding this.

lun_bawang: "Aleg nima' anak muyuh luk decur mangun ku decur luk mesawa', pad bawang ineh na mepanu' ku sawa' idi kekamen luk meluun dat.
english: ‘Do not disgrace your daughters by forcing them to become prostitutes. If you cause them to become prostitutes, soon the land will be filled with prostitutes and all other kinds of people’s wicked behavior.

lun_bawang: Do' muyuh nginita aco luk inanKu mudeng idi ngedita' Su inanKu luk Meligan. Ui ini Tuhan.
english: ‘Honor my Sabbath days and revere my Sacred Tent, because I, Yahweh, live there.

lun_bawang: "Idi aleg muyuh lumi inan lemulun luk mangun idi lemulun luk nawar ada'. Aleg muyuh nakap nedeh ineh, idi ngelutak burur muyuh ku ineh. Ui ini Tuhan Allah muyuh.
english: ‘Do not seek advice from those who ◄consult/talk with► the spirits of dead people DOU, because if you do that, they will defile you. I, Yahweh your God, am the one you should consult.

lun_bawang: "Do' muyuh ngerayeh idi ngedita' lun luk mengered. Idi do' muyuh matot inan Allah muyuh. Ui ini Tuhan.
english: ‘Stand up when old people enter the room, and show that you respect them, and also revere me, your God; that is what I, Yahweh, am commanding.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng aceh sakai tudo arang muyuh idi bang bawang muyuh, aleg muyuh mekuel nedeh.
english: ‘When foreigners live among you in your land, do not mistreat them.

lun_bawang: "Aleg muyuh ngisu' tari, uad, idi timang.
english: ‘When you are measuring things, to see how long they are or how much they weigh or how many there are,

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh do' muyuh maya' amung ukum idi balaKu. Ui ini Tuhan."
english: ‘Obey carefully DOU all my laws and decrees, because I, Yahweh, am the one who am commanding them.’ ”

lun_bawang: "Kudeng selemulun amé' ngitun nelun luk mangun idi lun luk nawar ada', Ui museh tu-tu neneh, idi ieh dukenKu buro rat arang pupuneh.
english: ‘ will reject IDM those who go to those who ◄consult/talk with► the spirits of dead people and fortune-tellers to seek advice from them. I will command that they no longer be allowed to associate with my people.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh do' muyuh ngeligan burur muyuh, ngaceku Ui ni Tuhan Allah muyuh.
english: ‘Set yourselves apart and be holy, because I, Yahweh your God, am holy, and I want you to be like me.

lun_bawang: "Idé-idé luk mulung idi ngediman tamanneh kian tinanneh lek, miak pitayen. Idi ieh mabeh dara'neh sebuleng.
english: ‘If anyone curses his father or his mother, he must be executed. He himself will be responsible for his own death MTY.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng seburur deléi pasét inan awan lun denganneh, na miak na didueh pitayen.
english: ‘If a man commits adultery with some other man’s wife, both of them, the man and the woman, must be executed.

lun_bawang: Kudeng selemulun pamung rudap dengan awan tamanneh idi ngigu' tamanneh, na miak na didueh pitayen. Idi dara' ineh baben didueh sebuleng.
english: ‘If a man has sex with EUP one of his father’s wives, he has disgraced his father. So both that man and that woman must be executed, they will be responsible for their own deaths MTY.

lun_bawang: Kudeng selemulun pasét inan awan anakneh na miak na didueh pitayen, ngaceku pasét nelun bang tetek ruma'neh. Idi dara' ineh baben didueh sebuleng.
english: ‘If a man has sex with EUP his daughter-in-law, both of them must be executed. What they have done is very perverse; and they will be responsible for their own deaths MTY.

lun_bawang: Kudeng sedeléi pamung inan deléi, ieh ineh kudeng ayu decur, idi didueh nganau' aceh kekamen luk pelaba dat. Na miak na didueh pitayen. Idi dara' ineh baben didueh sebuleng.
english: ‘If two men have sex together, they have done something detestable. They must both be executed, they will be responsible for their own deaths MTY.

lun_bawang: Idi kudeng selemulun ngalap aceh decur perapu dengan tinanneh ku awanneh, ieh ineh kekamen luk dat. Na miak na ideh sabpen, pad na inan kekamen luk dat arang muyuh.
english: ‘If a man marries both a woman and her mother, that is a wicked thing. All three of them must be burned to death, in order that such a wicked practice will not continue to be done among you.

lun_bawang: Kudeng aceh deléi pasét inan pung, na miak na ieh pitayen. Idi pung ineh pana' pitayen teh.
english: ‘If a man has sex with an animal, he must be executed, and you must also kill that animal.

lun_bawang: Kudeng sedecur pian pasét inan pung idi do' decur ineh idi pung ineh pana' pitayen. Idi dara' ineh baben didueh sebuleng.
english: ‘Similarly, if a woman has sex with an animal, both the woman and that animal must be killed DOU; they are responsible for their own deaths MTY.

lun_bawang: Idi teh aleg iko pasét inan tinan pinakenmu, ngaceku ieh ineh pasét nelun bang tetek ruma'mu sebuleng. Didueh sebuleng mabeh sala' didueh.
english: ‘Do not have sex with the sister of either your father or your mother, because that would be disgracing someone who is a close relative. And you and the woman must both be punished.

lun_bawang: Idi kudeng selemulun ngalap awan kinanakneh luk deléi, ieh ineh kekamen luk pelaba dat, idi ieh ngigu' kinanakneh. Idi didueh ineh na inul.”
english: ‘If a man marries his brother’s wife while his brother is still living, that is disgraceful. He has dishonored his brother; and they both will die without having any children.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Do' muyuh maya' amung ukum bada'Ku, pad bawang su luk inanKu nated nemuyuh na nala' nemuyuh, pad muyuh tudo bang ineh.
english: ‘Obey all my laws/decrees DOU carefully, in order that you will not be forced to leave MET the land to which I am bringing you.

lun_bawang: Iamo' jani'Ku nemuyuh, 'Muyuh miak ngalap bawang ini luk mebaleng luk barénKu nemuyuh. Ui ini Tuhan Allah muyuh luk pangeh ngatad nemuyuh ratnan amung pupu luk baken.
english: But I said to you, “You will take their land from them; I will give it to you to be yours, a land that is very fertile IDM. I am Yahweh your God, who has set you apart from the people of other nations.”

lun_bawang: "Idi idé-idé rat arang muyuh, do' deléi idi decur, luk mileh mangun idi nawar ada' na miak na ieh pitayen. Do' ideh bitungin ku batu. Idi dara' ineh babendeh sebuleng."
english: ‘You must execute any man or woman among you who ◄consults/talks with► the spirits of dead people or who is a fortune-teller. Kill them by throwing stones at them; but they will be responsible for their own deaths.’”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Do' iko mada' kuan amung imam idi anak Arun, pad sebuleng imam pana' na ngelutak bururneh ngaceku ngakem butung seburur pupuneh.
english: Yahweh also said to Moses/me, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them,

lun_bawang: Idi kareb lemulun maté, aleg imam ngiki uluhdeh idi mingit buluh adadeh, idi ngirit bururdeh.
english: You priests must not shave your heads or shave the edges of your beards or cut your bodies to show that you are mourning for someone who has died.

lun_bawang: Aleg imam ngaweh decur luk mesawa' idi luk pangeh nengedat lawéneh. Idi aleg ieh ngaweh aceh decur luk pangeh ligkan deléineh. Ngaceku imam ineh meligan kuan Tuhan.
english: You priests must not marry women who have been prostitutes or who have been divorced from their husbands, because you priests are ◄set apart for me/holy►.

lun_bawang: Idi kudeng anak decur imam mangun ku aceh decur luk mesawa', idi ieh ngedat tamanneh. Na miak na decur ineh sabpen.
english: If a priest’s daughter disgraces herself by becoming a prostitute, she disgraces her father; and she must be killed by being burned in a fire.

lun_bawang: "Idi imam luk rayeh arang amung kinanakneh, luk pangeh inumau uluhneh ku umau luk ku ngumau, idi luk pangeh kinikit ngayung ku ayung luk meligan ineh, na miak ngesasung abpukneh, idi narak-narak ayungneh.
english: The Supreme Priest is the one among his relatives who has been appointed for that work by having his head anointed with olive oil. He is also the one who has been appointed to wear the special garments that priests wear. He must not allow the hair on his head to remain uncombed, and he must not tear his clothes when he is mourning for someone.

lun_bawang: Idi do' ieh ngaweh aceh decur luk pun mebaruh.
english: Women whom you priests marry must be virgins.

lun_bawang: "Mada' kuan Arun kudeng ini: Idé-idé luk ratnan inulmu luk dat ayu, ieh ineh na miak amé' muneng maré baré akan Allah ineh. Ini aceh ukum luk meruked.
english: No one who is blind or lame or deformed, or whose face is disfigured,

lun_bawang: "Mada' kuan Arun idi anak-anakneh, pad ideh matar do'-do' idi ngerayeh amung luk meligan ineh luk biré lun Israil kuanKu, pad ideh na ngedat ngadanKu luk meligan. Ui ini Tuhan.
english: “Tell Aaron and his sons to greatly respect the sacred offerings that the Israeli people bring to me; by doing that you will respect me MTY, Yahweh.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng ineh teh do' imam maya' ukumKu, pad ideh na mabeh sala' idi mate' ngaceku ngedat ngadanKu ineh. Ngaceku Ui ini Tuhan luk ngeligan nedeh.
english: “The priests must obey my commandments in order that they will not become guilty and die as a result of ◄despising/not obeying► them.

lun_bawang: "Idi lun mula' na miak kuman luk meligan ineh, do' lun sakai idi lun tebarin imam pana'.
english: “Anyone who is not a member of a priest’s family is not permitted to eat any of a sacred offering, and no one who is visiting the priest or whom the priest has hired is permitted to eat it.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng selemulun kuman ratnan luk meligan ineh dengan na kali', idi do' ieh maré libalneh sebabpat limeh mela ratnan luk kinanneh kuan imam.
english: “If anyone who is not permitted to eat a sacred offering eats it without realizing that it is sacred, he must pay the priest for the offering, and pay him an extra one-fifth of its value.

lun_bawang: Idi kudeng muyuh maré inan Tuhan aceh baré ubur, do' muyuh maré ineh, pad ineh miak lapen Tuhan.
english: “Then you sacrifice an animal to thank me for what I have done, sacrifice it in a way that is acceptable to me.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' muyuh maya' ukumKu. Ui ini Tuhan.
english: “Obey all my commands DOU. I, Yahweh, am commanding them;

lun_bawang: "Mada' kuan lun Israil kudeng ini: Ini aco rayehKu luk uen muyuh ngeletep mangun ku tebubpun luk meligan.
english: “Tell the Israeli people about the festivals that I have chosen, the days when you all must gather together to worship me.”

lun_bawang: Anem aco kinioneh muyuh miak ngakem, iamo' aco luk ketudu' muyuh ngato erur muyuh pa kiung Tuhan, su luk inan amung muyuh tudo. Ieh ineh Aco luk inan Mudeng kuan aceh tebubpun sembayang. Idi kekamen anun- anun pana' aleg muyuh nganau'.
english: “You may work for six days each week, but on the seventh day you must not do any work. You must rest. It is a sacred/holy day when you must gather together to worship me. Wherever you live, you must rest on that day.”

lun_bawang: Idi ini amung aco rayeh Tuhan, luk ruen muyuh ngeletep bang kareb luk petulu.
english: “There are festivals that I have established for you. Those will also be sacred/holy days when you must gather together to worship me.

lun_bawang: "Idi kareb aco luk kenebpa muci ratnan Aco luk inan Mudeng ineh, ieh ineh aco luk inan muyuh maré padé mangun ku baré luk tidulen, do' muyuh ngiap macing tudu' minggu,
english: “Seven weeks after the priest offers that grain to me,

lun_bawang: "Ngecuk nelun Israil ineh nguit amé' namu umau saitun luk tipeh idi metaro ruen bang amung-amung lapung, pad amung lapung ineh miak mulun kidi- kidi.
english: “Command the Israeli people to continually bring to you clear oil made from pressed olives to burn in the lamps in the Sacred Tent, in order that those lamps will burn all the time.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' iko ngalap anem gatang banak idi nganau' ineh ku ruti pulu' dueh balad.
english: “Also, each week you must take some fine flour and bake twelve very big loaves of bread, using about four quarts/liters of flour for each loaf.

lun_bawang: "Nguit lemulun luk nguyo ineh remuat rat su luk inandeh nelupo. Do' amung lun luk pangeh neninger neneh ineh ngerareng ticu'deh luun uluhneh, idi do' lun mula' mitung neneh ku batu.
english: Tell the Israelis, ‘If anyone curses me, he must ◄endure the consequences/be punished►.

lun_bawang: "Idé-idé luk ngaté aceh lemulun miak pitayen.
english: And anyone who kills another person’s animal must give that person a live animal to replace the one that he killed.

lun_bawang: "Mada' kuan amung lun Israil kudeng ini: Kareb muyuh semuet bang bawang luk pian barénKu nemuyuh, idi do' bawang ineh inan aceh kareb luk inan ucu' kuan Tuhan.
english: “Tell the Israelis that I, Yahweh, say this: When you enter the land that I am about to give you, every seventh year you must honor me by not planting any seeds. You will be allowing the ground to rest.

lun_bawang: "Idi teh do' muyuh ngiap tudu' kua' tudu' lak. Kinula'neh apat ngepulu' iwa' lak.
