english: ‘Also, after every 49 years has ended, you must do this: ◄On the tenth day of the seventh month/At the end of September► of the next/50th year, blow trumpets throughout the country, to declare that it will be a day on which you request that I forgive you for the sins that you have committed.

lun_bawang: "Idi Lak luk Kelimeh Ngepulu' ineh, do' anid-anid muyuh muli' amé' inan babpat tana'neh, sagan pana' pangeh pinasui.
english: ‘If you sell some of your land to a fellow Israeli or if you buy some land from one of them, you must treat that person fairly:

lun_bawang: Idi ngaceku ineh kudeng muyuh masui tana' kuan lun dengan muyuh, kian muyuh melih rat nelun dengan muyuh, aleg muyuh muyok seburur dengan seburur.
english: If you buy land, the price that you will pay will depend on the number of years there will be until the next Year of Celebration. If someone sells land to you, he will charge a price that is determined by the number of years until the next Year of Celebration.

lun_bawang: "Do' muyuh maya' amung ukumKu idi nginita amung balaKu idi nganau' luk petulu, pad muyuh lutep tudo bang bawang ineh.
english: And crops will grow well on the land, and you will have plenty to eat.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng inan lun ngitun, 'Anunké luk kenen kai lak luk ketudu' ineh, ngaceku kai na nganau' lati'?'
english: My answer is that I will bless you very much during the sixth/previous year, with the result that during that year there will be enough crops to provide food for you for three years!

lun_bawang: "Idi ngaceku ineh aleg masui tana' ineh ruked-ruked, ngaceku tana' ineh Ui kuan. Idi muyuh lun sakai idi lun luk tudo denganKu.
english: Throughout the country that you will possess, you must remember that if someone sells some of his land to you, he is permitted to buy it back from you if he wants to.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng kinanakmu masi', pad ieh masui anun-anun ratnan babpatneh, do' pupuneh luk muneng amé' nguli' luk pangeh pinasui kinanakneh ineh.
english: However, if a man has no one to buy the land for him, and he himself prospers again and saves enough money to buy that land back,

lun_bawang: "Kudeng selemulun masui ruma' bang bawang luk inar meraben, idi miak ieh uen nguli' bang lak ineh teh.
english: If he does not buy it during that year, it will belong permanently to the man who bought it and to his descendants. It must not be returned to the original owner in the Year of Celebration.

lun_bawang: Iamo' amung bawang lun Liwi ineh, idi amung ruma' luk bang bawangdeh, idan-idan pana' miak teh uen nguli'.
english: And because the houses in their towns are on land that was given to them by other Israelis, that land will become theirs again in the Year of Celebration if they do not buy it back before then.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng kinanakmu masi', idi na ieh miak tebawang denganmu, do' iko ngedengan neneh, mepad kudeng lun sakai luk mudeng arang muyuh, pad ieh miak mulun denganmu.
english: If you lend money to him, do not charge any kind of interest DOU. Instead, show by what you do that you revere me, your God, and help that man, in order that he will be able to continue to live among you.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng kinanakmu luk denganmu ineh masi', idi ieh masui bururneh kuanmu, aleg iko ngecuk neneh ngakem mepad kudeng demulunmu.
english: Treat him like you treat workers that you hire or like someone who is living on your land temporarily. But he must work for you only until the Year of Celebration.

lun_bawang: Iamo' muyuh miak melih demulun luk deléi idi decur ratnan pupu baken luk tudo libut-libut bawang muyuh.
english: You are also permitted to buy some of the foreigners who are living among you, and members of their clans that were born in your country. Then you will own them.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng seburur lun sakai kian lun tebarinmu pangeh nengalap mula' binaweh, idi kinanakmu ineh masi' pad ieh masui bururneh kuan lun sakai kian lun tebarinmu ineh lek,
english: it is permitted for someone to pay for him to be freed. It is permitted for one of his relatives to pay for him to be released:

lun_bawang: Do' muyuh ngerayeh amung aco luk inanKu mudeng idi ngerayeh Su inanKu luk Meligan. Ui ini Tuhan.
english: “Honor the Sabbath days and revere my Sacred Tent, because I, Yahweh, live there.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng muyuh nginita ukumKu idi maya' balaKu,
english: “If you carefully obey all my commands DOU,

lun_bawang: "Idi Ui maré do' bang bawang ineh, pad muyuh telubid dengan na gegapin idé-idé pana'. Idi Ui miak ngaté amung pung luk mesangit luk bang bawang muyuh. Idi bunu' pana' nateh.
english: “If you obey all my laws, there will be peace in your country, and when you lie down to sleep, nothing will cause you to be afraid. I will get rid of the dangerous animals in your country, and there will no wars MTY in your country.

lun_bawang: Idi Ui méi nemuyuh, ngasa' nemuyuh, idi ngula' nemuyuh. Idi Ui ngeriput jani'Ku nemuyuh.
english: “If you obey all my laws, I will bless you and cause you to have many children DOU. And I will do what I said that I would do in the agreement that I made with you.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' kudeng muyuh na maya' amung ukumKu,
english: “But if you will not heed me and obey all these commands,

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng muci ratnan amung ini na muyuh sikal ninger balaKu, Ui miak ngedereh nemuyuh tudu' kua' ngaceku amung sala' muyuh.
english: “If you still will not heed me after all those things happen to you, I will continue to punish you again and again for the sins that you have committed.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng muyuh na perurum Negku idi na ninger balaKu, kali' rungen Ui ngacing tuda'-tuda' dereh kuan muyuh, tudu' kua' maya' sala' muyuh.
english: “If you continue to oppose me and refuse to heed me, I will cause you to experience disasters again and again, like you deserve to experience because of your sins.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng muci ratnan amung dereh ini, muyuh na uren iamo' sikal metueh rat Negku,
english: “When you experience those things that I do to punish you, if you still do not pay attention to me, and if you continue to oppose me,

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng muci ratnan ineh teh muyuh na ninger balaKu, idi sikal metueh rat Negku,
english: “After all those things happen, if you still do not heed me, if you still oppose me,

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng ideh ngamo amung sala'deh idi sala' tepundeh pana', ngaceku ideh na maya' Negku idi sikal metueh rat Negku,
english: “But your descendants must confess their sins and the sins that their ancestors committed. Their ancestors acted unfaithfully toward me and were hostile to me, with the result that I forced them to go to the countries that belonged to their enemies. But when your descendants humble themselves SYN and stop being very stubborn IDM and accept being punished for their sins,

lun_bawang: "Do' mada' kuan amung lun Israil kudeng ini: Kudeng selemulun pejani' maré raga seburur lemulun kuan Tuhan, do' maya' raga luk litep ini:
english: “Tell the Israeli people that this is what I am saying to them: If anyone solemnly promises to dedicate another person to work solely for me, the person who is dedicated to me is allowed to be free from having to do that by someone paying to the priest a fixed amount of money. The money that is given must be calculated by comparing it with the official pieces of silver in the Sacred Tent.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng aya' luk biré lun inan Tuhan ku baré, anun-anun luk biré inan Tuhan kudeng ineh, ieh ineh meligan.
english: ‘If someone solemnly promises to give an animal that is acceptable to be an offering to me, that animal becomes sacred and belongs to me.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng selemulun maré ruma'neh ku aceh ruma' luk meligan kuan Tuhan, do' imam nganau' raganeh maya' do' idi datneh, idi raga luk inau' imam, ieh ineh luk lutep.
english: ‘Similarly, if someone dedicates his house to be a sacred gift to belong to me, the priest will decide how much it is worth, which will depend on whether the house is in good condition. Whatever the priest says that it is worth, that will be its value and that is the price that the priest must pay for it.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng aceh lemulun maré inan Tuhan aceh babpat ratnan tana'neh, idi do' raganeh maya' kinula' pimaraneh, ieh ineh limeh ngepulu' gatang pimara, limeh ngepulu' balad pirak.
english: ‘If someone dedicates to me some of the property that belongs to him and his family, its value will be determined by the number of bushels of seed that will be needed to plant seeds on that land: Its value will be ten pieces of silver for each bushel of seed.

lun_bawang: Idi kudeng ieh maré kuan Tuhan aceh tana' luk pangeh bilihneh,
english: ‘If someone dedicates to me some land that he has bought, land which is not part of the land that his family has always owned,

lun_bawang: "Iamo' amung anak aya' muyuh luk tinganak pun-pun kuan Tuhan aleg seburur pana' maré ineh ku baré, do' sapi', amék, idi dumba, ngaceku Tuhan mo' luk kuan nedeh.
english: ‘No one is permitted to dedicate to me the firstborn of any cow or sheep, because the firstborn already belongs to me DOU.

lun_bawang: Amung luk litep uen ngatad ratnan lemulun, ieh ineh na miak uen nguli'. Na miak na ieh ineh pitayen peh.
english: ‘No person who has done something that I consider to be very wicked is permitted to be freed from being punished; that person must surely be executed.

lun_bawang: "Idi amung babpat pulu' uli' tana', do' padé idi bua' pana' Tuhan kuan.
english: ‘One tenth of all the crops and grain or fruit that is produced on anyone’s land is sacred and belongs to me.

lun_bawang: "Do' medueh Arun ngiap kinula' lun Israil dengan amung inul, idi tetek ruma'deh, perapu dengan ngadan anid-anid deléi,
english: “I want you and Aaron to determine how many Israeli men are able to fight in battles. Write down the names of all the men who are at least 20 years old, and write down the names of their clans and families.

lun_bawang: "Do' amung lun Israil nganau' lepodeh, anid-anid muneng ku bedéra'deh, dengan tanu' ruma' tamandeh. Idi do' ideh nganau' lepodeh libut Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan.
english: “When the Israelis set up their tents, they should set them up in areas that surround the Sacred Tent, but not close to it. The people of each tribe must set up their tents in a different area. Each tribe must erect in that area a banner of their own clan and a flag that represents their tribe.

lun_bawang: -9"Idi do' lun Yahuda lupo pa busat aco su babpatdeh, dengan bedéra'deh, idi lun rayehdeh." Ini kinula'deh: Pupu, Lun Rayeh, Kinula'deh; Yahuda, Nasun Aminadab, 74,600; Iskar, Netanel Suar, 54,400; Sebulon, Eliab Helon,
english: The people of the tribes of Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun must set up their tents on the east side of the Sacred Tent, close to their tribal flags. These are the names of the leaders of those tribes and the number of soldiers whom they will lead: Nahshon, the son of Amminadab, will be the leader of the 74,600 men of the tribe of Judah.

lun_bawang: -16Idi lun Rubin lupo pa kabing busat aco su babpatdeh dengan bedéra'deh, idi lun rayehdeh. Ini kinula'deh: Pupu, Lun Rayeh, Kinula'deh; Rubin, Elisur Sedur, 46,500; Simion, Selumil Surisadai, 59,300; Gad, Eliasap Ruel, 45,650; Kinula'deh:, 151,450 Babpat Rubin luk nalan maya' puet Yahuda.
english: So there will be 151,450 troops on the south side of the Sacred Tent. Those three tribes will follow the first group when the Israelis travel.

lun_bawang: Idi arang dueh babpat ini idi dueh babpat luk muci, lun Liwi mirir Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan. Anid babpatdeh nalan maya' atur kareb ideh lupo dengan bedéra'deh.
english: Pagiel, the son of Ocran, will be the leader of the 41,500 men of the tribe of Asher.

lun_bawang: -24Idi lun Epraim lupo pa acep aco, su babpatdeh dengan bedéra'deh, idi lun rayehdeh. Ini kinula'deh: Pupu, Lun Rayeh, Kinula'deh; Epraim, Elisama Amihud, 40,500; Manasé, Gamalil Pedasur, 32,200; Beniamin, Abidan Gidioni, 35,400; Kinula'deh:, 108,100 Babpat Epraim luk nalan maya' puet lun Liwi.
english: Ahira, the son of Enan, will be the leader of the 53,400 men of the tribe of Naphtali.

lun_bawang: "Nguit lun Liwi ineh amé' pa kiung Arun luk imam, pad ideh miak ngedengan neneh.
english: “Bring the men of the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron, in order that they may assist him.

lun_bawang: "Ui pangeh nengalap amung lun Liwi rat arang lun Israil ku libal amung anak lun Israil luk atun. Idi amung lun Liwi ineh Ui kuan.
english: “Note that from all the Israelis, I have chosen the men of the tribe of Levi to take the places of all the firstborn sons of the Israeli people. The male descendants of Levi belong to me,

lun_bawang: "Do' iko ngiap amung anak deléi lun Liwi, maya' tetek ruma'deh luk ulun sebulan idi mela ratnan ineh.”
english: “Count the male members of the tribe of Levi. Write down their names and the names of their clans and family groups. Count all the males who are at least one month old.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Do' iko ngiap anak deléi lun Israil luk atun, ieh ineh luk ulun sebulan ini mela. Idi do' ngalap amung ngadandeh.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Now count all the other firstborn males in Israel who are at least one month old, and write down their names.

lun_bawang: "Do' iko ngalap amung lun Liwi ineh ku libal amung anak deléi lun Israil luk atun, idi amung aya' lun Liwi ku libal aya'deh. Ngaceku amung lun Liwi ineh Ui kuan. Ui ini Tuhan.
english: “Set apart the descendants of Levi to be substitutes for the firstborn males of the other Israeli people. The descendants of Levi belong to me, Yahweh.

lun_bawang: "Do' ngiap anak-anak deléi Kohat rat arang amung lun Liwi maya' inuldeh idi tetek ruma'deh,
english: “Write down the names of the men who belong to the clans descended from Levi.

lun_bawang: Idi kekamendeh, ieh ineh nginita repapeh luk meluun ligan.
english: “The work of these descendants of Kohath will be to take care of the sacred items that are used when the people worship at the Sacred Tent.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' ideh malad sepekatu kibung luk bata' melaco luun méja ruti luk barén kuan Tuhan idi ngerareng luun ineh amung bigan, kaduit, sikuan luk ku ngutang, idi busi', idi do' inan ruti luun méja ineh kidi-kidi.
english: “Then they must put a blue cloth over the table on which the priests put the sacred bread. On top of the cloth they must put the bowls for incense, the pans, the other dishes, the jars for the wine that will be offered as a sacrifice, and the sacred bread.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' ngakeb kukud dawan ineh dengan amung lapungneh, apitneh, amung luk ku ngilep, idi amung su luk inan umau lapung ineh ku sepekatu kibung luk mebata'.
english: “Then with another blue cloth they must cover the lampstand, the lamps, the lamp snuffers, the trays, and the special jars of olive oil to burn in the lamps.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' malad sepekatu kibung luk mebata' luun bubpun luk ratnan amas ineh, idi mapen ineh ku ebpu luk ratnan kubil amék. Idi do' nganau' kayuh luk ku mirir bubpun ineh.
english: “Then they must spread another blue cloth over the gold altar which is used for burning incense. Over this they must spread a nice covering made from the skins of goats. Then they must insert into the rings of that altar the poles for carrying it.

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh do' ngalap amung repapeh luk miak ruen bang kekamen Su luk Meligan ineh idi ngebpu ineh ku kibung luk mebata', idi mapen ineh ku ebpu luk ratnan kubil amék. Idi do' nganau' kayuh ineh ku mirir ineh.
english: “They must take all the other items that are inside the Sacred Tent and wrap them in a blue cloth, cover that with a nice covering made from the skins of goats, and place all that on a frame for carrying it.

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh do' nala' abuh luk luun bubpun ineh idi malad sepekatu kibung luk mesia' luunneh.
english: “Then they must remove the ashes from the altar on which they have burned sacrifices. Then they must cover the altar with a purple cloth.

lun_bawang: "Do' iko ngiap anak-anak deléi Gerson maya' inuldeh, idi tetek ruma'deh,
english: “This is the work that they must do and the things that they must carry when you move to a new location:

lun_bawang: Idi ini luk miak ruen inul Gerson idi luk miak itendeh:
english: They must also carry the curtains that form the wall that surrounds the courtyard that surrounds the Sacred Tent and the altar, the curtain that is at the entrance to the courtyard, and the ropes that fasten the curtains. They must also do the packing and loading of these things.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' Musa ngiap anak-anak deléi Merari maya' inuldeh idi tetek ruma'deh,
english: Their work will be to carry the frames that hold up the tent, the crossbars, the posts that hold up the curtains, and the bases.

lun_bawang: "Do' ngecuk nelun Israil ngeruat amung lun luk mét susud idi amung lun luk mekebabpa' idi amung lun luk ku gani' ngaceku ngakem butung ratnan su luk inan lun mula' nelupo,
english: “Tell this to the Israeli people: ‘You must send away from your ◄camp/area where you have your tents► any man or woman who has leprosy and anyone who has a discharge of some fluid from his body, and anyone who has become unacceptable to God because of having touched a corpse.

lun_bawang: "Do' mada' kuan lun Israil, kudeng idé-idé luk nganau' sala' pa kiung lun denganneh, pad ieh na lutep maya' Tuhan,
english: “Tell this to the Israeli people: ‘If someone ◄commits a crime against/does something wrong to► another person, I consider that that person has done wrong to me.

lun_bawang: "Do' mada' kuan amung lun Israil, kudeng seburur decur luk inan awan, idi ieh na lutep inan awanneh,
english: “Tell this to the Israeli people: ‘Suppose a man thinks that his wife has slept with another man,

lun_bawang: Idi abpa' luk ngacing kediman ini miak semuet bang tinéi'mu pad batekmu tebuki', idi tipanmu merugu'.' "Idi do' decur mala, 'Mo.'
english: ‘Then the priest must write with ink on a small scroll these ◄curses/bad things that will happen to her if she is guilty► and then wash the ink off into the bitter water.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' imam ngayud kediman ini luun surat idi ngerereb ineh bang abpa' luk mepét ineh.
english: The priest must take from her the offering of barley flour that she is holding, and lift it up to dedicate it to me. Then he must put it on the altar

lun_bawang: "Idi ini ukum, kudeng aceh deléi ngimaruh idi nganu awanneh pangeh pasét.
english: Even if the woman has not done what the husband suspected, he will not be punished MTY for doing something wrong by bringing his wife to the priest. But if his wife is guilty, she will suffer as a result.’”

lun_bawang: "Do' mada' kuan amung lun Israil, kudeng idé-idé nganau' aceh pejani' lun Nasiri, pian ngatad bururneh kuan Tuhan,
english: “Tell this to the Israeli people: ‘If any of you wants to make a solemn promise to dedicate himself to belong to me in a special way, after you obey these instructions, you will be called a Nazir-man, which means “dedicated man”.

lun_bawang: Idi aleg ieh amé' muneng ku butung,
english: And you must not go near a corpse during the time that you are a Nazir-man.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' kudeng seburur lemulun maté denak-denak iringneh, pad ieh ngelutak abpukneh luk pijani' ineh, idi do' ieh ngiki uluhneh kareb aco luk inanneh uen ngeligan, ieh ineh aco luk ketudu'.
english: ‘If anyone dies very suddenly when he is near you, then your hair that you have dedicated to me is no longer sacred. So you must wait seven days and then shave it all off. Then you must perform a special ritual to cause yourself to become acceptable to me again.

lun_bawang: "Idi ini ukum lun Nasiri ineh. Idi kareb aco luk pijani'neh mabud, do' ieh iten amé' munung tanga' Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan.
english: ‘When the time that you promised to dedicate yourself to me is ended, go to the entrance of the Sacred Tent

lun_bawang: "Do' mada' kuan Arun idi anak-anakneh, Kudeng ini dalan muyuh ngeperuan nelun Israil: kebala muyuh,
english: “Tell Aaron and his sons that when they ask me to bless the people, they must say,

lun_bawang: "Kudeng ideh sembayang kudeng ini pa kiung Tuhan kuan lun Israil, idi Ui miak ngeperuan nedeh."
english: Then Yahweh said, “If Aaron and his sons ask me to bless the Israeli people, truly I will bless them.”

lun_bawang: "Do' iko ngalap amung baré ineh ku kekamen Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan. Idi maré amung ineh kuan lun Liwi maya' kekamendeh.”
english: “Accept these gifts, in order that the descendants of Levi can use them for carrying the sacred items that are here at the Sacred Tent.”

lun_bawang: idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Do' ideh maré baré seburur seaco, pad ngeligan bubpun ineh.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Each of the next twelve days one leader should bring his gifts for the dedication of the altar.”

lun_bawang: "Do' mada' kuan Arun, kareb ieh nutud lapung, idi do' lapung luk tudu' ineh ngacang pa atun kukud dawan ineh.”
english: “Tell Aaron to put the seven lamps on the lampstand and place them in such a way that they shine toward the front of the lampstand.”

lun_bawang: "Do' ngatad amung lun Liwi rat arang lun Israil idi ngeligan nedeh.
english: “You must cause the descendants of Levi to be acceptable to me by setting them apart from the other Israeli people.

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh lun Liwi miak ngerareng ticu'deh luun uluh dueh sapi' deléi ineh, idi do' iko maré sebuleng mangun ku baré ngaceku sala', idi sebuleng barén ku baré luk sabpen kuan Tuhan, pad nganau' luk nguit pedo' kuan lun Liwi ineh.
english: “After that, the descendants of Levi must place their hands on the heads of the two bulls. Then the bulls will be killed and burned on the altar. One will be an offering to enable me to forgive them for the sins they have committed, and the other will be completely burned to please me.

lun_bawang: Kareb iko pangeh nengeligan nedeh idi pangeh nemaré nedeh mangun ku baré luk tidulen, do' lun Liwi amé' ngakem bang Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan.
english: “After the descendants of Levi have been made acceptable to me, and presented to me like a special offering, they may start to work at the Sacred Tent.

lun_bawang: "Do' amung lun Liwi luk ulun dueh ngepulu' limeh lak idi mela, ngakem bang Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan.
english: “The descendants of Levi who are between 25 and 50 years old will work at the Sacred Tent.

lun_bawang: "Do' lun Israil temina' nganau' Aco Rayeh Paska,
english: “Tell the Israeli people that they must celebrate the Passover Festival again.

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh nedidueh, "Kai ini pangeh nelutak ku butung lemulun. Ngudehké kai na miak maré aceh baré kuan Tuhan bang kareb luk litep dengan amung lun Israil?”
english: “It is true that we have touched a corpse. But why should that prevent us from celebrating the Passover Festival and offering sacrifices to Yahweh like everyone else RHQ?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Musa nedeh, "Nganét atun, pad ui ninger kudeng apeh bala Tuhan.”
english: Moses/I replied, “Wait here until I go into the Sacred Tent and find out what Yahweh says about it.”

lun_bawang: "Do' mada' kuan amung lun Israil, Kudeng inan rat arang muyuh idi rat arang amung anak mupun muyuh luk nelutak ngaceku nengakem butung lemulun, idi kian inan luk pangeh nenalan iné' mado, do' ideh na nganau' Irau Paska bang aco sineh.
english: “Tell this to the Israeli people: If any of you or your descendants touch a corpse and as a result become unacceptable to me, or if you are away from home on a long trip at the time to celebrate the Passover, you will still be permitted to celebrate it.

lun_bawang: "Do' iko nuno dueh serupit pirak ku nawar nelun Israil idi ku ngecuk nedeh nalan.
english: “Tell someone to make two trumpets by hammering each one from one lump of silver. Blow the trumpets to summon the people to come together and also to signal that they must move their tents to a new location.

lun_bawang: Idi luk ngiup serupit, ieh ineh anak-anak Arun luk imam. "Idi ini aceh dalan luk meruked macing ku anak inul muyuh.
english: “The priests who are descended from Aaron are the ones who should blow the trumpets. That is a regulation that will never be changed.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Hobab nengor balaneh, "Na ui amé'. Ngaceku ui pian muli' amé' bawangku, idi nan pupuku sebuleng.”
english: But Hobab replied, “No, I will not go with you. I want to return to my own land and to my own family.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa, "Aleg iko necan nekai. Ngaceku iko kali' su luk inan tau lupo déi' su luk ali-ali. Idi iko luk nguyut nekai.
english: But Moses/I said, “Please do not leave us. You know the places where we can set up our tents in this desert, and you can guide us.

lun_bawang: Idi idan-idan, kareb Pati' Pejani' ineh nalan idi Musa pebala, "Miket, O Tuhan! Nima' amung bunu'Mu urap-urap, idi amung luk megateh Namu buro rat pa kiungMu.”
english: Each morning when the men who were carrying the sacred chest started to walk, Moses/I said, “Yahweh, arise! Scatter your enemies! Cause those who hate you to run away from you!”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb Pati' Pejani' ineh ucu' ieh pebala, "Lemubed, O Tuhan, amé' inan pulu' ngeribu tetek ruma' lun Israil."
english: And each time the men stopped to set down the sacred chest, Moses/I said, “Yahweh, stay close to the thousands of us Israelis!”

lun_bawang: Idi lun baken luk nemaya' nedeh melili ku akan luk do'. Idi lun Israil nenangi' teh, kebaladeh, "Kai pelaba pian ku luk kikid!
english: Then some troublemakers from other people-groups who were traveling with the Israelis began to want better food. And when they started complaining the Israeli people also started to complain.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa inan Tuhan, "Ngudehké Iko nganau' luk dat kuanku. Ngudehké Iko na méi' negku, idi na ngalap babeh amung pupu ini rat negku?
english: He/I went into the Sacred Tent and asked Yahweh, “Why have you caused me, your servant, to experience this trouble RHQ? Act mercifully to me! What wrong have I done, with the result that you have appointed me to take care of all of these people RHQ?

lun_bawang: iamo' sebulan, pad macing ieh remuat rat bang icung muyuh idi muyuh mesukol ku ineh, ngaceku muyuh pangeh nengedat Tuhan luk arang muyuh, idi muyuh pangeh nengedureng pa kiungNeh, kebala muyuh, "Anun pun kai remuat rat bang bawang Masir?" ' “
english: You will eat meat every day for one month, and then you will loathe/despise it, and it will cause you to want to vomit. This will happen because you have rejected Yahweh who is here among you, and you have wailed in his presence, saying “We would have had better food to eat if we had not left Egypt RHQ.”’”

lun_bawang: Kebala Musa inan Tuhan, "Kinula' lemulun luk maya' negku 600,000 burur, idi kebala Tuhan, 'Ui miak maré luk kikid kuandeh, tap kenen sebulan!'
english: But Moses/I replied to Yahweh, “There are 600,000 men plus women and children here with me, so ◄why do you say ‘I will give them plenty of meat every day for a month!’?/it does not seem right for you to say ‘I will give them plenty of meat every day for a month!’► RHQ

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Naké lalud Tuhan petap? Nekini iko miak nier kudeng balaKu matu ku na.”
english: But Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Do you think that I SYN have no power? You will now see if I can do what I say I will do.”

lun_bawang: Idi seburur anak adi' nupun mada' ni Musa ratnan luk ruen Eldad idi Midad.
english: So a young man ran and told Moses/me, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in all their tents!”

lun_bawang: Idi Yusak Nun luk ngakem dengan Musa rat isuut, nepebala, "O Musa, do' mebpeng nedidueh.”
english: Joshua, who had helped Moses/me since he was a young man, said, “Sir, tell them to stop doing that!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Musa neneh, "Ngudehké iko megagau ngaceku ui? Meluun do' amung pupu Tuhan mangun ku nabi, pad Tuhan maré RohNeh nedeh!”
english: But Moses/I replied, “◄Are you worried that they might injure my reputation/Do you think that I want to be the only one who prophesies► RHQ? I wish that all Yahweh’s people could ◄prophesy/speak messages from Yahweh►. I wish that Yahweh would give the power of his Spirit to all of them!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala didueh "Baken Musa mo' inan Tuhan nepebala. Kiteh pana' inan Tuhan nepebala teh!" Idi Tuhan neninger bala ini. ( 3Idi Musa ineh aceh lemulun luk pelaba beneh niat rat nelun baken.)
english: The truth was that Moses/I was very humble. He/I was more humble than anyone else on the earth and Moses/I had not appointed himself/myself to be their leader.

lun_bawang: Idi denak-denak Tuhan nepebala ni Musa, Arun, idi Miriam, "Remuat meteluh amé' bang Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan." Idi diteluh pana' neremuat.
english: Then Yahweh descended to the entrance of the tent in a cloud that resembled a huge white pillar. He told Aaron and Miriam to step forward, so they did.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan, "Ninger medueh balaKu ini! Kudeng inan nabi Tuhan arang muyuh, Ui ini Tuhan ngelagan bururKu neneh bang luk sirenneh, idi pebala neneh bang nupineh.
english: But that is not the way I speak to my servant Moses. I trust that he will lead my people well.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Arun ni Musa, "O Tuan, aleg ngukum nekai ngaceku kai nenganau' luk mebacé idi sala' teh.
english: Do not allow Miriam to be like a baby that is already dead when it is born, whose flesh is already half decayed!”

lun_bawang: Idi Musa nesembayang nan Tuhan, kebalaneh, "O Allah, ui mutuh Namu ngedo' neneh.”
english: But Yahweh replied, “If her father had rebuked her for doing something wrong by spitting in her face, she would have been ashamed for seven days. She should be ashamed because of what she has done. So send her outside the camp for seven days. Then she will not have leprosy any more, and she may return to the camp.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Kudeng tamanneh pangeh nengelica' kiungneh, naké ieh migu' tudu' aco kinioneh? Ngaceku ineh do' ngata neneh tudu' aco kinioneh petatang rat su luk inan nelupo. Pangeh ineh miak ngalap neneh.”
english: So they sent her outside the camp for seven days. ◄The people/We► did not move to another location until she returned.

lun_bawang: "Do' iko ngecuk nelun amé' nier bawang Kanaan luk barénKu kuan lun Israil; ratnan anid-anid inul tamandeh, do' iko ngecuk seburur deléi, idi do' amungdeh lun luk mileh nguyut.”
english: “Send some men to Canaan land to explore it. That is the land that I will give to you Israelis. Send men who are leaders in their tribes.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Musa nengecuk nedeh nalan, idi kebalaneh nedeh, "Do' muyuh nalan rat ieni amé' Negeb idi uké pegkung,
english: Before Moses/I sent them to explore Canaan, he/I said to them, “Go through the southern part of Canaan, and then go north into the hilly area.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh ni Musa, "Kai pangeh nacing inan bawang luk icukmu iné' sira' kai, idi tana' su ineh mebaleng. Idi ini bua' ratnan tana' ineh.
english: But this is what they reported to Moses/me: “We arrived in the land that you sent us to explore. It is truly a beautiful land, and it is very fertile IDM. Here is some of the fruit.

lun_bawang: Idi Kaleb nengecuk nelun Israil ineh pirud pa kiung Musa, kebalaneh, "Do' tau nalan nekini idi ngaro tana' ineh. Ngaceku kali' rungen tau miak ngelaya' nedeh.”
english: When they said that, the people were afraid and started to cry out very loudly. But Caleb told the people who were standing near Moses/me to be quiet. Then he said, “We should go there and take the land, because we are certainly able to conquer it!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebaladeh luk iné' maya' ni Kaleb, "Na mepelengit tau pupu ineh. Ngaceku ideh ineh meluun tueh rat netau.”
english: But the men who had gone with him said, “No, we cannot attack and defeat those people! They are much stronger than we are!”

lun_bawang: Idi amungdeh tekedamut ni Musa idi Arun. Kebaladeh nedidueh, "Meluun do' kai maté déi' bawang Masir, idi su luk ali-ali ini.
english: The next day they all complained to Aaron and Moses/me. All the men said, “We wish that we had died in Egypt, or in this desert!

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh arangdeh sebuleng, "Do' tau mili' seburur mangun ku lun rayeh tau idi lemubed amé' bawang Masir.”
english: Then some of them said to each other, “We should choose a leader who will take us back to Egypt!”

lun_bawang: idi kebala didueh kuan lun Israil, "Bawang luk iné' sira' ineh aceh bawang luk pelaba do'.
english: They said to the Israeli people, “The land that we explored is very good.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Tuda' ioké pupu ini ngedat Negku? Tuda' io teh ideh na maya' Negku, sagan tu pana' inan mula' tanu' luk inau'Ku arangdeh?
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “How long will these people reject me RHQ? I am tired of them not believing in what I can do, in spite of all the miracles I have performed among them RHQ!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa inan Tuhan, "Kudeng pieh kudeng ineh kali' rungen lun Masir kali' ineh muci, ngaceku Iko nenguit pupu ini remuat rat arangdeh dengan laludMu.
english: But Moses/I replied to Yahweh, “Please do not do that, because the people of Egypt will hear about it! You brought these Israeli people from Egypt by your great power,

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan, "Ui pangeh nemaré do' kuandeh maya' kudeng putuhmu ineh.
english: Then Yahweh replied, “I have forgiven them, as you requested me to.

lun_bawang: "Tuda' ioké pupu luk dat ini tekedamut Negku? Idi amung dureng lun Israil Negku Ui pangeh kali'.
english: “How long will the wicked people of this nation keep complaining about me RHQ? I have heard everything that they have grumbled/complained against me.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nekulat uka-uka idi iné' luun pegkung, idi kebaladeh, "Nekini tau sikal amé' inan bawang luk pijani' Tuhan kuan tau. Kali' rungen tau pangeh mesala'.”
english: So the people got up early the next morning and started to go toward the hilly area in Canaan. They said, “We know that we have sinned, but now we are ready to enter the land that Yahweh promised to give to us.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Musa, "Ngudehké muyuh pian ngelaba bala Tuhan? Kali' rungen na ulekneh.
english: But Moses/I said, “Yahweh commanded you to return to the desert, so why are you now disobeying him RHQ? It will not ◄succeed/be possible►.

lun_bawang: "Mada' kuan lun Israil: Kareb muyuh macing inan bawang luk biréKu nemuyuh,
english: “Tell this to the Israeli people: When you arrive in the land that I am giving to you,

lun_bawang: Idi kareb iko maré aceh dumba deléi, do' iko nguit segatang banak luk rinabur ku dueh seréi' umau saitun ku baré akan.
english: ‘When you offer a ram to be a sacrifice, you must also bring an offering of four quarts/liters of finely-ground flour mixed with ◄a third of a gallon/1.3 liters► of olive oil.

lun_bawang: do' amung lun Israil nganau' kudeng ineh, kareb maré baré akan, mangun ku luk do' buen kuan Tuhan.
english: ‘All of you people who have been Israelis all of your lives must obey these regulations when you offer sacrifices that will be pleasing to me when they are burned on the altar.

lun_bawang: "Do' iko mada' kuan amung lun Israil: Kareb muyuh macing bang bawang luk inanKu nated nemuyuh,
english: “Tell these instructions to the Israeli people: Yahweh says this: ‘When you arrive in the land to which I am taking you,

lun_bawang: "Iamo' kudeng muyuh meraruh idi na maya' amung ukum ini luk bila Tuhan ni Musa iamo' baken inau' rungen,
english: “‘There may be times when you Israelis do not obey all these instructions that I have given to Moses to tell you, but not because you intended to disobey them.

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng selemulun nganau' sala' dengan na inau' rungen, idi do' ieh maré aceh amék tineh luk ulun selak ku baré ngaceku sala'.
english: If one person commits a sin without realizing that he was sinning, that person must bring to me a female goat to be an offering to enable me to forgive that person for the sins that person has committed.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' lemulun luk nganau' sala' dengan rungen, do' lun Israil idi lun sakai pana', lemulun ineh ngedat Tuhan, idi do' ieh duken buro rat arang pupuneh.
english: But those who disobey my commands ◄deliberately/because they want to►, both Israelis and the foreigners who live among you, have sinned against me by doing that. So ◄they must be expelled/you must expel them► from your camp.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Do' lemulun ineh pitayen. Idi do' amung lun Israil mitung neneh ku batu petatang rat su luk inan muyuh nelupo.”
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “The man must be executed. All of you must kill him by throwing stones at him outside the camp.”

lun_bawang: "Do' iko ngecuk nelun Israil nganau' lidung kuyu'deh meramoi macing ruked-ruked. Idi do' ngabet ramoineh ku nuper luk bata' melaco.
english: “Tell this to the Israeli people: You and all your descendants must twist threads together to make tassels, and then attach them with blue cords to the bottom edges of your clothes.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa ni Kora, "Do' muyuh ninger, O lun Liwi.
english: Then Moses/I spoke again to Korah. He/I said, “You men who are descendants of Levi, listen to me!

lun_bawang: Idi Musa nengecuk seburur nawar ni Datan idi Abiram anak-anak Eliab ineh. Iamo' kebala didueh, "Na kai sikal amé'.
english: Then Moses/I summoned Dathan and Abiram, but they refused to come. They sent a message saying, “We will not come to you!

lun_bawang: Idi Musa pelaba useh. Idi kebalaneh inan Tuhan, "Aleg Iko ngalap luk baréndeh ineh, ngaceku sebuleng keladai pana' nateh luk ilapku rat nedeh. Idi sebururdeh pana' nateh luk piderehku.”
english: Then Moses/I became very angry. He/I said to Yahweh, “Do not accept the grain offerings that they have brought. I have not taken anything from them, not even one donkey, and I have never done anything wrong to them, so they have no reason to complain about me.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa ni Kora, "Do' iko idi 250 burur lun luk maya' namu, idi Arun amé' pa kiung Tuhan nebpa.
english: Then Moses/I said to Korah, “You and all those who are with you must come here tomorrow and stand in front of Yahweh. Aaron will also be here.

lun_bawang: "Do' medueh mado rat iring lun mula' ineh, pad Ui miak ngaté nedeh dengan segageh mo'.”
english: “Get away from all these people, in order that I can get rid of them immediately!”

lun_bawang: Idi didueh netekeradung, kesembayang didueh, "O Allah, Allah lawa amung ulun! Kudeng seburur mesala', miakké Iko museh kuan lun mula' ini?”
english: But Aaron and Moses/I prostrated themselves/ourselves on the ground. We pleaded with Yahweh, saying, “God, you are the one who caused all these people to live MTY. Only one of these men has sinned; so, ◄is it right for you to be angry with all the people?/it is not right for you to be angry with all the people!► RHQ”

lun_bawang: "Do' ngecuk nelun mula' ineh mado rat su luk inan Kora, Datan, idi Abiram.”
english: “Okay, but tell all the people to get away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh kuan lun mula' ineh, "Do' muyuh mado ratnan lepo lemulun luk dat ini. Aleg ngakem anun-anun binawehdeh pad muyuh na maté ngaceku sala'deh.”
english: He/I told the people, “Get away from the tents of these wicked men, and do not touch anything that belongs to them! If you touch anything, you will die because of their sins!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa, "Ratnan ineh muyuh miak kali' ui icuk Tuhan, pad ui nganau' amung kekamen ini, idi na ini maya' pianku sebuleng.
english: Then Moses/I said, “I was not the one who decided to do all these things that I have done. It was Yahweh who chose me and sent me to do them. And now he will prove that to you.

lun_bawang: Idi amung lun Israil luk libutdeh neburo ku aroddeh, kebaladeh, "Miket, pad tau pana' na mebpeh bang lubang ineh!”
english: They screamed as they fell, and all the people who were standing nearby heard them scream. The people were terrified and cried out as they ran away, saying, “We do not want the ground to swallow us also!”

lun_bawang: "Do' ngecuk ni Eliasar anak Arun luk imam ngalap amung luk inan ngeseb umau luk do' buen ineh rat arang butungdeh luk iseb ineh, idi ngisak bareh apui luk bang ineh, ngaceku amung ineh meligan.
english: “Tell Aaron’s son Eleazar to take the pans that had incense in them away from the fire and to scatter the burning coals. The pans that those men were carrying are ◄holy/dedicated to me► because they burned incense to me in them.

lun_bawang: Idi kenebpa amung lun Israil nuseh ni Musa idi Arun, kebaladeh, "Medueh pangeh nengaté sebuang pupu Tuhan.”
english: But the following morning, all the Israeli people started to complain against Aaron and Moses/me, saying “You have killed many people who belonged to Yahweh!”

lun_bawang: "Buro medueh rat arang lun Israil ini, ngaceku dengan segageh Ui miak ngaté nedeh." Idi didueh netekeradung.
english: “Get away from these people, in order that I can get rid of them immediately without injuring you two!” But Aaron and Moses/I prostrated themselves/ourselves on the ground and prayed.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa ni Arun, "Ngalap luk inanmu ngeseb umau luk do' buen ineh. Idi nganau' apui luk ratnan bubpun bang ineh idi nganau' umau luk do' buen luun apui ineh, idi nguit ineh miket amé' nelun Israil, idi nganau' luk nguit pedo' kuandeh. Ngaceku useh pangeh remuat ratnan Tuhan. Idi ét luk mebura' pana' pangeh nengimun.”
english: Moses/I said to Aaron, “Quickly take another pan and put in it some burning/hot coals from the altar. Put incense in the pan, and carry it out among the people to atone for the sins of the people. Yahweh is very angry with them, and I know that a ◄severe plague/bad sickness► has already started among them.”

lun_bawang: "Do' ngecuk nelun Israil maré sebuleng rukud rat anid-anid pupudeh, ieh ineh ratnan anid-anid lun rayehdeh luk pulu' dueh burur ineh. Idi ngayud ngadandeh nan rukuddeh.
english: “Tell the Israeli people to bring to you twelve walking sticks. They should bring one from each of the leaders of the twelve tribes. You should carve each leader’s name on his stick.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Do' ngelubed rukud Arun ineh amé' pa atun Pati' Pejani', pad mangun ku aceh tanu' kuan amung-amung lun luk sikal metueh, pad iko ngagka' durengdeh Negku, idi ideh na pitayen.”
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Put Aaron’s stick in front of the sacred chest, and let it stay there permanently. That will be a warning to people who want to rebel against me. Then no more people will die because of complaining against me.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun Israil ni Musa, "Kali' rungen amung-amung kai mabud maté.
english: Then the Israeli people said to Moses/me, “We are going to die! All of us are surely going to die!

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Arun, "Iko idi anak-anakmu idi amung lun bang tetek ruma'mu pana' mabeh sala' luk mangun bang Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan. Iko idi anak-anakmu pana' mabeh sala' luk mangun kareb muyuh nganau' kekamen imam.
english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You and your sons and the other members of your father’s family are the ones ◄who will be punished/whom I will punish► if anything bad happens to the things inside the Sacred Tent. But only you and your sons will be punished if the priests do something bad.

lun_bawang: Idi muyuh miak nganau' amung luk ruen bang Su luk Meligan idi ngasa' bubpun, pad usehKu na macing kuan lun Israil.
english: “You are the ones who will do the sacred work inside the Sacred Tent and at the altar. If you obey these instructions, I will not become very angry with the Israeli people again.

lun_bawang: "Amung umau, bua' anggur, idi padé luk meluun do', ieh ineh amung babpat luk meluun do' luk baréndeh kuanKu, barénKu nemuyuh.
english: “ am also giving to you the first food that people harvest each year and bring to me—the best olive oil and new wine and grain.

lun_bawang: "Amung-amung luk barén lun Israil kuan Allah, ieh ineh miak kuan muyuh.
english: “Everything in Israel that is set apart to belong to me also belongs to you.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Arun, "Na iko miak ngalap babpat tana' arangdeh idi sebuleng babpat anun-anun pana' nateh apenmu, ngaceku Ui ini luk babpatmu arang lun Israil.
english: Yahweh also said to Aaron, “You priests will not receive any of the land or the property like the other Israeli people will receive. I am what you will receive.

lun_bawang: "Idi kuan lun Liwi Ui pangeh nemaré amung babpat pulu' lun Israil ku babpatdeh, ku libal kekamendeh bang Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan.
english: “Then the Israeli people bring to me a tenth of all the crops and of their newborn animals, I will give that to you descendants of Levi. That will be your payment for the work you do at the Sacred Tent.

lun_bawang: Kareb muyuh pangeh nemaré luk meluun do' ratnan baré ineh, idi luk ketecan miak kuan muyuh lun Liwi mepad kudeng ula' padé luk rinik idi bua' anggur luk pirek.
english: “Also, tell this to the descendants of Levi: ‘When you present those best portions of grain and wine as your offering to me, I will consider that those gifts are as though they came from your own grain fields and vineyards.

lun_bawang: "Ngecuk nelun Israil nguit sebuleng sapi' tineh luk mesia' idi luk do', amé' namu, idi luk nateh nengeruid kayuh.
english: “I am now giving to you another regulation. Tell the Israeli people to bring to you one reddish-brown cow that has no defects. It must be an animal that ◄has never been/no one has ever► used for plowing ground.

lun_bawang: "Idé-idé luk ngakem butung lemulun, idi ieh mangun ku gani' tudu' aco kinioneh.
english: “All those who touch a corpse will be unacceptable to me for seven days.

lun_bawang: "Idi ini dalanneh kudeng aceh lun maté bang aceh lepo, idé-idé luk semuet bang lepo ineh, idi idé-idé luk bang ineh, ieh ineh mangun ku gani' tudu' aco kinioneh.
english: “There is another ritual that must be performed when someone dies inside a tent. All those who were inside that tent when that person died or who enter that tent will be unacceptable to me for seven days.

lun_bawang: Idi idé-idé luk ngakem lun luk pinaté, idi luk pangeh naté ku ét déi' liang, idi teh tulang butung lemulun, idi tanem, ieh ineh pana' mangun ku gani' tudu' aco kinioneh.
english: If someone who is out in a field touches the corpse of someone who was murdered, or who died from natural causes, or if someone touches a bone from some human or touches a grave, that person will be unacceptable to me for seven days.

lun_bawang: "Idi ideh luk ku gani' ineh, do' ideh ngalap abuh ratnan sapi' luk biré ngaceku sala' luk pangeh iseb ineh, idi ngutang abpa' metaro luun abuh ineh bang sebuleng kuden.
english: “For someone like that to become acceptable to me again, some of the ashes from the cow that was burned must be taken and put in a jar. Then some fresh water must be poured over the ashes.

lun_bawang: Idi anun-anun pana' luk kamen lun luk ku gani' ineh, ieh ineh mangun ku gani'. Idi idé-idé luk nengakem ineh teh, ieh pana' mangun ku gani' macing aco macep."
english: “If someone touches a thing or a person that has become unacceptable to me, that person will remain unacceptable to me until that evening.”

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh ni Musa, "Do' kudeng kai pangeh naté arang kinanak kai kareb ideh naté pa kiung Tuhan.
english: They complained and said, “We wish that we had died in front of Yahweh’s Sacred Tent when our fellow Israelis died!

lun_bawang: Idi Musa didueh Arun nengamung nelun mula' ineh iring batu ineh. Idi didueh nepebala nedeh, "O muyuh luk sikal metueh, do' ninger. Miakké kai dueh ngeruat abpa' kuan muyuh ratnan batu ini?”
english: Then Aaron and he/I summoned all the people to gather at the rock. Then Moses/I shouted to them, “All you rebellious people, listen! Is it necessary for us to give you water from this rock?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa idi Arun, "Medueh na miak nguit lun mula' ini semuet bang bawang luk pangeh biréKu nedeh, ngaceku medueh na manu Negku idi na nengerayeh liganKu pa kiung lun Israil.”
english: But Yahweh said to Aaron and Moses/me, “You did not believe that I could demonstrate my power to the Israeli people and give them water without your striking the rock. So you will not lead them into the land that I am giving to them!”

lun_bawang: Idi Musa nengecuk tuda'-tuda' lun duken amé' matun raca' Edom rat Kadis, idi kebaladeh neneh, 'Kebala kinanakmu lun Israil kudeng ini, "Iko kali' amung susa' luk pangeh nangun nekai,
english: While the people were at Kadesh town, Moses/I sent messengers to the king of Edom to tell him this: “Your relatives, the Israeli people, are sending you this message. You know the many troubles/hardships that have happened to us.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala lun Edom nedeh, "Muyuh na miak lemaba bawang kai, pad kai na ngaté nemuyuh.”
english: But the king of Edom refused. He replied, “Stay out of my country! If you try to enter it, I will send my army to attack you!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' lun Edom nengor baladeh, "Muyuh na miak lemaba bawang ini." Idi raca' Edom neremuat iné' matun nedeh dengan bawehneh luk mula'.
english: But the king replied, “No! Stay out of our country! We will not allow you to travel through our land!” Then he sent the strongest soldiers in his army to prevent the Israelis from entering his country.

lun_bawang: "Idi Arun miak maté', ngaceku na ieh miak semuet bang bawang luk pangeh biréKu kuan lun Israil. Ngaceku medueh pangeh nengelaba balaKu déi' Abpa' Meriba.
english: “It is time for Aaron to die EUP. He will not enter the land that I am giving to you Israelis, because the two of you disobeyed me when I told you to speak to the rock to cause the water to flow at Meribah.

lun_bawang: Idi lun Israil nepejani' inan Tuhan, kebaladeh, "Kudeng Tuhan maré pupu ini bang palad kai, idi kai miak ngusag amung bawangdeh.”
english: Then the Israelis solemnly vowed: “Yahweh, if you will help us to defeat these people, we will completely destroy all their towns.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh inan Allah idi ni Musa, "Ngudehké medueh nguit nekai remuat rat bang bawang Masir, pad kai maté tungé' su luk ali-ali ini. Ngaceku su ini ruti pana' na, abpa' pana' na. Idi kai mesukol ku akan luk dat ini.”
english: and they began to grumble/complain against God and against Moses/me. They said, “Why have you brought us out of Egypt to die here in this desert RHQ? There is nothing to eat here, and nothing to drink. And we detest this lousy manna food!”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh iné' matun ni Musa, kebaladeh, "Kai pangeh nenganau' sala' ngaceku ngedureng-ngedureng inan Tuhan idi namu teh. Do' sembayang mutuh Tuhan pad seruang ini buro rat nekai." Idi Musa nesembayang kuandeh.
english: Then the people came to Moses/me and cried out, saying, “We now know that we have sinned against Yahweh and against you. Pray to Yahweh, asking that he will take away the snakes!” So Moses/I prayed for the people.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Do' iko mudut aceh seruang ratnan tekaling. Nganau' neneh paped aceh kayuh luk mekadang. Idé-idé luk tinicuk, idi nier ineh, ieh miak mulun.”
english: Then Yahweh told him/me, “Make a model/image of a poisonous snake, and attach it to the top of a pole. If those who are bitten by the snakes look at that model, they will ◄recover/get well►.”

lun_bawang: Ini punneh pangeh bida' bang Surat Bunu' Tuhan, ratnan "Waheb déi' Supa idi Abpa' Arnon
english: That is why in the book called ‘The Book of the Wars of Yahweh’ it tells about “Waheb town in the Suphah area, and the ravines there; and the Arnon River

lun_bawang: Idi rat ieneh ideh nenalan iné' Bir, ieh ineh subuk luk inan Tuhan nepebala ni Musa, "Ngamung lun mula' ineh, idi Ui miak maré abpa' rupendeh.”
english: From there, the Israelis traveled to Beer. There was a well there, where Yahweh previously had said to Moses/me, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb ineh lun Israil menani kudeng ini: "Kemubul muyuh, O bued abpa'. Do' menani ngubur abpa' ineh!
english: There the Israelis sang this song: “O well, give us water! Sing about this well!

lun_bawang: "Nima' nekai lemaba bawangmu. Idi na kai umai luun lati' muyuh idi bang kabun anggur muyuh. Idi abpa' subuk muyuh na kai ngirup. Iamo' dalan rayeh luk bén kai, pad kai lemaba lakan tana'mu.”
english: “Allow us to travel through your country. We will stay on the king’s highway, the main road that goes from the south to the north, until we have finished traveling through your land. We will not walk through any field or vineyard, or drink water from your wells.”

lun_bawang: Idi ngaceku ineh buri' lun luk nganau' buek, "Do' tau amé' Hesbon, idi nier bawang Sihon luk pinudut baruh.
english: For that reason, one of the poets wrote long ago, “Come to Heshbon, the city where King Sihon ruled. We want the city to be restored/rebuilt.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Aleg iko matot neneh, ngaceku Ui maré neneh dengan anak itinneh idi bawangneh bang paladmu, idi iko miak nganau' kuanneh mepad kudeng luk inau'mu kuan Sihon, raca' lun Amori, luk tudo déi' Hesbon.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Do not be afraid of Og, because I am going to enable your men to defeat him and his army, and to take possession of all his land. You will do to him what you did to Sihon, the king of the Amor people-group, who ruled in Heshbon.”

lun_bawang: Kebala lun Moab kuan amung lun rayeh-rayeh déi' Midian, "Idi nekini pupu ini pian kuman amung luk pekelibut nekai, mepad kudeng sapi' luk kuman amung uduh luk mebata'i natad." Idi kareb ineh Balak Sipor raca' lun Moab,
english: So the king of Moab went to the leaders of the Midian people-group and said to them, “This huge group of Israelis will ◄wipe out/destroy► everything around them, like an ox devours grass!” Balak was the king of Moab.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Bilam nedeh, "Rudap muyuh malem sini ieni, pad ui miak mada' nemuyuh bala luk belén Tuhan negku." Idi lun rayeh Moab pana' nerudap déi' ruma' Bilam.
english: Balaam said, “Stay here tonight. Tomorrow morning I will tell you whatever Yahweh tells me that I should say to you.” So the leaders from Moab stayed there that night.

lun_bawang: Idi Allah iné' ni Bilam, kebalaNeh, "Idéké amung deléi luk denganmu?”
english: During the night, God appeared to Balaam and asked him, “◄Who are/Tell me about► these men who are staying with you.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Bilam inan Allah, "Balak Sipor, raca' Moab pangeh nengecuk lun dukenneh amé' matun negku. Idi kebaladeh negku,
english: Balaam replied, “Balak, the king of Moab, sent these men to tell me this:

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Allah ni Bilam, "Aleg iko amé' maya' nedeh. Aleg iko ngediman pupu ineh. Ngaceku ideh miak uen ngeperuan.”
english: God replied to Balaam, “Do not go with them! I have blessed those people, so you must not curse them!”

lun_bawang: Idi pekak uka-uka Bilam netumui, idi nepebala kuan lun rayeh Balak, "Lemubed muyuh amé' bawang muyuh, ngaceku Tuhan na maré negku maya' nemuyuh.”
english: The next morning, Balaam got up and told Balak’s men, “Go back home. But go by yourselves, because Yahweh is not allowing me to go with you.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala inul Gad idi inul Rubin ni Musa, "Kai miak nganau' maya' kudeng luk bilamu nekai.
english: Our wives and children and our cattle and sheep and goats will stay here in the cities in the Gilead area,

lun_bawang: Idi inul Gad idi inul Rubin nengor balaneh, "Kai miak nganau' maya' luk bila Tuhan nekai.
english: We will cross the river into Canaan land, and we will do what Yahweh desires and be prepared for battle. But our land will be here on the east side of the Jordan River.”

lun_bawang: "Do' mada' nelun Israil: Kareb muyuh pangeh neguta Abpa' Yarden idi semuet bang bawang Kanaan,
english: “Tell this to the Israeli people: When you cross the Jordan River and enter the Canaan region,

lun_bawang: "Do' mada' nelun Israil: Kareb muyuh semuet bang bawang Kanaan, do' ngeletep lakan tana' muyuh kudeng ini.
english: “Tell this to the Israeli people: You will soon enter Canaan land, and it will become yours. These will be the borders of the land:

lun_bawang: "Idi lakan muyuh pa acep aco ineh Abpa' Rayeh.
english: The border on the west will be the Mediterranean Sea.

lun_bawang: "Idi lakan muyuh pa tinueh busat aco, ieh ineh rat Abpa' Rayeh. Do' muyuh ngetu iringneh macing Pegkung Hor.
english: The border on the north will start from the Mediterranean Sea and extend east to Hor Mountain.

lun_bawang: "Idi do' muyuh ngetu lakan muyuh pa busat aco rat Hasar Enan macing Sepam.
english: The border on the east will start at Hazar-Enan and extend south to Shepham.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa nelun Israil, "Ini tana' luk ruen muyuh mabpat dengan nala' udi, idi luk pangeh bila Tuhan barénNeh kuan inul pupu luk liwa' setangal ineh.
english: So Moses/I told all that to the Israeli people. Then he/I said to them, “That is the land that you will receive. You must throw ◄lots/stones that have been marked► to decide which area will go to each of the nine and a half tribes, because Yahweh has commanded that it should be divided among them.

lun_bawang: "Idi ini ngadan amung lun luk mabpat tana' ineh kuan muyuh, ieh ineh Eliasar luk imam idi Yusak Nun.
english: “These are the men who will divide the land: First, Eleazar and Joshua.

lun_bawang: "Ngecuk nelun Israil maré tuda'-tuda' babpat bawangdeh kuan lun Liwi, dengan laman teh.
english: “Tell the Israeli people that from the land that they will receive, they must give to the descendants of Levi some cities in which they can live. They must also give them some land around these cities.

lun_bawang: Idi laman luk iko maré kuan lun Liwi ineh, ieh ineh rat anid lidung ar bawang 250 depeh.
english: “The land that you give them for their animals must extend out for ◄1,500 feet/450 meters► from the walls of the cities.

lun_bawang: "Idi rat arang amung bawang luk barén muyuh nelun Liwi, do' inan anem bawang luk inan sigapung, pad lemulun luk ngaté lemulun baken dengan rungen, miak buro amé' déi'. Idi baken ratnan ineh do' muyuh maré apat ngepulu' dueh bawang baruh teh.
english: “Six of the cities that you give to the descendants of Levi will be cities to which people can run to be safe. If someone accidentally kills someone else, the one who killed that person may run to one of those cities to be safe.

lun_bawang: "Do' mada' nelun Israil: Kareb muyuh pangeh guta Abpa' Yarden macing bawang Kanaan,
english: “Tell this to the Israeli people: When you cross the Jordan River and enter the Canaan region,

lun_bawang: -18"Kudeng aceh lemulun maper aceh lun ku belawan, batu kian kayuh lek, pad ieh maté, idi ieh ineh selemulun luk ngaté dengan rungen. Na miak na ieh pitayen.
english: “But you must consider that anyone who kills another person with an iron weapon or with a big rock or with a piece of wood, is a murderer, and the one who killed the other person must be executed.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' kudeng inan lemulun naté netarad lun baken dengan na inau' rungen, kian nebitungneh ku anun-anun dengan na inau' rungen,
english: the people of that city must decide whether the relative of the dead person has the right to get revenge, or whether the one who killed the other person truly did it ◄accidentally/without planning to do it►.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kudeng lun luk nengaté ineh remuat rat bang bawang luk inanneh sigapung,
english: The killer must stay in that city where he will be safe/protected until the Supreme Priest dies. He will be safe from revenge after that, because the death of the Supreme Priest will be considered to be a sacrifice to atone for that murder. After that, the killer may return to his home.

lun_bawang: Idi ini aceh ukum kuan muyuh macing ku anak inul muyuh bang anid-anid bawang muyuh.
english: “If there is a murderer who truly should be executed, do not spare his life by accepting ◄a ransom/money for him not to be killed►. He must be executed.

lun_bawang: "Anid-anid lemulun luk ngaté lemulun, do' ieh pitayen maya' bala lun luk nekali'. Iamo' kudeng seburur lun luk nekali' mo', na ieh miak pitayen.
english: “If someone has run to a city where he will be safe/protected, do not allow him to give you money in order that you will permit him to return to his home before the Supreme Priest dies.

lun_bawang: Idi aleg muyuh ngalap usin luk ku nguli' nelun luk nengaté ineh. Iamo' do' ieh pitayen.
english: “You must execute people who truly murder others. If you did not do that, you would be causing the people who live in the land to become unacceptable to me. Anyone who deliberately kills an innocent person must be executed.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ineh teh aleg muyuh ngalap usin luk ku nguli' lemulun luk pangeh neburo iné' bang bawang luk inan sigapung, pad ieh miak muli' amé' bang bawangneh sebuleng kareb nateh Imam Rayeh maté,
english: I am Yahweh, and I live among you Israelis, so do not spoil/pollute the land by allowing people to murder others without being punished.”

lun_bawang: "Tuhan nengecuk namu mabpat tana' ineh kuan lun Israil ku babpatdeh dengan nala' udi. Idi teh Tuhan nengecuk namu maré babpat Selopehad luk kinanak kai kuan anak-anakneh luk decur.
english: They said to Moses/me, “Yahweh commanded you, our leader, to apportion the land to the Israeli tribes by throwing ◄lots/stones that have been marked► to decide which group would get which area. Yahweh also commanded you to give the land that belonged to our fellow Israeli Zelophehad to his daughters.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa nelun Israil, maya' ecuk Tuhan, "Matu bala inul Manasé ini.
english: Yahweh told Moses/me what to reply to them, so Moses/I said this to them: “These men from the tribe of Manasseh are right.

lun_bawang: "Idi Tuhan Allah tau pangeh nepebala netau déi' Sinai, kebalaNeh, 'Petap io muyuh tudo luun pegkung ini.
english: “Yahweh our God said to us when we were at Sinai Mountain, ‘You have stayed for a very long time at the bottom of this mountain.

lun_bawang: Kebala Musa, "Kareb ineh ui nepebala nemuyuh, 'Ui sebuleng na miak mabeh nemuyuh.
english: Moses/I also said to the people, “When we were still at Sinai Mountain, I told your ancestors ‘It is a very big burden/responsibility for me to govern all of you. So I cannot do it by myself.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala muyuh, 'Matu bala mineh.'
english: Your ancestors replied, ‘What you have suggested is good for us to do.’

lun_bawang: "Idi ui neperiteteng nedeh, kebalaku, 'Do' muyuh ninger ratnan amung lawé kinanak muyuh idi mutut ukum luk muned arang seburur dengan kinanakneh, idi lun sakai pana'.
english: I instructed/told your leaders, ‘Listen to the disputes that occur among your people. Judge each dispute, including disputes between close relatives and quarrels between your people and people from other countries who live among you.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaku nemuyuh, 'Idi nekini muyuh pangeh nacing pegkung lun Amori luk pangeh biré Tuhan Allah tau kuan tau.
english: I said to your ancestors, ‘We have now come to the hilly area where the Amor people-group live. This is part of the area that Yahweh our God, the one whom our ancestors worshiped, is giving to us.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengalap bua'-bua' ratnan tana' ineh, idi nenguit kuan tau, kebaladeh, 'Idi do' tu tana' luk pangeh biré Tuhan Allah tau kuan tau.'
english: They picked some of the fruit that they found there and brought it to us. They reported that the land that Yahweh our God was giving to us is very good/fertile.”

lun_bawang: Idi muyuh dureng-dureng bang lepo muyuh, kebala muyuh, 'Ngaceku gatehNeh kuan tau idi Tuhan pangeh nenguit netau remuat rat bang bawang Masir, pian maré netau bang palad lun Amori, pad tau pederen.
english: Your ancestors stayed in their tents and complained saying ‘Yahweh hates us. So he has brought us here from Egypt just to allow the Amor people-group to destroy us.

lun_bawang: "Idi kebalaku nemuyuh, 'Aleg muyuh matot nedeh.
english: Then I said to your ancestors, ‘Do not be afraid ◄at all/even a little bit► DOU of those people!

lun_bawang: 'Seburur pana' rat arang pupu luk dat ini nateh miak nier tana' luk do' luk pangeh pijani'Ku kuan tepun-tepun muyuh.
english: But because of what your ancestors did, Yahweh was also angry with me. He said to me, ‘You also will not enter that land.

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan museh negku ngaceku muyuh. Idi kebalaNeh, 'Iko pana' na miak semuet bang bawang ineh.
english: Then Yahweh said to all of us, ‘You said that your children would be captured by your enemies. Because they are very young, they do not yet know what is good and what is evil. But they are the ones to whom I will give that land, and they will enter it and occupy it.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' kebala Tuhan negku, 'Do' mada' nedeh, Aleg muyuh amé' idi aleg pebunu', ngaceku Ui na idi arang muyuh, pad muyuh na uen amung bunu' muyuh ngelaya'.'
english: Then the men of the Amor people-group who lived in that region came out of their towns and attacked those soldiers. They pursued your ancestors’ soldiers like a swarm of bees pursues people, and they pursued them south from the Edom area and defeated them at Hormah city.

lun_bawang: 'Pangeh petap lawé muyuh nengelibut pegkung ini. Do' muyuh lemubed amé' pa tinueh busat aco.
english: ‘You have been wandering around this hilly area for a long enough time. Now turn and travel toward the north.

lun_bawang: "Idi kebala Tuhan negku, 'Aleg muyuh nganau' luk inan lun Moab pebunu'. Ngaceku ratnan tana'deh sesuut pana' nateh barénKu nemuyuh, ngaceku bawang Ar pangeh biréKu kuan pupu Lut.' " ( 10Idi atun lun Emim tudo déi' Ar, ieh ineh aceh pupu luk rayeh, idi ideh medita' mepad kudeng pupu Enak ineh.
english: Yahweh said to me, ‘Do not bother/harass the people of Moab, and do not start to fight against them, because I am not going to give you any of their land. Do not forget that they are descendants of Abraham’s nephew Lot, and I have given to them Ar city, their capital, and the other areas in that country.’ ”

lun_bawang: "Idi tau amung neguta Arur Sered ineh, maya' kudeng luk icuk Tuhan netau.
english: I also said to the Israeli people, “Then we crossed the Zered Gorge, as Yahweh told us to do.

lun_bawang: 'Aco sini do' muyuh nalan lemaba lakan Moab déi' bawang Ar.
english: ‘Today you all must cross the border into the Moab region, near Ar, their capital city.

lun_bawang: "Idi kebala Tuhan, 'Do' muyuh nalan idi guta Arur Arnon. Ui pangeh nemaré Sihon, raca' Hesbon, lun Amori ineh dengan bawangneh bang palad muyuh. Do' muyuh pebunu' nedeh, idi ngalap bawangdeh.
english: “After we had gone through the Moab region, Yahweh said to us, ‘Now cross the Arnon River. I will help you to defeat IDM the army of Sihon, the king of the Amor people-group, who lives in Heshbon city. So attack their army and start to take their land from them.

lun_bawang: 'Maré nekai lemaba bawangmu. Kai sikal maya' dalan rayeh. Na kai umai ratnan dalan.
english: ‘Please allow us to travel through your land. We promise that we will stay on the road; we will not turn off to the right or to the left.

lun_bawang: "Idi kebala Tuhan negku, 'Ui pangeh nengimun maré ni Sihon perapu bawangneh kuan muyuh. Do' muyuh ngimun ngalap bawangneh, mangun ku babpat muyuh.'
english: Yahweh said to me, ‘Listen! I am about to allow you to defeat Sihon’s army and to take the people’s land from them. So start to occupy it!’

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Tuhan negku, 'Aleg iko matot neneh, ngaceku Ui pangeh nemaré neneh bang paladmu perapu amung anak itinneh, idi amung bawangneh teh. Idi do' iko ngaté neneh mepad kudeng iko nengaté ni Sihon, raca' lun Amori, luk tudo déi' Hesbon.'
english: Yahweh said to me, ‘Do not be afraid of him, because I will enable your army to defeat MTY him and all his army and to capture all their land. Do to him what you did to Sihon, the king of the Amor people-group, who ruled in Heshbon city.’

lun_bawang: "Idi kareb ineh teh kebalaku nedeh kudeng ini, 'Tuhan Allah tau pangeh nemaré tana' ini luk pa busat aco Abpa' Yarden mangun ku babpat muyuh. Ngaceku ineh do' amung lun luk mesangit rat arang muyuh guta pa atun amung kinanak muyuh lun Israil.
english: At that time, I told you three tribes, ‘Yahweh our God is giving you this land east of the Jordan River, for you to occupy/capture. So now, give your soldiers weapons, and send them across the Jordan River ahead of the men from the other Israeli tribes to help them to conquer/capture the land that has been allotted to them.

lun_bawang: "Idi kareb ineh kebalaku ni Yusak, 'Muyuh pangeh nenier amung luk inau' Tuhan Allah muyuh kuan dueh burur raca' ini. Idi kudeng ineh teh luk miak ruen Tuhan kuan amung bawang, su luk ulek muyuh.
english: And I told Joshua, ‘You SYN have seen everything that Yahweh our God did to those two kings, Sihon and Og. He will do the same thing to the people who are now in the land that you will be entering.

lun_bawang: 'O Tuhan Allah, Iko nengimun nicul kuanku kekamenMu luk rayeh idi luk melalud. Na luk idi allah baken bang langit idi bang tana' ini luk miak nganau' mepad kudeng luk inau'Mu.
english: ‘Yahweh our Lord, you have merely begun to show me that you are very great and to show me the powerful things that you can do MTY. There is certainly no RHQ god in heaven or on earth who can do the powerful things/deeds that you have done.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' Tuhan museh negku ngaceku muyuh. Idi na Ieh nengua' putuhku. Iamo' kebala Tuhan negku, 'Petap! Aleg iko mutuh baruh.
english: But Yahweh was angry with me because of what your ancestors had made me do, so he would not pay attention to me. Instead, he said, ‘That is enough talk from you! Do not talk to me about that again!

lun_bawang: Idi do' muyuh lutep maya' ukum ineh, ngaceku ieh ineh mangun ku ileh muyuh, pa kiung amung pupu. Kareb ideh ninger amung ukum ini, idi ideh miak pebala, 'Pupu luk rayeh ini, ieh ineh aceh pupu luk mileh idi luk do' kali.'
english: Obey them faithfully because, if you do that, you will show the people of other nations that you are very wise. When they hear about all these laws, they will say, ‘The people of this great nation of Israel are certainly very wise DOU!’

lun_bawang: Idi Musa nengamung amung lun Israil, idi kebalaneh nedeh, "Ninger muyuh, O lun Israil, amung bada' ratnan ukum luk belénku nemuyuh aco sini. Idi do' muyuh nginita amung ineh idi maya' ineh.
english: Moses/I summoned all the people of Israel and said to them, “You Israeli people, listen to all the rules and regulations that I am giving to you today. Learn them and be sure to obey them.

lun_bawang: 'Ui ini Tuhan Allahmu luk pangeh nenguyut namu remuat rat bang bawang Masir, rat su luk inanmu tiban ineh.
english: ‘I am Yahweh your God, the one you worship. I am the one who brought you out of the land of Egypt. I am the one who freed you from being slaves there.

lun_bawang: " 'Aleg iko maya' allah baken rat Negku.
english: You must worship only me; you must not worship any other god.

lun_bawang: " 'Aleg iko nganau' akang maya' ayu anun-anun luk déi' langit, idi luk bang tana', idi luk bang abpa' pana'.
english: You must not carve/make for yourselves any idol that represents anything in the sky or anything that is on the ground or anything that swims in the water.

lun_bawang: " 'Aleg iko neten ngadan Tuhan Allahmu mo'-mo'. Ngaceku Ui miak ngukum idé'-idé' luk neten ngadanKu mo'-mo'.
english: Do not use/speak my name carelessly (OR, for wrong/evil purposes), because I am Yahweh God, the one whom you should worship, and I will certainly punish those who use/speak my name for wrong/evil purposes LIT.

lun_bawang: " 'Do' iko nginita Aco luk inan Mudeng, pad iko ngeligan ineh, maya' kudeng bala Tuhan Allah namu.
english: Do not forget that the seventh day of every week is mine. Dedicate those days to me just like I, Yahweh your God, am commanding you.

lun_bawang: " 'Do' ngedita' tamanmu idi tinanmu, maya' kudeng luk icuk Tuhan Allahmu namu' pad ulunmu mekadang, idi iko do' udeng bang bawang luk biré Tuhan Allahmu namu.
english: Honor/Respect your fathers and your mothers, just like I, Yahweh your God, am commanding you, in order that you may live a long time in the land that I, Yahweh your God, will give you, and in order that things will go well for you there.

lun_bawang: " 'Aleg iko pasét.
english: Do not ◄commit adultery/have sex with anyone other than your spouse►.

lun_bawang: " 'Aleg iko ngadu' nelun denganmu dengan mebalih.
english: Do not tell lies about anyone when you are speaking in a court.

lun_bawang: " ' Aleg iko melili ku awan lun denganmu. Aleg iko melili ku ruma'neh, tana'neh, lun tebarinneh, sapi'neh, keladaineh, idi binawehneh luk baken.'
english: Do not ◄covet/desire to have► someone else’s wife, someone else’s house, someone else’s fields, someone else’s male slave or female slave, someone else’s livestock, someone else’s donkeys, or anything else that another person owns.’

lun_bawang: Do' iko amé' ngecuk nedeh muli' amé' lepodeh.
english: So go down and tell them to return to their tents.

lun_bawang: "Idi kali' rungen anak muyuh ngitun nemuyuh muci, kebaladeh, 'Ngudehké Tuhan Allah tau nengecuk nemuyuh maya' amung ukum ini?'
english: “In the future, when your children ask you, ‘Why did Yahweh our God command us to obey all these rules and regulations?’

lun_bawang: Do' muyuh mada' kuan anak muyuh ineh, 'Idi atun kai ini lun duken raca' Masir. Iamo' tau inuit Tuhan remuat rat bang bawang Masir ineh ku laludNeh luk rayeh.
english: tell them, ‘Our ancestors were slaves of the king in Egypt, but Yahweh brought them out of Egypt by his great power MTY.

lun_bawang: "Aleg pebala bang niat muyuh, 'Pupu ineh meluun ula' rat netau ini, kudeng apeh tau ngusu nedeh?'
english: “Do not think to yourselves, ‘These people-groups are more numerous/powerful than we are, so we certainly cannot RHQ expel them.’

lun_bawang: Idi aleg muyuh ngerawé, 'Idi dengan lalud idi tueh kai sebuleng kai pangeh nengalap amung binaweh ini.'
english: Be sure that you do not think to yourselves, ‘I have acquired all these things by my own power MTY and ability.’

lun_bawang: Pupu ineh lun luk medita' idi rayeh burur. Idi muyuh pangeh neninger bala rat nedeh kudeng ini, seburur pana' nateh luk miak metueh rat nedeh.
english: Those people are very tall and strong. Some of them are giants who are descendants of Anak. You know about them, and you have heard people say that no one RHQ can defeat the descendants of Anak.

lun_bawang: "Idi teh kebala Tuhan negku, 'Ui kali' pupu ini aceh pupu luk metueh niat.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, ‘I have been watching these people, and I see that they are very stubborn.

lun_bawang: Idi kareb Tuhan nengecuk nemuyuh nalan rat Kadis Barnia, pad ngalap tana' luk barénNeh nemuyuh, idi muyuh metueh niat idi na maya' bala Tuhan Allah muyuh. Na muyuh manu Neneh.
english: And when we were at Kadesh-Barnea, Yahweh said to your ancestors, ‘Go up and capture the land that I am about to give to you!’ But they rebelled against him. They did not trust him, and they did not obey what he told MTY them to do.

lun_bawang: Kesembayangku, 'Tuhan Allah, aleg ngaté pupuMu idi babpatMu, luk pangeh inuli' ngaceku rayehMu, luk pangeh inuitMu remuat rat bang bawang Masir ku laludMu sebuleng.
english: And I prayed to Yahweh, saying, ‘Lord God, these people belong to you; do not destroy them. They are people whom you rescued and brought out of Egypt by your very great power. DOU, MTY

lun_bawang: "Idi kebala Tuhan negku, 'Do' iko ngabang dueh balad batu, mepad kudeng luk atun ineh, idi uké amé' luun pegkung matun Negku. Idi do' iko mudut aceh pati' ratnan kayuh.
english: “Then Yahweh said to me, ‘Cut two stone tablets like the first ones. And make a wooden chest to put them in. Then bring the tablets up to me on this mountain.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan negku, 'Do' iko lemubed idi nguyut pupu ineh, pad ideh miak semuet idi ngalap tana' luk pangeh pijani'Ku kuan tepundeh.'
english: Then Yahweh said to me, ‘Continue your journey, going in front of the people, to occupy the land that I vowed your ancestors that I would give to you.’”

lun_bawang: "Kareb Tuhan Allah muyuh pangeh nengiuk lakan bawang muyuh maya' kudeng luk pijani'Neh nemuyuh, idi muyuh miak kuman uang pung maya' pian niat muyuh.
english: “When Yahweh our God gives you much more land than you will have when you first occupy it, which is what he has promised to do, and you say ‘I would like some meat to eat’ because you are craving/wanting some meat, you will be permitted to eat meat whenever you want to.

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh pangeh linaya' Tuhan, matar do'-do', idi na maya' lawé sembayangdeh, pad muyuh na meraruh idi aleg ngitun ratnan lawé sembayangdeh, pad muyuh na nginud lawé ineh.
english: After he does that, be sure that you do not worship the gods that they have been worshiping, because if you do that, you will be caught in the same trap that they were caught in MET. Do not ask anyone about those gods, saying, ‘Tell me how they worshiped their gods, in order that I can worship them also.’

lun_bawang: pad ngubuk nemuyuh sembayang nan allah baken luk na inan muyuh nepekalai, sagan tu pana' luk pijani'neh ineh mangun,
english: They will say those things in order to induce/persuade you to worship gods that you have never known about before. But even if what they predict happens,

lun_bawang: ratnan lun luk dat luk remuat rat arang muyuh, idi ideh nengubuk amung lun bawang ineh, kebaladeh, 'Amé' tau sembayang inan allah baken,' luk inan muyuh na nepekalai,
english: that some worthless people there among you IDM are deceiving the people of their town, saying, ‘Let’s go and worship other gods,’ but they are gods that you have never heard about before.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' kudeng demulunmu pebala namu kudeng ini, 'Na ui sikal mepuit rat namu,' ngaceku ieh mawa namu idi muang uang tetek ruma'mu pana', idi do' udengneh tudo denganmu,
english: If he says that, take him to the door of your house and, while he stands against the doorway, pierce one of his earlobes with ◄an awl/a sharp pointed tool►. That will indicate that he will be your slave for the rest of his life. Do the same thing to any female slave who does not want to leave you.

lun_bawang: "Idi kareb muyuh semuet bang bawang luk barén Tuhan Allah nemuyuh, idi tebawang su ineh, idi muyuh sikal ngikit aceh raca' pa luun muyuh, mepad kudeng amung pupu luk tudo libut-libut muyuh;
english: “I know that after you have occupied the land that Yahweh our God is giving to you, and you are living there, you will say, ‘We should have a king to rule over us, like the kings that other nations around us have.’

lun_bawang: Idi raca' ineh na miak ngalap mula' kuda kuan bawehneh, idi na ieh miak ngecuk nelun dukenneh amé' bawang Masir pad ngalap mula' kuda. Ngaceku Tuhan mebpeng pupuNeh na miak amé' déi'.
english: After he becomes the king, he should not acquire a large number of horses for himself. He should not send people to Egypt to buy horses for him, because Yahweh said to you, ‘Never return to Egypt for anything’!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan negku, 'Matu baladeh ineh.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, ‘What they have said is true/wise.

lun_bawang: "Kian muyuh ngerawé lek, mikat kali' bala nabi sapeh luk baken ratnan Tuhan.
english: But if you say to yourself, ‘How can we know if a message that someone tells us does not come from Yahweh?’

lun_bawang: kudeng ini balaneh, 'Do' muyuh ninger, O lun Israil! Aco sini muyuh temina' amé' pebunu'.Aleg muyuh metalang niat. Aleg muyuh matot. Aleg megegker. Idi aleg muyuh merapang.
english: He must say to them, ‘You Israeli men, listen to me! Today you are going to fight against your enemies. Do not be timid or afraid DOU or tremble or panic DOU,

lun_bawang: Idi teh do' lun rayeh pebunu' ineh petacu pebala kudeng ini, 'Idé-idé luk matot idi luk metalang niatneh, do' ieh lemubed muli' amé' i ruma'neh, pad niat kinanak-kinanakneh na mangun metalang mepad kudeng niatneh ineh.'
