english: “Then the officers must also say, ‘If anyone among you is afraid or timid RHQ, he should go home, in order that he does not cause his fellow soldiers to also stop being courageous.’

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh kudeng ini, 'Baken ticu' kai nengeruat dara' ini, idi mateh kai pana' nateh nenier.
english: and they must say, ‘We did not murder this person MTY, and we did not see who did it.

lun_bawang: idi do' ideh mala kuan lun rayeh bawang kudeng ini, 'Anak kai ini melalid idi dat teh, na ieh sikal ninger bala kai dueh. Idi ieh manga idi megéi' mabuk.'
english: Then the parents must say to the elders of that city, ‘This son of ours is stubborn and always rebelling against us. He will not pay attention to what we tell him MTY. He wastes a lot of money (OR, eats too much food) and gets drunk.’

lun_bawang: pad ieh ngadu' neneh idi ngedat neneh, kebalaneh, 'Ui pangeh nengalap decur ini ku awanku, idi baken ieh anak baruh,'
english: and he says false things about her, and claims that she was not a virgin when he married her.

lun_bawang: Idi do' taman anak adi' ineh mala kuan amung lun rayeh-rayeh kudeng ini, 'Ui pangeh nemaré anak ku kuan lun ini ku awanneh, idi ieh ara' neneh,
english: Then the father of the young woman must say to the elders, ‘I gave my daughter to this man to be his wife. But now he says that he doesn’t want her any more.

lun_bawang: Idi do' lun rayeh bawang ineh nawar neneh, idi pelaba neneh. Kudeng balaneh lutep, 'Ui na sikal ngalap neneh,'
english: Then the elders must summon that man and talk to him. If he still refuses to marry that widow,

lun_bawang: Idi do' neten ngadanneh arang lun Israil, 'Ruma' lun luk lingu kasut.'
english: After that happens, that man’s family will be known as ‘the family of the man whose sandal was pulled off’.

lun_bawang: Idi do' iko amé' matun imam luk ngimet bang kareb ineh. Idi iko miak pebala neneh, 'Bang aco sini ui ngamo dengan megala' pa kiung Tuhan Allahku, ngaceku ui pangeh nacing bang bawang luk pangeh pijani' Tuhan kuan tepun kai.'
english: Go to the Supreme Priest who is serving at that time and say to him, ‘By giving you this first part of my harvest today, I am declaring to Yahweh our God that I have picked it in the land that he vowed to our ancestors to give to us.’

lun_bawang: Idi do' pebala pa kiung Tuhan Allahmu, 'Tamanku aceh lun Arami luk nepura', idi ieh iné' déi' Masir, idi tudo déi' mepad kudeng lun sakai. Idi teh ideh pawa'. Idi su ineh ieh pana' mangun ku aceh pupu luk rayeh idi pelaba ula'.
english: Then in Yahweh’s presence you must say this: ‘My ancestor Jacob was a man from Aram/Syria who was continually wandering from one place to another. He took his family to Egypt. They were a small group when they went there, but they lived there and their descendants became a very large/populous DOU and powerful nation.

lun_bawang: Idi Musa idi amung lun rayeh Israil nengecuk nelun mula' kudeng ini, "Do' muyuh nginita amung ukum luk bida'ku nemuyuh aco sini.
english: Moses/I, along with the other Israeli leaders, said this to the people: “Obey all the commandments that I am giving to you today.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa idi imam-imam lun Liwi ineh kuan amung lun Israil, "Do' pirud idi ninger, O lun Israil. Bang aco sini teh muyuh pangeh mangun ku pupu Tuhan Allah muyuh.
english: On that same day Moses/I said to the Israeli people,

lun_bawang: "Kareb muyuh pangeh neguta Abpa' Yarden, do' amung pupu ini tuped luun Surud Gerisim pad maré peruan kuan lun mula' ineh, ieh ineh Simion, Liwi, Yahuda, Iskar, Yusup, idi Beniamin.
english: The descendants of Levi must shout these words loudly:

lun_bawang: idi kareb ieh ninger bala pejani' ini, idi ieh ngawang niatneh, kebalaneh, 'Ui miak uen ngulun, sagan tu pana' ui maya' pinian bururku luk dat idi dengan abukku ui pian ngato paring.'
english: “Be sure that no one here today who hears this agreement thinks, ‘Everything will go well with me, even if I stubbornly do what I want to.’ If you are stubborn like that, the result will be that Yahweh will eventually get rid of all of you, both good people and evil people MET.

lun_bawang: Idi amung pupu miak ngitun, 'Ngudehké Tuhan pangeh nenganau' kudeng ineh kuan bawang ini? Anunké punneh Ieh pelaba useh?'
english: And the people from those other nations will ask, ‘Why did Yahweh do this to this land? Why was he very angry with the people who lived here?’

lun_bawang: Idi ideh miak ngor, 'Ngaceku ideh pangeh nengelaba pejani' Tuhan Allah tepundeh, luk pangeh inau'Neh kuandeh, kareb Ieh nenguit nedeh remuat rat bang bawang Masir.
english: “Then other people will reply, ‘It is because they refused to keep the agreement that Yahweh, the God whom their ancestors worshiped, had made with them when he brought them out of Egypt.

lun_bawang: Baken ieh bang langit pad lemulun miak ngitun, 'Idéké miak umak langit ngaceku tau, idi miak nguit ukum ineh amé' netau, pad ieh kali' tau, idi pad tau miak maya' ineh?'
english: They are not in heaven, with the result that you need to say, ‘◄Who will need to go up to heaven for us to bring them down here to us in order that we can hear them and obey them?/Someone will need to go up to heaven for us to bring them down here to us in order that we can hear them and obey them.►’ RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi teh baken ieh déi' dipar abpa' rayeh, pad lun pebala, 'Idé miak guta abpa' rayeh ngaceku tau, idi miak nguit ukum ineh amé' netau pad ieh kali' tau, idi pad tau miak maya' ineh?'
english: And they are not on the other side of the sea, with the result that you need to say, ‘◄Who will need to cross the sea for us and bring them back to us, in order that we can hear them and obey them?/Someone will need to cross the sea for us and bring them back to us, in order that we can hear them and obey them.►’ RHQ

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh nedeh, "Nekini ulunku meratu dueh ngepulu' lak. Na ui miak ngimet nemuyuh, ngaceku bala Tuhan negku, 'Na iko miak guta Abpa' Yarden ini.'
english: he/I said to them, “Now I am 120 years old. I am no longer able to go everywhere that you go (OR, to be your leader). Furthermore, Yahweh has told me that I will not cross the Jordan River.

lun_bawang: Idi Musa neperiteteng nedeh, kebalaneh, "Bang anid tudu' lak, kareb lak puit ineh, do' maca' Ukum ini kareb Aco Rayeh Lepo.
english: Moses/I told them, “At the end of every seven years, at the time that all debts are canceled, read this to the people during the Festival of Living in Temporary Shelters.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Musa, "Na mio teh iko maté. Nawar ni Yusak idi do' medueh tuped bang Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan, pad Ui ngeletep neneh." Idi Musa didueh Yusak iné' tuped bang Lepo ineh.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses/me, “Listen carefully. You will soon die. Summon Joshua, and you go to the Sacred Tent with him, in order that I may appoint him to be the new leader.” So Joshua and Moses/I went to the Sacred Tent.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh do' ngayud nani ini, idi mada' ineh kuan lun Israil, pad ineh mangun ku aceh bada' luk rat Negku kuandeh.
english: “So, I am going to give you a song. Write it on a scroll and teach it to the Israeli people and cause them to memorize it. It will be like a witness that accuses them.

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nengeletep ni Yusak Nun, kebalaNeh, "Do' iko metueh idi mekuu'. Ngaceku iko miak nguit nelun Israil semeut bang bawang luk pangeh pijani'Ku nedeh. Idi Ui pana' idi denganmu.”
english: Then Yahweh ◄appointed/set apart► Joshua and said to him, “Be brave and confident, because you will lead the Israeli people into the land that I vowed that I would give to them. And I will be with you.”

lun_bawang: "Lapen muyuh surat Ukum Allah ini, ngerareng ineh luun iring Pati' Pejani' Tuhan Allah muyuh, pelé rat su ineh, ieh ineh mangun ku aceh bada' kuan pupuNeh.
english: “Take this scroll on which these laws are written, and place it beside the Sacred Chest that contains the agreement that Yahweh our God made with you, in order that it may remain there to testify about what Yahweh will do to the people if they disobey him.

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, 'Ui mapen kiungKu rat nedeh, idi nier kudeng apeh kekipeddeh, ngaceku ideh aceh inul luk naluk idi na lutep.
english: He said, ‘They are very wicked/stubborn people, very unfaithful; so I will no longer help them, and then I will watch and see what happens to them.

lun_bawang: " 'Idi Ui ngamung dereh kuandeh, idi amung ilebKu ku ngelatik nedeh.
english: I will cause them to experience many disasters; they will feel as though MET I am shooting all my arrows at them.

lun_bawang: "Tuhan ngerawé ratnan luk inau' bunu'deh; Ieh nganét kareb luk petulu, pad Ieh miak ngukum nedeh.
english: “Yahweh says, ‘I know RHQ what I have planned to do to the Israeli people and to their enemies, and those plans are so secure that it as though he locked them up MET.

lun_bawang: Tuhan miak pebala nan pupuNeh, 'Iapehké allah-allah ineh idi batu luk inandeh merapet ineh,'
english: Then Yahweh will ask his people, ‘Where are the gods that you thought would protect you MET?

lun_bawang: " 'Ui ini sebuleng mo' luk Allah, idi na luk idi allah baken rat Negku. Ui ini luk ngaté idi luk ngulun, ngurat idi ngedo'. Seburur pana' nateh luk metueh rat Negku.
english: “But now you will realize that I, only I, am God; there is no other god who is a real god. I am the one who can kill people and who can cause people to live; I can wound people, and I can heal people, and there is no one who can prevent me from doing those things.

lun_bawang: idi kebalaneh nedeh, "Ngerawé muyuh do'-do' amung bala luk bida'ku nemuyuh aco sini, pelé muyuh ngecuk anak-anak muyuh nginita idi maya' amung bala Allah ini.
english: Moses/I said, “Never forget all these commands that I have been giving you today. Teach these laws to your children, in order that they will faithfully obey all of them.

lun_bawang: "Uké iko Pegkung Abarim, ieh ineh Pegkung Nebo, luk déi' tana' Moab, petutup ku Yeriko, idi nier tana' Kanaan luk barénKu kuan lun Israil.
english: “Go to the Abarim Mountain range here in the Moab region, across from Jericho. Climb Nebo Mountain, and look toward the west to see Canaan land, the land that I am about to give to the Israeli people.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh: "Tuhan nacing rat Pegkung Sinai, idi merasat rat Edom, Ieh nesilagan rat Pegkung Paran Ieh linibut pulu' ngeribu melaikat luk meligan, dengan apui mekilep pa tinuehNeh.
english: This is what he said: “Yahweh came and spoke to us at Sinai Mountain; he came like MET the sun rises in the Edom region and like his light shone on us when we were in the desert near Paran Mountain after we left Sinai Mountain. He came with 10,000 angels, and there was a flaming fire at his right side.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Musa ratnan inul Rubin: "Nima' Rubin mulun, idi na maté, saban tu pana' ideh pawa'.”
english: I say this about the tribe of Reuben: I desire/hope that their tribe will never disappear, but they will never become numerous.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ratnan inul Yahuda: "Ninger, O Tuhan, arod lun Yahuda, idi nguit nedeh perurum nan pupu Israil luk baken. Do' ticu' Tuhan ngedengan endeh, idi ngelaya' bunu'deh.”
english: “ say this about the tribe of Judah: Yahweh, listen to them when they call out for help; and unite them with the other tribes again. Fight for them, and help them to fight against their enemies.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ratnan inul Liwi: "O Tuhan, ngegala' pianMu kuan lun Liwi. Ideh ineh pupuMu luk lutep luk tinutunMu déi' Masa idi Meriba.
english: I say this about the tribe of Levi: Yahweh, give to those who are dedicated to you the sacred stones that they will use to find out what you want to be done; You tested them at a spring in the desert, a spring that they named Massah and also named Meribah to find out if they would ◄remain loyal to/continue to obey► you.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ratnan inul Beniamin "Tuhan mawa idi matar pupu ini, Allah ngelinged nedeh bang anid aco, pad ideh do' udeng.”
english: I say this about the tribe of Benjamin: They are the tribe that Yahweh loves; he keeps them safe. He protects them continually, and he lives among their hills MET.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ratnan inul Yusup: "Tuhan ngeperuan tana'deh dengan udan, idi bued abpa' rat pa liang tana'.
english: “ say this about the tribes of Joseph: I desire/hope that Yahweh will bless their land by giving them rain/dew from the sky and water from deep in the ground,

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ratnan inul Sebulon, idi Iskar: "Do' Sebulon uen ngeperuan kareb ieh pepua', idi do' Iskar uen ngeperuan bang leponeh.
english: “ say this about the tribes of Zebulun and Issachar: I desire/hope that the people of Zebulun will prosper in their travels across the seas, and that the people of Issachar will prosper while they stay at home and take care of their cattle and crops.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ratnan inul Gad: "Ngubur Allah luk ngula' tana' kuan Gad; ieh luku mepad kudeng balang luk rayeh idi ngerekem ticu' idi buduk uluh.
english: “ say this about the tribe of Gad: Praise Yahweh, the one who made their territory large. The people of their tribe will attack their enemies fiercely SIM like a lion that crouches, waiting to tear off the arm or the scalp of some animal.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ratnan inul Dan: "Idi Dan ineh balang luk pegawa', idi ieh pana' uput remuat rat Basan.”
english: “ say this about the tribe of Dan: The people of the tribe of Dan are like SIM a young lion; they leap from their caves in the Bashan region to attack their enemies.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ratnan inul Naptali: "Naptali mebor ku katu idi peruan Tuhan, idi babpatneh rat abpa' rayeh macing pa kabing busat aco.”
english: “ say this about the tribe of Naphtali: The people of the tribe of Naphtali have been blessed by Yahweh, who has been very kind to them; their land extends far south from Lake Galilee.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ratnan inul Aser: "Pelaba samal Aser rat arang pupu Israil. Nima' neneh inan amung kinanakneh mawa, idi nima' neneh ngerereb kukudneh bang umau saitun pana'.
english: “ say this about the tribe of Asher: May Yahweh bless the descendants of Asher more than he will bless the other tribes. May he favor Asher’s descendants most of all. I desire/hope that their land will be filled with olive trees that will produce a lot of IDM olives to make olive oil.

lun_bawang: O lun Israil na allah baken ratnan Allah muyuh, luk nalan déi' langit dengan rayehNeh, luk nalan luun laput pian ngedengan namu.
english: “You people of Israel, there is no god like your God, who rides majestically across the sky to help you.

lun_bawang: "DemulunKu Musa pangeh naté. Nekini do' iko gugkang idi nalan amé' guta Abpa' Yarden ineh dengan amung lun Israil, idi amé' bang bawang luk barénKu nemuyuh.
english: “You know that my servant Moses is now dead. So now get ready to lead all these Israeli people across the Jordan River. Enter the land that I will soon give to you.

lun_bawang: Do' iko metueh idi mekuu', ngaceku iko miak nguyut pupu ini ngalap tana' ini luk pangeh pijani'Ku kuan tepundeh.
english: “Be strong and courageous, because you are the one who will lead these Israeli people and enable them to possess the land that I solemnly promised to their ancestors that I would give them.

lun_bawang: "Amé' muyuh arang lepo muyuh ineh idi ngecuk nelun mula' ineh kudeng ini, 'Temina' nguit balu' muyuh. Kareb mabud teluh aco, idi amung muyuh miak guta Abpa' Yarden ini pad ngalap tana' luk biré Tuhan Allah muyuh ku babpat muyuh.' “
english: “Go throughout the camp and tell the people this: ‘Prepare all the food that you will take with you, because the day after tomorrow you will cross this Jordan River, in order to possess the land that Yahweh, our God, is about to give you.’ ”

lun_bawang: "Ngerawé muyuh bala luk biré Musa lun duken Tuhan ineh kuan muyuh, kebalaneh, 'Tuhan Allah muyuh maré tana' ini inan muyuh ucu'.'
english: “Do not forget what Moses, the servant of Yahweh, commanded you: ‘Yahweh, your God, has given you this land in order that you can live here safely/peacefully.’

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengor bala Yusak ineh, kebaladeh, "Amung luk icukmu nekai ineh pian kai maya', idi iapeh-iapeh pana' iko ngecuk nekai, kai pana' amé' teh.
english: The people answered Joshua, “We will do everything that you have commanded us to do, and we will go wherever you tell us to go.

lun_bawang: Idi Yusak nelulem ngecuk dueh burur rat Sitim amé' nier, kebalaneh, "Amé' medueh ngikak tana' ineh, idi bawang Yeriko." Idi didueh nesemuet bang ruma' seburur decur luk mesawa', ngadanneh Rahab, idi didueh netudo déi'.
english: Then Joshua chose two men from their camp at Acacia. He told them, “Go across the Jordan River and secretly find out all that you can about the land on that side of the river, especially about Jericho city.” So the two men crossed the river and entered Jericho. They entered the house of a prostitute, whose name was Rahab. They stayed in her house that night.

lun_bawang: Idi lun nemada' ni raca' Yeriko, kebaladeh, "Malem ini lun Israil nacing tungé' pian nier bawang ini.”
english: But someone saw them and told the king of Jericho, “Some Israeli men have come here tonight to spy out the land!”

lun_bawang: Idi raca' Yeriko nengacing bala ini ni Rahab, "Iten remuet lun luk pangeh nacing namu. Ngaceku ideh luk amé' tungé' ineh pian nier amung bawang.”
english: So the king sent some messengers to tell Rahab, “Bring out the men who came and entered your house, so that we can kill them, because they have come here to ◄spy out/find out all they can about► this land!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' decur ineh pangeh nengapung dueh deléi ineh. Idi kebalaneh, "Kali' rungen lun ineh pangeh nacing negku. Iamo' na ui kali' rat iapeh didueh.
english: She told them that the two men had gone to her house. But she had hidden the two men there. So when the messengers came to her house, she told them, “Two men came here, but I did not know where they had come from.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nedidueh ineh, "Ui kali' tana' ini pangeh biré Tuhan nemuyuh, idi kali' rungen amung kai matot nemuyuh.
english: and said to them, “We know that Yahweh is about to give this land to you Israelis, and as a result all the people living in this land are terrified because of you.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala didueh neneh, "Kai temina' maté kuanmu! Kudeng iko na mada' lawé kai dueh ini, kali' rungen kai maya' jani' kai kareb Tuhan maré bawang ini kuan kai.”
english: The two men replied, “We desire that God will cause us to die if we do not do as we say! If you do not tell others what we are planning to do, we will act kindly toward you all when Yahweh enables us to possess the land.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nedidueh, "Nalan medueh amé' nan pegkung, pelé medueh na mepapu' nelun luk ngerada' nemedueh. Idi do' sigapung déi' teluh aco kinioneh, pad lun luk iné' ngerada' ineh lemubed. Pangeh ineh miak medueh maya' dalan medueh pun di.”
english: Then she said to them, “When you leave the city, go up into the hills so that the men who are searching for you will not find you. Hide in caves in the hills for three days, until the men who are searching for you return to the city. Then you can return safely to your camp.”

lun_bawang: Kebala didueh ni Rahab, "Kai miak maya' jani' kai luk icukmu di.
english: The two men gave her a red cord, and said to her, “This is what you must do; if you do not do this, we will not be required to do what we have vowed to do.

lun_bawang: Kebala decur ineh, "Matu bala medueh ini. Do' kudeng ineh." Idi ieh nenima' nedidueh nalan, idi nuper luk mesia' ineh pana' inabetneh nan gisumenneh.
english: Rahab said, “I agree to do what you say.” So they climbed down the rope and left. And she left the red cord tied in the window.

lun_bawang: Kebala didueh ni Yusak, "Kali' rungen Tuhan pangeh nemaré amung tana' ini bang palad tau. Ngaceku niat amung lun bang bawang ineh megagau, ngaceku matot netau."
english: They said to Joshua, “We are sure that Yahweh is going to enable us to possess everything that is in that land. The people there are terrified IDM because of us.”

lun_bawang: idi nemada' nelun mula' ineh, kebaladeh, "Kareb muyuh nier Pati' Pejani' Tuhan Allah muyuh idi amung imam lun Liwi mirir ineh, do' muyuh nalan rat su inan muyuh idi pebaya' Pati' ineh,
english: telling the people, “You will see some of the priests, who are descendants of Levi, carrying the chest that contains the Ten Commandments that Yahweh our God gave us. When you see them, leave the places where you are camped and follow them.

lun_bawang: Kebala Yusak nelun mula' ineh, "Ngeligan burur muyuh, ngaceku pekak nebpa Tuhan pian nganau' kekamen luk rayeh arang muyuh.”
english: Then Joshua told the people, “Perform the ceremonies needed to make yourselves acceptable to Yahweh, because tomorrow he is going to do things for you that will amaze you!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusak nelun imam, "Kedingen muyuh Pati' Pejani' ineh, idi nalan pa atun lun mula'." Idi ideh nenganau' maya' kudeng luk bilaneh.
english: Then Joshua said to the priests, “Carry the chest and go in front of the rest of the people.” So they lifted up the chest and went ahead.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Yusak, "Aco sini Ui pian ngimun ngerayeh namu pa kiung amung lun Israil, pelé ideh kali', mepad kudeng Ui nengedengan ni Musa atun, kudeng ineh teh Ui ngedengan namu.
english: Then Yahweh said to Joshua, “This is the day that I will begin to show all the Israeli people that you are a great leader. Then they will honor you, and know that I am with/helping you as I ◄was with/helped► Moses.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusak nelun Israil, "Amé' amung muyuh ninger bala Tuhan, Allah muyuh.
english: Then Joshua said to the Israeli people, “Come close to me in order that you can listen to what Yahweh, your God, is saying.”

lun_bawang: Aco sini muyuh miak kali' Allah mulun arang muyuh. Idi Ieh miak ngusu amung lun Kanaani, lun Hiti, lun Hiwi, lun Prisi, lun Girgasi, lun Amori, idi lun Yebusi rat pa kiung muyuh.
english: When they came near, he said to them, “This is how you will know that God, who is all-powerful, is among you, and that he will expel for you the descendants of Canaan, Heth, Hiv, Periz, Girgash, Amor, and Jebus who are now living in that land.

lun_bawang: "Mili' pulu' dueh burur, seburur ratnan anid inul lun Israil,
english: “When you choose the twelve men, one from each tribe, whom I mentioned previously, tell them to pick up large stones from the middle of the Jordan riverbed, where the priests are still standing.

lun_bawang: "Ngecuk amung imam luk mirir Pati' Pejani' ineh umak rat bang Abpa' Yarden.”
english: “Now tell the priests who are carrying the chest containing the Ten Commandments to come up from the Jordan riverbed.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yusak nenganau' kudeng ineh.
english: So Joshua commanded the priests to do that.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nelun Israil, "Kareb anak muyuh ngitun tamandeh muci aco, 'Anunké ilungneh amung batu ini?'
english: Joshua said to the Israeli people, “In the future, when your children and grandchildren ask, ‘◄What do these stones mean/Why are these stones here►?’,

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Yusak, "Nganau' tuda'-tuda' iyu ratnan batu luk metueh idi nunat nelun Israil sekedueh kua'.”
english: While they were camped at Gilgal, Yahweh said to Joshua, “The Israeli males who lived in Egypt were circumcised before they left there. Now make knives from flint stones and circumcise all the Israeli males who have been born since then.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Yusak, 'Idi aco sini teh Ui nala' rat nemuyuh igu' ngaceku muyuh titen lun Masir 'demulun'." Idi ngaceku ineh su ineh pana' tetanen Gilgal macing aco sini.
english: Then Yahweh said to Joshua, “Because your forefathers were slaves in Egypt, the Egyptians felt a revulsion toward you. But today I have removed the revulsion the Egyptians have had toward you.” Because of that, the people called the place ‘Gilgal’, which sounds like the Hebrew word ‘removed’, and it still has that name.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh, "Baken; iamo' Ui ini Lun Rayeh Baweh Tuhan. Idi nekini Ui pangeh nacing." Idi Yusak pana' netekeradung idi sembayang Neneh, kesembayangneh, "Anunké bala Tuhan kuan lun dukenNeh?”
english: The man replied, “I am not planning to fight with you or against you. Instead, I am the commander of Yahweh’s army in heaven, and I have come down from there to assure you that Yahweh will help you.” Then Joshua bowed down with his face on the ground ◄to show his respect for/to worship► the man, and said to him, “Tell me what you want me to do.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Lun Rayeh Baweh Tuhan ni Yusak, "Neka kasut ratnan kukudmu. Ngaceku su luk inanmu tuped ineh meligan." Idi Yusak nenganau' kudeng ineh.
english: The commander of Yahweh’s army replied, “Take off your sandals! I am Yahweh, and the ground on which you are standing is holy because I am here.” So Joshua took off his sandals.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Yusak, "Kali' rungen Ui maré bawang Yeriko ini perapu ku raca'neh idi amung lun luk mesangit kuanmu.
english: Then Yahweh said to Joshua, “Listen to what I say! I am going to enable your army SYN to capture/conquer MTY Jericho and its king and its soldiers.

lun_bawang: Idi Yusak nenawar amung imam, kebalaneh nedeh, "Kedingen muyuh Pati' Pejani' ineh. Idi do' tudu' burur imam ngiup tudu' serupit luk ratnan unga dumba deléi, idi nalan pa atun Pati' Pejani' Tuhan.”
english: So Joshua summoned the priests and said to them, “Tell four priests to carry the chest that contains the Ten Commandments that Yahweh gave to us. Tell seven other priests to carry trumpets and walk in front of them.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nelun mula' ineh, "Do' muyuh nalan ngelibut bawang. Idi do' lun pebunu' nalan pa atun Pati Pejani' Tuhan.”
english: And Joshua told the soldiers, “Start marching! March around the city, with several soldiers with weapons marching in front. Behind them will march the seven priests with trumpets, and behind them will march the four priests carrying Yahweh’s sacred chest.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yusak nemebpeng nelun mula' na ngitang idi na meria', pad macing ieh ngecuk.
english: But the rest of the people were silent, because Joshua had commanded them, “Do not make a war cry. Do not yell or say anything until the day when I tell you to shout. On that day, you must shout loudly!”

lun_bawang: Idi luk ketudu' kua', amung imam nengiup serupitdeh. Idi Yusak nepebala nelun mula', "Ngitang muyuh, ngaceku bawang ineh barén Tuhan nemuyuh.
english: As they were marching around the seventh time, when the priests were about to blow the long/loud blast on their trumpets, Joshua commanded the people, “Shout, because Yahweh will enable you to capture the city!

lun_bawang: Kebala Yusak nedidueh luk iné nier bawang ineh, "Amé' medueh déi' ruma decur luk mesawa' ineh, idi nguit decur ineh rat déi', idi amung lun luk bang tetek ruma'neh, maya' kudeng jani' medueh neneh atun.”
english: Then Joshua said to the two men ◄who had spied on/whom he had sent to learn all they could about► the land, “Go to the prostitute’s house. Bring her out, along with all her family, just as you promised to her.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yusak nengecuk lun rat Yeriko amé' déi' Ai, luk muneng ku Bait Awen pa busat aco Baitel, pelé ideh nier bawang ineh. Idi ideh iné' nier bawang Ai.
english: Joshua told some of his men to go from Jericho to Ai town, which was east of Bethel city and near Beth-Aven town. He said to them, “Go to Ai and ◄spy out the area/see what the area is like►.” So the men went.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Yusak, "Mudur iko, anun ulekneh iko tekunal kudeng ini?
english: But Yahweh said to Joshua, “Stand up! Stop lying there with your face on the ground RHQ!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusak ni Akan, "O anakku, ngerayeh Tuhan Allah lun Israil, do' iko ngamo sala'mu Neneh, idi maré kali' negku anun luk pangeh inau'mu ineh. Aleg iko ngapung ineh negku.”
english: Then Joshua said to Achan, “Son, tell the truth IDM. Confess to Yahweh, the God whom we Israelis worship, what you have done. And tell me what you did, and do not try to ◄conceal anything/prevent me from knowing what you did►.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Akan, "Matu ui pangeh nenganau' sala' inan Tuhan Allah lun Israil. Idi kudeng ineh kudeng ini kekamenku.
english: Achan replied, “It is true. I have sinned against Yahweh, the God whom we Israelis worship.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusak, "Ngudehké iko ngacing dat kuan kai? Idi Tuhan ngedereh namu aco sini." Idi amung lun Israil nemitung ni Akan ku batu, idi nengeseb amung uang tetek ruma'neh, kareb ideh pangeh nemitung nedeh ku batu.
english: Joshua said, “◄I do not know why you caused so much trouble for us/You have caused a lot of trouble for us► RHQ, but now Yahweh will cause trouble for you.” Then all the people threw stones at Achan and his family until they all died. Then the people burned their corpses.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nenaped pa luundeh aceh perupun batu luk rayeh luk idi macing aco sini. Idi ngaceku ineh ideh neten su ineh Ruan Susa' macing aco sini. Idi Tuhan nugka' ratnan usehNeh.
english: They piled rocks over the ashes of their corpses, and those rocks are still there. That is why that valley is called Trouble Valley. After that, Yahweh was no longer angry with the Israeli people.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nemada' lawédeh, kebalaneh, "Do' muyuh ngabang bawang ineh rat pa keted. Aleg muyuh pelaba ado rat ku bawang ineh. Do' amung muyuh temina' kidi-kidi.
english: He said to them, “Listen carefully. Some of you must hide on the other side of the city. Do not go far from the city. Just be ready to attack.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Yusak, "Ngegenang gaman luk bang paladmu ineh pa bawang Ai. Ngaceku Ui maré bawang ineh kuanmu." Idi Yusak nengegenang gaman luk bang paladneh ineh pa bawang Ai.
english: Then Yahweh said to Joshua, “Lift up your spear and  point it toward Ai, because I am going to enable your soldiers to capture it!” So Joshua pointed his spear toward Ai.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh iné' papu' ni Yusak su luk inandeh nelupo déi' Gilgal. Kebaladeh neneh, idi nelun Israil teh, "Kai ini pangeh nacing rat bawang luk mado. Idi nekini do' muyuh nganau' jani' kuan kai.”
english: They traveled to where Joshua and the other Israelis had set up their tents near Gilgal. They said to Joshua and the other Israeli leaders, “We have traveled from a distant land. We want you to make a peace agreement with us.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun Israil, "Kian, muyuh tudo arang kai lek. Kudeng apeh kai nganau' jani' kuan muyuh?”
english: The Israeli leaders said to those men from Gilead who were from the Hiv people-group, “We do not know if you truly live far from us. If you live near us, we cannot RHQ make a peace agreement with you, because God has commanded us to get rid of the people that are living near us.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh ni Yusak, "Amung kai ini lun dukenmu." Idi kebala Yusak nedeh, "Idéké muyuh ini? Idi rat iapehké muyuh?”
english: They replied to Joshua, “If you make a peace agreement with us, we will be your servants.” But Joshua answered, “What people-group are you? Where do you come from?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh neneh, "Kai ini pangeh nacing rat bawang luk pelaba ado ngaceku kai pangeh neninger ratnan Tuhan Allah muyuh. Idi kai pangeh neninger bala ratnan amung luk pangeh inau'Neh bang bawang Masir,
english: The men from Gibeon answered, “We want to be your servants. We have come here from a distant land, because we have heard about the great things that your god has done. We have heard about everything that he did in Egypt to help you.

lun_bawang: Kebala amung lun rayeh kai idi amung lun bang bawang kai nekai, 'Ngalap balu' muyuh idi nalan. Amé' matun nedeh idi mada' nedeh, "Amung kai ini lun dukenmu. Ngaceku ineh nganau' kuan kai aceh pejani'." '
english: So our leaders and the rest of our people said to us, ‘Take some food and go to talk with the Israelis. Tell them, “We want to be your servants. So make a peace agreement with us.”’

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala lun rayeh ineh, "Tau pangeh nepejani' ku bulung dengan ngadan Tuhan Allah lun Israil. Ngaceku ineh nekini na tau miak mekuel nedeh.
english: But the leaders answered, “We promised to live peacefully with them, and Yahweh, the God whom we Israelis worship, heard us promise to do that. So now we cannot attack EUP them.

lun_bawang: Nima' nedeh mulun, pad ideh ngapak kayuh idi ngereb abpa' kuan tau." Idi kudeng ineh bala lun rayeh kuandeh.
english: So we must allow them to live. But they will cut wood for us, and they will carry water for us.” So the Israeli leaders did what they had promised.

lun_bawang: Idi Yusak nenawar nelun Gibion, kebalaneh, "Anun punneh muyuh nenaluk nekai, kebala muyuh, 'Kai nacing rat mado,' iamo' muyuh idi arang kai?
english: Then Joshua summoned the men from Gibeon and asked them, “Why did you lie to us? Your land was near to where we had set up our tents, but you told us that you were from a distant land!

lun_bawang: kebalaneh, "Amé' ngedengan negku pelé tau ngaro bawang Gibion, ngaceku pangeh ieh nepedo' ni Yusak idi amung lun Israil.”
english: In the message he said, “Please come up with your armies and help me to attack Gibeon, because the people of Gibeon have made a peace treaty with Joshua and the Israelis.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Yusak, "Aleg iko matot nedeh, ngaceku ideh pangeh biréKu namu. Idi seburur pana' nateh metueh rat namu.”
english: Then Yahweh said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of those armies! I will enable your army to defeat them IDM. None of them will be able to ◄resist/fight and defeat► your army.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yusak nepebala inan Tuhan kareb aco Tuhan nemaré amung lun Amori ineh kuan lun Israil. Ieh nemada' pedingeren amung lun Israil, kebalaneh, "O mateh aco, ugka' iko pa luun bawang Gibion, Idi iko, O bulan, pa luun Ruan Aijalon.”
english: On the day that Yahweh enabled the Israeli army to defeat the groups who were descendants of Amor, Joshua said to Yahweh while the Israeli people were listening, “Yahweh, cause the sun to stand still over Gibeon, and cause the moon to not move when it is over Aijalon Valley.”

lun_bawang: Idi lun nemaré kali' ni Yusak, ratnan ideh nesigapung.
english: Then someone told Joshua, “We found those five kings, hiding in a cave at Makkedah!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusak, "Ngelubid batu luk rayeh amé' bang lubang batu ineh. Idi ngecuk nelun ngabang munung ineh.
english: When Joshua heard that, he said, “Roll some very large rocks to the entrance of the cave so that the kings cannot escape, and leave some soldiers there to guard it.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusak, "Kabin muyuh kakeb lubang batu ineh idi ngeruat raca' luk limeh burur ineh rat bang lubang batu ineh, idi nguit nedeh amé' negku.”
english: Then Joshua said, “Open the entrance of the cave, and bring out to me those five kings!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusak nedeh, "Aleg muyuh mator idi megegker. Do' muyuh metueh idi mekuu'. Ngaceku kudeng ineh ayu kekamen Tuhan muci kuan amung bunu' muyuh.”
english: Then Joshua said to them, “Do not be afraid of any of our enemies! Never be discouraged! Be strong and courageous. This is what Yahweh will do to all the enemies you will fight!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Yusak, "Aleg iko matot nedeh, ngaceku pekak nebpa bang kareb luk kudeng ini Ui ngaté amungdeh ineh kuan lun Israil. Do' iko narad urat tumid amung kudadeh, idi ngeseb amung kerétadeh.”
english: Then Yahweh said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them, because at this time tomorrow I will enable your men to defeat them. Your men must also cripple their horses and burn their chariots.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yusak pana' mengered peh. Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Iko pangeh mengered, idi mula' teh tana' ketecan luk miak lapen.
english: When Joshua was very old, Yahweh said to him, “Joshua, you are now an old man, but there is still a lot of land for your army to capture.

lun_bawang: Idi ini tana' luk ketecan: amung tana' lun Pilistin, idi amung tana' Gesuri
english: Here is a list of the land that remains: The Geshur region and all the area where the Philistia people-group live;

lun_bawang: Idi Kaleb nepebala teh, "Tuhan pangeh nengulun negku maya' kudeng balaNeh. Idi nekini apat ngepulu' limeh lak rat kareb Tuhan nepebala kudeng ineh kuan Musa, kareb lun Israil lawé-lawé déi' su luk ali-ali. Idi nekini ulunku pangeh ualuh ngepulu' limeh lak.
english: So Joshua asked God to bless Caleb, and he gave to Caleb the city of Hebron.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Kaleb, "Ide luk munu' Kiriat Seper ineh, idi ngelaya' neneh, ui miak maré kuanneh Aksa, anakku, ku awanneh.”
english: Caleb said, “If someone attacks the people in Kiriath-Sepher and captures their city, I will give my daughter Acsah to him to be his wife.”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb decur ineh nacing neneh, idi ieh nengubuk ni Otniel pelé ieh iné' mutuh selalang tana' nan tamanneh. Idi ieh netemurun ratnan keladaineh. Idi Kaleb nengitun neneh, "Anun pianmu?”
english: When Caleb’s daughter married Othniel, she told him to ask her father to give her a field. Then Acsah went to talk with her father Caleb. As she got down from her donkey, Caleb asked her, “Do you want something?”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengor balaneh, "Maré kuanku aceh peruan, ngaceku iko nemaré kuanku tana' luk déi' Negeb. Idi teh maré kuanku tuda'-tuda' bued abpa'." Idi Kaleb nemaré kuanneh tuda'-tuda' bued abpa' luk déi' luun, idi luk déi' beneh.
english: Acsah replied, “Yes, I want you to do something for me. You have given me some land in the southern part of Canaan, but there is no water there. So please give me some land that has springs.” So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs near Hebron.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala inul Yusup ni Yusak, "Ngudehké iko maré sebuleng babpat mo' kuan kai. Iamo' kai ini mula' burur ngaceku peruan luk biré Tuhan kuan kai macing nekini?”
english: The people of the tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh said to Joshua, “You allotted to us only one area of land, but there are a lot of us. Yahweh has blessed us very much with the result that our tribe has grown very large. So why did you give us only a small part of the land RHQ?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusak kuan inul Epraim idi Manasé, "Kali' rungen muyuh aceh pupu luk mula' burur idi muyuh meluun tueh. Muyuh miak ngalap mela ratnan sebuleng babpat.
english: Joshua replied to them, “Your tribe is very numerous and very powerful. So I will allot more land for you in the hilly area,

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusak nelun Israil, "Tuda' ioké muyuh na iné' ngalap tana' ineh ku babpat muyuh luk pangeh biré Tuhan Allah tepun muyuh nemuyuh?
english: Choose three men from each of your seven tribes. Then I will send them to explore the parts of the land which you have not occupied yet. When they finish exploring it, they must write a report, in which they will ◄make a map/show the boundaries► of the land that each tribe wants to receive.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh iné' ngayud ayu tana' ineh, idi kebala Yusak nedeh, "Amé' muyuh nalan aput-aput tana' ineh idi ngayud ayuneh, idi lemubed amé' negku, pelé ui nala' udi ngaceku muyuh pa kiung Tuhan déi' Silo.”
english: So the men left and walked through the area. Then they described in a scroll each town that was in the seven parts into which they had divided the land. Then they returned to Joshua, who was still at Shiloh.

lun_bawang: "Mada' kuan lun Israil kudeng ini, "Ngeletep tuda'-tuda' bawang luk inan sigapung kuan muyuh, luk pangeh icukKu ni Musa mada' nemuyuh.
english: “Tell the Israeli people that they should choose some cities to which people can run in order to be safe/protected, like I told Moses that they should do.

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh nedeh déi' Silo bang bawang Kanaan, "Tuhan pangeh nepebala ni Musa. Ieh nengecuk maré bawang kuan kai inan tudo, idi laman kuan aya' kai pana'.”
english: So the Israeli leaders obeyed this command from Yahweh. They agreed to give towns and pasturelands to the tribe of Levi.

lun_bawang: kebalaneh nedeh, "Muyuh pangeh nenganau' amung luk bida' Musa demulun Tuhan ineh kuan muyuh. Idi muyuh pangeh nemaya' amung balaku.
english: He said to them, “You have done everything that Moses, who served Yahweh well, told you to do. You have also done what I told you to do.

lun_bawang: kebalaneh nedeh, "Muyuh muli' dengan mula' binaweh idi mula' aya', dengan amas, pirak, tekaling, idi belawan, idi dengan mula' ayung. Mabpat amung binaweh luk ilap ratnan bunu' muyuh ineh kuan kinanak-kinanak muyuh.”
english: He said, “Go back to your homes and to all the things that you have taken from your enemies—the many animals and silver and gold and things made of bronze and iron, and many beautiful clothes. But you should share some of those things with other people of your tribe.”

lun_bawang: "Kudeng ini bala amung pupu Tuhan, 'Ngudehké muyuh nenganau' kekamen luk dat ini idi nengedat Allah lun Israil. Idi nekini muyuh pangeh nelemubed ratnan Tuhan, idi nemudut aceh bubpun kuan muyuh, pad aco sini pana' muyuh pangeh mangun, ku bunu' Tuhan?
english: “All the other Israelis are asking, ‘Why have you rebelled against the God whom we Israelis worship by building an altar for yourselves?

lun_bawang: "Idi Allah luk Melalud. Ieh ineh Tuhan! Idi Allah luk Melalud. Ieh ineh Tuhan! Ieh meluun kali'. Idi do' Israil pana' kali' teh. Kudeng kai ini bunu' Tuhan idi ngelaba ukumNeh, do' muyuh na méi' nekai.
english: “Yahweh, the Almighty God, knows why we did that, and we want you to know, too. If we have done something wrong against Yahweh, you may kill us.

lun_bawang: Na, iamo' kai nenganau' ineh ngaceku matot anak muyuh pebala kuan kai muci aco, 'Kapeh rurum muyuh ku Tuhan Allah lun Israil?
english: “This is the reason that we built that altar: We were afraid/worried that some day your descendants would say that our descendants are not true Israelis. We were afraid that then they would say, ‘You are not allowed to worship Yahweh, the God whom we Israelis worship.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh kai nepebala, 'Do' kai nganau' anun luk pian kai, idi nganau' bubpun ini. Baken ieh ku baré sabpen kian baré kereten,
english: “That is the reason that we decided to build that new altar. But it is not an altar for completely burning sacrifices of animals and burning other sacrifices.

lun_bawang: Idi lun Rubin idi lun Gad neneten bubpun ineh "Luk Maré Kali'", ngaceku kebaladeh, "Ieh ineh aceh luk maré kali' arang tau ratnan Tuhan ineh, Allah.
english: The people of the tribes of Reuben and Gad named their new altar ‘A reminder to us all that Yahweh is God’.

lun_bawang: Idi Yusak nenawar amung lun Israil, dengan amung lun mengered, idi lun rayeh, idi luk mutut ukum idi luk ngimet nedeh ineh. Idi kebalaneh nedeh, "Ui pangeh mengered.
english: Joshua was now very old. One day he summoned the leaders of the tribes of Israel, the leaders of the clans, the judges, and other officials. He said to them, “I am now very old.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh do' muyuh maya' idi nganau' anun-anun luk inayud bang surat Ukum Musa, idi aleg ngelaba ineh,
english: “Be sure that you obey all the laws that are in the book that Moses wrote. Do not disobey any part of it IDM.

lun_bawang: Tuhan pangeh nengusu tuda'-tuda' pupu luk rayeh idi luk metueh ratnan babpatdeh rat pa kiung muyuh.
english: “Yahweh has forced many very powerful people-groups to leave as you advanced. No people-group has been able to defeat you.

lun_bawang: Kudeng muyuh lemubed idi maya' pupu-pupu luk na tabpen ini, luk mudeng arang muyuh, idi muyuh paweh nedeh,
english: “If you turn away from doing what Yahweh desires and you associate with the people who are not Israelis, and if you marry them,

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusak nelun mula' ineh, "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah lun Israil, 'Rat mon tepun muyuh mudeng i dipar Abpa' Pirat, ieh ineh Tira, taman Ibrahim idi taman Nahor. Idi ideh teh pangeh nesembayang nan allah baken.
english: Joshua said to all of them, “This is what Yahweh, the God we Israeli people worship, is saying: ‘Long ago, your ancestors, including Abraham’s father Terah and Abraham’s younger brother Nahor, lived on the east side of the Euphrates River.

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh Ui nengecuk ni Musa idi Arun, idi Ui nenecat Masir mepad kudeng luk pangeh inau'Ku arangdeh. Idi Ui nenguyut nemuyuh remuat.
english: “Many years later, I sent Moses and his older brother Aaron to help your people, and I caused the people of Egypt to suffer very much because of what I did there. Then I enabled your ancestors to leave Egypt.

lun_bawang: Idi Ui nenguit nemuyuh iné' bawang lun Amori, luk tudo pa busat aco Abpa' Yarden. Idi ideh nepebunu' nemuyuh. Iamo' Ui nemaré nedeh bang palad muyuh, pad muyuh nengalap tana'deh ku babpat muyuh. Idi Ui nengaté nedeh pa kiung muyuh.
english: “Then I brought your ancestors to the area where the groups who were descendants of Amor lived, east of the Jordan River. They fought against you, but I enabled you to defeat them IDM. I enabled you to destroy them so that you could live in their land IDM.

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh idi muyuh neguta Abpa' Yarden. Kareb pangeh macing déi' Yeriko idi lun bang bawang Yeriko nepebunu' nemuyuh, ieh ineh lun Amori, lun Prisi, lun Kanaani, lun Hiti, lun Gergasi, lun Hiwi, idi lun Yebusi. Idi amungdeh ineh biréKu bang palad muyuh.
english: “Then you all crossed the Jordan River and came to Jericho. The people of Jericho prepared to fight against you, and the armies of the descendants of Amor, Periz, Canaan, Heth, Girgash, Hiv, and Jebus all prepared to do the same thing but I enabled you to defeat IDM them all.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Yusak, "Idi ngaceku ineh do' muyuh sembayang inan Tuhan idi nganau' kekamen kuanNeh dengan niat luk lutep idi matu. Idi necan amung allah luk inubur tepun-tepun muyuh luk dipar Abpa' Pirat idi déi' Masir pana'. Iamo' do' muyuh mepicet maya' Tuhan.
english: Then Joshua said to the people, “Because of all that Yahweh has done for you, revere him, and serve/worship him very faithfully. Throw away the idols that your ancestors worshiped on the east/other side of the Euphrates River and in Egypt. Serve only Yahweh.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun mula', "Na kai sikal necan Tuhan idi maya' allah baken.
english: The Israeli people answered, “We will never quit serving/worshiping Yahweh! We would never think of IDM serving/worshiping other gods!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusak nelun mula' ineh, "Muyuh na miak maya' Tuhan, ngaceku Ieh ineh Allah luk meligan, idi Allah luk temaruh. Idi na Ieh miak maré do' ku sala' muyuh idi kekamen muyuh luk dat.
english: Joshua replied to the people, “I think that you are not able to serve/worship Yahweh, because he is a holy God. He will not forgive your sinning and rebelling against him. He demands that you serve/worship only him IDM.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun mula' ineh ni Yusak, "Baken! Iamo' kai sikal maya' Tuhan teh.”
english: But the people replied to Joshua, “No, we will not turn away from worshiping/serving Yahweh We will serve/worship Yahweh!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusak nedeh, "Muyuh mangun ku luk maré kali' kuan burur muyuh sebuleng ratnan muyuh pangeh nemili' Tuhan." Idi kebaladeh, "Kai ini lun luk maré kali'.”
english: Then Joshua said, “You yourselves are saying that you have decided to serve/worship Yahweh.” They replied, “Yes, we are saying that.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusak nedeh, "Nekini teh talan muyuh amung akang lun pupu baken luk arang muyuh. Idi do' muyuh merapet inan Tuhan Allah lun Israil.”
english: Then Joshua said, “Since you have decided that, you must throw away all the other gods/idols that you have among you. You must also promise that you will wholeheartedly give yourselves to Yahweh, the God whom we Israelis serve/worship.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun mula' ni Yusak, "Kai sikal maya' Tuhan Allah kai, idi maya' balaNeh.”
english: The people replied, “We will serve/worship Yahweh, our God, and obey him.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yusak nelun mula' ineh, "Siruh! Batu ini mangun ku luk maré kali' kuan tau. Ngaceku batu ini pangeh neninger amung bala Tuhan luk bilaNeh netau. Ieh ini pana' miak mangun ku luk maré kali' kuan muyuh, pad muyuh na teketed ratnan Allah muyuh.”
english: He said to all the people, “Look! It is as though this stone has heard everything that Yahweh said to you and that you promised Yahweh. It will serve as a witness against you if you rebel against your God!”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yusak pangeh natée, idi lun Israil nengitun Tuhan, kebaladeh, "Idéekée rat arang kai miak nalan atun amée' munu' nelun Kanaani?”
english: After Joshua died, the Israeli people asked Yahweh, “Which of our tribes should attack the Canaan people-group first?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan, "Do' pupu Yahuda nalan atun, idi Ui miak marée bawang ineh bang paladdeh.”
english: Yahweh replied, “I will enable the tribe of Judah to defeat IDM the Canaan people-group.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun Yahuda nelun pupu Simion, "Amée' maya' nekai ngalap bawang luk litep kuan kai, idi do' tau amée' munu' nelun Kanaani. Idi kai pana' miak nalan maya' nemuyuh ngalap bawang luk litep kuan muyuh." Idi lun pupu Simion pana' nenalan maya' nedeh.
english: The men of Judah went to their fellow Israelis, the men from the tribe of Simeon, and said to them, “Come and help us to fight the Canaan people-group in order that we can take from them the land that Yahweh allotted to us. If you do that, we will go with you and help you conquer the people in the land that Yahweh promised to give to you.” So the men from the tribe of Simeon went with the men of the tribe of Judah.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Adonibesek, "Inan tudu' ngepulu' burur lun raca' luk titek bua' ticu' mebpuh idi bua' kukud mebpuhdeh ngamung areg-areg nuba' iring téengku. Idi Allah pangeh nengua' kuanku maya' kudeng luk inau'ku nedeh." Idi ideh nenguit Adonibesek inée' Yerusalim, idi ieh natée déei'.
english: Adoni-Bezek said, “My army captured 70 kings. We cut off their thumbs and big toes. After that, we forced those kings to eat scraps that fell from our table. Now God has ◄paid me back for/done to me like► what we did to them.” Then the men of Judah took Adoni-Bezek to Jerusalem, and he died there.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Kaleb, "Ui miak marée anakku luk decur, ngadanneh Aksa ku awan lemulun luk ngelaya' Kiriat Seper.”
english: Before they attacked the city, Caleb said to them, “If one of you attacks and captures Kiriath-Sepher, I will allow him to marry my daughter.”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb decur ineh nacing, idi Otniel nengecuk neneh mutuh selalang tana' ratnan tamanneh. Idi decur ineh netemurun rat luun keladaineh, idi Kaleb nengitun neneh, "Anun luk pianmu?”
english: When Acsah married Othniel, she told him to ask her father to give him a field. But she decided to ask him herself. She rode to Caleb’s house on her donkey, and when she got off the donkey, Caleb could see that something was troubling her. So he asked her, “What do you want?”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengor balaneh, "Marée aceh peruan kuanku. Ngaceku iko nemarée tana' luk tekering kuanku, do' marée tuda'-tuda' bued abpa' teh." Idi ieh nemarée kuanneh bued abpa' luk pa dayeh idi luk pa lod teh.
english: She replied, “I want you to do a favor for me. You have given me some land in the southern desert, but it is very dry there. So please also give me some land that has springs of water.” So Caleb gave her some land on higher ground that had a spring, and some land on lower ground that also had a spring.

lun_bawang: Idi lun luk inée' nier ineh nenier aceh burur deléei remuat rat bang bawang ineh. Idi kebaladeh neneh, "Mada' nekai su apeh dalan semuet amée' bang bawang ini, pad kai na ngatée' namu.”
english: The spies saw a man who was coming out of the city. They said to him, “If you show us a way to get into the city, we will be kind to you and we will not kill you.”

lun_bawang: Idi Melaikat Tuhan nacing rat Gilgal inée' Bokim. KebalaNeh nelun Israil, "Ui nenguit nemuyuh remuat rat bang bawang Masir, idi nenated nemuyuh semuet bang bawang luk pangeh pijani'Ku kuan tepun muyuh. KebalaKu, 'Na Ui miak ngelaba jani'Ku nemuyuh macing ruked-ruked.
english: Yahweh appeared in the form of an angel and  went up from Gilgal to a place that was later called Bokim. He said to the Israeli people, “I brought your ancestors up here from Egypt. I led them into this land that I solemnly promised to give to your ancestors. I said to them, ‘The agreement that I made with you, as for me, I will never ◄break it/say that it is ended►.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh Tuhan pelaba useh nelun Israil, kebalaNeh, "Pupu ini pangeh nengelaba jani'Ku, luk pangeh bida'Ku kuan tepundeh. Idi na ideh neninger arodKu.
english: I will use them to test the Israeli people to see whether they will do what I want them to do, as their ancestors did.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh sebuleng nelemubed rat ku batu luk inarit luk muneng ku Gilgal, idi ieh inée' papu' raca', kebalaneh neneh, "O tuanku, inan sebila' bala luk pian beléenku namu dengan lulem." Idi kebala raca' kuan luk dukenneh, "Buro muyuh." Idi amung-amungdeh neremuat.
english: Then, as Eglon was sitting alone in the upstairs room of his summer palace, Ehud came close to him and said, “I have a message for you from God.” As the king got up from his chair,

lun_bawang: Idi Ehud inée' matun raca' kareb ieh tudo bang takepneh luk do' bui. Idi kebala Ehud neneh, "Inan aceh bala ratnan Allah kuanmu." Idi raca' ineh nudur.
english: Ehud reached with his left hand and pulled the dagger from his right thigh, and plunged it into the king’s belly.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh neburo. Idi lun duken raca' nacing, idi ideh nenier tanga' ineh pinasak. Idi keterawéedeh, ieh bubpa' bang takep ineh.
english: So they waited, but when the king did not open the doors of the room, after a while they were worried. They got a key and unlocked the doors. And they saw that their king was lying on the floor, dead.

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh nedeh, "Maya' negku. Ngaceku Tuhan marée nemuyuh metueh ratnan bunu' muyuh lun Moab." Idi amungdeh nemaya' neneh. Idi ideh nengalap su luk inan lun Moab guta Abpa' Yarden. Na ideh nemarée seburur pana' guta ieneh.
english: At that time, the Israelis killed about 10,000 people from Moab. They were all strong and capable men, but not one of them escaped.

lun_bawang: Kebala Barak ni Debora, "Ui miak amée' kudeng iko maya' negku. Kudeng iko na amée', ui pana' nateh amée'.”
english: Barak replied, “I will go only if you go with me.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Debora, "Mo, ui miak maya' namu. Iamo' iko na miak buren ku tuehmu, ngaceku Tuhan miak marée Sisera bang palad seburur decur." Idi Debora maya' neneh inée' Kedes.
english: She replied, “Okay, I will go with you. But because that is what you have decided to do, Yahweh will enable a woman to defeat Sisera, and the result will be that ◄you will not be honored/people will not honor you► for doing that.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Debora ni Barak, "Do' iko nalan! Ngaceku aco sini Tuhan marée ni Sisera bang paladmu. Tuhan luk nguyut namu." Idi Barak neremuru rat luun Pegkung Tabor ineh dengan lun luk pulu' ngeribu ineh.
english: Then Deborah said to Barak, “Get ready! This is the day that Yahweh will enable your army to defeat the army of Sisera. Yahweh is going ahead of you!” So Barak led his men as they descended from Tabor Mountain.

lun_bawang: Idi Yael neremuat inée' papu' ni Sisera, kebalaneh, "Do' iko semuet bang lepoku. Aleg matot." Idi ieh nesemuet. Idi Yael nenarub neneh.
english: Jael went out to greet Sisera. She said to him, “Sir, come into my tent! Do not be afraid!” So he went into the tent and lay down, and she covered him with a blanket.

lun_bawang: Kebala Sisera neneh, "Marée aceh abpa' rupenku, ngaceku ui meparing." Idi ieh nengukab seréei' kubil luk inan abpa' rata idi nemarée rupenneh. Pangeh ineh idi ieh nenarub neneh teh.
english: He said to her, “I’m thirsty; can you give me some water?” So she opened a leather container of milk, and gave him a drink. Then she covered him with the blanket again.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Sisera neneh teh, "Do' iko tuped munung tanga'. Idi kudeng inan lun macing ngitun namu, 'Inankée lun tungée'?' do' iko ngor, 'Na lemulun tungée'.' “
english: He said to her, “Stand in the entrance of the tent. If someone comes and asks ‘Is anyone else here?’, say ‘No.’”

lun_bawang: "Ngubur Tuhan! Lun rayeh Israil geregan pebunu'; idi anak itin pana' inée' dengan mawang niat!
english: “When the leaders of the Israeli people really lead them, and the people follow them, it is time to praise Yahweh!

lun_bawang: Ninger muyuh, O raca'-raca'! Idi ngeten lalid muyuh, O muyuh lun rayeh- rayeh! Ui pian menani idi marée ubur kuan Tuhan Allah lun Israil!
english: Listen, you kings! Pay attention, you leaders! I will sing to Yahweh. With this song I will praise Yahweh, the God we Israelis worship.

lun_bawang: O Tuhan, kareb Iko nenalan rat pegkung-pegkung Sir, idi nelemaba raked Edom, idi tana' neruyuh, idi udan pana' nebpeh, idi laput pana' nengeruat abpa'.
english: O Yahweh, when you came from Seir, when you marched from that land better known as Edom, the earth shook, and rain poured down from the skies.

lun_bawang: "Idi bang kareb Samgar Anat, idi Yael teh, na mula' lemulun maya' dalan rayeh, idi ideh luk nalan nemaya' dalan baken.
english: “When Shamgar was our leader and when Jael ruled us, we were afraid to walk on the main roads; instead, caravans of travelers walked on winding less traveled roads to avoid being molested.

lun_bawang: O amung muyuh luk maya' keladai luk mebuda', idi luk tudo luun tapin luk meluun do', idi muyuh luk nalan maya' tana', do' mada' ineh.
english: “You wealthy people who ride on donkeys, sitting on nice padded saddles, and you people who just walk on the road, you all listen!

lun_bawang: Do' ninger ria' lun mula' luk iring subuk, luk mada' ratnan tueh Tuhan, idi ratnan tueh lun Israil. "Idi pupu Tuhan nenalan rat bawangdeh.
english: Listen to the voices of the singers who gather at the places where the animals drink water. They tell about how Yahweh acted righteously when he enabled the Israeli warriors to conquer their enemies. “Yahweh’s people marched down to the gates of our city.

lun_bawang: Lemulun luk lutep maya' Tuhan inée' negku. Idi ideh temina' maya' lun rayehdeh amée' pebunu'.
english: Later, some of the Israeli people came down from Tabor Mountain with us, their leaders. These men who belonged to Yahweh came with me to fight their strong enemies.

lun_bawang: "Idi amung raca' nacing idi nepebunu', déei' Tanak, tangeb Abpa' Megido. Idi amung raca' Kanaan nepebunu' teh, iamo' sebalad pirak pana' nateh luk nekarodeh.
english: “The kings of Canaan fought us at Taanach, near the springs in Megiddo Valley. But since they did not defeat us, they did not carry away any silver or other treasures from the battle.

lun_bawang: "Luk ngalap peruan meluun ratnan amung decur, ieh ineh Yael, awan Heber lun Keni ineh. Idi ieh luk ngalap peruan meluun ratnan amung decur, luk tudo bang lepo kibung.
english: “But God is very pleased with Jael, the wife of Heber from the Ken people-group. He is more pleased with her than with all the other women who live in tents.

lun_bawang: "Idi tinan Sisera nenier rat bang tabuk, kebalaneh. 'Ngudeh keréetaneh pelaba io macing? Ngudeh kudaneh pelaba ulai lemubed?'
english: “Sisera’s mother looked out from her window. She waited for him to return. She said, ‘Why is he taking so long to come home in his chariot? Why don’t I hear the sound of the wheels of his chariot?’

lun_bawang: "Dengan luk kudeng ineh nima' amung bunu'Mu matée, O Tuhan. Iamo' do' lun rurumMu merasat mepad kudeng asat aco." Idi bawang ineh na inan bunu' apat ngepulu' lak kinioneh.
english: But that is not what happened! Yahweh, I hope that all your enemies will die as Sisera did! And I desire that all those who love you will be as strong as the sun when it rises!

lun_bawang: idi Tuhan nengecuk aceh nabiNeh kuandeh, kebalaneh, "Ini bala Tuhan Allah lun Israil: Ui nenguit nemuyuh remuat rat bang bawang Masir, su luk inan muyuh tiban.
english: he sent to them a prophet, who said, “Yahweh, the God we Israelis worship, says this: ‘Your ancestors were slaves in Egypt.

lun_bawang: Ui pangeh nemada' nemuyuh, 'Ui ini Tuhan Allah muyuh, aleg muyuh sembayang inan allah lun Amori, luk kuan tana' luk inan muyuh tudo nekini. Iamo' na muyuh neninger balaKu.' “
english: I told you all, “I am Yahweh, your God. You are now in the land where the descendants of Amor live, but you must not worship the gods whom they worship.” But you did not pay attention to me.’”

lun_bawang: Idi Melaikat Tuhan nesilagan neneh, kebalaNeh, "Tuhan idi denganmu, O, iko luk metueh idi mekuu'.”
english: Yahweh went over to Gideon and said to him, “You mighty warrior, Yahweh is helping you!”

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nengecuk neneh, kebalaNeh, "Amée' iko dengan amung tueh luk namu, idi muit nelun Israil rat nelun Midian. Ui ini luk ngecuk namu.”
english: Then Yahweh turned toward him and said, “I will give you strength to enable you to rescue the Israelis from the people of Midian. I am sending you to do that!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh Neneh, "O Tuhan kudeng apehkée ui miak muit nelun Israil, ngaceku lun bang tetek ruma'ku pelaba laya' arang pupu Manasée. Idi ui luk isuut rat arang anak i Ama'.”
english: Gideon replied, “But Yahweh, how can I rescue the Israelis? My clan is the least significant in the whole tribe descended from Manasseh, and I am the least significant person in my whole family!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Iko miak nganau' kudeng ineh, ngaceku Ui miak ngedengan namu. Iko miak ngelaya' nelun Midian, mepad kudeng ngelaya' seburur lemulun.”
english: Yahweh said to him, “I will help you. So you will defeat the army of Midian as easily as if you were fighting only one man!”

lun_bawang: Idi Gidion nengor balaNeh, "Kudeng Iko mawang niat, marée aceh tanu' kuanku, pad ui kali' Tuhan luk pebala negku.
english: Gideon replied, “If you are truly pleased with me, do something which will prove that you who are speaking to me are really Yahweh.

lun_bawang: Aleg Tuhan buro rat ieni, kareb nateh ui macing nguit aceh barée luk kenen kuanMu." Idi kebalaNeh, "Ui miak nganéet pad iko macing.”
english: But do not go away until I go and bring back an offering to you.” Yahweh answered, “Okay, I will stay here until you return.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Melaikat Tuhan neneh, "Ngerareng uang idi ruti ineh luun batu ini, idi ngutang abpa' ineh luunneh." Idi ieh nenganau' kudeng ineh teh.
english: Then Yahweh said to him, “Put the meat and the bread on this rock. Then pour the broth on top of it.” So Gideon did that.

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh idi Gidion nekali' ineh Melaikat Tuhan luk pangeh sinierneh. Idi kebalaneh, "Adui, O Tuhan Allah! Ngaceku ui pangeh nenier Melaikat Tuhan.”
english: When Gideon realized that it was really Yahweh who had appeared in the form of an angel and talked with him, he exclaimed, “O, Yahweh, I have seen you face-to-face when you had the form of an angel! So I will surely die!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Tuhan neneh, "Aleg matot. Na iko mekudeh. Na iko matée.”
english: But Yahweh called to him and said, “Do not be afraid! You will not die because of seeing me!”

lun_bawang: Idi Gidion nemudut aceh bubpun kuan Tuhan su ineh. Idi ieh nenganau' ngadan su ineh "Tuhan Lawa Awang." Idi bubpun ineh idi teh nekini déei' Opira, bawang lun Abieser.
english: Then Gideon built an altar to worship Yahweh there. He named it ‘Yahweh gives us peace’. That altar is still there in Ophrah town, in the land that belongs to the descendants of Abiezer.

lun_bawang: Idi bang malem ineh teh, Tuhan nengecuk neneh, kebalaNeh, "Ngalap aceh sapi' deléei i tamam, idi ngalap sebuleng teh luk tudu' lak ulunneh. Idi nabpa bubpun i tamam luk kuan Baal ineh, idi nebpeng ulung luk iringneh.
english: That night Yahweh said to Gideon, “Take the second-best/oldest bull from your father’s herd, the bull that is seven years old. Kill it. Then tear down the altar that your father built to worship the god Baal. Also cut down the pole for worshipping the goddess Astarte that is there beside it.

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh seburur dengan seburur, "Idéekée luk nenganau' ini?" Kareb ideh pangeh nengelio idi nengitun ratnan ineh idi ideh nekali', ieh ineh Gidion Yoas luk nenganau' idi.”
english: The people asked each other, “Who did this?” After they investigated, someone told them that it was Gideon, the son of Joash, who had done it.

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh ni Yoas, "Nguit anakmu ineh remuat amée' tungée' pad ieh pitayen kai. Ngaceku ieh pangeh nenabpa bubpun luk kuan Baal, idi nenebpeng ulung luk iringneh pana'.”
english: They went to Joash and said to him, “Bring your son out here! ◄He must be executed/We must kill him►, because he destroyed our god Baal’s altar and cut down the pole for our goddess Astarte!”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb aco sineh, ideh nenganau' ngadan Gidion, Yerubaal, ilungneh, "Nima' Baal ngerayeh bururneh sebuleng ngaceku bubpun dieh luk pangeh tibpa Gidion.”
english: From that time, people called Gideon Jerub-Baal, which means ‘Baal should defend himself’, because he tore down Baal’s altar.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Gidion inan Allah, "KebalaMu Iko pian negku muit nelun Israil.
english: Then Gideon said to God, “If you are truly going to enable me to rescue the Israeli people as you promised,

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Gidion, "Pelaba ula' lemulun maya' namu, meluun ratnan luk pianKu. Ngaceku ineh na Ui marée nedeh ngelaya' nelun Midian. Kudeng Ui nima' nedeh, kali' rungen ideh ngerawée tuehdeh sebuleng, idi na ngubur Negku.
english: Yahweh said to Gideon, “You have too many soldiers with you. If I allow all of you to fight the army of Midian, if your army defeats them, they will boast to me that they defeated their enemies by themselves, without my help.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Gidion, "Ui miak muit nemuyuh idi marée nemuyuh metueh rat nelun Midian dengan baweh luk 300 burur ini luk pangeh nengirup dengan inook ticu'deh. Do' ngecuk nelun luk baken ineh muli'.”
english: Then Yahweh told Gideon, “The 300 men who lapped the water from their hands will be your army! I will enable them to defeat the Midian army. Let all the others go home!”

lun_bawang: Idi bang dacem ineh teh kebala Tuhan ni Gidion, "Tumui iko, idi amée' ngerieng baweh ineh. Ngaceku Ui pangeh nemarée nedeh bang paladmu.
english: That night, Yahweh said to Gideon, “Get up and go down to their camp, and you will hear something that will convince you that I will enable your men to defeat them.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun denganneh, "Na luk baken iamo' pelapet Gidion Yoas, lun Israil. Ieh ineh ilungneh, Allah pangeh nemarée nelun Midian idi amung baweh tau bang paladneh.”
english: His friend said, “Your dream can mean only one thing. It means that God will enable Gideon, the man of Israel, to defeat all of the armies that are here with us men from Midian.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Gidion neninger nupi ineh idi dengan ilungneh, idi ieh netekeradung sembayang. Idi ieh nelemubed inée' lepo lun Israil, kebalaneh, "Tumui muyuh. Ngaceku birée Tuhan lun Midian bang palad muyuh.”
english: When Gideon heard the man tell about his dream and the meaning of that dream, he thanked God. Then he and Purah returned to the Israeli camp, and he shouted to the men, “Get up! Because God is enabling you to defeat the men from Midian!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nedeh, "Nier negku. Maya' luk ruenku kareb ui macing iring lepodeh ineh.
english: Then he said to them, “Watch me. When we come close to the enemy camp, spread out to surround the camp. Then do exactly what I do.

lun_bawang: Idi amungdeh luk teluh babpat ineh nengiup ungadeh, idi nemila' sidangurdeh. Idi ticu'deh pa kabing ngimet ilu'. Idi ticu'deh pa tinueh ngimet unga. Idi amungdeh ineh nengitang, "Kai ini Tuhan kuan idi Gidion kuan!”
english: Then the men in all three groups blew their horns and smashed their jars. They held the torches high with their left hands, and held up the horns with their right hands and alternatively blew them and shouted, “We have swords to fight for Yahweh and for Gideon!”

lun_bawang: Kebala lun Epraim ni Gidion, "Ngudehkée iko na nenawar nekai kareb iko inée' pebunu' nelun Midian? Ngudehkée iko nenganau' nekai kudeng ini?" Idi ideh ngedureng-ngedureng neneh.
english: Then the descendants of Ephraim said to Gideon, “Why have you acted toward us like this? When you went out to fight against the people of Midian, why did you not summon us to help you?” They rebuked Gideon severely.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Gidion nedeh, "Luk inau'ku na miak uen maad dengan luk inau'muyuh. Sesuut luk inau' muyuh lun Epraim meluun do' ratnan amung- amung luk inau' lun bang tetek ruma'ku.
english: But Gideon replied, “I have done RHQ very little compared with what you have done! My small clan of descendants of Abiezer only started the battle, but your very large group of descendants of Ephraim helped me to finish the task very well. It is like the final grapes of the harvest being much better than the first grapes that are picked.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nemutuh ruti nelun bawang Sukot, "Marée ruti tuda'-tuda' balad kuan lun luk maya' negku. Ngaceku ideh merur. Ngaceku kai ngerada' Séeba idi Salmuna, raca' Midian ineh.”
english: When they arrived at Succoth town, Gideon said to the town leaders, “Please give my men some food! They are very tired. We are pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala amung lun rayeh bawang Sukot ineh, "Kudeng apeh kai miak marée ruti kuan muyuh ngaceku nateh Séeba idi Salmuna kikem muyuh?”
english: But the leaders of Succoth replied, “You have not caught RHQ Zebah and Zalmunna yet. So why should we give food to your troops now? Catch them first, and then we will give you food.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Gidion, "Do', kudeng pieh kudeng ineh, kareb Tuhan pangeh nemarée Séeba idi Salmuna bang paladku, kali' rungen ui mebal nemuyuh ku tabpa' rat déei' su luk ali-ali.”
english: Gideon replied, “Because you said that, after Yahweh enables us to defeat Zebah and Zalmunna, we will return. And then we will make whips from thorns from the desert, and with them we will rip the flesh off your bones!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nedeh, "Ui miak lemubed dengan do', idi kareb ineh kali' rungen ui miak ngusag pudut luk medita' ini.”
english: So he said to the men of Peniel, “After I defeat those kings, I will return and tear down this tower!”

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh idi Gidion nengitun ni Séeba idi Salmuna, "Kudeng apeh ayu lemulun luk pangeh pinatée medueh déei' Tabor di?" Kebala didueh, "Mepad kudeng iko ni teh ideh. Amungdeh mepad kudeng ayu anak raca'.”
english: Then Gideon said to Zebah and Zalmunna, “The men you killed near Tabor Mountain, what did they look like?” They replied, “They were like you; they all looked like they were sons of a king.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Gidion, "Ideh ineh kinanakku, kai sebuleng tinan mo'. Idi ui pebulung, kudeng medueh na nengatée nedeh, ui pana' nateh ngatée nemedueh.”
english: Gideon replied, “They were my brothers! Just as surely as Yahweh lives, I would not kill you if you had not killed them.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Gidion ni Yeter, anak deléeineh luk rayeh, "Amée' iko ngatée nedidueh." Iamo' anak ineh matot ngangat pelapetneh ngaceku ieh isuut.
english: Then he turned to his oldest son, Jether. He said to him, “Kill them!” But Jether was only a boy, and he was afraid, so he did not pull out his dagger to kill them.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Séeba idi Salmuna, "Do' iko sebuleng ngatée nekai dueh. Ngaceku lun rayeh mo' miak nganau' kekamen lun rayeh." Idi Gidion nengatée nedidueh. Idi ieh nengalap amas luk kudeng bulan luk i dier unta didueh.
english: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said to Gideon, “Do not ask a young boy to do the work that a man should do!” So Gideon killed both of them. Then he took the gold ornaments from the necks of their camels.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun Israil ni Gidion, "Do' iko mangun ku lun rayeh kai, do' iko idi anakmu idi anak mupunmu. Ngaceku iko pangeh nemuit nekai rat bang palad lun Midian.”
english: Then a group of Israeli men came to Gideon and said to him, “You be our ruler! We want you and your son and your grandsons to be our rulers, because you rescued us from the Midian army.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Gidion nengor baladeh, "Ui na miak mangun ku lun rayeh muyuh, idi anakku pana'. Iamo' Tuhan sebuleng mangun ku Lun Rayeh muyuh.”
english: But Gideon replied, “No, I will not rule over you, and my son will not rule over you. Yahweh will rule over you.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nepebala nedeh teh, "Sebuleng mo' luk pianku rat nemuyuh. Ieh ineh do' anid-anid burur muyuh marée luk ilap muyuh kuanku." (Lun Midian ineh inan abée amas ngaceku ideh lun rat déei' su luk ali-ali.)
english: Then he said, “I request only one thing. I request that each of you give me one earring from the things you captured after the battle.” All the men descended from Ishmael wore gold earrings.

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh neneh, "Kai pelaba awang niat marée ineh namu." Idi ideh nemalad seputut kibung, idi anid-anid bururdeh nengerareng abée luk ilapdeh ineh luun kibung ineh.
english: They replied, “We will be glad to give earrings to you!” So they spread a cloth on the ground, and each man threw on it one gold earring that he had taken from a man he had killed in the battle.

lun_bawang: Idi amung pupu tinanneh nepegayam nelun Sikem ratnan ineh. Idi amungdeh nengamo maya' ni Abimelek, ngaceku ieh pupudeh.
english: So Abimelech’s mother’s brothers spoke to all the leaders of Shechem about what Abimelech had said. They said to each other, “We should allow Abimelech to rule over us, because he is our relative.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yotam neninger ratnan amung ineh, idi ieh inée' tuped luun buduk Surud Gerisim. Idi ieh nengitang, kebalaneh, "Ninger negku, O muyuh lun Sikem, idi Allah miak ninger nemuyuh teh.
english: When Jotham heard about that, he climbed up Gerizim Mountain. He stood at the top of the mountain and shouted to the people down below, “You leaders of Shechem, listen to me, in order that God will listen to you!

lun_bawang: Iamo' lawa saitun nengor baladeh ineh, 'Na ui pian amée' ngimet nemuyuh idi necan umauku luk buren amung allah idi amung lemulun teh.'
english: “But the olive tree said, ‘No! I will not be your king Men and gods enjoy the oil from my fruit. I will not RHQ stop producing olives from which we make that oil, in order to rule over you other trees!’

lun_bawang: Idi kebala amung lawa kayuh ineh kuan lawa gita', 'Amée' iko mangun ku raca' kai.'
english: “Then the trees said to the fig tree, ‘You come and be our king!’

lun_bawang: Iamo' lawa gita' nengor baladeh, 'Na ui amée' ngimet nemuyuh idi necan amung bua'ku luk mepaci'.'
english: “But the fig tree replied, ‘No! I do not want to RHQ stop producing my good sweet fruit, and rule over you other trees!’

lun_bawang: Idi amung lawa kayuh ineh nepebala kuan lawa anggur, 'Amée' iko mangun ku raca' kai.'
english: “Then the trees said to the grapevine, ‘Come and be our king!’

lun_bawang: Iamo' lawa anggur nengor baladeh, 'Na ui pian amée' ngimet nemuyuh idi necan abpa'ku luk mepaci' luk ngawang niat amung allah idi lemulun teh.'
english: “But the grapevine replied, ‘No! I will not be your king The new wine that is made from my grapes causes people and gods who drink it to become very happy. I do not want to stop producing grapes and rule over you other trees!’ RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebala amung lawa kayuh ineh kuan lawa tabpa', 'Amée' iko mangun ku raca' kai.'
english: “Then all the trees said to the thornbush, ‘Come and be our king!’

lun_bawang: Idi lawa tabpa' nengor baladeh, 'Kudeng matu muyuh ngikit negku mangun ku raca' muyuh, amée' amung muyuh silungung liang lungungku. Iamo' kudeng muyuh na amée', apui miak remuat ratnan lawa tabpa' idi ngeseb amung tumuh luk déei' Lebanon.'
english: “The thornbush replied, ‘If you truly want to appoint me to be your king, come into the shade of my tiny branches. But if you do not want to do that, I hope/desire that fire will come out from me and burn up all the huge cedar trees in Lebanon country!’”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yotam teh, "Matukée muyuh nganau' ni Abimelek mangun ku raca' dengan niat luk do' idi matu? Matukée muyuh nganau' do' kuan Gidion idi kuan uang tetek ruma'neh? Matukée muyuh ngua' kuanneh maya' kudeng luk inau'neh?
english: “After Jotham finished telling them this parable, he said, “So now I ask you, were you being completely honest and sincere when you appointed Abimelech to be your king RHQ? And have you treated Gideon and his family RHQ fairly? Have you rewarded Gideon by honoring him as he deserved because of all the good things he did for you? No!

lun_bawang: Kudeng ui ngimet pupu ini, kali' rungen ui nala' ni Abimelek. Idi ui miak mala kuanneh, 'Kudeng iko inan baweh, nguit nedeh amée' munu' negku!' “
english: If you would appoint me to be your leader, I would get rid of Abimelech. I would say to him, ‘Get your army ready, and then come to fight us!’”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengecuk nelun duken amée' ni Abimelek déei' Aruma, kebaladeh, "Gaal Ebed idi amung kinanakneh pangeh nacing déei' Sikem. Idi ideh na nima' namu semuet bang bawang ineh.
english: He secretly sent some messengers to Abimelech. They told him, “Gaal and his brothers have come here to Shechem, and they are causing the people of the city to rebel against you.

lun_bawang: Kareb Gaal nekali' nedeh, idi ieh nekidi ni Sebul, "Nier! Inan lemulun musul ratnan pegkung!" Idi Sebul nengor balaneh, "Na ineh lemulun. Aca' pegkung ineh!”
english: When Gaal saw the soldiers, he said to Zebul, “Look! There are people coming down from the hills!” But Zebul said, “You are seeing only the shadows of trees on the hills. They are not people; they only resemble people.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Gaal teh, "Nier, inan mula' lemulun musul maya' ruanneh. Idi inan sebabpat macing rat pa kayuh luk meraben su luk inan mangun.”
english: But Gaal looked again and said, “Look! There are people coming down from the top of the sacred mountain! There is a group of them coming down from where the tree is where people talk with the spirits of dead people!”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Sebul neneh, "Peh tueh tang midi peh. Iko luk nengitun ngudeh tau maya' ni Abimelek ineh? Lemulun ini luk inanmu nesitunga. Remuat iko nekini idi pebunu' nedeh.”
english: Zebul said to Gaal, “Now ◄what good is your bragging?/your bragging is worthless!► MTY, RHQ You said, ‘◄Why should we serve Abimelech/We should not allow Abimelech to rule over us►?’ You made fun of these men. So now go out and fight them!”

lun_bawang: Dengan mesaget Abimelek nenawar seburur luk nguit repapehneh. Idi keburi'neh neneh, "Ngangat pelapetmu idi ngatée negku, pad ideh na mala ui pinatée seburur decur." Idi lun luk nguit repapehneh pana' nenebpek neneh pad ieh natée.
english: Abimelech quickly called to the young man who carried Abimelech’s weapons, and said, “Pull out your sword and kill me with it! I do not want people to say ‘It was a woman who killed Abimelech.’” So the young man thrust his sword into Abimelech, and Abimelech died.

lun_bawang: Idi bang kareb ineh lun Israil nengitang idi nenawar Tuhan, kebaladeh, "Kai pangeh nenganau' sala' pa kiungMu, ngaceku kai pangeh nenecan Namu Allah kai, idi nesembayang inan Baal.”
english: So the Israelis cried out to Yahweh, saying “We have sinned against you. We have abandoned you, and we have been worshiping the idols of their god Baal.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Tuhan nedeh, "Ui pangeh nemuit nemuyuh rat bang palad lun Masir, lun Amori, lun Amon, lun Pilistin,
english: Yahweh answered them, saying, “When the people of Egypt, and the Amor and Ammon and Philistia people-groups
