lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul kuan bawehneh, "Iapin muyuh amung baweh idi ngitun idé' luk na idi arang tau." Idi ideh nengiap nelun mula'. Idi Yonatan idi anak adi' luk nguit pelapetneh ineh na idi.
english: Saul realized that some of his soldiers must have attacked the Philistia army. So he  said to the soldiers who were with him, “Check to see if any of our men are not here.” So they checked, and they found out that Jonathan and the man who carried his weapons were gone.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul ni Ahiya, "Nguit amé' tungé' Pati' Pejani' Allah." Ngaceku kareb ineh Pati' Pejani' ineh iné' pa atun lun Israil.
english: So Saul said to Ahijah the Supreme Priest, “Bring the sacred vest here and find out what we should do.” On that day Ahijah was wearing the sacred vest, going in front of the Israelis.

lun_bawang: Idi laba' Saul pebala kuan imam ineh, iuk-iuk mula' ria' arang baweh lun Pilistin. Idi kebala Saul kuan imam ineh, "Aganeh!”
english: But while Saul was talking to the priest, he saw that the Philistia soldiers were becoming more panicked/confused. So Saul said to Ahijah, “Take your hand down from the sacred vest. Do not waste any more time using the marked stones in the vest to find out what Yahweh wants us to do.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala seburur rat arang baweh ineh neneh, "Idi Tamam pangeh nemulung nelun mula'. Kediman kuan lun luk kuman luk anun-anun bang aco sini. Ngaceku ineh amung kai melaya' burur.”
english: But one of the Israeli soldiers saw him and said to him, “Your father solemnly declared to us that Yahweh would curse/punish anyone who ate any food today. So now we are very tired and weak from being hungry because we obeyed him.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yonatan, "I Ama' ngesusa' nelun mula'. Nier kudeng apeh tuehku kareb ui nengil sesuut mo' duru' tebikan ini.
english: Jonathan exclaimed, “My father has caused trouble for all of us! See how refreshed/strong I am after eating a little honey!

lun_bawang: Idi lun nemada' ni Saul, "Baweh ineh mesala' inan Tuhan, ngaceku ideh nekuman uang perapu dara'neh." Idi kebala Saul, "Pelaba rayeh sala' ineh. Do' ngelubid aceh batu rayeh amé' negku.”
english: One of the soldiers told Saul, “Look! The men are sinning against Yahweh by eating meat that still has blood in it!” Saul replied to the men who were near him, “They have disobeyed Yahweh! Roll a large stone over here!”

lun_bawang: Idi Saul nengitun Allah, "Miakké ui amé' ngerada' nelun Pilistin? Miak Iko maré nedeh bang palad kai?" Iamo' aco sineh na Ieh nengua' putuhneh.
english: So Saul asked God, “Should we pursue the Philistine soldiers? Will you enable us to defeat them?” But God did not answer Saul that day.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul, "O amung lun rayeh baweh, do' muyuh amé' tungé', pad tau kali' anun sala' luk kikem bang aco sini.
english: Then Saul summoned all the leaders of his army. He said to them, “I am sure that God has not answered me because someone has sinned. We must find out what sin someone has committed.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul kuan amung lun Israil, "Do' amung muyuh tuped bal selipa idi ui dengan anakku Yonatan selipa." Idi kebala lun mula' ni Saul, "Do' iko nganau' luk matu bang terawému.”
english: Then Saul said to all the Israeli soldiers, “You stand on one side. My son Jonathan and I will stand on the other side.” His men replied, “Do whatever you think is best.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul, "O Tuhan Allah lun Israil, anun punneh Iko na ngor balaku aco sini? Kudeng ui, kian, anakku Yonatan inan sala', O Tuhan Allah lun Israil, maré Urim kareb kai nala' udi. Kudeng lun Israil inan sala' do' maré Tumim." Iamo' Yonatan idi Saul nepetulu. Lun mula' ineh na nepetulu.
english: Then Saul prayed to Yahweh, the Israelis’ God, “Tell me who is guilty and who is not guilty.” Then the priest ◄cast lots/threw the stones that were marked►, and they indicated that it was either Jonathan or Saul who was the guilty one, and that the other men were not guilty.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul, "Nala' udi arangku dengan anakku Yonatan." Idi Yonatan luk nepetulu.
english: Then Saul said to the priest, “Throw the stones again to indicate which of us two is guilty.” So he did, and the stones indicated that Jonathan was the guilty one.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul ni Yonatan, "Mada' negku anunké luk inau'mu." Idi kebala Yonatan neneh, "Ui nekuman sesuut duru tebikan. Ini ui, ui temina' maté.”
english: Then Saul said to Jonathan, “Tell me what you have done that was wrong.” Jonathan replied, “I ate a little bit of honey. It was only a little bit that was on the end of my stick. Do I deserve to be executed because of doing that?”

lun_bawang: Idi Saul nepebulung pa kiung Tuhan, kebalaneh, "Kali' rungen Yonatan miak pitayen.”
english: Saul replied, “Yes, you must be executed! I hope/wish that God will strike me and kill me if you are not executed for having done that!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Semuil ni Saul, "Ui luk pangeh icuk Tuhan ngikit namu ku raca' pupuNeh, lun Israil. Idi nekini do' iko ninger bala Tuhan luk Melalud.
english: One day Samuel said to Saul, “Yahweh sent me to appoint you to be the king of the Israeli people. So now listen to this message from Yahweh:

lun_bawang: "Ui nginuud ngaceku i Saul pangeh kinikitKu ku raca'. Ngaceku ieh nelemubed rat Negku, idi na maya' balaKu." Idi Semuil pelaba susa' niat. Idi ieh nengitang nawar Tuhan kedangan-kedangan ineh.
english: “I am sorry that I appointed Saul to be your king, because he has turned away from me and has not obeyed what I commanded him to do.” Samuel was very disturbed/upset when he heard that, and he cried out to Yahweh all that night.

lun_bawang: Idi kenebpa pekak uka-uka Semuil iné' nakap ni Saul. Ieh neninger bala ratnan Saul pangeh iné' Karmel, idi ieh nenaped aceh luk ku terawé ratnan bururneh sebuleng. Pangeh ineh ieh iné' Gilgal.
english: Early the next morning, Samuel got up and went to talk with Saul. But someone told Samuel, “Saul went to Camel city, where he has set up a monument to honor himself. Now he has left there and gone down to Gilgal.”

lun_bawang: Idi Semuil iné' papu' ni Saul. Idi kebala Saul neneh, "Do' Tuhan ngeperuan namu; ngaceku ui pangeh nemaya' balaNeh.”
english: When Samuel arrived at Gilgal he approached Saul, and Saul said to him,, “I wish/desire that Yahweh will bless you! I have obeyed what Yahweh told me to do.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Semuil, "Anunké uni dumba ini, idi uni sapi' luk pedingerenku?”
english: But Samuel replied, “If that is true, why is it that I hear cattle mooing and I hear sheep bleating?”

lun_bawang: Idi Saul nengor balaneh, "Bawehku pangeh nenguit nedeh rat nelun Amalek. Ngaceku ideh méi' inan sapi' idi amékdeh luk do', idi baréndeh ku baré kuan Tuhan Allahmu. Iamo' amung luk baken ineh pangeh kai nengaté.”
english: Saul replied, “The soldiers took them from the Amalek people-group. They saved the best sheep and cattle, in order to offer them as sacrifices to Yahweh, your God. But we have completely destroyed all the others.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Semuil ni Saul, "Pirud iko, pad ui maré kali' kuanmu bala Tuhan luk pangeh bida'Neh negku ina dacem!" Idi kebala Saul neneh, "Mada' ieh.”
english: Samuel said to Saul, “Stop talking! Allow me to tell you what Yahweh said to me last night.” Saul replied, “Tell me what he said.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Semuil, "Kareb iko isuut bang terawému sebuleng, iko mangun ku lun rayeh amung inul pupu Israil. Idi iko kinikit Tuhan ku raca' amung lun Israil.
english: Samuel said, “Previously you did not think that you were important. But now you have become RHQ the leader of the tribes of Israel. Yahweh appointed you to be their king.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul ni Semuil, "Ui pangeh nemaya' bala Tuhan. Ui pangeh nengetacu dalan luk icuk Tuhan negku. Iamo' Agag raca' lun Amalek inuitku iné' tungé'. Iamo' amung lun Amalek ineh pangeh pinatéku.
english: Saul replied to Samuel, “Hey, I did what Yahweh sent me to do! I brought back King Agag, but we killed everyone else!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Semuil, "Pianké Tuhan ku luk barén sabpen idi luk kereten mepad kudeng Ieh pian ku lun luk maya' bala Tuhan? Setuneh baya' ineh meluun do' ratnan baré, idi beneh niat meluun do' ratnan ngeret dumba luk do'.
english: But Samuel replied, “Which do you think pleases Yahweh more, animals that are completely burned on the altar and other sacrifices, or people obeying him SYN? It is better to obey Yahweh than to offer sacrifices to him. It is better to pay attention to what he says than to burn the fat of rams, even though God said they should be sacrificed to him.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul, "Ui pangeh mesala', ngaceku ngelaba bala Tuhan idi bala diko teh. Ngaceku matot ui ku amung anak itinku. Idi ui nemaya' baladeh ineh.
english: Then Saul said to Samuel, “Yes, I have sinned. I disobeyed what you told me to do, which is what Yahweh commanded. I did that because I was ◄afraid of/worried about► what my men would say if I did not do what they wanted. So I did what they demanded.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Semuil, "Na ui sikal lemubed maya' namu. Ngaceku iko pangeh nengarung bala Tuhan. Idi Tuhan pana' pangeh nengarung namu, pad iko na mangun ku raca' lun Israil.”
english: But Samuel replied, “No, I will not go back with you. You have rejected/disobeyed what Yahweh commanded you to do. So he has rejected you, and declared that you will no longer be the king of Israel. So I do not want to talk any more with you.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Semuil neneh, "Idi aco sini teh Tuhan pana' ngerarak imet raca' Israil ineh rat namu, idi barénneh kuan lun luk meluun do' rat namu.
english: Samuel said to him, “You tore my robe! And today Yahweh has torn away from you the kingdom of Israel! He will appoint someone else to be king, someone who is a better man than you are.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul, "Ui pangeh mesala'. Iamo' ngedita' negku pa kiung amung lun rayeh lun pupuku idi pa kiung amung lun Israil. Do' lemubed maya' negku, pelé ui tekeradung sembayang inan Tuhan Allahmu.”
english: Then Saul pleaded again. He said, “I know that I have sinned. But please honor me in front of the leaders of the Israeli people and in front of all the other Israeli people by coming back to them with me in order that I may worship Yahweh your God.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Semuil, "Nguit ni Agag, raca' lun Amalek ineh amé' matun negku." Idi Agag iné' matun neneh dengan megegker niat, terawéneh, "Até ineh pelaba susa'.”
english: Then Samuel said, “Bring King Agag to me.” So they brought Agag to him. Agag was confidently expecting that they would spare him/not kill him. He was thinking, “Surely I will not have to endure an agonizing death!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Semuil, "Mepad kudeng pelapetmu pana' pangeh nenganau' tuda'- tuda' lun decur na anak, kudeng ineh teh tinanmu pana' na anak." Idi Semuil nengaté ni Agag, titek-titekneh pa kiung Tuhan déi' Gilgal.
english: But Samuel said to him, “You have killed the sons of many women with your sword, so now your mother will no longer have a son.” And Samuel cut Agag into pieces with his sword, there at Gilgal, in the presence of Yahweh.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Semuil, "Kudeng apeh ui miak amé'? Kudeng dalan ini nekali' Saul, kali' rungen ui pitayenneh." Idi kebala Tuhan, "Itenmu aceh anak sapi' idi mala, 'Ui ini amé' tungé' pian maré baré kuan Tuhan.'
english: But Samuel said, “I am afraid RHQ to do that! If Saul hears about it, he will kill me!” Yahweh said, “Take a ◄heifer/young female cow► with you, and say to people that you have come to kill it and offer it as a sacrifice to me.

lun_bawang: Idi Semuil nenganau' luk bida' Tuhan. Idi ieh iné' déi' Baitlahim. Idi nacing amung lun rayeh bawang ineh iné' papu' neneh dengan megegker, idi kebaladeh, "Do'ké acingmu ini?”
english: Samuel did what Yahweh told him to do. He went to Bethlehem. When the town leaders came to him, they trembled, because they were worried that Samuel had come to rebuke them about something. One of them asked him, “Have you come to speak peacefully to us?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh, "Do'. Lawéku ini pian maré baré kuan Tuhan. Ngeligan burur muyuh idi maya' negku." Idi ieh nengeligan ni Isai idi amung anak deléineh. Idi ieh nenawar nedeh amé' su luk inan maré ineh.
english: Samuel replied, “Yes. I have come peacefully, to make a sacrifice to Yahweh. Perform the rituals to make yourselves acceptable to Yahweh, and then come with me to where they will offer the sacrifice.” Then Samuel performed the ritual to make Jesse and his sons acceptable to God, and he also invited them to the sacrifice.

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh nacing idi Semuil nenier ni Eliab Isai. Idi keterawéneh, "Ineh ieh luk uen ngumau kuan Tuhan di lek.”
english: When they arrived there, Samuel looked at Jesse’s oldest son Eliab, and thought, “Surely this is the one whom Yahweh has appointed to be king!”

lun_bawang: Idi Isai nenawar ni Aminadab amé' papu' ni Semuil. Iamo' kebala Semuil, "Ieh ini pana' baken luk pinili' Tuhan.”
english: Then Jesse told his next oldest son Abinadab to step forward and walk in front of Samuel. But when he did that, Samuel said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”

lun_bawang: Idi Isai nenguit ni Sama papu' neneh. Iamo' kebala Semuil, "Ieh ini pana' baken luk pinili' Tuhan.”
english: Then Jesse told his next oldest son Shammah to step forward. He stepped forward, but Samuel said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”

lun_bawang: Kudeng ineh teh Isai nengecuk tudu' burur anak deléineh papu' ni Semuil. Iamo' kebala Semuil ni Isai, "Idi amung ini baken luk pinili' Tuhan.”
english: Similarly, Jesse told his other four sons to walk in front of Samuel. But Samuel said to Jesse, “Yahweh has not chosen any of these sons of yours.”

lun_bawang: Idi Semuil nengitun neneh, "Iniké amung anakmu?" Kebala Isai, "Inan teh ieh luk isuut. Iamo' ieh matar dumba." Idi kebala Semuil ni Isai, "Ngecuk nelun nguit neneh. Ngaceku na tau maré baré ineh kudeng na ieh macing tungé'.”
english: Then Samuel asked Jesse, “Do you have any other sons?” Jesse replied, “My youngest son is not here; he is out in the fields taking care of the sheep.” Samuel said, “Send someone to bring him here! We will not sit down to eat until he gets here.”

lun_bawang: Idi Isai nengecuk nelun nakap neneh. Idi anak adi' ineh do' taga, pingitneh mesia', idi do' matehneh. Idi kebala Tuhan ni Semuil, "Ini ieh luk pilinKu. Do' iko ngumau neneh!”
english: So Jesse sent someone to bring David there. And when David arrived, Samuel saw that he was handsome and healthy, and had bright eyes. Then Yahweh said, “This is the one whom I have chosen; anoint him to be king.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala amung lun tareh Saul neneh, "Idi seburur sétan sinima' Allah ngagap namu.
english: One of his servants said to him, “It is evident that an evil spirit sent by God is terrifying you.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul nedeh, "Do' muyuh nakap kuanku seburur luk mileh nateg giula' idi nguit neneh amé' negku.”
english: Saul replied, “Fine/Okay, find for me a man who can play the harp well, and bring him to me.”

lun_bawang: Idi Saul nengecuk nelun dukenneh amé' matun ni Isai, kebaladeh, "Ngecuk anakmu amé' negku, ieh ineh Daud luk matar dumba ineh.”
english: So Saul sent this message to Jesse: “Send your son David to me, the one who takes care of sheep.”

lun_bawang: Idi Saul nengecuk nelun duken amé' ni Isai, "Nima' Daud ngakem kuanku kidi-kidi, ngaceku ui pelaba éi' neneh.”
english: Then Saul sent a messenger  to Jesse to tell him, “I am pleased with David. Please let him stay here and work for me.”

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala lun Pilistin ineh, "Aco sini ui situnga ku amung lalud lun Israil; maré nekini aceh deléi amé' negku pad kai dueh pakub sebuleng.”
english: I defy/challenge you men of the Israeli army. Send me a man who will fight with me!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Isai ni Daud, "Ngalap kuan kinanakmu apat gatang setangal padé luk kiriki ini idi pulu' balad ruti ini. Idi nguit ineh mesaget amé' su luk inan nelupo kuan kinanakmu.
english: One day, Jesse said to David, “Here is a sack of roasted grain and ten loaves of bread. Take these quickly to your older brothers.

lun_bawang: Idi lun mula' ineh perigéi' mala bala luk ina di, kebaladeh, "Kudeng ineh luk ruen kuan lemulun luk ngaté neneh ineh muci.”
english: They told him the same thing that the other men had said, about what the king would do for anyone who killed Goliath.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud neneh, "Anun kekamenku luk dat? Ui ngitun mo'?”
english: David replied, “Have I done something wrong? I was merely asking a question!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud ni Saul, "Seburur pana' aleg metalang niatneh. Ngaceku ui sikal amé' pebunu' nelun Pilistin ineh.”
english: David told king Saul, “No one should ◄worry/become a coward► because of that Philistine man. I will go and fight with him!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Saul, "Na iko miak amé' pebunu' neneh, ngaceku iko ineh isuut teh. Idi ieh teh lun pebunu' rat isuut.”
english: Saul said to David, “You are only a young man, and he has been a very capable soldier all his life. So you are not able to go and fight with him!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Daud ni Saul, "Inan aceh kareb laba' ui matar dumba tamanku, nacing aceh balang, idi teh aceh beruang nengakem sebuleng dumba ratnan riudan ineh.
english: David replied, “I have been taking care of my father’s sheep for many years. Whenever a lion or a bear came and carried away a lamb,

lun_bawang: Idi Daud teh nengabet remiri binan pelapetneh pa luun ayungneh idi ieh nenutun nalan, iamo' na ieh pekalai. Idi Daud nepebala ni Saul, "Ui na miak nalan ku ini, ngaceku nateh ui nepekalai ku ini atun." Idi Daud nengelengu ayung ineh peh.
english: David put these things on. Then he fastened his sword over them, and tried to walk. But he could not walk, because he was not accustomed to wearing those things. So David said to Saul, “I cannot fight wearing all these things, because I am not accustomed to wearing them!” So he took them off.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ni Daud, "Iko ngerawé negku uko'ké, idi iko amé' matun negku nguit rukud?" Idi ieh nengediman ni Daud ku akangneh.
english: He said to David, “Are you coming to me with a stick because you think that I am a dog?” Then he called out to his gods to harm David.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nenguto ni Daud kebalaneh, "Amé' matun negku, idi ui maré uang bururmu kuan suit luk arang gawa' idi kuan pung luk bang pulung.”
english: He said to David, “Come here to me, and I will kill you and give your dead body to the birds and wild animals to eat!”

lun_bawang: Kareb Saul nenier ni Daud amé' matun ni Goliat, idi kebalaneh ni Abner lun rayeh bawehneh, "Abner, idéké anak ineh?" Idi kebala Abner, "O tuanku, ui na kali' anak idé ini.”
english: Then the king said, “Find out whose son he is!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul, "Do' ngitun ku anak idé ineh.”
english: Later, as David returned from killing Goliath, Abner took him to Saul. David was carrying Goliath’s head.

lun_bawang: Idi amung decur ineh menani, dengan mawang niat, kenanideh, "I Saul pangeh nengaté ribu-ribu. Iamo' i Daud nengaté tuda'-tuda' ngepulu' ribu.”
english: As they danced, they sang this song to each other: “Saul has killed 1,000 enemy soldiers, But David has killed 10,000 of them.”

lun_bawang: Idi Saul megateh niat, idi dat bala neneh. Idi kebalaneh, "Daud luk ruendeh nengaté tuda'-tuda' ngepulu' ribu. Iamo' ui nengaté ribu-ribu mo'. Idi kali' rungen kekipedneh ieh mangun ku raca'.”
english: When Saul heard them singing that, he did not like it. He became very angry. He said to himself, “They are saying that David killed 10,000 men, but that I have killed only 1,000. Soon they will want to make him their king!” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi i Saul nemayung busuneh, kebalaneh, "Do' ui mayung ni Daud pad busuku mepesut luun alad." Iamo' Daud nekuming macing dueh kua'.
english: and he hurled it at David, saying to himself, “I will fasten David to the wall with the spear!” He did that two times, but David jumped aside both times.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud ni Saul, "Idéké ui ini. Idi idéké uang tetek ruma'ku, pad ui mangun ku ibanmu?”
english: But David said to Saul, “I am not RHQ a very important person, and my family is not very important, and my clan is not a very important Israeli clan. So I do not deserve to become your son-in-law.” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi Saul nengecuk amung lun tarehneh kebalaneh, "Mada' ni Daud sebuleng. 'Idi raca' pian namu idi amung tarehneh pana' méi' namu. Idi do' iko ngalap anakneh.' “
english: Saul told his servants, “Talk to David privately, and say to him, ‘Listen, the king is pleased with you, and all of us his servants love you. So now we think that you should marry Michal and become the king’s son-in-law.’ ”

lun_bawang: Kareb amung tareh Saul ngacing bala ineh ni Daud, idi kebala Daud nedeh, "Malé mo' bang terawé muyuh ui mangun ku iban raca'. Iamo' ui ini lun masi' idi na mebala.”
english: So they told that to David. But David said, “It would be a great honor RHQ to become the king’s son-in-law. But I do not think that I should do that, because I am only a poor and insignificant man.”

lun_bawang: Idi tareh Saul nengacing bala Daud ni Saul.
english: When the servants told Saul what David had said,

lun_bawang: Idi Saul nengecuk nedeh mada' ni Daud, "Idi raca' na sikal ku purut baken ratnan meratu kubil lun Pilistin luk na sinunat peh, pelé ngacing ua' kuan bunu' raca'." (Ngaceku ulek Saul ngerawé Daud pitayen lun Pilistin.)
english: Saul replied, “Go and say to David, ‘In order for  the king to allow you to marry Michal, he wants you to kill 100 Philistines and cut off their foreskins and bring the foreskins to him to prove that you have killed them. In that way he will get revenge on his enemies.’ ” But what Saul wanted was that the Philistines would kill David while David was trying to kill them.

lun_bawang: Idi Yonatan nemada' ni Daud, kebalaneh, "Tamanku sikal ngaté namu. Ngaceku ineh nginita iko bururmu pekak nebpa. Do' iko sigapung su luk melinged, pad iko na kali' lun.
english: So he warned David, “My father Saul is seeking for a way to kill you. So be careful. Tomorrow morning go and find a place to hide in the field.

lun_bawang: Idi Yonatan nengubur ni Daud kuan Saul, kebalaneh neneh, "Aleg iko nganau' luk dat kuan Daud lun dukenmu ineh. Ngaceku ieh teh na sala' pa kiungmu. Iamo' kekamenneh petulu maya' luk pianmu.
english: The next morning, Jonathan spoke with his father, saying many good things about David. He said, “You should never do anything to harm your servant David! He has never done anything to harm you! Everything that he has done has helped you very much.

lun_bawang: Idi Saul neninger bala Yonatan, idi ieh nepebulung ku ngadan Tuhan, "Na tu ui ngaté ni Daud.”
english: Saul listened to what Jonathan said. Then Saul said, “I solemnly promise that just as certain as Yahweh lives, I will not kill David.”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb dacem ineh Saul nengecuk tuda'-tuda' lun amé' ruma' Daud, pelé ideh ngabang neneh idi ngaté neneh kareb pekak. Iamo' Mikal awanneh nemada' ni Daud, kebalaneh, "Kudeng iko na buro malem ini, kali' rungen nebpa iko maté.”
english: Then Saul sent messengers to David’s house. He told them to watch the house and to kill David while he was leaving the house the following morning. But David’s wife Michal saw them and warned him, “To survive, you must run away tonight, because if you do not do that, you will be killed tomorrow!”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb Saul nengecuk lun amé' ngalap ni Daud, kebala Mikal, "Ieh mét.”
english: When the messengers came to the house the next morning, she told them that David was sick and could not get out of bed.

lun_bawang: Idi Saul nengecuk nelun amé' nier ni Daud, kebalaneh, "Nguit neneh amé' negku perapu amung luk inanneh rudap, pelé ui miak ngaté neneh.”
english: When they reported that to Saul, he told them to go back to David’s house. He said to them, “Bring him to me lying on his bed, in order that I can kill him!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul ni Mikal, "Ngudeh iko nenaluk negku kudeng ini, pad iko nima' bunu'ku buro?" Idi kebala Mikal ni Saul, "Kebalaneh negku, 'Kudeng iko na muit negku, ui ngaté namu.' “
english: When they reported that to Saul, Saul summoned Michal and said to her, “Why did you trick me like that? You allowed my enemy to escape!” Michal replied to Saul, “David told me that if I did not help him escape, he would kill me!” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi lun nemada' ni Saul, kebaladeh, "Daud idi déi' Nayot luk déi' Rama.”
english: Someone told Saul that David was in Naioth.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh sebuleng iné' déi' Rama. Idi ieh nacing déi' subuk rayeh luk déi' Seku. Idi ieh nengitun, "Iapehké Semuil didueh Daud?" Idi kebaladeh, "Déi' Nayot luk déi' Rama.”
english: Finally, Saul himself went to Ramah. When he arrived at the well at a place named Secu, he asked people there, “Where are Samuel and David?” The people replied, “They are at Naioth in Ramah city.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengelengu ayungneh. Idi ieh sebuleng pana' mada' pa kiung Semuil. Idi ieh netelubid lubpa setebaco sekedangan. Idi ngaceku ineh kebala lun, "Idiké Saul arang nabi-nabi?"
english: There he took off his clothes, and he spoke messages from God in front of Samuel. He lay on the ground doing that all day and all night. That is the reason that when people see someone doing something that is very unexpected, they think about what happened to Saul, and they say, “We are surprised, like the people were surprised to see Saul acting like a prophet?” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi Daud neburo rat Nayot luk déi' Rama ineh. Idi ieh iné' matun ni Yonatan, kebalaneh, "Anunké luk inau'ku, idi anunké datku? Idi anun sala'ku pa kiung tamanmu, pad ieh pian ngaté negku?”
english: David ran away from the Naioth section of Ramah city. He went to Jonathan and asked him, “What have I done to displease your father? What did I do that was wrong? Why is he trying to kill me?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yonatan neneh, "Na miak kudeng ineh, na iko miak uen ngaté. Ngaceku tamanku na nganau' anun-anun, do' luk rayeh idi luk isuut luk na ginala'neh negku atun. Na miak i Ama' ngalum dalan luk kudeng ineh rat negku. Na ieh kudeng ineh.”
english: Jonathan replied, “My father is surely not trying to kill you! He always tells me before he does anything that he is planning. He tells me about important things and unimportant things that he plans to do. ◄Why would he refuse to tell me if he were planning to kill me?/I am sure that he would not refuse to tell me if he were planning to kill you.► RHQ So what you are saying cannot be true.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yonatan ni Daud, "Anun luk pianmu duken ui miak nganau'?”
english: Jonathan said to David, “I will do whatever you tell me to do.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud, "Idi nebpa Irau Bulan Baruh, idi pekalai aco sineh kuman pamung dengan raca'. Idi nekini do' iko nima' negku amé' sigapung déi' luun amug macing aco luk keteluh kareb malem.
english: David replied, “Tomorrow we will celebrate the Festival of the New Moon. I always eat with the king at that festival. But tomorrow I will hide in the field, and I will stay there for one night. I will stay there until the evening of the day after tomorrow.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yonatan, "Na miak kudeng ineh! Ngaceku kudeng ui kali' tamanku pian nganau' luk dat, ui miak maré klai' namu.”
english: Jonathan replied, “I will never do that! But if I find out that my father is determined to harm/kill you, I will certainly warn you.” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud, "Idéké miak maré kali' negku kudeng i tamam dat bala namu?”
english: David asked him, “How will I find out if your father answers you harshly?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yonatan, "Do' kiteh remuat amé' i natad." Idi didueh iné'.
english: Jonathan replied, “Come with me. We will go out into the field.” So they went together out into the field.

lun_bawang: aleg nima' ngadan Yonatan talan rat bang tetek ruma' Daud. Idi do' Tuhan ngua' kuan amung bunu' Daud.
english: David agreed. So Jonathan made a solemn agreement with David. And he said, “I hope/desire that Yahweh will get rid of all your enemies.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yonatan neneh, "Nebpa Irau Bulan Baruh idi kali' rungen lun ngitun namu, ngaceku kali'deh su inanmu ineh na uang.
english: Then Jonathan said, “Tomorrow we will celebrate the Festival of the New Moon. When you are not sitting at your place when we eat, my father will ◄miss you/see that you are not there►.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku terawéneh, "Kian inan bayengneh idi na ieh meligan lek.”
english: On that day, Saul did not say anything about David, because he was thinking, “Something must have happened that caused David to become unacceptable to worship God.”

lun_bawang: Idi kenebpa, ieh ineh seaco pangeh Irau Bulan Baruh ineh, kareb ideh kali' su luk inan Daud ineh na uang, idi kebala Saul ni Yonatan, "Anun pun anak Isai ineh na iné' bang irau i nalem idi aco sini pana'?”
english: But the next day, when David was not sitting at the place where he usually sat, Saul asked Jonathan, “Why has that son of Jesse not been here to eat with us yesterday and today?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yonatan, "Ngaceku Daud pangeh nemutuh negku nima' neneh amé' Baitlahim.
english: Jonathan replied, “David earnestly requested me that I permit him to go to Bethlehem.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yonatan, "Anun punneh pitayen? Anun luk pangeh inau'neh?”
english: Jonathan asked his father, “Why should David be executed? What wrong has he done?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh kuan anak ineh, "Amé' iko nakap ileb luk linatikku ineh." Idi anak ineh nupun, idi Yonatan nengelatik sebuleng ileb lemaba buduk uluhneh.
english: Jonathan said to the boy, “Run and find the arrows that I shoot.” The boy started running, and Jonathan shot an arrow ahead of the boy.

lun_bawang: Idi anak ineh nacing su inan ileb luk pangeh linatik Yonatan ineh. Idi Yonatan nenawar anak ineh, kebalaneh, "Mado ileb ineh rat namu!
english: When the boy ran to the place where the arrow hit the ground, Jonathan called out, “The arrow is further away!” RHQ

lun_bawang: Saget iko! Upun mo'! Aleg ugka'!" Idi anak ineh nengalap ileb ineh, idi ieh nelemubed amé' ni Yonatan.
english: Then he shouted to the boy, “Act quickly; do not wait! Do not stop!” The boy picked up the arrow and brought it back to Jonathan.

lun_bawang: Idi Yonatan nemaré binorneh kuan anak ineh, kebalaneh, "Amé' iko nguit ini amé' bang bawang.”
english: Then Jonathan gave his bow and arrows to the boy and told him, “Go back to the town.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yonatan ni Daud, "Do' Allah ngedengan namu. Kiteh pangeh nepejani' dengan ngadan Tuhan, kudeng ini, 'Tuhan idi arang kiteh idi arang pupuku dengan pupumu. Nima' jani' ineh meraben macing ruked-ruked.' " Pangeh ineh idi Daud negugkang nalan. Idi Yonatan nelemubed iné' bang bawang rayeh.
english: Jonathan said to David, “May things go well for you as you go. Yahweh has heard what we solemnly promised to always do for each other, and what we said that our descendants must do for each other.” Then David left, and Jonathan went back to the town.

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nacing déi' Nob idi iné' inan Imam Ahimalek. Idi Ahimalek iné' papu' ni Daud dengan megegker niat, kebalaneh, "Ngudeh iko buleng-buleng idi na lun baken denganmu?”
english: David fled from there and went to Nob city to see Ahimelech the priest. Ahimelech trembled when he saw David because he was afraid that something bad had happened. He said to David, “Why are you alone? Why have no men come with you?”

lun_bawang: Idi imam nengor bala Daud, kebalaneh, "Na ruti luk baken negku, iamo' ruti ligan mo' luk inan, kudeng anak adi' ineh pangeh nengimet bururdeh ratnan decur.”
english: The priest answered David, “There is no ordinary bread here, but I have some of the sacred bread that was placed before Yahweh. Your men may eat it if they have not slept with EUP women recently.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud ni Ahimalek, "Inanké busu kian pelapet lek? Na ui nenguit pelapet idi busu, ngaceku raca' nengecuk negku miket.”
english: David asked Ahimelech, “Do you have a spear or a sword that I could use? The king appointed us to do this task and told us to leave immediately, so I did not have time to bring any weapons.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala amung tareh Akis kuanneh, "Naké ieh ini Daud raca' bawang ineh? Naké lun mula' pangeh nemenani ngubur neneh, kebaladeh, 'Saul pangeh nengaté ribu-ribu lemulun. Iamo' Daud nengaté pulu' ribu?' “
english: But the officers of King Achish objected to David being there. They said to King Achish, “This man is RHQ David, the king of Israel! He is the one RHQ whom our enemies, the Israeli people, honored by dancing and singing, ‘Saul has killed thousands of his enemies, but David has killed tens of thousands of them!’”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Akis kuan amung lun tarehneh, "Naké muyuh kali' lun ini meruden, ngudeh muyuh nguit neneh amé' negku?
english: Then King Achish said to his men, “Look at this man! He is acting like an insane man! Why have you brought him to me?

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nenalan rat déi' iné' Mispa déi' Moab. Idi kebalaneh kuan raca' lun Moab ineh, "Nima' taman-tinanku mudeng denganmu, pad ui kali' anun luk ruen Allah kuanku.”
english: Later they left there and went east to Mizpah city in the Moab region. There David requested the king of Moab, “Please allow my father and mother to live here with you until I know what God is going to do for me.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Nabi Gad ni Daud, "Aleg iko tudo bang lubang batu ineh, iamo' do' iko mepura' amé' déi' tana' Yahuda." Idi Daud nepura' idi ieh iné' pulung Herit.
english: One day the prophet Gad told David, “Leave ◄your fortress/this area► and return to Judah.” So David and his men went to Hereth forest in Judah.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nelun rayehneh, "Ninger muyuh, O lun Beniamin, "Miak Daud maré nemuyuh amung tana' idi kabun anggur? Matuké ieh miak nganau' nemuyuh amung ku lun rayeh baweh?
english: He shouted to them, “You men of the tribe of Benjamin, listen to me! Do you think that the son of Jesse will give all of you fields and vineyards if he becomes your king? Will he appoint all of you to become generals and captains in his army RHQ?

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Doeg lun Edom luk tuped dengan amung lun rayeh Saul ineh, "Ui pangeh nenier ni Daud iné' matun Ahimalek Ahitub déi' Nob.
english: Doeg, a man from the Edom people-group, was standing there with Saul’s officers. He said to Saul, “When I was at Nob, I saw that son of Jesse talking to Ahimelech, the priest.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul, "Ninger iko O Ahimalek." Idi ieh nengor balaneh, "Anun idi, tuanku?”
english: Saul said to Ahimelech, “You son of Ahitub, listen to me!” Ahimelech answered, “Yes, sir!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Ahimalek, "Idi ratnan amung lun dukenmu, idé luk lutep kudeng Daud, ieh ineh ibanmu. Ieh mangun ku lun rayeh lun luk matar raca' idi ieh pana' buren bang ruma' raca'.
english: Ahimelech replied, “I do not understand why you are saying that, because David, your son-in-law, the captain of your bodyguards, is very loyal to you. No one is more loyal to you than David! Everyone in your household respects him very much.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala raca', "O Ahimalek, na miak na iko pitayen, dengan amung lun bang tetek ruma'mu.”
english: The king then shouted, “Ahimelech, you and your all your relatives are going to be executed right now!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' ni Doeg, "Do' iko ngaté amung imam ineh." Idi Doeg lun Edom ineh nengaté nedeh. Idi aco sineh ieh nengaté 85 burur imam Tuhan.
english: Then the king said to Doeg, “You kill them!” So Doeg, the man from the Edom people-group, went out and struck them with his sword. On that day he killed eighty-five men who were wearing the sacred vests because they were God’s priests.

lun_bawang: idi kebala Daud neneh, "Kali' ku aco sineh Doeg lun Edom ineh déi', idi na miak na badénneh lawé ineh kuan Saul muci. Idi amung lun bang tetek ruma' tamam pangeh pinaté ngaceku ideh nengedengan negku.
english: Then David said to him, “That man from the Edom people-group, Doeg, was there at Nob on the day that I was there. I knew that he would surely tell Saul what happened. So it is my fault that your father and all of his family have been killed.

lun_bawang: Daud neninger bala ratnan lun Pilistin ngerieng bawang Kila, idi ratnan ideh nengaro padédeh.
english: One day someone told David, “You need to know that the Philistia army is attacking Keilah town and they are stealing grain from where men are threshing it.”

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nengitun inan Tuhan, kebalaneh, "Miakké ui amé' ngelaya' nelun Pilistin ineh?" Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Amé' mo'. Idi iko miak ngelaya' nelun Pilistin ineh, idi muit Kila rat nedeh.”
english: David asked Yahweh, “Should my men and I go to fight against those men from the Philistia people-group?” Yahweh answered, “Yes, go. Attack them, and rescue the people of Keilah.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala lun luk maya' ni Daud, "Su ini tana' Yahuda luk katot tau. Meluun teh bawang Kila luk ulek tau amé' pebunu' nelun Pilistin.”
english: But David’s men said to him, “We are afraid that Saul will attack us here in Judah. We will be more afraid if we go to Keilah where the Philistia army is!”

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nengitun inan Tuhan sekua' teh. Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Nalan iko idi amé' déi' Kila. Ngaceku amung lun Pilistin ineh barénKu bang paladmu.”
english: So David asked Yahweh again if they should go to Keilah. Yahweh answered, “Yes, go down to Keilah. I will help you to defeat the men of the Philistia people-group.”

lun_bawang: Saul neninger bala ratnan Daud pangeh nacing déi' Kila, idi kebalaneh, "Allah pangeh nemaré neneh bang paladku, ngaceku ieh pangeh linibung bang bawang luk meraben tanga' idi pilin.”
english: Soon Saul found out that David was at Keilah. So he said, “That is good! God is enabling me to capture him! He has trapped himself in that town, because it has high walls with gates around it.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Daud nekali' Saul pian nganau' luk dat kuanneh, idi kebalaneh inan Imam Abiatar, "Nguit kakeb ruuk imam ineh amé' tungé'.”
english: But David found out that Saul was planning for his army to attack him. So he said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring here the sacred vest.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Daud, "O Tuhan Allah lun Israil, ui pangeh neninger bala ratnan Saul pian amé' tungé' Kila, sikal ngusag bawang ngaceku ui.
english: So when Abiathar brought it, David prayed, “Yahweh, God of us Israelis, I have heard that Saul is planning to come here with his army and destroy Keilah because I am here.

lun_bawang: Matuké lun bang bawang Kila ineh pian maré negku bang paladneh? Matuké Saul sikal amé' mepad kudeng luk pindengerku? O Tuhan Allah lun Israil, maré kali' kuanku." Idi kebala Tuhan, "Matu Saul amé'.”
english: Will Saul come down here to Keilah, as people reported to me? Will the leaders of Keilah enable Saul to capture me? Yahweh, God of us Israelis, please tell me!” Yahweh answered, “Yes, Saul will come down.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud teh, "Matuké lun bang bawang Kila ini pian maré negku idi amung lun denganku bang palad Saul?" Idi kebala Tuhan, "Matu, ideh pian maré namu.”
english: Then David asked, “Will the leaders of Keilah enable Saul’s army to capture me and my men if we stay here?” By means of the stones in the sacred vest, Yahweh replied, “Yes, they will.”

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh neneh, "Aleg iko matot, ngaceku tamanku Saul na miak ngesusa' namu. Iamo' iko teh miak mangun ku raca' muci pa luun lun Israil. Idi ui mangun ku luk kedueh pa liangmu. Idi kali' tamanku Saul lawé ineh do'-do' teh.”
english: Jonathan told him, “Do not be afraid, because my father will not be able to harm IDM you. Some day you will be the king of Israel, and I will be the second most important man in Israel. My father Saul also knows that.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' tuda'-tuda' lun Sip iné' matun ni Saul déi' Gibia, kebaladeh, "Daud sigapung muneng nekai bang lubang batu déi' Hores, luun Surud Hakila, déi' su luk ali-ali Yahuda luk pa kabing busat aco.
english: Some people from Ziph went to Saul when he was at Gibeah, and they told him, “David and his men are hiding in our land RHQ! They are hiding in places at Horesh on Hakilah Hill, south of a place named Jeshimon.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul, "Do' Tuhan ngeperuan nemuyuh ngaceku muyuh méi' negku.
english: Saul replied, “I hope/desire that Yahweh will bless you for telling that to me.

lun_bawang: Idi denak-denak aceh lun icuk iné' matun ni Saul, kebalaneh, "Do' iko amé' dengan mesaget. Ngaceku lun Pilistin pangeh nengaro bawang tau.”
english: But then a messenger came to Saul and said to him, “Come quickly! The Philistia army is attacking the people in our land!”

lun_bawang: Kareb Saul nelemubed ratnan ngerada' nelun Pilistin ineh, idi lun nemada' neneh, kebaladeh, "Daud idi déi' su luk ali-ali muneng ku Enggedi.”
english: After Saul and his soldiers returned home after fighting against the Philistia army, someone reported to Saul that David and his men had gone into the desert near En-Gedi.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh kuan lun denganneh, "Na petulu pa kiung Tuhan kudeng ui ngesusa' raca' luk pangeh pinili' Tuhan.”
english: He said to his men, “I should not have done that to the king! I hope/desire that Yahweh will never allow me to attack the one whom God has appointed, because Yahweh is the one who chose him to be the king.”

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nudur teh idi neremuat rat bang lubang batu ineh. Idi ieh nengitang rat pa puet Saul, kebalaneh, "O tuanku, O raca'ku!" Idi Saul nelumi. Idi Daud netekeradung pa kiung raca',
english: After Saul left the cave and started to walk on the road again, David came out of the cave and shouted to Saul, “King Saul!” Saul turned around and looked, and David bowed down with his face touching the ground.

lun_bawang: idi kebalaneh ni Saul, "Ngudehké iko ninger bala dulun luk mala, Daud sikal ngedat namu?
english: Then he said to Saul, “◄Why do you pay attention to people when they say ‘David wants to harm you’?/You should not pay attention to people when they say ‘David wants to harm you’.► RHQ

lun_bawang: Kareb Daud pangeh nemada' amung bala ini ni Saul, idi kebala Saul neneh, "Iniké iko, O Daud, anakku?" Idi Saul nenangi'.
english: When David finished speaking, Saul called out to him and asked, “My son David, is that your voice that I am hearing?” Then he began to cry loudly.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ni Daud, "Iko luk meluun matu rat negku, ngaceku iko pangeh nenganau' do' kuanku. Iamo' ui pangeh nenganau' dat kuanmu.
english: He said, “You are a better man than I am. You have done something very good to me when I tried to do something very bad to you.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengecuk pulu' anak adi' amé' Karmel nakap ni Nabal idi maré tabi' kuanneh.
english: So David told ten of his men, “Go to Nabal at Carmel and greet him for me.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Nabal nedeh, "Idéké Daud ineh? Idi idéké anak Isai ineh? Idi nekini mula' lun duken luk buro ratnan tuandeh.
english: He said to them, “Who does this man, this son of Jesse, think that he is? DOU, RHQ There are many slaves who are running away from their masters at the present time, and it seems to me that he is just one of them.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud, "Do' anid-anid muyuh ngabin pelapet!" Idi ideh nengabin pelapetdeh ineh. Idi Daud sebuleng pana' nengabin pelapetneh. Idi amungdeh ineh nalan maya' ni Daud, 400 kinula'deh. Idi 200 burur ketecan matar amung repapehdeh.
english: When David heard that, he told his men, “We are going to kill Nabal; fasten your swords!” So he fastened on his sword and about 400 men fastened on their swords and went with David. There were 200 of his men who stayed with their supplies.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala seburur demulun Nabal ni Abigail awan Nabal ineh, "Daud pangeh nengecuk nelun rat su luk ali-ali maré tabi' kuan tuan kai. Iamo' tuan kai museh nedeh.
english: One of Nabal’s servants found out what David and his men were planning to do, so he went to Nabal’s wife Abigail and said to her, “David sent some messengers from the desert to greet our master Nabal, but Nabal only yelled at them.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nelun dukenneh, "Nalan muyuh pa atunku. Idi ui amé' maya' puet." Idi anun-anun pana' nateh bida'neh ni Nabal awanneh ratnan lawé ineh.
english: Then she told her servants, “Go ahead of me. I will follow you.” But she did not tell her husband what she was going to do.

lun_bawang: Idi keterawé Daud, "Setuneh mo'-mo' ui nematar amung binaweh idi aya' lun ineh déi' su luk ali-ali, pad sebuleng anun-anun pana' nateh netutu' ratnan amung binawehneh. Idi ieh pangeh nengua' do'ku ku luk dat.
english: David had been saying to his men, “It was useless for us to protect that man and all his possessions here in this desert. We did not steal anything that belonged to him, but he has done evil to me in return for our good things we did for him.

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "O tuan, ui sebuleng mo' luk mabeh sala' ini. Nima' negku pebala namu idi ninger balaku namu.
english: Then she prostrated herself at David’s feet and said to him, “Sir, I deserve to be punished for what my husband has done. Please listen to what I say to you.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud ni Abigail, "Amung ubur kuan Tuhan Allah lun Israil luk nengecuk namu amé' matun negku aco sini.
english: David replied to Abigail, “I praise Yahweh, the God whom we Israelis worship, because he sent you to talk with me.

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nengalap rat neneh binaweh luk pangeh tinatedneh kuanneh. Idi kebalaneh neneh, "Muli' iko dengan do'. Ngaceku ui pangeh neninger balamu, idi ui maya' balamu.”
english: Then David accepted the gifts that Abigail had brought to him. He said to her, “I hope/desire that things will go well for you. I have heard what you said, and I will do what you have requested.”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb lun luk icuk Daud ineh nacing ni Abigail déi' Karmel, idi ideh nengitun neneh, kebaladeh, "Daud pangeh nengecuk nekai ini, ngaceku ieh pian ngalap namu ku awanneh.”
english: His servants went to Carmel and said to Abigail, “David sent us to take you to become his wife.”

lun_bawang: Idi Abigail netekeradung, kebalaneh, "Nima' negku maru' kukud lun duken tuanku.”
english: Abigail bowed down with her face touching the ground. Then she told the messengers to tell David, “I am happy to become your wife. I will be your servant. And I am willing to wash the feet of your slaves.”

lun_bawang: Idi lun Sip ineh iné' matun ni Saul déi' Gibia, kebaladeh, "Naké Daud ineh sigapung luun Surud Hakila, iring su luk ali-ali?”
english: One day some of the people of Ziph town went to Saul while he was at Gibeah, and they said to him, “David is hiding in a cave on Hakilah hill, across from Jeshimon town.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud ni Ahimalek lun Hiti ineh, idi ni Abisai anak Seruya kinanak Yoab ineh, "Idé' sikal maya' negku amé' matun ni Saul su luk inandeh nelupo ineh?" Idi kebala Abisai, "Ui sikal amé'.”
english: David went back to where his men were and talked to Ahimelech, who was from the Heth people-group, and Joab’s brother Abishai, whose mother was David’s older sister Zeruiah. He asked them, “Who will go with me down into the camp where Saul is?” Abishai replied, “I will go with you.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Abisai ni Daud, "Bang aco sini bunu'mu pangeh biré Allah bang paladmu. Do' ui mayung neneh sekua' mo' ku busuneh ineh, pad ieh petatem luun tana', idi ieh petacu maté.”
english: Abishai whispered to David, “Today Yahweh has enabled us to kill your enemy! Allow me to fasten Saul to the ground by thrusting my spear into him. It will be necessary for me to strike him only once. I will not need to strike him twice.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Daud ni Abisai, "Aleg iko ngaté neneh. Ngaceku Tuhan ngukum lemulun luk ngaté lun luk pinili'Neh ku raca'“
english: But David whispered to Abishai, “No, do not kill Saul. Yahweh has appointed him to be king, so Yahweh will surely RHQ punish anyone who kills him.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud, "Ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan luk mulun. Idi Tuhan miak ngukum ni Saul, pad ieh maté. Kian ieh maté kareb pebunu' lek.
english: Just as surely as Yahweh lives, he himself will punish Saul. Perhaps Yahweh will strike him when it is Saul’s time to die, or perhaps Saul will be killed in a battle.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengitang nawar amung baweh ineh idi Abner Ner pana', kebalaneh, "Naké iko miak ngor, O Abner?" Idi Abner nengor balaneh, "Idéké iko luk nawar raca'?”
english: Then David shouted to Abner, “Abner, can you hear me?” Abner woke up and replied “Who are you, waking up the king by calling out to him?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud ni Abner, "Naké iko lun deléi? Idéké luk mepad kudeng iko rat arang amung lun Israil? Anun punneh iko na nginita tuanmu, raca' ineh? Ngaceku ina seburur rat arang lun mula' nacing sikal ngaté tuanmu, raca' ineh.
english: David replied, “I am sure that you are the greatest man in Israel IRO, RHQ! So why did you not guard your master, the king? Someone came into your camp in order to kill your master, the king.

lun_bawang: Idi Saul miti arod Daud, kebalaneh, "Iniké balamu, O Daud, anakku?" Idi Daud nengor balaneh, "O raca', ini ui.”
english: The shouting woke  Saul up and he recognized that it was David’s voice. He called out, saying, “My son David, is that your voice?” David replied, “Yes, your majesty it is my voice.”

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebalaneh, "Anun punneh ikongerada' negku kudengineh? Idianunké luk inau'ku? Idi dat anunké luk nekali'mu?
english: Then David added, “Sir, why are you pursuing me RHQ? What wrong have I done RHQ?

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul, "Ui pangeh mesala'. Muli' O anakku Daud. Ngaceku na ui sikal nganau' dat peh kuanmu. Ngaceku aco sini, iko méi' negku. Ui mebacé idi neraruh!”
english: Then Saul said, “David, my son. I have sinned by trying to kill you. So come back home. Today you have considered my life to be very valuable and so you have not killed me. So I will not try to harm you. I have made a big mistake and have acted foolishly.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud, "Siruh, ini busumu. Nekini ngecuk seburur rat arang bawehmu amé' tungé' ngalap ineh.
english: David replied, “ will leave your spear here. Send one of your young men here to get it.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul ni Daud, "Samal kuanmu O anakku Daud! Anun-anun luk ruenmu miak mangun." Idi Daud nelemubed. Idi Saul pana' nuli'.
english: Then Saul said to David, “My son David, I pray that Yahweh will bless you. You will do great things very successfully.” Then David returned to his men, and Saul went back home.

lun_bawang: Kareb Akis nengitun neneh, "Iné' pebunu' iapeh iko sekua' ini?" Idi kebala Daud, "Déi' Negeb bang bawang Yahuda," kian, "Déi' Negeb bang bawang lun Yeramil," kian, "Déi' Negeb bang bawang lun Keni.”
english: Each time Achish would ask David, “Where did you go raiding today?” David would lie to him. Sometimes he would reply that they had gone to the southern part of Judah, and sometimes he would say that they had gone to Jerahmeel, or to the area where the Ken people-group lived.

lun_bawang: Idi Akis merapet ni Daud, keterawéneh, "Ieh pangeh nenganau' luk inan pupuneh lun Israil megateh neneh. Idi ngaceku ineh ieh miak mangun ku lun dukenku macing ruked-ruked."
english: So Achish believed what David told him, and said to himself, “Because of what David has done, his own people, the Israelis, must now hate him very much. So he will have to stay here and serve me forever.”

lun_bawang: Idi muci' ratnan ineh lun Pilistin nengamung bawehdeh pian amé' munu' nelun Israil. Idi kebala Akis ni Daud, "Kali'mu na miak na iko maya' negku bang baweh ineh, do' iko, idi amung anak itinmu.”
english: Some time later, the people of Philistia gathered their army to attack the Israelis again. King Achish told David, “I am expecting that you and your men will join with my men to attack the Israelis.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud ni Akis, "Do', iko miak nier muci anun luk miak ruenku." Idi kebala Akis ni Daud, "Mo, iko miak nginita bururku ruked ulunku.”
english: David replied, “We will go with you, and then you will see for yourself what we can do!” Achish said, “Okay, I will appoint you to be my bodyguard permanently.”

lun_bawang: Idi Saul nepebulung neneh ku ngadan Tuhan, kebulungneh, "Ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan luk mulun. Na tu-tu ikko ngalap susa' ngaceku kekamenmu ini.”
english: Saul replied, solemnly asking Yahweh to listen to what he was saying, “Just as surely as Yahweh lives, you will not be punished for doing this.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala decur ineh, "Idéké luk pianmu uen ngacing namu?" Kebalaneh, "Ngacing Semuil kuanku.”
english: Then the woman said, “Whom do you want me to cause to appear?” Saul replied, “Cause Samuel to appear.”

lun_bawang: Idi decur ineh nenier ni Semuil. Idi ieh nengitang, kebalaneh ni Saul, "Ngudeh iko naluk negku? Ngaceku iko ini Raca' Saul.”
english: So the woman did that. But when she saw Samuel, she screamed. She said, “You have tricked me RHQ! You are Saul! You will execute me for doing this!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' neneh, "Aleg iko matot. Anun luk siniermu ineh?" Idi kebala decur ineh, "Ui nier inan aceh ada' remuat rat bang tana'.”
english: Saul said to her, “Do not be afraid. What do you see?” The woman said, “I see a god/spirit coming up out of the ground.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Saul neneh, "Kudeng apeh ayuneh?" Kebala decur ineh, "Luk macing ineh seburur lun mengered luk ubpu ku tarub." Idi Saul nekali' ieh ineh Semuil. Idi ieh netekeradung pa kiungneh.
english: Saul said, “What does he look like?” The woman replied, “An old man wearing a robe is appearing.” Then Saul knew that it was Samuel. So he bowed down with his face touching the ground.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Semuil, "Ngudeh iko ngitun negku? Ngaceku Tuhan pangeh nenecan namu idi pangeh mangun ku bunu'mu.
english: Samuel said, “Yahweh has abandoned you and has become your enemy. So why do you ask me what you should do? RHQ

lun_bawang: Iamo' na Saul pian, kebalaneh, "Ara' ui kuman." Idi lun duken nengubuk neneh, idi decur ineh teh, pad ieh nemaya' ubukdeh ineh. Idi ieh nudur rat luun tana', idi tudo luun bitaran.
english: But Saul refused. He said, “No, I will not eat anything.” Then Saul’s servants also urged him to eat something, and finally he heeded what they said. He got up from the ground and sat on the bed.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Akis ni Daud, "Ui kali' namu na sala' pa kiungku, iamo' iko mepad kudeng melaikat Allah. Iamo' amung raca' lun Pilistin nepebala, 'Aleg maré neneh maya' netau amé' pebunu'.'
english: Achish replied, “I know that you are as just as good as an angel from God. But the commanders of my army have said, ‘We will not allow David and his men to go with us into the battle.’

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud inan Imam Abiatar Ahimalek, "Nguit kakeb ruuk imam ineh kuanku." Idi Abiatar nenguit ineh kuanneh.
english: David did not know what to do, so he said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring to me the sacred vest.” So Abiathar brought it,

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nengitun Tuhan, kebalaneh, "Kudeng ui ngerada' baweh ineh miak ideh mepigketku?" Idi Tuhan nengor balaneh, "Ngerada' mo' nedeh, ngaceku na miak na iko ngepigket nedeh. Idi kali' rungen iko miak muit amungdeh luk tiban ineh.”
english: and David asked Yahweh, “Should I and my men pursue the men who took our families? Will we be able to catch up to them?” Yahweh answered by means of the stones in Abiathar’s sacred pouch, “Yes, pursue them. You will catch up to them, and you will be able to rescue your families.”

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nengitun neneh, kebalaneh, "Idé kuan namu ini? Idi rat iapeh iko?" Idi kebala lun Masir ineh, "Ui ini seburur demulun lun Amalek. Idi ui tican tuanku ngaceku ui mét. Idi nekini pangeh mela teluh aco.
english: David asked him, “Who is your master? And where do you come from?” He replied, “I am from Egypt. I am a slave of a man from the Amalek people-group. Three days ago my master left me here, because I was sick and I was not able to go with them.

lun_bawang: Idi teh Daud nengalap amung amék, dumba, idi sapi'. Idi ideh nemabpet puet amung aya' ineh, kebaladeh, "Ini binaweh Daud.”
english: They took with them the sheep and cattle that had been captured, and his men caused those animals to go in front of them, saying, “These are animals that we captured in the battle; they belong to David!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Daud, "Aleg muyuh nganau' kudeng ineh, O kinanak- kinanakku. Binaweh ini pangeh biré Tuhan kuan tau, idi Tuhan pangeh nengasa' netau, idi Ieh nemare baweh luk pangeh nacing munu' netau ineh bang palad tau.
english: David replied, “No, my fellow Israelis, it would not be right to divide up like that the things that Yahweh has allowed us to capture. Yahweh has protected us and enabled us to defeat the enemies who attacked our town.

lun_bawang: Kareb Daud nacing déi' Siklag, idi ieh nemaré ratnan binaweh ineh kuan amung lun rayeh Yahuda luk rurumneh, kebalaneh, "Ini aceh samal luk icing kuan muyuh ratnan binaweh bunu' Tuhan,”
english: When David and all the others arrived in Ziklag, David sent to his friends who were leaders in Judah some of the things that they had captured from the Amalek people-group. He said to them, “Here is a present for you. These are things that we took from Yahweh’s enemies.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Daud neneh, "Rat iapeh iko?" Kebalaneh neneh, "Ui neburo ratnan baweh lun Israil.”
english: David asked him, “Where have you come from?” The man replied, “I escaped from where the Israeli army had been camped.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud neneh, "Anun luk mangun bang bunu' ineh?" Idi ieh nemada' neneh kudeng apeh lun mula' ineh pangeh neburo ratnan bunu' idi mula' anak itin luk pangeh pinaté. Idi teh Saul idi Yonatan anakneh teh pangeh pinaté.
english: David asked him, “What happened? Tell me about the battle!” The man replied, “The Israeli soldiers ran away from the battle. Many of them were killed. And Saul and his son Jonathan ◄are dead/were also killed►.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud kuan anak adi' luk nenguit bala ineh kuanneh, "Kudeng apeh iko kali' lawé Saul idi Yonatan anakneh pangeh naté?”
english: David said to the young man, “How do you know that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala anak adi'ineh, "Ngaceku ui nepetulu nacing luun Pegkung Gilboa. Idi Saul pucang luun busuneh, idi tuda'-tuda' keréta idi lun maya' kuda teh nengerieng neneh.
english: The young man replied, “It happened that I was on Gilboa Mountain where the battle occurred, and I saw Saul, leaning on his spear. The enemy chariots and their drivers had come very close to Saul.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud inan anak adi' luk nenguit bala ineh kuanneh, "Rat iapeh iko?" Kebalaneh, "Ui ini anak lun Amalek luk tudo bang bawangmu.”
english: Then David asked the young man who had told him about the battle, “Where are you from?” He replied, “My father is a descendant of Amalek, but we live in Israel.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud neneh, "Kudeng apeh iko na matot ngaté raca' luk pinili' Tuhan?”
english: David asked him, “◄Why were you not afraid that you would be punished if you killed Saul, whom Yahweh had appointed MTY to be the king?/You should have been afraid that you would be punished if you killed Saul, whom Yahweh had appointed MTY to be the king.► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nenawar seburur lun dukenneh, idi kebalaneh, "Do' ngaté neneh." Idi ieh nengaté nelun Amalek.
english: You yourself said, ‘I killed the man whom Yahweh appointed to be the king.’ So you have caused yourself to be guilty MTY of causing your own death!” Then David summoned one of his soldiers and said to him, “Kill him!” So the soldier killed him by striking him with a sword.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud neneh, "Iko nengacing atému sebuleng, ngaceku iko nengukum bururmu sebuleng kareb iko nengamo ratnan iko nengaté raca' luk pinili' Tuhan ineh.”
english: Then David composed/wrote this sad song about Saul and Jonathan,

lun_bawang: "Lun rayeh tau pangeh naté luun pegkung Israil! Amung lun mesangit pangeh naté!
english: “Do not tell it to our enemies in the Philistia area; do not tell to the people who live in Gath city what happened; do not proclaim it in the streets of Ashkelon city, because if you tell them, even the women in that area will be happy; do not allow those ◄pagan women/women who do not know God► to rejoice.

lun_bawang: Muci ratnan ineh Daud nengitun Tuhan, kebalaneh, "Miakké ui amé' ngalap aceh bawang Yahuda?" Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Miak." Idi kebala Daud, "Bawang sapeh luk miak ulekku?" Idi kebala Tuhan, "Hebron.”
english: Some time after that, David asked Yahweh, “Should I go back to live in one of the towns in Judah?” Yahweh replied, “Yes, go up there.” Then David asked, “To which town should I go?” Yahweh replied, “To Hebron.”

lun_bawang: Idi lun Yahuda nacing, idi ideh nengumau ni Daud mangun ku raca' amung lun Yahuda. Kareb Daud nekali' bala ratnan lun Yabis idi lun Giliad pangeh nenanem butung Saul,
english: Then the men of Judah came to Hebron, and one of them poured olive oil on David’s head to show they were appointing him to be MTY the king of the tribe MTY of Judah. When David found out that the people of Jabesh town in the Gilead region had buried Saul’s body,

lun_bawang: idi ieh nengecuk nelun duken nguit bala kuandeh, kebaladeh nedeh, "Samal kuan muyuh ratnan Tuhan, ngaceku muyuh pangeh lutep ngakem kuan tuan muyuh, ieh ineh kuan Saul pad muyuh nenanem neneh.
english: he sent messengers to the men of Jabesh to tell them this: “I desire/hope that Yahweh will bless you for having shown, by burying the body of Saul your king, that you were loyal to him.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Abner ni Yoab, "Do' tau ngecuk tuda'-tuda' anak adi' mudur amé' marot pelapet pa kiung tau." Kebala Yoab, "Do ineh.”
english: Abner said to Joab, “Let’s tell some of our young men to fight each other!” Joab replied, “Okay!”

lun_bawang: Idi Abner nelumi idi nengitun, kebalaneh, "Iniké iko, O Asahel?" Kebalaneh, "Ui ini.”
english: Abner looked behind him, and said “Is that you, Asahel?” Asahel replied, “Yes!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Abner neneh, "Aleg ngerada' negku. Do' iko ngerada' seburur lun pebunu' idi ngaro anun-anun luk neneh." Iamo' Asahel na sikal ugka' ngerada' neneh.
english: Abner yelled at him, “Turn to one side or the other, and pursue someone else!” But Asahel would not stop pursuing Abner.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Abner neneh, "Aleg ngerada' negku. Ngudeh iko nganau' negku ngaté namu? Kudeng apeh ui miak nier kiung Yoab kinanakmu ineh muci?”
english: So Abner yelled at him again, “Stop ◄chasing after/pursuing► me! ◄Why should I kill you?/It would not be good for me to kill you!► RHQ If I did that, ◄how could I <face/be reconciled with> your brother Joab?/it would be very difficult for me to <face/be reconciled with> your brother Joab.► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yoab, "Ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan luk mulun. Kudeng na iko nepebala, kali' rungen ideh na ugka' pad macing pekak nebpa.”
english: Joab replied, “Just as surely as God lives, if you had not said that, my soldiers would have continued pursuing your men until tomorrow morning!”

lun_bawang: Idi atun Saul inan aceh apidneh ngadanneh Rispa Aya. Idi kebala Isboset ni Abner, "Ngudeh iko nepamung dengan apid tamanku?”
english: When Saul was alive, he had as one of his wives a slave woman named Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah. But one day Abner had sexual relations with her. So Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you had sexual relations with EUP my father’s slave wife?”

lun_bawang: Idi Abner nengecuk tuda'-tuda' lun duken amé' matun ni Daud déi' Hebron, kabalaneh, "Idéké kuan tana' ini? Do' iko pejani' negku, idi kali' rungen ui ngedengan namu, pelé ngelubed amung lun Israil kuanmu.”
english: David sent back this reply: “Good! I am willing to make an agreement with you. But before that happens, there is one thing that you must do. When you come to see me, you must bring my wife Michal, Saul’s daughter.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud, "Do', ui sikal pejani' namu. Iamo' aceh luk belénku namu, iko na miak amé' negku kareb nateh iko nated ni Mikal anak Saul ineh.”
english: Then David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, to say to him, “I had to kill 100 men from Philistia and cut off their foreskins to give to Saul to pay for Michal to be my wife. So now give her back to me!”

lun_bawang: Idi teh Daud nengecuk nelunduken amé' matun Isboset anak Saul ineh, kebalaneh, "Maré negku Mikal luk pangeh ilapku ku awanku dengan meratu kubil lun Pilistin.”
english: So Ishbosheth sent some men to take Michal from her husband Palti. But when they took her, her husband followed them all the way to Bahurim town, crying as he went.

lun_bawang: Idi awanneh nenalan maya' puetneh idi ieh nenangi' macing déi' Bahurim. Idi kebala Abner neneh, "Do' iko muli'." Idi ieh nuli'.
english: Abner went to the Israeli leaders and talked with them. He said, “For a long time you have wanted David to be your king.

lun_bawang: Idi Abner iné' nelun rayeh Israil, kebalaneh, "Pangeh mio muyuh pian ni Daud mangun ku raca' muyuh.
english: So now you have an opportunity to do that. Keep in mind that Yahweh promised this: ‘With the help of David, who serves me well, I will rescue my people from the people of Philistia, and from the power MTY of all their other enemies’.”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb Yoab nacing dengan amung baweh ineh, idi ieh neninger bala ratnan Abner pangeh iné' matun raca' idi ieh pangeh nenima' neneh nalan dengan do'.
english: So Joab went to the king and said, “Why have you done that? Listen to me! Abner is your enemy, but when he came to you, you allowed him RHQ to leave!

lun_bawang: Idi Yoab iné' matun raca'kebalaneh, "Anunké luk inau'mu? Abner pangeh iné' matun namu. Ngudeh iko nenima' neneh nalan pad ieh nenalan dengan do'?
english: Do you not know that he came to you to deceive you and to find out everything that you are doing, and all the places that you go to?”

lun_bawang: Kareb Daud nekali' bala ineh idi ieh nepebala, "Tuhan kali' negku idi anak itinku na mesala' ratnan até Abner ineh.
english: I hope/desire that Joab and all his family will be punished MTY for doing that! I hope/desire that there will always be someone in his family who has sores, or someone who is a leper, or some man who is forced to do women’s work, or someone who is killed in a battle, or someone who does not have enough food to eat!”

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nengecuk ni Yoab idi amung anak itinneh narak ayungdeh, idi nacung, pad ideh temido ni Abner. Idi Raca' Daud sebuleng pana' nemaya' lungunneh.
english: They buried Abner’s body at Hebron. And at the grave, the king cried loudly, and all the other people also cried.

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nenganau' aceh tido kuan Abner, ketidoneh, Ngudeh Abner naté mepad kudeng lun luk mebacé?
english: No one tied his hands or put chains on his feet, like they do to criminals. No, he was murdered by wicked men!”

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh idi lun mula' nacing ngubuk ni Daud kuman ruti kareb nateh aco macep. Iamo' ieh nepebulung, kebulungneh, "Do' Allah ngukum negku kudeng ui kuman ruti idi anun akan luk baken atun ratnan aco macep!”
english: All the people saw what David did, and they were pleased. Truly, everything that the king did pleased the people.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' kuan amung lun tarehneh, "Naké muyuh kali' aco sini aceh burur lun rayeh pangeh naté arang amung lun Israil?
english: Even though Yahweh appointed me to be the king, today I feel weak. These two sons of Zeruiah, Joab and Abishai, are very violent; I cannot control them. So I hope/desire that Yahweh will punish them severely in return for this wicked thing that they have done!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Daud nedidueh, "Ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan luk mulun luk pangeh nemuit negku ratnan amung dereh.
english: But David replied to them, “Yahweh is the one who has rescued me from all my troubles. And just as surely as Yahweh lives, what I am now saying is also true.

lun_bawang: Idi amung inul pupu Israil iné' matun ni Daud déi' Hebron. Idi kebaladeh neneh, "Tau ini sebuleng inul.
english: Then the leaders of all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron, and said to him, “Listen, we have the same ancestors IDM that you do.

lun_bawang: Idi Raca' Daud dengan amung anak itinneh iné' ngerieng Yerusalim. Idi kebala lun Yebusi luk tudo bang bawang ineh ni Daud, "Na iko miak amé' tungé', iamo' lun mebuser idi lun mekio' miak ngusu namu. Keterawédeh, Daud na miak ngelaya' bawangdeh.”
english: One day King David and his soldiers went to Jerusalem to fight against the Jebus people-group who lived there. The people there thought that David’s army would not be able to capture the city, so they sent a message to David, saying “Your army will never be able to get inside our city! Even the blind and crippled people will be able to chase you away!”

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nengitun Tuhan, kebalaneh, "Miakké ui amé' ngelaya' nelun Pilistin? Miakké Tuhan maré nedeh bang paladku?" Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Amé' iko. Ngaceku Ui maré nedeh ineh bang paladmu.”
english: David asked Yahweh, “Should my men and I attack the Philistia army? Will you enable us to defeat them IDM?” Yahweh replied, “Yes, attack them, because I will certainly enable your army to defeat them. IDM”

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nacing déi' "Tuhan Luk Nemasut." Idi ieh nengelaya' nelun Pilistin déi', kebalaneh, "Idi Tuhan pangeh nemasut amung bunu'ku rat pa kiungku, mepad kudeng ereb." Idi ngaceku ineh ieh neneten su ineh, "Tuhan Luk Nemasut.”
english: So David and his army went to where the Philistia army was, and there they defeated them. Then David said, “Yahweh has burst through my enemies like a flood.” SIM So that place is called ‘Lord of Bursting-through’.

lun_bawang: Idi kareb Daud nengitun Tuhan, kebala Tuhan neneh, "Aleg iko amé' matun nedeh. Iamo' do' iko munu' nedeh rat pa keted, idi iko amé' matun nedeh rat bal lawa kayuh telatang ineh.
english: So again David asked Yahweh if his army should attack them. But Yahweh replied, “Do not attack them from here. Tell your men to go around them and attack them from the other side, near the balsam trees.

lun_bawang: Idi Daud matot inan Tuhan, kebalaneh, "Kudeng apeh Pati' Pejani' Tuhan ineh amé' taca' negku?”
english: David was also afraid of what else Yahweh would do to punish them, so he said, “◄How can I take the sacred chest with me to Jerusalem?/I am afraid to take the sacred chest with me to Jerusalem.►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Raca' Daud neninger bala ratnan Tuhan nengeperuan uang tetek ruma' Obed idi amung-amung luk ieh kuan ngaceku Pati' Pejani' ineh. Idi Daud iné' ngalap ineh rat bang ruma' Obed, idi inuitneh iné' Yerusalim dengan mawang niat.
english: Later, people told David, “Yahweh has blessed Obed-Edom and his family because he is taking care of the sacred chest!” When David heard that, he and some other men went to Obed-Edom’s house, and very joyfully brought the sacred chest from there to Jerusalem.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud ni Mikal, "Ui nenganau' ineh pa kiung Tuhan luk pangeh nemili' negku ku libal i tamam, idi tetek ruma'neh, pad ui mangun ku lun nguyut amung pupuNeh lun Israil. Idi ui pian ngalai teh pad ngerayeh Tuhan.
english: David replied to Michal, “I was doing that to honor Yahweh, who chose me instead of your father and other members of his family, to be the king of the Israeli people, the people who belong to Yahweh. And I will continue to dance to honor Yahweh!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud kuan Nabi Natan, "Ui ini tudo bang aceh ruma' ratnan kayuh tumuh, iamo' Pati' Pejani' Allah ineh tudo bang lepo kibung.”
english: One day he said to the prophet Nathan, “It is not right that I am here, living in a beautiful house made of cedar wood, but the chest that contains God’s Ten Commandments is kept in a tent!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Natan ni Daud, "Do' iko nganau' luk pianmu, ngaceku Tuhan idi denganmu.”
english: Then Nathan said to the king, “Yahweh is helping/directing you, so do regarding that chest whatever you are thinking.”

lun_bawang: "Amé' iko mada' balaKu kuan demulunKu Daud, 'Pianmu mudut aceh ruma' kuanKu pelé Ui tudo bang ineh?
english: “Go and tell my servant, David, that this is what I, Yahweh, am saying to him: ‘You are not the one RHQ who should build a temple for me to live in.

lun_bawang: "Idi nekini do' iko mada' kuan demulunKu Daud, Ini bala Tuhan luk Melalud, 'Ui pangeh nengikit namu rat bang laman idi ratnan matar dumba, mangun ku lun nguyut amung pupuKu lun Israil.
english: So this is what you should say to my servant David: ‘The Almighty Commander of the armies of angels says that he took you from a pasture where you were taking care of sheep, and appointed you to become the ruler of my Israeli people.

lun_bawang: Idi Raca' Daud nesemuet bang Lepo idi tudo pa kiung Tuhan, kesembayangneh, "O Tuhan Allah, ui na mayu ngalap amung peruan luk biréMu kuanku idi kuan tetek ruma'ku.
english: “And now, O Yahweh my God, in addition to everything else, you have spoken about what will happen to my descendants in the future for many generations.

lun_bawang: "Idi nekini O Tuhan Allah, nganau' kuanku idi kuan tetek ruma'ku maya' kudeng luk pijani'Mu,
english: When that happens, you will become famous forever, and people will exclaim, ‘The Almighty Commander of the armies of angels is the God who rules Israel.’ And you will cause that forever there will be descendants of mine who will rule.

lun_bawang: "Idi nekini O Tuhan Allah, Iko mo' Allah luk matu. Idi amung balaMu pana' matu teh. Idi Iko nengacing pejani' ini luk pelaba do' kuanku.
english: So now I ask you that if it pleases you, you will bless my descendants, in order that they may continue to rule forever. Yahweh God, you have promised these things, and so I know that you will keep blessing my descendants forever.”

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nengitun, kebalaneh, "Inanké lun neketecan rat bang tetek ruma' Saul, pelé ui miak méi neneh ngaceku Yonatan?".
english: One day David asked, “Is there anyone who is a descendant of Saul to whom I can be kind?” He asked this because he wanted to honor Jonathan.

lun_bawang: Idi inan seburur lun duken bang ruma' Saul, ngadanneh Siba. Idi ideh nenawar neneh amé' papu' ni Daud. Idi kebala Daud neneh, "Iko ini Siba?" Kebalaneh, "Ui ini, tuan.”
english: They told him that there was in Jerusalem a man named Ziba who had been a servant of Saul’s family. So David sent messengers to summon Ziba. When he arrived, the king asked him, “Are you Ziba?” He replied, “Yes, your majesty, I am.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud, "Inanké lun rat bang ruma' Saul luk inanku méi' ngaceku janiku pa kiung Allah?" Idi kebala Siba kuan raca', "Inan aceh anak Yonatan, idi ieh mekio'.”
english: The king asked him, “Is there anyone in Saul’s family to whom I can be kind, as I promised Jonathan that I would do?” Ziba replied, “Yes, there is one son of Jonathan who is still alive. His feet are crippled.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud neneh, "Iapehké ieh?" Idi kebala Siba, "Idi tieh bang ruma' Makis Amiel déi' Lodebar.”
english: The king asked him, “Where is he?” Ziba replied, “He is living in the house of Machir, son of Ammiel, in Lo-Debar city east of the Jordan River.”

lun_bawang: Idi Mepiboset Yonatan, mupun Saul ineh nacing iné' matun ni Daud. Idi ieh netekeradung pa kiungneh. Idi kebala Daud, "Mepiboset." Idi kebala Mepiboset, "Anun idi tuanku?”
english: When Mephibosheth came to David, he knelt down with his face on the ground, to show respect. Then David said, “Mephibosheth!” He replied, “Yes, your majesty, how may I serve you?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud neneh, "Aleg iko matot, ngaceku ui méi' namu ngaceku tamanmu Yonatan. Idi ui sikal nguli' amé' namu amung tana' Saul tepunmu ineh. Idi iko miak peruyung kuman denganku.”
english: David said to him, “Do not be afraid; I will be kind to you because Jonathan your father was my loyal friend. I will give back to you all the land that belonged to your grandfather Saul. And I want you to always eat with me at my house MTY.”

lun_bawang: Idi Mepiboset netekunal, kebalaneh, "Idéké ui ini, pad iko méi' negku luk mepad kudeng uko' luk naté?”
english: Mephibosheth bowed in front of David again and said, “Sir, I am as worthless as MET a dead dog; I do not deserve RHQ that you be kind to me!”

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nenawar ni Siba, lun duken Saul ineh, idi kebalaneh neneh, "Ui maré kuan Mepiboset amung-amung binaweh luk ni Saul idi tetek ruma'neh atun.
english: Then the king summoned Saul’s servant Ziba and said to him, “Saul was your master; now I am giving to Mephibosheth everything that belonged to Saul and his family.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Siba ni Daud, "Amung bala raca' negku ini ui miak maya." Idi Mepiboset ineh tudo pamung akan dengan Raca' Daud mepad kudeng anak burur Daud.
english: Ziba replied to the king, “Your majesty, I will do everything that you have commanded me to do.” So after that, Mephibosheth always ate at the king’s table, as though he were one of the king’s sons.

lun_bawang: Kareb i Daud nekali' bala ineh, idi ieh nengecuk nelun amé' mada' nedeh, ngaceku ideh pelaba igu'. Idi kebala Daud, "Meluun do' muyuh tudo déi' Yeriko, pad buluh ada muyuh mulun idi teh muyuh muli'.”
english: The men were very humiliated/ashamed, so they did not want to return home. When David found out about what had happened to his officials, he sent someone to tell them, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown again, and then return home.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yoab neneh, "Kudeng lun Siria ineh ngelaya' negku, do' iko amé' ngedengan negku. Idi kudeng lun Amon ineh ngelaya' namu, kali' rungen ui amé' ngedengan namu.
english: Then Joab said, “If the soldiers from Syria are too strong for us to defeat them, your men must come and help us. But if the soldiers from the Ammon people-group are too strong for you to defeat, we will come and help your men.

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nengecuk nelun ngitun ku idé' decur ineh. Kebaladeh, "Ieh ini Batsiba Eliam, awan Uria lun Hiti ineh.”
english: David sent a messenger to find out who she was. The messenger returned and said, “She is RHQ Bathsheba. She is the daughter of Eliam, and her husband is Uriah, from the Heth people-group.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh mali'. Idi ieh nengecuk maré kali' ni Daud.
english: After some time, she realized that she was pregnant. So she sent a messenger to tell David that she was pregnant.

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nengecuk nelun amé' matun ni Yoab, kebalaneh, "Ngecuk Uria lun Hiti ineh amé' matun negku." Idi Yoab nengecuk Uria amé' neneh.
english: Then David sent a message to Joab. He said, “Send Uriah, from the Heth people-group, to me.” So Joab did that. He sent Uriah to David.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud ni Uria, "Muli' iko idi ngato erurmu." Idi kareb Uria nenalan, idi Daud nengecuk nelun nguit aceh baré kuanneh.
english: Then David, hoping that Uriah would go home and sleep with his wife, said to Uriah, “Okay, go home and relax for a while. IDM” So Uriah left, and David gave someone a gift of some food to take to Uriah’s house.

lun_bawang: Idi kareb bala ineh nekali' Daud, idi kebala Daud ni Uria, "Mioké iko na nuli'? Ngudeh iko na muli'?”
english: When someone told David that Uriah did not go to his house that night, David summoned him again and said to him, “Why didn’t you go home to be with your wife last night, after having been away for a long time?” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud ni Uria, "Do' iko tudo tungé' aco sini teh. Idi nebpa ui nima' namu nalan." Idi Uria tudo déi' Yerusalim bang aco sineh idi kenebpa teh.
english: Then David said to Uriah, “Stay here today. I will let you return to the battle tomorrow.” So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day and that night.

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "Ruenmu Uria ineh pa atun baweh, su luk inan mula' bunu'. Idi do' muyuh petetang rat neneh, pelé ieh pitayen.”
