english: In the letter, he wrote, “Put Uriah in the front line, where the fighting is the ◄worst/most severe►. Then command the soldiers to pull back from him, in order that he will be killed by our enemies.”

lun_bawang: Idi balaneh kuan lun luk icuk ineh, "Kareb iko pangeh nemada' amung bala ratnan bunu' ineh kuan Raca' Daud,
english: He said to the messenger, “Tell David the news about the battle. After you finish telling that to him,

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ni Daud, "Lun ineh metueh rat nekai amung-amung. Idi ideh iné' matun nekai déi' natad, iamo' kai nengusu nedeh lemubed macing tanga' bawang ineh.
english: The messenger said to David, “Our enemies were very brave, and came out of the city to fight us in the fields. They were defeating us but we forced them back to the city gate.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud kuan lun luk icuk ineh, "Ngubuk ni Yoab idi ngecuk neneh na megagau. Ngaceku tau na kali' idé' luk miak pitayen bang bunu'. Idi ngecuk neneh ngegkang bawehneh pad ngelaya' idi ngalap bawang ineh.”
english: David said to the messenger, “Go back to Joab and say to him, ‘Do not be distressed about what happened, because no one ever knows who will be killed in a battle.’ Tell him that the next time his troops should attack the city more strongly, and capture it.”

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nengecuk ni Natan amé' matun ni Daud. Idi ieh iné' neneh, kebalaneh, "Bang aceh bawang inan dueh burur, seburur lun do', seburur lun masi'.
english: Yahweh told the prophet Nathan what David had done, and he sent Nathan to tell this story to David: “I heard about two men who were living in a certain city. One was rich and the other was poor.

lun_bawang: Idi Daud megateh nelun ineh. Idi kebalaneh ni Natan, "Ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan luk mulun, lun luk pangeh nenganau' luk kudeng ineh miak uen ngaté.
english: When David heard that, he was very angry about what the rich man had done. He said to Nathan, “I solemnly declare that the man who did that should be executed!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Natan ni Daud, "Iko luk kudeng ineh. Idi ini bala Tuhan Allah lun Israil. Ui nengumau namu mangun ku raca' lun Israil, idi Ui nemuit namu rat bang palad Saul
english: Nathan said to David, “You are the man I have been talking about! And this is what Yahweh, the God we Israelis worship, says to you: ‘I appointed you to be king of Israel, after having rescued you from Saul.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud ni Natan, "Ui pangeh mesala' pa kiung Tuhan." Idi kebala Natan ni Daud, "Tuhan maré do' namu, pad iko na maté
english: David replied, “I have sinned against Yahweh.” Nathan said to David, “Yahweh has forgiven you for your sin: You will not die because of this sin.

lun_bawang: Kareb Daud kali' nedeh payek-payek seburur dengan seburur, idi ieh kali' anak ineh pangeh naté. Idi kebalaneh nedeh, "Pangehké anak ineh naté?" Idi kebaladeh, "Pangeh.”
english: But when David saw that his servants were whispering something to each other, he realized that the baby must be dead. So he asked them, “Is the baby dead?” They replied, “Yes, he is dead.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun tarehneh neneh, "Kudeng apehké luk inau'mu ini? Ngaceku kareb anak ineh mulun, iko mawa' idi nangi'. Pangeh anak ineh naté, idi iko netumui idi petacu kuman.”
english: Then his servants said to him, “We do not understand RHQ why you have done this! While the baby was still alive, you cried for him and refused to eat anything. But now that the baby has died, you are not crying any more! You got up and ate some food!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Mo, inan peh ui mawa' idi nangi' kareb anak ineh mulun, keterawéku, 'Idé kali', kian Tuhan méi' negku idi ngulun anak ineh baruh lek?'
english: David replied, “While the baby was still alive, I fasted and cried. I thought, ‘Who knows? Yahweh may be merciful to me and not allow the baby to die’.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengecuk tuda'-tuda' lun duken amé' mada' ni Daud, kebalaneh, "Ui pangeh nemunu' Raba, idi ui pangeh nengelaya' bawang luk tangeb abpa' ineh.
english: Then Joab sent messengers to David, to tell him this: “My troops are attacking Rabbah, and we have captured the city’s water supply.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ni Amnon, "Iko ineh anak raca', ngudeh anid-anid pekak iko iuk-iuk mesusa' niat? Do' maré kali' negku?" Kebala Amnon neneh, "Ngaceku ui mawa ni Tamar kinanak decur Absalom kinanakku.”
english: One day Jonadab said to Amnon, “You are the king’s son, but every day I see that RHQ you seem very depressed/sad. What is your problem?” Amnon replied, “I ◄am in love/want to sleep► EUP with Tamar, my half-brother Absalom’s sister.”

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nengecuk nelun amé' mada' ni Tamar kebalaneh, "Do' iko amé' bang ruma' kinanakmu Amnon, nganau' akan kuanneh.”
english: So David sent a message to Tamar in the palace, saying “Amnon is sick and he wants you to go to his house and prepare some food for him.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengiding periuk, idi nengado neneh pa kiung Amnon. Iamo' ieh ara' kuman. Idi kebala Amnon, "Ngecuk amung lun remuat rat pa kiungku." Idi amung lemulun neremuat rat bang takepneh.
english: She took them out of the pan and put them on a plate in front of him, but he refused to eat them. Then he said to everyone else in the room, “All the rest of you, leave me now!” So all the others left his room.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Amnon ni Tamar, "Amu', do' iko nguit akan ineh amé' iringku, pelé' ui miak kuman luk barénmu." Idi Tamar nengalap pinaram luk pangeh inau'neh ineh, idi iné' iringneh.
english: Then Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food into my room and serve it to me.” So Tamar took into his room the scones/dumplings that she had made.

lun_bawang: Kareb ieh nemaré pinaram ineh neneh, idi Amnon nengakem neneh, kebalaneh, "Do' iko pamung lubid negku.”
english: But when she brought them close for him to eat them, he grabbed her and said to her, “Come to bed with me!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Tamar, "Aleg nganau' luk kudeng ineh, aleg ngesaad negku. Dat kekamen ineh!
english: She replied, “No, do not force me to do such a disgraceful thing! We never do things like that in Israel! That would be awful/terrible!

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh idi Amnon megateh neneh. Gatehneh ineh meluun ratnan awaneh luk atun. Kebalaneh neneh, "Buro iko!”
english: Then Amnon hated her very much. He hated her much more than he had desired her. He said to her, “Get up and get out of here!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Tamar, "Aleg kudeng ineh, ngaceku dat ini meluun rayeh ratnan dat luk pangeh inau'mu kuanku ineh." Iamo' nateh ieh sikal ninger balaneh.
english: But she said to him, “No! It would be very wrong for you to send me away. It would be worse than what you just did to me!” But he would not listen to her.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nenawar lun dukenneh sebuleng, kebalaneh, "Nala' decur ini nekini rat negku. Idi malin tanga' raben-raben!”
english: He summoned his personal servant and said to him, “Take this woman outside, away from me, and lock the door so that she cannot come in again!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Absalom kinanakneh luk rayeh neneh, "Inanké Amnon kinanakmu nepamung namu? Ungeng mo', ngaceku ieh kinanakmu. Aleg pelaba susa' niat." Idi i Tamar tudo buleng-buleng dengan mesusa' niat bang ruma' Absalom.
english: Her brother Absalom saw her and said to her, “Has your half-brother Amnon DOU forced you to have sex with him EUP? Please, my sister, do not tell anyone, and do not become depressed/sad.” So Tamar went to live in Absalom’s house, and she was very sad and lonely.

lun_bawang: Idi Absalom iné' papu' raca', kebalaneh, "Ui uned muting buluh dumba. Idi do' iko idi lun dukenmu maya' negku.”
english: Absalom went to the king and said to him, “Sir, my servants have been shearing my sheep. Please come with your officials to celebrate with us!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala raca' ni Absalom, "Na kai amé' amung, Asi, pad kai na maré susa' namu." Idi ieh nengubuk tamanneh. Iamo' nateh ieh sikal amé'. Iamo' raca' nepetabi' neneh.
english: But the king replied, “No, my son, it would not be good for all of us to go, because it would cause you to do a lot of work and spend a lot of money for food.” Absalom continued urging him, but the king would not go. Instead, he said that he hoped/desired that God would bless them while they celebrated.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Absalom, "Kudeng iko na amé', idi do' maré Amnon kinanakku amé' maya' nekai." Idi kebala raca' neneh, "Amé' ngudeh ieh maya nemuyuh?”
english: Then Absalom said, “If you will not go, please allow my half-brother Amnon to go with us.” But the king replied, “Why do you want him to go with you?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh kuan lun dukenneh, "Matar do'-do' kareb Amnon mabuk. Kareb ui ngecuk, do' muyuh ngaté neneh. Aleg matot. Ngaceku ui sebuleng mabeh ineh. Do' muyuh metueh idi mekuu!”
english: So they all went. And at the celebration, Absalom commanded his servants, “Notice when Amnon has become a bit drunk from the wine. Then when I signal to you, kill him. Do not be afraid; you will be doing this only because I told you RHQ to do it. So be courageous and do it!”

lun_bawang: Idi laba' ideh nalan, bala ini nacing ni Daud, ratnan Absalom pangeh nengaté amung anak raca'. Seburu pana' nateh luk inulunneh.
english: While they were on their way home, someone went quickly and reported to David, “Absalom has killed all of your other sons; none of them is still alive!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yonadab kuan raca', "Nier amung anakmu macing, kudeng balaku namu.”
english: Jonadab said to the king, “Aha! What I told you is true. Your other sons are alive and have come!”

lun_bawang: Idi decur rat Tekoa ineh netekeradung pa kiung raca', kebalaneh, "O raca', nengan negku.”
english: So the woman from Tekoa went to the king. She prostrated herself in front of him and then bowed down to him, and said, “Your Majesty, help me!”

lun_bawang: Idi raca' Daud nengitun neneh, "Anun susa'mu?" Idi kebalaneh, "Ui ini seburur decur tinula'. Awanku pangeh naté.
english: The king replied, “What is your problem?” She replied, “Please, sir, I am a widow. My husband died some time ago.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Muli' iko. Ui miak nganau' luk petulu kuanmu.”
english: Then the king said to the woman, “Go back home; I will take care of this matter for you.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala decur ineh, "O raca', nima' negku, idi uang tetek ruma' tamanku mabeh sala' ini. Iamo' do' iko idi kerusi imetmu meligan ratnan sala'.”
english: The woman from Tekoa replied to the king, “Your Majesty, if you are criticized for helping me, my family and I will accept the blame. You and the royal family will ◄be innocent/not have done what is wrong►.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Idé-idé luk ngedureng namu, nguit neneh amé' negku, pad ieh na mekuel namu.”
english: The king said to her, “If anyone says anything to threaten you/cause you trouble you, bring that person to me, and I will make sure that he will never cause you trouble again.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala decur ineh, "Maré negku mada' sebila' bala teh kuanmu." Idi kebala raca', "Mada' mo'.”
english: Then the woman said, “Your Majesty, please allow me to say one more thing to you.” He replied, “Speak!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Aleg iko ngapung anun-anun luk tuninku namu." Idi kebala decur ineh, "Do' iko pebala.”
english: Then the king said to the woman, “I will now ask you a question. Answer it, and tell me the truth. LIT” The woman replied, “Your majesty, ask your question.”

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh raca' nepebala ni Yoab, "Ui maya' luk bilamu. Amé' iko ngalap ni Absalom anak adi' ineh lemubed.”
english: Then the king summoned Joab and said to him, “Listen! I have decided to do what you want. So go and get that young man Absalom and bring him back to Jerusalem.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Raca' Daud, "Do' ieh muli' amé' ruma'neh. Aleg ieh amé' papu' negku." Idi Absalom tudo bang ruma'neh sebuleng. Na ieh iné' papu' raca'.
english: But the king said/commanded that Absalom would not be permitted to live in the palace. He said, “I do not want him to come to see me.” So Absalom lived in his own house, and did not go to talk to the king.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Absalom nelun dukenneh, "Tana' Yoab ineh pelengit ku tana'ku. Idi ieh inan ikun déi'. Amé' muyuh nutung ineh." Idi lun duken Absalom nenutung lati' ineh.
english: Then Absalom said to his servants, “You know that Joab’s field is next to mine, and that he has barley growing there. Go and light a fire there to burn his barley.” So Absalom’s servants went there and lit a fire, and all his barley burned.

lun_bawang: Idi Yoab iné' ni Absalom déi' ruma'neh. Idi ieh nengitun neneh, "Ngudeh lun dukenmu nenutung lati'ku?”
english: Joab knew who had done it, so he went to Absalom’s house and said to him, “Why have your servants burned the barley in my field?”

lun_bawang: idi kebala Absalom neneh, "Putuhmu ineh matu idi do'. Iamo' rat pa babpat raca' seburur pana' nateh lutep ninger balamu.”
english: Absalom would say to him, “Listen, I am sure that what you are saying/claiming is right. But there is no one whom the king has appointed/authorized to listen to people like you.”

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Absalom, "Meluun do' ui mangun ku lun mutut besara' bang bawang ini, pad anid-anid lemulun luk inan besara' amé' negku, pad ui mutut luk petulu kuanneh.”
english: Absalom would then add, “I wish that I were a judge in this land. If I were a judge, anyone who had a dispute could come to me, and I would decide it fairly/justly.”

lun_bawang: Idi pangeh apat lak, idi kebala Absalom kuan Raca' Daud, "Do' iko maré negku amé' déi' Hebron ngacing jani' luk pangeh pijani'ku kuan Tuhan.
english: Four years later, Absalom went to the king and said, “Please allow me to go to Hebron city, in order that I can do what I promised Yahweh that I would do.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' neneh, "Amé' iko dengan do'." Idi Absalom nenalan iné' Hebron.
english: The king replied, “You may go.” So Absalom went to Hebron.

lun_bawang: Iamo' ieh nengecuk tuda'-tuda' lun duken amé' dengan lulem kuan amung inul pupu lun Israil, pad mada', "Kareb muyuh ninger uni serupit, do' muyuh pebala, 'Absalom pangeh mangun ku raca' déi' Hebron!' “
english: But while he was there, he secretly sent messengers to all the tribes in Israel, to tell them, “When you hear the sound of the trumpets being blown, shout ‘Absalom has become the king at Hebron!’ ”

lun_bawang: Idi nacing seburur luk nguit bala iné' ni Daud, kebalaneh, "Amung lun Israil perurum ni Absalom pian maya' neneh.”
english: Soon a messenger came to David and said to him, “All HYP the Israeli people SYN are joining Absalom to rebel against you!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "Mo, amung balamu kai maya'.”
english: The king’s officials said, “Okay, your majesty, we are ready to do whatever you decide.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' kuan Itai luk lun rayeh lun Gat ineh, "Ngudeh iko amé' maya' nekai. Do' amé' idi tudo dengan raca' luk mebaruh. Ngaceku iko ini lun sakai luk pangeh nenecan bawangmu sebuleng.
english: Then David said to Ittai, the leader of the soldiers from Gath, “◄Why are you going with us?/You should not be going with us.► RHQ Go back and stay with Absalom the new king. You are not an Israeli; you are living away from your own land.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Itai, "Ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan luk mulun, idi iapeh pana' ulekmu, ui sikal amé', sagan pana' maté.”
english: But Ittai replied, “Your Majesty, as surely as you live, wherever you go, I will go; I will stay with you, whether they kill me or allow me to live.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud ni Itai, "Kudeng pieh kudeng ineh, amé' iko nalan pa atunku." Idi Itai lun Gat ineh idi amung lun dieh macing ku amung anak-anak pana' luk pebaya' neneh ineh nenalan atun.
english: David replied to Ittai, “Okay, march with us!” So Ittai and all his troops and their families went with David.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Raca' Daud ni Saduk, "Iten muyuh Pati' Pejani' Allah ineh lemubed amé' bang bawang. Kudeng Tuhan méi' negku, Ieh miak ngelubed negku muci, idi Ieh miak maré negku nier ineh, idi su luk inanneh pana'.
english: Then the king said to Zadok, “You and Abiathar take the sacred chest back into the city. If Yahweh is pleased with me, he will some day allow me to return to see it and the place where it is kept.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebalaneh ni Saduk luk imam ineh, "Do' iko idi Abiatar lemubed amé' bang bawang dengan do'. Kudeng ineh teh dueh anak medueh Ahimas anakmu, idi Yonatan anak Abiatar teh maya' nemedueh.
english: He also said to Zadok, “Listen to what I suggest. You and Abiathar return to the city peacefully/safely, and take your son Ahimaaz and Abiathar’s son Jonathan with you.

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh ni Daud, "Ahitopel pana' idi arang lun rurum Absalom." Idi kesembayang Daud, "O Tuhan ngisu' bala Ahitopel, pad balaneh mebacé!”
english: Someone told David that Ahithophel had joined with those who were rebelling against David. So David prayed, “Yahweh, cause whatever Ahithophel suggests to Absalom that he should do to be considered to be foolish!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud neneh, Kudeng iko nalan maya' negku, kali' rungen iko ngesusa' negku muci.
english: David said to him, “If you go with me, you will not be able to help me.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Iapehké anak tuanmu?" Idi kebala Siba kuan raca', "Ieh tudo déi' Yerusalim. Ngaceku kebalaneh, 'Aco sini teh lun bang uang tetek ruma' Israil miak maré imet raca' lemubed kuanku.' “
english: The king said, “Where is Mephibosheth, the grandson of your former master Saul?” Ziba deceived David by saying, “He stayed in Jerusalem, because he thinks that now the Israeli people will allow him to rule the kingdom that his grandfather Saul ruled.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' ni Siba, "Amung-amung luk Mepiboset kuan iko kuan." Kebala Siba, "Ui ngerayeh namu. Do' iko méi' negku, O raca'.”
english: The king said to Ziba, “Okay, everything that belonged to Mephibosheth is now yours.” Ziba replied, “Your Majesty, I will humbly serve you; and I desire/hope that you will always be pleased with me.”

lun_bawang: Idi Simi nengediman neneh, kebalaneh, "Buro iko, O iko luk ngeruat dara', idi lun luk dat:
english: Shimei cursed David and said to him, “Get out of here, you murderer, you scoundrel!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Abisai anak Seruya kuan raca', "Ngudeh uko' naté ini ngediman namu? Nima' negku amé' ngaleb neneh.”
english: Then Abishai said to the king, “Your Majesty, this man is as worthless as MET a dead dog! ◄Why should he be allowed to curse you?/He should not be allowed to curse you.► RHQ Allow me to go over there and cut off his head!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala raca' ni Abisai, "Na ini kekamenmu. Nima' neneh ngediman negku. Kudeng ieh icuk Tuhan, idéké miak ngitun, 'Ngudeh iko nganau' kudeng ineh?' “
english: But the king replied, “You two sons of Zeruiah, ◄do not tell me what to do/this does not concern you► RHQ. If he is cursing me because Yahweh told him to do that, certainly no one should say ‘◄Why are you doing that?/You should not be doing that.► RHQ’”

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Daud ni Abisai idi lun tarehneh, "Kudeng anak bururku sebuleng pian ngaté negku, meluun teh lun Beniamin ini. Nima' neneh ngediman negku, ngaceku ieh icuk Tuhan lek.
english: Then David said to Abishai and to all his officials, “You know that my own son is trying to kill me. So it is not surprising that this man from the tribe of Benjamin is also trying to kill me. So ignore him, and allow him to curse me, because perhaps he thinks that Yahweh told him to do that.

lun_bawang: Kareb Usai luk rurum Daud ineh nepapu' ni Absalom, kebalaneh, "Do' raca' mipu ulun!”
english: When David’s friend Hushai came to Absalom, he said to Absalom, “I desire/hope that the king will live a long time! May you live for many years!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Absalom ni Usai, "Iniké awamu inan rurummu? Ngudeh iko na amé' maya' rurummu ineh?”
english: Absalom said to Hushai, “You have been loyal RHQ to your friend David for a long time. So why did you not go with him instead of coming to me?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Usai ni Absalom, Na tu! Ui maya' nelun luk pinili' Tuhan idi anak itin ini dengan amung lun Israil. Ui pian maya' namu.
english: Hushai replied, “I will serve the one whom Yahweh and these people and all the other people of Israel have chosen to be their king. So I will stay with you.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Absalom ni Ahitopel, "Do' iko mada' anun luk petulu ruen tau.”
english: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, “What do you advise that we should do?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Ahitopel ni Absalom, "Nima' negku mili' 12,000 burur pad ui ngerada' ni Daud bang dacem ini teh,
english: Then Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Allow me to choose 12,000 men, and I will leave with them tonight to pursue David.

lun_bawang: Kebala Absalom, "Darin muyuh Usai. Do' tau ninger anun luk belénneh.”
english: But Absalom said, “Summon Hushai also, and we will hear what he suggests.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Usai nacing, idi kebala Absalom neneh, "Kudeng ini bala Ahitopel. Do' tau maya' balaneh, kian na lek? Do' iko mada' nekai.”
english: So when Hushai arrived, Absalom told him what Ahithophel had suggested. Then he asked Hushai, “What do you think we should do? If you do not think that we should do what Ahithophel suggests, tell us what you think that we should do.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Usai, "Bala luk bila Ahitopel sekua' ini na do.
english: Hushai replied, “This time what Ahithophel has suggested is not good advice.

lun_bawang: Idi Usai nemada' ni Saduk idi Abiatar didueh imam ineh ratnan bada'neh ni Absalom idi lun rayeh Israil, idi teh ratnan bada' Ahitopel ni Absalom.
english: Then Hushai told the two priests, Zadok and Abiathar, what both he and Ahithophel had suggested to Absalom and the Israeli leaders.

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh pangeh nuli' idi didueh neremuat rat bang subuk ineh idi nenalan iné' mada' bala kuan Raca' Daud, kebala didueh, "Do' iko nalan idi guta abpa' dengan mesaget. Ngaceku kudeng ini bala Ahitopel ratnan lawému.”
english: After they had gone, the two men came out of the well and went and reported to King David what had happened and what Ahithophel had suggested. Then they said to him, “Cross the river quickly!”

lun_bawang: duru', lemak sapi', dumba, idi kakat rata sapi' kuan Daud idi anak itinneh, ngaceku kebaladeh, "Ideh melau, merur, idi meparing déi' su luk ali-ali."
english: They brought honey and curds, sheep, and some cream/cheese for David and his soldiers to eat. They knew that David and his soldiers would be hungry and tired and thirsty from marching in the desert.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' nedeh, "Ui pian maya' anun luk do' bang terawé muyuh." Idi ieh tuped munung tanga' laba' amung anak itin ineh remuat ratu-ratu idi ribu-ribu.
english: The king replied, “Okay, I will do whatever seems best to you.” So he stood at the gate and watched while his soldiers marched out, group by group.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengecuk ni Yoab, Abisai, idi Itai, kebalaneh, "Méi' ni Absalom anak baruh ineh." Idi amung baweh nekali' bala raca' ratnan Absalom kuan amung lun rayeh bunu' ineh.
english: While they were leaving, the king commanded Joab, Abishai, and Ittai, “For my sake, do not harm my son Absalom!” And all the troops heard it when David gave that order about Absalom to those three commanders.

lun_bawang: Idi seburur anak itin Daud nenier neneh. Idi ieh nemaré kali' ni Yoab, kebalaneh, "Ui nekali' Absalom tekito arang angat kayuh luk meraben.”
english: One of David’s soldiers saw what happened, and went and told Joab, “I saw Absalom hanging in an oak tree!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yoab nelun ineh, "Matuké iko nekali' neneh! Ngudeh iko na petacu ngaté neneh, pad ui maré namu pulu' balad pirak idi sebuleng abet awa'.”
english: Joab said to the man, “What? You say that you saw him hanging there, so why did you not kill him immediately RHQ? If you had killed him, I would have given you ten pieces of silver and a belt!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yoab, "Na ui pian mio pegayam namu ieni." Idi ieh nengalap teluh busu idi ieh nenepeh ruuk Absalom macing luun pusu'neh, kareb ieh lakat mulun idi nepalak arang angat kayuh luk meraben ineh.
english: Joab said, “I am not going to waste time talking to you!” Then he took three spears and went to where Absalom was, and thrust them into Absalom’s chest/heart while he was still alive, dangling from the oak tree.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Ahimas Saduk, "Nima' negku amé' mada' raca', ratnan Tuhan pangeh nemuit neneh rat bang palad bunu'neh.”
english: After Absalom had been killed, Zadok’s son Ahimaaz said to Joab, “Allow me to run to the king to tell him the good news that Yahweh has rescued him from the power of his enemies!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yoab neneh, "Aleg iko nguit bala luk do' aco sini. Miak iko nguit bala muci aco. Ngaceku aco sini anak raca' pangeh naté'.”
english: But Joab said to him, “No, I will not allow you to take news to the king today. Some other day I will allow you to take some news, but not today. If you took news today it would not be good news for the king, because his son is dead.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yoab kuan demulunneh lun Sudan, "Amé' iko mada' kuan raca' anun luk siniermu ineh." Idi lun Sudan ineh netekeradung pa kiung Yoab, idi nenalan.
english: Then Joab said to David’s servant who was from Ethiopia, “You go and tell the king what you have seen.” So the man from Ethiopia bowed in front of Joab, and started to run.

lun_bawang: Kebala Ahimas, "Sagan tu pana' kudeng ineh. Simén mo' ui amé'." Idi kebala Yoab, "Amé' mo' iko." Idi Ahimas nupun maya' raked, pad ieh pa atun lun Sudan ineh.
english: But Ahimaaz replied, “That does not matter, I want to go.” So Joab said, “Okay, go.” So Ahimaaz ran along another road through the Jordan Valley and arrived where David was before the man from Ethiopia arrived.

lun_bawang: Idi lun luk matar bawang ineh nengitang maré kali' kuan raca'. Idi kebala raca', "Kudeng ieh sebuleng mo' kali' rungen ieh amé' nated bala luk do'." Idi lun ineh iuk-iuk amé' muneng.
english: The watchman called down and reported it to the king. The king said, “If he is alone, that indicates/means that he is bringing good news.” The man who was running continued to come closer.

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh idi lun luk matar bawang ineh nenier aceh lun baken upun teh. Idi ieh nengitang kuan lun luk matar tanga', kebalaneh, "Inan teh seburur, ieh nalan buleng-buleng teh." Idi kebala raca', "Lun ineh pana' nated bala luk do'.”
english: Then the watchman saw another man running. So he called down to the gatekeeper, “Look! There is another man running!” And the king said, “He also is bringing some good news.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun luk matar bawang ineh, "Ui nier lawé lun luk atun ineh kudeng lawé Ahimas Saduk." Idi kebala raca', "ieh ineh lun luk do'. Kali' rungen ieh macing nguit bala luk do'.”
english: The watchman said, “I think the first man must be Ahimaaz, because he is running like Ahimaaz runs.” The king said, “He is a good man, and I am sure he is coming with good news.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Do'ké Absalom anak adi' ineh?" Idi kebala Ahimas, "Ui pangeh nenier ria' rayeh kareb Yoab pangeh nengecuk negku. Iamo' na ui kali' anun tuneh.”
english: The king said, “Is the young man Absalom safe/all right?” Ahimaaz did not want to answer that question, so he replied, “When Joab sent me, I saw that there was a lot of confusion, but I do not know what it was about.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Lumuut iko idi tuped su ineh." Idi ieh nelumuut idi netuped su ineh.
english: Then the king said, “Stand aside.” So Ahimaaz stepped aside and stood there.

lun_bawang: Idi lun Sudan pana' nacing. Idi kebalaneh inan raca', "Do' bala kuan raca'! Aco sini Tuhan pangeh nemuit namu rat bang palad amung lun luk sikal metueh rat namu.”
english: Suddenly the man from Ethiopia arrived, and said, “Your Majesty, I have good news for you! Yahweh has enabled your soldiers to defeat all those who rebelled against you!”

lun_bawang: Idi Yoab neninger bala ratnan Raca' Daud nangi' idi temido ni Absalom
english: Someone told Joab that the king was crying and mourning because Absalom had died.

lun_bawang: Tuehdeh kareb aco sineh pangeh nisu' kuan lun mula' ku aceh tido. Ngaceku ideh nekali' bala ratnan raca' na miak buken ratnan anakneh.
english: All of David’s soldiers became sad. Instead of rejoicing about defeating the soldiers who had fought with Absalom, they were sad because they heard that the king was mourning because Absalom was dead.

lun_bawang: Idi raca' nengebpu kiungneh, idi nengitang dengan rayeh tang, "O anakku Absalom, O Absalom anakku, O anakku!”
english: The king covered his face with his hands and kept crying loudly, “O, my son Absalom! O, Absalom, my son! My son!”

lun_bawang: Idi raca' nudur idi tudo munung tanga' bawang. Idi anak itinneh nekali' bala ratnan ieh idi déi'. Idi ideh iné' matun neneh. Iamo' amung lun Israil pangeh neburo iné' anid-anid ruma'deh.
english: So the king got up and went and sat near the city gate. And all the people were told, “Hey, the king is sitting at the gate!” So they all came and gathered around him. Meanwhile, all the Israeli troops who had been with Absalom had returned to their homes.

lun_bawang: Idi kudeng ineh lawé niat amung lun Yahuda rinuidneh mepad kudeng niat seburur mo'. Idi ideh nemaré bala nan raca', kebaladeh, "Do' iko lemubed maya' amung lun tarehmu.”
english: By sending that message to them, David convinced all the people of Judah IDM that they should ◄be loyal to him/accept him as their king►. So they sent a message to the king, saying “We want you and all your officials to return here.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Abisai anak Seruya, "Petulu Simi pitayen, ngaceku ieh pangeh nengediman nelun luk inumau kuan Tuhan.”
english: But Abishai, the son of Zeruiah, said, “He cursed the one that Yahweh appointed MTY to be the king! So ◄should he not be executed for doing that?/he certainly should be executed for doing that.►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ni Simi, "Na iko miak pitayen." Idi raca' nepebulung neneh.
english: Then the king said to Shimei, “I solemnly promise that I will not execute you.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Mepiboset nacing papu' raca' déi' Yerusalim, idi kebala raca' neneh, "Anun punmu na nemaya' negku atun, O Mepiboset?”
english: When he arrived from Jerusalem to greet the king, the king said to him, “Mephibosheth, why did you not go with me?”

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "O raca', ui pangeh sinaluk lun dukenku. Ngaceku kebalaku neneh, 'Do' ngapin aceh keladai kuanku pad ui tudo luunneh idi amé' maya' raca'. Ngaceku ui ini mekio'.'
english: He replied, “Your Majesty, you know that I am crippled. When I heard that you were leaving Jerusalem, I said to my servant Ziba, ‘Put a saddle on my donkey in order that I can ride on it and go with the king.’ But he deceived me and left without me.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' neneh, "Anun punmu pebala ratnan lawému ineh baruh. Ini ukumku. Do' iko mabpat tana' ineh babpat dueh kuan Siba.”
english: The king replied, “You certainly do not need to say any more. I have decided that you and Ziba will divide equally the land that belonged to your grandfather Saul.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Mepiboset kuan raca', "Aganeh apenneh amung, ngaceku iko pangeh nuli' dengan do'.”
english: Mephibosheth replied to the king, “Your Majesty, I am content that you have returned safely. So allow him to take all the land.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' ni Barsilai, "Do' iko maya' negku. Idi ui miak nginita namu déi' Yerusalim.”
english: The king said to Barzillai, “Come with me to Jerusalem, and I will take care of you.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Barsilai kuan raca', "Tuda' lak teh io ulunku, pad ui miak nalan maya' namu amé' déi' Yerusalim.
english: But Barzillai replied, “I certainly do not have RHQ many more years to live. So ◄why should I go with you to Jerusalem?/there is certainly no reason for me to go with you to Jerusalem.► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Do' Kiman maya' negku. Idi ui miak nganau' kuanneh luk do' sirenmu. Idi anun pana' luk pituenmu, ui miak nganau' kuanmu.”
english: The king replied, “Okay, he will cross the river with me, and I will do for him whatever seems good to you. And I will do for you whatever you want me to do.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' ni Amasa, "Nekini darin muyuh amung lun Yahuda pamung bang teluh aco ini. Pangeh ineh do' iko amé' tungé teh.”
english: One day the king said to Amasa, “Summon the soldiers of Judah to come here within three days, and you be here also.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud ni Abisai, "Nekini Siba Bikri ineh miak nganau' dat kuan tau meluun ratnan Absalom. Lapenmu amung lun dukenku idi ngerada' neneh, pelé ieh na miak ngala bawang luk linibung meraben, idi nganau' dereh kuan tau.”
english: So David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba will harm us more than Absalom did. So you take my soldiers and pursue him. If you do not do that, he and his soldiers may occupy/capture some of the ◄fortified towns/towns that have walls around them►, and escape from us. IDM”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ni Amasa, "Do' teh iko kinanakku?" Idi yoab nengimet buluh ada Amasa ku ticu'neh pa tinueh sikal muen neneh.
english: Joab said to Amasa, “Are things going well with you, my friend?” Then Joab grabbed Amasa’s beard with his right hand, in order to kiss him.

lun_bawang: Iamo' seburur rat arang lun duken Yoab ineh netuped iring butung Amasa, kebalaneh, "Idé luk méi' ni Yoab, idi idé luk lutep ni Daud, do' ieh maya' ni Yoab.”
english: One of Joab’s soldiers stood alongside Amasa’s body and called out, “Everyone who wants Joab to be our commander and who wants David to be our king, go with Joab!”

lun_bawang: Idi inan seburur decur luk mileh, nengitang rat bang bawang ineh, "Ninger muyuh, ninger idi ngecuk Yoab amé' tungé', pelé' ui pebala neneh.”
english: Then a wise woman who was in that town stood on the top of the wall and shouted down, “Listen to me! Tell Joab to come here, because I want to talk to him!”

lun_bawang: Idi Yoab iné' muneng. Idi decur ineh nepebala, "Ikoké Yoab?" Kebalaneh, "Ui ini." Kebala decur ineh, "Ninger balaku ini." Kebalaneh, "Mo, ui ninger.”
english: So after they told Joab, he came there, and the woman said, “Are you Joab?” He replied, “Yes, I am.” She said to him, “Listen to what I say.” He replied, “I am listening.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala decur ineh, "Bang kareb luk mon pekalai lun pebala kudeng ini, 'Nima' lun amé' ngitun déi' Abel.' Pangeh ineh idi teh ideh ngeletep lawédeh.
english: She said, “Long ago people used to say, ‘Go to Abel town to get good advice about your problems.’ And that is what people did.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yoab, "Na tu-tu ui ngedat idi ngedereh bawangmu ineh!
english: Job replied, “I would certainly never want to ruin or destroy your town!

lun_bawang: Idi bang kareb Daud inan iru' teluh lak kinioneh. Ngaceku ineh Daud nemutuh pa kiung Tuhan, idi Tuhan nepebala, "Ieh ineh ngaceku Saul idi ngaceku uang tetek ruma'neh nengeruat dara'. Ngaceku ideh pangeh nengaté nelun Gibion ineh.”
english: During the time that David ruled, there was a famine in Israel for three years. David prayed to Yahweh about it. And Yahweh said, “In order for the famine to end, Saul’s family needs to be punished MTY because Saul killed many people from Gibeon city.”

lun_bawang: Idi Daud nenawar nelun Gibion ineh, kebalaneh, "Anunké luk ruenku kuan muyuh? Idi dengan anunké ui miak nganau' pedo', pad muyuh ngeperuan pupu Tuhan?”
english: and said to them, “What shall I do for you? How can I make amends/up for what was done to your people, in order that you will bless us who belong to Yahweh?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "Saul sikal ngaté nekai, pad kai na miak mulun bang aput bawang lun Israil.
english: They replied, “Saul wanted to get rid of us. He wanted to annihilate/kill all of us, in order that none of us would live anywhere in Israel.

lun_bawang: Do' maré kuan kai tudu' inulneh luk deléi pad kai ngekito nedeh pa kiung Tuhan déi Gibia, bawang Saul luk pinili' Tuhan." Idi kebala raca', "Miak ui maré nedeh.”
english: Hand over to us seven of Saul’s descendants. We will hang them where Yahweh is worshiped in Gibeon, our town, the town where Saul, whom Yahweh previously chose to be king, lived.” The king replied, “Okay, I will hand them over to you.”

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "Tuhan, ieh ineh Lun Nengulun negku, Ieh mepad kudeng batu idi libung luk meraben.
english: This is what he sang: Yahweh, you are like a huge overhanging rock under which I can hide MET; you are like my fortress, and you rescue me.

lun_bawang: "Roh Tuhan pebala maya' tangku; idi balaNeh idi luun dila'ku.
english: “The Spirit of Yahweh tells me what to say; the message that I speak MTY comes from him.

lun_bawang: Idi Daud melili ku luk rupen, kebalaneh, "Adoi, ui pelaba pian ngirup abpa' rat bang subuk luk déi' Baitlahim luk iring tanga' bawang!”
english: One day David very much wanted some water to drink, and said “I wish that someone would bring me some water from the well near the gate at Bethlehem!”

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "O Tuhan, na tu-tu ui miak ngirup abpa' ini, ieh ineh mepad kudeng ui ngirup dara' lun ini luk pangeh iné' dengan na matot maté!" Idi na ieh sikal ngirup abpa' ineh. Kudeng ineh kekamen diteluh luk mebala ineh.
english: He said, “Yahweh, it would certainly not be right for me to drink this water! That would be like RHQ drinking the blood of these men who were willing/ready to die for me!” So he refused to drink it. That was one of the things that those three great warriors did.

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan museh nelun Israil teh, idi Ieh nengubuk ni Daud ku akubdeh ineh, kebalaNeh, "Iapinmu lun Israil idi lun Yahuda.”
english: Yahweh was angry with the Israeli people again, so he incited David to cause trouble for them. He said to David, “Send some men to count the people of Israel and Judah.”

lun_bawang: "Amé' iko mada' ni Daud, 'Kudeng ini bala Tuhan, teluh dalan ini barénKu namu. Mili' iko rat arang Teluh ineh, pad Ui nganau' kuanmu.' “
english: “Go and tell this to David: ‘I am allowing you to choose one of three things to punish you. I will do whichever one you choose.’ ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daud ni Gad, "Ui pelaba gagau. Do' tau mebpeh bang palad Tuhan, ngaceku katuNeh pelaba rayeh. Iamo' aleg ui mebpeh bang palad lemulun.”
english: David said to Gad, “All those are very terrible things for me to choose between! But allow Yahweh to punish MTY me, because he is very merciful. Do not allow humans to punish me, because they will not be merciful.”

lun_bawang: Idi aco sineh Gad iné' matun ni Daud. Kebalaneh neneh, "Do' iko nalan, idi mudut kuan Tuhan aceh bubpun su luk inan Arauna lun Yebusi ineh rumik.”
english: That day Gad came to David and said to him, “Go up to the place where Araunah threshes grain, and build an altar to worship Yahweh there.”

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "Anunké punneh iko macing amé' matun negku ini?" Idi kebala Daud, "Ui pian melih su luk inanmu rumik ini, pad ui miak mudut aceh bubpun kuan Tuhan, pelé kaca ini buro rat nelun mula' ini.”
english: Araunah said, “Your Majesty, why have you come to me?” David replied, “I have come to buy this ground where you thresh grain, in order to build an altar to Yahweh and offer sacrifices on it, in order that he will stop the plague.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Arauna ni Daud, "Do' raca' ngalap idi maré binaweh luk do' sirenmu. Ini sapi' ku baré luk sabpen, idi luk inan rumik idi paga' ku dier sapi' ku kayuh apui.
english: Araunah replied to David, “Your Majesty, offer to Yahweh whatever you wish/want. Here, take my oxen to use for the offering that will be completely burned on the altar. And here, take their yokes and the boards that I use for the threshing, and use them for the wood that you will burn.

lun_bawang: Idi Arauna nemaré amung ineh kuan raca'." Idi kebala Arauna inan raca', "Do' Tuhan Allahmu ngalap luk barénmu ineh.”
english: I, Araunah, am giving all this to you, the king.” Then he said, “I desire/hope that Yahweh our God will accept your offering.”

lun_bawang: -6Idi Adonia anak Daud didueh Hagit ineh pelaba do' taga. Idi ieh pian mangun ku raca'. Ieh tinganak muci ratnan Absalom. Idi na tu-tu Daud museh neneh. Idi tuda'-tuda' keréta idi lun maya' kuda ilapneh dengan limeh ngepulu' burur luk maya' neneh.
english: After Absalom died, David’s oldest surviving son was Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith. He was a very handsome/good-looking man. But David had never rebuked him about anything he did. After Absalom died, Adonijah thought that he would become king. So he started to boast, saying “I will become king now.” Then he provided for himself some chariots, and men to drive them, and horses to pull them, and 50 men to run as his bodyguards in front of those chariots wherever he went.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Natan ni Batsiba tinan Selimun, "Naké iko kali' idi Adonia anak Hagit ineh mangun ku raca', idi Raca' Daud pana' nateh kali' ratnan ineh?
english: So if you want to save yourself and your son Solomon from being killed, allow me to tell you what you should do.

lun_bawang: Amé' iko matun Raca' Daud, idi ngitun neneh, 'Naké iko nepebulung negku ratnan anakku Selimun ineh mangun ku raca' ku libalmu muci? Ngudehké Adonia mangun ku raca' nekini?'
english: Then, while you are still talking to the king, I will come in and tell him that what you are saying to him about Adonijah is true.”

lun_bawang: Batsiba netekeradung pa kiung raca'. Idi kebala raca', "Anun luk pianmu?”
english: She replied, “Your Majesty, you solemnly promised me, knowing that Yahweh our God was listening IDM, that my son Solomon would become king after you die, and that he would sit on your throne and rule.

lun_bawang: Kebala Batsiba neneh, "O raca', naké iko nepebulung negku ku ngadan Tuhan Allahmu, ratnan anakku Selimun ineh mangun ku raca' ku libalmu muci?
english: But now, believe it or not, Adonijah has become king, and you do not know anything about it.

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "Tungé' Nabi Natan." Idi ieh iné' papu' raca' idi netekeradung pa kiungneh.
english: Then Nathan said, “Your Majesty, have you declared that Adonijah will become king after you are no longer the king?

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "O raca', matuké iko pangeh mala Adonia miak mangun ku raca' libalmu?
english: I say that  because today he has gone down to En-Rogel Spring and has sacrificed a lot of oxen, fattened cattle, and sheep. And he has invited all of your other sons, Joab the army commander, and Abiathar the priest. They are all eating and drinking with him and saying ‘We hope/desire that King Adonijah will live a long time!’

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Raca' Daud, "Nawar Batsiba amé' negku." Idi ieh iné' matun raca'. Idi ieh tuped pa kiungneh.
english: Then the king said, “Yahweh has rescued me from all my troubles. I promised you, with Yahweh the God whom we Israelis worship listening, that your son Solomon would be king after I am no longer the king. Today, as surely as Yahweh lives, I solemnly declare that I will do what I promised.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh neneh, "Ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan luk mulun, luk pangeh nenguli' negku ratnan amung-amung dereh,
english: Bathsheba knelt down with her face on the ground and said, “Your Majesty, I hope/desire that you will live for many more years HYP!”

lun_bawang: Batsiba netekeradung pa kiung raca', kebalaneh, "Do' Raca' Daud mipu ulun!”
english: he said to them, “Put my son Solomon on my mule. Take him with my officials down to Gihon Spring.

lun_bawang: Idi Raca' Daud nengecuk nawar Imam Saduk, Nabi Natan, idi Benaya Yoyada amé' neneh. Kareb diteluh nacing,
english: There, you two, Zadok and Nathan, should anoint him, with olive oil to appoint him to be the king of Israel. Then you must blow trumpets, and all the people there must shout, ‘We hope/desire that King Solomon will live for many years!’

lun_bawang: idi kebalaneh nediteluh, "Nguit lun tarehku maya' nemuyuh, idi ngikit anakku Selimun luun keladaiku, idi do' muyuh nated neneh amé' déi' Gihun.
english: Then follow him back here, and he will come and sit on my throne. He will then become king instead of me. I have appointed him to be the ruler of all the people of Israel and of Judah.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Benaya Yoyada kuan raca', "Mo! Do' Tuhan Allahmu ngeletep ineh.
english: So Zadok, Nathan, Benaiah, and the two groups of men who were the king’s bodyguards went and put Solomon on King David’s mule and escorted him down to Gihon Spring.

lun_bawang: Idi Saduk nengalap unga luk inan umau rat bang Lepo Tuhan ineh, idi ieh nengumau ni Selimun. Idi ideh nengiup serupit. Idi amung lun mula' ineh pana' nengitang, kebaladeh, "Do' Raca' Selimun mipu ulun!”
english: When Adonijah and all ◄his guests/the people whom he had invited► were finishing eating at their celebration, they heard the noise. When Joab heard the sound of the trumpets, he asked, “What is causing all that noise in the city?”

lun_bawang: Idi uni ineh nekali' Adonia idi amung lun luk tinawar denganneh, kareb ideh malé pangeh akan. Idi kareb uni serupit ineh nekali' Yoab, kebalaneh, "Anun punneh mula' uni bang bawang ineh?”
english: Jonathan replied, “No, I do not have good news! His Majesty, King David, has caused Solomon to be the king!

lun_bawang: Idi laba' ieh pebala, idi Yonatan anak Abiatar luk imam nacing. Idi kebala Adonia, "Semuet iko, ngaceku iko lemulun luk do', idi iko maré bala luk do' kuan kai.”
english: He sent Zadok, Nathan, Benaiah, and his own group of bodyguards to go with Solomon. They put Solomon on King David’s mule.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yonatan, "Na ieh bala do', iamo' Raca' Daud pangeh nengikit ni Selimun mangun ku raca'.
english: They went down to Gihon Spring, and there Zadok and Nathan anointed him to become the king. Now they have returned from there to the city, shouting joyfully. That is why there is that great/loud noise that you are hearing.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nemada' ni Selimun, ratnan Adonia matot neneh, pad ieh ngimet unga bubpun, kebalaneh, "Nima' raca' Selimun pejani' negku, pad ieh na ngaté negku.”
english: So King Solomon sent some men to Adonijah, and they brought him back from the altar. He came to Solomon and bowed down in front of him. Then Solomon said to him, “Go home.”

lun_bawang: "Tarekku pangeh nacing. Ngaceku ineh do' iko lutep idi mekuu',
english: “I am about to die EUP, like everyone else on earth does. Be courageous and conduct yourself as an adult should.

lun_bawang: Idi Adonia anak Hagit ineh iné' papu' ni Batsiba tinan Selimun. Idi kebala Batsiba neneh, "Iko lawé do'ké?" Kebalaneh, "Mo, lawé do'.”
english: One day Adonijah came to Solomon’s mother Bathsheba. She said to him, “Have you come because you want things to go well?” He replied, “Yes.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh, "Inan aceh itunku namu." Idi kebala Batsiba, "Mada' ieh.”
english: But then he said, “I have something to ask you to do.” She said, “Tell me what you want me to do.”

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "Iko teh pangeh kali', imet ineh pangeh litep kuanku ini, idi amung lun Israil teh pangeh pian negku mangun ku raca'. Idi imet ineh linubed kuan kinanakku. Ngaceku litep Tuhan kuanneh.
english: He said, “You know that all the Israeli people expected me to be their king because I am David’s oldest surviving son. But that did not happen. Instead, my younger brother became king, because that is what Yahweh wanted.

lun_bawang: Idi nekini ui pian mutuh namu. Aleg iko ngarung putuhku ineh.”
english: Now I have one thing that I ask you to do. Please do not refuse to do it.” She replied, “Tell me what you want me to do.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Batsiba, "Mada' ieh." Idi kebalaneh, "Do' iko mutuh Raca' Selimun — na ieh ngarung putuhmu — pad Abisag decur Sunam ineh barénneh negku ku awanku.”
english: He said, “Please ask King Solomon to give to me Abishag, the woman from Shunem town, to be my wife. I am sure that he will not refuse.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Batsiba, "Do'! Ui miak mutuh neneh kuanmu.”
english: Bathsheba replied, “Okay, I will speak to the king for you.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Batsiba, "Inan sesuut itunku namu. Aleg iko ngarung putuhku." Idi kebala raca', "O Ina' mutuh mo'. Idi na ui ngarung putuhmu Ina'.”
english: Then she said, “I have one small thing which I want you to do; please do not say that you will not do it.” The king replied, “Mother, what do you want? I will not refuse you.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Batsiba, "Nima' Abisag decur Sunam ineh barén kuan Adonia kinanakmu ku awanneh.”
english: She said, “Allow Abishag to be given to your older brother Adonijah to be his wife.”

lun_bawang: Idi Selimun nepebulung ku ngadan Tuhan, kebalaneh, "Do' Allah ngukum negku kudeng putuh ini na ngacing até kuan Adonia!
english: Then Solomon solemnly promised, requesting Yahweh to listen, “I wish God would strike me and kill me if I do not cause Adonijah to be executed for requesting this!

lun_bawang: Kareb Raca' Selimun nekali' bala ratnan Yoab pangeh neburo iné' bang Lepo Tuhan, idi ieh tudo iring bupun, idi Selimun nengecuk Benaya Yoyada amé' ngaté neneh.
english: When someone told Solomon that Joab had run to the Sacred Tent and was standing alongside the altar, Solomon told Benaiah, “Go and execute Joab.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Selimun neneh, "Ruenmu kudeng luk bilaneh ineh. Ngaté neneh, idi nanem neneh, pelé iko nala' rat negku idi ratnan tetek ruma'ku amung dara' lemulun luk na mesala' luk pangeh rinuat Yoab.
english: The king replied to him, “Do what he has requested. Kill him and bury his body. If you do that, my descendants MTY and I will no longer be punished for what Joab did when he killed MTY two men who ◄were innocent/had not done anything that is wrong►.

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh idi raca' nengecuk nawar ni Simi. Idi kebalaneh neneh, "Pidutenmu aceh ruma' déi' Yerusalim, idi do' iko tudo bang ineh, idi aleg iko remuat rat déi' amé' iapeh-iapeh.
english: Then the king sent a messenger to summon Shimei, and the king said to him, “Build a house for yourself here in Jerusalem. Remain there and do not leave the city to go anywhere.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Simi, "Mo, Raca'! Miak ui maya' balamu." Idi ieh tudo déi' Yerusalim tuda'-tuda' io.
english: Shimei replied, “Your Majesty, what you say is good. I will do what you have said.” So Shimei remained in Jerusalem for several years.

lun_bawang: Iamo' udung lak luk keteluh, dueh demulun Simi neburo iné' ni raca' Gat, Akis Maaka. Kareb Simi nekali' bala ratnan didueh idi déi' Gat,
english: But three years later, two of Shimei’s slaves ran away. They went to stay with Maacah’s son Achish, the king of Gath city. When someone told Shimei that they were in Gath,

lun_bawang: Iko teh kali' do'-do' bang niatmu sebuleng amung-amung dat luk pangeh inau'mu kuan tamanku Daud. Idi ngaceku ineh Tuhan ngelubed datmu ineh luun uluhmu sebuleng.
english: The king also said to Shimei, “You know all the evil things that you did to my father David. So Yahweh will now punish you for the evil things that you did.

lun_bawang: Idi dacem sineh Tuhan nesilagan neneh bang nupi. Idi kebalaNeh neneh, "Mutuh iko anun luk pianmu, idi miak Ui maré kuanmu.”
english: That night, Yahweh appeared to him in a dream. He asked Solomon, “What would you like me to give to you?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala seburur decur ineh, "O raca', idi ui idi decur ini pamung ruma'. Idi ui nenganak kareb ieh idi denganku bang ruma' ineh.
english: One of them said, “Your Majesty, this woman and I live in the same house. I gave birth to a baby while she was there in the house.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Raca' Selimun, "Kebala seburur, 'Ini anakku luk mulun ineh. Iamo' anakmu ineh pangeh naté.' Idi kebala seburur, 'Na! Luk naté ineh anakmu. Idi luk mulun ineh ui kuan.' “
english: Then the king said, “Both of you are saying, ‘My baby is the one that is alive and the one that is dead is yours.’ ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Amé' ngalap aceh karit kuanku." Idi ideh nemaré aceh karit neneh.
english: So he said to one of his servants, “Bring me a sword.” So the servant brought a sword to the king.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh, "Upanmu luk mulun ineh mangun dueh upa. Idi maré seupa kuan sebuleng decur idi seupa kuan sebuleng.”
english: Then the king said to the servant, “Cut the baby that is alive into two parts. Give one part to each of the women.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Maré anak luk mulun ineh kuan decur ineh. Aleg iko ngaté neneh. Ngaceku ieh ineh tinan anak ineh.”
english: Then the king said to the servant, “Do not kill the baby. Give the baby to the woman who said ‘Do not cut the baby in half,’ because she is truly the baby’s mother.”

lun_bawang: "Iko teh kali' idi tamanku Daud na miak mudut aceh Ruma' kuan ngadan Tuhan Allahneh, ngaceku amung bunu' luk inau'deh pekelibut, pad Tuhan nemaré neneh metueh ratnan amung bunu'neh.
english: “You know that my father David led his soldiers to fight many wars against his enemies in the nearby countries. So he could not arrange to build a temple in which we MTY could worship Yahweh our God, until after Yahweh enabled the Israeli army to defeat IDM all his enemies.

lun_bawang: Kareb Raca' Hiram neninger bala Selimun ineh, idi ieh mawang niat, kebalaneh, "Amung ubur kuan Tuhan bang aco sini teh. Ngaceku Ieh pangeh nemaré kuan Daud aceh anak luk mileh ngimet pupu luk mebala ini.”
english: When Hiram heard the message from Solomon, he was very happy and said, “I praise Yahweh today for giving David a very wise son to rule that great nation!”

lun_bawang: Idi Hiram nengor bala Selimun, kebalaneh, "Ui pangeh neninger bala luk bida'mu negku. Idi ui miak maya' amung pianmu ratnan kayuh tumuh idi kayuh tongor.
english: He sent this message back to Solomon: “I have heard the message that you sent to me, and I am ready to do what you ask. I will provide cedar and cypress logs.

lun_bawang: Idi kesembayang Raca' Selimun: "O Tuhan, Iko pangeh nenganau' aco bang langit, iamo' Iko pian tudo bang laput idi su luk medacem.
english: Then Solomon prayed this: “Yahweh, you have placed the sun in the sky, but you have decided that you would live in very dark clouds.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh, "Amung ubur kuan Tuhan Allah lun Israil luk pangeh nengacing jani'Neh kuan tamanku Daud, kebalaNeh,
english: He said, “Praise Yahweh, the God whom we Israelis belong! By his own power he has done what he promised to give to my father David. What he promised was this:

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Selimun, "Tamanku Daud sikal mudut aceh Ruma' luk inan sembayang nan Tuhan Allah lun Israil.
english: Then Solomon said, “My father David wanted to build a temple in order that we Israeli people could worship Yahweh our God there.

lun_bawang: kesembayangneh, "O Tuhan Allah lun Israil. Na Allah baken, iamo' Iko mo', do' bang langit idi bang tana' pana'. Iko mo' luk maya' jani' idi luk mekatu kuan amung lun dukenmu luk maya' amung balaMu.
english: and he prayed, “Yahweh, the God whom we Israeli people belong to/worship, there is no god like you up in heaven or down here on the earth. You solemnly promised that you would faithfully love us. And that is what you have done for us who earnestly do what you want us to do.

lun_bawang: Idi nekini pana' O Allah lun Israil, ui mutuh Namu maya' jani' luk pijani'Mu nan demulunMu tamanku Daud.
english: So now, God of us Israeli people, cause what you promised to do for my father David, who served you well, to happen.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng seburur pangeh nenganau' sala' nelun denganneh, idi ieh nepebulung neneh pa atun bubpunMu bang Ruma' ini,
english: If someone is accused of doing something wrong to another person, and they bring him to your altar outside this holy temple, and if he says, ‘I did not do that; may God punish me if I am not telling the truth,’

lun_bawang: "Kareb pupuMu lun Israil melaya' pa atun bunu'deh ngaceku pangeh mesala' Namu, idi ideh lumi Namu idi ngubur Namu, idi sembayang mutuh do' bang Ruma' ini,
english: And when your Israeli people are defeated by their enemies in a battle because they have sinned against you, and if they are forced to go to some distant country, if they turn away from their sinful behavior and turn toward this temple and admit that you have justly punished them, and if they plead that you will forgive them,

lun_bawang: "Kareb langit initek pad na inan udan, ngaceku ideh pangeh mesala' Namu, idi ideh uren sium pa Ruma' ini dengan sembayang idi ngubur Namu,
english: And when you do not allow any rain to fall on the land because your people have sinned against you, if they turn toward this temple and admit that you have justly punished them, if they turn away from their sinful behavior and humbly pray to you,

lun_bawang: "Kudeng bang bawang ineh inan iru', kaca, bangas, rapung, bui luk melau', kato, idi uled, idi kudeng bunu'deh ngelibut bawangdeh; kian kaca idi ét macing lek,
english: And when the people of this land experience famines, or if there is a plague/illness that causes many people to become sick, or if their crops are destroyed by very hot winds or by  mildew or by  locusts or grasshoppers, or when their enemies surround any of their cities in order to attack them, if any of those bad things happen to them,

lun_bawang: -42"Idi kudeng seburur lun pupu baken pana' kali' ratnan laludMu idi kekamen luk rayeh luk inau'Mu kuan pupuMu ini, pad ieh macing rat bawang luk mado pian sembayang Namu idi mutuh rat Namu bang Ruma' ini,
english: There will be some foreigners who do not belong to your Israeli people who have come here from countries far away because they have heard that you are very great and that you perform great miracles. If they come here to this temple to worship you and pray,

lun_bawang: "Kareb Iko ngecuk pupuMu amé' pebunu', idi ideh pana' sembayang inan Tuhan sium pa bawang ini luk pinili'Mu idi Ruma' luk pinudutku ini kuanMu,
english: listen in heaven to their prayers; listen to what they plead for you to do, and assist them.

lun_bawang: "Amung ubur kuan Tuhan luk pangeh nemaré do' udeng kuan pupuNeh lun Israil, maya' kudeng amung luk pangeh pijani'Neh. Sebila' bala pana' nateh netutu' ratnan amung jani'Neh luk do' luk pangeh bida'Neh dengan tang demulunNeh Musa.
english: I pray that our God will be with us like he was with our ancestors, and that he will never abandon us.

lun_bawang: O lun pupu Israil do' muyuh lutep maya' Tuhan Allah tau, pad muyuh maya' ukumNeh idi nginita balaNeh, mepad kudeng aco sini.”
english: Then the king and all the Israeli people who were there offered sacrifices to Yahweh.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ni Selimun, "O kinanakku, kudeng apeh bawang ini luk pangeh birému negku?" Idi ideh neneten ineh "Bawang Metugeh" macing aco sini.
english: He said to Solomon, “My friend, those cities that you gave me are worthless!” So, that area is still called ‘Worthless’.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh kuan Raca' Selimun, "Matu bala luk pindengerku déi' bang bawangku rat namu idi ilehmu.
english: She said to King Solomon, “Everything that I heard in my own country about you and about how wise you are is true!

lun_bawang: Idi kareb Hadad neninger bala déi' bawang Masir ratnan Raca' Daud pangeh naté, idi Yoab lun rayeh bawehneh teh pangeh naté, idi kebalaneh nan raca', "Nima' negku muli'.”
english: God also caused another man named Rezon, the son of Eliada, to rebel against Solomon. Rezon had run away from his master, King Hadadezer of the Zobah area north of Damascus.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala raca' Masir neneh, "Ngudehké iko pian muli'? Inanké luk nateh biréku namu?" Iamo' kebala Hadad neneh, "Nima' negku amé'." Hadad, raca' Edom ineh aceh bunu' luk megateh inan Israil.
english: Rezon then became the leader of a group of outlaws. That happened after David’s army had defeated Hadadezer and had also killed all his soldiers. Rezon and his men went to Damascus and started to live there, and the people there appointed him to be their king.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh ni Yerebom, "Lapenmu pulu' babpat ini, ngaceku bala Tuhan Allah lun Israil kudeng ini, 'Ui ngalap imet ineh rat bang palad Raca' Selimun muci, idi pulu' inul pupuneh barénKu namu.
english: I am going to do this because Solomon has rejected me and has been worshiping Astarte, the goddess that the people of Sidon worship, Chemosh, the god that the Moab people-group worship, and Milcom, the god that the Ammon people-group worship. He has not conducted his life as I wanted him to. He has not obeyed my statutes and laws, like his father David did.

english: He went into a cave there and slept there that night. The next morning, Yahweh said to him “Elijah, why are you here?”
