english: When Elijah heard that, he wrapped his cloak around his face. He went out of the cave and stood at its entrance. And he heard Yahweh speaking to him, saying again, “Elijah, why are you here?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Lemubed iko amé' déi' su luk ali-ali muneng ku Damsik. Amé' déi' idi ngumau Hasel mangun ku raca' bawang Siria.
english: Then Yahweh told him, “Go back to the desert near Damascus. When you arrive there, anoint with olive oil a man named Hazael, to appoint him to be the king of Syria.

lun_bawang: Idi Elisa nenecan amung sapi' ineh, idi nupun maya' ni Elia, kebalaneh, "Nima' negku petabi' inan taman-tinanku atun. Pangeh ineh idi miak ui maya' namu." Idi kebala Elia, "Amé' mo' iko, ngaceku na ui ngibpang namu.”
english: Elisha left the oxen standing there and ran after Elijah, and said to him, “I will go with you, but first let me kiss my parents goodbye.” Elijah replied, “Okay, go home. But do not forget why I have given my cloak to you!”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengecuk nelun dukenneh amé' matun ni Akab raca' lun Israil, kebalaneh,
english: Ben-Hadad sent messengers into the city to King Ahab, to say this to him: “This is what King Ben-Hadad says:

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' lun Israil, "Matu balamu. Ui pana' kuanmu dengan amung luk ui kuan.”
english: The king of Israel replied to them, “Tell this to King Ben-Hadad: ‘I agree to do what you requested. You can have me and everything that I own.’”

lun_bawang: Idi lun luk icuk ineh iné' sekua' teh, kebaladeh, "Kudeng ini bala Raca' Benhadad, 'Idi ui pangeh nengecuk nelun duken amé' matun namu mada': "Amas, pirak, idi amung anak idi awanmu na miak na barénmu negku.”
english: The messengers told that to Ben-Hadad, and he sent them back with another message: “I sent a message to you saying that you must give me all your silver and gold and your wives and your children.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala amung lun rayeh idi lun mula' ineh teh, "Aleg iko ninger balaneh idi ngamo putuhneh.”
english: The leaders and all the other people said to him, “Do not pay any attention to him! Do not do what he is requesting!”

lun_bawang: ratnan Benhadad, kebalaneh, "Nima' amung allah ngaté negku, kudeng ui na nguit petap ula' lemulun ngusag bawangmu ini, pad ideh miak naban amung usagneh.”
english: In that message he said, “We will destroy your city completely, with the result that there will not be enough dust and rubble left for each of my soldiers to have one handful! I hope/wish that the gods will strike me dead if we do not do that!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Akab nelun duken ineh, "Mada' ini kuanneh, 'Lun luk ngabin pelapetneh aleg medita' niat, mepad kudeng lemulun luk pangeh metueh.' “
english: King Ahab replied to the messengers, “Tell King Ben-Hadad that a soldier who is putting on his armor preparing to fight a battle MTY should not boast at that time; he should wait until after he wins the battle.”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb Benhadad neninger bala ini laba' ieh tudo ngirup dengan amung raca' ineh bang lepodeh, idi kebalaneh kuan anak itinneh, "Temina' muyuh idi amé' munu' bawang ineh." Idi ideh nenganau' kudeng ineh.
english: Ben-Hadad heard that message while he and the other rulers were drinking wine in their temporary shelters. He told his men to prepare to attack MTY the city. So his men did that.

lun_bawang: Idi inan aceh nabi luk iné' matun ni Akab raca' lun Israil, kebalaneh, "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan, 'Aleg matot ku baweh luk rayeh ineh. Ngaceku aco sini teh Ui maré nedeh bang paladmu, pad iko kali' Ui ini mo' Tuhan.' “
english: At that moment, a prophet came to King Ahab and said to him, “This is what Yahweh says: ‘Do not be at all afraid of RHQ the large enemy army that you see! I will enable your army to defeat them today, and you will know that it is I, Yahweh, who have the power to do what I say that I will do.’”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Akab, "Idéké luk miak ngedengan nekai pebunu'?" Idi kebala nabi neneh, "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan, 'Anak adi' luk pa liang lun luk ngimet anid babpat Israil.' " Idi kebala raca', "Idéké miak ngimun bunu' ineh?" Idi kebala nabi ineh, "Iko.”
english: Ahab asked, “What group of our army will defeat them?” The prophet replied, “The young soldiers who are commanded by the district governors will do it.” The king asked, “Who should lead the attack?” The prophet replied, “You should!”

lun_bawang: Idi anak adi' ineh nenalan atun. Idi kebala lun duken Benhadad luk iné' nier, 'Inan tuda'-tuda' lemulun neremuat rat Samaria.”
english: The young soldiers advanced first. Some scouts who had been sent out by Ben-Hadad reported to him, “There are men coming out of Samaria city”!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' nedeh, "Kudeng ideh remuat pian pedo', do' muyuh ngakem nedeh mulun. Kudeng ideh remuat sikal pebunu' pana', ngakem nedeh mulun teh.”
english: He said, “It does not matter whether they are coming to fight against us or to ask for peace. Capture them, but do not kill them

lun_bawang: Idi kebala nabi inan Raca' Akab, "Lemubed iko idi nuneb bawehmu ineh, idi ngerawé do'-do' ratnan luk miak ruenmu, ngaceku raca' Siria miak pebunu' namu lak baruh teh.”
english: Then that same prophet went to King Ahab and said to him, “Go back and prepare your soldiers, and think carefully about what will be necessary for you to do, because the king of Syria with attack with his army again in the springtime of next year.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun tareh Raca' Benhadad neneh, "Allah-allah lun Israil, ieh ineh allah-allah pegkung. Ngaceku ineh ideh meluun tueh rat netau. Iamo' kudeng tau pebunu' nedeh luun tana' luk meraked, kali' rungen amung tau miak ngelaya' nedeh.
english: After the Syrian army was defeated, Ben-Hadad’s officials said to him, “The gods that the Israelis worship are gods who live in the hills. Samaria is built on a hill, and that is why their soldiers were able to defeat us. But if we fight against them in the plains/lowlands, we certainly will be able to defeat them.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengayung ku kibung guni, idi nenganau' nuper luun dierdeh. Idi ideh iné' matun raca' Israil, kebaladeh, "Demulunmu Benhadad mutuh namu ngulun neneh." Idi kebala Akab, "Mulun tiehké? Do'! Ieh mepad kudeng kinanakku.”
english: The king permitted them to do that, so they wrapped coarse sacks around their waists and put ropes on their heads/necks, and they went to the king of Israel and said to him, “Ben-Hadad, who greatly respects you, says, ‘Please do not kill me.’” Ahab replied, “Is he still alive? He is like a brother to me!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala seburur rat arang amung anak nabi kuan lun denganneh, dengan bala Allah, "Dedatenmu ui." Iamo' lun ineh na sikal necat neneh.
english: Then Yahweh spoke to a member of a group of prophets and said to him, “Ask one of your fellow prophets to strike and wound you.” So he did what Yahweh told him to do. He said to one of his fellow prophets, ‘Strike me and wound me.’ But that man refused to do it.

lun_bawang: Idi nabi ineh nepapu' aceh lun baken, idi kebalaneh, "Dedatenmu ui." Idi lun ineh nenecat neneh pad ieh nurat.
english: Then the prophet found another prophet, and said to him, “Strike me!” So that man hit him very hard and injured him.

lun_bawang: Idi kareb ui ini mesaso ku kekamenku idi lun ini na idi peh." Idi kebala raca' lun Israil, "Ini ukummu. Iko sebuleng pangeh nemutut ineh.
english: But while I was busy doing other things, the man escaped!” The king of Israel said to him, “That is your problem! You yourself have said that you deserve to be punished.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Nabot, "Ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan. Na tu ui pian maré babpat luk ilap ratnan tepunku ini namu.”
english: But Naboth replied, “That land belonged to my ancestors, so I want to keep it. I hope that Yahweh will never allow me to give that land to you!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Isabel neneh, "Anun punmu mét niat, pad iko na kuman?”
english: His wife Jezebel came in and asked him, “Why are you so depressed? Why are you refusing to eat anything?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Isabel neneh, "Matuké iko raca' lun Israil? Tumui idi kuman, idi ngawang niatmu. Ui miak maré kabun anggur Nabot kuanmu.”
english: His wife replied, “You are RHQ the king of Israel, so you can get whatever you want Get up, and eat some food and do not worry about what Naboth said. I will get Naboth’s vineyard for you.”

lun_bawang: Idi bala amung surat ineh kudeng ini: "Do' muyuh ngeletep aceh aco, pad amung lun mawa'. Idi do' Nabot tudo su luk medita' pa atun amung lemulun.
english: This is what she wrote in the letters: “Proclaim a day when all the people will gather together and ◄fast/abstain from eating food►. Give to Naboth an important place to sit among them.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengecuk nelun amé' mada' ni Isabel, "I Nabot ineh pangeh naté binitung ku batu.”
english: Then those leaders sent a message to Jezebel, saying “We have executed Naboth.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Isabel neninger bala ineh, idi ieh nepebala ni Akab, "Do' iko amé' ngalap kabun anggur Nabot lun Yesril ineh kuanmu, ieh ineh kabun luk dibpinneh pisuen namu. Ngaceku i Nabot ineh pangeh naté.”
english: When Jezebel found out that Naboth had been killed, she told Ahab, “Naboth is dead. Now you can go and take possession of the vineyard that he refused to sell to you.”

lun_bawang: "Do' iko amé' papu' Raca' Akab luk ngimet déi' Samaria ineh. Ngaceku ieh idi bang kabun anggur Nabot, idi ieh pian ngalap ineh kuanneh.
english: “Go to Samaria and talk to Ahab, the king of Israel. He is in the vineyard of a man named Naboth. He has gone there to claim that he now owns it.

lun_bawang: Idi mada' kuanneh, 'Kudeng ini bala Tuhan, "Pangehké iko nengaté lemulun idi nengaro binawehneh?" ' Idi teh do' iko mada' neneh, 'Kudeng ini bala Tuhan: "Su luk inan uko' pangeh nengil dara' Nabot ineh, su ineh teh inan uko' ngil dara'mu!" ' “
english: Tell Ahab that this is what I, Yahweh, say to him: ‘You have murdered Naboth and taken his land.’ So I am telling you this: ‘In the same place where Naboth died and dogs came and licked up Naboth’s blood, you will die and the dogs will lick up your blood, too!’ ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Akab ni Elia, "Pangehké iko kali' negku, O bunu'ku!" Idi kebala Elia, "Matu ui kali' namu. Iamo' iko pangeh nemasui bururmu idi pangeh nenganau' luk dat pa kiung Tuhan.
english: So when Elijah met with Ahab, Ahab said to him, “You, my enemy, have found me!” RHQ Elijah answered, “Yes, I have found you. You have never stopped doing the things that Yahweh says are wrong.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ratnan Isabel, ieh miak kenen uko' bang bawang Yesril.
english: Yahweh has also told me that your wife Jezebel will be killed, and dogs in Jezreel will eat her corpse.

lun_bawang: "Pangehké iko nenier Akab nengebeneh bururneh pa kiungKu? Na Ui ngacing dat ineh seruked ulunneh, ngaceku ieh pangeh nengebeneh bururneh pa kiungKu. Iamo' bang kareb anakneh muci Ui ngacing dat ineh kuan uang tetek ruma'neh."
english: “I have seen RHQ that Ahab is now very sorry for all the evil things that he has done. So the things that I promised to do to his family will not happen while he is still alive. I will cause them to happen after his son becomes king. Then those things will happen to his family.” MTY

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Akab nan lun tarehneh, "Kali' muyuh idi Ramot Giliad ineh tau kuan idi tau ungeng mo', na tau ngaro bawang ineh rat bang palad raca' bawang Siria?”
english: While they were talking, Ahab said to his officials, “Do you realize that the Syrians are still occupying our city of Ramoth in the Gilead region? And we are doing nothing to retake that city!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh kuan Raca' Yosapat, "Pian iko maya' negku amé' pebunu' dei' Ramot Giliad?" Idi kebala Yosapat, "Kudeng iko temina', ui pana' temina' dengan lun pebunu'ku idi teh kuda.
english: Then he turned to Jehoshaphat and asked, “Will your army join my army to fight against the people of Ramoth and retake that city?” Jehoshaphat replied, “Certainly I will do whatever you want, and you may command my troops. You may take my horses into battle, also.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' do' iko ngitun Tuhan atun.”
english: Then he added, “But we should ask Yahweh first, to find out what he wants us to do.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yosapat, "Inanké nabi Tuhan baken tungé', luk miak tunin tau?”
english: But Jehoshaphat asked, “Is there no prophet of Yahweh here whom we can ask?”

lun_bawang: Idi Raca' Akab nenawar seburur lun tarehneh, kebalaneh, "Amé' iko nguit Mikaya Imla ineh amé' tungé' dengan mesaget.”
english: So the king of Israel told one of his officers to summon Micaiah immediately.

lun_bawang: Idi Nabi Sedekia Kenana pangeh nenganau' unga belawan. Idi kebalaneh ni Akab, "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan: 'Idi kudeng ini teh lawému miak ngegkul- ngegkul nelun bawang Siria ineh, pad iko ngaté nedeh ineh.' “
english: One of them, whose name was Zedekiah, the son of Kenaanah, had made from iron something that resembled horns of a bull. Then he proclaimed to Ahab, “This is what Yahweh says: ‘With horns like these your army will keep attacking the Syrians like a bull attacks another animal MET, until you completely destroy them!’”

lun_bawang: Idi kudeng ineh teh bada' amung nabi ineh, kebaladeh, "Do' iko amé' déi' Ramot idi kali' rungen iko metueh. Ngaceku Tuhan miak maré nedeh bang paladmu.”
english: All the other prophets of Ahab agreed. They said, “Yes! If you go up to attack Ramoth city in the Gilead region, you will be successful, because Yahweh will enable you to defeat them!”

lun_bawang: Idi lun luk icuk amé' nawar ni Mikaya ineh, nepebala neneh, "Amung nabi baken mada' luk do' kuan raca'. Do' iko pana' mada' kudeng ineh teh.”
english: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to summon Micaiah said to him, “Listen to me! All the other prophets are predicting that the king’s army will defeat the Syrians. So be sure that you agree with them and say ◄what will be favorable/that the king’s army will be successful►.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Mikaya, "Ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan luk mulun, idi anun luk belén Tuhan negku, ineh teh luk belénku.”
english: But Micaiah replied, “As surely as Yahweh lives, I will tell him only what Yahweh tells me to say.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Akab neneh, "Tuda' kua' ui nemebpeng namu na miak pebala luk na matu dengan ngadan Tuhan?”
english: But King Ahab realized that Micaiah was ◄lying/being sarcastic►, so he said to Micaiah, “I have told you RHQ many times that you must always tell only the truth when you say what Yahweh has revealed to you!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Mikaya neneh, "Ui pangeh nenier amung lun Israil urap-urap luun pegkung, mepad kudeng dumba luk na lun matar. Idi Tuhan nepebala, 'Ideh ini na inan lun nguyut, ngaceku ineh nima' anid-aniddeh muli' dengan do'.' “
english: So Micaiah said to him, “The truth is that in a vision I saw all the troops of Israel scattered on the mountains. They seemed to be like sheep that did not have a shepherd. And Yahweh said, ‘Their master has been killed. So tell them all to go home peacefully.’ ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Akab ni Yosapat, "Naké ui nepebala namu, sesuut pana' nateh balaneh do' negku. Iamo' ieh pelaba dat bala?”
english: Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “I told you RHQ that he never predicts that anything good will happen to me! He always predicts that bad things will happen to me.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Mikaya, "Ninger iko bala Tuhan. Ui pangeh nenier Tuhan tudo luun kerusiNeh. Idi amung melaikat luk déi' surga tuped pekop iringNeh.
english: But Micaiah continued, saying, “Listen to what Yahweh showed to me! In a vision I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, with all the armies of heaven surrounding him, on his right side and on his left side.

lun_bawang: Idi Sedekia nemepag kiung Mikaya, kebalaneh, "Kudeng apeh Roh Tuhan ineh mubuh rat negku pad ieh pebala namu?”
english: Then Zedekiah walked over to Micaiah and slapped him on his face. He said, “Do you think that Yahweh’s Spirit left me in order to speak to you?” RHQ

lun_bawang: Kebala Mikaya, "Iko teh miak kali' kareb iko buro amé' sigapung bang takep.”
english: Micaiah replied, “You will find out for yourself which of us Yahweh’s Spirit has truly spoken to on the day when you go into a room of some house to hide from the Syrian troops!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Raca' Akab, "Ngakem Mikaya idi nguit neneh lemubed amé' ni Amon lun rayeh bawang idi ni Yoas anak raca' ineh.
english: King Ahab commanded his soldiers, “Seize Micaiah and take him to Amon, the governor of this city, and to my son Joash.

lun_bawang: Idi ngecuk nedidueh, Kebala raca', 'Nipa lemulun ini bang tutup. Idi maré neneh sesuut ruti idi abpa' mo' pad macing ui muli' dengan do'.' “
english: Tell them that I have commanded that they should put this man in prison and give him only bread and water. Do not give him anything else to eat until I return safely from the battle!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Mikaya, "Kudeng iko muli' dengan do', kali rungen na Tuhan nepebala negku." Idi teh kebalaneh, "Ninger O amung muyuh!”
english: Micaiah replied, “If you return safely, it will be clear that it was not Yahweh who told me what to say to you!” Then he said to all those who were standing there, “Do not forget what I have said to King Ahab!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Akab ni Yosapat, "Ui sikal ngisu' ayuku, idi amé' pebunu'. Iamo' do' iko ngayung ku ayung raca' teh." Idi raca' lun Israil nengelibal ayungneh idi iné' pebunu'.
english: King Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “I will put on different clothes, in order that no one will recognize that I am the king. But you should wear your ◄royal robe/robe that shows that you are a king►.” So Ahab disguised himself, and they both went into the battle.

lun_bawang: Idi raca' bawang Siria ineh nemebpeng amung lun rayeh keréta, teluh ngepulu' dueh burur kinula'deh, kebalaneh, "Aleg muyuh pebunu' nelun baken, iamo' raca' lun Israil mo' sebuleng luk uen munu'.”
english: The King of Syria told this to his thirty-two men who were driving the chariots: “Attack only the king of Israel!”

lun_bawang: Kareb lun rayeh keréta ineh nenier Raca' Yosapat, idi ideh nengerawé neneh raca' lun Israil. Idi ideh iné' munu' neneh. Iamo' kareb Raca' Yosapat nengitang,
english: So when the men who were driving the Syrian chariots saw Jehoshaphat wearing ◄his royal robes/clothes that showed he was the king►, they pursued him. They shouted, “There is the king of Israel!” But when Jehoshaphat cried out,

lun_bawang: Idi kareb aco lélé macep, inan seburur nengitang arang uned baweh ineh, kebalaneh, "Do' anid-anid burur muli' amé' bang bawangneh sebuleng!”
english: Just as the sun was going down, someone among the Israeli troops shouted, “The battle is ended! Everyone should return home!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Raca' Ahasia Akab kuan Raca' Yosapat, "Do' anak itinku maya' anak itinmu bang kapal ineh." Iamo' Raca' Yosapat na sikal.
english: Before the ships were wrecked, Ahab’s son Ahaziah suggested to Jehoshaphat, “Allow my sailors to go with your sailors,” but Jehoshaphat refused.

lun_bawang: Mada' raca' ratnan luk bila Tuhan, kebalaNeh, 'Na iko miak do' ratnan étmu. Iamo' kali' rungen iko maté.' " Idi Elia nemaya' luk icuk Tuhan,
english: Yahweh says that you should tell King Ahaziah that he will not recover from his being injured; he will surely die.’”

lun_bawang: idi lun duken ineh nelemubed iné' inan raca'. Idi raca' nengitun nedeh, kebalaneh, "Anun pun muyuh nelemubed?”
english: So Elijah went to meet the messengers and told that to them, and they returned to the king instead of going to Ekron. The king asked them, “Why did you return so soon?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Kudeng apeh ayu lun ineh?”
english: The king said to them, “The man who came to meet you and told that to you, what did he look like?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "Ieh lun luk ngayung ku kibung luk mebuluh, idi abet awa'neh ratnan kubil pung." Idi kebala raca', "Ieh ineh Elia.”
english: They replied, “He was a hairy man and he had a wide leather belt around his waist.” The king exclaimed, “That was Elijah!”

lun_bawang: Idi sekua' teh raca' nengecuk seburur lun rayeh baweh luk baken dengan limeh ngepulu' burur anak itinneh. Idi kebalaneh ni Elia, "O nabi Allah, raca' ngecuk namu temurun dengan mesaget.”
english: When the king found out about that, he sent another officer with 50 more soldiers. They went to where Elijah was, and the officer called out to him, “Prophet, the king commands that you come down immediately!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elia neneh, "Kudeng ui ini nabi Allah do' apui temurun rat i langit ngeseb amung muyuh." Idi apui pana' netemurun rat i langit idi nengeseb amungdeh.
english: But Elijah replied, “I am a prophet; to prove that, I command that fire come down from the sky and kill you and your soldiers!” Then a fire from God came down from the sky and killed the officer and his soldiers.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala melaikat Tuhan ni Elia, "Temurun iko maya' neneh. Aleg matot!" Idi Elia nenalan maya' neneh iné' papu' raca'.
english: Then the angel from Yahweh said to Elijah, “Go down and go  with him. Do not be afraid of him.” So Elijah went with them to the king.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elia ni Elisa, "Do' iko ketecan ieni. Ngaceku ui pangeh icuk Tuhan amé' déi' Baitel." Iamo' kebala Elisa, "Ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan luk mulun, idi ulunmu pana', na tu ui sikal patad rat namu." Pangeh ineh idi didueh nenalan iné' déi' Baitel.
english: Elijah said to Elisha, “Stay here, because Yahweh has told only me to go to Bethel town.” But Elisha replied, “Just as certainly as Yahweh lives and you live, I will not leave you!” So they went down together to Bethel.

lun_bawang: Idi anak sekola' nabi luk déi' Baitel iné' ni Elisa, kebaladeh, "Kali'mu idi aco sini lun rayehmu lapen Tuhan rat namu?" Idi kebala Elisa, "Ui kali'. Pirud muyuh.”
english: A group of prophets came to Elisha and Elijah before they entered the town, and they asked Elisha, “Do you know that Yahweh is going to take your master/boss Elijah away from you today?” Elisha answered, “Certainly I know that, but don’t talk about it!” IDM

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elia ni Elisa, "Do' iko ketecan ieni, ngaceku ui icuk Tuhan amé' Yeriko. Iamo' kebala Elisa, "Ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan luk mulun, idi ulunmu pana', na tu ui sikal patad rat namu." Idi didueh iné' déi' Yeriko.
english: Then Elijah said to Elisha, “Stay here, because Yahweh has told only me to go to Jericho.” But Elisha replied again, “Just as certainly as Yahweh lives and you live, I will not leave you!” So they went together to Jericho city.

lun_bawang: Idi anak sekola' nabi luk déi' Yeriko iné' ni Elisa, kebaladeh, "Kali'mu aco sini lun rayehmu lapen Tuhan rat namu?" Idi kebala Elisa, "Ui kali'. Pirud muyuh.”
english: As they neared Jericho, a group of prophets who were from there came to Elisha and said to him, “Do you know that Yahweh is going to take your master/boss Elijah away from you today?” He answered again, “Certainly I know that, but don’t talk about it!” IDM

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elia ni Elisa, "Do' iko ketecan ieni, ngaceku ui pangeh icuk Tuhan amé' déi' Abpa' Yarden." Iamo' kebala Elisa, "Ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan luk mulun, idi ulunmu pana', na tu ui sikal patad rat namu." Idi didueh nenalan.
english: Then Elijah said to Elisha, “Stay here, because Yahweh has told only me to go to the Jordan River.” But again Elisha replied, “As certainly as Yahweh lives and you live, I will not leave you!” So they continued walking together.

lun_bawang: Kareb didueh nepegeta, idi kebala Elia ni Elisa, "Mutuh iko anun luk miak ruenku kuanmu atun kareb nateh ui lapen Tuhan rat iringmu." Idi kebala Elisa, "Do' iko maré dueh babpat laludmu negku.”
english: When they came to the other side, Elijah said to Elisha, “What do you want me to do for you before ◄I am taken away/Yahweh takes me away►?” Elisha replied, “I want to receive twice as much of your power as you have had, (OR enable me to very powerfully continue your ministry).”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elia neneh, "Luk pinutuhmu ineh mikat tu. Kudeng iko nier negku kareb ui lapen rat iringmu, idi miak mangun kuanmu kudeng ineh. Iamo' kudeng na, idi ineh na miak mangun peh.”
english: Elijah replied, “You have asked for something which is difficult for me to cause to happen. But, if you see me when ◄I am taken from you/Yahweh takes me from you►, you will get what you are requesting. But if you do not see me, then you will not get it.”

lun_bawang: Idi Elisa nenier ineh idi ieh nengitang, "O ama'! O ama'! Siruh keréta Israil idi lun luk maya' kuda!" Idi ieh na kali'neh peh. Idi Elisa nenarak kuyu'neh upa dueh.
english: Elisha saw it. He cried out, “My father/master! My father/master! The chariots of us Israeli people and their drivers have taken my master away!” They disappeared into the sky, and Elisha never saw Elijah again. Then Elisha tore his own robe into two pieces to show that he was sad.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nemabpet abpa' ineh ku kuyu' Elia. Idi kebalaneh, "Iapehké Tuhan Allah Elia ineh?" Idi kareb ieh pangeh nenecat abpa' ineh, idi abpa' nepatad. Idi Elisa neguta.
english: He rolled up the cloak and struck the water with it, and cried out, “Will Yahweh, the God who enabled Elijah to perform miracles, enable me to do similar things?” Then the water separated, and a path opened up for him, and Elisha went across.

lun_bawang: Kareb anak sekola' nabi luk déi' Yeriko nenier i dipar ineh, idi kebaladeh, "Roh Elia ineh idi ni Elisa peh." Idi ideh iné' papu neneh. Idi ideh netekunal pa kiungneh.
english: When the group of prophets from Jericho saw what happened, they exclaimed, “Elisha now has the power that Elijah had!” MTY They walked over to him and bowed down in front of him.

lun_bawang: Iamo' ideh pelaba saad pad ieh migu'. Idi kebalaneh, "Amé' mo'." Idi limeh ngepulu' burur ineh nenakap neneh teluh aco kinioneh. Idi na ieh nekali'deh.
english: But they kept insisting. Finally he was tired of saying “No,” and he said, “Okay, send them.” So 50 men searched for three days, but they did not find Elijah.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nelemubed iné' ni Elisa, luk tudo nganét nedeh déi' Yeriko. Idi kebala Elisa nedeh, "Pangeh ui nemala nemuyuh, 'Aleg muyuh amé'.' “
english: They returned to Jericho, and Elisha was still there. He said to them, “I told you that you should not go, because you would not find him!” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi lun rat bawang Yeriko iné' ni Elisa, kebaladeh, "Su inan bawang ini do' tu. Iko pana' kali' teh. Iamo' abpa'neh na do'. Idi decur luk mali' megéi' musul.”
english: Then the leaders of Jericho city came to talk with Elisha. One of them said, “Our master, we have a problem. You can see that this is a very nice place to live in. But the water is bad, and as a result, crops will not grow on the land.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elisa, "Ngalap aceh bigan baruh kuanku, idi nganau' sesuut tucu' bang idi." Idi ideh nenguit bigan ineh iné' neneh.
english: Elisha said to them, “Put some salt in a new bowl and bring the bowl to me.” So they brought it to him.

lun_bawang: Idi Elisa iné' déi' bued abpa', idi ieh nengutang amung tucu' ineh bang idi. Kebalaneh, "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan, 'Abpa' ini pangeh dino'Ku. Idi ngaceku ineh na luk miak mangun ku luk inan maté, idi na anak musul teh.' “
english: Then he went out to the spring from which the people in the town got water. He threw the salt into the spring. Then he said, “This is what Yahweh says: ‘I have made this water good/pure. No longer will anyone die, from having drunk this water, and now crops will be able to grow.’” LIT

lun_bawang: Idi rat ieneh Elisa nenalan iné' Baitel. Idi laba' ieh nalan inan tuda'-tuda' anak adi' deléi neremuat rat bang bawang Baitel idi nesitunga neneh, kebaladeh, "O butal, buro! O butal, buro!”
english: Elisha left Jericho and went up to Bethel. As he was walking along the road, a group of young boys from Bethel saw him and started to make fun of him. They continued shouting, “Go away, you bald-headed man!”

lun_bawang: Idi Raca' Yosapat nengitun, "Maya' dalan sapeh tau?" Idi kebala Yoram, "Maya' su luk ali-ali déi' Edom.”
english: He asked, “On which road shall we march to attack them?” Joram replied, “We will go south to Jerusalem, where your army will join us. Then we will all go south of the Dead Sea, and then turn north through the Edom Desert.”

lun_bawang: idi kebala Raca' Yoram, "Mesusa' tu-tu, Tuhan maré netau teluh bang palad lun Moab.”
english: The king of Israel exclaimed, “This is a terrible situation! It seems that Yahweh will allow the three of us to be captured by the army of MTY Moab!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Raca' Yosapat, "Ieh ineh nabi luk matu." Idi teluh raca' ineh iné' neneh.
english: Jehoshaphat said, “It will be good to ask him, because he speaks what Yahweh tells him to say.” So those three kings went to Elisha.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elisa, "Ui ini demulun Tuhan idi ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan luk mulun. Kudeng na ui ngerawé Yosapat raca' Yahuda ineh, kali' rungen na ui pian ngedengan namu.
english: Elisha replied, “I serve Yahweh, the commander of the armies of angels in heaven. As surely as he lives, if I did not respect Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not even think about doing anything to help you.

lun_bawang: pad ieh nemada', "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan, 'Ngukat abang bang arur luk nekeket ini.
english: He said, “Yahweh says that he will cause this dry stream-bed to be full of water.

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "Dara' mo' ini. Kali' rungen amung raca' ineh pangeh pepaté. Do' tau amé' ngaro binawehdeh!”
english: They exclaimed, “It is blood! The three enemy armies must have fought and killed each other! So let’s go and take everything that they have left!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elisa neneh, "Anunké miak ruenku kuanmu? Mada' negku anun luk bang ruma'mu." Idi kebalaneh, "Na luk anun-anun bang ruma'ku, iamo' sebuleng mo' sidangur umau saitun.”
english: Elisha replied, “What can I do to help you? Tell me, what do you have in your house?” She replied, “We have only a container of olive oil; we have nothing else.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elisa, "Do' iko mutuh tuda'-tuda' sidangur rat nelun denganmu, ieh ineh luk na uang. Do' mutuh mula'.
english: Elisha said, “Go to your neighbors and borrow from them as many empty jars as you can.

lun_bawang: Kareb amung sidangur ineh pangeh panu', idi kebalaneh nan anakneh, "Inanké sidangur teh?" Idi kebala anak ineh neneh, "Na luk idi peh." Idi umau ineh pana' nugka'.
english: Soon all the jars were full. So she said to one of her sons, “Bring me another jar!” But he replied, “There are no more jars!” And then the olive oil stopped flowing.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh iné' ni Elisa. Idi kebala nabi neneh, "Amé' iko masui umau ineh ku ngua' balehmu. Idi elaneh kuanmu sebuleng idi kuan anak-anakmu.”
english: When she told Elijah what had happened, he said to her, “Now sell the jars of oil. And with the money you get, pay what you owe, and there will be enough extra money to keep buying food for yourself and your sons.” So she did that.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala decur ineh inan awanneh, "Ui kali nabi Allah luk megéi' lemaba bawang tau ineh, ieh ineh seburur lun luk meligan.
english: One day the woman said to her husband, “I am sure that this man who often comes here is a prophet who brings messages  from God.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengecuk nelun dukenneh Gehasi nawar decur ineh. Kareb ieh iné' su inan Elisa ineh,
english: He said to his servant Gehazi, “Tell the woman that I want to speak to her.” So the servant went and told her. When she came to the doorway of Elisha’s room,

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elisa, "Kian anun luk miak ruenku kuan decur ini?" Idi ieh nengor balaneh, "Na ieh inan anak deléi, idi awanneh pana' pangeh mengered.”
english: Later, Elisha asked Gehazi, “What do you think that we can do for that woman?” He replied, “She does not have a son, and her husband is an old man. So maybe we should ask Yahweh to enable her to have a son.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elisa, "Nawar neneh." Idi ieh nenawar neneh. Idi ieh netuped munung tanga'.
english: Elisha told Gehazi, “Call her back again.” So Gehazi went and called her. And when the woman returned, as she stood in the doorway,

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elisa neneh, "Lak baruh, kareb luk kudeng ini, iko inan anak deléi." Idi kebala decur ineh, "O nabi Allah aleg iko naluk negku ini.”
english: Elisha said to her, “About this time next year you will be holding your infant son in your arms.” But she protested, “O, sir, you are a prophet who brings messages  from God, so please do not deceive/lie to me by saying things like that!”

lun_bawang: Idi denak-denak ieh nengitang kuan tamanneh, "Mét uluh ku! Mét uluhku!" Idi kebala tamanneh kuan seburur lun dukenneh, "Nated neneh amé' nan tinanneh.”
english: Suddenly the boy exclaimed, “My head hurts! My head hurts a lot!” His father said to one of the servants, “Carry him home to his mother!”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nenawar awanneh, idi kebalaneh, "Ngecuk seburur lun duken amé' negku, dengan sebuleng keladai, pelé ui mesaget amé' matun Nabi Elisa ineh. Pangeh ineh ui miak lemubed.”
english: She then called out to her husband, saying, “Send to me one of the servants and a donkey, so that I can ride on it quickly to the prophet, and then come back!” But she did not tell her husband that their son had died.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala deléineh neneh, "Ngudeh iko amé' neneh aco sini? Na ieh Bulan Baruh. Na ieh Aco luk inan Mudeng." Idi kebalaneh, "Na mekudeh.”
english: Her husband called out to her and said, “Why do you want to go today? This is not the day when we celebrate the Festival of the New Moon, and it is not a Sabbath day!” But she only replied, “Just do what I requested and everything will be all right.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nenapin keted keladaineh ineh. Idi kebalaneh kuan lun dukenneh, "Do' tau mawer. Kareb ui pian ucu' miak ui maré kali'.”
english: So she told the servant to put saddles on two donkeys, and as they left, she said, “Hurry! Do not slow down unless t tell you to do that!”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nenalan peh, idi nacing inan Nabi Elisa luun Pegkung Karmel. Kareb Elisa nenier neneh rat mado, idi kebalaneh ni Gehasi, lun dukenneh ineh, "Nier, decur Sunam ineh macing.
english: As they approached Carmel Mountain, where Elisha was, Elisha saw her in the distance. He said to Gehazi, “Look, the woman from Shunem is coming!

lun_bawang: Do' iko mesaget amé' papu' neneh, idi ngitun neneh, 'Do' ikoké? Idi do'ké ulun awanmu idi anakmu?' " Idi kebala decur ineh, "Do'.”
english: Run to her, and ask her if everything is all right with her and her husband and with her child!” So Gehazi ran to her and asked her, but she did not tell Gehazi anything. She only said, “Yes, everything is fine.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala decur ineh, "Inanké ui pangeh nemutuh seburur anak rat namu? Naké ui nemebpeng namu na naluk negku?”
english: Then she said to Elisha, “O, sir, I did not ask you to enable me to give birth to a son RHQ. And I told you not to lie to me about that!” RHQ

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala decur ineh ni Elisa, "Ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan luk mulun luk inanku merapet, idi ku ulunmu pana', na ui sikal necan namu!" Idi ngaceku ineh Elisa nenalan maya' neneh.
english: But the boy’s mother said, “Just as certain as Yahweh lives and you live, I will not go home if you do not go with me.” So Elisha returned with her to her home.

lun_bawang: Idi Gehasi ineh nenalan atun rat nedidueh. Idi ieh nengerareng rukud ineh luun anak ineh. Iamo' bala pana' nateh. Idi na anak ineh nesigio. Idi ieh nelemubed iné' papu' ni Elisa, kebalaneh, "Na anak ineh sigio peh.”
english: Gehazi hurried quickly, and when he got to the woman’s home, he laid the staff/walking stick on the child’s face, but the child did not move or say anything. So Gehazi returned to meet Elisha along the road, and told him, “The child is still dead.”

lun_bawang: Idi Elisa nenawar ni Gehasi, kebalaneh, "Darinmu decur Sunam ineh." Idi ieh nenawar neneh. Kareb ieh nacing idi Elisa nengecuk neneh ngalap anakneh.
english: Then Elisha summoned Gehazi. He said, “Call the boy’s mother!” So Gehazi went and called her, and when she came in, Elisha said, “Here, take your son!”

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh nganid akan ineh, denak-denak kareb ideh kuman kikid ineh idi ideh nengitang, kebaladeh, "Até inan bang lacang ineh, O nabi Allah!" Idi na ideh miak kuman ineh.
english: He served the stew to the prophets, but after the men had eaten only a couple bites, they cried out, “Elisha, there is something in the pot that will kill us!” So they would not eat it.

lun_bawang: Idi Elisa nemutuh sesuut banak. Idi ieh nengukit banak ineh bang lacang ineh, kebalaneh, "Nganid ieh kuan lun mula' ini, pad ideh kuman." Idi sesuut pana' nateh luk dat bang lacang ineh peh.
english: Elisha said, “Bring me some flour.” They brought him some, and he threw it in the pot and he said, “It is all right now. You can eat it.” And they ate it, and it did not harm them.

lun_bawang: Idi seburur deléi rat Baal Salisa nenguit kuan Elisa tuda'-tuda' pinaram padé baruh, dueh ngepulu' balad pinaram ikun, idi teh dalé luk isebneh. Idi kebala Elisa, "Maré ineh kenen lun mula' ini.”
english: One day a man from Baal-Shalishah town brought to Elisha a sack of freshly cut grain and 20 loaves of barley bread, made from the first grain that they harvested that year. Elisha said to his servant, “Give it to the group of prophets, so that they can eat it.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebalaneh, "Na ineh miak kuandeh luk meratu ini." Idi kebala Elisa, "Maré mo' ieh kenendeh. Ngaceku bala Tuhan kudeng ini, 'Ideh miak kuman. Pangeh ineh inan teh elaneh.' “
english: But his servant exclaimed, “Do you think that we can feed 100 of us prophets with only that much?” RHQ But Elisha replied, “Give it to the prophets so that they can eat it, because Yahweh says that there will be plenty for all of them, and there will be some left over!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh kuan awan Naaman, "Kudeng Naaman amé' papu' nabi luk déi' Samaria ineh, kali' rungen ieh do' ratnan ét susudneh ineh.”
english: One day, that girl said to her, “I wish that ◄my master/your husband► would go to see the prophet in Samaria. That prophet would heal your husband from his leprosy.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Naaman kali' bala ineh, idi ieh iné' nan raca' idi nemada' neneh ratnan luk bila decur ineh.
english: Naaman’s wife told her husband what the girl from Israel had said, and Naaman told that to the king.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' Siria, "Amé' iko idi ui miak maré aceh surat kuan raca' lun Israil ineh." Idi Naaman nenalan. Idi ieh nenguit 30,000 balad pirak, idi amas
english: The king said to him, “Okay, go and see the prophet. I will write a letter for you to take to the king of Israel, saying that I sent you.” The king wrote in the letter, “I am sending this letter with my army commander Naaman, who serves me faithfully. I want you to heal him of his disease.” So Naaman, assuming/thinking that the king of Israel was the prophet, took the letter and 750 pounds of silver, 150 pounds of gold, and ten sets of clothing, to give to the king of Israel, and he went to Samaria, taking along several servants.

lun_bawang: ,000 balad, idi pulu' kuyu' buyor luk meluun do'.
english: When he arrived in Samaria, he gave the letter to the king of Israel. The king read the letter. Then, being very dismayed, the king tore his clothes and said, “I am not God RHQ! I am not able to enable people to live or to die RHQ! Why does the king who wrote this letter request me to cure this man of his leprosy? I think that he is just wanting to start a fight with me!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' Siria bang surat ineh, "Kareb surat luk biréku ini macing namu, iko kali' negku pangeh nengecuk Naaman lun dukenku amé' papu' namu, pelé iko ngedo' neneh ratnan ét susudneh.”
english: When he arrived in Samaria, he gave the letter to the king of Israel. The king read the letter. Then, being very dismayed, the king tore his clothes and said, “I am not God RHQ! I am not able to enable people to live or to die RHQ! Why does the king who wrote this letter request me to cure this man of his leprosy? I think that he is just wanting to start a fight with me!”

lun_bawang: Idi Elisa nengecuk lun dukenneh amé' ngecuk ni Naaman unub tudu' kua' bang Abpa' Yarden, pad bururneh miak petuneb kudeng luk pun-pun, idi ieh miak meligan.
english: But Naaman became very angry. He said, “I thought that surely he would wave his hand over the leprosy, and pray to Yahweh his god, and heal me!

lun_bawang: Iamo' lun dukenneh iné' neneh, kebaladeh, "O Naaman, kudeng nabi ineh ngecuk namu nganau' aceh kekamen luk mikat ruen, kali' rungen iko nganau' ineh. Ngudeh iko na amé' diu' maya' kudeng balaneh, pad iko uen ngedo'?”
english: So Naaman went down to the Jordan River and washed himself seven times, as ◄the prophet/Elisha► told him to do. Then his skin was restored/healed, and it became healthy/smooth, like the skin of a young child.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Elisa, "Ui ini demulun Tuhan idi ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan luk mulun ineh. Na tu-tu ui miak ngalap baré ineh." Idi Naaman mesaad ngubuk neneh. Iamo' ara' ieh.
english: Then Naaman said, “Okay, but I have one request. This dirt here in Israel is holy, so please allow me to take some dirt from this place and put it in sacks on two mules. Then I will take it back home with me and make an altar on this dirt. From now on, I will offer sacrifices to Yahweh on that altar. I will not offer sacrifices to any other god.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Naaman, "Kudeng iko na pian, do' iko maré tana' kuanku tap iten dueh keladai. Ngaceku nekini na ui maré baré luk sabpen idi baré luk kereten kuan allah baken, iamo' kuan Tuhan mo'.
english: However, when my master, the king, goes into the temple of the god Rimmon to worship him/it there, and he is leaning on my arm, I hope/desire that Yahweh will forgive me because I will have to bow down, too.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elisa neneh, "Amé' iko dengan do'." Idi Naaman nenalan. Idi kareb Naaman pangeh nenalan na mado tu,
english: But then Elisha’s servant Gehazi said to himself, “It is not good that my master allowed this Syrian man to leave like this. He should have accepted his gifts. So just as certainly as Yahweh lives, I will go and catch up with Naaman and get something from him.”

lun_bawang: Idi Gehasi nengerada' ni Naaman. Kareb Naaman nekali' Gehasi maya' puetneh, idi ieh netemurun rat bang kerétaneh. Idi ieh iné' neneh, kebalaneh, "Anunké susa'mu?”
english: Gehazi replied, “Yes, but two young prophets from the hilly area where the descendants of Ephraim live have just arrived. Elisha has sent me to tell you that he would like 75 pounds of silver and two sets of clothing to give to them.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Naaman, "Amé' tungé' idi ngalap 6,000 balad pirak. Idi ieh nengubuk-ngubuk neneh. Idi ieh nengabet pirak ineh bang dueh tebpung, idi teh dueh kuyu' buyor luk do'. Amung ineh panen dueh lun dukenneh luk maan ineh pa atunneh.
english: But when they arrived at the hill where Elisha lived, Gehazi took the silver and the clothes from Naaman’s servants and sent the servants back to Naaman. Then he took those things into his house and hid them.

lun_bawang: Idi Gehasi nesemuet bang ruma', idi kebala Elisa neneh, "O Gehasi, rat iapeh iko?" Kebalaneh, "Na ui iné' iapeh-iapeh.”
english: Elisha asked him, “Do you not realize that my spirit was there when Naaman got out of his chariot to talk with you? This is certainly not RHQ the time to accept gifts of money and clothes and olive groves and vineyards and sheep and oxen and servants!

lun_bawang: Idi inan aceh kareb amung anak sekola' nabi ineh nepebala ni Elisa, "Nier su inan kai tudo ineh pelaba pari' kuan kai.
english: One day a group of prophets said to Elisha, “Look, this place where we meet together with you is very small.

lun_bawang: Nima' nekai amé' déi' Abpa' Yardeh, idi nebpeng kayunh ruen ku ruma' déi'." Idi kebala Elisa, "Amé' mo'.”
english: Allow us to go to the Jordan River and cut down some trees to make logs to build a new meeting place.” So Elisha said, “Okay, go.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala sebururdeh, "Do' iko amé' maya' nekai." Kebala Elisa, "Mo, miak ui amé'.”
english: One of them said to Elisha, “Please come with us.” So Elisha replied, “Okay, I will go with you.”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb sebururdeh nebpeng kayuh rayeh ineh, idi uaineh nelulu' nebpeh bang abpa'. Idi ieh nengitang. Kebalaneh, "O Guru', uai ini inicehku.”
english: But while one of them was cutting down a tree, suddenly the axe head separated from the handle and fell into the water. He cried out to Elisha, “O, Master, what shall I do? The axe is not mine; I borrowed it!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala nabi Allah ineh, "Nebpeh su apeh ieh?" Idi ieh nenicul su idi neneh. Ieh nenutu' aceh angat kayuh, idi ieh nemepet neneh su idi. Idi uai ineh nelupung.
english: Elisha replied, “Where did it fall into the water?” After the man showed him the place, Elisha cut off a stick, and threw it into the water, and caused the iron axe head to float on top of the water.

lun_bawang: Kebala Elisa, "Ngalap ieh." Idi ieh nengalap ineh.
english: Elisha said, “Take it out of the water.” So the man reached his hand down and picked up the axe head.

lun_bawang: Kareb raca' bawang Siria nepebunu' nelun Israil, idi kebalaneh kuan lun tarehneh, "Bawang kaceh pianku inan tau lupo.”
english: Whenever the king of Syria prepared to send his army to fight against Israel, he first consulted his officers, and then told them where they should set up their tents.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Elisa nemebpeng raca' Israil na amé' su ineh, ngaceku lun Siria nengabang déi'.
english: But each time, Elisha would send a message to warn the king of Israel, telling him where the army of Syria was planning to attack them, saying, “Be sure that your army does not go near that place, because the army of Syria has set up their tents there.”

lun_bawang: Idi ngaceku ineh raca' Siria pelaba gateh niat. Idi ieh nenawar amung lun tarehneh, kebalaneh, "Idéké rat arang tau luk perurum dengan raca' lun Israil?”
english: The king of Syria was very upset/disturbed/angry about that. So he summoned his army officers and said to them, “Obviously one of you is ◄betraying us/revealing our plans► to the king of Israel. Which one of you is doing it?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala seburur lun dukenneh, "Na luk idi O raca'. Iamo' Nabi Elisa mada' kuan raca' Israil amung bala luk bilamu bang takepmu pana'.”
english: One of his officers answered, “Your Majesty, it is not one of us. Elisha the prophet knows what we plan to do, and he tells the king of Israel everything. He even knows what you say in your own bedroom!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Amé' muyuh nier su inanneh, pad ui miak ngecuk nelun amé' ngakem neneh." Idi kareb raca' neninger ratnan Elisa idi déi' Dotan,
english: The king of Syria replied, “Go and find out where he is, and I will send some men there to capture him.” Someone told him, “People say that he is in Dothan town north of Samaria.”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb lun duken nabi Allah ineh nekulat pekak uka-uka idi ieh neremuat. Idi ieh mawa ngaceku bawang ineh linibut baweh dengan tuda'- tuda' kuda idi keréta. Idi kebala lun duken ineh ni Elisa, "O nabi! Mesusa' kiteh! Anunké luk ruen kiteh?”
english: Early the next morning, Elisha’s servant got up and went outside the house. He saw the soldiers of Syria with their horses and chariots surrounding the town. So he went inside the house and reported it to Elisha and exclaimed, “O, sir! What are we going to do?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elisa, "Aleg matot, ngaceku luk ngedengan nekiteh ineh meluun ula'deh ratnan luk ngedengan nedeh.”
english: Elisha replied, “Do not be afraid! Those who will be helping us will be more than those who will be helping them!”

lun_bawang: Idi kesembayang Elisa, "O Tuhan, ngalat matehneh pelé ieh pana' miak nier." Idi Tuhan nengalat mateh lun dukenneh ineh pad ieh miak nier. Ieh mawa, ngaceku pegkung ineh panu' ku kuda luk kudeng apui idi keréta luk kudeng apui libut Elisa.
english: Then he prayed, “Yahweh, I request that you open my servant’s eyes in order that he can see what is out there!” So Yahweh enabled the servant to look out and see that surrounding the hill on which the town was built was a huge number of horses, and chariots made of fire!

lun_bawang: Idi kareb lun Siria iné' munu' ni Elisa, idi ieh nesembayang mutuh Tuhan, kesembayangneh, "Necat amungdeh ini ku saweng mateh." Idi Tuhan nenecat nedeh ineh ku saweng mateh, maya' kudeng sembayang Elisa ineh.
english: When the army of Syria prepared to attack Elisha, he prayed again, saying, “Yahweh, cause all these soldiers to become blind!” Yahweh answered his prayer and caused them to be unable to see clearly.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elisa nedeh, "Ini baken dalan luk petulu, idi ini baken bawang luk ulek muyuh. Maya' negku mo', idi ui miak nated nemuyuh amé' nelun luk tekapen muyuh." Idi ieh nenated nedeh ineh iné' Samaria.
english: Then Elisha went to them and said, “You are not on the right road; this is not the city that you are searching for. I will take you to the man whom you are searching for.” But he led them to Samaria, the capital of Israel!

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh nacing déi' Samaria, kesembayang Elisa, "O Tuhan, ngalat matehdeh ineh pelé ideh miak nier." Idi Tuhan nengalat matehdeh ineh, pad ideh miak nier. Idi ideh mawa ngaceku ideh bang bawang Samaria.
english: As soon as they entered Samaria, Elisha prayed again, saying, “Yahweh, now enable these soldiers to see correctly again!” So Yahweh enabled them to see correctly, and they were surprised to see that they were inside Samaria city.

lun_bawang: Kareb raca' Israil nekali' nedeh, idi ieh nengitun ni Elisa, "Miakké ui ngaté nedeh?”
english: When the king of Israel saw them, he said to Elisha, “Sir, shall I tell my soldiers to kill them? Shall we kill all of them?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Elisa, "Na! Muyuh na ngaté lemulun luk tiban bang bunu' pana'. Do' maman nedeh, pelé ideh kuman idi lemubed amé' inan raca'deh.”
english: Elisha replied, “No, you must not kill them. If your army captured many of your enemies in a battle, you would certainly not RHQ kill them. Give these men something to eat and drink, and then allow them to return to their king.”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb raca' lun Israil nalan luun libung batu bawang ineh inan aceh decur nengitang nawar raca', kebalaneh, "O raca', ngedengan negku!”
english: One day when the king of Israel was walking on top of the city wall, a woman cried out to him, “Your Majesty, help me!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Kudeng Tuhan na miak ngedengan namu, kudeng apeh ui miak ngedengan namu? Inanké padé idi abpa' anggurku?
english: He replied, “If Yahweh will not help you, I certainly cannot RHQ help you. I certainly RHQ do not have any wheat or wine!

lun_bawang: Idi anunké susa'mu?" Kebalaneh, "So nilad kebala decur ini, 'Do' kiteh kuman anakmu ineh aco sini. Idi nebpa kiteh kuman anakku.'
english: What is your problem?” She replied, “Several days ago, that woman over there said to me, ‘Because we have nothing left to eat, let’s kill your son today, in order that we can eat his flesh. Then tomorrow we can kill my son and eat his flesh.’

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Do' Tuhan ngaté negku, kudeng na uluh Elisa Sapat ineh kelebpen aco sini.”
english: The king exclaimed, “I wish/hope that God will strike me dead if I do not cut off the head of Elisha today, because he is the one who has caused these terrible things to happen to us!”

lun_bawang: Idi laba' ieh pebala nedeh, denak-denak raca' ineh nacing. Idi kebalaneh, "Susa' ini ratnan Tuhan mo'! Anun ulek ui merapet inan Tuhan peh?"
english: And while he was still speaking, the king and the officer arrived. The king said, “It is Yahweh who has caused us to have all this trouble/suffering. ◄Why should I wait any longer RHQ for him to do something to help us?/It is useless for me to wait any longer for him to help us!►”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elisa, "Ninger iko bala Tuhan! Pekak nebpa bang kareb luk kudeng ini aceh gatang banak luk do' idi dueh gatang ikun mepad raga, ieh ineh aceh balad pirak, pisuen munung tanga' bawang Samaria.”
english: Elisha replied to the king, “Listen to what Yahweh says: ‘He says that by this time tomorrow, at the marketplace here in Samaria, you will be able to buy ◄ten pounds/five kg.► of fine wheat or ◄20 pounds/ten kg.► of barley for only one piece of silver.’”

lun_bawang: Idi bal tanga' bawang ineh inan apat burur lun mét susud. Idi kebaladeh seburur dengan seburur, "Anun punneh tau tudo ieni idi maté?
english: That day there were four men who had ◄leprosy/a dreaded skin disease► who were sitting outside the gate of Samaria city. They said to each other, “◄Why should we wait here until we die?/It is ridiculous for us to wait here until we die.► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi raca' nengecuk dueh burur lun maya' kuda, ngerada' baweh lun Siria ineh, kebalaneh, "Amé' medueh nier nedeh.”
english: So they chose some men and told them to go in a chariot and find out what had happened to the army of Syria.

lun_bawang: Elisa pangeh nemada' raca', kudeng ini, "Aceh gatang banak luk do' idi dueh gatang ikun mepad raga, ieh ineh sebalad pirak pisuen nebpa bang kareb luk kudeng ini munung tanga' bawang Samaria,”
english: Elisha had told him that by the next day there would be plenty of food, with the result that anyone could buy ten pounds of fine wheat or 20 pounds of barley for only one piece of silver.

lun_bawang: idi lun tareh raca' ineh nengor balaneh, kebalaneh, "Kudeng Tuhan nganau' bubpu' langit, idi teh na miak mangun kudeng balamu ini." Idi kebala Elisa neneh, "Iko miak nier ku matehmu sebuleng, iamo' na iko miak kuman ratnan ineh.”
english: And the officer had answered, “That certainly cannot RHQ happen! Even if Yahweh himself would open the sky and send down some grain, that could not happen.” And Elisha had replied, “Because you said that, you SYN will see it happen, but you will not be able to eat any of the food!”

lun_bawang: Idi raca' uned pegayam ni Gehasi lun duken Elisa ineh, kebalaneh, "Mada' negku amung kekamen luk rayeh luk pangeh inau' Elisa ineh.”
english: When she arrived, the king was talking with Gehazi, Elisha’s servant. The king was saying to him, “Tell me all the great things that Elisha has done.”

lun_bawang: Idi Elisa iné' déi' Damsik kareb Benhadad raca' bawang Siria ineh mét. Idi kebaladeh kuan raca', "Nabi Allah idi tungé'.”
english: Elisha went to Damascus, the capital of Syria, when Ben-Hadad, the king of Syria, was very sick. When someone told the king that Elisha was in Damascus,

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' ni Hasel seburur lun tarehneh, "Nguit aceh luk barén kuan nabi Allah ineh, pad ieh ngitun Tuhan kudeng ui miak do' ratnan ét ini?”
english: the king told one of his officials named Hazael, “Go and talk to that prophet and take a present/gift with you to give to him. Request him to ask Yahweh if I will recover from my illness.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elisa neneh, "Amé' iko mada' neneh, 'Miak ét ini mé' do',' iamo' Tuhan pangeh nemada' negku ieh miak maté'.”
english: Elisha said to Hazael, “Go and say to him, ‘Yes, you will certainly not die from this illness,’ but Yahweh has shown me that he will certainly die before he recovers.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Hasel, "Kudeng apehké ui nganau' luk kudeng ineh? Na ui lun mebala!" Idi kebala Elisa, "Pangeh ginala' Tuhan kuanku, idi iko miak mangun ku raca' bawang Siria.”
english: Hazael replied, “I am as insignificant as MET a dog; ◄how could I do such things?/I would never do such terrible things!►” RHQ Elisha replied, “Yahweh has also revealed to me that you will become the king of Syria.”

lun_bawang: Idi Hasel iné' matun Raca' Benhadad, luk nengitun neneh, "anunké bala Elisa namu?" Idi kebalaneh, "Kebala Elisa, 'Et ini miak amé' do'.' “
english: Then Hazael left and returned to his master/boss the king, who asked him, “What did Elisha say?” He replied, “He told me that you would certainly recover.”

lun_bawang: Bang kareb ineh Elisa nenawar seburur anak sekola' nabi. Kebalaneh neneh, "Do' iko temina' idi nguit seréi' umau ineh, idi amé' déi' Ramot Giliad.
english: Meanwhile, the prophet Elisha summoned one of the other prophets. He said to him, “Get ready IDM and go to Ramoth city in the Gilead region. Take this jar of olive oil with you.

lun_bawang: Idi ngalap seréi' ineh, idi ngukit umau ineh luun uluhneh, kebalamu, 'Tuhan ngumau namu mangun ku raca' lun Israil.' Pangeh ineh do' iko upun buro.”
english: and pour some of this oil on his head. Then say to him, ‘Yahweh declares that he is appointing you to be the king of Israel.’ Then open the door and run away as quickly as you can.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nekali' amung lun rayeh baweh pegayam. Idi kebalaneh ni Yihu, "Inan aceh bala luk belénku namu." Idi kebala Yihu, "Kuan idé'?" Kebalaneh, "Kuan diko, O iko lun rayeh baweh.”
english: When he arrived, he saw that the commanders of the army were having a conference. He looked at Jehu and said, “Sir, I have a message for one of you.” Jehu replied, “Which one of us is the message for?” The young prophet replied, “It is for you, commander/sir.”

lun_bawang: Idi didueh iné' bang ruma'. Idi anak sekola' nabi' ineh nengutang umau ineh luun uluh Yihu, kebalaneh, "Kebala Tuhan Allah lun Israil, 'Ui ngumau namu mangun ku raca' amung pupu Tuhan, ieh ineh lun Israil.
english: So Jehu got up and went with the young prophet into a house. There the young prophet poured some olive oil on Jehu’s head and said to him, “Yahweh, the God whom we Israelis worship, declares this: ‘I am appointing you to be the king of my Israeli people.

lun_bawang: Idi Yihu nelemubed iné' matun amung lun rayeh baweh ineh. Idi kebaladeh neneh, "Kudeng apeh, bala do'ké? Ngudeh lun meruden ini iné' namu?" Idi kebala Yihu nedeh, "Muyuh kali' lemulun ineh idi balaneh.”
english: When Jehu came out of the room to where his other commanders were, they said to him, “Is everything all right? Why did that mad fellow come to you?” He replied, “You know what kinds of things young prophets like him say.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebaladeh, "Na kali' kai, mada' nekai nekini." Idi kebalaneh, "Kudeng ini luk bilaneh negku, 'Kudeng ini bala Tuhan, Ui ngumau namu mangun ku raca' lun Israil.' “
english: They said, “You are lying! Tell us what he said!” He replied, “He told me that Yahweh said, ‘I am appointing MTY you to be the king of Israel.’”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh saget-saget nengalap kuyu'deh, idi ideh nemalad ineh su dalanneh. Idi ideh nengiup serupit, kebaladeh, "Yihu pangeh inau' ku raca'.”
english: Then they all spread their cloaks on the steps of the building for Jehu to walk out on, and they blew trumpets and shouted, “Jehu is now the king!”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengecuk seburur lun baken amé' teh. Kareb ieh nacing nedeh, kebalaneh, "Kebala raca' 'Lawé do' muyuh ni?' " Kebala Yihu, "Anun punmu ngitun lawé kai? Do' iko maya' puetku.”
english: Then the watchman reported again, “That messenger also reached them, but he is not coming back alone. And the leader of the group must be Jehu, the son of Nimshi, because he is driving his chariot furiously, like Jehu does!”

lun_bawang: Idi lun luk nginita bawang ineh nemaré kali' ratnan lawéneh, kebalaneh, "Lun luk icuk ineh pangeh nacing nedeh, iamo' na ieh lemubed teh. Idi lawé lun luk nguyut nedeh mepad kudeng lawé Yihu. Ngaceku lawéneh mepad kudeng lun meruden.”
english: Joram said to his soldiers, “Get my chariot ready!” So they did that. Then King Joram and King Ahaziah both rode toward Jehu, each one in his own chariot. And it happened that they met Jehu at the field that had previously belonged to Naboth!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Raca' Yoram, "Do' temina' ku keréta." Idi ideh netemina'. Idi Yoram idi Ahasia nenalan, idi didueh manid keréta, pian papu' ni Yihu. Idi didueh nepapu' neneh déi' kabun Nabot.
english: When Joram met Jehu, he said to him, “Are you coming on a peaceful visit?” Jehu replied, “◄How can there be peace while you and your people are prostrating themselves to worship idols and practicing very much <witchcraft/sorcery> like your mother Jezebel did?/There certainly cannot be peace while you and your people are prostrating themselves to worship idols and practicing <witchcraft/sorcery> like your mother Jezebel has been doing!►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yoram neneh, "Lawé do' iko ni, Yihu?" Kebalaneh, "Na lawé kai ini do', ngaceku sét tinanmu Isabel, idi bangunneh pelaba ula'.”
english: Joram cried out, “Ahaziah, they have deceived us! They want to kill us!” So Joram turned his chariot around and tried to flee.

lun_bawang: Idi Raca' Yoram nengeliud kerétaneh. Idi ieh neburo, kebalaneh ni Ahasia, "Naluk ieh, pian ngalap imetku, O Ahasia!”
english: But Jehu drew his bow mightily and shot an arrow that pierced Joram between his shoulder blades. The arrow went through his body and pierced his heart, and he slumped down dead in his chariot.

lun_bawang: Idi kareb Yihu nesemuet bang tanga' bawang, idi kebala Isabel, "Anun bala, O Simri, iko luk nengaté raca'mu?”
english: Jehu looked up toward the window, and then he said, “Who is ◄on my side/wants to help me►? Anyone?” Two or three palace officials looked down at him from a window and pointed to themselves.

lun_bawang: Idi Yihu netengook nenier tabuk ineh, kebalaneh, "Idé pian maya' negku?" Idi inan dueh kian teluh burur lun ngasa' bang ruma' raca' nenier neneh.
english: Jehu said to them, “Throw her down here!” So they threw her down, and when she hit the ground and died, some of her blood splattered on the city wall and on the horses that were pulling the chariots.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yihu nedeh, "Ngabpa decur ineh rat déi' dita'." Idi ideh nengabpa neneh rat déi' dita', pad dara'neh nuput luun libung batu idi luun kudaneh. Idi kuda ineh nengeradu' neneh.
english: Then Jehu went into the palace and ate and drank. Then he said to some of his men, “Take the corpse of that women whom Yahweh has cursed and bury it, because she is a king’s daughter and therefore should be buried properly.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yihu nesemuet bang ruma' raca', idi nekuman, kebalaneh, "Amé' muyuh ngalap butung decur luk kidiman ineh, idi nanem neneh. Ngaceku ieh anak raca'.”
english: But when they went to get her corpse to bury it, all that was left was only her skull and the bones of her feet and her hands. Everything else was gone.

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh nelemubed idi nemaré kali' ni Yihu, idi kebalaneh, "Kudeng ineh bala Tuhan luk bida' demulunNeh Elia, kebalaNeh, 'Luun tana' Yesril, uko' miak kuman butung Isabel.
english: Her bones will be scattered there in Jezreel like dung, with the result that no one will be able to recognize them and say, “These are Jezebel’s bones.” ’ ”

lun_bawang: -3"Kareb surat ini macing, do' muyuh mili' anak Akab luk meluun do' mangun ku raa' muyuh. Idi do' muyuh temina' pebunu' kuan imetneh. Ngaceku muyuh inan tuda'-tuda' keréta idi kuda, idi aceh bawang luk meraben libung, idi teh repapeh pebunu'.”
english: This is what he wrote: “You are the ones who are taking care of the king’s descendants. You have chariots and horses and weapons, and you live in cities that have walls around them. So as soon as you receive this letter,

lun_bawang: Iamo' lun rayeh-rayeh bawang Samaria pelaba tot, kebaladeh, "Raca' Yoram idi Raca' Ahasia pana' na tuman pa kiungneh. Tau pana' nateh tuman!”
english: But when they got those letters from Jehu and read them, they became very afraid. They said, “King Joram and King Ahaziah could not resist him; ◄how can we resist him?/we cannot possibly resist him!►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kareb Yihu neninger bala ineh, idi ieh nengecuk nedeh ngamung uluh ineh dueh bubpun iring tanga' bawang macing kenebpa.
english: A messenger came to Jehu and told him, “They have brought the heads of Ahab’s descendants.” So Jehu commanded that the heads should be put in two piles at the city gate and that the heads should stay there until the next morning.

lun_bawang: Idi pa pekak Yihu iné' tanga' bawang. Ieh nengitun nelun mula' ineh, "Ui ini sikal metueh ratnan Raca' Yoram pad ui nengaté neneh. Muyuh na inan sala'. Iamo' idéké pangeh nengaté amungdeh ini?
english: The next morning he went out to the city gate and said to all the people, “I am the one who plotted against King Joram and killed him. You are not guilty of doing that. But it was Yahweh, not I RHQ who commanded that all these descendants of Ahab should be killed.

lun_bawang: idi ieh nepapu' sebuang pupu maté Ahasia raca' lun Yahuda. Idi kebalaneh nedeh, "Idéké muyuh ini?" Idi kebaladeh ineh, "Amung kai ini pupu Raca' Ahasia. Idi kai amé' ngikak amung anak raca' idi anak tinan raca' pana'.”
english: he met some relatives of King Ahaziah of Judah. He asked them, “Who are you?” They replied, “We are relatives of King Ahaziah. We are going to Jezreel to visit the children of Queen Jezebel and the other members of King Joram’s family.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yihu, "Do' ngakem nedeh." Idi ideh nengakem apat ngepulu' dueh burur deléi ineh idi nengaté nedeh iring lubang luk muneng ku Lepo ineh. Seburur pana' nateh inulundeh.
english: Jehu said to his men, “Seize them!” So they seized them and killed all of them at the pit named Beth-Eked. There were 42 people whom they killed; they did not allow any of them to remain alive.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yihu, "Amé maya' negku idi nier tuehku ngaceku Tuhan." Idi didueh nenalan maya' kerétaneh.
english: Jehu said to him, “Come with me, and you will see that I am very devoted to Yahweh.” So they rode together to Samaria.

lun_bawang: Yihu nengamung nelun Samaria ineh, kebalaneh nedeh, "Idi Raca' Akab nemaya' akang Baal ineh, iamo' na ieh mepicet tu-tu. Iamo' ui sikal mepicet maya' neneh.
english: Then Jehu summoned all the people of Samaria, and said to them, “King Ahab was devoted to your god Baal a little bit, but I will serve him much more.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yihu, "Do' nganau' aceh tebubpun rayeh kuan Baal." Idi ideh nengeletep aceh aco rayeh kuan tebubpun ineh.
english: Then Jehu commanded, “Announce that we are going to set aside a day to honor Baal.” So they did that.

lun_bawang: Idi Yihu nengecuk nelun luk ngasa' ayung nguit ayung amung lun luk sembayang inan Baal ineh.
english: Jehu told the priest who took care of the sacred robes to bring them out and give them to the people who worshiped Baal. So the priest did that.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh neperiteteng nedeh, kebalaneh, "Kareb muyuh amé' nginita bang ruma' raca' kareb Aco luk inan Mudeng, do' muyuh teluh babpat; idi sebabpat amé' nginita bang ruma' raca',
english: He gave them these instructions: “There are three groups of you guards. When one group finishes their work on the Sabbath day, divide yourselves into three smaller groups. One group must guard the palace.

lun_bawang: Idi Yoyada nenguit ni Yuas remuat, idi nenganau' pata raca' luun uluhneh. Idi ieh nemaré ukum Allah kuan raca' neneh. Idi Yuas inumau mangun ku raca'. Lun mula' nemepag palad idi ngudub, "Do' raca' mipu ulun!”
english: Then he brought Joash out. He put the crown on his head and gave him a scroll on which were written the rules that the kings needed to obey. Then he poured some olive oil on Joash’s head and proclaimed that he was now the king. The people all clapped their hands and shouted, “We desire/hope that the king will live for many years!”

lun_bawang: Idi Nabi Elisa mét lélé maté, idi Yoas raca' Israil iné' ngikak neneh. Idi ieh nenangi', kebalaneh, "O ama'! O ama'! Keréta lun Israil dengan luk maya' Kuda!”
english: Elisha became very ill. Just before he died, King Jehoash went to Elisha and cried in front of him. Saying the same words that Elisha had said when Elijah was taken to heaven, he said, “My father/master! My father/master! The chariots of us Israeli people and their drivers are taking my master away!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Elisa neneh, "Ngalap binor dengan ilebneh." Idi Yoas nengalap ineh.
english: Elisha said to him, “Bring to me a bow and some arrows!” So the king did that.

lun_bawang: Idi Elisa nengecuk neneh temina' ngelatik. Idi raca' nemaya' balaneh, idi Elisa nengerareng ticu'neh luun ticu' raca'.
english: Then Elisha told the king to put his hands on the bow and prepare to shoot some arrows. And then Elisha put his own hands on the king’s hands.

lun_bawang: Idi Elisa nengecuk raca' ngalap amung ileb ineh idi necat tana'ku ineh. Idi raca' nenecat tana' teluh kua', idi ieh nugka'.
english: Then Elisha said, “Pick up the other arrows and strike the ground with them!” So the king picked up the arrows and struck the ground three times.

lun_bawang: Idi Elisa museh neneh, kebalaneh neneh, "Kudeng iko nenecat limeh anem kua', kali' rungen muci iko miak ngelaya' nelun bawang Siria pad ideh mabud maté. Iamo' nekini iko miak ngelaya' nelun Siria ineh teluh kua' mo'.”
english: But Elisha was angry with him. He exclaimed, “You should have struck the ground five or six times! If you had done that, your army would have defeated the Syrian army until they were completely wiped out!
