lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "Tuhan Allah muyuh pangeh nengedengan nemuyuh, pad Ieh nemaré nemuyuh do' udeng. Ieh pangeh nemaré amung lun luk tudo bang bawang ini atun bang paladku. Idi nekini ideh pa liang imet muyuh idi pa liang Tuhan pana'.
english: “Yahweh our God is certainly with/helping you RHQ. He has allowed you to have peace with all the nearby nations RHQ. He has enabled my army to conquer IDM them, so now Yahweh and my people control them.

lun_bawang: Idi raca' nengeletep 24,000 burur ngakem Ruma' Tuhan, idi 6,000 burur luk ngayud ratnan kekamen ineh idi luk mutut ukum teh.
english: Then David said, “From those 38,000 men, I want 24,000 of them to supervise the work at the temple of Yahweh, and I want 6,000 of them to be officials and judges.

lun_bawang: Kebala Daud, "Tuhan Allah lun Israil pangeh nemaré do' udeng kuan pupuNeh. Idi Ieh teh miak tudo déi' Yerusalim macing ruked-ruked.
english: David had said previously, “Yahweh, the God to whom we Israeli people belong, has enabled us to have peace, and he has come to live in Jerusalem forever.

lun_bawang: Kebala Raca' Daud, "Amung ini ginala' bang tari luk inayud maya' kudeng luk pangeh bida' Tuhan negku.”
english: Then David said, “I have written all these plans while Yahweh was directing MTY me. He has enabled me to understand all the details of his plan for the temple that is to be built.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Raca' Daud nelun mula' ineh: "Anakku Selimun, luk pangeh pinili' Allah, ieh ineh anak luk na pekalai. Idi rayeh kekamen ini, ngaceku baken ieh ineh ruma' lemulun, iamo' ruma' Tuhan Allah.
english: Then King David said to all the people who had gathered there, “My son Solomon, the one whom God has chosen to be the next king, is young and does not have much experience. This work of building the temple is great/important, because this glorious building will not be to honor people, but to honor Yahweh our God.

lun_bawang: ,000 pon amas, 30,000,000 balad pirak, tekaling mela 10,000 pikul, idi belawan 6,000 pikul.
english: Then, while all the people there were listening, David prayed, saying, “We praise you, Yahweh, the God whom our ancestor Jacob worshiped. We will praise you forever!

lun_bawang: Daud nengubur Tuhan pa kiung amung lun mula' ineh, kebalaneh, "Amung ubur kuanMu, O Tuhan Allah tepun kai Yakub, rat mon idi macing ruked- ruked.
english: Then, while all the people there were listening, David prayed, saying, “We praise you, Yahweh, the God whom our ancestor Jacob worshiped. We will praise you forever!

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh idi Daud nepebala inan lun mula' ineh, "Do' muyuh ngubur Tuhan Allah muyuh." Idi amung lun mula' ineh nengubur Tuhan Allah tepundeh. Idi ideh netekunal sembayang inan Tuhan, pa kiung raca'.
english: Then David said to all the people who were gathered there, “Praise Yahweh our God!” So they all praised Yahweh the God whom their ancestors ◄also worshiped/belonged to►. They prostrated themselves on the ground in front of Yahweh and in front of the king.

lun_bawang: Idi bang malem ineh teh Allah nesilagan ni Selimun, kebalaNeh neneh, "Mutuh iko anun luk petulu barénKu namu.”
english: Please enable me to be wise and to know what I should do, in order that I may rule these people well, because there is no one who can rule all this great nation of yours without your help.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Selimun inan Allah, "Iko pangeh nengegala' awaMu luk rayeh idi lutep kuan tamanku Daud. Idi Iko teh pangeh nenganau' negku mangun ku raca' libalneh.
english: God replied, “I am pleased with what you desire; you have not requested a huge amount of money or to be honored or that your enemies be killed. And you have not requested that you live for a long time. Instead, you have requested that I enable you to be wise and to know what you should do in order that you may govern well my people whom I have appointed you to rule.

lun_bawang: Selimun nengecuk nelun duken amé' pegayam ni Hiram raca' Sur, kebalaneh, "Do' masui binaweh kuanku, mepad kudeng luk inau'mu kuan tamanku Daud, kareb iko nemasui kayuh tumuh ku mudut ruma'neh.
english: Solomon sent this message to King Hiram of Tyre city: “Many years ago when my father David was building his palace, you sent to him cedar logs. Will you send me cedar logs, too?

lun_bawang: Ui pian mudut aceh ruma' sembayang luk rayeh kuan Allah, ngaceku Allah kai ineh rayeh ratnan allah luk baken.
english: We want this temple to be a great temple, because our God is greater than all other gods.

lun_bawang: Idi teh do' iko maré kayuh tumuh kuanku, idi kayuh tongor idi aru' rat Lebanon, ngaceku ui kali' lun dukenmu mileh nebpeng kayuh déi' Lebanon, idi lun dukenku miak pebaya' nelun dukenmu,
english: I know that your workers are skilled in cutting timber, so also please send me cedar logs, pine logs, and juniper logs from the Lebanon mountains. My workers will work with your workers.

lun_bawang: Idi Hiram raca' Sur ineh nemaré aceh surat kuan Selimun, kebalaneh, "Ngaceku Tuhan méi' inan pupuNeh, idi iko kinikitNeh ku raca'deh ineh.
english: When Hiram received that message, he replied by sending this message to Solomon: “Because Yahweh loves his people, he has appointed you to be their king.”

lun_bawang: Idi nekini do' maré amung padé, ikun, umau, idi abpa' anggur luk pangeh bida'mu ineh.
english: “Now please send us the wheat and barley and olive oil and wine that you promised to send to us.

lun_bawang: Kesembayang Raca' Selimun, "O Tuhan, Iko miak tudo bang laput idi su luk medacem.
english: Then Solomon said, “Yahweh, you said that you would live in a dark cloud.

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "Amung ubur kuan Tuhan Allah lun Israil luk pangeh nengacing jani'Neh kuan tamanku Daud, kebalaNeh,
english: He said to them, “Praise Yahweh, the God to whom we Israelis belong, who has caused to happen what he promised to my father David. What he said to David was this:

lun_bawang: Kesembayangneh, "O Tuhan Allah lun Israil, na Allah baken, iamo' Iko mo', do' bang langit idi bang tana'. Iko mo' luk maya' jani' idi mekatu kuan amung lun dukenmu luk maya' amung balaMu.
english: and he prayed, “Yahweh, the God to whom we Israeli people belong, there is no God like you in heaven or on the earth. You solemnly promised that you would faithfully love us, and that is what you have done for us who earnestly do what you want us to do.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' miakké Allah tudo dengan lemulun luun tana' ini? Idi amung langit pana' na petap inanMu, meluun teh ruma' luk pangeh pinudutku ini!
english: “But, my God, will you really live on earth among people? There is surely not enough space for you in the sky, or even in the heaven! So there is surely not enough space for you to live in this temple that my workers have built.

lun_bawang: "Kareb seburur nganau' sala' nelun denganneh, idi ieh icuk pebulung, idi ieh pebulung pa atun bubpunMu bang Ruma' ini,
english: “If someone is accused of doing something wrong to another person, and they bring him to testify in front of your altar outside this holy temple, and if he says, ‘I did not do that; may God punish me if I am not telling the truth,’

lun_bawang: "Kareb pupuMu Israil melaya' pa atun bunu'deh, ngaceku ideh pangeh mesala' Namu, idi ideh uren, idi ngamo ngadanMu, idi sembayang mutuh do' rat Namu bang Ruma' ini,
english: “And when your Israeli people are defeated by their enemies because they sinned against you, and forced to go to some distant country, if they turn away from their sinful behavior and turn toward this temple and admit that you have justly punished them, and plead that you will forgive them,

lun_bawang: "Kareb langit initekMu, pad na inan udah ngaceku pupuMu pangeh mesala' Namu, idi ideh sium pa Ruma' ini idi sembayang dengan mebeneh niat, idi uren ratnan sala'deh,
english: “When you do not allow any rain to fall because your people have sinned against you, if they turn toward this temple and admit that you have justly punished them, and turn away from their sinful behavior and humbly pray to you,

lun_bawang: "Kareb bang bawang ineh inan iru', kaca, bangas, bui luk melau', kato, idi uled, idi kudeng pupuMu uen bunu'deh ngerieng, kian kudeng inan ét luk mebura' lek,
english: “And when the people of this land experience famines or if there is a plague, or when their crops are destroyed by very hot winds or by mildew or by locusts or grasshoppers, or when their enemies surround any of their cities in order to attack them, if any of those bad things happen to them,

lun_bawang: Kareb seburur lun pupu baken macing rat bawang luk mado, ngaceku ieh pangeh ninger ratnan ngadanMu, laludMu, idi pedenganMu, idi kareb ieh macing sium pa Ruma' ini idi sembayang,
english: “There will be some foreigners who do not belong to your Israeli people who have come here from countries far away because they have heard that you are very great and that you perform great miracles. If they turn toward this temple and pray,

lun_bawang: "Kareb Iko ngecuk pupuMu amé' pebunu', idi ideh pana' sembayang mutuh Namu, sium pa bawang ini luk pinili'Mu, idi Ruma' luk pinudutku ini kuanMu,
english: “When you send your people to go to places to attack their enemies, if they pray to you, wherever they are, if they turn toward this city that you have chosen and toward this temple that I have caused to be built to honor you,

lun_bawang: "Kareb pupuMu mesala' Namu, (idi seburur pana' nateh luk na mesala') idi Iko museh nedeh, pad Iko maré nedeh bang palad bunu'deh, pelé ideh tebanen bunu' amé bawang luk mado pana',
english: “It is true that everyone sins. So, when your people sin against you, and you become angry with them, you may allow their enemies to capture them and take them to their countries, even to countries that are far away.

lun_bawang: "Idi nekini, O Allahku, do' Iko nier negku idi ninger putuh sembayangku bang Ruma' ini.
english: “Now, my God, look at us and listen to us as we pray to you in this place.

lun_bawang: O Tuhan Allah, tumui Iko nekini, do' amé' bang Ruma'Mu dengan Pati' Pejani', ieh ineh tanu' laludMu, idi tudo su ineh ruked-ruked. Ngeperuan amung kekamen imamMu, idi ngacing awang niat kuan pupuMu ngaceku éi'Mu nedeh.
english: Yahweh our God, come and stay in this place with the Sacred Chest, the chest that shows that you are powerful. Yahweh God, cause your priests to know clearly that you have blessed them. Cause us your people to rejoice because of all the good things that you do for us.

lun_bawang: O Tuhan Allah, aleg Iko ngarung raca' luk pinili'Mu ini. Do' ngerawé awaMu nan demulunMu Daud."
english: Yahweh God, do not reject me the king whom you have appointed to be the king of Israel; do not forget that you greatly loved David, who served you very well.”

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nesilagan ni Selimun kareb medacem, kebalaNeh, "Ui pangeh neninger putuhmu, idi su ini pangeh pinili'Ku ku ruma' luk inan mare bare.
english: “When I prevent any rain from falling, or when I command locusts to eat all the crops, or when I send a plague among my people,

lun_bawang: Kudeng Ui ngitek langit pad na inan udah, idi kudeng Ui ngecuk kato kuman uli' tana', idi kudeng Ui ngacing kaca arang pupuKu,
english: if the people who belong to me humble themselves and pray, and request me to help them, and if they turn away from their sinful behavior, then I will hear from heaven. I will forgive them for having sinned and I will cause them to prosper again.

lun_bawang: Idi kudeng iko lutep maya' Negku mepad kudeng lawé tamanmu Daud ineh, idi kudeng iko nganau' amung-amung luk pangeh bida'Ku namu, pad iko nginita amung bala idi ukumKu,
english: I will make sure that your descendants will always be kings, which is what I promised to David your father, saying, ‘Some of your descendants will always be the kings of Israel.’

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh kuan Raca' Selimun, "Matu bala luk pangeh pindengerku déi' bang bawangku, rat namu idi ilehmu.
english: She said to the king, “Everything that I heard in my own country about you and about how wise you are is true!

lun_bawang: "Tamanmu pangeh nengeberat amung kekamen kali ini. Kudeng iko ngeran kekamen kai pad kai na mesusa', idi amung kai ini miak lutep maya' namu.”
english: “Your father Solomon forced us to work very hard for him. If you do not force us to work that hard, and if you charge us less taxes than we were paying to him, we will serve you faithfully.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Rehebom nedeh, "Muli' muyuh atun. Idi teluh aco baruh do' muyuh lemubed amé' negku." Idi ideh nuli'.
english: He replied, “Come back three days from now and I will give you my answer.” So those leaders and Jeroboam left.

lun_bawang: Idi Rehebom nengitun amung lun rayeh, luk nengedengan tamanneh Selimun kareb ieh mulun, kebalaneh, "Kudeng apehké ui miak ngor bala lun mula' ini?”
english: Then King Rehoboam consulted his older men who had advised his father Solomon while he was still alive. He asked them, “What shall I say to answer these men?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "Kudeng iko méi' nelun mula' ineh, idi maya' piniandeh, idi do' bala nedeh, kalli' rungen amungdeh ineh mangun ku lun dukenmu ruked- ruked.”
english: They replied, “If you will be kind to these people and do things that will please them, and if you say kind things to them when you answer them, they will always serve you.”

lun_bawang: kebalaneh, "Kudeng apehké tau miak ngor bala lun mula' ini luk pangeh nemutuh negku ngeran babeh luk pangeh rireng tamanku pa luundeh?”
english: He said to them, “How should I answer the men who are asking me to reduce the work and taxes that my father required from them?”

lun_bawang: Pangeh teluh aco idi Yerebom dengan lun mula ineh iné' ni Rehebom maya' kudeng balaneh nedeh.
english: Three days later, Jeroboam and all the leaders came to King Rehoboam again, which is what he had told them to do.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nepebala nedeh ineh maya' kudeng baladeh luk anak adi' ineh, kebalaneh, "Idi i Ama' pangeh nengeberat kekamen muyuh. Iamo' ui miak ngula' ineh teh. Idi i Ama' pangeh nemabpet nemuyuh ku ué. Iamo' ui mabpet nemuyuh ku kayuh.”
english: He told them what the younger men had advised. He said, “My father put heavy burdens of work and taxes on you, but I will put heavier burdens on you. It was as though he beat you with whips, but I will beat you with whips that have pieces of metal in them!”

lun_bawang: amé' mada' ni Rehebom idi amung lun Yahuda idi lun Beniamin kudeng ini:
english: “Go and tell this to Solomon’s son Rehoboam, the king of Judah, and to all the Israeli people of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin:

lun_bawang: "Aleg muyuh amé' pebunu' inan kinanak muyuh lun Israil. Iamo' do' anid- anid muyuh muli', ngaceku isu' ineh pangeh mangun maya' pinianKu." Idi ideh neninger bala Tuhan ini. Idi ideh nuli' idi na nepebunu' ni Yerebom.
english: ‘Yahweh says that you must not go to fight against the people of Israel; they are your distant relatives. All of you must go home. What has happened is what Yahweh wanted to happen.’” So Shemaiah went and told that to them, and they all heeded what Yahweh had commanded them to do, and they did not attack Jeroboam and his soldiers.

lun_bawang: Idi amung lun rayeh Israil idi raca' pana' nengebeneh bururdeh, kebaladeh, "Tuhan ineh matu.”
english: Then the king and the other Israeli leaders humbled themselves and said, “What Yahweh is doing to us is fair.”

lun_bawang: Dueh baweh ineh petutup luun pegkung-pegkung Epraim. Idi Abia mudik Pegkung Semaraim idi nenawar ni Yerebom idi lun Israil, kebalaneh, "Ninger muyuh!
english: Abijah stood on the top of Zemaraim Mountain, which is in the hilly area that belonged to the tribe of Ephraim, and he shouted, “Jeroboam and all you other people of Israel, listen to me!

lun_bawang: Nekini muyuh ngerawé muyuh miak ngeluun kekamen Tuhan luk bang palad anak Daud, ngaceku muyuh mula', idi dengan muyuh inan akang anak sapi' amas luk pinudut Yerebom ku akang kuan muyuh.
english: “And now you are planning to fight against the kingdom that Yahweh established to be governed by David’s descendants. It is true that you have a huge army, and you and your soldiers have brought with you the golden statues of calves that Jeroboam’s workers made to be gods for all of you.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' Tuhan mo' luk Allah kai, idi na kai necan Neneh, idi amung imam luk ngakem kuan Tuhan, ieh ineh inul Arun. Idi amung lun Liwi pana' idi teh bang kekamendeh.
english: “As for us, Yahweh is our God, and we have not abandoned him. Our priests who serve Yahweh are descendants of Aaron, and the descendants of Levi assist them.

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "Sikal iko nalan maya' negku amé' déi' Ramot Giliad ineh?" Idi kebala Yosapat, "Kudeng iko temina', ui pana' temina' dengan bawehku. Miak kai maya' namu.”
english: Then he asked Jehoshaphat, “Will you and your army go with my army to attack Ramoth city in the Gilead region?” Jehoshaphat replied, “My soldiers and I will go to the battle when you tell us to go.”

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Yosapat, "Iamo' do' iko ngitun Tuhan atun.”
english: Then he added, “But we should ask Yahweh first, to find out what he wants us to do.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yosapat, "Inanké nabi baken tungé', luk miak tunin tau?”
english: But Jehoshaphat asked, “Is there no prophet of Yahweh here whom we can ask?”

lun_bawang: Idi Raca' Akab nenawar seburur lun tarehneh, kebalaneh, "Amé' iko nguit Mikaya Imla ineh amé' tungé' dengan mesaget.”
english: So the king of Israel told one of his officials to summon Micaiah immediately.

lun_bawang: Idi Nabi Sedekia Kenana pangeh nenganau' unga belawan. Idi kebalaneh ni Akab, "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan, 'Idi kudeng ini teh lawému miak ngegkul- ngegkul nelun bawang Siria ineh, pad iko ngaté nedeh ineh.' “
english: One of them whose name was Zedekiah, the son of Kenaanah, had made from iron something that resembled the horns of a bull. He proclaimed to Ahab, “This is what Yahweh says: ‘With horns like these, your army will keep attacking the army of Syria like a bull attacks another animal, until you completely destroy them.’”

lun_bawang: Idi kudeng ineh teh bada' amung nabi ineh, kebaladeh, "Do' iko amé' déi' Ramot idi kali' rungen iko metueh. Ngaceku Tuhan miak maré nedeh bang paladmu.”
english: All the other prophets of Ahab agreed. They said, “Yes! If you attack Ramoth city in the Gilead region, you will be successful, because Yahweh will enable you to defeat them.”

lun_bawang: Idi lun luk icuk amé' nawar ni Mikaya ineh nepebala neneh, "Idi amung nabi baken mada' luk do' kuan raca'. Do' iko pana' mada' kudeng ineh teh.”
english: The messenger who went to summon Micaiah said to him, “Listen to me! All the other prophets are unitedly predicting that the king will be successful in the battle. So be sure to agree with them and say that the king’s army will be successful!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Mikaya, "Ui pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan luk mulun, idi anun luk belén Tuhan negku, ineh teh luk belénku.”
english: But Micaiah said, “As surely as Yahweh lives, I will tell the king only what Yahweh tells me to say.”

lun_bawang: Kareb ieh nacing inan raca', idi raca' nengitun neneh, kebalaneh, "O Mikaya, miak kai amé' pebunu' déi' Ramot ineh, kian na lek?" Idi kebala Mikaya, "Do' iko amé'. Miak iko metueh. Tuhan maré amungdeh ineh bang paladmu.”
english: When Micaiah arrived, the king of Israel asked him, “Should we go to attack Ramoth, or not?” Micaiah replied, “Sure, go! Yahweh will enable your army to defeat them!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Akab neneh, "Tuda' kua' ui nemebpeng namu na miak pebala luk na matu dengan ngadan Tuhan?”
english: But King Ahab realized that Micaiah was lying, so he said to Micaiah, “I have told you many times that you must always tell only the truth when you say what Yahweh has revealed to you!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Mikaya neneh, "Ui pangeh nenier amung lun Israil urap-urap luun pegkung, mepad kudeng dumba luk na lun matar. Idi Tuhan nepebala, 'Ideh ini na inan lun nguyut, ngaceku ineh nima' anid-aniddeh muli' dengan do'.' “
english: Then Micaiah replied, “The truth is that in a vision I saw all the troops of Israel scattered on the mountains. They seemed to be like sheep that did not have a shepherd. And Yahweh said, ‘Their master has been killed. So tell them all to go home peacefully.’”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Akab ni Yosapat, "Naké ui nepebala namu, sesuut pana' nateh balaneh do' negku, iamo' ieh pelaba dat bala?”
english: Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “I told you that he never predicts that anything good will happen to me! He always predicts that bad things will happen to me.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Mikaya, "Ninger iko bala Tuhan: Ui pangeh nenier Tuhan tudo luun kerusiNeh. Idi amung melaikat luk déi' surga tuped pekop iringNeh.
english: But Micaiah continued, saying, “Listen to what Yahweh showed to me! In a vision I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, with all the armies of heaven standing around him, on his right side and on his left side.

lun_bawang: Idi aceh ada' iné' pa kiung Tuhan, kebalaneh, 'Ui miak ngubuk neneh.' Idi Tuhan nengitun neneh, 'Dengan anun?'
english: “Finally one spirit, having received a message from Satan, came to Yahweh and said, ‘I can do it!’ “Yahweh asked him, ‘How will you do it?’

lun_bawang: Idi kebala ada' ineh, 'Ui miak mangun ku ada' luk mebalih bang tang amung nabi Akab ineh.' Idi Tuhan nepebala, 'Amé' naluk neneh. Luk bilamu miak mangun.'
english: “The spirit replied, ‘I will go and inspire all of Ahab’s prophets to tell lies.’ Yahweh said, ‘You will be successful; go and do it!’

lun_bawang: "Idi nekini Tuhan pangeh nemaré ada' luk mebalih bang tang amung nabimu ini. Idi Tuhan pangeh nengeletep susa' kuanmu.”
english: “So now I tell you that Yahweh has caused your prophets to lie to you. Yahweh has decided that something terrible will happen to you.”

lun_bawang: Idi Nabi Sedekia nemepag kiung Mikaya, kebalaneh, "Kudeng apeh Roh Tuhan ineh mubuh rat negku pad ieh pebala namu?”
english: Then Zedekiah son of Kenaanah walked over to Micaiah and slapped him on his face. He said, “Do you think that Yahweh’s Spirit left me in order to speak to you?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Mikaya, "Iko teh miak kali', kareb iko buro amé' sigapung bang takep.”
english: Micaiah replied, “You will find out for yourself to which of us Yahweh’s Spirit has truly spoken on the day when you go into a room of some house to hide from the Syrian soldiers!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Raca' Akab, "Ngakem ni Mikaya', idi nguit neneh lemubed amé' ni Amon lun rayeh bawang, idi ni Yoas anak raca' ineh.
english: King Ahab commanded his soldiers, “Seize Micaiah and take him to Amon, the governor of this city, and to my son Joash.

lun_bawang: Idi ngecuk nedeh nipa lemulun ini bang tutup. Idi maré neneh sesuut ruti idi abpa' mo' pad macing ui muli' dengan do'.”
english: Tell them that I have commanded that they should put this man in prison and give him only bread and water. Do not give him anything else to eat until I return safely from the battle!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Mikaya, "Kudeng iko muli' dengan do', kali' rungen na Tuhan nepebala negku." Idi teh kebalaneh, "Ninger O amung muyuh!”
english: Micaiah replied, “If you return safely, it will be clear that it was not Yahweh who told me what to say to you!” Then he said to all those who were standing there, “Do not forget what I have said to King Ahab!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Akab ni Yosapat, "Ui sikal ngisu' ayuku, idi amé' pebunu'. Iamo' do' iko ngayung ku ayung raca' teh." Idi raca' lun Israil nengelibal ayungneh idi iné' pebunu'.
english: King Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “I will put on different clothes, in order that no one will recognize that I am the king. But you should wear your royal robe.” So the king of Israel disguised himself, and they both went into the battle.

lun_bawang: Idi raca' bawang Siria ineh nemebpeng amung lun rayeh kerétaneh, "Aleg muyuh pebunu' nelun baken, iamo' raca' lun Israil mo' sebuleng luk uen munu'.”
english: The King of Syria told his soldiers who were driving the chariots, “Attack only the king of Israel!”

lun_bawang: Kareb lun rayeh keréta ineh nenier Raca' Yosapat idi ideh nengerawé neneh raca' lun Israil. Idi ideh iné' pebunu' neneh. Iamo' Raca' Yosapat nengitang, idi Tuhan nengedengan neneh. Idi Allah nengelubed nedeh rat neneh.
english: So when the soldiers who were driving the Syrian chariots saw Jehoshaphat wearing the royal robes, they thought “He must be the king of Israel!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Nabi Yihu Hanani iné' papu' raca'. Idi kebalaneh nan Raca' Yosapat, "Ngudeh iko ngedengan lun luk dat idi méi' inan lun luk megateh inan Tuhan? Ngaceku ineh Tuhan museh namu.
english: the prophet Jehu, the son of the prophet Hanani, went out of the city to meet the king, and said to him, “It was not right for you to help a wicked man and to love those who hate Yahweh. Because of what you have done, Yahweh is angry with you.

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh nedeh, "Ngerawé do'-do' kareb muyuh mutut ukum, pad muyuh mutut ineh pa kiung Allah idi baken pa kiung lemulun mo', pelé Tuhan idi dengan muyuh kareb muyuh mutut ukum ineh.
english: He told them, “Make your decisions carefully, because you are judging cases not in order to please people but to please Yahweh. And he will be watching you whenever you make a decision.

lun_bawang: Kebala raca' nedeh, "Do' muyuh nganau' kekamen muyuh dengan matot inan Tuhan, dengan niat luk mesiri idi matu,
english: He told them this: “You must always do your work faithfully, revering Yahweh.

lun_bawang: Idi lun nemaré kali' ni Yosapat, kebaladeh, "Inan aceh baweh rayeh nacing rat bawang Siria, ieh ineh rat dipar Abpa' luk Mepaci', sikal pebunu' namu. Idi ideh pangeh nacing déi' Hasason Tamar." (Ieh ineh, Enggedi.)
english: Some men came and told Jehoshaphat, “A huge army is coming to attack your army. They are coming from the Edom region, from the eastern side of the Dead Sea. They have already come to Hazazon-Tamar!” Another name for that place is En-Gedi.

lun_bawang: Kesembayangneh, "O Tuhan Allah tepun kai, Iko ineh luk ngimet déi' bang Surga. Idi teh Iko ngimet amung pupu. Iko ineh metueh idi melalud, pad seburur pana' nateh luk miak metueh rat Namu.
english: and he prayed this: “Yahweh, the God whom our ancestors belonged to, you are surely the God who rules from heaven. You rule over all the kingdoms of the nations. You have great power, and no one can successfully oppose you.

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "O lun Yahuda, lun Yerusalim, Raca' Yosapat: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan kuan muyuh, 'Aleg muyuh matot idi merapang ku baweh luk mula' ini. Ngaceku bunu' ini baken kuan muyuh, iamo' kuan Allah.
english: and said, “King Jehoshaphat and all you who live in Jerusalem and in other places in Judah, listen! This is what Yahweh says to you: ‘Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this huge army that is coming to attack you, because it is not you who will win this battle. It is God who will win it.

lun_bawang: Idi kareb aco luk keapat idi ideh nepamung déi' Ruan Beraka, idi déi' ideh nengubur Tuhan. Idi ngaceku ineh ideh neten ngadan su ineh Ruan Beraka macing aco sini.
english: The following day they gathered in Beracah Valley and praised Yahweh there. That is why that valley is still called Beracah, which means praise.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Elieser Dodawa rat Marisa ineh neperiteteng ni Yosapat kebalaneh, "Ngaceku iko pangeh neperurum ni Ahasia, idi Tuhan miak ngusag luk pangeh inau'mu ineh." Idi amung kapal ineh nekarem, kareb nateh nenalan amé' déi' Tarsis.
english: Eliezer the son of Dodavahu from Mareshah city warned Jehoshaphat. He said, “You have made an alliance with Ahaziah, who is a wicked king. Therefore, Yahweh will destroy the ships that your workers have made.” And the ships were wrecked, and were not able to sail to other countries.

lun_bawang: Idi inan aceh surat ratnan Nabi Elia, kebalaneh, "Tuhan Allah tepunmu Daud ngukum namu, ngaceku na iko maya' lawé tamanmu Yosapat, idi lawé Asa raca' Yahuda.
english: One day, Jehoram received a letter from the prophet Elijah. Elijah had written this in the letter: “This is what Yahweh, the God whom your ancestor King David worshiped, says: 'You have not done things that please me like your father Jehoshaphat did or what King Asa did.

lun_bawang: Idi amungdeh ineh pana' nepejani' bang Ruma' Allah dengan Yuas anak raca' ineh. Idi kebala Yoyada nedeh, "Nier muyuh, ini anak raca' di! Nekini ieh mangun ku raca', maya' kudeng bala Tuhan ratnan inul Raca' Daud ineh.
english: the whole group went to the temple and made an agreement with the young king there. Jehoiada said to them, “This is the son of the previous king of Judah. So he is the one who must rule, like Yahweh promised that the descendants of King David must do.

lun_bawang: Idi Yoyada nenated ni Yuas remuat. Idi ieh nengerareng pata luun uluhneh. Idi ieh nemaré neneh ukum Allah ineh, idi ideh neneten neneh raca'. Idi Imam Yoyada dengan anak-anakneh pana' nengumau ni Yuas, idi lun mula' nengitang, "Do' raca' mipu ulun.”
english: Then Jehoiada and his sons brought Joash out. They put a crown on his head and gave him a scroll on which were written the rules that the kings needed to obey, and proclaimed that he was now the king. They anointed him with olive oil and shouted, “We hope that the king will live for many years!”

lun_bawang: Kudeng ineh lawé Raca' Yuas na ngerawé kekamen luk do' luk pangeh inau' Yoyada taman Sekaria kuanneh, iamo' raca' nengaté anakneh. Idi kareb aténeh, kebala Sekaria, "Idi Tuhan mo' nier kekamenmu idi Ieh miak ngua'!”
english: King Joash had forgotten about how Zechariah’s father Jehoiada had been kind to him. That’s why he gave orders for the people to kill Jehoiada’s son Zechariah, who said as he was dying, “I hope that Yahweh will see what you are doing to me and punish you for doing it.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' seburur nabi Allah iné' matun raca', kebalaneh, "O raca', aleg iko maré baweh lun Israil ineh nalan maya' namu, ngaceku Tuhan na idi dengan lun Israil, ieh ineh amung inul Epraim ineh.
english: But a prophet came to him and said, “Your majesty, you must not allow those soldiers from Israel to march with your soldiers, because Yahweh does not help the people of the tribe of Ephraim or from anywhere else in Israel.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Amasia inan nabi Allah ineh, "Iamo' anun miak mangun ratnan
english: Amaziah asked that prophet, “If I do that, what about the huge amount of silver that I paid to hire those soldiers from Israel?” The prophet replied, “Yahweh is able to pay you back more money than you paid to hire those soldiers.”

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh Tuhan museh ni Amasia. Idi Ieh nengecuk seburur nabi amé' neneh. Kebala nabi ineh, "Ngudeh iko pangeh nenakap akang pupu baken ineh luk na iak muit pupudeh sebuleng rat bang paladmu?”
english: Because of that, Yahweh was very angry with Amaziah. He sent a prophet to him, who said, “Why do you worship these foreign gods that were not even able to save their own people when your army attacked them?”

lun_bawang: Idi Amasia raca' Yahuda nepegayam. Idi ieh nengecuk nelun amé' matun Yoas raca' Israil, ieh ineh anak Yuahas Yihu, kebalaneh, "Do' kiteh pebunu'.”
english: Some time later Amaziah, the king of Judah, consulted his advisors. Then he sent a message to Jehoash, the king of Israel. He wrote, “Come here and let’s talk together.”

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh nedeh, "Ninger muyuh balaku O lun Liwi! Ngeligan burur muyuh idi ngeligan Ruma' Tuhan Allah tepun muyuh. Idi ngeruat amung luk melutak rat bang Ruma' Allah.
english: and he said to them, “You descendants of Levi, listen to me! Consecrate yourselves. And then consecrate the temple of Yahweh, the God whom our ancestors worshiped/belonged to. Remove from the temple all the things that are not pleasing to God.

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh idi ideh iné' papu' ni Raca' Hesekia, kebaladeh, "Amung Ruma' Allah pangeh linigan kai, kudeng ineh teh bubpun luk inan ngeseb idi amung repapehneh idi méja luk inan ruti ubur dengan amung repapehneh.
english: Then they went to King Hezekiah and reported, “We have purified all parts of the temple, and the altar where sacrifices are completely burned, and all the items used at the altar, the table on which the priests place the sacred bread, and the things used at that table.

lun_bawang: "Do' muyuh metueh idi mekuu'. Aleg muyuh matot nan raca' Asur idi bawehneh, ngaceku luk idi dengan tau ini meluun rayeh ratnan luk denganneh.
english: They have to rely on the power of humans, but we have Yahweh our God to help us and to fight battles for us.” So the people became more confident because of what Hezekiah, the king of Judah, said.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng ini bala Senakerib raca' Asur, 'Idéké inan muyuh merapet, pad muyuh mudeng déi' Yerusalim bang bawang luk linibut.
english: Hezekiah says to you, “Yahweh our God will save us from being defeated by the army of the king of Assyria,” but he is misleading you. He wants you to die from having no food or water.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nemudut bubpun allah baken bang Ruma' Allah. Idi ratnan Ruma' ineh Tuhan pangeh nepebala, "Idi déi' Yerusalim inan ngadanKu macing ruked-ruked!”
english: He directed his workers to build altars for foreign gods in the temple, about which Yahweh had said, “It is here in Jerusalem that I want people to worship me, forever.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Hilkia ni Sapan lun luk ngayud ineh, "Ui pangeh nekali' surat Ukum ineh bang Ruma' Allah." Idi Hilkia nemaré surat ineh ni Sapan.
english: So Hilkiah said to Shaphan, “I have found in the temple a scroll on which are written the laws that God gave to Moses!” Then Hilkiah gave the scroll to Shaphan.

lun_bawang: Idi Sapan nenguit surat ineh kuan raca', kebalaneh, "Kai pangeh nenganau' luk icukmu ineh.
english: Shaphan took the scroll to the king and said to him, “Your officials are doing everything that you told them to do.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Sapan teh, "Hilkia pangeh nemaré surat ini kuanku." Idi Sapan nemaca' surat ineh kuan raca'.
english: Then Shaphan said to the king, “I have brought to you a scroll that  Hilkiah gave to me.” And Shaphan started to read it to the king.

lun_bawang: Idi Hulda nengecuk nedeh ineh ngacing bala Tuhan ini kuan raca':
english: When they told her what the king had said, she said to them, “This is what Yahweh, the God whom we Israelis worship, says: ‘Go back and tell the king who sent you

lun_bawang: "Ui ini Tuhan miak ngukum Yerusalim dengan amung lun luk bang bawang ini teh, pad ngacing amung kediman luk bila bang surat luk pangeh bica' lun pa kiung raca'.
english: that this is what Yahweh says: “Listen to this carefully. I am going to cause a disaster to strike Jerusalem and all the people who live here. I will cause them to experience the curses that were written in the scroll that was read to the king of Judah.

lun_bawang: Ui ini Tuhan Allah lun Israil pebala kuan raca': Iko pangeh neninger luk inayud bang surat ineh.
english: The king of Judah sent you to ask what I, Yahweh, want. Go and tell him that this is what I, Yahweh, the God whom you Israelis worship, say about what you read:

lun_bawang: Idi Raca' Yosia inurat lun luk ngelatik ku binor. Idi kebala raca' kuan lun dukenneh, "Nguit negku rat ieni, ngaceku mebura' uratku.”
english: Some Egyptian archers shot King Josiah. He told his officers, “Take me away from here because I am badly wounded.”

lun_bawang: "Kudeng ini bala Kores raca' Parsi: Tuhan Allah Surga pangeh nemaré negku amung imet luk luun tana'. Idi pangeh Ieh nengecuk negku mudut aceh Ruma' kuanNeh déi' Yerusalim luk bang tana' Yahuda.
english: “I, King Cyrus, who rule the Persian Empire, declare this: 'Yahweh, the God who is in/rules from heaven, has caused me to become the ruler of all the kingdoms that I know about on the earth. And he has appointed me to enable his people to build a temple for him in Jerusalem, in Judah land.

lun_bawang: Idi bang kareb ineh Pengulu Tatenai rat pa acep aco Abpa' Pirat, Setar Bosenai, idi amung lun rayeh luk ngedengan nedidueh iné' Yerusalim idi nengitun nelun Yahuda, kebaladeh, "Idéké nengecuk nemuyuh mudut Ruma' Allah muyuh ini dengan repapehneh?”
english: Then Tattenai the governor of the province west of the Euphrates River and Shethar-Bozenai his assistant and some of their officials went to Jerusalem and said to the people, “Who has permitted you to rebuild this temple and put furnishings in it?”

lun_bawang: "Idi kai pangeh nengitun amung lun rayehdeh ineh, 'Idé luk nengecuk nemuyuh mudut Ruma' ini idi repapehneh?'
english: “We asked the Jewish leaders, ‘Who has permitted you to rebuild this temple and put furnishings in it?’

lun_bawang: "Idi ideh nengor bala kai kudeng ini: 'Kai ini lun duken Allah langit idi tana', idi kai mudut Ruma' ini luk pangeh pinudut seburu raca' Israil luk rayeh bang kareb luk mon.
english: “But instead of telling us their leaders’ names, what they said was, ‘We serve the God who created the heaven and the earth. Many years ago a great king who ruled us Israeli people told our ancestors to build a temple here, and now we are rebuilding it.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaku nedeh, "Muyuh ini meligan kuan Tuhan Allah tepuh muyuh. Kudeng ineh teh amung repapeh amas idi pirak luk inuit muyuh ku aceh baré dengan ran niat kuanNeh.
english: I said to those priests, “You belong to Yahweh, the God whom our ancestors ◄worshiped/also belonged to►, and these valuable things also belong to him. The people themselves gave these things to be offerings to Yahweh ◄voluntarily/because they wanted to►.

lun_bawang: kesembayangku, "O Allahku, ui pelaba igu', na ui mekuu' sium Namu, O Allahku. Ngaceku amung dat kai pangeh medita' ratnan uluh kai, idi amung sala' kai pangeh pebuun-pebuun macing i langit.
english: and this is what I prayed: “Yahweh my God, I am very ashamed to raise my head in front of you. The sins that we Israelis have committed are very great; it is as though they have risen up higher than our heads, and our guilt for committing those sins, it is as though it rises up to the heavens.

lun_bawang: "Idi nekini, anunké luk miak belén kai, O Allah kai? Ngaceku kai pangeh nenecan amung balaMu,
english: “Our God, what more can we say now RHQ? In spite of all that you have done for us, we have disobeyed your commands.

lun_bawang: Idi ngaceku ratnan amung-amung luk pangeh nangun nekai ngaceku amung sala' idi kekamen kai luk dat, idi kai kali' O Allah, ukum luk biréMu nekai na petap nan kekamen kai luk dat, idi Iko pangeh nenima' nekai mulun teh.
english: “You punished us because we were very guilty for having done wicked things. But you have not punished us as much as we deserve to be punished. I say this because you, our God, have allowed some of us to survive.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Sekania Yehil, rat inul Elam ni Esra, "Pelaba rayeh sala' kai inan Allah kai ngaceku kai pangeh nengaweh decur-decur ratnan pupu baken. Iamo' sagan tu pana' kudeng ineh inan rapet kuan Israil.
english: Then Shecaniah, the son of Jehiel from the clan of Elam, said this to me: “We have disobeyed God. Some of us have married women who are not Israelis. But we can still confidently expect Yahweh to be merciful to us Israeli people.

lun_bawang: Idi Imam Esra nudur, idi kebalaneh nedeh, "Idi meluun rayeh sala' muyuh ngaceku muyuh nengaweh decur pupu baken, idi kudeng ineh teh muyuh ngula' sala lun Israil.
english: Then I stood up and said to them, “Some of you men have committed a very bad sin. You have married women who are not Israelis. By doing that, you have made us Israeli people more guilty than we were before.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun mula' ineh dengan rayeh arod, "Kai miak nganau' anun-anun luk dukenmu.
english: The whole group answered, shouting loudly, “Yes, what you have said is right! We will do what you have said.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh negku, "Lun luk neketecan bang bawang ineh luk nepuit ratnan bawang luk inandeh tiban ineh, ideh ineh pelaba susa' idi migu'. Idi teh libung luk meraben déi' Yerusalim pangeh tibpa idi amung tanga'neh pana' iseb.”
english: They said to me, “The Jews in Jerusalem who returned there from Babylonia are living in a very difficult situation. The walls of the city have been broken down, and even the city gates have been burned down.”

lun_bawang: kesembayangku, "O Tuhan Allah Surga, Allah luk meluun rayeh idi luk inan matot! Iko lutep maya' jani' idi mawa nelun luk mawa Namu, idi luk maya' amung ukumMu.
english: I said, “Yahweh, you who are/rule in heaven, you are a wonderful and awesome God. You keep your promise to faithfully love those who love you and who obey your commands.

lun_bawang: Ngerawé bala luk biréMu ni Musa, 'Kudeng muyuh lun Israil na lutep maya' Negku, Ui miak ngatad nemuyuh amé' arang pupu baken.
english: “But please remember what you told your servant Moses. You said, ‘If you sin, I will scatter you among the ◄heathen nations/nations that do not believe in me►.

lun_bawang: "O Tuhan ideh ineh demulunMu idi pupuMu, luk pangeh inuli'Mu ku laludMu luk rayeh idi ticu'Mu luk metueh.
english: “We are your servants. We are the people whom you brought here by your very great power MTY, DOU

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' negku, "Ngudeh iko dat niat? Ngaceku na iko mét. Iko dat niat mo'." Idi ui pelaba tot.
english: So he asked me, “Why are you sad? I know that you are not sick. It must be that you are troubled about something.” Then I was very afraid, because it was not proper to be sad when I came to the king (OR, because I was worried what the king would do to me if he refused to do what I was about to request him to do).

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaku kuan raca', "Do' raca' mipu ulun! Kali' rungen ui dat niat, ngaceku bawang su luk inan tanem tepunku inusag, idi tanga' bawang pana' pangeh iseb.”
english: I replied, “Your majesty, I hope you will live a very long time! But ◄how can I prevent myself from being sad, because the city where my ancestors are buried has been destroyed and is in ruins?/I cannot keep myself from looking sad, because the city where my ancestors are buried has been destroyed and is in ruins.► RHQ Even the city gates have been completely burned.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' negku, "Anun luk pianmu negku?" Idi ui nesembayang inan Allah Surga.
english: The king replied, “What do you want me to do for you?” I prayed silently to our God who is/rules in heaven.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' negku (idi raca' decur tudo iringneh,) "Anun kinio lawému, idi iko muli'?" Idi raca' nengecuk negku nalan. Idi ui nengeletep kinioneh.
english: While the queen was sitting beside the king, he asked, “If I allow you to go, how long will you be gone? When will you return?” I told the king how long I would be gone, and the king gave me permission to go, and I told him what day I wanted to leave.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaku inan rica', "Kudeng petulu pa kiungmu, do raca maré tuda'-tuda' surat kuan amung lun rayeh bawang déi' dipar Abpa' Pirat, pad ideh maré negku lemaba bawangdeh, pelé ui macing déi' Yahuda,
english: I also said to the king, “If you are willing to do it, write letters for me to take to the governors of the province west of the Euphrates River. Tell them to allow me to travel safely through their province until I arrive in Judah.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaku nedeh, "Muyuh kali' susa' tau ratnan Yerusalim pangeh inusag idi tanga'neh pangeh iseb. Do' tau mudut libung luk meraben déi' Yerusalim pad tau na migu'.”
english: Then I told them about how God had kindly/graciously helped me when I talked to the king, and what the king had said to me. They immediately replied, “Let’s start rebuilding!” So they started to do this good work.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kareb Sanbalat, Tobia, idi Gesan lun Arab nekali' bala ineh, idi ideh nesitunga nekai, kebaladeh, "Anunké luk ruen muyuh? Muyuh pian metueh ratnan raca'ké?”
english: But I replied, “Our God who is/rules in heaven will help our plans to succeed. But as for you, you have no right to decide anything about this city, because you have not participated in what has happened in this city in previous years.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tobia, lun Amon luk tuped iringneh, "Anunké luk pidutendeh? Kudeng inan bungalé manad libung batu ineh kali' rungen ineh metabpa!”
english: Tobiah was standing beside Sanballat. He said, “That stone wall that they are building is very weak; so if even a fox climbed up on it, the wall would fall down!”

lun_bawang: Idi ui ini Nehemia nesembayang, kesembayangku, "O Allah kai, ninger, ngaceku kai ini luk inandeh situnga. Do' ngelubed kuyodeh amé' luun bururdeh sebuleng, pad ideh pana' tebanen idi uen ngaro.
english: Then I prayed. I said, “Our God, hear us, because they are ridiculing us! Cause the words of their insults to fall back on them! Allow their enemies to come and capture them and force them to go to a foreign land!

lun_bawang: Iamo' lun Yahuda inan aceh nani, kenanideh, "Kai na miak mudut libung ini aco sini, Ngaceku lun luk ngakem ineh melaya', Idi mula' arap teh.”
english: Then the people of MTY Judah started to say, “The men who are working on the wall are becoming very tired. There is a lot of heavy rubble that we must remove; we ourselves cannot finish the work.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala bunu' kai, "Kudeng kai semuet arangdeh idi ngaté nedeh idi ngagka' kekamen ineh, kali' rungen ideh na kali' nekai.”
english: “Besides, our enemies are saying, ‘Before the Jews see us, we will swoop down on them and kill them and stop their work on the wall!’”

lun_bawang: Kareb lun Yahudi luk tudo arangdeh macing, ideh megéi pebala, "Ideh miak amé' pebunu' nekai ratnan anid-anid bawangdeh.”
english: The Jews who were living near our enemies came and told us many times, “You should leave the city and go to other places, in order that your enemies will not attack you!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaku kuan lun rayeh-rayeh idi lun mula', "Kekamen tau ini rayeh, idi mado arang tau, idi tau urap luun libung ini.
english: Then I said to the officials, the other important men, and the other people, “This wall is very long, and we are far apart from each other along the wall.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaku kuan lun mula' kareb ineh teh, "Do' anid-anid lemulun idi lun dukenneh tudo tungé' Yerusalim anid alem, pad ideh matar netau medacem, idi maco ideh ngakem.”
english: At that time, I also said to the people, “Tell every worker and his helper that they must stay inside Jerusalem at night. By doing that, they can guard us at night, and they can work on the wall during the daytime.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala sebuangdeh, "Mula' kai bang tetek ruma' kai. Na kai miak mulun kudeng na petap padé'.”
english: Some/One of them said, “We have many children. So we need a lot of grain to be able to eat and continue to live.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun baken, "Kai pangeh nemaré lati', kabun anggur, idi ruma' kai ku duduk, pad kai ngalap padé idi na maté.”
english: Others said, “The fields and vineyards and houses that we own, it has been necessary for us to ◄mortgage them/promise to give them to someone if we do not pay back to him the money he has loaned us► in order to get money to buy grain, during this ◄famine/time where there is not much food►.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun baken teh, "Na miak na kai ngabit usin, pad kai ngua' acam lati' idi kabun anggur kai kuan raca'.
english: Others said, “We have needed to borrow money to pay the taxes that the king commanded us to pay on our fields and our vineyards.

lun_bawang: pad ui nengayud nelun rayeh-rayeh, kebalaku, "Muyuh ngedereh kinanak- kinanak muyuh!" Idi ui nengamung nelun mula', pad kai miak mutut ratnan susa' ini,
english: So I thought about what I could do about it. I told the leaders and officials who were responsible for this work, “You are charging interest to your own relatives when they borrow money from you!” Then I called together a large group of people,

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaku teh, "Sala' luk ruen muyuh ineh! Petulu muyuh matot inan Allah idi nganau' luk matu, pad bunu' tau lun pupu baken na miak situnga netau.

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh, "Do' tau mepuit ratnan imetdeh, idi nala' abetdeh.”
english: They shout, “We should free ourselves from their control MET; we should not let them rule over us any longer!”

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "Ui pangeh nengeletep raca'Ku luun Sion, pegkungKu luk meligan.”
english: Yahweh says, “I have installed my king on Zion, my sacred hill in Jerusalem.”

lun_bawang: Kebala raca', "Ui maré kali' luk bila Tuhan. Kebala Tuhan negku: 'Iko anakKu. Aco sini Ui mangun ku TamanMu.
english: And his king says, “I will proclaim what Yahweh has decreed. He said to me, ‘It is as though you are my son; today I have declared to everyone that it is as though MET I am your father.

lun_bawang: Ideh ngedat negku, keburi'deh, "Allah na sikal ngedengan neneh!”
english: Many people are saying about me, “God will certainly not help him!”

lun_bawang: Mula' lun pebala, "Kai pian tu-tu uen ngeperuan!" O Tuhan méi' kuan kai!
english: Some people ask, “Who will allow good things to happen to us?” But I say, “Yahweh, continue to act kindly toward us.

lun_bawang: Ui maré ubur Namu, dengan amung niatku, ui mada' amung-amung tanu' luk inan mawa luk inau'Mu.
english: Yahweh, I will praise you with all of my inner being. I will tell others about all the wonderful things that you have done.

lun_bawang: Keterawéneh, "Na ui miak mebeneh; na ui miak mesusa'.”
english: They think, “Nothing bad will happen to us! We will never have troubles!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' lemulun luk dat pebala bang niatneh, "Allah na kali'. Ieh nemapen kiungNeh, idi na Ieh nier negku!”
english: Wicked people say, “God will not pay any attention to what we do. His eyes are covered, so he never sees anything.”

lun_bawang: Ngudehké lemulun luk dat nguyo Allah, idi pebala bang niatneh, "Ieh na ngukum negku"?
english: Wicked people revile you RHQ continually. They think, “God will never punish us!”

lun_bawang: Ui merapet inan Tuhan ngelibung negku. Ngudeh muyuh mebacé pebala negku: "Temulud iko kudeng suit amé' nan pegkung,
english: I trust that Yahweh will protect MTY me. So do not RHQ say to me, “You need to escape/flee to the mountains like birds do,

lun_bawang: Keburi'deh: "Kai pebala maya' pian kai. Seburur pana' nateh miak mebpeng nekai. Idéké luk miak mada' anun luk belénkai?”
english: They say, “By telling lies we will get what we want; we control what we say MTY, so no one can tell us what we should not do!”

lun_bawang: "Iamo'," kebala Tuhan, "Ui sikal macing, ngaceku lun masi' pangeh pidereh, idi lun luk pidereh ngarod ku étdeh: Ui miak ngedengan nedeh, mepad kudeng luk piandeh!”
english: But Yahweh replies, “I have seen the violent things that they have done to helpless people; and I have heard those people groaning, so I will arise and rescue the people who are wanting me to help them.”

lun_bawang: pelé bunu'ku na pebala, "Kai pangeh nengelaya' neneh!" Aleg nima' nedeh mawang niat ku ebpehku.
english: Do not allow my enemies to boast saying, “We have defeated him!” Do not allow them to defeat me, with the result that they will rejoice about it!

lun_bawang: Lun luk mebacé pebala bang niatdeh, "Na luk idi Allah." Amung-amungdeh na mesiri, idi ideh nenganau' luk pelaba dat; seburur pana' nateh luk nganau' luk do'.
english: Only foolish people say to themselves, “There is no God!” People who say those things are corrupt/worthless; they do abominable/detestable deeds; there is not one of them who does what is good/right.

lun_bawang: Ui pebala kuan Tuhan, "Iko luk Tuhanku; amung luk do' ilapku rat Namu.”
english: I said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord; all the good things that I have come from you.”

lun_bawang: O Allahku ngudehké Iko nenecan negku? Ui nengitang mutuh pedengan, iamo' macing nekini nateh luk idi.
english: My God, my God, why have you abandoned/deserted me? Why do you stay so far from me, and why do you not hear/help me RHQ? Why do you not hear me when I am groaning?

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh, "Iko merapet inan Tuhan. Ngudeh Ieh na ngulun namu? Kudeng Tuhan mawa namu, ngudeh Ieh na ngedengan namu?”
english: “He trusts in Yahweh, so Yahweh should save him! He says that Yahweh is very pleased with him; if that is so, Yahweh should rescue him!”

lun_bawang: KebalaMu, "Amé' Negku." Idi ui sikal amé' Namu, O Tuhan;
english: I sensed that I heard you say, “Come and worship me IDM,” so, Yahweh, I will worship you.

lun_bawang: Arod Tuhan maré talau nenganak, idi ngerurug amung-amung don kayuh; idi amung-amung luk bang ruma'Neh ngitang, "Rayeh kuan Allah!”
english: Yahweh’s voice shakes the huge oak trees and strips the leaves from the trees while the people in the temple shout, “Praise God!”

lun_bawang: Ui do' udeng, idi ui nepebala bang niatku, "Na ui miak uen ngelaya'.”
english: As for me, when I had no troubles, I said to myself, “No one will defeat me!”

lun_bawang: "Anunké luk do' luk macing ratnan atéku? Anunké samal ratnan ui amé' tanem? Miakké lun naté ngubur Namu, idi mada' éi'Mu luk meruked?
english: I said, “Yahweh, ◄what will you gain if I die?/ you won’t gain anything if I die► MTY. ◄In what way will it benefit you?/it won’t benefit you at all► if I go to the place where the dead people are RHQ. Dead people are certainly not able to praise you RHQ, and they are not able to tell others that you are trustworthy RHQ!

lun_bawang: Iamo' ui merapet Namu, Tuhan; Iko luk Allahku.
english: But Yahweh, I trust in you. You are my God.

lun_bawang: Ui matot idi nepebala, "Ui pangeh tila' rat pa kiungMu." Iamo' Iko neninger tawarku, kareb ui nenawar Namu mutuh pedengan.
english: I was afraid, and I cried out, “I have been separated from Yahweh!” but you heard me and answered my cry for help.

lun_bawang: Ngimet gaman idi pelapetMu, pad munu' lemulun luk ngerada' negku. Mada' negku Iko ineh Lun Nengulun negku!
english: Lift up your spear DOU and throw it at those who pursue me! Promise me that you will enable me to defeat my enemies.

lun_bawang: Dengan amung niatku ui sikal pebala kuan Tuhan, "Na lemulun mepad kudeng Iko! Iko matar lemulun luk melaya' ratnan lemulun luk metueh, idi lemulun luk mesiri' ratnan lemulun luk ngedereh nedeh!”
english: With my whole inner being SYN I will say, “There is no one like Yahweh RHQ! No one else can rescue helpless people from powerful people RHQ. No one else can rescue weak and needy people from those who want to rob them.”

lun_bawang: Ideh ngadu' negku dengan rayeh arod, "Neh! Neh! Kali' kai luk inau'mu!”
english: They shout at me, to accuse me, saying, “We saw the wrong things that you did!”

lun_bawang: Aleg nima' nedeh sebuleng pebala, "Neh! Ineh luk pian kai!" Aleg nima' nedeh pebala, "Kai pangeh nengelaya' neneh!”
english: Do not allow them to be able to say to themselves, “Yes, we have gotten rid of him IDM just like we desired!”

lun_bawang: Nima' nelun luk pian nier negku ruen matu ngitang ku awang niat idi megéi' pebala, "Tuhan ineh rayeh, idi Ieh mawang niat, ngaceku tueh demulunNeh!”
english: But cause those who desire that I be acquitted to be happy and shout joyfully, and cause them to continually say, “Yahweh is great! He is delighted to cause things to go well for those who serve him.”

lun_bawang: Aleg nima' nedeh mesido' niat ku susa'ku; aleg nima' nedeh medita' niat kareb ui mebpeh!
english: I said to you, “Do not cause me to die, with the result that my enemies will rejoice! Do not cause me to stumble, with the result that they will be very happy!”

lun_bawang: Kebalaku, "Ui miak matar do'-do' ratnan luk ruenku, pad balaku na mesala'. Ui na mala anun-anun kareb lemulun luk dat muneng.”
english: I said to myself, “I will be careful not to sin by the things that I say MTY. I will not say anything to complain while wicked people are near to me and can hear me.”

lun_bawang: "O Tuhan, maré kali' idan kareb ui maté. Tuda' aco baruh ui mulun? Mada' negku anun kisaget ulunku mabud.”
english: “Yahweh, show/tell me how long I will live. Tell me when I will die. Tell me how many years I will live!

lun_bawang: idi mepad kudeng aca'! Amung luk ruenneh, na ulekneh; ieh ngamung binaweh, idi na kali' idé luk miak ngalap neneh!
english: Then we disappear like a shadow does. It seems that all that we do is for nothing/useless. We sometimes get a lot of money, but we do not know who will get it after we die.

lun_bawang: Ninger sembayangku O Tuhan, idi ninger putuhku; aleg Iko ungeng, kareb ui nangi'! Mepad kudeng tepunku, ui ini sakaiMu, luk tudo tungé' segageh mo'.
english: Yahweh, listen to me while I pray; pay attention to me while I cry out to you. Help me while I am crying. I am here on the earth for only a short time, like all my ancestors.

lun_bawang: idi ui nengor, "Tungé' ui; bada'Mu kuanku ineh bang surat Ukum.
english: So I said to you, “Yahweh, here I am, to do the things that have been written in the scroll that contains your laws, things that you want me to do.”

lun_bawang: Nima' lemulun luk situnga negku, ruen ngesusa' ngaceku igu'deh.
english: I hope/desire that those who make fun of me will be dismayed when you defeat them.

lun_bawang: Do' amung lemulun luk amé' Namu mawang niat idi geriguen! Do' amung lemulun luk geregan ku ulunMu, megéi' pebala, "Tuhan pelaba rayeh!”
english: But I hope that all those who go to worship you will be very joyful DOU. I want those who love you because you saved them to shout repeatedly, “Yahweh is great!”

lun_bawang: Kebalaku, "Ui pangeh mesala' pa kiungMu, Tuhan, méi' negku idi ngedo' negku!”
english: When I was sick, I said, “Yahweh, be merciful to me and heal me; I know that I am sick because I have sinned against you.”

lun_bawang: Bunu'ku ngedat negku, keburi'deh, "Idan ieh maté, pad na luk uen ngerawé?”
english: My enemies say cruel things about me; they say, “How soon will he die, and then everyone will forget about him MTY? (OR, he will not have any descendants to continue his name).”

lun_bawang: Keburi'deh, "Pelaba bura' étneh, idi na metuineh.”
english: They say, “He will soon die because of his being sick; he will never get up from his bed before he dies.”

lun_bawang: Tebaco kedangan ui nangi', idi abpa' mateh mo' luk kenenku. Idi bunu'ku megéi' ngitun negku, "Iapehké Allahmu?”
english: Every day and every night I cry; it is as though the only thing I have to drink is my tears; and while I do that, my enemies are continually asking me, “Why does your god not help you?”

lun_bawang: Ui pebala inan Allah luk Batu Libungku, "Ngudeh Iko nekelupan negku? Ngudeh ui nangi' kidi-kidi ngaceku gateh bunu'ku?”
english: I say to God, who is like an overhanging rock under which I can hide MET, “It seems that you have forgotten me. I <mourn/cry> constantly because my enemies act cruelly toward me” RHQ.

lun_bawang: Ui pelaba dat niat ku baladeh luk dat. Idi ideh megéi' ngitun negku, "Iapehké' Allahmu?”
english: They make fun of me constantly; they continually ask, “Why does your god not help you?” RHQ And when they insult me like that, it is like wounds that I feel even in my bones.

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "Ugka' pebunu' idi kali' Ui ini Allah, luk meluun rayeh arang amung pupu, idi aput-aput tana'!”
english: God says, “Be quiet, and remember that I am God! I will be honored by the people of all nations. I will be honored all over the earth.”

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "Ngamung kuanKu lemulun luk nelutep maya' Negku, luk maré baré Negku maya' jani'deh.”
english: He says, “Summon those who faithfully worship me, those who made an agreement with me by offering sacrifices to me.”

lun_bawang: "Ninger, amung pupuKu! Ui miak pebala; Ui sikal maré luk nekali' namu, O Israil. Ui ini Allah idi Allahmu.
english: God says, “My people, listen! You Israeli people, listen, as I, your God, say what you have done that is wrong.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Allah pebala kuan lemulun luk dat, "Ngudeh iko ngapal ukumKu? Ngudeh iko pegayam ratnan jani'Ku?
english: But I say this to the wicked people: ◄Why do you/It does not benefit you at all to► RHQ recite my commandments or talk about the agreement that I made with you,

lun_bawang: "Iko megéi' pian pebala luk dat, idi mebalih teh.
english: You are always talking MTY about doing wicked things, and you are always trying to deceive people.

lun_bawang: "Ninger bala ini, amung-amung muyuh luk na ngerawé Negku, pad Ui na ngaté nemuyuh, ngaceku seburur pana' nateh luk miak ngulun nemuyuh.
english: So, all you who have ignored me, pay attention to this, because if you do not, I will tear you to pieces, and there will be no one to rescue you.

lun_bawang: Ngudeh iko medita' niat ku sala'mu O lemulun luk mesangit? Awa Allah ineh lutep.
english: You people think that you are strong and brag about the sins that you have committed, while you plan to harm godly people.

lun_bawang: "Siruh, lemulun luk na merapet inan Allah luk miak ngulun neneh, iamo' ieh merapet ku do' neh, idi binawehneh luk mula'!”
english: “Look what happened to the man who would not ask God to protect him; he trusted that his great wealth would save him; he trusted in the money that he got by wickedly taking it from others!”

lun_bawang: Lun luk mebacé pebala bang niatneh sebuleng, "Na luk idi Allah." Amung- amungdeh na mesiri, idi ideh nenganau' luk pelaba dat; seburur pana' nateh luk nganau' luk do'.
english: Only foolish people say to themselves, “There is no God!” People who say that are corrupt; they commit terrible sins; there is not one of them who does what is good/right.

lun_bawang: Ngulun negku dengan laludMu, O Allah, muit negku dengan tuehMu!
english: God, by your power MTY, DOU save me from my enemies, and show people that I have not done anything that is wrong!

lun_bawang: Keburi'ku, "Ui pelaba pian ku ilad, mepad kudeng sukur, pad ui temulud idi ngato erurku,
english: I said, “I wish that I had wings like a dove! If I had wings, I would fly away and find a place to rest.

lun_bawang: idi ui miket nakap ducung inanku, ngaceku bui idi barui luk rayeh.”
english: I would quickly find a shelter from my enemies who are like MET a strong wind and rainstorm.”

lun_bawang: Miakké muyuh mutut ukum luk matu, O muyuh lun rayeh? Miakké muyuh ngukum lemulun maya' luk mesiri?
english: When you mighty men speak, you never say what is right; you never decide things about people justly RHQ!

lun_bawang: Lemulun miak pebala, "Kali' rungen inan tabpar kuan lemulun luk matu; idi kali' rungen inan Allah luk ngukum tana' ini!"
english: Then people will say, “It is true that there is a reward for righteous people; and there is indeed a God who judges people justly here on the earth!”

lun_bawang: Ninger lu beléndeh! Dila'deh mepad kudeng pelapet, iamo' ideh ngitun, "Idéké ninger netau?”
english: They loudly say terrible things; they say MTY many things that injure people like MET swords do, but they think, “No one will RHQ hear us!”

lun_bawang: Allah nepebala bang su inanNeh luk meligan, keburi'Neh, "Ui miak amé' idi mabpat bawang Sikem, idi mabpat Raked Sukot tuda'-tuda' babpat.
english: Then God answered my prayer and spoke from his temple, saying, “Because I have conquered your enemies, I will divide up everything in Shechem city, and I will distribute it among my people the land in Succoth Valley.

lun_bawang: Ideh perurum bang gayamdeh luk dat, ideh pegayam nakap su inandeh tumen abpungdeh. Keburi'deh, "Na ini melagan sirendeh.”
english: They encourage each other about doing the evil things that they are planning to do; they talk with each other about where they can set traps to catch people, and they think, “No one RHQ will see what we are doing,

lun_bawang: Ideh nganau' terawé luk dat, idi pebala, "Kai mileh nganau' aceh terawé luk ngelaba ukum." Niat idi terawé lemulun pelaba dalem!
english: because we have planned very well the crime that we are going to commit!” No one can fully understand what people can think and plan!

lun_bawang: Do' mala kuan Allah, "Pelaba do' kekamen luk ruenMu! LaludMu pelaba rayeh, pad bunu'Mu matot idi tekeradung pa kiungMu.
english: They should say to God, “The things that you do are awesome! You are very powerful, with the result that your enemies ◄cringe/bow down► in front of you.”

lun_bawang: "Amung raca' idi bawehdeh upun buro!" Idi amung decur luk déi' ruma' nemabpat luk ilapdeh;
english: They proclaimed, “Many kings and their armies are running away from our army!” When our army brought back to their homes the things that they captured, the women who were at home divided up those things among themselves and among their families.

lun_bawang: Tuhan nepebala, "Ui miak nguit nedeh lemubed rat Basan; Ui miak nguit nedeh lemubed rat bang ribaruh abpa' luk rayeh,
english: The Lord said, “I will bring back the corpses of those who were killed in Bashan, and I will bring back those who sank deep in the ocean and drowned.

lun_bawang: "Ngubur Allah bang tebubpun pupuNeh, idi ngubur Tuhan amung-amung anak inul lun Israil!”
english: They are all singing, “You Israeli people, praise God when you gather together; praise Yahweh, all you who are descendants of Jacob!”

lun_bawang: Nuglun negku, O Allah! Abpa' medalem pad dierku;
english: O God, save me, because I am in great danger. It is as though flood water is up to my neck, and I am about to drown MET.

lun_bawang: Do' lemulun luk situnga negku, ruen ngesusa' ngaceku igu'deh!
english: I hope/desire that you will cause them to become dismayed and ashamed because you have defeated them.

lun_bawang: Do' amung lemulun luk amé' Namu mawang niat idi geriguen! Idi do' amung lemulun luk geregan ku ulunMu megéi' pebala, "Allah pelaba rayeh!”
english: But I hope/desire that all those who go to worship you will be very joyful DOU. I want those who love you because you saved them to shout repeatedly HYP, “God is great!”

lun_bawang: Keburi'deh, "Allah pangeh nenecan neneh; do' tau ngerada' neneh idi ngakem neneh, seburur pana' nateh luk miak muit neneh!”
english: They say about me, “God has abandoned him; so now we can pursue him and seize him, because there is no one who will rescue him.”

lun_bawang: Keburi'deh, "Allah na miak kali', idi Luk Meluun Medita' nateh kali'!”
english: Wicked people say to themselves, “God will certainly not RHQ know what we have done; people say that he is greater than any other god, but he does not know everything.”

lun_bawang: Kudeng ui nepebala kudeng ini, kali' rungen ui mesala' pa kiung pupuMu.
english: If I had said the things that the wicked people say, I would have been sinning against your people.

lun_bawang: Keburi'deh, "Do' tau ngabud nedeh." Idi ideh nenutung amung-amung ruma' sembayang bang bawang ini.
english: They said to themselves, “We will destroy the Israelis completely,” and they also burned down all the other places where we gathered to worship God.

lun_bawang: Kai ngubur Namu, O Allah, kai ngubur Namu! Kai mada' rayehMu, idi mada' kekamen luk inan mawa luk pangeh inau'Mu!
english: We give thanks to you; our God, we thank you. You are close to us, and we proclaim to others the wonderful things that you have done for us.

lun_bawang: Ui pebala kuan lemulun luk dat, 'Aleg medita' niat peh;'
english: I say to people who ◄boast/talk proudly about themselves►, ‘Stop bragging!’ and I say to wicked people, ‘Do not proudly do things to show how great you are IDM!

lun_bawang: "Miakké Tuhan megéi' necan negku, idi na mé' kuanku teh?
english: “Will the Lord always reject us? Will he never again be pleased with us?

lun_bawang: Idi ui nepebala, "Luk ngesusa' negku meluun ratnan ini — ngaceku Allah na melalud peh.”
english: Then I said, “What causes me to be very sad is that it seems that God, who is greater than any other god, is no longer powerful.”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengedat Allah, kebaladeh, "Miak ké Allah maré akan déi' su luk ali-ali?
english: They insulted God by saying, “We don’t think he can supply food for us here in this desert!

lun_bawang: Ngudehké lun luk na manu ngitun nekai, "Iapeh Allah muyuh?" Nima' nekai nier Namu ngukum pupu-pupu, ngaceku ideh nengeruat dara' demulun Mu!
english: It is not right that RHQ other people-groups say about us, “If their God is very powerful, ◄surely he should help them/why does he not help them►?” Allow us to see you punishing the people of other nations in return for their shedding our blood; they have killed many of us, your people.

lun_bawang: Ninger nekai, O Lun Luk Matar pupu Israil, Iko nguyut pupuMu mepad kudeng dumba, Iko tudo luun kerusiMu arang melaikat karub,
english: Yahweh, you who lead us like a shepherd leads his flock of sheep, listen to us Israeli people. You sit on your throne in the Very Holy Place in the temple, above the carvings of winged creatures.

lun_bawang: "Ui pangeh nengalap babeh muyuh luk meberat rat luun keted muyuh, idi nenima' nemuyuh ugka' ratnan kekamen muyuh luk meberat.
english: “After the rulers of Egypt forced you Israelis to work as slaves, I took those heavy burdens off your backs, and I enabled you to lay down those heavy baskets of bricks that you were carrying.

lun_bawang: O pupuKu, ninger bada'Ku; O lun Israil, Ui pelaba pian nemuyuh ninger bada'Ku!
english: You who are my people, listen while I warn you! I wish that you Israeli people would pay attention to what I say to you!

lun_bawang: "Do' muyuh ugka' mutut ukum luk na mesiri, idi na ngerurum lemulun luk dat!
english: “You must RHQ stop judging people unfairly; you must no longer make decisions that favor wicked people!

lun_bawang: Ngedengan nelun masi' idi anak maté teh; mutut ukum luk mesiri kuan lun masi' idi lun luk melaya' teh.
english: You must defend people who are poor and orphans; you must act fairly toward those who are needy and those who have no one to help them.

lun_bawang: Ui nepebala nemuyuh, 'Muyuh ini allah! Amung muyuh anak Luk Meluun Medita'.'
english: I the all-powerful God, previously said to them, “You think you are gods! It is as though you are all my sons,

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh, "Amé' ngusag bawang Israil, pad na luk teruayen macing ruked- ruked!”
english: They say, “Come, we must destroy their nation, with the result that no one will remember that Israel ever existed!”

lun_bawang: luk nepebala, "Kai sikal ngalap tana' Allah.”
english: who said, “We will take for ourselves the land that the Israelis say belongs to God!”

lun_bawang: "Kareb Ui neten ngadan bawang luk maya' Negku, Ui neten ngadan bawang Masir idi Babil; Ui nuet bawang Pilistin, Sur, idi Etiopia bang babpat Yerusalim.”
english: Some of those who know about God are the people of Egypt and Babylonia, and also the people of Philistia and Tyre and Ethiopia; some day they all will say, “Although I was not born in Jerusalem, because I belong to Yahweh, it is as though I was born there.”

lun_bawang: Sion miak tetanen bawang amung-amung pupu, idi Luk Meluun Medita' ngeraben neneh.
english: And concerning Jerusalem, people will say “It is as though everyone was born there, and Almighty God will cause that city to remain strong/safe/secure.”

lun_bawang: Tuhan miak ngayud ngadan amung pupu, idi nuet nedeh mangun ku lun kuan bawang Yerusalim.
english: Yahweh will write a list of the names of the people of various groups who belong to him, and he will say that he considers them all to be citizens of Jerusalem.

lun_bawang: Ideh ngalai idi menani, kenanideh, "Bang Sion inan lawa amung-amung peruan."

lun_bawang: Raca' inan lalud, idi lun baken na miak mebpeng neneh.
english: We need to obey what the king says more than we need to obey what anyone else says; no one can say to the king, “◄Why are you doing that?/You should not be doing that.► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Kebalaku, Ileh ineh meluun do' ratnan tueh, iamo' na tau ngerawé lun masi' mileh idi na tau pian ninger balaneh.
english: So I realized that although being wise is better than being strong, if you are poor, no one will appreciate what you do, and people will soon forget what you said.

lun_bawang: Idi ngerawé Allah luk nemudut namu kareb iko anak adi', kareb nateh aco susa' macing idi iko pebala, "Na ui mawang niat ku ulun tana' ini,”
english: While you are still young, keep thinking about God, who created you. Do that before you are old and you experience many troubles, during the years when you say “I no longer enjoy being alive.”

lun_bawang: Na ulekneh, na ulekneh, kebala Lun luk Mada'. Amung ineh na ulekneh.
english: So I say again that it is difficult to understand why everything happens; everything is mysterious.

lun_bawang: Awaku pebala negku. Awaneh O awaku, amé' tungé' maya' negku.
english: He spoke to me and said, “You whom I love, get up; my beautiful one, come with me CHI!

lun_bawang: Lun luk matar bawang ineh nepapu'ku, idi ui nengitun nedeh, "Kali' muyuh awa kidi?”
english: The city watchmen saw me while they were patrolling/walking around the city. I asked them, “Have you seen the one whom I love?”

lun_bawang: Ui miak manad ineh, idi ngalap bua'neh. Iti'mu mepad kudeng bua' anggur sirenku, idi riebmu mepad kudeng bua' luk do' buen,
english: I said to myself, “I will climb that palm tree and take hold of those clusters of dates.” To me, your breasts are like clusters of grapes that I can feel and your breath is like the sweet fragrance of apples

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O tana' idi langit, ninger balaKu! Kudeng ini bala Tuhan! Anak-anak luk isa'Ku sikal metueh rat Negku.
english: This is what Yahweh says: “All you angels in APO heaven and all you people on APO earth, listen to me! The people that I caused to exist and took care of DOU have rebelled against me.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Tuhan, "Nekini do' tau mutut gayam ini. Sagan pana' muyuh mesia' ku sala' muyuh, Ui sikal maru' nemuyuh, pad muyuh mebuda' kudeng salju. Sagan pana' sala' muyuh sia' merirem muyuh mangun mebuda' kudeng buluh dumba.
english: Yahweh says, “You need to think about the results of what you do. Even though the guilt of your sins be as evident and as difficult to get rid of as SIM red stains on a white garment DOU, I will get rid of them completely like someone who can make that stained garment become as white as snow or wool DOU.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh kebala Tuhan amung baweh, ieh ineh Allah Israil luk Melalud: "O bunu'Ku, Ui ngua' nemuyuh pad muyuh na ngesusa' Negku.
english: Therefore I, the Commander of the armies of angels, the mighty God of Israel, say to my enemies, ‘ will get revenge on you; you will not cause me any more trouble. And I will pay you back for the evil things that you did.

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh, tuda'-tuda' burur lemulun miak mili' seburur rat arang inuldeh, kebaladeh, "Iko inan ayung, do' iko mangun ku lun rayeh kai bang susa' ini.”
english: At that time, someone will grab one of his brothers in his father’s house and say to him, “You have a coat, which shows that you are respected. So you be our leader! You rule this city, which is now a pile of ruins!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebalaneh, "Ara' ui! Ui na miak ngedengan nemuyuh. Ui pana' na petap akan idi ayung. Aleg nganau' negku ku lun rayeh muyuh!”
english: But his brother will reply, “No, I cannot help you, because I do not have any extra food or clothes in this house. So do not appoint me to be your leader!”

lun_bawang: Tuhan pian ngukum lun rayeh idi lun luk ngimet pupuNeh. Ieh ngadu' nedeh, kebalaNeh: "Muyuh pangeh nengaro kabun anggur, idi ruma' muyuh panu' ku luk ilap muyuh rat nelun masi'.
english: He will stand up to declare why the elders and rulers of his people should be punished: he says, “The people of Israel are like MET a vineyard that I planted, but you have ruined it! Your houses are full of things that you have stolen from poor people.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Decur Yerusalim pelaba dita' niat! Ideh tungog idi ngimateh. Ideh nalan-nalan pian siren, idi karing luk luun kukuddeh ngekéng.
english: Yahweh says this: “The women of Jerusalem are haughty/proud; they walk around sticking their chins out, and flirting with men with their eyes. They walk with tiny steps with bracelets on their ankles that jingle.

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh tudu' burur decur miak ngakem seburur deléi, kebaladeh, "Miak kai maman idi ngayung burur kai sebuleng, iamo' nima' nekai neten namu awan kai, pad kai na migu' ngaceku kai tudo buleng-buleng.”
english: When that happens, there will be very few unmarried men still alive. As a result, seven unmarried women will grab one man, and say, “Allow us all to marry you IDM! We will provide our own food and clothing. All that we want is to no longer be disgraced because of not being married.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Rurumku, "Do' muyuh luk tudo déi' Yerusalim idi Yahuda mutut ukum arang kabun anggurKu idi Ui.
english: Now this is what Yahweh says: “You people of Jerusalem and other places in Judah, I am like the friend, and you are like my vineyard; so you judge which of us has done what is right.

lun_bawang: Ui neninger Tuhan luk Melalud pebala, "Ruma' luk rayeh idi luk do' ini miak uen ngusag.
english: But I heard the Commander of the armies of angels solemnly declare this: “Some day, many of those huge houses will be empty/deserted; no one will be living in those beautiful mansions.

lun_bawang: Kebala muyuh, "Do' Tuhan miket nganau' luk belénNeh, pad tau miak kali' ineh. Do' Allah Israil luk Meligan ngacing luk pianNeh, pad tau miak nier ineh.”
english: They make fun of God and say to him, “Go ahead, do something to punish us! We want to see what you will do. You, the Holy One of Israel, should do what you are planning to do, because we want to know what it is.”

lun_bawang: Ideh ngitang seburur inan seburur: "Meligan, meligan, meligan! Tuhan luk Melalud ineh meligan! Tana' ini maput ku rayehNeh.”
english: They were calling to each other, saying, “The Commander of the armies of angels is holy; he is completely holy! The entire earth is filled with his glory.”

lun_bawang: Kebalaku, "Ui na inan rapet! Ui miak kumin! Amung bala luk lemaba bibir tangku mesala', idi ui tudo arang aceh pupu luk megéi pebala luk mesala'. Idi nekini dengan matehku sebuleng ui pangeh nenier Raca', ieh ineh Tuhan luk Melalud!”
english: Then I said, “Terrible things will happen to me, because everything that I say MTY is sinful, and I live among people who constantly say MTY sinful things. I will be destroyed because I have seen the Commander of the armies of angels!”

lun_bawang: Ieh nengisit bibir tangku ku bareh apui luk mulun ineh, kebalaneh, "Ini pangeh nepisit luun bibir tangmu, idi babeh sala'mu pangeh netala', idi iko ngalap do' ratnan sala'mu.”
english: and touched my lips with the coal. Then he said, “Look at what I have done. I have touched your lips with this coal. Now your guilt is ended, and your sins are forgiven DOU.”

lun_bawang: Idi ui neninger Tuhan pebala, "Idéké luk miak dukenKu? Idéké luk mangun ku gatum Kai?" Kebalaku, "Ui miak amé'. Do' ngecuk negku!”
english: Then I heard Yahweh asking, “Whom shall I send to be a messenger to my people? Who will go and speak for us?” I replied, “I will. Send me!”

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nengecuk negku amé' mada' bala ini nelun mula': "Sagan tu pana' muyuh ninger do'-do', muyuh na miak kali' ilungneh. Sagan tu pana' muyuh nier do'-do' muyuh na miak kali' luk mangun.”
english: Then he said, “Okay, go, and say to the Israeli people, ‘You will listen carefully to what I say, but you will not understand it. You will look very carefully at the things that I am doing, but you will not understand them.’

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaku, "Tuda' ioké ideh kudeng ineh, Tuhan?" KebalaNeh, "Pad macing amung bawang pangeh inusag idi na lemulun, idi pad macing amung ruma' pangeh tican, idi bawang ineh mangun ku su luk ali-ali.
english: Then I said, “How long do you want me to continue to do that?” He replied, “Do it until their cities are ruined by their enemies, until no one is living in their houses, do it until all the crops are stolen from their fields and the fields are ruined.

lun_bawang: Raca' Yahuda neninger bala ratnan baweh Siria nacing bawang Israil, idi raca' dengan anak itinneh pelaba tot, pad ideh megegker, mepad kudeng kayuh luk meguer ku bui.
