english: But before they attacked, everyone in the palace heard a report that the armies of Syria and Israel were now ◄allies/joined to attack Jerusalem►. So Ahaz and the people over whom he ruled were extremely afraid; they were shaking from fear like trees shake in a windstorm.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Yesaya, "Nguit anakmu Sier Yasub idi amé' papu Raca' Akas. Medueh miak papu' neneh su luk inan lun ngebaruh kibung paped abang luk dalan abpa' ratnan takung luk pa luun.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Take your son Shear-Jashub, and go to talk with King Ahaz. He is at the end of the ◄aqueduct/water channel► that brings water into the upper reservoir, near the road to the place where women wash clothes.

lun_bawang: Ideh pian ngerieng Yahuda, ngatot nelun mula' pad ideh perurum nedeh, idi ngikit anak Tabil mangun ku raca' Yahuda.
english: ‘We will attack Judah and conquer it. Then we will appoint Tabeel’s son to be the king of Judah.’

lun_bawang: "Iamo' Ui ini Tuhan pebala: Amung ineh na miak mangun.
english: But this is what Yahweh, the Lord, says: ‘It will not happen; they will not conquer Jerusalem!

lun_bawang: "Mutuh Tuhan Allahmu maré aceh tanu' namu. Tanu' ineh miak macing ratnan su luk inan até, kian rat surga luk déi' dita' lek.”
english: He said to tell him, “Request me, Yahweh your God, to do something that will enable you to be sure that I will help/protect you. What you request can be from a place that is as high as the sky or as low as the place where the dead people are.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Akas, "Na tu ui mutuh tanu'. Ui na sikal nutun Tuhan.”
english: But when I told that to the king, he refused. He said, “No, I will not request Yahweh to do something to prove that he will help/protect us!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yesaya neneh, "Ninger iko, O inul Raca' Daud; petap susa' kudeng iko ngerur lemulun, pianké iko ngerur Allah teh?
english: Then I said to him, “You people who are descendants of King David, listen! You are causing me to be tired of being patient. Are you also going to cause my God to stop being patient with you RHQ?

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan negku, "Ngalap aceh luk inan ngayud luk rayeh, idi ngayud dengan urup luk mekara: 'Miket Ngaro, Saget Ngalap.'
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Make a large signboard. And write clearly on it, ‘Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz’ which means ‘quickly ◄plunder/take by force► and steal everything’.”

lun_bawang: Muci ui pamung dengan awanku luk nabi teh. Ieh mali' idi nenganak aceh anak deléi. Kebala Tuhan negku, "Nganau' ngadanneh, "Miket Ngaro, Saget Ngalap.'
english: Then I had sex with EUP my wife, who was a prophetess, and she became pregnant and then gave birth to a son. Then Yahweh said to me, “Give him the name Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz (which means ‘suddenly attacked, quickly conquered’),

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku pupu ini na pian ku Arur Siloa luk melitong, idi ngaceku ideh megegker pa kiung Raca' Resin idi Raca' Peka,
english: ‘I have taken good care of you people, but you have rejected that, thinking that my help was very little, like MET the little canal through which water flows from the Gihon Spring into Jerusalem. Instead, you have been happy to request help from King Rezin and King Pekah.

lun_bawang: "Aleg iko semuet bang gayam lun mula', idi aleg merapang ku luk inandeh matot.
english: “Do not say that everything that people do is conspiring/rebelling against the government, like other people say, and do not ◄be afraid of/worry about► the things that other people are afraid of.

lun_bawang: Lemulun miak mutuh namu ngitun bala rat nelun luk mangun idi lemulun luk inan ileh Sétan luk dureng-dureng. Kebaladeh, "Petulu lemulun ngitun bala ratnan ada' idi ngitun nelun luk naté pad ngedengan lemulun luk mulun.”
english: Some people may urge you(pl) to ◄consult/go and talk with► those who talk with the spirits of dead people or with those who say that they receive messages from those spirits. They whisper and mutter about what we should do in the future. But God is RHQ the one whom we should ask to guide us! It is ridiculous RHQ for people who are alive to request spirits of dead people to tell us what we should do!

lun_bawang: "Ruma' ratnan batu bata netabpa, iamo' kai miak ngelibal nedeh ku ruma' batu. Tuked ratnan kayuh gita' pangeh tingal, iamo' kai miak ngelibal ineh ku kayuh tumuh luk do'.”
english: But Yahweh brought the armies of Assyria, the enemies of King Rezin of Syria, to fight against Israel and incited other nations to attack Israel.

lun_bawang: Ieh nengadan, kebalaneh, "Amung lun rayeh bawehku mepad kudeng raca'!
english: He says, ‘All of my army commanders will soon be kings of these nations that I conquer!

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud inan pupuNeh luk tudo déi' Sion, "Aleg matot nelun Asur, sagan pana' ideh ngedereh nemuyuh mepad kudeng luk inau' Masir mon.
english: This is what the Commander of the armies of angels says: “My people in Jerusalem, do not be afraid of the army of Assyria when they beat you with rods and clubs, like the men of Egypt did to your ancestors long ago.

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh inul muyuh miak menani, "O Tuhan, ui ngubur Namu. Atun Iko museh negku, iamo' nekini usehMu nugka', idi ui bukenMu.
english: At that time, you people of Jerusalem will sing this song: “Yahweh, we praise you! Previously, you were angry with us, but you are not angry now and you have comforted us.

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh inul muyuh miak menani, "Maré ubur kuan Tuhan! Mutuh Neneh ngedengan namu! Mada' luk inau'Neh kuan pupu baken. Ngegala' rayehNeh nedeh!
english: At that time you all will say, “We should thank Yahweh! We should praise him MTY! We should tell the people of all the people-groups what he has done; we should enable them to know that he MTY is very great!

lun_bawang: Kareb Tuhan nganau' kudeng ini, ideh miak situnga inan raca' Babil, kebaladeh: "Raca' luk mekuel pangeh nebpeh! Seburur pana' nateh luk miak pederenneh teh!
english: When that happens, you will make fun of the King of Babylon by saying this: “You treated us cruelly, but that has ended! Your insolently causing others to suffer is finished!

lun_bawang: Kayuh tongor idi tumuh Lebanon mawang niat ku ebpeh raca', ngaceku na lun luk nebpeng nedeh, ngaceku raca' ineh na idi!
english: It will be as though even the trees in the forests will joyfully sing this song, the cyprus/pine trees and the cedar trees in Lebanon will sing it: ‘You ◄have been overthrown/are no longer a ruler►, and now no one comes to get rid of us MET.’

lun_bawang: Ideh nawar neneh, kebaladeh, 'Nekini iko mepad laya' kudeng kai. Iko mepad kudeng kai teh!
english: They will all shout to you together, ‘Now you are as weak as we are!’

lun_bawang: Kebalamu bang niatmu, 'Ui amé' déi' surga; Ui miak ngeletep kerusi meluun dita' ratnan gituen Allah. Ui miak tudo luun pegkung pa tinueh busat aco su luk inan amung allah mepamung.
english: You proudly said to yourself, ‘I will ascend to heaven, to my throne above God’s stars. I will rule on the mountain where the gods gather together, far in the north.

lun_bawang: "Lun naté miak nutong idi mawa nier namu. Kebaladeh, 'Kudeng iniké lemulun luk nengeruyuh tana' idi luk nengatot amung bawang?
english: The other dead people there stare at you; they wonder what happened to you. They say, ‘Is this the man who caused the earth to shake and caused the people in many kingdoms to tremble?

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud, "Ui ngerieng Babil idi ngusag neneh. Ui na necan anun-anun — anak pana' nateh. Seburur pana' nateh luk miak mulun. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: This is what the Commander of the armies of angels says: “I myself will cause Babylon to be conquered. I will get rid of Babylon and its people and their descendants.

lun_bawang: Ui ngisu' Babil mangun ku tana' payeh idi puek miak mulun su ineh. Ui miak ngapuh Babil ku apuh pad na luk ketecan. Ui ini Tuhan luk Melalud pangeh nepebala.”
english: I will cause Babylon to be a place where owls live, a place full of swamps; I will get rid of it completely as though MET I were sweeping it with a broom. That is what I, the Commander of the armies of angels, say.”

lun_bawang: Tuhan luk Melalud pangeh nepebulung, "Luk pangeh litepKu miak mangun, idi luk tirawéKu miak ruenKu.
english: The Commander of the armies of angels has also solemnly promised this: “The things that I have planned will surely happen DOU.

lun_bawang: Ini bala ratnan Damsik. Kebala Tuhan, "Damsik na miak mangun ku aceh bawang teh; ieh mangun ku usag mo'.
english: I received this message from Yahweh about Damascus the capital of Syria: “Listen carefully! Damascus will no longer be a city; it will be only a heap of ruins!

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Kareb ineh rayeh Israil miak ugka', idi do'neh uen ngelibal ku asi'.
english: “At that time, Israel will become insignificant. It will be like MET a fat person who has become very thin.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan negku, "Ui miak nier rat surga mepad kudeng ipup luk macing dengan na muni, ieh ineh kareb do' aco, kareb ngeranih idi mepad kudeng acang aco kareb mét idang.
english: Listen because Yahweh has told me this: “I will watch quietly from where I live. I will watch as quietly as SIM the heat waves shimmer as they rises on a hot summer day, as quietly as the dew forms on the ground during harvest time.”

lun_bawang: Ini bala ratnan Masir. Tuhan amé' Masir maya' laput. Akang Masir megegker pa kiungNeh, idi lun Masir matot Neneh.
english: I received this message from Yahweh about Egypt: “Listen to this! I, Yahweh, am coming to Egypt, riding on a fast-moving cloud. The idols in Egypt will tremble when I appear, and the people of Egypt will be extremely afraid IDM.

lun_bawang: Amung lun rayeh Soan pelaba bacé, idi lun Masir luk mileh mada' raca' maré bada' luk mebacé. Ngudehké ideh pebala kuan raca', "Kai ini anak lun mileh, idi anak-anak raca' luk mon"?
english: The officials in Zoan city in northern Egypt are foolish. The advice that they gave to the king was worthless. Why do they continue to tell the king that they are wise, that they are descendants of wise kings who lived long ago RHQ?

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh limeh bawang Masir miak pebala bang buri' Kanaan. Lemulun bang bawang ineh pebulung ku ngadan Tuhan luk Melalud. Sebuleng rat arangdeh tetanen, "Bawang Aco.”
english: At that time, people in five cities in Egypt will solemnly declare that they will serve Yahweh. They will learn to speak the Hebrew language. One of those cities will be called ‘City of the Sun’.

lun_bawang: Tuhan luk Melalud miak ngeperuan nediteluh, kebalaNeh, "O pupuKu, Masir, O Asur luk pinudutKu, O Israil, pupu luk pinili'Ku, Ui ngeperuan nemuyuh."
english: The Commander of the armies of angels will bless them, saying, “You people of Egypt are now my people. You people of Assyria, I have established your country. You people of Israel are the people whom I have chosen to belong to me.”

lun_bawang: Teluh lak luk nepangeh Tuhan nengecuk ni Yesaya Amos nengelengu tacung idi kasutneh. Ieh nemaya' balaNeh idi nelungu.
english: At that time, Yahweh told me, “Take off the rough sackcloth that you have been wearing and take off your sandals.” So I did what he told me to do, and then I walked around naked and barefoot for three years.

lun_bawang: Kareb Asdod pangeh linaya', idi kebala Tuhan, "DemulunKu Yesaya nalan- nalan dengan lungu teluh lak kinioneh. Ini mangun ku tanu' ratnan luk mangun kuan Masir idi Sudan.
english: Then Yahweh said this to the people of Judah: “My servant Isaiah has been walking around naked and barefoot for the past three years. That is to show the terrible disasters that I will cause the people of Egypt and Ethiopia to experience.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan negku,"Amé' iko ngecuk aceh lun nginita, idi ngecuk neneh maré kali' ratnan luk sirenneh.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Put a watchman on the wall of Jerusalem, and tell him to shout/proclaim what he sees.

lun_bawang: Lun luk nginita ineh ngitang, kebalaneh, "O Tuan, ui matar tebaco kedangan.”
english: So I did that, and one day the watchman called out, “Day after day I have stood on this watchtower, and I have continued to watch during the day and during the night.

lun_bawang: Denak-denak ideh macing! Lemulun luk nalan maya' kuda, tedueh-tedueh. Lun luk nginita ineh maré bala, kebalaneh, "Babil pangeh netabpa! Amung akang luk inandeh sembayang pangeh nebila'.”
english: Now, I saw a man riding in a chariot pulled by two horses. I called out to him, and he answered/shouted, ‘Babylon has been destroyed! All the idols in Babylon lie in pieces on the ground!’”

lun_bawang: Ini bala ratnan Edom. Seburur lemulun nawar negku rat Edom, kebalaneh, "O lun luk nginita, anun kinio dacem ni teh?”
english: I received this message from Yahweh about Edom: Someone from Edom has been calling/shouting to me saying, “Watchman, how long will it be before the night is ended? DOU”

lun_bawang: Kebalaku, "Malé macang aco, iamo' inan dacem teh. Kudeng iko sikal ngitun teh, do' lemubed napeh.”
english: I, the watchman, replied, “It will soon be morning, but after that, it will soon be night again. If you want to inquire again about what will happen in our country, come back and inquire again.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan negku, "Selak baruh ubur pupu Kedar miak ugka'.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Exactly one year from now, all the greatness of the Kedar area in Arabia will end.

lun_bawang: Nima' negku nangi' buleng-buleng. Aleg ngubuk negku, ngaceku pupuku pelaba ula' naté.
english: That is why I said, “Allow me to cry alone; do not try to comfort me about my people being slaughtered.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' muyuh neriruh idi nenganau' irau. Muyuh nengeret dumba idi sapi' ku kikid muyuh, idi nengirup abpa' anggur. Kebala muyuh, "Meluun do' tau ngirup idi kuman, ngaceku nebpa tau maté.”
english: But instead of doing that, you were happy and celebrating; you slaughtered cattle and sheep, in order to cook their meat and eat it and drink wine. You said, “Let’s eat and drink all that we want to, because it is possible that we will die tomorrow!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah luk Melalud negku, "Ideh na miak ngalap do' ratnan dat ini ruked ulundeh. Ui ini Allah luk Melalud pangeh nepebala.”
english: So the Commander of the armies of angels revealed this to me: “I will never forgive my people for sinning like this!”

lun_bawang: Tuhan luk Melalud nengecuk negku amé' matun ni Sebna, ieh ineh lun rayeh ruma' raca', idi pebala neneh,
english: The Commander of the armies of angels said this to me: “Go to Shebna, the official who supervises the workers in the palace, and give this message to him:

lun_bawang: O bawang Sidon, iko inigu'! Abpa' rayeh idi ribaruh abpa' rayeh pana' na pian namu, kebaladeh, "Na anakku, anak deléi idi anak decur nateh luk isa'ku.”
english: But now you people in Sidon should be ashamed, because you trusted in Tyre, which has been a strong fortress on an island in the sea. Tyre is like a woman who is saying, “Now it is as though I have not given birth to any children, or raised any sons or daughters.”

lun_bawang: O bawang Sidon, awang niatmu na idi peh. Pupumu pederen, idi sagan pana' ideh buro amé' Siprus, ideh na miak mepuit.
english: He said to the people of Sidon, “You will never rejoice again, because you will be crushed; even if you flee to Cyprus island, you will not escape destruction.”

lun_bawang: Rat iring tana' tau ninger nani ubur ratnan Israil, pupu luk matu ineh. Iamo' na luk idi rapet kuanku! Ui iuk-iuk melaya'! Lemulun luk dat lakat nganau' luk dat, idi datdeh iuk-iuk amé' rayeh.
english: We will hear people in the most distant places on the earth singing praise to Yahweh, the truly righteous one. But now, I am SYN very sad. Weep for me, because I have become thin and weak. Terrible things are happening! Treacherous people still betray/deceive others everywhere DOU.

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh, amung lemulun miak pebala, "Ieh ineh Tuhan tau! Tau pangeh merapet Neneh idi Ieh nemuit netau idi nekini tau pelaba awang niat, ngaceku Ieh nengulun netau!”
english: At that time, people will proclaim, “Yahweh is our God! We trusted in him, and he rescued us! Yahweh, in whom we trusted, has done it; we should rejoice because of his saving/rescuing us!”

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh, lemulun menani déi' bawang Yahuda, kenanideh: Bawang tau meraben! Allah sebuleng matar libungneh!
english: Some day, people in Judah will sing this song: Our city of Jerusalem is strong! Yahweh protects our city; He is like MET a wall that surrounds it.

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh Tuhan miak pebala,
english: At that time, Yahweh will say, “You Israeli people, who are like MET a fruitful vineyard, must sing!

lun_bawang: Ieh pian ngato erur idi ngubuk nemuyuh, iamo' muyuh ara' ninger balaNeh.
english: Yahweh told his people long ago, “This is a place where you can rest; you are exhausted from all your travels through the desert, but you will be able to rest in this land.” But they refused to pay attention to what he said.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan: "Ui nganau' déi' Sion aceh tapin luk meraben. Luun ineh Ui nganau' aceh batu lidung luk metueh. Idi bala ini inayud luunneh, 'Lemulun luk manu mulai niat.'
english: Therefore, Yahweh our Lord says this: “Listen to this! I am going to place in Jerusalem someone who is like MET a foundation stone, he is like a stone that has been tested to determine if it is solid. He will be like a valuable cornerstone around which it will be safe to build a house; and whoever trusts in him will never be disappointed.

lun_bawang: Setuneh nabi mangun ku mateh lun mula', iamo' Allah pangeh nengebuser nedeh. Ilung amung luk sinier nabi miak uen ngalum nemuyuh. Ieh ineh mepad kudeng aceh surat luk pangeh itu.
english: Yahweh gave me this vision; but for you, it is only words on a scroll that is sealed shut. If you give it to those who can read and request that they read it, they will say, “We cannot read it because the scroll is sealed.”

lun_bawang: Kudeng iko maré ineh ruen lun luk na mileh maca', ieh miak pebala, "Ui na mileh.”
english: When you give it to others who cannot read, they will say, “We cannot read it because we do not know how to read.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Lemulun ini siayu sembayang Negku, iamo' na ilung baladeh, idi niatdeh mado rat Negku. Sembayangdeh ineh mangun ku ukum idi adat lemulun mo', luk pangeh ipaldeh.
english: So the Lord says, “These people say that they belong to me. They honor me by what they say MTY, but they do not think IDM about what I desire. When they worship me, all they do is recite rules that people have made and that they have memorized.

lun_bawang: Lemulun luk pian ngapung terawé deh ratnan Tuhan miak kumin! Ideh nganau' luk pangeh tirawédeh dengan lulem. Ideh ngerawé lemulun na miak nier nedeh idi kali' luk ruendeh.
english: Terrible things will happen to those who try to conceal from me, Yahweh, the evil things that they plan to do; they do those things in the darkness and they think, ‘Yahweh certainly cannot RHQ see us; he cannot RHQ know what we are doing!’

lun_bawang: Idi nekini bala Tuhan, Allah lun Israil, luk nemuit Ibrahim ratnan susa', "O pupuKu, muyuh na miak uen ngigu' teh idi muyuh na mesia' kiung ku igu' teh.
english: That is why Yahweh, who rescued Abraham, says about the people of Israel, “My people will no longer be ashamed; no longer will they show on their faces that they are ashamed.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Lemulun luk ngimet Yahuda miak kumin, ngaceku ideh sikal metueh rat Negku. Ideh maya' dalan luk na icukKu, idi nganau' rurum luk na pianKu, idi ideh iuk-iuk mula' sala'.
english: Yahweh says, “Terrible things will happen to you, my people who rebel against me. You make plans, but what you plan is not what I want. You have made an alliance with the rulers of Egypt, but you did not ask my Spirit if that was what you should do. By doing that, you have increased the number of your sins.

lun_bawang: Ideh ngecuk amung nabi pirud. Kebaladeh, "Aleg mada' nekai ratnan luk matu. Mada' ratnan luk pian pedingeren kai. Nima' nekai saluken.
english: They tell the people who see/receive visions from Yahweh, “Stop seeing visions!” They tell the prophets, “Do not reveal to us what is right! Tell us pleasant things; do not tell us visions about things that are true!

lun_bawang: Iamo' kudeng ini bala Allah Israil luk meligan: "Muyuh na ninger balaKu, idi muyuh merapet ratnan ngaté lemulun idi naluk.
english: Therefore, this is what the Holy One of Israel says: “You have rejected my message, and you are relying on those who oppress and deceive others.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah Israil luk Meligan inan pupuNeh, "Amé' Negku, idi teh merapet Negku, pelé muyuh metueh idi do' udeng." Iamo' na muyuh pian!
english: Yahweh, our God, the Holy One of Israel, also says this: “You will be rescued from your enemies only if you repent and trust in what I will do for you; you will be strong only if you quit worrying and trust in me. But you do not want to do that.

lun_bawang: Kebala muyuh, "Kai sikal buro maya' kuda." Aganeh, buro muyuh! Idi teh kebala muyuh, "Kuda kai mawer." Setuneh kuda lun luk ngerada' nemuyuh meluun awer!
english: You said, ‘No, we will escape on horses that the army of Egypt will give us!’ So, you will try to flee. You said, ‘We will escape from the army of Assyria by riding on swift horses!’ But those who pursue you will also ride swiftly.

lun_bawang: Kudeng muyuh umai ratnan dalan amé selipa idi selipa, muyuh miak ninger arodNeh pa puet muyuh kebalaNeh, "Ini dalan, do' maya' ineh.”
english: And you will hear him speak to you to guide you. Right behind you he will say, “This is the road on which you should walk; walk on this road!”

lun_bawang: Muyuh nala' akang muyuh luk kikep ku pirak idi amas, mepad kudeng nala' arap, kebala muyuh, "Buro muyuh!”
english: When that happens, you will destroy all your idols that are covered with silver or gold. You will throw them away like you throw away a filthy rag, and you will say to them, “We do not need you any more!”

lun_bawang: Asur miak uen ngusag bang bunu', iamo' baken ngaceku tueh lemulun. Lun Asur miak buro rat bang bunu', idi anak adi'deh miak tebanen.
english: Many of the Assyrian soldiers will be killed, but not by swords that men use. They will be destroyed by the sword of God; and those who are not killed will ◄panic/be very afraid► and flee. And some of them will be captured and forced to become slaves.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan kuan amung pupu, "Nekini Ui tumui idi ngegala' laludKu.
english: Yahweh says, “Now I will begin to show that I am very powerful DOU.

lun_bawang: Seburur pana' nateh luk pebala, "Ui mét," idi tau ngalap do' ratnan amung- amung sala'.
english: And the people in Jerusalem will no longer say, “We are sick,” because Yahweh will forgive the sins that have been committed by the people who live there.

lun_bawang: Mada' lemulun luk merapang, kebalamu, "Do' muyuh metueh idi aleg matot! Allah miak muit nemuyuh, idi teh Ieh ngua' bunu' muyuh.”
english: Say to those who are afraid, “Be strong and do not be afraid, because our God is going to come to get revenge on his enemies; he will ◄pay them back/punish them► for what they have done, and he will rescue you.”

lun_bawang: Idi inan aceh dalan su ineh, luk titen, "Dalan Macing Inan Luk Meligan." Lun mesala' na tu-tu miak maya' dalan ini; idi lun luk mebacé na nalan su ineh.
english: And there will be a highway through that land; it will be called ‘the Holy Highway’. People who are not acceptable to God will not walk on that road; it will be only for those who conduct their lives as God wants them to; foolish people will become lost while walking on that road.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun rayeh raca' Asur, "Mada' Hesekia, 'Kudeng ini bala raca' Asur luk rayeh: Ngudehké iko pelaba kuu''
english: Then one of Sennacherib’s important officials told them to take this message to Hezekiah: This is what the King of Assyria, the great king, says: “What are you trusting in to rescue you?

lun_bawang: Miakké ui amé' ngerieng idi ngusag bawang ini dengan na pedengan ratnan Tuhan? Tuhan sebuleng nengecuk negku ngerieng idi ngusag bawang muyuh.' “
english: Furthermore, do not think that RHQ we have come here to attack and destroy this land without Yahweh’s orders! It is Yahweh himself who told us to come here and destroy this land!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Eliakim, Sebna, idi Yoa nelun rayeh ineh, "Do' pebala nekai dengan buri' Arami. Kai kali' ineh. Aleg pebala dengan buri' Iberani pedingeren lun mula' luk luun libung batu ineh.”
english: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to the official from Assyria, “Please speak to us in your Aramaic language, because we understand it. Do not speak to us in our Hebrew language, because the people who are standing on the wall will understand it and become frightened.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh netuped ngitang dengan buri' Iberani, "Ninger luk belén raca' Asur nemuyuh.
english: Then the official stood up and shouted in the Hebrew language to the people sitting on the wall. He said, “Listen to this message from the great king, the King of Assyria!

lun_bawang: Idi aleg muyuh duken Hesekia merapet nan Tuhan, pad muyuh ngerawé Tuhan miak ngulun nemuyuh, idi na Ieh nima' baweh Asur ngalap bawang muyuh.
english: Do not allow him to persuade you to trust in Yahweh, saying that Yahweh will rescue you, and that the army of the King of Assyria will never capture this city!’

lun_bawang: Aleg muyuh uen Hesekia ngeraruh, pad muyuh ngerawé Tuhan miak muit nemuyuh. Pangehké allah pupu bakén nemuit bawangdeh ratnan raca' Asur?
english: Do not allow Hezekiah to mislead you by saying, “Yahweh will rescue us.” The gods that people of other nations worship have never RHQ rescued any of them from the power MTY of the King of Assyria!

lun_bawang: Lun mula' ineh pirud maya' kudeng luk icuk Hesekia. Idi na ideh nengor balaneh.
english: But the people who were listening were silent. No one said anything, because King Hezekiah had commanded, “When the official from Assyria talks to you, do not answer him.”

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh ni Yesaya, "Kudeng ini bala Hesekia, 'Aco sini, ieh ineh aco dereh; tau bida' idi inigu'. Tau mepad kudeng decur luk malé nenganak, iamo' ieh pelaba laya' pad anak na mebpeh.
english: He said to them, “Tell this to Isaiah: ‘King Hezekiah says that this is a day when we are greatly distressed. Other nations are causing us to be insulted and disgraced. We are like SIM a woman who is about to give birth to a baby, but she does not have the strength that she needs to do it.

lun_bawang: idi ieh nengelubed bala ineh: "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan: Aleg muyuh megagau ku bala lun Asur luk nengedat Negku.
english: I replied, “Tell the King, ‘This is what Yahweh says: “Those messengers from the King of Assyria have said evil things about me. But do not be disturbed by what they said.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku raca' Asur pangeh neninger bala ratnan Tirhaka, raca' Sudan luk amé' pebunu' neneh. Idi kareb ieh neninger bala ineh, idi ieh nemaré aceh surat kuan Hesekia, kebalaneh,
english: Soon after that, King Sennacherib received a report that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was leading his army to attack them. So before King Sennacherib left Libnah with his army to fight against the army from Ethiopia, he sent other messengers to Hezekiah in Jerusalem with a letter. In the letter he wrote this to Hezekiah:

lun_bawang: "Allah luk inan Hesekia raca' Yahuda merapet, nepejani' na maré Yerusalim bang palad raca' Asur. Iamo' aleg iko saluken ku bala ineh.
english: “Do not allow your god, on whom you are relying, to deceive you by promising you that Jerusalem will not be captured by my army.

lun_bawang: "O Tuhan luk Melalud, Allah lun Israil, luk tudo luun kerusiMu, Iko mo' Allah luk Sebuleng. Idi Iko luk pa luun amung imet bang tana' ini. Iko luk nemudut tana' idi langit.
english: “O Yahweh, Commander of the armies of angels, the God to whom we Israelis belong, you are seated on your throne above the statues of the creatures with wings, above the Sacred Chest. Only you are truly God. You rule all the kingdoms on this earth. You are the one who created everything on the earth and in the sky.

lun_bawang: Idi lun duken Yesaya icukneh nated bala kuan Raca' Hesekia ratnan or Tuhan kuan sembayangneh.
english: Then I sent this message to Hezekiah: “This is what Yahweh, the God to whom we Israelis belong, says: Because you prayed about what King Sennacherib of Assyria said,

lun_bawang: "Naké iko kali', idi Ui pangeh nengeletep amung ini rat mon? Idi nekini Ui pangeh nengacing amung ineh. Ui luk nemaré lalud namu, pad iko nenabpa amung libung bawang luk meraben, pelé bawang ineh mangun ku tuda'-tuda' bubpun batu mo'.
english: But I, Yahweh, reply, “Have you never heard that long ago I determined those things; I planned them long ago, and now I have been causing those things to occur. I planned that your army would destroy cities and cause them to become piles of rubble.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan ratnan raca' Asur ineh: "Na tu-tu ieh miak semuet bang bawang ini, idi ngelatik sebuleng ileb binorneh pana'. Idi na ieh miak ngerieng bawang ini ku utap. Idi na ieh miak nganau' aceh dalan umak amé' luun libung batu ineh.
english: And this is what I, Yahweh, say about the King of Assyria: ‘His armies will not enter Jerusalem; they will not even shoot arrows into it. His soldiers will not march outside the city gates holding their shields, and they will not build high mounds of dirt against the walls of the city to enable them to attack the city.

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh Hesekia mebura' ét lélé maté. Idi Nabi Yesaya Amos iné' neneh, kebalaneh, "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan: Periteteng iko kuan uang tetek ruma'mu, ngaceku iko lélé maté. Ngaceku na ét mini amé' do'.”
english: About that time, Hezekiah became very ill and was close to dying. So I went to see him. And I gave him this message: “This is what Yahweh says: ‘You should tell the people in your palace what you want them to do after you die, because you will not recover from this illness. You are going to die’ ”

lun_bawang: "O Tuhan, do' Iko ngerawé ratnan ui pangeh nenalan pa kiungMu dengan amung do' idi letep niatku. Idi pangeh ui nenganau' luk matu pa kiungMu." Idi ieh pelaba tangi'.
english: “Yahweh, do not forget that I have always served you very faithfully, and I have done things that pleased you!” Then Hezekiah started to cry loudly.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan tepun muyuh Daud: Pangeh Ui neninger sembayangmu. Idi pangeh Ui kali' abpa' matehmu. Idi ui miak ngekadang ulunmu pulu' limeh lak baruh.
english: “Go back to Hezekiah and tell him that this is what I, the God to whom your ancestor King David belonged, say: ‘I have heard what you prayed, and I have seen you crying. So listen: I will enable you to live 15 years more.

lun_bawang: Ui nengerawé kareb ui mulun do', idi ui amé' su luk inan até, idi na mulun macing nan tarekku.
english: I thought to myself, “Is it necessary for me to die and go to the place where the dead people are during this time of my life when I am still strong? Is Yahweh going to rob me of the remaining years that I should live?”

lun_bawang: Ui nengerawé ui na miak nier Tuhan idi lemulun teh, bang tana' su luk inan lemulun tudo.
english: I said, “I will not see Yahweh again in this world where people are alive. I will not see my friends again, or be with others who now are alive in this world.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yesaya, "Do' muyuh ngalap sengapil bua' gita' idi ngerareng ineh luun kimuh raca' pad ieh do'.”
english: I had previously said to Hezekiah’s servants, “Prepare an ointment from mashed figs, and spread it on his boil, and then he will recover.” So they did that, and Hezekiah recovered.

lun_bawang: Idi teh Hesekia pangeh nepebala, "Anunké tanu' luk ngegala' ratnan ui miak umak idi semuet bang ruma' Tuhan teh?"
english: And Hezekiah had previously asked, “What will Yahweh do to prove that I will recover and be able to go to his temple?”

lun_bawang: Idi Nabi Yesaya iné' ni Raca' Hesekia, idi nengitun neneh, "Anun luk bila lun ini? Idi rat iapeh ideh?" Kebala Hesekia, "Ideh nacing rat bawang luk mado, ieh ineh Babil.”
english: Then I went to King Hezekiah and asked him, “Where did those men come from, and what did they want?” He replied, “They came from the far away land of Babylon.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yesaya, "Anun luk sinierdeh bang ruma'mu?" Idi kebala Hesekia, "Ideh pangeh nenier amung luk bang ruma'ku. Sebuleng pana' luk bang amung takepku nateh luk na bida'ku nedeh.”
english: I asked him, “What did they see in your palace?” Hezekiah replied, “They saw everything. I showed them absolutely everything that I own—all my valuable things.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yesaya inan Raca' Hesekia, "Do' iko ninger bala Tuhan luk Melalud:
english: Then I said to Hezekiah, “Listen to this message from the Commander of the armies of angels:

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Hesekia ni Yesaya, "Petulu bala Tuhan luk bilamu ineh, ngaceku inan do' idi awang ruked ulunku."
english: Then Hezekiah replied to me, “That message from Yahweh that you have given to me is good.” He said that because he was thinking, “Even if that happens, there will be peace, and people in this country will be safe during the time that I am alive.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Allah muyuh, "Do' muyuh ngubuk pupuKu!
english: Our God says, “Encourage my people! Encourage them!

lun_bawang: Ngubuk nelun Yerusalim. Do' mada' nedeh, nekini ideh petap dereh, idi Ui maré do' ratnan sala'deh. UkumKu nedeh ngaceku sala'deh pangeh petap.”
english: Speak kindly to the people of Jerusalem; tell them that their suffering is ended, and that I have forgiven them for the sins that they have committed; I SYN have fully punished them for their sins.”

lun_bawang: Inan lemulun luk ngitang, "Nganau' aceh dalan déi' su luk ali-ali kuan Tuhan idi Allah tau!
english: I hear someone who is shouting, “Prepare in the desert a way for Yahweh to come to you; make a smooth road for our God (OR, Prepare yourselves to receive Yahweh when he comes, like people make a straight road for an important official MET).

lun_bawang: Inan lemulun luk ngitang, "Do' mada'!" Kebalaku, "Anunké luk badénku?" "Mada' ratnan lemulun mepad kudeng uduh; idi na mulun mio mepad kudeng busak bunga'.
english: Someone said to me, “Shout!” I replied, “What should I shout?” He replied, “Shout that people are like SIM grass; their influence fades as quickly as flowers in the field.

lun_bawang: Idéké luk miak uen maad dengan Allah luk meligan? Inanké lun baken luk mepad kudeng Ieh?
english: The Holy One asks, “To whom will you compare me? Is anyone equal to me?”

lun_bawang: O Israil, ngudehké iko ngedureng idi ngerawé Tuhan na kali' susa'mu idi na nganau' luk petulu kuanmu?
english: You people of Israel DOU, why do you complain that Yahweh does not see the troubles that you are experiencing? Why do you say that he does not act fairly toward you?

lun_bawang: Kebala Allah, "O bawang luk mado, do' pirud idi ninger balaKu! Do' muyuh temina' pebala bang besara'. Muyuh inan kareb pebala. Do' tau mepamung, pad tau kali' idé luk matu.
english: Yahweh says, “You people who live on APO islands in the ocean, be silent in front of me while I ask you some questions! Then you can be courageous and talk to me. We will meet together and decide which one of us is right.

lun_bawang: Lemulun luk mileh ngakem makai ticu' miak ngedengan idi ngubuk nelun baken.
english: They encourage each other and say to each other, “Be strong!'

lun_bawang: Kebala lun luk ngakem kayuh kuan lun luk tukang amas, 'Do' ineh!' Lun luk nuno akang pad ieh mesalud, ngubuk lemulun luk maku' neneh. Kebala seburur, 'Amut ineh do',' — idi ideh maku' akang su luk inanneh ineh.
english: The craftsmen encourage those who make things from gold, and the men who flatten metal encourage those who hammer metal ◄on an anvil/into shape►. They all say, “The idol has been well made!” And then they carefully nail down the idol in order that it will not topple over!

lun_bawang: "Iamo' iko demulunKu Israil, pupu luk pinili'Ku idi inul rurumKu Ibrahim.
english: Yahweh says, “You people of Israel are like my servants; you are descendants of Jacob, whom I chose; you are descendants of Abraham, who I said is my friend.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O Israil, sagan tu pana' iko isuut idi melaya', aleg iko matot; Ui ngedengan namu. Ui ini Allah Israil luk meligan luk ngulun namu.
english: Although you people of Israel DOU think that you are as insignificant as worms, do not be afraid of your enemies, because I will help you. I am Yahweh, the one who rescues you; I am the Holy One of Israel.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, raca' Israil, "O allah-allah pupu baken, do' ngukab besara' idi mada' terawé muyuh luk tu-tu!
english: I, Yahweh, the true king of Israel say to you nations, “Tell what your idols can do for you!

lun_bawang: Amé' tungé' idi mada' ratnan luk miak mangun. Idi teh ngelio su luk inan besara', ratnan luk pangeh nangun idi kekipedneh.
english: Bring them here to tell us what is going to happen! Ask them to tell us what things happened long ago, in order that we may think about those things, and learn if those things that they predicted really happened. Or, ask them to tell us about the future, in order that we can know what will happen.

lun_bawang: "Ui nemili' seburur lemulun luk tudo pa busat aco; Ui nguit neneh muhu' rat pa busat aco. Ieh ngeradu' raca'-raca' ayu-ayudeh kudeng tana'. Mepad kudeng lun luk mipi' kudeng ngeradu' tana' salit.
english: “But I have incited/urged a ruler who will come with his army from the north. I have summoned him to come from his country, which is east of Israel, and I have given him my authority MTY. I will enable his army to conquer other rulers; they will trample those leaders like SIM a man who makes clay pots first tramples the clay.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ini DemulunKu luk uenKu ngetueh — Lun luk pinili'Ku luk inanKu mawang niat. Ui nemanu' Neneh ku laludKu; Ieh ngacing luk mesiri kuan amung pupu.
english: Yahweh says, “I want you people to know about my servant, whom I encourage. I have chosen him, and I am pleased with him. I have given him my Spirit, and he will make certain that all the people-groups do what is right/just.

lun_bawang: "Ui ini Tuhan, nenawar Namu idi nemaré lalud Namu, pelé ngacing luk mesiri luun tana' ini. Ui maré Namu kudeng aceh pejani' kuan amung lemulun, pad mangun ku acang kuan amung pupu.
english: “I, Yahweh, have chosen you to show people that I always act righteously/fairly. I will grasp your hand and protect you, and I will present you to my Israeli people to be the one who will put into effect my agreement with them. You will be like a light to the other nations.

lun_bawang: "Ui ini mo' Tuhan Allah muyuh. RayehKu na barén kuan allah baken; idi uburKu na miak barén kuan akang.
english: I am Yahweh; that is my name. I will not allow anyone else to receive the honor that only I deserve. And I will not allow idols to be praised like only I should be praised.

lun_bawang: Kebala Allah, "Pelaba io Ui ungeng idi na nengor bala pupuKu. Iamo' nekini Ui ngeruat usehKu. Ui ngarod mepad kudeng decur luk mét nenganak.
english: He will say, “I have remained silent DOU for a long time; I have restrained myself from doing what I need to do. But now, like SIM a woman who is giving birth to a baby, I will cry out and gasp and pant.

lun_bawang: Amung lemulun luk merapet ku akang idi neten akang ineh allahdeh, miak uen ngigu'.”
english: But those who trust in carved idols, and say to images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be completely humiliated/disgraced.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O muyuh lun luk mebengel, do' ninger! idi muyuh lun luk mebuser, nier do'-do'!
english: You Israeli people who have acted toward God like deaf people, listen to what Yahweh says! “You who have been like MET blind people, look!

lun_bawang: O Israil, kebala Tuhan luk nemudut namu, "Aleg matot — Ui matar namu. Ui neneten ngadanmu. Iko Ui kuan.
english: But now, you people of Israel, listen to Yahweh, the one who established your nation. The one who caused you to become a nation DOU says this: “Do not be afraid, because I previously rescued you. I enabled you to have a personal relationship with me MTY, and you belong to me.

lun_bawang: "O lun Israil, muyuh ineh lun nekali' Negku, idi pupu luk pinili'Ku ku demulunKu, pelé muyuh ngiti Negku idi manu Negku, na luk idi atun, idi teh na luk idi muci.
english: But Yahweh says, “You people of Israel ◄are my witnesses/know what I have done►, and you are the ones who serve me. I chose you in order that you would know me, believe in me, and understand that I am the only one who is truly God. There is no other true God. There was no other true God previously, and there will never be another true God.

lun_bawang: Ui nemada' atun ratnan luk miak mangun, idi Ui nengedengan nemuyuh. Allah pupu baken na tu nenganau' kudeng ineh; muyuh ineh lun nekali' Negku.
english: I said that I would rescue your ancestors, and then I rescued them, and I proclaimed that I had done it. No foreign god among you did that! And you are witnesses that only I, Yahweh, am God.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, Allah Israil luk meligan luk ngulun nemuyuh, "Ui ngecuk aceh baweh amé' munu' Babil, pelé Ui ngulun nemuyuh. Ui ngusag amung tanga' bawang, pad arod pupu ineh misu' ku tangi'.
english: Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, is the one who rescues you; and this is what he says: “For your sake, I will send an army to attack Babylon. They will force the people of that city to flee in ships which they have been proud of.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Tuhan, "Aleg muyuh megéi' ngerawé luk nangun bang kareb luk mon.
english: But do not think only about what happened in the past, long ago DOU.

lun_bawang: Ui ini Tuhan luk nemudut namu; rat pun ulunmu, Ui nengedengan namu. Aleg matot, iko ineh demulunKu, idi pupu luk pinili'Ku luk inanKu mawa.
english: Yahweh, the one who created you and helps you, says this: “You dear people of Israel whom I have chosen, you who serve me, do not be afraid.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan luk ngimet idi matar Israil, ieh ineh Tuhan luk Melalud. "Ui ini luk pun-pun, idi Ui ini luk kekiped. Ui sebuleng mo' luk Allah.
english: Yahweh, the King of Israel, the one who saves us, the Commander of the armies of angels, says this: “I am the one who begins everything and who ends everything; there is no other God.

lun_bawang: Sebuang kayuh ineh ruenneh ku apui, ku ngeseb uang pung luk kenenneh, pad ieh mebor. Ieh singidu, kebalaneh, "Pelaba do' lau'! Do' apui ini!”
english: He burns part of the wood of the tree to cook his meat and eats the meat and his stomach becomes full, and he burns part of the wood to warm his body, and he says, “I feel warm while I am watching the flames in the fire.”

lun_bawang: Kayuh luk ketecan ineh ruenneh ku aceh akang inanneh tekeradung idi sembayang. Kesembayangneh, "Iko ineh allahku. Do' ngulun negku!”
english: Then he takes the rest of the wood and makes an idol which is his god. He bows down to it and worships it, and prays to it and says, “You are my god, so save me!”

lun_bawang: Lun mebacé luk sinaluk ineh kuman abuh; idi na miak muit bururneh dengan pebala, "Akang luk bang paladku mebalih mo'.”
english: They are very stupid to worship something that if you burn it, it becomes ashes! They trust in something that cannot save them; they do not admit, “In my hand I hold something that is not really a god! RHQ”

lun_bawang: "Ui ini Tuhan luk nemudut idi nenguli' namu. Ui ini Tuhan luk nemudut luk amung-amung, Ui ini mo' luk nemalad langit. Kareb Ui nemudut tana' ini na lun nengedengan Negku.
english: Yahweh, who saved you and created you, says this: “I am Yahweh, the one who created everything. I am the only one who stretched out the sky. There was RHQ no one who ◄was with/helped► me when I created the earth.

lun_bawang: "Ui sebuleng nganau' dalan kuanmu, idi ngeraked pegkung idi surud pana'. Ui miak ngusag amung tanga' tekaling idi mutul palin belawandeh.
english: This is what Yahweh says to him: “Cyrus, I will go ahead of you and level the mountains. I will smash down bronze gates and cut through iron bars.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah Israil luk meligan, luk ngeletep luk mangun muci. "Muyuh na miak ngitun Negku ratnan anakKu, idi mada' luk petulu ruenKu!
english: Yahweh, the Holy One of the Israeli people, the one who created Israel, says this to them: “◄Why do you ask questions about what I do for you, my children?/You should not ask questions about what I do for you, my children.► RHQ ◄Why do you tell me about the work that I should do?/You should not tell me about the work that I should do.► RHQ

lun_bawang: Tuhan nemudut amung langit — Ieh sebuleng mo' luk Allah! Ieh nenganau' tana' ini pad ieh meraben! Na Ieh nemudut ineh ku su luk ali-ali, iamo' ku su luk inan lemulun tudo. Ieh ineh luk pebala, "Ui ini Tuhan, idi na Allah baken rat Negku.
english: Yahweh is God; he is the one who created the sky and created and formed the earth. He did not want it to remain with nothing living on it; he wanted people to live on it. He says, “I am Yahweh; there is no other God.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O amung pupu, do' muyuh mepamung, amung lun luk ketecan kareb imet Babil inusag. Do' muyuh amé' besara'! Lemulun luk pekarur dengan akang kayuhdeh, idi luk sembayang inan akang luk na ngulun nedeh, na kali' anun-anun!
english: You people who are still alive after experiencing great disasters, should come and gather together and listen to this: The people who carry around their wooden idols and pray to them are foolish, because those idols cannot rescue them!

lun_bawang: "O Amung pupu luk aput-aput tana', do' lumi amé' Negku idi ngalap ulun! Ui ini mo' luk Allah.
english: Everyone in the world should ask me to save them, because I am the only God who can do that; there is no other one.

lun_bawang: "O inul Yakub, pupuKu luk ketecan, do' ninger balaKu. Ui nengasa' nemuyuh rat pun muyuh tinganak.
english: Yahweh says, “You descendants of Jacob who were exiled, I am not like the gods of Babylonia that must be carried; instead, it is as though I have carried you since you first became a nation MET. I carried you even before you became a nation.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Idéké miak uen maad denganKu? Inanké lun baken luk mepad kudeng Ui?”
english: There is certainly RHQ no one to whom I can be compared. There is RHQ no one who is equal to me DOU.

lun_bawang: "O muyuh lun mesala', ngerawé bala ini, ngerawé ratnan luk inau'Ku.
english: You people of Judah, do not forget this; keep thinking about it, you sinful people!

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O Babil, temurun ratnan kerusimu, idi tudo luun abuh. Atun iko mepad kudeng anak adi' decur, aceh bawang luk na linaya'! Idi nekini na iko do' taga idi lun do', iamo' iko demulun mo'.
english: Yahweh also says, “You people of Babylon, you should go and sit in the dust/dirt to show that you are mourning, because your time to rule MTY other countries is almost ended. People will never again say that Babylonia is beautiful like a very attractive/beautiful young woman.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan kuan Babil, "Tudo bang dacem idi ungeng; na ideh neten namu Raca' decur amung pupu teh
english: Yahweh says, “You people of Babylon, sit silently in the darkness, because people will never again say that your city is like MET a queen that rules many kingdoms.

lun_bawang: Kian, kudeng iko makai bangunmu idi lapadmu, luk inanmu pekalai rat isuut, miak iko denganin ineh lek, pad iko ngatot amung bunu'mu.
english: So you can continue to perform all your magic spells IRO! You can perform the many kinds of sorcery that you have practiced for many years! Perhaps doing those things will enable you to be successful; perhaps you will be able to cause your enemies to be afraid of you!

lun_bawang: "Amung luk bilaKu atun pangeh nangun; iko na miak na mala luk bilakU matu. Nekini Ui mada' namu ratnan luk mangun mebaruh, ieh ineh luk na ginala'Ku atun.
english: You have heard those things that I predicted and now you have seen that they have all occurred, so why do you not admit it RHQ? Now I will tell you new things, things that you have not known previously.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O Israil, pupu luk pinili'Ku, do' ninger balaKu, Ui ini mo' luk Allah, luk pun-pun idi luk kekiped teh!
english: “You descendants MTY of Jacob, you people of Israel whom I have chosen, listen to me! Only I am God; I am the one who begins everything and who causes everything to end.

lun_bawang: "O lun muyuh, do' mepamung idi ninger! Sebuleng akang pana' nateh luk miak mada' atun, ratnan lun luk pinili'Ku ngerieng Babil; lemulun ineh miak nganau' luk pianKu.
english: All of you, gather together and listen to me. None of your idols has RHQ told this to you: I, Yahweh, have chosen Cyrus to assist me, and he will do to Babylon what I want him to do, and his army will get rid of the army of Babylonia.

lun_bawang: "Do' amé' Negku idi ninger balaKu. Rat pun-pun Ui nemada' nemuyuh dengan megala', idi megéi nengacing balaKu ineh." (Idi nekini ui ini, Yesaya, duken Tuhan Allah idi RohNeh.)
english: Come close to me and listen to what I say. Long ago MTY I told you plainly/clearly LIT what would happen, and when those things occurred, I was causing them to happen.” And now Yahweh the Lord and his Spirit have sent me to give you a message.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah Israil luk meligan luk ngulun nemuyuh, "Ui ini Tuhan Allah muyuh luk mada' luk do' kuan muyuh, idi luk nguyut nemuyuh maya' dalan luk petulu.
english: This is what Yahweh, the one who saves you, the Holy God of us Israelis, says: “I am Yahweh, your God; I teach you what is important for you to know; I direct you and lead you to the roads that you should walk on MET.

lun_bawang: Remuat rat Babil! Buro rat nelun Kasdim! Do' ngitang mada' bala iapeh- iapeh dengan mawang niat: "Tuhan pangeh nengulun demulunNeh Israil!”
english: However, now I tell you, leave Babylon! Flee from being slaves of the people of Babylonia! Proclaim this message joyfully; send it to the most remote/distant places on the earth: Yahweh freed the people of Israel from being slaves in Egypt.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Na luk idi awang kuan lemulun luk mesala'."
english: “But things will not go well like that for wicked people,” says Yahweh.

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh Negku, "O Israil, Iko ineh DemulunKu. Ui miak buren lemulun ngaceku Iko.”
english: He said to me, “You will serve my Israeli people, and you will cause people to honor me.”

lun_bawang: KebalaKu, "Ui pangeh nengakem mo'-mo', Ui nengabud tuehKu, iamo' na bua'neh." Iamo' Ui merapet inan Tuhan nuneb kekamen ineh; idi Ieh miak ngua' kuanKu
english: I replied, “My work has been useless; I have used my strength, but I have accomplished nothing worthwhile; everything that I have done has been ◄in vain/useless►. However, Yahweh can honor me as he pleases; my God is the one who will reward me as I deserve.”

lun_bawang: Ui pebala kuan lun luk tiban, 'Do' muyuh mepuit!' Idi kuan lun luk tudo bang dacem, 'Do' semuet bang acang!' Kareb ineh ideh mepad kudeng dumba bang laman;
english: I will say to those who were captured and ◄exiled/taken to Babylonia►, ‘Leave Babylonia and return to your own country!’ And I will say to those who are in dark prisons, ‘Come out into the light!’ When that happens, they will again be like MET sheep that eat grass in green pastures, on hills where previously there was no grass.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala lun Yerusalim, "Tuhan pangeh nenecan netau! Ieh nekelupan netau.”
english: The people of Jerusalem say, “Yahweh has abandoned us; he has forgotten about us.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan nedeh, "Miakké decur mekelupan anakneh, idi megateh inan anak luk tinganakneh? Sagan pana' decur mekelupan anakneh, Ui na tu mekelupan nemuyuh.
english: But Yahweh replies, “That is not true! ◄Can a woman forget the infant that she is nursing?/A woman certainly cannot forget the infant that she is nursing!► RHQ ◄Can she stop being kind to the child to whom she has given birth?/She certainly cannot stop being kind to the child to whom she has given birth!► RHQ But even if a woman would do that, I will not forget you!

lun_bawang: "Bawangmu inusag atun idi dat ali — iamo' nekini ieh pelaba isuut kuan lemulun luk amé' tudo su ineh! Idi lemulun luk nengusag namu miak lapen amé' mado rat namu.
english: Your land has been ruined and caused to become desolate/abandoned DOU, but some day it will be filled with people, and those who conquered you will be far away.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah kuan pupuNeh, "Ui nateg tawak nawar amung pupu, pelé ideh nguit anak-anakmu muli'.
english: This is what Yahweh our God says: “Watch! It is as though I will lift up my hand to signal to those who are not Israelis. And they will carry your little sons and daughters on their shoulders and bring them back to you.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Amung ineh miak mangun. Lun luk tiban lun pebunu' miak lapen rat neneh, idi binaweh luk inaro lun luk mesangit miak tebanen rat neneh. Ui miak munu' lemulun luk munu' namu, idi Ui miak muit anak- anakmu.
english: But Yahweh says this: “Some day, those who have been captured will be freed, and the valuable things that ◄tyrants/cruel men► have snatched from others will be returned, because I will fight against those who fight against you, and I will rescue your children.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O muyuh luk amé' Negku luk pian mutuh pedengan, pad muyuh uen ngulun, do' ninger balaKu. Do' ngerawé batu su luk inan muyuh kinuer, idi lubang luk inan muyuh ilap.
english: Yahweh says, “You people who desire to act righteously/justly, who want to do what I want you to do, listen to me! Think about Abraham! It is as though MET he was a huge rock cliff; and when you people of Israel became a nation, it was as though MET you were cut from that rock DOU.

lun_bawang: "O pupuKu, do' ninger balaKu. Ui maré bada'Ku kuan amung pupu. UkumKu ngacing acang kuandeh.
english: My people of Judah, listen carefully DOU to me, because I want you to proclaim my laws; the just/right things that I do will be like MET a light for the people of the nations.

lun_bawang: "O muyuh luk kali' luk matu idi luk ngerawé bada'Ku, do' ninger balaKu. Aleg matot kareb lemulun ngedat idi situnga nemuyuh.
english: You people who know what things are right to do, and who know in your inner beings what is written in my laws, listen to me! Do not be afraid of people who taunt/insult you; do not be disturbed/upset when people revile you,

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ui ini luk ngetueh nemuyuh. Ngudehké iko matot ku lemulun luk maté, luk mekamu' ulun mepad kudeng uduh?
english: Yahweh says, “I am the one who encourages you. So ◄why are you/you should not be► RHQ afraid of humans who will wither and disappear like MET grass.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan inan pupuNeh, "Na muyuh bilih ku usin: iamo' muyuh nangun ku demulun. Na usin barén ku nguli' nemuyuh, iamo' muyuh miak puatin.
english: because this is what Yahweh says: “When you were taken to Babylonia, no one paid me for doing that. So now I will bring you back without being required to pay for you!”

lun_bawang: Mon muyuh tudo déi' Masir mepad kudeng sakai. Muci ratnan ineh muyuh tiban Asur dengan na belih.
english: Yahweh our Lord also says this: “Long ago, my people went to Egypt to live there. Later they were being ◄oppressed/treated cruelly► by the soldiers of Assyria.

lun_bawang: Luk mepad kudeng ineh pangeh mangun déi' Babil nekini; muyuh tiban su ineh dengan na belih. Lemulun luk ngimet nemuyuh medita' niat idi megéi' situnga Negku.
english: But now think about what is happening: My people are being forced to be slaves again, this time by the people of Babylonia. And those who have conquered them this time have also paid me nothing, and they despise me MTY continually DOU.

lun_bawang: Pelaba do' ayu lemulun luk guta pegkung pian nguit bala luk do', ieh ineh bala awang! Ieh mada' ratnan tuehneh, idi kebalaneh kuan Sion, "Allah muyuh ineh raca'!”
english: It is a wonderful thing when messengers MTY arrive on the mountains/hills, bringing good news, the news about God giving us peace and saving us, the news that the God to whom we Israeli people belong is now ruling/king!

lun_bawang: O Yerusalim, atun iko mepad kudeng decur luk na anak. Iamo' do' iko menani idi ngitang ku awang niat. Nekini iko mula' anak, meluun ratnan decur luk na tican awanneh!
english: Yahweh says, “You people of Jerusalem MET, start to sing! You who are like MET women who have never given birth to children, sing loudly and shout joyfully, because you, who are like MET childless women who have been abandoned by their husbands, will soon have more children than women who have never had any children.

lun_bawang: Do' ngeranat lepo kibungmu! Ngekadang abetneh idi ngeraben abpenneh!
english: Make your tents larger; make them wider, and fasten them firmly with tent pegs.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko matot — iko na miak uen ngigu'teh! Iko miak mekelupan sétmu luk mon, idi susa'mu kareb iko tinula'.
english: Do not be afraid; you will no longer be ashamed. Previously you were ashamed because your enemies conquered you and caused many of your women to become widows, but soon you will not even remember that.

lun_bawang: "Ui nenecan namu segageh mo'; dengan awa luk matu Ui ngalap namu baruh.
english: I abandoned you people of Jerusalem for a while, but now I am saying, ‘I will take you back.’

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O Yerusalim, bawang luk pidereh idi mesusa', luk na mubuk. Ui mudut tapinmu mebaruh ratnan batu luk meraga.
english: You people of Jerusalem APO,, your enemies acted very violently toward you; it was as though your city was battered by a severe storm, and no one helped you. But now I will cause your city to be rebuilt with stones made of ◄turquoise/valuable stones►, and I will cause the foundations of the city to be made of ◄sapphires/valuable blue stones►.

lun_bawang: "Ui mudut lun luk nuno, luk pingiup apui ku nuno pelapet. Idi teh Ui mudut lun pebunu' luk ngaté lemulun ku pelapet ineh.
english: Think about this: ◄Blacksmiths/Men who make things from metal► fan the coals to make a very hot flame in order to produce weapons that can be used in battles, but I am the one who has produced blacksmiths! And I am also the one who created people who destroy other people and cities.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O muyuh luk meparing, amé' inan abpa! O muyuh luk na usin, melih bera idi kuman! Melih abpa' anggur idi rata sapi' dengan na raga!
english: “All you people who are in exile, listen to me! It is as though MET you are thirsty, so come and get water from me! It is as though you have no money, but you can come and get things from me that are like wine and milk! You can get what you need from me, and you will not need to give me any money for them!

lun_bawang: Ngaceku kebala Tuhan, "TerawéKu idi lawéKu baken ratnan terawé idi lawé muyuh.
english: I, Yahweh, declare that what I think is not the same as what you think, and what I do is very different from what you do.

lun_bawang: Mepad kudeng langit medita' ratnan tana', kudeng ineh teh lawé idi terawéKu meluun dita' ratnan lawé idi terawé muyuh.
english: Just as the sky is far above the earth, what I do is far greater than what you do, and what I think is much greater than what you think.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan inan pupuNeh, "Na mio teh Ui ngulun nemuyuh. Ngaceku ineh do' nganau' luk mesiri idi luk matu.
english: Yahweh says to all the people of Judah, “Do the things that are fair and just, because I will soon come to rescue DOU you.

lun_bawang: Na petulu seburur lun pupu baken luk pian maya' Tuhan pebala, "Tuhan na nima' negku sembayang perapu dengan pupuNeh." Na petulu lemulun luk pinani' pebala, "Ui na miak pamung dengan pupu Allah, ngaceku ui na miak inan anak.”
english: And foreigners who have believed in me should not say, ‘Yahweh will surely not allow me to belong to his people.’ And eunuchs should not say, ‘Because I am unable to have children, I cannot belong to Yahweh; I am like MET a tree that has completely withered.’

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan kuan lemulun ineh, "Kudeng muyuh ngerayeh Negku idi ngerawé Aco luk inan Mudeng, idi maya' pianKu, idi nginita jani'Ku,
english: They should not say that, because I, Yahweh, say this to the eunuchs who obey my laws about the Sabbath, and who choose to do the things that please me, and who obey all the other laws of the agreement that I made with the Israeli people:

lun_bawang: Tuhan Allah luk nenguit pupuNeh Israil luk tiban muli' pangeh nepejani' nguit pupu baken pad perurum nedeh.
english: I, Yahweh, the Lord, the one who will bring back the people of Israel who have been ◄forced to go/exiled► to other countries, say this: 'I will bring from other countries many more people to join those Israelis whom I have brought back.' ”

lun_bawang: Kebala lun mabuk ini, 'Do' tau ngalap abpa' anggur idi ngirup macing mebor! Idi nebpa meluun do' ria' tau ratnan aco sini.' "
english: They say to each other, ‘Come, let’s go and get some wine and other alcoholic/strong drinks, and let’s become drunk! And tomorrow we will enjoy drinking even more!’ ”

lun_bawang: O muyuh luk melutak ku sala', amé' tungé' pad muyuh kumin! Muyuh ineh lun luk pasét idi decur luk mesawa'.
english: Yahweh says, “But you who practice sorcery, come here! You who worship idols MET, listen to me!

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Idéké akang-akang ini luk ngatot nemuyuh, pad muyuh mebalih pa kiungKu idi mekelupan Negku? Ugka'ké muyuh matot Negku ngaceku Ui mio nungeng?
english: Was it because you were afraid of those idols more than you were afraid of me that you lied about what you were doing, and you do not even think about DOU, RHQ me? Was it because I did not punish you for a long time that you are not afraid of me RHQ?

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Nima' pupuKu lumi Negku. Nala' amung-amung luk ngesabeng nedeh! Nganau' dalan temina'!
english: Yahweh will say, “Prepare yourselves to receive me, like MET people build and prepare a road for a king to come on. Get rid of the things that are causing you to sin like MET people remove from a road ◄obstacles/things that cause people to stumble►.

lun_bawang: Ui maré awang kuan amung-amungdeh luk muneng idi luk mado'! Ui ngedo' pupuKu.
english: I will enable them to sing songs to praise me. I will restore all my people, those who live near Jerusalem and those who live far away, and I will cause things to go well for them.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Lemulun luk dat na ngalap awang."
english: and I, Yahweh, say that things will never ◄go well/be peaceful► for those who are evil.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ngitang dengan abud tuehmu! Ngegala' amung sala' pupuKu Israil!
english: Yahweh said to me, “Shout loudly! Shout like SIM a loud trumpet! Shout to warn my Israeli people about their sins DOU!

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh, "Ngudehké tau mawa', kudeng Tuhan na pian nier ineh? Ngudehké tau mesusa', kudeng Ieh na ngerawé ineh?" Kebala Tuhan nedeh, "Setuneh, sagan pana' muyuh mawa', muyuh nakap pian muyuh sebuleng, idi ngedereh lun tebarin muyuh.
english: They say, ‘We have ◄fasted/abstained from eating food► to please you, but you did not RHQ notice our doing that. We humbled ourselves, but you did not RHQ pay any attention!’ I will tell you why I did not pay attention. It is because when you fast, you do it only to please yourselves, and you act cruelly toward all your workers.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng ini lawéneh mawa' luk pianKu: Neka kaling dereh idi paga' ukum luk na mesiri; idi muit lemulun luk pidereh.
english: No, that is not the kind of fasting that I desire. What I really want RHQ is for you to free those who have been unjustly put in prison DOU, and to encourage those who are ◄treated cruelly/oppressed►; I want you to free those who have been oppressed in any way.

lun_bawang: Kareb muyuh sembayang Ui ngua' putuh muyuh. Kareb muyuh nawar Negku Ui ngor bala muyuh. "Kudeng muyuh ugka' ngedereh lemulun, idi ugka' ratnan situnga idi dat bala;
english: Then you will call out to me, and I will quickly answer and say that I will help you.’ Stop ◄oppressing people/treating people cruelly►; stop falsely accusing people; and stop saying evil things about people.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan kuan pupuNeh, "Ui amé' ngedengan nemuyuh déi' Yerusalim, pad Ui ngulun amung muyuh luk teketed ratnan sala' muyuh.
english: And Yahweh says that he will come to Jerusalem to free his people; he will come to rescue those in Judah who have quit ◄doing sinful things/their sinful behavior►.

lun_bawang: O Yerusalim, tumui iko, idi merasat mepad kudeng aco. Rayeh Tuhan merasat luunmu!
english: You people of Jerusalem PRS, stand up! Yahweh has done glorious things for you, and he has acted powerfully for you; so show others that he is very great!

lun_bawang: Do' tengook idi nier libut-libut: amung lemulun mepamung amé' namu; anak deléimu macing rat mado; anak decurmu baben mepad kudeng anak.
english: Yahweh says, “Look around and you will see the people who will be returning from ◄exile/countries to which they have been forced to go►! Your sons will come from distant countries; others will carry your little daughters home.

lun_bawang: Anunké kapal ini luk temulud mepad kudeng laput, idi kudeng sukur luk muli'?
english: And what are those things that are moving swiftly like SIM clouds? They resemble SIM doves returning to their nests.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan kuan Yerusalim, "Lun pupu baken miak mudut libungmu baruh; raca'-raca'deh mangun ku demulunmu. Dengan usehKu Ui nengukum namu, iamo' nekini Ui ngegala' katu idi éi'Ku namu.
english: Foreigners will come and rebuild the walls of your cities, and their kings will serve/help you. Although I punished you because I was angry with you, these things will happen now because I will act mercifully toward you because I am kind.

lun_bawang: "Kayuh tongor, aru', idi peribu, luk meluun do' ratnan pulung Lebanon, miak iten, pad mudut namu baruh, O Yerusalim, pelé Ruma'Ku do' ayu, idi bawangKu buren.
english: The glorious/beautiful things in Lebanon will be brought to you— lumber from cypress trees and fir trees and pine trees — to be used to make my temple beautiful. When that is done, my temple MTY will truly be glorious!

lun_bawang: "Atun iko tican idi inan megateh, aceh bawang luk dat ali. Ui nganau' namu buren idi do' ayu, su luk inan awang ruked-ruked.
english: Previously everyone hated you and ignored you, but now your city will be majestic/honored forever; and I will cause you to be joyful forever.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ui mawa ku luk mesiri, idi Ui megateh ku luk ngedereh idi luk dat. Ui lutep ngeperuan pupuKu, pad Ui nganau' jani' luk meruked kuandeh.
english: “I, Yahweh, am very pleased with those/judges who decide matters fairly; I hate those who illegally take things from other people. I will surely repay my people ◄for/because of► all that they have suffered in the past. And I will make an everlasting agreement with them.

lun_bawang: bala Tuhan kuan aput tana'. KebalaNeh, "Mada' pupu Yerusalim ratnan acing Tuhan luk ngulun nemuyuh idi luk nguit denganNeh lemulun luk pinuitNeh!”
english: This is the message that Yahweh has sent to the people of every nation: “Tell the people of Israel, ‘The one who will rescue/save you is coming! Look! He will be bringing to you ◄your reward/what you deserve for the good things that you have done►; those whom he is setting free will be going ahead of him.’ ”

lun_bawang: Muyuh tetanen, "Pupu Allah luk Meligan," idi, "Pupu luk Inulun Tuhan!" Yerusalim miak tetanen, "Bawang luk Inan Allah Mawa," idi "Bawang luk Na Tican Allah."
english: They will be called “Yahweh’s own people, the ones whom he rescued”. And Jerusalem will be known as the city that Yahweh loves, the city that is no longer abandoned.

lun_bawang: "Idéké luk macing rat Bosra luk bang bawang Edom? Idéké luk nengayung ku kibung luk mesia' luk pelaba do', idi luk nalan dengan pelaba tagep?" "Ieh ineh Tuhan luk ngulun dengan laludNeh. Ieh amé' mada' tuehNeh.”
english: I ask, “Who is this who is coming from Bozrah city in Edom, whose clothes are stained red from blood? Who is this who is wearing beautiful robes?” He replies, “It is I, Yahweh, declaring that I have defeated your enemies, and I am able to rescue you!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ideh ineh pupuKu, na ideh naluk Negku." Idi Ieh nemuit nedeh
english: Yahweh said, “These are my people; they will not deceive me;” so he rescued us.

lun_bawang: Iamo' ideh nengerawé ratnan luk nepangeh, kareb Musa, demulun Tuhan ineh, idi kebaladeh, "Iapehké Tuhan ineh luk nengulun lun rayeh pupuNeh ratnan abpa' rayeh? Iapehké Tuhan ineh luk nemaré RohNeh luk Meligan ni Musa?
english: Then we thought about what happened long ago, during the time when Moses led our ancestors out of Egypt. We cried out, “Where is the one who brought our ancestors through the Red Sea while Moses led them? Where is the one who sent his Holy Spirit to be among our ancestors?

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ui netemina' ngua' putuh pupuKu, iamo' na ideh nesembayang. Ui netemina' papu' nedeh, iamo' na ideh nenakap Negku. Pupu ineh na nenawar Negku, sagan pana' Ui megéi' temina' ngua' idi pebala, 'Idi Ui; Ui miak ngedengan nemuyuh.'
english: This is what Yahweh said: “I was ready to reply to my people, but no one requested me to help them. I was ready to help even those who did not call out to me. I continued to say, ‘I am here to help you!’

lun_bawang: "Ui pangeh nemutut ukum kuandeh, idi ukumdeh ineh pangeh inayud. Na Ui mekelupan luk inau'deh, iamo' Ui ngua'
english: I have written a record of all the evil things that they have done. And I will not do nothing about all those things; I will certainly punish them

lun_bawang: sala'deh, idi sala' tepundeh. Ideh nengeseb umau luk do' buen luun surud su luk inandeh sembayang inan allah baken, idi ideh nengedat Negku. Idi Ui ngukum nedeh maya' kekamendeh.”
english: for the sins that they and their ancestors have committed. They have mocked/insulted me by burning incense to their idols on the hilltops. So I will punish them like they deserve for doing those things.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Na lemulun ngusag bua' anggur luk do'; iamo' ideh ngalap abpa'neh. Idi Ui pana' na ngusag pupuKu — Ui ngulun lemulun luk maya'' Negku.
english: This is also what Yahweh said: “When there is a cluster of nice grapes on a vine, people do not throw them away, because they know that there is good juice in those grapes. Similarly, because there are some people in Judah who faithfully serve/worship me, I will not get rid of all of them.

lun_bawang: Iamo' na ieh kudeng ineh kuan muyuh luk necan Negku, idi luk na ngerawé Sion, pegkungKu luk meligan ineh idi luk sembayang inan allah Nasip idi Kapeh Tau' luk titen Gad idi Meni.
english: But it will be different for you who have abandoned me, you who do not worship me on Zion, my sacred hill, you who worship Gad and Meni, the gods who you think will bring you good luck and good fortune.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh kudeng ini bala Tuhan: Lemulun luk sembayang Negku idi maya' balaKu petap akan, iamo' muyuh miak melau idi meparing. Ideh miak mawang niat, iamo' muyuh uen ngigu'.
english: I, Yahweh the Lord, will give to those who worship and obey me things to eat and drink, and they will be happy; but all you evil people will be hungry and thirsty, and you will be sad and disgraced.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ui mudut tana' idi langit luk mebaruh. Amung luk pangeh mangun mon miak mekelupan.
english: “Note this: Some day I will create a new heaven and a new earth. They will be very wonderful, with the result that you will no longer think about all the troubles you had previously.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Langit ineh kerusiKu, idi tana' ineh tapin kukudKu. Kudeng apehké ayu ruma' luk miak piduten muyuh kuanKu, idi su luk inanKu tudo?
english: Yahweh also said this: “All of heaven is like my throne, and the whole earth is like my footstool. So you could certainly not RHQ build a house that would be adequate for me to live in and rest!

lun_bawang: "BawangKu luk meligan mepad kudeng decur luk denak-denak nenganak aceh anak deléi dengan na mét nenganak.
english: No one RHQ ever heard that a woman gave birth to a baby when she was just starting to have birth pains.

lun_bawang: Petuluké Ui ngedengan pupuKu pad macing ideh malé uen nenganak, iamo' na nima' nedeh uen nenganak?" Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: Women certainly do not RHQ bring infants to the time when they are ready to be born and then do not allow them to be born. Similarly, he will do for Jerusalem MET what he has promised to do: He will cause Jerusalem to be full of people again. That will happen because Yahweh has said it.

lun_bawang: O muyuh luk mawa inan bawang Yerusalim, do' muyuh mawang niat idi do' ria' ku ieh! O muyuh luk netemido neneh atun, do' muyuh mawang niat ku ieh!
english: You people in APO Jerusalem, rejoice! And all you people who love Jerusalem should also be happy. You people who were sad because of what happened to Jerusalem, you should now be glad.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Kekiped lun mesala' malé macing, ieh ineh lemulun luk ngeligan bururdeh pad sembayang inan allah baken, idi luk kuman barek idi anak labo dengan akan baken luk dat.
english: Yahweh says, “Some of you people purify/bathe yourselves and then go to a garden to worship your gods. You eat the meat of pigs and lizards and mice, and other things that I have forbidden you to eat. So I will get rid of you for doing that.

lun_bawang: Ui kali' terawédeh idi kekamendeh. Ui amé' ngamung lemulun ratnan anid- anid pupu. Kareb ideh mepamung, ideh miak nier laludKu,
english: I know all the evil things that you think and do. It is now time for me to gather together the people who live in all nations and who speak all languages, and to show them that I am very great.

lun_bawang: "Mepad kudeng tana' luk mebaruh idi langit luk mebaruh meraben ngaceku laludKu, kudeng ineh teh inul muyuh idi ngadan muyuh lutep peh.
english: I also promise that just like the new heaven and the new earth will last forever, you will always have descendants, and you MTY will always be honored.

lun_bawang: "Idi kareb ideh remuat ideh miak kali' butung lemulun luk sikal metueh rat Negku. Uled luk kuman nedeh na miak maté, idi teh apui luk ngeseb nedeh pana' na miak maté. Amung lemulun megileg nier nedeh."
english: Then they will go out of Jerusalem and look at the corpses of those who rebelled against me. The maggots in those corpses will never die, the fire will never stop burning them, and everyone who sees their corpses will detest them.”

lun_bawang: "Kareb nateh Ui nemudut namu ku lemulun, Ui nemili' namu. Idi kareb nateh iko tinganak Ui nengetu namu; Ui nemili' namu mangun ku nabi kuan amung-amung pupu.”
english: “I knew you before I finished forming you in your mother’s womb. Before you were born, I ◄set you apart/chose you► and I appointed you to be my prophet whose messages would be for all nations.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalamu, "O Tuhan Allah, na ui mileh peburi'. Ngaceku ui anak.”
english: I replied, “O, Yahweh my God, I am not qualified to speak for you, because I am very young!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Tuhan negku, "Alegmala namu anak, iamo' do' amé' inan pupu su luk dukenKu namu, idi mada' nedeh ratnan amung-amung luk bilaKu namu.
english: Yahweh replied, “Do not say that, because you must go to everyone to whom I will send you, and you must tell them everything that I tell you to say.

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nenatang ticu'Neh, idi nengakem bibirku, idi kebalaNeh negku, "Do' iko ninger! Nekini Ui maré bala luk badénmu.
english: Then it was as though Yahweh touched my mouth and said, “Listen to me! I am ◄putting my message into your mouth/telling you what you must speak►.

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nengitun negku, kebalaNeh, "Yeremia, anun luk sirenmu?" Kebalaku, "Ui nier angat berangan.”
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I replied, “I see a branch from an almond tree.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan negku, "Matu balamu, idi Ui matar pad balaKu mangun.”
english: Yahweh said, “That is correct. And because the word for ‘almond’ resembles the word for ‘watching’, it means that I am watching what will happen, and I will make certain that what I have said to you about destroying nations will happen.”

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nengitun negku teh, kebalaNeh, "Anun luk sirenmu baken teh?" Kebalaku, "Ui nier aceh lacang meburek pa tinueh busat aco, luk lélé melukeb pa tungé'.”
english: Then Yahweh spoke to me again and said, “What do you see now?” I replied, “I see a pot full of boiling water MTY. It is tipping toward me from the north.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan negku, "Dereh miak macing rat pa tinueh busat aco kuan amung-amung lun luk tudo bang bawang ini,
english: Yahweh replied, “Yes! It means that from the north great trouble/destruction will spread MET over this land, like boiling water MET pouring from a pot.

lun_bawang: Do' iko mekuu' amé' mada' nedeh ratnan amung-amung luk belénKu namu. Aleg iko matot nedeh nekini, pad Ui na maré namu matot nedeh muci, kareb iko idi dengandeh.
english: So, get up and put on your clothes to get ready for action! Then go to the people of Judah and tell them everything that I tell you to say. Do not be afraid of them, because if you are afraid of them, I will cause you to be truly terrified in front of them!

lun_bawang: amé' mada' balaNeh kuan amung lun bang bawang Yerusalim, kebalaNeh, "Ui kali' namu lutep karebmu anak, idi iko mawa Negku kareb kiteh pun paweh. Iko nemaya' Negku déi' su luk ali-ali, su luk na inan lemulun nenganau' lati'.
english: to proclaim to everyone in Jerusalem. He said that I should tell them this MET: “I, Yahweh, remember that you very much wanted to please me long ago. You tried to please me like a bride tries to please her husband; You loved me, and you followed me through the desert DOU.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan: "Anun datKu pad tepun muyuh nenecan Negku? Ideh nesembayang inan akang luk na ulek, pad ideh pana' na ulek teh.
english: listen to what Yahweh says: “◄What sin did I commit RHQ that caused your ancestors to turn far away from me?/Though your ancestors found no fault in me, they turned far away from me.► They worshiped worthless idols, and they themselves became worthless.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan, "Ui sikal nguit pupuKu besara' sekua' baruh teh, idi ngadu' anak inuldeh.
english: “So, I will accuse you in court. In future years, I will say what your children and your grandchildren have done that is wrong. That will happen because I, Yahweh, have said that it will happen.

lun_bawang: Idi Ui ini Tuhan ngecuk langit megegker ku tot, pad ieh megagap idi mawa.
english: It is as though everything in the sky is surprised and dismayed/appalled about what you have done; it is as though they tremble because they are very horrified.

lun_bawang: PupuKu pangeh nenganau' dueh sala': ideh nenecan Negku, ieh ineh aceh bued abpa' luk do'; idi ideh nengukat tuda'-tuda' subuk, luk na inan abpa' mudeng.
english: You, my people, have done two evil things: You have rejected me, the one who is like MET a fountain where you can obtain fresh water, and you are worshiping gods that are like MET pits in the ground that are cracked and which are not able to hold any water.

lun_bawang: O Israil, iko luk nengedat bururmu sebuleng! Ngaceku iko nenecan Negku luk Tuhan Allahmu, karebKu nenguyut namu maya' dalan.
english: But it is RHQ because you abandoned me, Yahweh, that these disasters have happened to you.

lun_bawang: "O lun Israil, rat monneh iko ngelaba balaKu, idi ara' maya' Negku, idi kebalamu, 'Na ui pian mangun ku demulun!' Iamo' iko mepad kudeng decur luk mesawa' luun anid-anid surud luk medita' idi liang anid-anid kayuh luk mebata'.
