english: Long ago, you stopped obeying me MET, and you would not allow me to lead you MET; you refused to worship me. Instead, you worship idols that are under trees on the top of every hill, and your young women have sex with EUP men at those places.

lun_bawang: Ngudeh iko mala namu na nengelutak bururmu, idi na tupu nesembayang inan Baal? Ngerawé sala' luk pangeh inau'mu déi' luun raked. Iko mepad kudeng aceh unta tineh luk ucet nakap deléi,
english: You say that you have not sinned. You say ‘We have not become unacceptable to God; we have not worshiped Baal.’ But think about the disgusting things that you do very eagerly in Hinnom Valley outside Jerusalem. You are like desperate female camels, running here and there to find male camels to have sex with.

lun_bawang: O Israil, aleg nima' kukudmu mét idi telananmu metekering nakap allah baken. Iamo' kebalamu, 'Kapehneh tau'? Ui mawa inan allah baken, idi pian nakap nedeh.' “
english: You constantly run here and there to find idols to worship, with the result that your sandals are worn out, and your throats have become dry. I told you to stop doing that, but you said, ‘We cannot stop, because we love foreign gods, and we must worship them.’ ”

lun_bawang: "Iapehké amung allah luk inau' midi? Kareb iko inan susa', nima' nedeh ngulun namu, kudeng mo' ideh miak! O Yahuda, allahmu mepad kinula' bawangmu.
english: Why do you not RHQ cry out to the gods that you made? You have as many gods as you have cities and towns in Judah. So why do you not plead with them to rescue you when you experience disasters?

lun_bawang: Ui ini Tuhan luk ngitun, anunké luk inan muyuh dat Negku. Amung muyuh pian metueh rat Negku.
english: You complain that it was wrong for me not to have rescued you, but you have all rebelled against me.

lun_bawang: Ui nengukum nemuyuh, iamo' na ulekneh, ngaceku muyuh na pian badén. Muyuh nengaté nabi muyuh, mepad kudeng balang luk mesangit.
english: I punished some of you, but you did not learn anything from my doing that. You have killed many of the prophets that I sent to you, like SIM fierce lions kill other animals.

lun_bawang: Miakké seburur decur luk paweh ngayung ku kuyu' luk dat? Idi miakké seburur anak adi' decur mekelupan banéneh? Iamo' pupuKu megéi' mekelupan Negku.
english: A young woman would certainly never RHQ forget to wear her jewelry, and a bride would never RHQ forget to wear her wedding dress, but you my people have forgotten me for many years.

lun_bawang: 'Ui na mesala'; kali' rungen Tuhan na museh negku.' Iamo' Ui ini Tuhan miak ngukum namu, ngaceku iko mala namu na mesala'.
english: you say ‘We have not done anything that is wrong; so surely Yahweh is not angry with us.’ But I will punish MTY you severely for saying ‘We have not sinned.’

lun_bawang: Idi teh iko mala Negku na museh namu ruked-ruked! O Israil, sagan pana' balamu kudeng ineh iamo' iko pangeh nenganau' luk pelaba dat.”
english: So surely you will not RHQ be angry with me forever!’ But you will not quit sinning!”

lun_bawang: Kareb imet Raca' Yosia, idi Tuhan nepebala negku, kebalaNeh, "Yeremia, pangeh iko nenier luk inau' Israil, decur luk na lutep ineh? Ieh iné' inan anid- anid pegkung, idi iné' liang anid-anid kayuh luk mebata' idi pasét.
english: One day when Josiah was the king of Judah, Yahweh said to me, “Have you seen what the people of Israel have done? They have turned away from me, like a woman who has abandoned her husband and sleeps with other men. They have gone up on every hilltop and under every big tree and worshiped idols there MET.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan negku, "Sagan pana' Israil neteketed rat Negku, ieh meluun do' rat ni Yahuda luk na lutep.”
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “The people of Israel have turned away from me, but what the people of Judah have done is worse.

lun_bawang: " 'O pupu luk na lutep, do' muyuh lemubed amé' Negku, ngaceku Ui ini Tuhan muyuh. Ui miak ngalap seburur muyuh rat anid bawang, idi dueh burur ratnan anid pupu, idi Ui miak nguit nemuyuh lemubed amé' Pegkung Sion.
english: But you belong to me. So I will take you, one from each city and two from each clan, and bring you back to Jerusalem from the countries to which you were exiled.

lun_bawang: Iamo' iko mepad kudeng decur luk na lutep inan awanneh, kudeng ineh teh iko na lutep Negku. Ui ini Tuhan luk pebala namu.”
english: But you have abandoned me like wives who have abandoned their husbands.’ ” That is what Yahweh said, and I told it to the people of Israel.

lun_bawang: O amung muyuh luk nenecan Tuhan, do' muyuh lemubed amé' matun Neneh. Ieh miak ngedo' nemuyuh, idi nganau' nemuyuh lutep. Kebala muyuh, "Mo, kai amé' inan Tuhan, ngaceku Ieh ineh Tuhan Allah kai.
english: Yahweh will say to them, “You Israeli people, come back to me! If you do that, I will cause you to never turn away from me again.” The people will reply, “We are returning to you, because you are Yahweh, our God.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O lun Israil, kudeng muyuh lemubed ratnan Baal, do' amé' Negku, idi nala' amung akang luk inanKu megateh, idi lutep maya' Negku,
english: Yahweh says, “You Israeli people, come back to me! If you get rid of those detestable idols and do not turn away from me again,

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan kuan lun Yahuda idi lun Yerusalim, "Ngukat tana' luk na inukat muyuh; idi aleg nibu ilung muyuh arang tabpa'.
english: This is what Yahweh says to the people of Jerusalem and the other cities in Judah: “Prepare yourselves to receive my messages like farmers plow up hard ground in order that they can plant seed in it. Just as farmers do not waste good seed by sowing seeds among thorny plants, I do not want to waste my time telling you messages that you are not ready to receive.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Kareb ineh amung raca' idi lun rayeh miak matot; idi lun imam miak megagap, idi amung nabi miak nginawa.”
english: Yahweh said that at the time he punishes you, the King of Judah and all his officials will be very afraid. The priests and the prophets will be terrified.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'ku, "O Tuhan Allah, Iko pangeh nenaluk nelun Yerusalim! KebalaMu, 'Na luk idi bunu' miak macing,' iamo' nekini inan bunu' macing nedeh.”
english: Then I replied, “Yahweh my God, you completely deceived the people by telling them that there would be peace in Jerusalem, but now our enemies PRS are ready to slaughter us with their swords!”

lun_bawang: Muci lun Yerusalim miak ninger bala ratnan aceh bui luk melau' macing rat su luk ali-ali idi ngedereh pupu Tuhan. Bui ineh baken ieh macing malid nedeh mepad kudeng padé.
english: When that happens, Yahweh will say to the people of Jerusalem, “A huge army will come to attack you. They will not be like a gentle breeze that separates wheat from chaff. They will be like a very hot wind that blows in from the desert MET.

lun_bawang: Ideh nengecuk mada' amung pupu idi Yerusalim teh, ratnan bunu' luk macing rat bawang mado. Ideh ineh ngitang ngedat amung bawang Yahuda.
english: Tell this to the people in other nations but also announce it in Jerusalem: Yahweh says, “An army is coming to Jerusalem from far away; they will shout a battle-cry against the cities in Judah.

lun_bawang: O Yahuda, iko luk nengedat bururmu sebuleng, ngaceku lawému idi kekamenmu luk dat. Sala'mu luk nengacing ét ini; idi ieh luk nenebpek niatmu.
english: You will be punished very severely; it will be as though a sword has stabbed your inner beings. But you are causing those things to happen to you because of the evil things that you have done.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "PupuKu mebacé! Na ideh miti Negku. Ideh mepad kudeng anak luk dat ileh; idi ideh na mileh kali'. Ideh mileh tu-tu nganau' luk dat, iamo' na ideh mileh nganau' luk do'.”
english: Yahweh says, “My people are very foolish! They do not have a relationship with me. They are like MET stupid children who do not understand anything. They very cleverly do what is wrong, but they do not know how to do what is good.”

lun_bawang: Idi keterawéku, "Lemulun ini na mileh. Ideh nganau' luk mebacé, idi na kali' luk pian Tuhan.
english: I thought, “We cannot expect these people to act righteously, because they are poor; they do not have any sense. They do not know the way Yahweh wants them to conduct their lives; they do not know what God requires them to do.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ngudeh Ui maré do' ratnan sala pupuKu? Ngaceku amung anakdeh nenecan Negku, idi nepebulung ku allah luk na matu. Ui nemaman pupuKu pad ideh mebor, iamo' ideh pasét idi nakap decur luk mesawa'.
english: Yahweh says, “I cannot RHQ forgive these people; even their children have abandoned me. When they solemnly declare something, they ask their gods to show that what they say is true. I gave my people everything that they needed, but they often went to the shrines of their idols and committed adultery there.

lun_bawang: Petulu Ui ngukum nedeh ngaceku amung ini. Petulu Ui ngua' sala' aceh pupu luk kudeng ineh.
english: ◄Should I not punish them for this RHQ?/I will certainly get revenge on this nation for this!► I will certainly get revenge RHQ on this nation whose people behave like that!

lun_bawang: Ui miak ngecuk bunu'deh nebpeng anggurdeh, iamo' na miak ngaté nedeh amung. Idi Ui ngecuk nedeh nangal angatdeh, ngaceku ineh baken Ui kuan.
english: I will say to your enemies, ‘The people of Judah and Israel are like a vineyard. Go along the rows in their vineyards and get rid of most of the people, but do not kill all of them. These people do not belong to me, so get rid of them, like a gardener MET lops/cuts off branches from a vine.

lun_bawang: Pupu Tuhan pangeh nengalum Neneh. Keburi'deh, "Na Ieh sikal ngukum netau. Na tau miak medereh. Na miak inan bunu' idi na tau miak melau.”
english: They have lied about me and said, ‘He will not punish us! He will not cause us to experience disasters! We will not experience wars or famines!

lun_bawang: O lun Israil, Tuhan miak nguit aceh pupu rat mado luk munu' nemuyuh. Ieh ineh aceh pupu luk metueh rat mon, idi muyuh na tupu kali' buri'deh.
english: Listen to this, you people of Israel: I will bring the army of a distant nation to attack you. It is a very powerful nation that has existed for a long time. They speak a language that you do not know and which you will not be able to understand.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Tuhan, "Kareb ineh pana', na Ui sikal ngaté pupuKu amung.
english: But even when those things happen, I will not get rid of all of you.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Do' mada' inul Yakub idi pupu Yahuda:
english: Yahweh said to me, “Proclaim this to the people of Israel and Judah:

lun_bawang: Iamo' muyuh ini metueh niat idi sikal metueh rat Negku, pad muyuh numai idi nenecan Negku.
english: But you people are not like the waves that obey me. You people are very stubborn and rebellious. You have constantly turned away from me.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku sala' idi dat muyuh, idi punneh muyuh pitad ratnan luk do' ini.
english: It is because of the wrong things that you have done, that those good things have not happened; it is because of the sins that you have committed that you have been prevented from receiving those blessings.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' Ui miak ngukum nedeh ngaceku kekamen ini. Ui miak ngua' sala' pupu ini. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: So I will certainly RHQ punish them for doing those things. I will certainly RHQ ◄get revenge on their nation/do to their nation what they deserve►.

lun_bawang: Inan sala' luk pelaba dat bang bawang ini.
english: Very appalling/horrible and terrible DOU things are happening in this country:

lun_bawang: O lun Beniamin, do' muyuh buro pad na maté! Buro rat Yerusalim! Amé' nateg tawak déi' Tekoa, idi mada' nedeh déi' Bait Kerim, ngaceku susa' idi até macing rat pa tinueh busat aco.
english: “You people in Jerusalem who are from the tribe of Benjamin, flee from this city! Blow the trumpets in Tekoa city south of Jerusalem! Send up a smoke signal in Beth-Haccherem town to warn the people of the coming danger! A powerful army will come from the north, and they will cause great destruction.

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "Do' tau temina' ngerieng Yerusalim kareb muned aco. Idi kebaladeh teh, "Ini pangeh nepelaba peh, ngaceku lélé malem aco.
english: The kings will tell their troops, “Get ready for the battle. We should attack them before noontime. But if we arrive there late in the afternoon when the shadows are becoming long,

lun_bawang: Tuhan luk Melalud nengecuk nebpeng amung-amung kayuh, pad tau nganau' aceh dalan luk medita', pelé tau miak semuet bang Yerusalim. KebalaNeh, "Ui pian ngukum bawang ini, ngaceku ieh mepanu' ku sala'.
english: Yahweh, the Commander of the armies of angels in heaven, says this: “I will command those soldiers to cut down the trees outside Jerusalem and to build dirt ramps up to the top of the city walls in order that they can enter the city. This city must be punished because everyone there continually oppresses others.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud negku, "Amung lemulun luk bang bawang Israil miak lapen amung mepad kudeng bua' anggur luk pinureg pad na luk idi ketecan. Ngaceku ineh do' iko ngulun amung luk miak uen ngulun, mepad kudeng lun luk ngasa' anggur ngalap bua'neh.”
english: Yahweh, the Commander of the armies of angels in heaven, also says this: “I will tell your enemies to cause your country to become as desolate SIM as a vineyard from which all the grapes have been completely stripped from the vines. Their soldiers will seize the possessions of those who remain in Israel after the others have been exiled like SIM farmers go to the vines again to pick any grapes that were ◄left/not picked►.”

lun_bawang: Idi amung-amung lun do' idi lun dat pana' nakap usin dengan naluk. Nabi- nabi idi imam pana' nateh mesiri kekamen.
english: Everyone is trying to get money by tricking others, from the most important people to the least important people; even the prophets and the priests are trying to deceive people to get money.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan kuan pupuNeh, "Tuped déi' lisangen dalan idi nier; ngitun dalan luk meruked, ieh ineh dalan luk meluun do'. Maya' dalan ineh, pad muyuh do' udeng." Iamo' keburi'deh, "Na kai pian maya' dalan ineh.”
english: This is also what Yahweh said to the Israeli people: “Stand at the crossroads and look at the people who pass by. Ask them what was the good behavior that their ancestors had long ago. And when they tell you, behave that way. If you do that, you will find rest for your souls.” But you replied, ‘We do not want to do that!’

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh, Ui ini Tuhan miak nganau' pupu ini metebaceng, pad taman idi anak pana' maté, lun rurum idi lun dengandeh teh.”
english: Therefore, I will put obstacles on the roads on which my people will travel. Men and their sons and people’s neighbors and friends will stumble over those obstacles and fall down; everyone will die.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Inan aceh pupu luk macing rat pa tinueh busat aco, ieh ineh rat aceh bawang rayeh luk temina' amé' pebunu'.
english: Yahweh also says this: “You will see a huge army marching towards you from the north. An army of a great nation very far away is preparing to attack you.

lun_bawang: O Yeremia, do' iko nutun pupuKu mepad kudeng muyuh nutun perak pad iko kali' kekamendeh
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Jeremiah, I have caused you to become like MET someone who heats metal very hot to completely burn the impurities. You will examine my people’s behavior.

lun_bawang: Amé' déi' Silo, luk pinili'Ku pun-pun inan muyuh sembayang Negku, idi nier anun luk inau'Ku ngaceku amung dat pupuKu Israil.
english: Long ago I put my Sacred Tent at Shiloh city, to be a place where people would worship me MTY. Think about how I destroyed it because my people, the Israeli people, did many wicked things there.

lun_bawang: Muyuh pangeh nenganau' amung-amung sala' luk pangeh bibpengKu. Sagan pana' Ui megéi' pebala nemuyuh iamo' muyuh ara' ninger, idi kareb Ui nawar nemuyuh, muyuh na sikal ngor balaKu. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: And while you were continually doing those wicked things, I told you about it many times, but you refused to listen. I called out to you, but you refused to answer me.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O Yeremia, aleg iko sembayang kuan pupu ini. Aleg iko mutuh kuandeh, ngaceku Ui na ninger sembayangmu.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Jeremiah, do not pray for these people any longer. Do not cry for them or plead for me to help them, because I will not pay any attention to you.

lun_bawang: Matuké Ui luk uendeh ngedereh? Na, Ui pebala, ideh ngedereh bururdeh sebuleng, idi ngigu' bururdeh sebuleng.
english: But I am not RHQ the one whom they are hurting; they are really RHQ hurting themselves by doing these things for which they should be very ashamed!”

lun_bawang: "O pupuKu, meluun do' muyuh sebuleng kuman baré-baré luk petulu sabpen luun bubpun dengan amung baré luk miak kenen muyuh. Ini luk bilaKu, Tuhan luk Melalud, Allah lun Israil.
english: Therefore, this is what the Commander of the armies of angels says: “Take away IRO your offerings that you bring to burn completely on your altars and your other sacrifices; don’t give them to me; eat them yourselves!

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku ineh, O Yeremia, iko miak pebala luk bilaKu ini kuandeh; iamo' na ideh pian ninger balamu ineh. Iko miak nawar nedeh, iamo' na ideh pian ngor balamu.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “When you tell all this to my people, they will not listen to you. When you call to them, they will not answer.

lun_bawang: "Pupu Yahuda pangeh nenganau' luk dat. Ideh pangeh nenganau' akangdeh luk inanKu megateh bang ruma'Ku idi nengelutak ruma' ineh. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: Yahweh says this: “The people of Judah have done many things that I say are evil. They have set up their disgusting idols in my temple, causing it to become an unacceptable place to worship me.

lun_bawang: "O Yeremia, Ui ini Tuhan pebala kuan pupuKu: Miakké lemulun mebpeh, idi na tumui teh? Miakké lemulun meraruh, idi na lemubed teh?
english: Yahweh said to me, “Jeremiah, tell the people that this is what I, Yahweh, am saying to them: ‘When people fall down, they get up again, do they not RHQ? When people are going along a road and find out that they are walking on the wrong road, they go back and find the correct road, do they not RHQ?

lun_bawang: Ui pangeh neninger do'-do', iamo' na muyuh pebala' luk matu. Seburur pana' rat arang muyuh nateh nenginuud ngaceku datneh. Seburur pana' nateh nengitun, 'Anun sala'ku?' Anid-anid burur muyuh lutep maya' pianneh sebuleng, mepad kudeng kuda luk upun amé' matun bunu'.
english: I have listened carefully DOU to what they say, but they do not say what they should say. Not one of them is sorry for having sinned. No one says, “I have done RHQ wicked things.” They are sinning and doing what they want to as fast as SIM a horse that is running into a battle.

lun_bawang: Kudeng apehké muyuh pebala, 'Kai mileh, kai inan ukum Tuhan?' Siruh, guru-guru Ukum pangeh nengisu' ukum ineh.
english: Your men who teach you the laws that Moses wrote have been saying false things about those laws. So, why RHQ do they continue saying, “We are very wise because we have the laws of Yahweh”?

lun_bawang: Idi urat pupuKu uendeh ngubat ayu-ayuneh na ieh mebura', kebaladeh, 'Do', do',' iamo' na ieh do'.
english: They act as though the sins of my people are not serious, like MET wounds that do not need to be cleaned and bandaged. They tell the people that everything will go well with them, but that is not true; things will not go well with them.

lun_bawang: "Ui ini Tuhan miak ngaté amung pupuKu. Ideh mepad kudeng anggur luk na kebua', idi gita' pana', idi don-don pana' mekarang. Ngaceku ineh Ui miak ngua' kuandeh maya' kekamendeh.
english: I will allow their enemies to take away the figs and grapes that the people would have harvested from their fields. Their fruit trees will all wither. They will not receive all the blessings that I prepared for them. This will certainly happen because I, Yahweh, have said it.’ ”

lun_bawang: "Ngudeh tau ungeng?" Kebala pupu Allah, "Do' tau miket amé' bawang luk linibung pad maté déi'. Tuhan Allah tau pangeh nemaré ukum maté kuan tau. Ieh pangeh nemaré abpa' luk megalih rupen tau, ngaceku tau nenganau' sala' pa kiungNeh.
english: Then the people will say, “◄Why should we wait here in these small towns?/We should not wait here in these small towns.► RHQ! We should go to the cities that have high walls around them, but even if we do that we will be killed there, because Yahweh our God has decided that we must be destroyed; it is as though MET he has given us a cup of poison to drink, because we sinned against him.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Matar do'-do'! Ui miak maré menipeh arang muyuh, ieh ineh menipeh luk megalih luk na miak inan marot, idi ideh miak nicuk nemuyuh.”
english: Yahweh says, “I will send those enemy soldiers to Judah, and they will be like MET poisonous snakes among you. No one will be able to stop them from attacking you MET; they will attack you like snakes do, and kill you.”

lun_bawang: Idi pupu ineh ngitang, "Pangeh rikan, pangeh ngeranih, iamo' nateh tau nepuit ratnan bunu' tau.”
english: The people say, “The harvest season is finished, the ◄summer/hot season► has ended, and we hoped that we would receive blessings from Yahweh, but he has not rescued us from our enemies.”

lun_bawang: Ideh megéi' mebalih; idi baken luk matu iamo' balih luk ngimet tana' ini. Kebala Tuhan, "PupuKu na ugka' nganau' luk dat, idi na ideh pian maya' Negku.”
english: Yahweh replied to me, “They use their tongues to tell MET lies like people shoot arrows with bows. It is because they tell lies that they have become more powerful in this land, and they do not know me.

lun_bawang: Do' anid burur matar lun rurumneh, ngaceku na miak merapet ku kinanakmu; ngaceku anid kinanakmu naluk kudeng Yakub, idi lun rurum ngedat lun rurumneh.
english: Do not trust your neighbors and even your brothers! They all are as deceitful as Jacob was. They slander each other and tell lies about each other.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh kebala Tuhan luk Meluun Melalud, "Ui pian nutun pupuKu mepad kudeng pirak. PupuKu pangeh nenganau' luk dat — kudanKu teh ideh?
english: Therefore I, the Commander of the armies of angels, say this: Listen carefully to what I say: I will cause my people to experience great afflictions, like a metalworker puts metal in a hot fire MET to completely burn out the impure bits. Because of all the evil things that my people have done, there is absolutely nothing else RHQ that I can do.

lun_bawang: Petuluké Ui ngukum nedeh ngaceku amung ini? Petuluké Ui ngua' sala' aceh pupu luk kudeng ineh? Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.”
english: Should I not punish them for doing that RHQ? Yes, I should certainly ◄get revenge on/give what they deserve to► the people of a nation that does things like that!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ui miak nganau' Yerusalim mangun ku ruma' tican, su luk inan galau tudo. Amung bawang Yahuda miak mangun ku su luk ali-ali idi na lemulun.”
english: Yahweh also says, “I will cause Jerusalem to become a heap of ruins, and only jackals/wolves will live there. I will destroy the towns of Judah, with the result that they will be completely deserted; no one will live there.”

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nengor bala Yeremia, "Amung ini pangeh nangun ngaceku pupuKu na pian maya' bada'Ku. Na ideh maya' Negku, idi na ideh nenganau' luk icukKu nedeh.
english: Yahweh replied, “These things will happen because my people have rejected my laws which I gave to them; they have not obeyed me or my instructions.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh ninger balaKu, Ui ini Tuhan luk Melalud, Allah lun Israil miak maré luk mepét kenen pupuKu, idi abpa' luk megalih pana' rupendeh.
english: So now listen to what I, the Commander of the armies of angels, the God of the Israelis, say: What I will do will be like MET giving these people bitter things to eat and poison to drink:

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud, "Ngerawé! Do' nawar lemulun luk mileh temido, ieh ineh decur luk mileh temido.”
english: This is also what the Commander of the armies of angels says: “Think about what is happening, then summon those women who mourn when someone has died.

lun_bawang: Butung lemulun miak uen ngatad mepad kudeng rimuk luk luun kabun, idi padé luk piranih luk tican luun lati'. Ini luk icuk Tuhan miak belénku.”
english: There will be corpses scattered across the fields like dung; their dead bodies will lie there like SIM grain that has been cut by reapers/farmers, and there will be no one still alive to bury them.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Na petulu lun mileh medita' niat ngaceku ilehneh, idi lun luk metueh ngaceku tuehneh, idi lun luk mula' binaweh ngaceku binawehneh.
english: Yahweh says this: “Wise men should not boast about their being wise, strong men should not boast about their being strong; and rich people should not boast about their being rich.

lun_bawang: -26Kebala Tuhan, "Malé karebneh macing, idi Ui miak ngukum amung lemulun luk sinunat bang bururdeh, iamo' luk na sinunat bang niatdeh: ieh ineh lun Masir, Yahuda, Edom, Amon, Moab, idi amung lun luk tudo déi' su luk ali-ali idi luk kamu' abpuk. Amung pupu ini idi amung pupu Israil nateh sinunat bang niatdeh idi na ideh maya' balaKu."
english: There will be a time when I will punish all those people of Egypt and of the Moab people-group and of the Edom people-group and of the Ammon people-group, all those people who live close to desert areas (OR, who cut their hair short to please their gods) far from Judah, all those people who have changed their bodies by circumcising them MET but who have not changed their inner beings. I will punish the people of Judah also, because they have not changed their inner beings, either.”

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "Aleg nginud kekamen pupu baken, idi aleg muyuh megagap ku tanu' luk siren muyuh déi' langit, mepad kudeng pupu baken.
english: “Do not act like the people of other nations act, and do not be terrified by strange/unusual things that you see in the sky, even though they cause the people of other nations to be terrified.

lun_bawang: ngaceku Tuhan miak nala' nemuyuh rat bang bawang ini nekini. Ieh miak munu' nemuyuh, pad muyuh mabud maté. Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: I will soon throw you out of this land and cause you to experience great troubles, with the result that you will have severe pain (OR, none of you will be left here).”

lun_bawang: Idi lun Yerusalim ngitang, "Pelaba bura' ét kai! Urat kai na miak mepali'. Idi kai nengerawé kai miak tuman ku ini!
english: The people replied, “It is as though we have been badly wounded, and we are very grieved; It is as though we have a very serious illness, and we must endure the pain.

lun_bawang: "Ninger bala pejani' ini. Do' mada' nelun Yahuda idi lun Yerusalim teh, kebalamu,
english: “Listen to the agreement that I made with the ancestors of the people of Jerusalem and the other cities in Judah. Then remind them of that agreement.

lun_bawang: Idi Ui miak maya' jani' luk inau'Ku kuan tepundeh, idi maré kuandeh tana' luk mebaleng luk inandeh tudo nekini." Idi kebala Yeremia, "Mo, Tuhan.”
english: Now tell these people that if they obey me, I will do what I promised to do for their ancestors. I will enable them to continue living in this very fertile IDM land in which they now live.” I replied, “Yahweh, I hope that what you said will happen.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Yeremia, "Amé' iko déi' amung bawang Yahuda idi amung dalan Yerusalim. Idi mada' balaKu su ineh, idi ngecuk nedeh ninger idi maya' bala pejani' ineh.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Go into the streets of Jerusalem and to the other cities in Judah. Proclaim my message to the people. Tell them to listen to the agreement that I made with their ancestors, and to obey it.

lun_bawang: Kareb Ui nenguit tepundeh remuat rat bang bawang Masir, Ui nengecuk nedeh maya' balaKu, idi Ui na ugka' mada' nedeh macing aco sini.
english: When I brought their ancestors out of Egypt, I solemnly pleaded with them many times to obey me, and I am still pleading with them now.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ni Yeremia, "Amung lun Yahuda idi lun Yerusalim sikal metueh rat Negku.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “The people of Jerusalem and the other cities in Judah are rebelling against me.

lun_bawang: O Yeremia, aleg iko sembayang mutuh kuan lemulun ini. Kareb ideh mesusa' idi nawar Negku mutuh pedengan, idi na Ui ninger baladeh.”
english: Jeremiah, do not pray for these people, and do not plead with me to rescue them. If you plead with me, I will not pay attention; and if they cry out to me for help when they are in distress, I will not listen to them.”

lun_bawang: Atun Ui neten nedeh aceh lawa saitun luk mula' don idi mula' bua'. Iamo' nekini Ui miak ngeseb donneh idi mutul angatneh dengan uni luk mepad kudeng lalam.
english: I previously said that they were like an olive tree full of green leaves with a lot of good olives on it, but now I will send their enemies to attack them furiously; it is as though I will break off their branches, and their city will be destroyed by fire.

lun_bawang: Idi Lun Anatot sikal ngaté ni Yeremia, kebaladeh, "Kai miak ngaté namu, kudeng iko na ugka' mada' dengan ngadan Tuhan.”
english: It was the men of my own town, Anathoth, who wanted to kill me, and they told me that they would kill me if I did not stop prophesying what Yahweh told me to say.

lun_bawang: Tuda' ioké tana' ini tekering, idi uduh bang laman mekarang? Amung pung idi suit maté ngaceku dat lemulun luk tudo bang bawang ini, ieh ineh lemulun luk pebala, "Tuhan na miak nier kekamen tau.”
english: This land is RHQ becoming very dry and even the grass is withering. The wild animals and the birds have all died because the people are very wicked. All that has happened because the people have said, “Yahweh does not know what we are doing (OR, what will happen to us)!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O Yeremia, kudeng iko na tuman peribatun dengan lemulun, kudeng apehké iko peribatun dengan kuda? Iko dat udeng bang bawang luk na inan susa', iamo' kudeng apehké iko miak tuman bang pulung tangeb Abpa' Yarden?
english: Then to show me that I needed to be prepared to endure even greater difficulties, Yahweh said to me, “It is as though you have become exhausted from racing against men; so how will you be able to race against horses? If you stumble and fall when you are running on open/bare/smooth ground, what will happen to you when you are running through the thornbushes near the Jordan River?

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ui pangeh nenecan pupuKu, Ui pangeh nenala' pupuKu luk pinili'Ku. Ui pangeh nemaré pupu luk inanKu mawa bang palad bunu'deh.
english: I have abandoned my Israeli people, the people whom I chose to belong to me. I have allowed their enemies to conquer the Israeli people, whom I love.

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nengecuk negku melih abpar ratnan kibung luk do', idi ngayung ku ineh; iamo' Ieh nemebpeng na miak nganau' bang abpa'.
english: One day Yahweh said to me, “Go and buy a linen waistcloth. Put it on, but do not wash it.”

lun_bawang: "Amé' déi' Abpa' Pirat. Nguit abpar luk pikaimu ineh, idi ngapung ineh bang aceh lubang batu.”
english: He said, “Go to the small Perath Stream near Jerusalem and hide your waistcloth in a crevice/hole in the rocks.”

lun_bawang: Muci ratnan ineh, Tuhan nengecuk negku lemubed amé' Abpa' Pirat idi ngalap abpar luk inapung ineh maya' luk icuk Tuhan.
english: A long time later, Yahweh said to me, “Go back to that stream and get the waistcloth that I told you to hide there.”

lun_bawang: "Kudeng ini lawéKu ngukum dita' niat Yahuda idi dita' niat Yerusalim luk pelaba rayeh ineh.
english: “What happened to your waistcloth shows that I will destroy the things that the people of Jerusalem and other places in Judah are very proud of.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O Yeremia, do' mada' nelun Israil, kebalamu, 'Ui ini Tuhan Allah muyuh pebala: "Idi anid-anid rubi miak uen manu' ku abpa' anggur." ' Idi Lun Israil miak pebala namu, kebaladeh, 'Matu anid-anid rubi miak uen manu' ku abpa' anggur,'
english: “So, tell this to them: ‘Yahweh, the God whom you Israeli people worship, says that every leather wineskin should be filled with wine.’ And when you tell that to them, they will reply, ‘◄Of course/Certainly► we know RHQ that all wineskins should be filled with wine!’

lun_bawang: Do' mada' nedeh, kebalamu, 'Ui ini Tuhan miak manu' pupu luk bang bawang ini ku abpa' anggur pad ideh mabuk: do' amung raca' luk inul Daud, lun imam, lun nabi idi lun Yerusalim pana'.
english: And then you must tell them, ‘No, that is not what Yahweh means. What he said means that he will cause this land to be filled with people who are drunk. That will include all of you—the king who sits on the throne that King David previously sat on, the priests and the prophets, and even the common people of Jerusalem.’

lun_bawang: Idi Ui miak mila' nedeh mepad kudeng rubi luk uen ngatuk, do' anak idi lun rayeh pana'. Na Ui mawa idi méi' nedeh pad ideh pitayenKu.' “
english: He is saying, ‘I will cause you to bash each other. Even parents will bash their children. I will not pity you or act mercifully toward you at all; pitying you will not prevent me from getting rid of you.’ ”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Yeremia, "Do' ngecuk raca' idi tinanneh, temurun rat luun kerusideh, ngaceku patadeh luk pelaba do' pangeh nebpeh rat luun uluhdeh.
english: You people of Judah, say to the king and to his mother, “Come down from sitting on your thrones and humbly sit in the dust, because your enemies will soon snatch from your heads your glorious crowns.”

lun_bawang: Kudeng muyuh ngitun anun punneh ini mangun kuan muyuh — idi anun punneh ayung muyuh pangeh dirak pad muyuh inigu' — ieh ineh ngaceku sala' muyuh pelaba dat.
english: You will ask yourselves, “Why is this happening to us?” I will reply that it is because of your many sins. That is why soldiers of the invading armies will lift up the skirts of your women and rape them.

lun_bawang: Tuhan miak matad nemuyuh mepad kudeng padek luk mepalid ku bui déi' su luk ali-ali.
english: Yahweh says, “I will scatter you like chaff that is blown away by the wind from the desert.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ini ukum luk pinututKu kuan muyuh, ngaceku muyuh mekelupan Negku idi merapet inan allah luk mebalih.”
english: That is what is certainly going to happen to you; the things that I have determined will happen to you, because you have forgotten me, and you are trusting in false gods.

lun_bawang: "Yahuda nacung, idi amung-amung bawangneh medereh, idi lun Yahuda telubid luun tana' ngaceku dat niat idi Yerusalim ngitang mutuh pedengan.
english: The people in Judah are very distressed; people are sitting on the ground and mourning; in all of Jerusalem people are crying loudly.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ratnan pupu ini, "Ideh pian buro rat Negku kudeng ini, idi ideh na miak ngimet bururdeh. Ngaceku ineh Ui na mawang niat nedeh. Ui miak ngerawé kekamendeh luk dat idi ngukum nedeh ngaceku sala'deh.”
english: And this is what Yahweh says to those people: “You love to wander away from me; you run MTY from one idol to another. Therefore, now I will no longer accept you, and I will punish you for your sins.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan negku, "Aleg mutuh Negku ngedengan pupu ini.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Do not pray for these people any more.

lun_bawang: Kebalaku, "O Tuhan Allah, Iko kali' amung nabi mada' pupu ini, kebaladeh, 'Na luk idi bunu' idi lau bang bawang tau ngaceku Tuhan pangeh pejani' na inan susa'.' “
english: Then I replied to him, “Yahweh my God, their prophets are telling the people that they will not experience wars MTY or famines. They are telling the people that you will surely allow us to have peace in our land for many years.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O Yeremia, mada' pupu ini ratnan susa'mu, kebalamu, 'Nima' abpa' matehku mebpeh tebaco kedangan, meluun do' ui na ugka' nangi', ngaceku pelaba bura' urat pupuku.
english: So, Jeremiah, tell this to them about yourself: ‘Day and night my eyes are full of tears. I cannot stop crying. I cry for my people, who are very precious to me, as if they were MET my daughters. I cry for them because they have been severely wounded; they have been severely crushed DOU.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan negku, "O Yeremia, sagan pana' Musa idi Semuil tuped ieni, idi mutuh rat Negku, idi Ui na miak méi' kuan pupu ini. Ngecuk nedeh buro rat pa kiungKu.
english: Then Yahweh said this to me: “Even if Moses and Samuel could come back from their graves and and stand in front of me and plead with me for these Israeli people, I would not act mercifully IDM toward these people. I would tell you, ‘Send them away from me. Cause them to leave me!’

lun_bawang: Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nemaré apat ukum luk dat kuandeh; ideh miak pitayen; butungdeh miak tebanen uko'; idi suit pana' miak kuman butung ineh; idi pung luk meliput miak kuman luk ketecan.
english: I will send four things that will get rid of them: I will send enemy soldiers using swords to kill them. I will send wild dogs to drag away their corpses. I will send vultures to eat their corpses. And I will send other wild animals to eat what remains of their corpses.

lun_bawang: Muyuh pangeh nenala' Negku, idi pangeh neteketed rat Negku. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala. Ui nenatang ticu'Ku idi nengaté nemuyuh, ngaceku Ui na tuman ku usehKu.
english: You people have abandoned me; you have continued to walk away from me DOU. So, I will lift up my fist to smash you; I will not act mercifully toward you any longer.

lun_bawang: O Tuhan, kudeng na ui demulunMu luk do', idi kudeng na ui nesembayang kuan bunu'ku kareb ideh medereh idi mesusa' niat, nima' amungdeh ngacing kedimandeh kuanku.
english: But Yahweh replied to me, “Jeremiah, I will take care of you. And at times when your enemies have troubles and disasters, they will come to you and plead for you to help them.”

lun_bawang: Ui muit namu rat bang palad lemulun luk dat, idi ngulun namu ratnan lalud lemulun luk mesangit. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala."
english: Truly, I will keep you safe from those wicked people, I will rescue you when you are seized by cruel people. That will happen because I, Yahweh, have said it.”

lun_bawang: "Aleg iko ngaweh idi ngalap anak bang bawang luk kudeng ini.
english: “Do not get married and have children in this land,

lun_bawang: "Aleg iko umak ruma' lemulun luk temido, idi aleg iko temido seburur lemulun pana'. Ngaceku na Ui maré nedeh do' udeng, idi na Ui méi' idi mawa nedeh.
english: This is also what Yahweh said to me: “Do not go to funerals to mourn or to show those whose relatives have died that you feel sorry for them, because I have stopped protecting them, and I have caused that things will not go well for them. I have stopped faithfully loving them and acting mercifully toward them.

lun_bawang: "Aleg umak ruma' lemulun luk nganau' irau. Aleg perurum kuman idi ngirup dengandeh.
english: And do not go into the houses where people are feasting. Do not eat or drink anything with them.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Idi karebneh miak macing, seburur pana' nateh miak pebulung ku ngadanKu ini, Allah luk mulun luk nenguit pupu Israil remuat rat bang tana' Masir.
english: But there will be a time when people who are solemnly promising to do something will no longer say, ‘I will do this, just as surely as Yahweh lives—the one who brought the Israeli people here from Egypt.’

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku ineh," kebala Tuhan, "nekini Ui miak ngegala' lalud idi tuehKu kuandeh, pad ideh kali' Ui ini Tuhan."
english: Then Yahweh said, “Now I will show my power to the people of Judah; I will show them that I am truly very powerful DOU. Then, finally, they will know that I, Yahweh, am the true God.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O lun Yahuda, sala' muyuh pangeh inayud ku pén belawan. Ieh pangeh inayud luun niat muyuh ku batu intan luk mesilo, idi inarit luun anid lidung bubpun luk inan muyuh maré baré luk sabpen.
english: Yahweh said, “It is as though a list of the sins committed by the people of Judah is engraved with an iron chisel, or engraved using the fine point of a very hard stone, on the altars where they worship idols. And it is as though this list is engraved on their inner beings!

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ui miak ngukum lemulun luk teketed rat Negku, idi luk merapet ku tueh lemulun idi ulun tana' ini.
english: This is also what Yahweh says: “I will curse/condemn those who trust in human beings to help them, those who rely on their own strength and turn away from me.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' Ui ngeperuan lemulun luk merapet Negku.
english: But I am pleased with those who trust in me, Yahweh, and who confidently expect me to take care of them.

lun_bawang: Ui ini Tuhan nutun terawé idi niat lemulun. Ui ngukum anid burur lemulun maya' lawéneh idi luk ruenneh.”
english: But I, Yahweh, search what is in everyone’s inner being, and I examine what they are thinking. I will give all people rewards, what they deserve for what they have done.”

lun_bawang: Kebala lun mula' negku, "Kudeng apehké bala ratnan Tuhan ngukum netau? Do' Ieh ngacing ukum ineh nekini!”
english: People often ridicule me and say, “You tell us messages that you say came from Yahweh, but ◄why have the things that you predicted not happened?/those predictions have not come true!►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan negku, "O Yeremia, amé' tuped munung Tanga' Lemulun, su inan raca'-raca' Yahuda semuet idi remuat, kareb ideh nalan rat Yerusalim, idi do' iko amé' tuped munung amung tanga' Yerusalim luk baken teh.
english: This is what Yahweh said to me: “Go to the city gates in Jerusalem. First go to the gate where the kings of Judah go in and out of the city, and then go to each of the other gates.

lun_bawang: Do' mada' nedeh, kudeng ideh ngerawé ulundeh, aleg ideh mabeh kareb Aco luk inan Mudeng. Aleg ideh mabeh anun-anun maya' tanga' Yerusalim.
english: He says, “Listen to this warning carefully! Stop doing work on ◄Sabbath/our rest► days! Stop carrying loads through these gates on those days!

lun_bawang: "Ngecuk lemulun ini maya' amung balaKu. Aleg ideh mabeh anun-anun maya' tanga' bawang ini kareb Aco luk inan Mudeng, pad Aco luk inan Mudeng mangun ku aco luk meligan kuandeh. Idi na tu-tu ideh ngakem kareb ineh.
english: But I say that if you obey me, and if you do not carry loads through these gates on Sabbath days or do any other work on Sabbath days, and if you dedicate the Sabbath days to me,

lun_bawang: "Amé' ruma' lun luk mileh mipi' kuden, idi Ui miak mada' balaKu namu.”
english: “Go to the shop of the man who makes clay pots. I will give you a message there.”

lun_bawang: "Kali' rungen Ui miak nganau' kuan muyuh lun Israil, mepad kudeng luk inau' lun luk mileh mipi' kuden. Muyuh idi bang paladKu, mepad kudeng tana' kuden luk bang palad lun luk mileh mipi' kuden.
english: “Perhaps the people of Israel think that I cannot do to them like this man who makes pots has done RHQ. But what they think is wrong. I can control what happens to them like this man controls what he does with the clay in his hands.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Do' ngitun amung-amung pupu, Inanké luk kudeng ineh mangun atun? Lun Israil pangeh nenganau' luk pelaba dat!
english: So, this is what Yahweh says: “Ask the people who live in other nations if they have RHQ ever heard of such a thing. My Israeli people, who have been pure like MET virgins, have done a terrible thing!

lun_bawang: Tuhan nengecuk negku amé' melih aceh kuden. Ieh nengecuk negku nguit tuda'-tuda' lun rayeh pupu Israil idi tuda'-tuda' imam luk mengered,
english: This is another message that Yahweh gave to me: “Go and buy a clay jar from a man who makes them. Then take with you some of the elders of the people and leaders of the priests.

lun_bawang: Tuhan nengecuk negku pebala, "O amung raca' Yahuda idi lun Yerusalim, do' ninger luk belénKu, ieh ineh Tuhan luk Melalud, Allah lun Israil. Ui ngacing aceh susa' kuan bawang ini, pad idé-idé luk ninger balaneh miak megagap.
english: Say to them, ‘This message is for you kings of Judah and other people of Jerusalem. Listen to what Yahweh is saying! The Commander of the armies of angels says that he will cause there to be a terrible disaster in Jerusalem. Those who hear about it will be stunned/shocked IDM.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh, muci su ineh na miak tetanen Topet idi Ruan Hinom, iamo' su ineh tetanen Ruan Até.
english: So, beware, because I, Yahweh, say that there will be a time when this garbage dump will no longer be called Topheth or Ben-Hinnom Valley; it will be called Slaughter Valley.

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nengecuk negku mila' kuden ineh pa kiung lemulun luk nemaya' negku,
english: Jeremiah, after you tell that to them, while the people who are with you are watching, smash the jar that you brought.

lun_bawang: Ini luk miak ruenKu kuan bawang ini idi lun luk tudo ieni. Ui miak nganau' neneh mepad kudeng bawang Topet.
english: That is what I will do to this city and to you people who live here. I will cause this city to be desecrated, like King Josiah caused Topheth to be a place that was unfit for people to worship me there.

lun_bawang: Pekak kenebpa, kareb Pasur pangeh neneka kalingneh, idi Yeremia nepebala neneh, "Na Tuhan neneten ngadanmu Pasur. Iamo' ngadan luk pangeh biré Tuhan namu, ieh ineh, 'Inan Luk Katot Iapeh-Iapeh.'
english: The next day, when Pashhur released me, I said to him, “Pashhur, Yahweh is giving you a new name. From now on, your name will be ‘Surrounded by Terror’,

lun_bawang: Kareb ui pebala, ui megéi' ngitang "Susa' idi Até!" O Tuhan, ideh situnga negku kidi-kidi ngaceku ui mada' balaMu.
english: When I tell people your messages, I shout saying, ‘Yahweh is going to cause you to experience violence and destruction!’ So because I tell them those messages from you, they insult me and scoff at me all day long.

lun_bawang: Ngediman nelun luk nengawang niat tamanku, kareb ieh nenguit bala, "Iko inan anak deléi!”
english: And as for that man who brought to my father the news, and caused him to be very happy, by saying “You wife has given birth to a son for you”, I hope/desire that he also will be cursed.

lun_bawang: "Do' iko mutuh Tuhan kuan kai, ngaceku Nebukadnesar, raca' Babil munu' nekai. Kian, Tuhan miak nganau' aceh tanu' luk melalud kuan kai lek, idi ngecuk Nebukadnesar buro.”
english: “The army of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon is attacking Judah. Please speak to Yahweh for us. Ask him if he will help us. Perhaps he will force Nebuchadnezzar’s army to leave by performing a miracle for us, like the miracles he performed previously.”

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nepebala ni Yeremia, idi Yeremia nepebala inan lun luk icuk iné' papu' neneh,
english: I replied to them, “Go back to King Zedekiah. Tell him,

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nengecuk ni Yeremia pebala inan pupu ineh, "Ninger muyuh! Ui ini Tuhan nima' nemuyuh mili' arang dueh dalan ini — aceh dalan luk macing inan ulun, idi aceh dalan luk macing inan até.
english: And tell this to all the people: ‘Yahweh says that you must decide whether you want to die or to remain alive.

lun_bawang: Ui lutep terawé na sikal méi' inan bawang ini, iamo' sikal ngusag neneh. Ieh miak barén kuan raca' Babil, idi ieh miak ngeseb neneh. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: That will happen because I, Yahweh, have decided to cause this city to experience disasters, not to experience something good. The army of the king of Babylon will capture this city and will destroy it completely by fire.’ ”

lun_bawang: -12"O Yeremia, do' ngecuk inul raca' Yahuda, ieh ineh inul Raca' Daud, ninger luk bilaKu ini, luk mangun ku Tuhandeh. 'Do' mutut ukum luk mesiri anid-anid aco. Matar lemulun luk uen naluk, ratnan lemulun luk naluk neneh. Kudeng na, kekamen muyuh luk dat miak ngegio usehKu, pad ieh mulun kudeng apui luk na miak uen ngilep.
english: Yahweh also told me to say this to the family of the king of Judah: “Listen to this message from Yahweh!

lun_bawang: Iko, Yerusalim meluun dita' ratnan amung ruan, mepad kudeng aceh pegkung batu luk uned raked. Iamo' Ui ini Tuhan miak munu' namu. Iko pebala, seburur pana' nateh luk miak munu' namu idi ngelaya' namu.
english: I will fight against you people of Jerusalem, you who live on top of a rocky hill above the valley. I will fight against you people who boast, saying, “No one can attack us and break through our defenses.”

lun_bawang: -2Tuhan nengecuk negku amé' ruma' raca' Yahuda, luk inul Raca' Daud, pad ui ngecuk raca', amung lun rayehneh, idi amung pupu Yerusalim ninger luk belén Tuhan.
english: This is another message that Yahweh gave to me: “Go down to the palace of the king of Judah and say this to him:

lun_bawang: "KebalaKu, Ui ini Tuhan mada' nemuyuh ratnan luk matu idi luk mesiri. Matar lemulun luk uen naluk ratnan lemulun luk naluk neneh. Aleg ngesusa' idi ngedereh nelun sakai, anak maté, idi decur tinula'. Idi aleg ngaté lemulun luk na mesala' bang bawang luk meligan ini.
english: to what Yahweh says: “Act fairly and justly. Do what is right. Help those who have been robbed. Rescue people from those who oppress them. Stop doing evil things. Do not mistreat those who have come here from other countries, and do not mistreat orphans and widows. Stop murdering here in Jerusalem MTY those who ◄are innocent/have not done things that are wrong►.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kudeng muyuh na maya' balaKu, idi Ui sebuleng mulung nemuyuh, idi ruma' muyuh ini miak metabpa. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: But if you refuse to pay attention to those commands, I, Yahweh, solemnly declare, with myself MTY as a witness, that this palace will become a pile of rubble.” ’ ”

lun_bawang: "Ruma' raca' Yahuda pelaba do' taga sirenKu, mepad kudeng tana' Giliad idi Pegkung Lebanon. Iamo' Ui miak ngisu' neneh mangun ku su luk ali-ali, pad na lemulun tudo su ineh.
english: And this is what Yahweh says about the king’s palace: “I like this palace, like I like the forests in the Gilead region and the mountains in Lebanon. But I will cause this palace to become a desert, a place that no one lives in.

lun_bawang: "Muci mula' lun sakai miak lemaba idi ngitun seburur dengan seburur, 'Ngudeh Tuhan nenganau' luk kudeng ini kuan bawang luk rayeh ini?'
english: People from many nations will walk past the ruins of this city and say to each other, “Why did Yahweh destroy this city that was very great?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ratnan Yoahas Yosia, luk nengelibal tamanneh mangun ku raca' Yahuda, "Ieh pangeh nenalan rat ieni idi na miak lemubed teh.
english: Jehoahaz became king after his father, King Josiah, died, but Jehoahaz indeed was captured and taken to Babylonia. And this is what Yahweh says about him: “He also will never return to Judah.

lun_bawang: Mesusa' kuan lemulun luk mudut ruma' idi parungneh maya' dalan luk tekilu' idi mebalih; luk ngecuk nelun denganneh ngakem idi na ieh mayar tabpardeh.
english: And Yahweh said to me, “Terrible things will happen to King Jehoahaz’s brother, King Jehoiakim. He unjustly forced men to build his palace. The rooms on the upper level were built by men who were forced unjustly to do that work; he forced his neighbors to work for nothing; he did not pay them anything.

lun_bawang: Miakké iko mangun ku raca', ngaceku iko inan ruma' ratnan kayuh tumuh luk meluun do' ratnan ruma' dulun? Do' ngerawé tamanmu. Ieh nekuman idi nengirup, idi nenganau' luk matu idi luk mesiri, idi ieh do' udeng peh.
english: But it is certainly not RHQ having a beautiful cedar palace that causes a king to be great! Jehoiakim’s father, Josiah, also had RHQ plenty of things to eat and drink. But Josiah always did things that are right and just, and that is why God blessed him.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan ratnan Yoyakim Yosia, raca' Yahuda, "Seburur pana' nateh luk temido aténeh idi pebala, 'Bulé, Bulé, lun rurumku!' Seburur pana' nateh luk nangi' neneh, idi ngitang, 'O Ama'! O raca'ku!'
english: Therefore, this is what Yahweh says about Jehoiakim, the son of King Josiah: “When he dies, people will not mourn for him. They will not say to each other, ‘It is very sad; we are so sorry!’ The people whom he ruled will not mourn for him, saying, ‘We are sad that our king is dead; we are so sorry that the wonderful things that happened while he was king are ended.’

lun_bawang: O Lun Yerusalim amé' déi' Pegkung Lebanon idi ngitang, amé' tana' Basan idi nangi'. Ngitang rat pegkung-pegkung Moab, ngaceku amung bawang luk inan muyuh perurum pangeh linaya'.
english: You people of Judah, go to the mountains in Lebanon and weep, shout in the mountains of the Bashan region, cry out in the mountains of Moab, because all your friends in those areas have been destroyed.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan kuan Yoyakin Yoyakim, raca' Yahuda, "Ui pebulung ku ngadanKu, Allah luk mulun. Sagan tu pana' iko susing luun bua' ticu'Ku pa tinueh Ui miak ngelengu namu,
english: Yahweh says this: “Jehoiachin, son of King Jehoiakim of Judah, as surely as I am alive, I will punish you. Even if you were the ring on my finger that shows that I am the king, I would pull you off.

lun_bawang: "Lemulun ini kumin na miak inan anak, idi na miak ngalap luk pianneh. Na ieh miak inan inul luk mangun ku raca' mepad kudeng Daud, idi ngimet bawang Yahuda. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala."
english: This is what Yahweh says: “In the record about the kings of Judah, write down that it will be as though this man Jehoiachin had no children, and that he has not been successful during his life, because none of his children/descendants will ever become king to rule over the people of Judah.”

lun_bawang: Pelaba rayeh ukum Tuhan kuan raca'-raca' luk nima' anak itinneh pitayen idi uen ngatad.
english: Yahweh declares, “Terrible things will happen to the leaders MET of my people—those who are like shepherds of the people who are like my sheep—because they have scattered my people and sent them away, and have not taken care of them.

lun_bawang: Ini bala Tuhan Allah lun Israil ratnan raca'-raca' luk pinili' mangun ku lun matar pupuNeh, "Muyuh pangeh nengatad pupuKu idi nengusu nedeh. Idi na muyuh nematar nedeh. Nekini Ui sikal ngukum nemuyuh ngaceku amung- amung dat luk inau' muyuh.
english: So, this is what I, Yahweh, the God whom the Israeli people worship, say to those leaders: ‘Instead of taking care of my people and leading them to places where they are safe, like a shepherd does for his sheep, you have scattered them. So I will punish you for the evil things that you have done.

lun_bawang: Ui miak ngamung pupuKu luk ketecan rat bawang-bawang luk inanKu nengatad nedeh, idi Ui miak nguit nedeh muli'. Idi ideh miak inan mula' anak idi amé'-amé' mula'.
english: But later I will gather those who are still alive, from the countries where I have forced them to go. I will bring them back to their own country, where they will have many children, and their number/population will increase.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Kali' rungen muci Ui miak mili' aceh inul Daud luk matu mangun ku raca'. Raca' ineh mileh ngimet idi miak nganau' luk mesiri idi luk matu aput-aput tana'.
english: Yahweh also says, “Some day I will appoint for you a righteous man who will be a descendant of King David. He will be a king who rules wisely. He will do what is just and right throughout the land.

lun_bawang: "Idi muci," kebala Tuhan, "lemulun na megéi' pebala, 'Allah luk mulun nenguit nelun Israil remuat rat bang bawang Masir.'
english: Yahweh also says that at that time, people who are solemnly promising to do something will no longer say, “I will do it as surely as Yahweh lives, who rescued the Israeli people from Egypt.”

lun_bawang: Bawang ini mepanu' ku lemulun luk na maya' Tuhan. Idi ideh nganau' luk dat, idi na mutut luk mesiri. Idi ngaceku ukum Tuhan amung tana' tekedamut; idi laman-laman tekering.”
english: The land is full of people who commit adultery; and Yahweh has cursed the land. Even the pastures in the desert are all dried up, because the people do what is evil, and the false prophets use their power to do things that are not just/fair.

lun_bawang: Ui pangeh nenier sala' nabi-nabi Samaria. Ideh nepebala dengan ngadan Baal, idi nengeraruh pupuKu lun Israil.
english: Previously I saw that the prophets in Samaria were doing something that was wrong; they were prophesying, saying that Baal gave them the messages that they were proclaiming, and they were deceiving my people.

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku ineh, Ui ini Tuhan luk Melalud pebala ratnan nabi-nabi Yerusalim: Ui miak maré tibu luk mepét kenendeh, idi abpa' luk megalih rupendeh, ngaceku ideh na manu idi nengeperuit luk dat aput-aput tana'.”
english: So, this is what the Commander of the armies of angels says about those false prophets: “I will give those prophets bitter things to eat and poison to drink, because it is because of them that this land is filled with people who do wicked things.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud kuan pupu Yerusalim, "Aleg ninger bala nabi- nabi, ngaceku ideh nguit nemuyuh merapet inan bala luk mo'-mo'. Ideh mada' nemuyuh ratnan luk pangeh tirawédeh sebuleng, idi baken luk bilaKu.
english: This is what the Commander of the armies of angels says: “Do not pay any attention to what those false prophets say to you, because they are just deceiving you. They tell you about visions that they have thought/created only in their own minds, not about visions that I have given them.

lun_bawang: Ideh megéi' ngubuk lemulun luk ara' ninger balaKu, kebaladeh, 'Amung- amung luk do' miak mangun kuan muyuh.' Idi ideh mada' lemulun luk metueh niat, kebaladeh, 'Na tu-tu susa' miak macing nemuyuh.' “
english: They habitually say to those who hate me, ‘Yahweh says that you will have peace.’ And they say to those who stubbornly do what they want to do, ‘Nothing bad will happen to you because of your doing those things.’

lun_bawang: "Ui ini Allah luk idi iapeh-iapeh pana', idi baken bang sebuleng luk inan mo'. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: Yahweh also says, “Am I a God who is only nearby? No, I am a God who is far away, also.

lun_bawang: Seburur pana' nateh luk miak sigapung su luk na kali'Ku. Naké muyuh kali' Ui idi iapeh-iapeh bang langit idi luun tana' pana'?
english: So, no one can hide in some secret place with the result that I cannot see him. I am everywhere, in heaven and on the earth! That is what I, Yahweh, say!

lun_bawang: Ui kali' luk bila nabi-nabi ineh luk mebalih dengan ngadanKu idi luk pebala, 'Tuhan pangeh nemaré balaNeh nekai bang nupi kai.'
english: I have heard those prophets prophesy lies, saying that they are telling people messages from me. They say, ‘Listen to me tell you the dream that God gave me last night! I really had this dream!’

lun_bawang: BalaKu mepad kudeng apui idi mepad kudeng tuno luk mila' batu.
english: It is as though my messages burn like a fire; they strike people’s inner beings like someone strikes a rock with a hammer and smashes it into pieces.

lun_bawang: Ui megateh inan nabi luk mano balaKu ratnan nabi luk baken, pad ideh sebuleng miak mada' bala ineh.
english: Therefore, I, Yahweh say, 'I oppose all those prophets who steal messages from each other and claim that those messages came from me.

lun_bawang: Ui megateh inan nabi luk mada' baladeh sebuleng idi pebala, 'Kudeng ini bala Tuhan.'
english: I oppose those prophets who speak their own messages but claim that those messages came from me.

lun_bawang: "O Yeremia, kareb seburur rat arang pupuKu, idi nabi idi imam pana' ngitun namu, kebaladeh, 'Anunké bala Tuhan?' do' mada' nedeh, kebalamu, 'Bala Tuhan, ieh ineh aceh babeh, idi ieh miak nala' nemuyuh.'
english: Yahweh said to me, “If one of those prophets or priests or one of the other people asks you, ‘What problem has Yahweh told you about now?’, you must reply, ‘You are the problem! And Yahweh says that he will abandon you!’

lun_bawang: -39Idi kudeng ideh pebala, 'Bala Tuhan, ieh ineh aceh babeh,' idi kali' rungen Ui miak ngakem nedeh idi nala' nedeh mado rat Negku, do' ideh idi bawang luk biréKu nedeh idi inan tepundeh pana'. Ngaceku ideh nengeruat bala luk bibpengKu ineh.
english: If he replies, ‘What I told you is a prophecy/message from Yahweh,’ you should say to him, ‘You have continued to say, “I received a prophecy/message from Yahweh” even though I told you to not claim that you have received prophecies/messages from Yahweh.’

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan negku, "O Yeremia, anunké luk sirenmu?" Idi ui nengor balaNeh, kebalaku, "Bua' gita'. Luk do', ieh ineh pelaba do', idi luk dat, ieh ineh pelaba dat, pad ieh na miak kenen.”
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I replied, “I see some figs. Some are very good ones, but some are very bad, with the result that no one would eat them.”

lun_bawang: "Ui ini luk Tuhan Allah lun Israil ngerawé idi pupu luk tiban iné' Babil mepad kudeng bua' gita' luk do' ini, idi Ui miak méi' nedeh.
english: “This is what I, Yahweh, the God whom the Israeli people say that they worship, say: ‘The good figs represent SIM the people of Judah whom I exiled to Babylonia.

lun_bawang: Ideh nengecuk nemuyuh lumi ratnan lawé idi kekamen muyuh luk dat, pad muyuh miak tudo bang bawang luk biré Tuhan nemuyuh idi inan tepun muyuh mangun ku babpat muyuh luk meruked.
english: Each time their message was this: ‘Turn from all your evil behavior MET, from all the evil things that you have continually been doing. If you do that, you will be able to stay in this land that Yahweh gave to you and to your ancestors, to belong to you forever.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Tuhan, 'Muyuh na sikal ninger balaKu. Iamo' muyuh nganau' Negku museh ngaceku akang muyuh. Idi muyuh pangeh nengacing ukumKu kuan burur muyuh sebuleng.'
english: And Yahweh says, ‘But you would not pay attention to the messages that I gave to those prophets. You caused me to become extremely angry by your worshiping idols that you had made with your own hands. That resulted in my punishing you.

lun_bawang: "Idi ngaceku muyuh na neninger balaNeh, kebala Tuhan luk Melalud,
english: So now, I, the Commander of the armies of angels, say that because you have not paid attention to what I said,

lun_bawang: Muci ratnan ineh Ui miak ngukum raca' Babil idi anak itinneh ngaceku sala'deh. Ui miak ngusag bawangdeh, pad ieh na piduten ruked-ruked.
english: Then, after they have been in Babylonia for seventy years, I will punish the King of Babylonia and his people for the sins that they have committed. I will cause Babylonia to become a wasteland/desert forever.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah lun Israil negku, "Ini aceh sangkir abpa' anggur luk mepanu' ku usehKu. Ui ngecuk namu nguit sangkir ini kuan tuda'-tuda' pupu luk badénKu namu, pad ideh ngirup abpa' ini.
english: Then Yahweh, the God we Israelis worship, gave me a vision. In the vision he was holding a cup of wine. He said, “Take from me this cup that is full of wine that represents punishment MTY. I will cause all the leaders of the nations to which I will send you to drink some of the wine in this cup.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan negku, "Do' mada' pupu ini, kebalamu, 'Ui ini Tuhan luk Melalud, Allah lun Israil ngecuk nemuyuh ngirup pad muyuh mabuk idi kuta', pelé muyuh mebpeh idi na miak tumui ngaceku bunu' luk uenKu ngacing kuan muyuh.'
english: Then in the vision Yahweh said to me, “Tell them that this is what the Commander of the armies of angels, the God whom we Israelis worship, says: ‘Drink from this cup some of the wine that represents the punishment that I will give you. Drink a lot of it and become drunk and vomit. You will fall down and not get up again, because I will cause you to be killed in wars MTY that I will send to you.

lun_bawang: Idi kudeng ideh ara' ngalap sangkir rat bang paladmu, pad ideh miak ngirup abpa' ineh, do' mada' nedeh, kebalamu, Tuhan luk Melalud ngecuk nemuyuh ngirup ineh.
english: If any of those to whom you give this wine MTY refuse to drink it, tell them that the Commander of the armies of angels says that they must drink it.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud, "Dereh miak macing kuan anid-anid pupu, idi aceh barui miak macing rat iring tana'.
english: Then tell them that this is what the Commander of the armies of angels says: ‘Listen to this! There will be disasters in one nation after another. I am preparing to punish them like MET a great storm that starts in the most distant places on the earth.

lun_bawang: idi kebala Tuhan ni Yeremia, "Do' tuped luun natad Ruma' Allah idi mada' amung-amung luk icukKu namu, kuan amung-amung lemulun luk macing rat bawang-bawang Yahuda, pad ideh sembayang déi'. Aleg mekelupan sebila' bala pana'.
english: “This is what I, Yahweh, am telling you: Stand in the courtyard in front of my temple, and speak to all the people from the various towns in Judah who come there to worship me. Tell them everything that I tell you; do not omit anything.

lun_bawang: Tuhan nengecuk ni Yeremia pebala inan pupu ineh, "Ui ini Tuhan ngecuk nemuyuh maya' Negku idi maya' amung bada' luk biréKu nemuyuh.
english: Say to them, ‘This is what Yahweh says: I sent to you the prophets who serve me, to tell you what you should do. I sent them to you many times, but you have not paid attention to what they said. If you will not pay attention to what I say and do not obey the message that I have given to you, and if you do not pay attention to what the prophets say,

lun_bawang: Kareb Yeremia pangeh nemada' amung-amung luk icuk Tuhan neneh, idi amung lun imam idi nabi idi pupu ineh pana' nengakem neneh, idi nengitang, "Na miak na iko pitayen ngaceku balamu ineh!
english: Why RHQ are you prophesying that this temple will be destroyed like Shiloh was destroyed? Why are you saying that this city will be destroyed, and that no one will live here any more? (OR, You should not be prophesying) RHQ” All the people surrounded me as I stood in front of the temple.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala amung lun imam idi nabi kuan lun rayeh idi kuan pupu ineh, "Na miak na lemulun ini pitayen ngaceku ieh nengadu' bawang tau. Muyuh sebuleng pangeh neninger balaneh.”
english: Then I replied to the officials and the other people, saying, “Yahweh sent me to prophesy all the things that you heard me say about what will happen to this temple and this city.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yeremia kuan amung lun rayeh idi pupu ineh pana', "Tuhan nengecuk negku mada' amung-amung bala luk pindenger muyuh ratnan Ruma' idi bawang ini.
english: But if you change your behavior and stop sinning, and start to obey Yahweh our God, he will change his mind, and not cause you to experience the disasters that he said that he would send.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala amung lun rayeh idi pupu ineh kuan lun imam idi nabi, "Lemulun ini na miak pitayen, ngaceku ieh nemada' netau dengan ngadan Tuhan Allah tau.”
english: Then some of the elders stood up and spoke to all the people who were gathered there.

lun_bawang: nganau' aceh paga' ratnan kubil sapi' idi raken kayuh, pad ieh miak ruen luun dierneh.
english: This is what he said to me: “Make a ◄yoke/set of wooden bars to fasten around the neck of an ox►, but fasten it around your own neck with leather straps.

lun_bawang: Tuhan luk Melalud, Allah lun Israil nengecuk ni Yeremia ngecuk nelun duken ineh mada' raca'-raca'deh ratnan luk bila Tuhan, kebalaNeh,
english: Tell them to give this message to their kings: This is what the Commander of the armies of angels, the God whom the Israeli people worship, says:

lun_bawang: Aleg ninger bala nabi muyuh, idi idé-idé pana' luk mada' ratnan luk miak macing muci, dengan mada' nupi, idi dengan nawar ada' lun naté, idi dengan ileh Sétan. Amung-amungdeh mebpeng nemuyuh na miak mangun ku demulun raca' Babil.
english: So, do not pay attention to your false prophets and fortune-tellers and people who predict what will happen by working magic or by talking with spirits of dead people. Those people say that the king of Babylon will not conquer your country.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ineh teh bala Yeremia kuan Sedekia raca' Yahuda, kebalaneh, "Do' maya' bala raca' Babil, idi mangun ku demulunneh, idi demulun anak itinneh pana' pad iko mulun.
english: After I gave that message to those ambassadors, I gave the same message to King Zedekiah of Judah. I said to him, “If you want to remain alive, do what the King of Babylon and his officials want you to do MET.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, Na Ui nengecuk nedeh, idi ideh mebalih dengan ngadanKu. Ngaceku ineh, Ui miak masut namu idi iko miak pitayen, idi nabi-nabi luk mebalih ineh.”
english: This is what Yahweh says: ‘I have not appointed those prophets. They are saying that I MTY gave them messages, but they are lying. So, if you believe them, I will expel you from this land. And you and all those prophets will die in Babylon!’ ”

lun_bawang: "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan luk Melalud, Allah lun Israil, 'Ui pangeh nengelaya' raca' Babil.
english: “This is what the Commander of the armies of angels, the God whom we Israelis worship, says: ‘I will cause the king of Babylon to stop ruling/controlling MET all of you.

lun_bawang: "Do' kudeng amung ineh mangun, idi Tuhan ngacing amung balamu, pad Ieh nguit lemubed rat Babil amung binaweh Ruma' Allah idi amung lemulun luk pangeh tiban.
english: I said, “◄Amen/May that happen►! I desire/hope that what you have predicted will happen. I hope/desire that Yahweh will do everything that you have said! I hope/desire that he will cause men from Babylon to bring back from Babylon all the valuable things that were in this temple, and all the people who were taken to Babylon.

lun_bawang: "Amé' mada' ni Hanania, kebalamu, 'Kebala Tuhan, Iko miak mutul paga' kayuh, iamo' Ieh miak ngelibal neneh ku paga' belawan.
english: “Go and say this to Hananiah: ‘Yahweh says that you have broken a wooden yoke, but that he will replace it with an iron yoke.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yeremia ni Hanania, "O Hanania, do' iko ninger! Na iko icuk Tuhan, idi iko ngeraruh pupu ini pad ideh maya' balihmu.
english: Then I went to Hananiah and said to him, “Hananiah, listen to this: Yahweh has not appointed you; instead, you have told lies to the people, and they have believed your lies.

lun_bawang: 'Do' muyuh mudut ruma' idi tebawang, idi nganau' kabun idi kuman luk tibuen muyuh.
english: Get married and have children. Then when they grow up, choose wives for your sons, and husbands for your daughters, in order that they also may have children. In that way, the number of you people will increase, not decrease.

lun_bawang: Ui ini Tuhan Allah lun Israil, mada' nemuyuh pad muyuh na saluken nabi- nabi luk tudo arang muyuh idi idé-idé pana' luk mada' ratnan luk miak macing muci. Aleg maya' nupideh.
english: because they are telling you lies, saying that MTY I have given them the messages that they are telling you. But, I have not appointed them.”

lun_bawang: "Kebala Tuhan, 'Kareb mabud tudu' ngepulu' lak déi' Babil, Ui miak méi' nemuyuh idi maya' jani'Ku idi nguit nemuyuh muli'.
english: I, Yahweh, know what I have planned for you. I am planning to cause things to go well for you, not to cause you to experience disasters. I am planning to give you many things that you confidently expect to receive in the future.

lun_bawang: Ui sebuleng mo' kali' luk pianKu kuan muyuh, pad muyuh ruen ngeperuan, idi na medereh peh, pelé muyuh miak ngalap luk pian muyuh.
english: At that time, when you pray, I will heed you.

lun_bawang: "Kebala muyuh, 'Tuhan pangeh nemaré nabi kuan kai déi' Babil.'
english: But this is what Yahweh says about the king who rules here in Jerusalem, and about all the other people who are still living here—your relatives who were not taken to Babylon with you.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud, 'Ui ngacing bunu', lau, idi ét kuandeh, idi Ui miak nganau' nedeh mepad kudeng bua' gita' luk melu luk na miak kenen.
english: I will not stop causing them to experience wars and famines and diseases. And I will scatter them all around the world. In every country where I ◄force them to be taken/exile them►, I will cause them to be people whom others curse and be horrified about and make fun of DOU.

lun_bawang: Amung ini miak mangun kuandeh ngaceku ideh na maya' bala luk megéi' bida' kuandeh dengan tang demulun idi nabiKu. Ideh ara' ninger bala ineh.
english: Therefore, you people who have been ◄exiled/forced to go► from Jerusalem to Babylon, listen to this message from Yahweh.

lun_bawang: -32"Do' maré bala ini kuan amung-amung lun luk tiban déi' Babil, 'Kudeng ini bala Tuhan ratnan Semaya: Ui ini Tuhan miak ngukum ni Semaya dengan amung inulneh. Na Ui nengecuk neneh, iamo' ieh nepebala nemuyuh mepad kudeng nabi, pad muyuh nemaya' balihneh. Na ieh miak inan inul arang muyuh. Ieh na miak mulun, pad ieh nier amung-amung luk do' luk miak ruenKu kuan pupuKu, ngaceku ieh nengecuk nedeh ngelaba balaKu. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.' "
english: So, I will punish him and his family. He has incited you to rebel against me. Because of that, all of his descendants will soon die. I will do many good things for you, my people, but he and his descendants will not see those things, because they will be dead. That will surely happen because I, Yahweh, have said it!’”

lun_bawang: nepebala ni Yeremia "Do' ngayud bang aceh surat amung-amung luk bilaKu namu.
english: “I, Yahweh, the God whom the Israeli people say they belong to, am telling you that you should write down everything that I have said to you.

lun_bawang: "Ui ninger lemulun ngarod, ngaceku megagap idi matot, ngaceku na awang niatdeh.
english: This is what he said: “I hear people screaming because they are terrified DOU; there is no peace in the land.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan kuan pupuNeh, "Et muyuh pelaba bura' idi urat muyuh na miak mepali'.
english: Yahweh also says this: “You have ◄suffered very much/endured many disasters►; it is as though you have a terrible wound that cannot be cured.

lun_bawang: Ui miak maré nemuyuh do' ulun, idi ngedo' urat muyuh, sagan tu pana' bunu' muyuh pebala, 'Sion pangeh tila'; seburur pana' nateh luk méi' neneh!' Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.”
english: Everyone says that you are ◄outcasts/people that they no longer associate with►, and that you live in Jerusalem, a city that no one cares about.” But Yahweh says, “I will heal your injuries/wounds and cause you to be healthy again.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ui miak nguit pupuKu lemubed amé' inan tana'deh, idi Ui méi' inan anid-anid tetek ruma'deh. Anid bawang miak piduten baruh idi anid ruma' pana'.
english: This is what Yahweh says: “I will bring the people of Israel back from the lands to which they were taken and enable them to possess their land and their houses again. When that happens, Jerusalem will be rebuilt on top of its ruins, and the king’s palace will be rebuilt to be like it was before.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Tarekneh malé macing kareb Ui mangun ku Allah amung pupu Israil, idi ideh miak mangun ku pupuKu.
english: Yahweh says that at that time, he will be the God who is worshiped by all the clans in Israel, and they will be his people.

lun_bawang: Ui pangeh méi' kuan lemulun déi' su luk ali-ali luk nepuit ratnan até. Kareb lun Israil pian ngato erurdeh,
english: This is what Yahweh says: “Those people who remained alive and were not killed by their enemies’ swords were blessed by me even in the desert; I enabled them to have peace.

lun_bawang: idi Ui nesilagan kuandeh rat mado. O muyuh lun Israil, Ui megéi' mawa nemuyuh pad Ui megéi' ngegala' éi'Ku.
english: Long ago I, Yahweh, said to your ancestors, the Israeli people, ‘I have loved you and I will continue to love you forever. By faithfully loving you, I have brought you close to myself.’

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Menani dengan mawang niat kuan Israil, pupu luk meluun rayeh. Do' muyuh menani ngubur Tuhan, 'Tuhan pangeh nengulun pupuNeh, idi nemuit amung lun luk neketecan.'
english: And now Yahweh also says this: “Sing joyfully about what I have done for the people of Israel! Shout about your nation, the greatest nation! Shout joyfully, praising me and saying, ‘Yahweh, rescue your people, the ones who are still alive!’

lun_bawang: Amung pupu, ninger balaKu, ieh ineh Tuhan. idi mada' balaKu déi' bawang luk mado! Ui ini, luk nengatad nelun Israil, miak ngamung nedeh idi matar nedeh mepad kudeng lemulun luk matar sengeriudan dumbaneh.
english: Yahweh says, “You people in the nations of the world, listen to this message from me. Then proclaim it to people who live along the coasts far away. I scattered my people, but I will gather them again and will take care of them like SIM a shepherd takes care of his sheep.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Inan aceh tang pindenger déi' bawang Rama. Inan luk nangi' idi temido teh, ieh ineh Rakel luk nangi' ku anakneh, idi na ieh miak buken, ngaceku anakneh na idi peh.
english: Yahweh also says this: “Women were weeping in Ramah town on the border between Israel and Judah; they were mourning and crying very loudly. The women who were the descendants of Ephraim and Manasseh, the two grandsons of Rachel the wife of Jacob, were weeping about their children, and no one could comfort them because their children were all dead.

lun_bawang: Aleg iko nangi', idi do' miid abpa' matehmu. Amung-amung luk inau'mu kuan anakmu na miak na uen ngua', idi ideh miak lemubed ratnan bawang bunu'deh. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: But now this is what I, Yahweh, say: ‘Do not cry any more, because I will reward you for the good things you have done for your children. Your children will return from the land where their enemies have taken them.

lun_bawang: Muyuh miak uen ngeperuan muci; idi anak muyuh miak muli'. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: I, Yahweh, am telling you that there are things that you can confidently expect me to do for you in the future. Your children will return to their own land.’

lun_bawang: "Idi Ui ninger lun Israil pebala dengan mesusa' niat, 'O Tuhan, kai mepad kudeng sapi' deléi luk ungeng, iamo' Iko nemada' nekai pad kai nemaya' balaMu. Do' Iko nguit nekai lemubed, ngaceku kai pian lumi Namu, Iko luk Tuhan Allah kai.
english: I have heard the people of Israel grieving very much and saying to me, ‘You punished us severely, like SIM calves are beaten by their owners to train them for pulling a plow. So bring us back to obey/worship you again, because we are ready to return to you, because you alone are Yahweh, our God.

lun_bawang: Do' nganau' etu dalan, idi lemubed maya' dalan luk nedalan muyuh atun. Lemubed O lun Israil, idi muli' amé' bawang luk pangeh tican muyuh.
english: You Israeli people, set up road signs; put up posts along the roads to mark the road on which you walked when you were taken from Jerusalem. My precious/beloved Israeli people, come back to your towns here.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud, Allah lun Israil, "Kareb Ui nguit nelun Israil muli', idi ideh miak pebala bang tana' Yahuda idi bang amung bawangneh, 'Do' Tuhan ngeperuan surud Yerusalim luk meligan, ieh ineh su luk meligan luk inanNeh tudo.'
english: This is what the Commander of the armies of angels, the God whom we Israeli people worship, says: “When I bring them back from the countries to which they have been exiled, all the people from the towns in Judah will again say, ‘I hope that Yahweh will bless this my home, the holy place where righteous people will live!’

lun_bawang: "Ui ini Tuhan pebala, 'Tarekneh malé macing kareb Ui manu' tana' Israil idi Yahuda ku lemulun idi pung.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “There will be a time when I will greatly increase MET the number of people and the number of livestock here in Israel and Judah.

lun_bawang: Idi kareb ineh na lemulun miak pebala, 'Amung-amung taman pangeh nekuman bua' anggur luk melam, idi lipen anak-anakdeh melaya' peh.'
