english: Previously the people often said, ‘The parents have eaten sour grapes, but it is the children’s teeth that ache.’ They meant that it was not fair for them to be punished for their ancestors’ sins. But when I bring them back to their land, they will no longer say that.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Tarekneh malé macing kareb Ui miak nganau' aceh pejani' luk mebaruh dengan pupu Israil idi Yahuda.
english: I, Yahweh, say this: ‘There will be a time when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and Judah.

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "Israil miak mangun ku aceh pupu pa kiungKu, pad macing kekiped tana'.”
english: “I will not reject my Israeli people any more than I will get rid of the laws that control the universe.

lun_bawang: Kudeng langit miak uen nari, idi luk pa liang tana' miak kali', kareb ineh mo' Ieh miak nala' pupu Israil, ngaceku amung-amung luk inau'deh. Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: And this is what I say: ‘No one can measure the sky, and no one can find out what is supporting the earth. Similarly, I cannot reject forever the descendants of Jacob because of all the evil things that they have done.’ That is certain, because I, Yahweh, have said it!

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Tarekneh miak macing kareb bawang ini miak piduten baruh, rat Pudut Hananel luk Medita' macing Tanga' Lidung.
english: I, Yahweh, also say that there will be a time when everything in Jerusalem will be rebuilt for me, from the tower of Hananel at the northeast corner, west to the gate named the Corner Gate.

lun_bawang: Raca' Sedekia pangeh nenutup neneh su ineh idi nengadu' neneh, ngaceku Yeremia nepebala, "Kebala Tuhan, 'Ui miak maré bawang ini kuan raca' Babil, idi ieh miak ngalap neneh.
english: King Zedekiah had put me there. I continued to prophesy there about what would happen. I continued to say, “Yahweh says that he is about to allow the army of the king of Babylon to capture this city DOU.

lun_bawang: Sedekia miak tebanen amé' Babil, idi ieh miak tudo déi' pad Ui ngukum neneh, sagan tu pana' ieh pebunu' nelun Babil, ieh na miak metueh. Ui ini, Tuhan pangeh nepebala.' “
english: Then his soldiers will take Zedekiah to Babylon, and he will remain there until I arrange for him to be punished. And if he tries to fight against the soldiers from Babylonia, he will not succeed.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yeremia, "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan negku,
english: At that time, Yahweh gave me another message. He said,

lun_bawang: 'Hanamel, anak taman pinakenmu Salum miak amé' namu idi mutuh namu melih tana'neh luk déi' Anatot, ngaceku iko pupuneh luk muneng idi miak melih tana'neh.' “
english: “Your cousin Hanamel, the son of Shallum your uncle, will come to you. He will say to you, ‘Buy my field at Anathoth, your hometown. Because you are my closest relative, it is written in our laws that you have the right to buy it before I ask if anyone else wants to buy it.’ ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaku ni Baruk pa kiung amungdeh,
english: Then, while they were all listening, I said to Baruch,

lun_bawang: "O Tuhan Allah, Iko luk nenganau' tana' idi langit dengan lalud idi tuehMu luk rayeh. Na luk idi anun-anun luk na miak ruenMu.
english: “Yahweh, you are my Lord! You made the sky and the earth by your very great power. MTY, DOU Nothing is too difficult for you to do.

lun_bawang: "Ui ini Tuhan Allah amung lemulun. Na luk idi anun-anun luk na miak ruenKu.
english: “I am Yahweh, the God who rules all the people in the world. There is absolutely nothing RHQ that is too difficult for me to do.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah lun Israil, "O Yeremia, iko pangeh nemada' pupu ini ratnan bunu', lau, idi ét luk miak nganau' bawang ini ruen raca' Babil ngelaya'. Idi nekini do' iko ninger luk badénKu teh.
english: “But now I will say something more about this city. You people of Jerusalem have been saying, ‘The army of the King of Babylon will conquer it, either by their swords or because of famines or diseases.’ But this is what I, Yahweh, the God whom you Israeli people say you belong to, say:

lun_bawang: "Mepad kudeng Ui pangeh nengacing susa' kuan pupu ini, kudeng ineh teh Ui miak maré kuandeh amung-amung peruan luk pijani'Ku.
english: And this is also what I, Yahweh, say: ‘I have caused them to experience all these disasters. Similarly, some day I will do for them all the good things that I have promised.

lun_bawang: Tuhan luk nemudut idi nengeletep tana' ini nepebala ni Yeremia. Ieh luk titen Tuhan nepebala,
english: “This is what I, the one who made the earth, who formed/shaped it and put it in its place, say to the people of Jerusalem: ‘My name is Yahweh.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud, 'Bang bawang ini luk mepad kudeng su luk ali- ali idi luk na lemulun idi pung pana', miak ku laman muci su luk inan lemulun miak matar dumbadeh.
english: This land is now desolate. There are no people or animals living here. But I, the Commander of the armies of angels, say this: ‘In this land there will again be pastures/fields where shepherds will lead their sheep.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Tarekneh miak macing, kareb Ui ngacing jani'Ku nelun Israil idi Yahuda.
english: Listen to this! I, Yahweh, say that there will be a time when I will do for the people of Israel and Judah all the good things that I promised to do for them.

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh Ui miak maré aceh inul Daud luk matu, idi Ieh miak nganau' luk matu idi luk mesiri aput-aput tana'.
english: At that time DOU I will appoint a righteous man who will be a descendant MET of King David. Throughout the land, he will do what is just and right.

lun_bawang: Ui ini Tuhan pejani', idi Ui miak maré inul Daud mangun ku raca' Israil ruked-ruked,
english: And this is also what I, Yahweh, say: ‘There will be descendants of King David ruling MTY Israel forever.

lun_bawang: "Ui na miak ngelaba jani'Ku ratnan aco idi dacem, pad aco idi dacem na mangun bang kareb luk petulu.
english: “This is what I, Yahweh, say: ‘You certainly cannot annul my promise/agreement to cause nighttime to follow daytime each day.

lun_bawang: "Kali'mu bala pupu ini luk pebala, 'Tuhan pangeh nenala' Israil idi Yahuda, ieh ineh dueh pupu luk pinili'Neh?' Pad ideh ngedat pupuKu, idi na ngerawé nedeh mangun ku aceh pupu.
english: “Have you noticed/heard that some people are saying, ‘Yahweh chose two groups, the people of Judah and the people of Israel, and later abandoned them.’ They are despising my people and saying that Israel no longer deserves to be considered a nation.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Ui ini Tuhan pangeh pejani' ratnan aco idi dacem, idi Ui pangeh nenganau' ukum ratnan tana' idi langit.
english: But this is what I say: ‘I will not change my laws that control the day and the night, the sky and the earth.

lun_bawang: Tuhan Allah lun Israil nengecuk ni Yeremia pebala ni Sedekia raca' Yahuda, "Ui ini Tuhan maré bawang ini bang palad raca' Babil, idi ieh miak sabpenneh.
english: “Go to Zedekiah the King of Judah, and say to him, ‘This is what Yahweh, the God whom we Israelis worship, says: “I am about to enable the army of the King of Babylon to capture this city, and they will burn it down.

lun_bawang: O Raca' Sedekia, ninger balaKu. Ui sikal mada' ratnan lawému! Na iko miak pitayen bang bunu'.
english: But King Zedekiah, listen to this that Yahweh has promised: ‘You will not be killed in a battle MTY;

lun_bawang: "Amé' pegayam nelun Rekabi. Idi nguit nedeh semuet bang aceh takep Ruma' Allah idi maré abpa' anggur kuandeh.”
english: “Go to the place where families of the Rechab clan live. Invite them to my temple. When they arrive, take them into one of the inside rooms and offer them some wine.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yeremia nengerareng tuda'-tuda' sangkir idi sidangur pa kiung lun Rekabi, idi kebalaneh nedeh, "Do' muyuh ngirup.”
english: I set jugs of wine in front of them and urged them to drink some,

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebaladeh, "Kai na miak ngirup abpa' anggur ngaceku Yonadab, anak tepun kai Rekabi, nemebpeng nekai idi inul kai na miak ngirup abpa' anggur.
english: but they refused. They said, “We do not drink wine, because our ancestor Jehonadab, the son of Rechab, commanded us, saying ‘You and your descendants must never drink wine.

lun_bawang: Idi Yeremia nemada' pupu Rekabi ratnan amung-amung luk bila Tuhan luk Melalud, Allah lun Israil, kebalaneh, "Muyuh pangeh nemaya' amung ukum luk biré tepun muyuh Yonadab.
english: Then I turned to the Rechab clan and said, “This is what the Commander of the armies of angels, the God whom we Israelis say we belong to, says: ‘You have obeyed what your ancestor Jehonadab told you. You have obeyed all his instructions.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yeremia ni Baruk, "Ui na simén semuet bang Ruma' Allah.
english: Then I said to him, “I am not allowed to leave here and go to the temple.

lun_bawang: "Tudo iko," kebaladeh, "idi maca' surat ineh kuan kai." Idi Baruk nemaca' surat ineh kuandeh.
english: They said to him, “Please sit down and read it to us.” So Baruch did what they requested.

lun_bawang: Idi kareb ieh pangeh nemaca' amung ineh, idi ideh pesier ngaceku ideh megagap. Idi kebaladeh ni Baruk, "Do' kai mada' bala ini kuan raca'.”
english: After they had heard all the messages, they were afraid. They looked at each other and then they said, “We must tell these messages to the king!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh neneh, "Do' mada' nekai kudeng apeh iko nengayud ini? Yeremiaké luk nengecuk namu?”
english: Then they asked Baruch, “How did you get this scroll? Did Jeremiah dictate to you all the messages on this scroll?”

lun_bawang: Idi Baruk nengor baladeh, kebalaneh, "Yeremia nemada' amung bala ini kuanku, idi ui nengayud ineh luun geretas ku dawat.”
english: Baruch replied, “Yes, Jeremiah dictated them to me, and I wrote them with ink on this scroll.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh neneh, "Do' medueh Yeremia amé' sigapung. Idi aleg nima' seburur pana' kali' su inan medueh.”
english: Then the officials told Baruch, “You and Jeremiah must both hide. Do not tell anyone where you are!”

lun_bawang: "Do' iko ngalap aceh geretas teh idi ngayud luun ineh amung bala luk inayud bang surat luk iseb Raca' Yoyakim.”
english: “Get another scroll, and tell Baruch to write everything again, the same messages that he had written on the scroll that the king burned.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh, Ui ini Tuhan pebala namu, O Raca' Yoyakim. Seburur pana' ratnan inulmu nateh miak mangun ku raca'. Butungmu miak talan, pad ieh melau' kareb macang, idi meteneb kareb medacem.
english: Now this is what I, Yahweh, say about you, Jehoiakim: 'None of your descendants will rule this kingdom MTY. Your corpse will be thrown out on the ground and not be buried; it will be under the hot sun during the days and struck by frost during the nights.

lun_bawang: Raca' Sedekia nengecuk Yukal Selemia idi Sepania Masia luk imam amé' papu' Yeremia. Kebala didueh neneh, "Do' sembayang inan Tuhan Allah kai kuan kai.”
english: However, one day King Zedekiah sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah, and Zephaniah the priest, who was the son of Maaseiah, to me. They requested me to pray to Yahweh our God for our nation.

lun_bawang: "Mada' raca' Yahuda, luk nengecuk namu ngitun Negku, kebalamu, 'Baweh raca' Masir luk amé' ngedengan namu, miak muli' amé' Masir.
english: “I, Yahweh, the God whom you Israelis say you belong to, say this: ‘The King of Judah has sent messengers to you to ask me what is going to happen. Tell the king that even though the army of the King of Egypt came to help him, they are about to return to Egypt.

lun_bawang: Ui ini Tuhan mada' nemuyuh pad muyuh na uen naluk idi ngerawé lun Babil na lemubed. Ngaceku kali' rungen ideh lemubed.
english: So, this is what I say to you Israelis: ‘You should not deceive yourselves, thinking that the army from Babylonia has gone and will not return. That is not true.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kareb ieh nacing Tanga' Beniamin, idi lun rayeh lun pebunu' luk matar tanga' ineh, luk ngadanneh Iria anak Selemia Hanania, nengagka' ni Yeremia, kebalaneh neneh, "Iko necan nekai amé' ngedengan nelun Babil!”
english: But as I was walking out the Benjamin Gate, a guard seized me and said, “You are deserting us and going to the soldiers from Babylonia!” The man who seized me was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah and grandson of Hananiah.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yeremia, "Na tu! Na ui necan nemuyuh." Iamo' Iria na sikal ninger balaneh. Ieh nengakem ni Yeremia idi nenguit neneh amé' nan lun rayeh.
english: But I protested and said, “That is not true! I was not intending to do that!” But Irijah would not pay attention to what I said. He took me to the king’s officials.

lun_bawang: Idi Yeremia nengitun, kebalaneh, "Anun sala'ku pa kiungmu, idi pa kiung lun rayehmu idi pupu ini pad ui tinutupmu?
english: Then I asked the king, “What crime have I committed RHQ against you or against your officials or against the Israeli people, with the result that you have commanded that I be put in a prison?

lun_bawang: "Tuhan pangeh nepebala, 'Idé-idé luk ketecan bang bawang ini miak maté ku bunu', lau, idi ét. Iamo' idé-idé luk amé' matun nelun Babil na miak pitayen. Iamo' ieh miak mulun.' “
english: I had been telling them that Yahweh was saying, “Everyone who stays in Jerusalem will die. They will be killed by their enemies’ swords or from famines or from diseases. But those who surrender to the Babylonian army, they will be spared. They will not be killed.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Raca' Sedekia, "Do', pad pian muyuh. Ui na miak mebpeng nemuyuh.”
english: King Zedekiah said, “All right, do to him what you want to; I do not have the power to stop you.”

lun_bawang: Idi raca' nengecuk Ebed Melek nguit teluh ngepulu' burur lemulun luk tuped ieneh amé' nginat ni Yeremia rat bang subuk ineh kareb nateh ieh maté.
english: So the king told Ebed-Melech, “Take thirty of my men/soldiers with you, and pull Jeremiah out of the well, in order that he does not die!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Ebed Melek ni Yeremia, "Do' iko nganau' kuyu' ini bang ilekmu pad abet ineh na miak ngurat namu." Idi Yeremia nenganau' luk kudeng ineh.
english: Then Ebed-Melech called down to me, “Put these rags underneath your armpits, to protect you from being injured by the ropes!” So I did that.

lun_bawang: Raca' Sedekia nengecuk nelun nguit Nabi Yeremia amé' matun neneh munung tanga' luk keteluh bang Ruma' Allah. Idi kebalaneh ni Yeremia, "Ui pian ngitun namu aceh itun, idi aleg iko ngalum anun-anun negku.”
english: One day King Zedekiah summoned me, and I was brought to the king, who was waiting for me at the entrance of the temple. He said to me, “I want to ask you something. I want you to answer me truthfully, and and to not conceal anything.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yeremia, "Kudeng ui mada' luk matu, ui miak pitayenmu. Idi kudeng ui ngubuk namu, na iko pian maya' balaku.”
english: I replied, “If I tell you the truth, you will command that I be executed. And if I give you good advice, you will not pay attention to what I say.”

lun_bawang: Idi Raca' Sedekia nepejani' ni Yeremia dengan lulem. Kebalaneh, "Ui pebulung dengan ngadan Tuhan luk mulun, idi luk ngulun netau, na ui ngaté namu, idi teh na ui maré namu bang palad lemulun luk sikal ngaté namu.”
english: But King Zedekiah secretly promised me, “Tell me the truth! And as surely as Yahweh lives, I will not cause you to be executed, and I will not hand you over to those who are wanting to kill you.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Raca' Sedekia, "Ui matot nelun Yahudi luk pangeh neperurum nelun Babil. Kian, ui barén bang paladdeh lek, pad ideh ngedereh negku.”
english: The king replied, “But I am afraid to surrender to the soldiers from Babylon, because their officers may hand me over to the people of Judah who have already joined the soldiers from Babylonia, and those people from Judah will mistreat me.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yeremia, "Na tu iko barén bang paladdeh. Ui mutuh namu maya' bala Tuhan luk bilaku namu, pad iko uen ngeperuan idi na iko maté.
english: I replied, “If you obey Yahweh by doing what I tell you to do, they will not hand you over to our people. Things will go well for you, and you will remain alive.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Sedekia, "Aleg iko mada' nelun baken ratnan gayam kiteh ini, pad iko na pitayen.
english: Then Zedekiah said to me, “Do not tell anyone what you told me; if you tell anyone, my officials may kill you.

lun_bawang: "Amé' ngalap ni Yeremia idi ngasa' neneh. Aleg ngedereh neneh, iamo' nganau' anun-anun luk pianneh.”
english: “Make sure that no one harms him. Take care of him, and do for him whatever he requests you to do.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Ui ini Tuhan miak matar namu, pad iko na barén bang palad lemulun luk inanmu matot.
english: but I will rescue you from the people whom you are afraid of.

lun_bawang: Idi lun rayeh baweh nepegayam ni Yeremia buleng-buleng, "Tuhan Allahmu nemada' ratnan susa' luk miak macing kuan bawang ini,
english: Nebuzaradan, the captain of the king’s bodyguards, found that I was there. He summoned me and said to me, “Yahweh your God said that he would cause this land to experience a disaster.

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh neneh, "Naké iko kali' Balis raca' Amon pangeh nengecuk Ismail Netania amé' ngaté namu?" Iamo' na ieh manu ku baladeh.
english: They said to him, “Do you know that Baalis, the king of the Ammon people-group, has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to assassinate you?” But Gedaliah did not believe what they said.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Gedalia, "Aleg muyuh ngaté neneh. Ngaceku bala muyuh ratnan Ismail na matu!"
english: But Gedaliah said to Johanan, “No, I will not allow you to do that. I think that you are lying about Ishmael.”

lun_bawang: Idi Ismail nenalan rat Mispa sikal papu' nedeh, idi ieh nangi' maya' dalan. Kareb ieh nacing nedeh, idi kebalaneh, "Do' amé' papu' Gedalia.”
english: Ishmael went out of the city to meet them, crying as he went. When he reached them, he said, “Come and see what has happened to Gedaliah!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh ni Yeremia, "Nima' Tuhan mangun ku lun nekali' luk matu rat nekai, kudeng kai na maya' amung ukum luk barén Tuhan Allah tau namu kuan kai.
english: They replied to me, “We hope/wish that Yahweh our God will be a faithful witness against us if we refuse to do everything that he tells us to do.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nedeh, "Tuhan Allah lun Israil luk pinutuhku kuan muyuh nepebala,
english: I said to them, “You told me to tell Yahweh, the God whom we Israelis worship, what you were requesting. This is what he replied:

lun_bawang: -15"Iamo' aleg muyuh luk ketecan bang bawang Yahuda ngelaba bala Tuhan Allah muyuh pad muyuh ara' tudo bang bawang ini. Aleg muyuh pebala, 'Na! Kai sikal amé' tudo déi' Masir. Ngaceku na luk idi bunu' idi uni tawak luk nawar amé' pebunu', idi na kai melau.' Kudeng muyuh pebala kudeng ini, idi Tuhan luk Melalud, Allah lun Israil pebala, 'Kudeng muyuh mesaad amé' bawang Masir,
english: But if you refuse to obey Yahweh our God, and if you say ‘We will not stay here;

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yeremia teh, "Tuhan pangeh nemebpeng nemuyuh luk ketecan déi' Yahuda, na miak amé' déi' Masir. Idi ui mada' nemuyuh nekini
english: You little group of people of Judah who are still alive, listen to me: Yahweh has told you, ‘Do not go to Egypt.’ So do not forget what I have warned you today.

lun_bawang: "Ngalap tuda'-tuda' batu luk rayeh idi nanem ineh pa atun munung tanga' ruma' raca' bang bawang ini, pad lun Yahudi nier namu nganau' ineh.
english: “While the people of Judah are watching you, take some large rocks and bury them under the brick pavement at the entrance to the king’s palace there at Tahpenes.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud, Allah lun Israil, "Muyuh sebuleng pangeh nekali' susa' luk icingKu kuan Yerusalim idi amung bawang Yahuda. Macing nekini pana' bawang ineh inusag idi na lemulun.
english: “This is what I, the Commander of the armies of angels, the God whom you Israelis say you belong to, say: ‘You saw the disaster that I caused the people in Jerusalem and the other towns in Judah to experience. Those towns are now ruined and deserted.

lun_bawang: Na Ui ugka' ngecuk demulunKu lun nabi luk mada' nemuyuh pad muyuh na nganau' kekamen luk dat ini luk inanKu megateh.
english: Many times I sent my prophets who served me, to say to them, “Do not do those abominable things that I hate!”

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku ineh, Ui ini Tuhan luk Melalud, Allah lun Israil miak ngacing susa' kuan muyuh, pad Ui ngusag amung bawang Yahuda.
english: Therefore, this is what I, the Commander of the armies of angels, the God whom you Israelis say you belong to, say: ‘I am determined to cause all of you to experience disasters and to get rid of every one of you.

lun_bawang: "Kai ara' ninger bala luk bilamu nekai dengan ngadan Tuhan.
english: “You are saying that MTY Yahweh gave messages to you, but we will not pay any attention to your messages!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala decur-decur ineh, "Kareb kai nenganau' pinaram mepad kudeng ayu Raca' Decur Surga, idi nemaré baré kuanneh, idi nengutang baré luk rupen kuanneh, idi awan kai mawang niat ratnan luk inau' kai.”
english: And the women said, “Furthermore, we burned incense and poured out wine offerings to the Queen of Heaven, and we also made small cakes that resembled her idol, to offer to her. But our husbands certainly knew about and approved of RHQ what we were doing!”

lun_bawang: -25Yeremia nemada' nelun mula', meluun teh decur-decur ineh, amung- amung luk bila Tuhan luk Melalud, Allah lun Israil kuan lun Yahuda luk tudo déi' Masir, kebalaNeh, "Muyuh idi awan muyuh pangeh nepejani' inan Raca' Decur Surga. Muyuh nepejani' maré baré kuanneh idi ngutang baré luk rupen kuanneh, idi muyuh pangeh nemaya' jani' muyuh. Kudeng pieh kudeng ineh, do' muyuh maya' jani' muyuh!
english: Then I said to all of them, including the women, “All you people of Judah who are here in Egypt, listen to this message from Yahweh.

lun_bawang: Ui ini Tuhan miak maré aceh tanu' luk ngegala' Ui miak ngukum nemuyuh bang bawang ini, idi jani'Ku ratnan ngacing susa' kuan muyuh miak mangun.
english: And Yahweh also says, ‘I will do something that will prove to you that everything that I have said will happen, and that I will punish you here in this place.

lun_bawang: "Tuhan Allah lun Israil nepebala,
english: “Baruch, Yahweh, the God whom we Israelis worship, has a message for you.

lun_bawang: 'O Baruk, kebalamu, Ui pian ugka', ngaceku Tuhan pangeh nengula' susa'ku! Ui merur ngarod idi na miak ngato erurku!' “
english: You have said, ‘Terrible things are happening to me! I have endured much pain already. And now Yahweh is causing me to be very sad, in addition to my having pain. I am exhausted from my ◄groaning/being sad►, and I am unable to rest!’

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nengecuk ni Yeremia pebala ni Baruk, "Ui ngusag luk pinudutKu, idi mubput luk tinibuKu. Ui miak nganau' luk kudeng ini aput tana'.
english: But Baruch, this is what Yahweh says: ‘I will destroy this nation that I established. This nation is like a tree MET that I planted and that I will now pull up with its roots.

lun_bawang: "Lun rayeh baweh Masir ngitang, 'Do' ngalap utap muyuh, idi amé' pebunu'!
english: ‘Prepare your shields and march out to fight the battle!

lun_bawang: Lemulun luk mawer na miak mepuit, lun bunu' pana' na miak buro. Idi muneng ku Abpa' Pirat pa tinueh busat aco, ideh metebaceng idi mebpeh.
english: Even the fastest runners will try to run away, but even the greatest of their warriors will not escape. In the north, by the Euphrates River, they will stumble and fall.

lun_bawang: Idé ini luk temubu' mepad kudeng Abpa' Nil, mepad kudeng abpa' luk ngereb?
english: What group is this that will be covering the land like the water of the Nile River covers the land when it floods?

lun_bawang: "Mada' bala ini bang amung bawang Masir, do' déi' Migdol, Mempis, idi Tapanes. 'Do' temina' amé' pebunu'; amung binaweh idi bawang muyuh miak uen ngusag bang bunu'!
english: “Shout this message throughout Egypt! Proclaim it in Migdol, Memphis, and Tahpenes cities! ‘◄Get into your positions/Line up► for the battle; Prepare to defend yourselves, because everyone around you will be killed.’ PRS, MTY

lun_bawang: Ui ini Tuhan luk Melalud luk raca'. Ui ini Allah luk mulun. Mepad kudeng Pegkung Tabor meluun dita' ratnan amung pegkung, idi Pegkung Karmel medita' ratnan abpa' rayeh, kudeng ineh teh tueh lemulun luk munu' namu.
english: I, the King, who am called the Commander of the armies of angels, say this: ‘As surely as I live, someone’s army will be coming to fight against the army of Egypt. They will be extremely powerful, as though they were as tall as Tabor Hill, or as high as Carmel Mountain close to the Mediterranean Sea.

lun_bawang: Masir mepad kudeng sapi' tineh luk do' luk kitep pitek luk rat pa tinueh busat aco.
english: Egypt is like SIM a beautiful young cow, but the army of a powerful king from the northeast will come to attack it like a horsefly MET bites a cow.

lun_bawang: Ideh temara' pulung Masir. Anak itindeh na mekiap, idi lun pebunu'deh meluun ula' ratnan kato.
english: I, Yahweh, say that they will kill the soldiers of Egypt as though SIM they were a forest of trees, because the enemy soldiers will be as numerous as a swarm of locusts.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud, Allah lun Israil, "Ui miak ngukum Amon, allah lun Tibis, perapu dengan Masir idi amung allah idi raca'deh. Ui miak ngukum raca' Masir idi amung lemulun luk merapet neneh.
english: I, the Commander of the armies of angels, the God whom the Israelis worship, say, ‘I will punish Amon, the god whom the people of Thebes city worship, and all the other gods in Egypt. I will punish the King of Egypt and all those who trust in him.

lun_bawang: Muyuh ngitang, 'O pelapet Tuhan! Tuda' ioké iko narad? Do' iko lemubed amé' bang binanmu idi ngato erurmu.'
english: The people of Philistia say, “Yahweh, when RHQ will you tell our enemies to stop killing us with PRS their swords? Tell them to PRS put them back into their sheaths and keep them there!”

lun_bawang: Kudeng apehké ieh miak ugka', ngaceku Ui maré kekamen kuanneh? Ui nengecuk neneh munu' bawang Askelon, idi lemulun luk tudo tangeb abpa' rayeh."
english: But it would not be right RHQ for their swords to stay there, because Yahweh has commanded their enemies to do something more; Yahweh intends to tell them to attack all the people living in Ashkelon and in other cities along the coast.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud ratnan Moab, "Mesusa' kuan lun Nebo — bawangdeh inusag! Kiriataim pangeh ilap, idi libung batuneh luk rayeh inusag, pupuneh pana' inigu' peh,
english: This is a message about Moab. The Commander of the armies of angels said: “Terrible things will happen to Nebo town; it will soon be ruined. Kiriathaim city will be captured and all its people will be humiliated; the high wall around their city will be ruined, and its people will become ashamed.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' tarekneh miak macing kareb Ui ngecuk lemulun ngutang Moab mepad kudeng abpa' anggur. Ideh miak nala' abpa' anggur idi mila' rubi ineh.
english: But Yahweh says that there will be a time when he will send enemies to attack them; they will get rid of the people of Moab like people pour out wine on the ground and then smash the wine jar.

lun_bawang: "O lun Moab, ngudehké muyuh mala nemuyuh lun luk mebala, lun luk mesangit bang bunu'?
english: The soldiers of Moab previously said, “We are warriors; we have fought bravely in battles!”

lun_bawang: Ukum Moab malé macing, idi ieh malé uen ngusag.
english: Moab will very soon be destroyed. It will soon experience disaster.

lun_bawang: O muyuh luk tudo déi' Dibon, temurun ratnan kerusi ubur muyuh, idi tudo luun tana'. Lun luk ngusag Moab pangeh nacing, idi pangeh nengusag amung libungneh.
english: You people of Dibon city, stop being proud because of being honored, and sit in the dust/dirt, because those who will destroy other places in Moab will attack your city and destroy your high walls.

lun_bawang: "Ngabuk ni Moab, ngaceku ieh sikal metueh rat Negku luk Tuhan. Moab miak silubid luun uta'neh, pad lemulun miak meriruh.
english: You people of Moab have rebelled against me, Yahweh; so now I will cause you all to stagger like SIM drunken people. You people of Moab will wallow in your own vomit and be ridiculed.

lun_bawang: Moab pelaba dita' niat! Ui pangeh nekali' dita' niat idi sido' niat muyuh. Idi Ui kali' nemuyuh megéi' ngerawé burur muyuh sebuleng.
english: We have all heard that the people of Moab are very proud; they are extremely proud and conceited/arrogant. IDM, DOU

lun_bawang: Ui ini Tuhan kali' dita' niat lun Moab. Baladeh luk medita' na ulekneh idi kekamendeh na meruked.
english: But Yahweh says, “I know about that, but it is useless for them to boast because it will accomplish nothing.

lun_bawang: Ui miak ngagka' nelun Moab, pad ideh na maré luk sabpen luun su luk inandeh sembayang, idi pad ideh na maré luk kereten kuan allahdeh. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: I, Yahweh, say that I will get rid of the people who offer sacrifices on the hilltops, and burn incense to their gods.

lun_bawang: Moab pangeh inusag! Do' muyuh ngitang! Ngaceku Moab pangeh inigu'. Ieh pangeh inusag, idi amung pupu libutneh situnga neneh.
english: Moab will be completely shattered! And you will hear the people wailing loudly! They will be disgraced. Moab will become a nation that people ridicule. The people in nearby countries will be horrified about what has happened there.

lun_bawang: "Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepejani': Aceh pupu miak ngeladai luun Moab mepad kudeng aceh kanui.
english: This is what I, Yahweh, say: ‘Look! Their enemies will be swooping/rushing down over Moab like an eagle SIM swoops down to seize an animal.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' muci aco, Ui miak ngeperuan ni Moab baruh." Ieh ineh ukum Tuhan kuan Moab.
english: But some day, I will enable the people of Moab to return to their land again. That will surely happen because I, Yahweh, have said it.” That is the end of what I prophesied about Moab.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ratnan lun Amon, "Iapehké lun Israil? Naké lemulun luk miak matar bawangdeh? Ngudehké ideh nima' lemulun luk sembayang inan Milkom ngalap tana' pupu Gad idi tebawang déi'?
english: This message is about the Ammon people-group. This is what Yahweh says: “There are RHQ plenty of Israeli people left to occupy the land of the tribe of Gad. So, why are RHQ the people who worship the god Molech living in those towns?

lun_bawang: O lun Hesbon, do' muyuh ngitang! Bawang muyuh pangeh inusag! O muyuh decur lun Raba. Do' muyuh temido! Do' muyuh nacung idi nangi'. Do' muyuh perigéi' upun. Akang muyuh Milkom miak tebanen perapu dengan imam idi penguluneh.
english: You people of Heshbon city MTY, wail, because Ai town nearby will be destroyed. You people of Rabbah city, weep; put on ◄rough clothing/sackcloth► to show you are mourning; run back and forth in confusion inside the city walls, because your god Milcom, along with its priests and officials, will be taken away ◄in exile/to other countries►.

lun_bawang: Ui miak ngacing tot kuan muyuh rat pa selipa idi rat pa selipa. Amung muyuh miak upun buro, idi seburur pana' nateh luk miak ngamung baweh muyuh teh. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: But listen to this: 'I, the Commander of the armies of angels, will cause you to become terrified. You will all be forced to flee to other countries, and no one will be able to bring you together again.'

lun_bawang: "Iamo' muci aco Ui miak ngeperuan nelun Amon teh. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.”
english: But some day I will enable the Ammon people-group to return to their land. That will surely happen, because I, Yahweh, have said it.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud ratnan Edom, "Matuké lun Edom na mileh ngerawé? Naké lun luk nguyut nedeh mileh mada' nedeh? Iapehké ilehdeh?
english: This message is about the Edom people-group. This is what the Commander of the armies of angels says: “It seems that RHQ there are no wise people in Teman district in Edom! There are no people left who can give others good advice. The people who were wise PRS have disappeared.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Kudeng lemulun luk na petulu kumin ngirup ratnan sangkir ukum, miakké muyuh mepuit ratnan ukum? Na tu! Muyuh pana' miak ngirup ratnan sangkir ineh!
english: And this is also what Yahweh says: “If those who do not deserve to suffer MET must suffer, you people of Edom must RHQ suffer much more DOU! You will not escape being punished.

lun_bawang: Ui sebuleng pangeh nepebulung, kebalaKu, Bawang Bosra miak mangun ku aceh luk inan megagap idi su luk ali-ali. Lemulun miak situnga neneh, idi neten ngadanneh ku kediman. Amung ruma' libut-libutneh miak uen ngusag macing ruked-ruked. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.”
english: I, Yahweh, have solemnly promised, using my own name, that your chief city Bozrah will become a place that people will be horrified about. It will be a heap of ruins. People will make fun of it and use its name when they curse people. All the nearby towns and villages will be a ruins forever.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yeremia, "Ui pangeh nengalap aceh bala ratnan Tuhan. Ieh nengecuk seburur lun duken mada' amung pupu, kebalaNeh, 'Ngamung baweh muyuh idi amé' munu' Edom! Do' muyuh temina' pebunu'!'
english: I heard this message from Yahweh: “I have sent an ambassador to many nations, to tell them to gather together to attack Edom. They must prepare for battle!”

lun_bawang: Tuhan miak ngelaya' bawangmu, pad seburur pana' nateh luk ngedita' namu.
english: And Yahweh says to the people of Edom, “I will cause your nation to become very unimportant among the other nations. They will all despise your country.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Aceh susa' luk pelaba rayeh miak macing kuan Edom, pad amung-amung lemulun luk lemaba miak megagap idi matot nier amung- amung luk pangeh nangun.
english: Edom will become a place about which people are horrified; people who pass by will be horrified and will ◄gasp/be shocked► when they see the destruction.

lun_bawang: Ukum miak macing kuan Edom, mepad kudeng ukum Sodom idi Gemora, ieh ineh kareb ideh idi amung bawang luk muneng inusag. Seburur pana' nateh luk miak mulun ieneh, segageh pana' nateh. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: Edom will be destroyed as completely as Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns were destroyed long ago. As a result, no one will live there any more DOU.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan kuan Damsik, "Lun bang bawang Hamat idi Arpad megagau idi mesusa' ngaceku ideh neninger bala luk dat. Susa' ngereb nedeh mepad kudeng abpa' rayeh, pad ideh na do' udeng.
english: This message is about Damascus. This is what Yahweh says: “The people in the nearby cities of Hamath and Arpad are confused, because they have heard bad news about Damascus. They are very anxious and restless, like SIM a sea in a big storm.

lun_bawang: Ui miak ngeseb amung libung batu Damsik idi ruma'-ruma' Raca' Benhadad pana'.”
english: And I, the Commander of the armies of angels, will start a fire to burn the walls that surround Damascus, and the palaces of King Ben-Hadad will be burned down.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ratnan pupu Kedar idi lun rayeh bawang Hasor, luk linaya' Nebukadnesar raca' Babil, "Amé' munu' nelun Kedar idi ngaté pupu luk rat pa busat aco ineh!
english: This is a message about the Kedar people-group and the kingdom of Hazor which the army of Nebuchadnezzar King of Babylon attacked. This is what Yahweh says: “I will cause an army to advance to attack Kedar and destroy those people who live east of Judah.

lun_bawang: "O lun Hasor, Ui ini Tuhan ngecuk nemuyuh buro amé' mado idi sigapung déi'. Nebukadnesar raca' Babil pian munu' nemuyuh, kebalaneh,
english: So I, Yahweh, say, ‘Run away quickly! You people who live in Hazor, go and hide in deep caves, because King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon wants to attack you with his army; he is planning to destroy you!’

lun_bawang: 'Miket! Do' tau munu' lemulun ineh luk ngerawé na inan susa'. Bawangdeh ineh na libung idi na tanga', idi teh na lun matar nedeh.' Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: But I say to Nebuchadnezzar, ‘Go up and attack that nation whose people feel secure; they do not have allies who will help them and do not have walls with gates that have bars in them.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud, "Ui miak ngaté amung lemulun luk mileh mayung ku busu luk pangeh nenganau' bawang Elam rayeh.
english: This is what the Commander of the armies of angels says: “The men of Elam are famous ◄archers/men who shoot arrows well►; that is how they have made their country very powerful. But I will get rid of them MET.

lun_bawang: "Mada' bala ini kuan amung pupu! Nateg tawak, idi maré kali'! Aleg ngalum ineh! Babil pangeh netabpa! Akangneh Marduk pangeh nebila'! Idi amung akang Babil pangeh inigu'. Amung akang luk inan megani' pangeh inusag!
english: This is what Yahweh says: “Proclaim DOU a message among the nations; do not withhold any of it; raise up a signal flag to announce that Babylon will be captured. Its chief god Marduk, whose other name is Bel, will be completely disgraced, and all the other statues and idols will be shattered.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Kareb ineh lun Israil idi lun Yahuda miak amé' nakap Negku luk Allahdeh dengan nangi'.
english: “But I, Yahweh, say that in the future, when that is about to happen, the people of Israel and the people of Judah will join together. They will be weeping and wanting to worship me, their God.

lun_bawang: "O Lun Israil, buro rat Babil! Necan bawang ineh! Do' muyuh buro atun!
english: But now, I say to the leaders of my people, ‘Flee from Babylon! Leave the land of Babylonia! Be like SIM male goats that go in front of the rest of the flock; lead my people back to their own land.

lun_bawang: "O Lun Babil, muyuh nengaro bawang pupuKu. Sagan tu pana' iko mawang niat idi do' ria', idi nalan mepad kudeng sapi' luk rumik padé, idi kudeng kuda luk muni,
english: “You people of Babylon who ◄plundered/stole everything valuable from► my chosen people, now you are very happy DOU. You run around joyfully like SIM a calf in a meadow, and are happy like SIM male horses are happy when they are neighing.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Lun Israil mepad kudeng dumba luk uen balang ngerada' idi ngatad. Pun-pun ideh binunu' raca' Asur, idi pangeh ineh Nebukadnesar raca' Babil ngim tulangdeh.
english: “The Israeli people are like MET sheep that have been scattered by lions. First the army of the King of Assyria defeated them. Then the army of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon smashed them.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh Ui ini, Tuhan luk Melalud, Allah lun Israil, miak ngukum Nebukadnesar idi bawangneh, mepad kudeng Ui nengukum raca' Asur.
english: So this is what I, the Commander of the armies of angels, the God whom the Israeli people worship, say: ‘Now I will punish the King of Babylon and the people of his land, like I punished the King of Assyria.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Do' munu' lemulun déi' Merataim idi Pekod. Do' ngaté nedeh. Do' nganau' amung luk dukenKu nemuyuh. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: “So, I, Yahweh, say to the enemies of Babylonia,‘Attack the people who live in the Merathaim region and the people in the Pekod region of Babylonia. Pursue them, kill them, and completely get rid of them, as I have commanded you to do.

lun_bawang: "O Babil, iko pelaba dita' niat. Ngaceku ineh, Ui ini, Tuhan luk Melalud, sikal metueh rat namu. Tarekneh pangeh nacing kareb iko miak kumin.
english: I, the Commander of the armies of angels, say this: ‘You arrogant/proud people, it is now the time; it is the time DOU when I will punish you.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud, "Amung lun Israil idi lun Yahuda pangeh pidereh. Amung-amung lun luk nenaban nedeh matar nedeh do'-do' idi na sikal muit nedeh.
english: I, the Commander of the armies of angels, also say this: ‘The people of Israel and Judah were ◄oppressed/treated cruelly►; those who captured them guarded them carefully and would not allow them to leave Babylon.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Até kuan Babil! Até kuan pupuneh, idi kuan lun rayeh idi lun mileh pana'.
english: I will send enemy soldiers carrying swords PRS to strike the people of Babylonia; they will strike the officials and wise men and all the other people who live in Babylon.

lun_bawang: Mepad kudeng luk inau'Ku kuan Sodom, Gemora, idi bawang luk muneng ku bawang ineh, kareb Ui nengusag nedeh, kudeng ineh teh luk miak ruenKu kuan Babil. Seburur pana' nateh luk miak mulun su ineh, segageh pana' nateh. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: I will destroy Babylon like I destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns; no one will ever live there again DOU.

lun_bawang: "Aceh pupu macing rat bawang luk pa tinueh busat aco, ieh ineh aceh bawang luk melalud rat mado luk temina' pebunu'.
english: Look! A great army will come from the north. A great nation far away with many kings is preparing to attack you people of Babylon.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ui ngacing aceh bui luk ngusag, kuan Babil idi pupuneh.
english: This is what Yahweh says: “I will inspire/motivate an army to destroy Babylon like a powerful wind MET, and also to destroy the people of Babylonia.

lun_bawang: Buro rat Babil, pad muyuh mulun. Aleg muyuh maté ngaceku sala' Babil. Ui miak ngua' idi ngukum neneh, maya' kudeng luk pangeh inau'neh
english: You people of Israel and Judah, flee from Babylon! Run away from there! Do not stay there and be killed when I punish the people of Babylon! It will be the time when I will get revenge; I will do to them what they deserve.

lun_bawang: Kebala lun sakai luk tudo déi', 'Kai nutun ngedengan Babil, iamo' mulai kai. Miket! Do' tau muli'. Allah pangeh nengukum Babil dengan amung tuehNeh, pad bawang ineh nabud nusag.' “
english: We foreigners would have tried to heal them, but now they cannot be healed. So we will not try to help them; we will abandon them, and return to our own lands, because it is as though the punishment they are receiving is so great that it reaches up to the clouds in sky, so great that no one can measure it.

lun_bawang: Tuhan nemudut tana' dengan lalud idi ilehNeh, idi Ieh nemalad langit dengan ilehNeh teh.
english: Yahweh created the earth by his power; he established it by his wisdom, and he stretched out the sky by his understanding.

lun_bawang: Amung lemulun dat ileh idi mebacé, amung lun luk mileh nganau' amas, dat niat ku akangdeh, ngaceku ideh ineh allah luk mebalih, idi na mulun.
english: People are senseless, and they know very little HYP; those who make idols are always disappointed, because their idols do nothing for them. The images/statues that they make are not real gods; they are lifeless.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O Babil, iko tunoKu idi busuKu luk ku nengelaya' tuda'-tuda' pupu idi tuda'-tuda' imet.
english: Yahweh says about the army of Babylonia (OR, about a nation that will attack Babylonia), “You have been like MET my battle-axe and war-club; with your power I have shattered nations and destroyed many kingdoms.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Muyuh miak nier Negku ngua' bawang Babil idi pupuneh, ngaceku amung dat luk inau'deh kuan Sion.
english: But, Yahweh also says, “Soon I will repay/punish you people in Babylon and in the rest of Babylonia for all the evil things that you have done in Jerusalem.

lun_bawang: O Babil, iko mepad kudeng aceh pegkung luk ngusag tana' ini, iamo' Ui ini Tuhan mangun ku bunu'mu. Ui miak ngakem namu, idi nala' namu luun tana', pad iko sabpen idi abuh mo' luk ketecan.
english: Babylonia is APO like MET a great mountain from which bandits descend to ◄plunder/steal things from► people all over the earth. But I, Yahweh, am the enemy of you people of Babylonia. I will raise my fist to strike you. I will knock you down from the cliffs and cause you to be only a huge pile of burned rubble.

lun_bawang: Na mio teh bunu'deh ineh miak narad nedeh idi ngeradu' nedeh mepad kudeng padé su luk inan rumik.' Tuhan luk Melalud, Allah lun Israil pangeh nepebala.”
english: This is what the Commander of the armies of angels, the God whom we Israelis worship, says; “Babylon is like SIM wheat on the ground where it is about to be threshed by animals tramping on it. Very soon their enemies will trample on the city of Babylon MET.”

lun_bawang: Raca' Babil nemulu' bawang Yerusalim, idi nekuman uangneh. Ieh nengukit amung-amung luk bang bawang ineh, mepad kudeng abpa' luk bang sidangur. Idi ieh nenelen ineh mepad kudeng galau. Idi ieh nengalap luk pianneh idi ieh nenala' luk na pianneh.
english: The army of Nebuchadnezzar, the King of Babylon, has attacked and crushed us Israeli people, and we have no strength left. It is as though they have swallowed us like a great monster that filled its belly with all our tasty parts, and then has spit out what it did not like.

lun_bawang: Nima' nelun Sion pebala, "Do' Babil mabeh sala' luk inau'neh kuan kai!" Nima' nelun Yerusalim pebala, "Do' Babil mabeh sala' ngaceku dereh luk icingneh kuan kai!”
english: So the people of PRS Jerusalem say to Yahweh, “Cause the people of Babylon to suffer like they caused us to suffer! Cause the people of Babylonia to be punished for killing MTY our people!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan nelun Yerusalim, "Ui miak ngedengan nemuyuh idi ngua' susa' muyuh. Ui miak nganau' bued abpa' idi amung arur Babil mekeket.
english: And this is what Yahweh replies to the people of Jerusalem: “I will be like your lawyer to defend you, and I will avenge you. I will dry up the river in Babylon and all the springs of water.

lun_bawang: Ui miak nguit nedeh kereten, mepad kudeng anak dumba, amék, idi dumba deléi. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: I will bring them down to a place where they will be slaughtered, like SIM someone who takes lambs or rams or goats to where they will be slaughtered for sacrifices.

lun_bawang: "Babil, ieh ineh bawang luk buren aput tana' ini, pangeh linaya'! Ieh pangeh nangun ku aceh luk inan megagap kuan amung pupu.
english: People all over the earth now ◄honor/praise► Babylon; they say that it is a great city. But I will cause it to become a place about which people of all nations are horrified.

lun_bawang: Do' amung muyuh buro ratnan usehKu luk pelaba bura'.
english: Yahweh also says, “My people, come out of Babylon! Run away from there! Run, because I, Yahweh, am extremely angry MTY with the people of Babylon, and I will get rid of them!

lun_bawang: Babil nengacing até kuan lemulun aput-aput tana', idi nekini Babil miak metabpa ngaceku ieh nengacing até kuan mula' lun Israil. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.”
english: Like the soldiers of Babylon killed the people of Israel and also killed others all over the world HYP, the people of Babylon must also be killed.

lun_bawang: Muyuh pebala, 'Kai pangeh dinat idi inigu'. Kai pelaba laya', ngaceku pupu baken pangeh nengalap su luk meligan bang Ruma' Allah.'
english: The Israeli people say, “We are ashamed. We are completely disgraced DOU, because foreigners have entered Yahweh’s temple and ◄defiled it/caused it to become unfit for worship►.”

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh, Ui pebala: Tarekneh malé macing kareb Ui ngukum amung akang Babil, idi lun luk nurat miak ngarod aput-aput bawangneh.
english: Yahweh replies, “That is true, but there will soon be a time when I will destroy the idols in Babylon, and throughout Babylonia there will be wounded people who will groan.

lun_bawang: "Ninger tangi' lemulun déi' Babil, idi tido ngaceku usag bawang.
english: Listen to the people of Babylon crying for help! And listen to the sounds of things being destroyed all over Babylonia!

lun_bawang: Libung batu Babil miak talan luun tana', idi amung tanga'neh luk rayeh miak sabpen. Amung kekamen anak itinneh na ulek, idi luk inau' amung pupu sabpen mo'. Tuhan luk Melalud pangeh nepebala.”
english: Yahweh also says, “The thick walls around Babylon will be flattened to the ground. The city gates will be burned. People from other countries will work hard to save the city, but it will be ◄in vain/useless►, because everything that they have built will be destroyed by fire.”

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh ni Seraya, "Kareb iko macing déi' Babil, do' iko maca' kuan lun mula' dengan rayeh arod amung-amung bala luk inayud bang surat ini.
english: He said to Seraiah, “When you arrive in Babylon, read aloud everything that I have written on this scroll.

lun_bawang: Lutakneh petatem nan takipneh, iamo' na ieh nengerawé kekipedneh. Ebpehneh pelaba dat, pad ieh na miak buken. Bunu'neh metueh idi ieh mutuh éi' ratnan Tuhan.
english: The city has become filthy because of PRS the sins that the people have committed; they did not think about what could happen to the city. Now the city has been destroyed, and there is no one to comfort the people. The people cry out saying, “Yahweh, look at how we are suffering because our enemies have defeated us!”

lun_bawang: Pupuneh ngarod kareb nakap akan. Ideh ngelibal binawehdeh ku akan, pad ideh miak mulun. "Nier negku, Tuhan," kebala Yerusalim, "Nier derehku".
english: The people of the city groan while they search for food; they have given their treasures to get food to eat to remain alive. They say, “Yahweh, look at us, and see that we are despised!”

lun_bawang: "Nier negku!" kebala Yerusalim kuan lemulun luk lemaba. "Na lun mét kudeng ui, Et ineh pangeh icing Tuhan kareb Ieh museh negku.
english: You people who pass by, you do not RHQ seem to care at all about what has happened to us. Look around and see that there are no other RHQ people who are suffering like we are. Yahweh has caused us to suffer because he was extremely angry with us.

lun_bawang: "Ieh nengacing apui rat déi' dita' luk ngeseb bang bururku. Ieh netumen abpung kuanku, pad ui mebpeh. Ieh nenecan negku, idi ui mét tebaco-tebaco.
english: It is as though he sent a fire from heaven MTY that burned in our bones; it is as though MET he has placed a trap for our feet, and has prevented us from walking any further. He has abandoned us; we are weak/miserable every day, all day long.

lun_bawang: "Tuhan meriruh ku bawehku luk meluun tueh. Ieh nengecuk aceh baweh ngerieng negku, idi nengaté anak adi'ku luk deléi. Ieh nengareg pupuku luk meluun do', mepad kudeng bua' anggur luk ridu'.
english: Yahweh looked at our mighty soldiers and laughed at them. He has summoned a great army to come and crush our young soldiers. It is as though MET Yahweh has trampled on us people of Judah like SIM people trample on grapes in a pit to make wine.

lun_bawang: "Ineh punneh abpa' matehku mebpeh. Idi ui na miak buken idi mawang niat. Bunu' ineh metueh rat nekai; idi pupuku pelaba susa' niat.
english: I weep because of all those things; my eyes are filled with tears. There is no one to comfort me; those who could encourage me are far away. Our enemies have conquered us, so our children have nothing good to ◄hope for/expect to happen►.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' Tuhan ineh mesiri, ngaceku ui nengelaba balaNeh. Ninger balaku, O amung pupu, idi nier derehku. Anak adi'ku luk delei idi decur pangeh tiban.
english: But what Yahweh has done to us is fair, because we have rebelled against obeying the commands that he gave us. You people everywhere, listen to us; look and see that we are suffering greatly. We had many sons and daughters, but they have been captured and forced to go to distant countries.

lun_bawang: "Ui nenawar rurumku, iamo' ideh na pian ngedengan negku. Amung imam idi lun rayeh pana' naté luun dalan. Kareb ideh nenakap akan.
english: We pleaded with our allies to help us, but they all refused. Our priests and our leaders have died from hunger in the city while they were searching for food to eat to remain alive.

lun_bawang: "O Tuhan, nier derehku idi susa' niatku! Niatku nginuud ku sala'ku. Inan até luun dalan, idi bang ruma' pana' inan teh até.
english: Yahweh, see that we are suffering very much. It is as though our inner beings are tormented. We are sad SYN because we have rebelled against you. Our enemies kill people in the streets with their swords; people are dying because they have no food to eat.

lun_bawang: "Ngukum nedeh ngaceku datdeh. Mepad kudeng Iko nengukum negku ngaceku sala'ku. Ui ngarod ku derehku, idi teh ui mesusa' niat."
english: Yahweh, see all the evil things that they have done and punish them! Punish them like you have punished us for all the sins that we committed! We say this to you because we suffer and groan very much, and we ◄faint/are very sad►.

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh nan tinandeh, "Iapehké nuba'?" Ideh mebpeh luun dalan, mepad kudeng lun nurat, idi maté bang abin tinandeh.
english: They cry out to their mothers, “We need RHQ something to eat and drink!” They faint like wounded men in the streets of the city. They slowly die in the arms of their mothers.

lun_bawang: Lemulun luk maya' dalan lemaba bawang, situnga idi mepag palad. Ideh siguling idi meriruh ku usag Yerusalim. "Iniké bawang luk pelaba do' taga?" Ideh meriruh. "Iniké luk ku awang amung tana' ini?”
english: All those who pass by you make fun of IDM you; they shake their heads and they hiss/sneer at you. They say, “Is this that great city of Jerusalem? Is it the city that was the most beautiful city in the world, the city that caused all the people on the earth to be joyful?”

lun_bawang: Amung bunu'mu situnga namu idi nutong namu dengan gateh niatdeh. Ideh ngeraceng, kebaladeh, "Kai nengusag ineh! Ini aco luk inan kai nginulat!”
english: Now all our enemies scoff IDM at you; they hiss/sneer at you and gnash their teeth to show that they hate you. They say, “We have destroyed them! This is what we longed/waited for, and now it has happened!”

lun_bawang: O Tuhan, nier nelun luk uenMu ngedereh! Decur kuman butung anak luk inandeh mawa! Imam idi nabi pana' pitayen bang Ruma' Allah!
english: Yahweh, look, and think about it! Have you ever RHQ caused people to suffer like this before? It is certainly not right that RHQ women are eating the flesh of their own children, the children whom they have always taken care of! It is not right that RHQ priests and prophets are being killed in your own temple!

lun_bawang: Butung anak adi' idi lun mengered telubid luun dalan, anak adi' luk deléi idi decur luk pinaté bunu'. Dengan na méi' Iko nengaté nedeh, kareb aco usehMu.
english: The corpses of people of all ages lie in the streets; there are even corpses of young men and young women who have been killed by our enemies’ swords. Because you were very angry, you caused them to be killed; you have slaughtered them without pitying them at all.

lun_bawang: Na mio teh ui maté; rapetku nan Tuhan pangeh neburo.
english: I continued to say to myself, “I no longer expect to live much longer; I no longer confidently expect to receive good things from Yahweh!”

lun_bawang: Tuhan mo' luk kuanku, idi ui merapet Neneh.
english: So I say to myself, “Yahweh is all that I need; so I will confidently wait for him to do good things for me.”

lun_bawang: "Kai nenganau' sala' idi sikal metueh rat Namu, O Tuhan, idi na Iko maré do' nekai.
english: “We have sinned and rebelled against you, and you have not forgiven us.

lun_bawang: "Iko nengerada' idi nengaté nekai, éi'Mu liniged ku usehMu.
english: You have surrounded us with your anger and pursued us; you have slaughtered us without pitying us.

lun_bawang: "Kai dinat idi inan bunu' kai situnga.
english: All our enemies have insulted us.

lun_bawang: Abpa' temubu', idi ui ngerawé maté.
english: The water in the pit rose above my head, and I said to myself, “I am about to die/drown!”

lun_bawang: Kareb ui nemutuh Namu ninger sembayangku, idi Iko neninger.
english: I pleaded with you, “Do not refuse to heed MTY me while I cry out to you!”

lun_bawang: Iko nengua' putuhku, idi nemada' negku pad ui na matot.
english: Then you answered me and said, “Do not be afraid!”

lun_bawang: Lun baken pebala, "Buro muyuh. Melutak muyuhneh. Aleg ngakem negku!" Idi ideh lawé-lawé rat aceh bawang macing nan bawang baken. Idi na lun pian nganak nedeh.
english: The people who were alive shouted, “Stay away from us DOU! You are defiled/untouchable! Do not touch us!” So the prophets and priests fled from Israel, and they wandered around from one country to another, because people in each country kept saying to them, “You cannot stay here!”

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, do' iko mudur. Ui pian pebala namu.”
english: He said to me, “You human, stand up while I speak to you.”

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, Ui ngecuk namu amé' nelun Israil, luk sikal metueh idi luk neteketed rat Negku. Macing nekini pana' ideh sikal metueh rat Negku mepad kudeng tepundeh.
english: He said, “You human, I will send you to the Israeli people. They are people who have turned away from me and rebelled against me. Their ancestors rebelled against me, and they themselves are still rebelling against me.

lun_bawang: Kebala Allah, "O lemulun, do' iko kuman surat ini, idi amé' pebala nelun Israil.”
english: He said to me, “You human, eat this scroll that is in front of you. Then go and speak to the Israeli people MTY.”

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "O lemulun, kuman surat ini luk barénKu namu. Ngebor batekmu ku ineh." Ui nekuman ineh, idi ieh mén mepad kudeng duru' tebikan.
english: Then he said to me, “You human, eat the scroll that I have given to you. Fill your stomach with it.” So I ate it, and in my mouth it tasted as sweet as honey.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Allah, "O lemulun, amé' nelun Israil, idi mada' nedeh ratnan luk belénKu namu.
english: Then he said to me, “You human, go to the Israeli people MTY and tell them my message.

lun_bawang: Kebala Allah, "O lemulun, ninger do'-do' idi ngerawé amung-amung luk belénKu namu.
english: He also said to me, “You human, listen very carefully to what I say, and keep thinking about it IDM.

lun_bawang: Idi Roh Allah nengikit negku, idi ui neninger aceh arod pa ketedku luk mepad rayeh kudeng uni ruyuh tana', kebalaneh, "Ngubur rayeh Tuhan luk déi' dita'!”
english: Thenin the vision the Spiritof God lifted me up, and I heard behind mesomeone speaking very loudly, like a loud rumbling sound. I heard someone say, “Praise our glorious Yahweh in the place where he livesin heaven!”

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "O lemulun, Ui nganau' namu mangun ku lun luk matar bawang kuan pupu Israil. Do' iko mada' balaKu nedeh.
english: “You human, I am appointing youto be like a watchman MET for the Israeli people MTY. So listen to these messages that I will give you, and tell them those messages to warn them.

lun_bawang: Idi lalud Tuhan neketukan luunku, idi ui neninger balaNeh negku, "Tumui iko idi amé' luun raked. Idi Ui miak pebala namu déi'.”
english: I felt Yahweh take control MTY of me, and he said to me, “Get up and go outfrom the city down to the plain/valley, and there I will speak to you.”

lun_bawang: iamo' Roh Allah nesemuet bang negku idi nenui negku. Idi kebala Tuhan negku, "Do' iko muli', semuet bang ruma'mu idi ngitek tanga' ruma'mu ineh.
english: Then the Spiritof God entered me and enabled me to stand up. He said to me, “Go into your house and stay inside it.

lun_bawang: Kebala Allah, "O lemulun, do' ngalap aceh batu bata, idi nganau' neneh pa atunmu, idi ngarit aceh ayu bawang Yerusalim luunneh.
english: Yahweh also said to me, “You human, take a large clay tablet/brick and put it in front of you. Then on the clayengrave/draw on it lines that represent Jerusalem.

lun_bawang: "Telubid tebiring pa kabing, idi Ui ngerareng sala' pupu Israil luunmu. Iko miak telubid su ineh idi mabeh sala'deh,
english: Then lie on your left side, and stay like that for 390 days. That willsymbolize that the Israeli people will be punished for their sins; you must lie like that one day for each year during which they will be punished.

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh tebiring selipa idi mabeh sala' Yahuda apat ngepulu' aco kinioneh — seaco mangun ku aceh lak ku pinginud ukumdeh.
english: Turn your face towardthe drawing of Jerusalem and bare your armlike a soldier does who prepares to go into a battle MTY, and prophesy aboutwhat will happen to the city.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Kareb Ui matad nelun Israil bang bawang pupu baken, kudeng ineh teh lawédeh kuman akan luk bibpeng ukum Musa.”
english: Then I said, “No, Yahweh God!Do not force me to do that! I have never caused myself to become unacceptable to you by doing anything like that. From the time when I was young, I have never eaten meat of any animal that was found dead or that had been killed by wild animals. And I have never eaten any meat that is unacceptable to you.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Allah, "Kudeng pieh kudeng ineh, miak iko makai téi' sapi' idi ngeseb rutimu luun ineh.”
english: Then he said to me, “You human, I will cause the supply of food to Jerusalem to be cut off. Then the people will eat the small amounts of food and drink the small amounts of waterthat the government permits them to have, and they will be very distressed and anxious as they do that,

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebalaNeh, "O lemulun, Ui miak ngesusa' bawang Yerusalim, pad ideh na inan petap ruti kenendeh. Dengan merapang ideh miak nguad akan idi abpa' luk rupendeh.
english: because water and food will be very scarce. They will see each other becoming extremely thin, and they will be appalled; but this will happen because they are being punished for the sins that they have committed.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Allah, "O lemulun, do' ngalap aceh pelapet luk metadem. Mingit buluh tangmu idi abpukmu. Nimang abpuk ineh, idi mabpat neneh mangun ku teluh babpat.
english: “Also, you human, when you start doing those things, take a sharp sword and use it like SIM a razor to shave your head and your beard. Then put the hair that you shaved off on scales, and divide the hairinto three equal parts.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan, "Nier bawang Yerusalim. Ui nemudut neneh uned tana' ini, dengan bawang baken libut-libutneh.
english: This is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: ‘Thisdrawing will represent Jerusalem, the city which I have set in the center of the nations, with other countries around it.

lun_bawang: "Iko miak kali' useh idi gatehKu luk mebura', pad Ui musam. Kareb amung ini mangun, iko miak kali' idi Ui ini Tuhan nepebala namu dengan usehKu, ngaceku iko na lutep maya' Negku.
english: Then I will no longer be angry with you; I will stop punishing MTY you after I have gotten revenge on you. And when I stop punishing you, you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken to you because I have been very strongly concerned aboutwhat you have done.

lun_bawang: Amung-amung lun pupu baken luk libut-libutmu idi luk lemaba namu miak situnga namu rat mado.
english: I will cause your city to be a ruins, with the result that people of other nations that are around you will pass by and see it and sneer at you.

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, nier amung pegkung déi' bawang Israil, idi mada' balaKu nedeh.
english: “You human, turn toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy aboutwhat will happen to them, and say,

lun_bawang: "Ui nima' sebuang lemulun mulun amé' arang pupu baken,
english: But I will allow some of the Israelis to remain alive. They will escape being killed when their enemies scatter them among many other nations.

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, Ui ini Tuhan, idi ini balaKu kuan tana' lun Israil. Ini kekipedneh, idi teh kekiped amung tana' lun Israil.
english: “You human, this is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say to the people MTY of Israel: All of Israel will soon be destroyed.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan, "Susa' megéi' macing namu.
english: This is also what Yahweh the Lord says: “You will soon experience many terrible disasters!

lun_bawang: Aco dereh malé macing. Kekamen luk dat amé' mula'. Dita' niat iuk-iuk amé' rayeh.
english: The dayof your punishment is here! It has arrived! Disasters have come.

lun_bawang: Inan lemulun pekakem luun dalan déi' kadai, idi bang ruma' inan lemulun luk mét idi melau. Idé-idé luk déi' lati' miak maté bang bunu', idi idé-idé luk bang bawang miak maté ku ét idi lau.
english: When those things happen, your enemies will be outsidethe city with their swords, and there will be plagues and famines insidethe city. Thosewho flee from the city into the countryside will be killed bytheir enemies’ swords, and those who stay in the city will die from famines and plagues.

lun_bawang: "Iapeh-iapeh pana' inan gagau. Mula' lun luk ngaté lemulun idi mula' lun luk dat bang bawang muyuh ineh.
english: Prepare chains to be fastened on you. People are being murdered MTY throughout the country, and people are acting violently throughout the city.

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "O lemulun, mesut alad su ini." Idi ui nemesut neneh idi nekali' aceh tanga'.
english: He said to me, “You human, dig through the wall here.” So I dug through the wall, and I saw a doorway inside.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh, "Semuet idi nier kekamendeh luk dat ineh.”
english: He said to me, “Go in and see the wicked and detestable things that they are doing there!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan negku, "Iko miak nier kekamendeh luk meluun dat ratnan ineh.”
english: He also said, “But you will see things that are even more detestable!”

lun_bawang: Idi Allah nengitun negku, kebalaNeh, "O lemulun, kali'muké ineh? Iko miak nier kekamendeh luk meluun dat ratnan ineh.”
english: He said to me, “You human, you see this RHQ, but you will see things that are more detestable than this!”

lun_bawang: Idi ui neninger Allah ngitang, kebalaNeh, "Amé' tungé' amung muyuh luk ngukum bawang ini, idi nguit repapeh muyuh.”
english: Then I heard Yahweh call out loudly, “You men who are going to punish this city, bring here the guards of the city, each carrying a weapon.”

lun_bawang: "Do' amé' nalan aput bawang Yerusalim, idi nganau' aceh tanu' luun madu' amung lemulun luk mesusa' niat ngaceku amung kekamen luk dat luk ruen lun bang bawang ineh.”
english: and said to him, “Go throughout Jerusalem and put a mark on the foreheads of those who are very sad DOU because of the detestable things that are being done inside the city.”

lun_bawang: Idi ui neninger bala Allah kuan lun baken ineh, "Maya' neneh nalan aput bawang idi ngaté lemulun. Aleg méi' inan seburur lemulun pana'.
english: While I was listening, he said to the other six men, “Follow the man wearing the white robe, and kill people. Do not pity them or act mercifully toward them.

lun_bawang: Kebala Allah nedeh, "ngelutak Ruma' Allah. Manu' natad ineh ku butung. Kai muyuh!" Idi ideh nengimun ngaté lemulun bang bawang ineh.
english: Then Yahweh said to those men, “Pollute the temple by filling the courtyardwith the corpses of those whom you kill! Start now!” So they went out and starting killing people throughout the city.

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh ngaté lemulun, ui sebuleng luk idi. Ui netekeradung luun tana' idi nengitang, kebalaku, "O Tuhan Allah, miakké Iko ngaté amung-amung lun Israil luk ketecan ngaceku usehMu nan bawang Yerusalim?”
english: While they were doing that, I was left alone. I prostrated myself on the ground and cried out, “Yahweh my Lord, are you going to get rid of all the people of Israel and Judah who are still alive, while you are severely punishing MTY the people of  Jerusalem?”

lun_bawang: Idi lemulun luk ngayung ku kibung pu ineh nepebala inan Tuhan, "Ui pangeh nemaya' balaMu."
english: Then the man wearing the linen robe returned, saying, “I have done what you commanded me to do.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Tuhan nengecuk lemulun luk ngayung ku kibung pu ngalap apui rat arang roda luk liang pung-pung ineh, idi ieh iné' tuped iring sebuleng roda ineh.
english: When Yahweh commanded the man wearing the linen robe to take burning coals from among those winged creatures, the man went intothe courtyard and stood beside one of the wheels.

lun_bawang: Amung roda ini mepad kudeng roda bang luk sinierku atun.
english: I heard someone call them ‘the whirling wheels’.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Allah negku, "O lemulun, ini lemulun luk dat luk ngakem bang bawang ini maya' terawédeh sebuleng.
english: Yahweh said to me, “You human, these are the new leaders in Jerusalem who are planning to do evil things and who are giving wicked advice to people in this city.

lun_bawang: Roh Tuhan neketukan negku, idi Tuhan nengecuk negku mada' bala ini nelun mula': "O lun Israil, Ui kali' luk belén muyuh idi luk teruayen muyuh.
english: Then the Spirit of Yahweh came upon me and told me to sayto the people, “This is what Yahweh says: You Israeli people MTY are saying those things, but I know what you are thinking.

lun_bawang: "Ui ini Tuhan, idi ini balaKu nemuyuh. Matu bawang ini mangun ku lacang, iamo' uang pung pinginud anunké? Ieh ineh amung butung luk pinaté muyuh! Iamo' muyuh miak talan rat bang bawang ini.
english: Therefore this is what Yahweh the Lord says: The corpses of the people whom you have killed here are like the meat MET, and this city is like the pot MET, but I will expel you from this city.

lun_bawang: Ui nala' nemuyuh rat bang bawang ini idi maré nemuyuh bang palad lun pupu baken. Muyuh mekaneh ukum maté.
english: I will expel you from this city and enable foreigners to capture you and punish you.

lun_bawang: Kareb ui uned mada' luk biré Tuhan ineh, Pelatia Benaya neluka' idi naté. Ui netekeradung idi nengitang, "Adui, Tuhan Allah! Miakké Iko ngaté amung lun Israil luk ketecan?”
english: While I was prophesying that, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah suddenly died. Then I prostrated myself on the ground and cried out loudly, “Yahweh my Lord, are you going tosimilarly get rid of all the Israeli people who are still alive?”

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku ineh do' mada' nedeh, kebalamu, Kudeng ini bala Tuhan: Ui miak ngamung nedeh ratnan bawang su luk inanKu nengatad nedeh, idi Ui maré tana' Israil lemubed kuandeh.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng Ui ngecuk pung luk meliput ngaté nedeh, idi bawang ineh pelaba susa', pad na miak nalan su ineh,

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaku, "O Tuhan Allah, amung lemulun ngilang negku, ngaceku ui megéi' pebala ratnan luk pinginud."
english: Then I said, “Yahweh, my Lord, when I tell things like this to people, they do not believe me. They say about me, ‘He is only telling parables.’ ”

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, do' ngadu' bawang Yerusalim, idi ngadu' su luk inan pupu ineh sembayang. Mada' bawang Israil,
english: “You human, turn toward Jerusalem. Preach about what will happen to the temple there. Preach about what will happen to the Israeli people.

lun_bawang: 'Kudeng ini bala Tuhan, Ui pian munu' nemuyuh, idi ngaté nemuyuh ku pelapetKu, do' lemulun luk do' idi lemulun luk dat pana',
english: Say to them, ‘This is what Yahweh says: I am opposed to you.

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, do' iko ngarod rayeh-rayeh siren amung lemulun mepad kudeng lemulun luk na merapet.
english: Therefore, you human, groan! Groan in front of the Israeli people very sadly and sorrowfully IDM, DOU.

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, mada' bala luk biré Tuhan. Mada' pupu ini luk belén Tuhan: Pelapet, ieh ineh pelapet luk metadem idi mesilo;
english: “You human, prophesy and say to them, ‘This is what Yahweh says: I have sharpened my sword and polished it.

lun_bawang: Ui nutun pupuKu, idi kudeng ideh ara' uren, kali' rungen amung ini mangun kuandeh.
english: I am about to test my people, and the kings MTY of Judah will not escape being punished. That is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say.

lun_bawang: "O raca' Israil luk dat idi luk na meligan. Tarekmu pangeh nacing, ieh ineh aco luk inanmu kumin.
english: Also, say, ‘You very wicked DOU king of Israel, it is your timeto die. It is the time for you to be punished.’

lun_bawang: Ui ini Tuhan Allah pangeh nepebala. Do' ngedita' luk mebeneh, idi ngebeneh luk medita'!
english: And this is what Yahweh the Lord says to you soldiers from Babylonia: ‘Take off the king’s turban and his crown, because now things will be different than they were before. Thosein Jerusalem who had no authority will now be given authority, and those who had authority will have their authority taken from them.

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, inanké iko temina' ngukum bawang luk mepanu' ku lun luk ngaté? Mada' neneh ratnan amung-amung kekamenneh luk dat.
english: “You human, are you ready to condemn the people of Jerusalem? It is RHQ a city full of murderers MTY. Remind them of all the detestable things that they have done.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Ngaceku iko pangeh nengaté mula' pupumu sebuleng, idi ngaceku iko pangeh nengelutak bururmu sebuleng, ngaceku sembayang inan akang, kali' rungen tarekmu macing.
english: Then say, ‘This is what Yahweh the Lord says: By your murdering people and by ◄defiling yourselves/making yourselves unacceptable to God► by making idols, you people of this city APO have brought to yourselves the time when you will be destroyed.

lun_bawang: Amung lun rayeh Israil merapet ku tuehdeh sebuleng idi megéi' ngaté lemulun.
english: Think about how each of your Israeli kings have used their power to cause people to be murdered MTY.

lun_bawang: "Ui miak ngukum namu ngaceku iko mano idi ngaté lemulun.
english: So I will shake my fists at you to show that I am angry with you because of your stealing money from people and murdering MTY people who live among you.

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, lun Israil na ulek kuanKu. Ideh mepad kudeng teceh tekaling, semara' luk mebuda', belawan, idi semara' luk mitem kareb pirak pangeh linigan bang tetel.
english: “You human, your Israeli people MTY have becomeuseless to me. They are like  MET dross/slag to me. They are like SIM theworthless copper, tin, iron, and lead that remains after silver is melted in avery hot furnace.

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, mada' nelun Israil, kudeng ini bala Tuhan: Muyuh mepad kudeng aceh bawang luk na inan udan idi luk na linigan, luk miak kumin ku usehKu.
english: “You human, say to the Israeli people, ‘WhenYahweh is angry with you, there has been no rain or showers in your country.’

lun_bawang: Ui nenakap lemulun luk miak mudut aceh libung, idi luk miak tuped su luk inusag, pad matar bawang kareb ieh uen ngusag ku usehKu, iamo' nateh luk nekali'Ku.
english: I looked among them to find a man who would cause the people of the city to repent MET so that I would not need to get rid of them. But I did not find anyone.

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, inan dueh denganak decur.
english: “You human, listen to this parable about Jerusalem and Samaria. Once there were two women, daughters of the same mother.

lun_bawang: Sagan tu pana' ieh awanKu, Oholah megéi' pasét idi melili ku deléi luk inanneh mawa rat bawang Asur, ieh ineh lun pebunu'
english: Oholah acted like a prostitute while she was still my wife. She desired to have sex with those she loved—soldiers from Assyria.

lun_bawang: pad Ui nemaré neneh kuan lun Asur luk inanneh mawa idi luk pianneh.
english: So I allowed the Assyrian soldiers, whom she wanted to have sex with, to capture her.

lun_bawang: "Sagan tu pana' Oholibah nekali' amung ineh, ieh meluun dat idi ucet pasét meluun ratnan kinanakneh Oholah.
english: Heryounger sister Oholibah saw those thingsthat happened to Oholah, but she was a prostitute, and she desired to have sex with men more than herolder sister had desired.

lun_bawang: -15"Idi ieh iuk-iuk ucet pasét. Idi teh ieh melili ku ayu lun rayeh-rayeh Babil luk inarit luun alad luk sinat ku sat mesia', dengan abet awa'deh idi sigardeh pana'.
english: But she did even worse things. She saw drawings of men from Babylonia on the walls, painted in red.

lun_bawang: "O Oholibah, kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Iko musam ku deléi ineh luk mawa namu, iamo' Ui nganau' nedeh megateh namu pad ideh ngelibut namu.
english: “Oholibahrepresents you people of Jerusalem. Therefore, this is what I, Yahweh the Lord say: ‘I will cause those soldiers who loved you but whom you turned away from because you became disgusted with them, to be angry with you. I will cause them to come and attack you from every side—

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah, "Ui maré namu bang palad lemulun luk inanmu museh idi megileg.
english: This is what I, Yahweh the Lord say: ‘I am about to allow those whom you hate, those you became disgusted with and turned away from, to capture you.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Iko miak ngirup ratnan sangkir kinanakmu; ieh rayeh idi medalem. Amung lemulun miak situnga namu; sangkir ineh mepanu'.
english: This is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: ‘You will suffer like people suffer when they drink from a cup a lot of strong alcoholic drink: It will be as though you will drink from the cup that the people of Samaria drank from; a big and tall cup. Because of your drinking what is in that cup, many people will scorn you and make fun of you because there is a lot of liquid in that cup.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah, "Ngaceku iko nekelupan Negku idi neteketed rat Negku, iko miak medereh ngaceku lili idi sétmu.”
english: Therefore, this is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: ‘Because you have forgotten me and rejected me IDM, you must be punished for your immoral behavior and for beinglike a prostitute.’ ”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan negku, "O lemulun, temina'ké iko ngukum ni Oholah idi Oholibah? Do' ngadu' nedidueh ngaceku kekamen didueh luk dat.
english: Yahweh said to me, “You human, you must RHQ judgethe people of those two cities represented by Oholah and Oholibah. You must remind them of their detestable behavior:

lun_bawang: "Didueh nengecuk nelun duken amé' nawar deléi rat bawang luk mado, idi deléi ineh nacing. Didueh decur ineh nediu' idi nenat mateh idi nenganau' bané.
english: They sent messages to men in countries far away. And when those men arrived, the women of those two cities bathed themselves for them, painted their eyebrows, and put on jewelry.

lun_bawang: Arod lemulun luk marot pedingeren, ieh ineh deléi luk inuit rat déi' su luk ali-ali. Ideh nenganau' leku' luun langen dueh decur ineh idi pata luun uluh didueh.
english: Soon there was a noisy crowd around them. Among the crowd there were men from Sheba who had come from the desertof Arabia. They put bracelets on the arms of the two sisters and put beautiful crowns on their heads.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah, "Nguit aceh baweh idi ngatot nedidueh idi ngaro binaweh didueh.
english: So this is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: Bring a mob to attack Samaria and Jerusalem, and allow that mob to cause the people of those cities to be terrified, and to rob them.

lun_bawang: Ui miak ngagka' sét aput bawang ineh, pad mebpeng decur na pasét mepad kudeng didueh.
english: In that way I will cause them to stop their immoral behavior. It will warn other women to not imitate/do what you people of Jerusalem are doing.

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "O lemulun, do' ngayud aco bulan aco sini, ngaceku aco sini raca' Babil ngimun ngerieng Yerusalim.
english: “You human, write down what day of the month this is. On this daythe army ofthe King of Babylon has surrounded Jerusalem.

lun_bawang: Mada' luk pinginud ini kuan pupuKu luk sikal metueh. Kudeng ini bala Tuhan: 'Nganau' lacang luun apui, idi manu' neneh ku abpa'.
english: Tell those rebellious Israeli people MTY in Babylon a parable. Say this to them: This is what Yahweh the Lord says: ‘Pour water into the cooking pot and put the pot onthe fire.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah, "Bawang lun luk ngaté pangeh inukum! Ieh mepad kudeng lacang luk metugor luk na tu isa. Uang pung ineh ilap tesebuleng-tesebuleng pad na luk ketecan.
english: Do that because this is what Yahweh the Lord says: ‘Terrible things will happen toJerusalem; it is city that is full of murderers MTY, a city that is like MET a scorched pot whose black residue inside cannot be removed. Take the pieces of meat out of the pot, but do not choose which pieces to take out.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ina até bang bawang rayeh. Iamo' dara' na inutang luun tana' su luk inan abuh miak ngapung neneh. Iamo' ieh inutang luun batu.
