english: The blood of the people who were murdered in Jerusalem is still there; they were murdered on the bare rocks, not on the soil, where their blood could be covered.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan, "Bawang lun luk ngaté pangeh inukum! Ui sebuleng miak ngamung kayuh apui.
english: Therefore, this is what I, Yahweh the Lord say: ‘Terrible things will happen to that city that is full of murderers MTY! It will be as though I also will pile high the wood in the fire.

lun_bawang: O Yerusalim, kekamenmu luk dat pangeh nengelutak namu. Sagan tu pana' Ui nenutun ngeligan namu, iko melutak teh. Iko na mangun meligan teh kareb nateh iko kali' usehKu luk mebura'.
english: The rustin the pot represents your immoral behavior. I tried to cleanse you from your wicked behavior, but you did not allow me to do that. So you will not be cleansedfrom the guilt of your sin untilI have punished you and I am no longer angry.

lun_bawang: Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala. Tarekmu pangeh nacing, pad Ui na miak méi' namu idi mekelupan datmu. Iko miak kumin ngaceku amung kekamenmu." Tuhan Allah pangeh nepebala.
english: I, Yahweh, have said that I will surely punish you. And it is time for me to do that. I will not change my mind; I will not refrain from punishing you, and I will not pity you. I will judge you and punish you as you deserve to be punished for your sinful behavior. That will surely happen because I, Yahweh the Lord, have said it.” ’ ”

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, denak-denak Ui sikal ngalap lemulun luk inanmu meluun awa. Aleg iko medureng, temindo, idi nangi'.
english: “You human, I am going to suddenly take from youyour wife, whom you love very much. Butwhen she dies, do notshow that you are sad or lament or cry.

lun_bawang: Kebala lun mula', "Ngudehké iko nganau' luk kudeng ineh?”
english: Then the people asked me, “What do the things that you are doing signify to us?”

lun_bawang: Kebalaku nedeh, "Tuhan nengecuk negku
english: So I said to them, “This is what Yahweh told me:

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O lemulun, nekini Ui miak ngusag Ruma' Allah luk meraben luk inandeh medita' niat idi mawang niat, ngaceku ideh pian ngikak idi nier neneh. Idi Ui miak ngaté anakdeh luk deléi idi decur pana'.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “You human, soon I will destroy their sacred temple, which they rejoice about and which they respect and delight to look at, and I will get rid of their sons and daughters also.

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, do' mada' sala' bawang Amon.
english: “You human, turn toward where the Ammon people-grouplives, and prophesy aboutwhat will happen to them.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah, 'Muyuh nemepag palad idi nuput ku awang niat muyuh. Muyuh nesitunga nan bawang Israil.
english: This is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: “You clapped your handsjoyfully and stomped your feet, and laughed because you despised the people in the land of Israel.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Ngaceku kebala Moab, 'Yahuda ineh mepad kudeng amung pupu baken,'
english: This is also what Yahweh the Lord says: “The people of  Moabsouth of Ammon and the people of Seirsouth of Moab despised Israel and said, ‘The people MTY of Israel have becomeas unimportant as all the other nations!’

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Dengan megateh niat lun Edom nengua' dat Yahuda, idi ngaceku ineh Edom mesala'.
english: This is also what Yahweh the Lord says: “You people of Edom are guilty of getting revenge on the people MTY of Judah.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Ui miak ngukum Edom idi ngaté amung lemulun idi pung pana' bang bawang ineh. Ui nganau' bawang Edom mangun ku su luk ali-ali rat bawang Teman macing bawang Dedan. Amung pupu ineh pitayen bang bunu'.
english: Therefore this is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: 'I will use my power against the people of Edom and will get rid of their men and their animals. I will ruin the land from Teman region in central Edom to Dedan region in the south of Edom, and many of their men will be killed bytheir enemies swords.'

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Dengan megateh niat lun Pilistin pangeh nengua' dat bunu'deh luk mon pad ideh pitayendeh.
english: This is also what Yahweh the Lord says: “The Philistia people-group wanted very much to get revenge on the people of Judah. They very maliciously wanted to destroy Judah.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan: Ui miak ngerieng nelun Pilistin pad ideh mabud. Ui miak ngaté amung lemulun luk neketecan luun Raked Pilistin.
english: Therefore this is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: I am about to use my power MTY against the Philistia people. I will get rid of the Kereth people-group and all those who live along the coast of the Mediterranean Sea.

lun_bawang: O lemulun, lun Sur ngitang ku awang niatdeh, kebaladeh, 'Bunu' tau Yerusalim pangeh inusag! Amung tanga'neh pangeh mukab kuan tau. Usagneh miak ngacing utung kuan tau!'
english: “You human, the people of Tyre city shouted joyfully and said about Jerusalem, ‘Jerusalem, the city from which many traders/merchants went to many nations, is now destroyed. And now people from all over the world will come to us to buy and sell things. Because Jerusalem has now been ruined, we will prosper!’

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Ui nguit raca' luk meluun rayeh, ieh ineh Nebukadnesar, raca' Babil, pad ieh ngerieng Sur. Ieh macing rat pa tinueh busat aco dengan aceh baweh luk pelaba rayeh dengan kuda, keréta, idi lun luk maya' kuda.
english: This is what I, Yahweh the Lord, sayis going to happen: ‘From the north, I am going to bring the most powerful king in the world, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon, with his army to attack Tyre. They will bring horses and chariots, and men who ride the horses and men who drive the chariots; it will be a huge army.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah kuan bawang Sur: "Kareb iko uen ngelaya', lemulun luk tudo tangeb abpa' rayeh miak matot ku arod lemulun luk pitayen.
english: This is also what I, Yahweh the Lord, say about the people of Tyre: ‘When the wounded people in Tyre groan and many people are slaughtered and the city is destroyed, it will surely be as though RHQ the areas along the coast will tremble.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Ui miak nganau' namu dat ali mepad kudeng bawang luk inusag idi luk tican. Ui mapen namu ku ribaruh abpa'.
english: This is also what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: ‘When I cause the city of Tyre to become desolate/empty, like other cities in which people no longer live, and when I cause the huge waves of the sea to cover it,

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, do' menani aceh tido kuan Sur,
english: “You human, sing a funeral song about Tyre.

lun_bawang: ieh ineh bawang luk tangeb abpa' rayeh idi luk pepua' dengan amung lemulun luk tudo tangeb abpa' rayeh. Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: 'O Sur, iko medita' niat ratnan iko metaga.
english: The city of Tyre is located on an island at the edge of the sea, and their merchants ◄traded/bought and sold goods► with people-groups who live along many seacoasts. This is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say that you should tell them: ‘You people of  Tyre said that your city was very beautiful.

lun_bawang: "Lun pebunu' rat Parsi, Lidia idi Libia, inan bang bawehmu. Ideh nengekito utap idi tupideh bang ruma' bawehmu. Idi teh ideh luk nengacing ubur kuanmu.
english: Men from as far away as Persia, Lydia, and Libya were soldiers in your army. They hung their shields and helmets on the walls of your city, and that caused people to admire your city.

lun_bawang: "Iko pepua' déi' Tarsis, idi nengalap pirak, belawan, semara' luk mebuda', idi semara' luk mitem ku libal binawehmu luk mula' ineh.
english: Because of the many things that you had to trade, men from Tarshish in Spain sent merchants who brought silver, iron, tin, and lead to trade for things that you had.

lun_bawang: Iko pepua' déi' Grika, Tubal, idi Misek idi nengalap demulun idi tekaling ku libal binawehmu.
english: Merchants from Greece, Tubal, and Meshech brought slaves and things made from bronze to trade for things that you had.

lun_bawang: Iko nengalap kuda ku ngeruid keréta, kuda luk nguit lemulun, idi aya' luk seupa kuda idi seupa keladai rat Bait Togarma ku libal binawehmu.
english: Men from Beth-Togarmah in Armenia brought work horses, war horses, and mules to trade for things that you had.

lun_bawang: Lun Dedan pepua' namu, idi lun rat bang bawang luk tangeb abpa' rayeh nemaré gading idi kayuh luk mitem ku libal binawehmu.
english: Merchants came to you from Rhodes island. People from nations along the coast traded with you; they brought ◄ivory/elephant tusks► and valuable black ebony wood to trade for things that you had.

lun_bawang: Lun Aram nemelih binaweh luk pisuenmu. Ideh nemaré batu luk bata' uduh, kibung luk sia' merirem, kibung luk tibaruh, kibung pu, batu luk meraga rat bang abpa' rayeh, idi batu luk mesia' ku libal binawehmu.
english: Because you had very many things to trade, people from Syria brought to you valuable turquoise stones, purple cloth, embroidered cloth, fine linen cloth, and jewelry made from coral and rubies to trade for your things.

lun_bawang: Lun Yahuda idi lun Israil nemaré padé, duru', umau saitun, idi umau luk do' buen ku libal binawehmu.
english: Men from Judah and Israel brought wheat from Minnith city in Ammon, and figs, honey, olive oil, and ointment to trade for your things.

lun_bawang: -19Damsik nemelih binaweh luk pisuenmu idi nemaré abpa' anggur rat Helbon idi buluh dumba rat Sahar ku libalneh. Ideh nemaré belawan luk tinuno idi umau luk do' buen ku libal sebuang binawehmu.
english: Because you had very many things to trade, men from Damascus brought wine from Helbon town and white wool from the Zahar area to trade for many things that you had.

lun_bawang: Lun Dedan nemaré kibung luk ku tapin keted kuda ku libal binawehmu.
english: Merchants came from Dedan in southern Edom bringing saddle blankets to trade for things that you had.

lun_bawang: Lun Arab idi lun rayeh bawang Kedar nemaré anak dumba, dumba, idi amék ku libal binawehmu.
english: Men from Arabia and all the rulers of the Kedar region sent merchants to trade lambs and rams and male goats for things that you had.

lun_bawang: Lun luk pepua' rat Siba idi Rama nemaré umau luk do' buen, batu luk meraga, idi amas ku libal binawehmu.
english: Merchants from Sheba and Raamah in Arabia brought many kinds of very good spices and jewels and gold to exchange for things that you had.

lun_bawang: Bawang Haran, Kani, Eden, lun luk pepua' rat Siba, bawang Asur, idi Kilmad pepua' namu.
english: Men came from Haran, Canneh, Eden, Sheba, Asshur and Kilmad in Mesopotamia with their goods.

lun_bawang: Binawehmu ineh inuit maya' kapal luk meluun rayeh. "Iko mepad kudeng kapal déi' luun abpa' rayeh, luk mepanu' ku binaweh luk meberat.
english: Cargo ships from Tarshish carried all those things that you traded; and the warehouses on your island were full of all those things.’ ”

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku ineh kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: 'Ngaceku iko ngerawé iko mepad ileh kudeng aceh allah,
english: Therefore, this is what Yahweh the Lord says: “Because you think that you are as wise as a god,

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, do' nganau' aceh tido kuan Raca' Sur luk kumin, idi mada' neneh, kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: 'Atun iko mangun ku pinginud ratnan luk meligan. Iko mileh idi metaga!
english: “You human, sing a sad/funeral song about the king of Tyre. Say to him, ‘This is what Yahweh the Lord says: “You thought that IRO you were completely perfect, extremely wise and handsome.

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, do' ngadu' bawang Sidon,
english: “You human, turn toward Sidon city, and declare the terrible things that will happen to it.

lun_bawang: idi mada' luk belén Tuhan Allah nedeh, kebalamu, 'Ui ini bunu'mu, O Sidon. Ui miak buren lun ngaceku ukumKu namu. Ideh miak kali' Ui ini Tuhan, kareb Ui ngegala' liganKu idi ngukum lemulun luk tudo bang namu.
english: Give the people of Sidon this message from me, Yahweh the Lord: ‘I am your enemy, you people of Sidon, and by what I do to you, I will reveal that I am very great/glorious. When I punish you and reveal that I am holy, everyone who is watching that will know that it is I, Yahweh, who have the power to do what I say that I will do.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Pupu baken libut-libut bawang Israil luk nesitunga neneh na mangun ku tabpa' luk ngurat Israil sekua' teh, pad ideh kali' Ui ini Tuhan.”
english: No longer will those who live near you people of Israel hurt you like MET painful briers and sharp thorns hurt people. And then the Israeli people will know that I, Yahweh, have the power to do what I say that I will do.”

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, do' ngadu' Raca' Masir idi mada' neneh ratnan ukum luk macing neneh, idi teh ukum bawang Masir:
english: “You human, turn toward Egypt and proclaim the terrible things that will happen to the king of Egypt and all his people.

lun_bawang: pad amung lun Masir kali' Ui ini Tuhan.' " Kebala Tuhan, "Lun Israil pangeh merapet nemuyuh lun Masir ngedengan nedeh, iamo' muyuh mepad kudeng aceh rukud luk melaya'.
english: When that happens, all the people of Egypt will know that it is I, Yahweh, who have the power to do what I say that I will do. The Israeli people trusted that you would help them. But you have been like MET a reed pole in their hands.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh, kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Ui ngecuk lemulun ngerieng namu ku pelapet, pad ideh ngaté pupumu idi aya'mu.
english: Therefore, this is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: “I will bring your enemies to attack you with their swords, and they will kill your people and your animals.

lun_bawang: Masir miak mangun ku su luk ali-ali, pad iko kali' Ui ini Tuhan. "Ngaceku iko pebala Abpa' Nil iko kuan, idi iko nemudut neneh,
english: Egypt will become an empty desert. Then the people of Egypt will know that I, Yahweh, have the power to do what I say that I will do.” You proudly said, “The Nile River is mine; I made it!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Pangeh apat ngepulu' lak Ui miak nguit nelun Masir lemubed ratnan bawang pupu baken, su luk inanKu nengatad nedeh,
english: But this is what I, Yahweh the Lord, also say: “At the end of 40 years, I will enable the people of Egypt to return home again from the nations to which they were scattered.

lun_bawang: "Kareb amung ineh mangun Ui miak ngetueh nelun Israil idi nima' namu, Yehiskiel, pebala su luk inan lemulun miak ninger namu, pelé ideh kali' Ui ini Tuhan."
english: And some day Israel will become a glorious nation MET again. When that happens, I will cause the Israeli people to respect what you say MTY. And then they will know that it has happened because  I, Yahweh, have the power to do what I say that I will do.' ”

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, mada' bala luk barénKu idi pebala, Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: 'Temido, ngaceku mesusa' aco ineh!'
english: “You human, prophesy about what will happen to Egypt. Say, ‘This is what Yahweh the Lord says: “Weep and wail DOU, because terrible things will happen some day.

lun_bawang: "Lun tebarin luk pebunu' rat Sudan, Lidia, Libia, Arabia, idi Kub, idi rat arang pupuKu sebuleng pana' miak pitayen bang bunu' ineh.”
english: Soldiers of  Ethiopia, Libya, Lydia, and from all of Arabia, and all the other groups who are their allies, will be killed in the battles.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Rat Migdol luk pa tinueh busat aco macing Asuan luk pa kabing busat aco, amung lemulun luk ngedengan Masir pitayen. Baweh Masir luk medita' niat miak uen ngusag. Ui ini Tuhan Allah pangeh nepebala.
english: This is what I, Yahweh say: “The allies of Egypt will be defeated, and the power that the people of Egypt are proud of will end. From Migdol city in the north to Aswan city in the south, the soldiers of Egypt will be killed by their enemies’ swords”; that is what I, Yahweh the Lord, declare.

lun_bawang: Tana' ineh mangun ku bawang luk meluun dat ali bang tana' ini, bawang- bawangneh mangun ku usag mo'.
english: Egypt will become the most deserted country in the world, and its cities will be ruined, surrounded by ruined cities in nearby nations.

lun_bawang: "Kareb aco ineh macing, idi Masir pangeh inusag, Ui miak ngecuk nelun duken amé' ngegio nelun Sudan, pad ideh matot. Aco ineh malé macing!”
english: At that time, I will send messengers to go swiftly up the Nile River in boats to cause the people of Ethiopia who ◄are complacent/confident/think that nothing terrible will happen to them► to become afraid. They will be terrified PRS when Egypt is destroyed; and it will soon be that time!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Ui ngecuk ni Nebukadnesar raca Babil ngabud binaweh Masir.
english: This is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: “By the power of MTY of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon I will get rid of very many people in Egypt.

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, Ui pangeh nemutul langen Raca' Masir. Na ieh inabet ku kén pad ieh do', pelé ieh metueh ngimet pelapet teh.
english: “You human, I have enabled the army of Nebuchadnezzar to defeat the army of the King of Egypt. It is as though I have broken one of the arms of the King of Egypt, and it has not been bandaged in order that it could be healed, and it has not been put in splints in order that after it heals the arm will be strong enough to hold a sword.

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, do' mada' Raca' Masir idi amung anak itinneh, kebalamu, 'Iko pelaba rayeh! Iko pinginud anunké?
english: “You human, say to the King of Egypt and all of his people, ‘You think that there is RHQ, IRO no country whose power is as great as the power of your country.

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku ineh, kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Iko ineh iuk-iuk medita' pad macing nan laput, idi kareb iko temubu', iko mangun medita' niat.
english: Therefore, this is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: ‘That tree, which represents Assyria, grew very tall, and its top was higher than the other trees, and it became very proud because of being very tall.

lun_bawang: Kareb mula' pupu mepamung, Ui miak ngakem namu bang rabatKu idi nima' nedeh nginat rabat ineh.
english: But this is what Yahweh the Lord says: “I will send many people to throw my net over you, and they will haul/drag you up onto the land in my net.

lun_bawang: "Mula' pupu miak mesusa' kareb Ui mada' bala ratnan atému bang bawang luk na inanmu pekalai.
english: And when the people of many nations hear about your being destroyed, many of them will be afraid/worried— people living in countries that you have never known about.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah kuan raca' Masir, "Iko amé' matun pelapet raca' Babil.
english: This is what Yahweh the Lord says: “The swords of the army of the King of Babylon will strike you.

lun_bawang: Kareb Ui nganau' Masir mangun ku su luk ali-ali idi ngaté amung lemulun luk tudo su ineh, ideh miak kali' Ui ini Tuhan.
english: When I cause Egypt to become empty/desolate and strip off everything that grows on the land, and when I get rid of all the people who live there, people will know that I, Yahweh, have the power to do what I say that I will do.” ’

lun_bawang: Bada' ini luk meberat miak mangun ku aceh tido. Decur ratnan anid pupu miak menani tidu ineh kuan Masir idi amung pupuneh. Ui ini Tuhan Allah pangeh nepebala.”
english: That sad song about Egypt will also be sung by the people. Women of many nations will sing it. They will chant it about Egypt and all its people; that will surely happen because I, Yahweh, have said that it would happen.”

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, nangi' idi temido kuan amung lun Masir. Ngecuk nedeh amé' su luk inan até dengan pupu baken luk mebala.
english: “You human, wail about the many people of Egypt, because I will send them to the place under the earth, where they and people of other mighty nations will be. I will send them there, along with others, down to the place where the dead are.

lun_bawang: "Asur pana' idi déi' dengan amung tanem bawehneh. Amungdeh ineh pinaté bang bunu',
english: The corpses of the people of Assyria will be there. They will be surrounded by corpses of soldiers who were killed by their enemies’ swords.

lun_bawang: "Misek idi Tubal pana' idi déi' dengan amung tanem bawehneh. Amungdeh ineh na sinunat, idi pinaté bang bunu'. Iamo' atun ideh nengatot lemulun bang tana' ini.
english: Corpses of soldiers of Meshech and Tubal will be there, surrounded by the graves of a huge crowd of their people. They were all godless people who were killed by swords because while they were alive, they also caused people in many places HYP to be terrified.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng ineh lun Masir uen ngelaya' pad ideh telubid arang lun luk na sinunat luk pinaté bang bunu'.
english: You king of Egypt, you also be killed and will lie there with other godless people who have been killed by their enemies’ swords.

lun_bawang: "Edom pana' idi déi' dengan raca'neh idi lun luk ngimet neneh. Atun ideh lun pebunu' luk metueh, iamo' nekini ideh telubid déi' su luk inan até dengan lun luk na sinunat luk pinaté bang bunu'.
english: People of the Edom people-group will be there, along with their kings and leaders. They were powerful, but they will be killed and lie there in the place where the other dead people are. They will lie there in that deep pit, with the other godless people.

lun_bawang: "Kareb raca' Masir nier nedeh, ieh miak buken ratnan aténeh sebuleng idi ratnan até bawehneh luk pinaté bang bunu'," kebala Tuhan Allah.
english: The king of Egypt and all his army will see them, and they will be comforted to know that there were other huge groups of people who were killed by their enemies’ swords.

lun_bawang: "Ui nenima' raca' Masir ngatot lemulun bang tana' ini, iamo' ieh pitayen dengan amung bawehneh idi tinamen dengan lun luk na sinunat luk maté bang bunu'." Tuhan Allah pangeh nepebala.
english: While he was living, I allowed him to cause others in many countries to be terrified, but he and his huge army will be there among other godless people who had been killed by their enemies’ swords. That will surely happen because I, Yahweh the Lord, am the one who has said that it would happen.”

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, mada' pupumu ratnan luk mangun kareb Ui ngacing bunu' kuan aceh bawang. Lun luk bang bawang ineh mili' rat arangdeh seburur lun luk matar.
english: “You human, speak to your fellow Israelis and say this to them: ‘When I bring an enemy army MTY to attack a country, and the people of that country choose one of their men and appoint him to be a watchman,

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, Ui ngikit namu mangun ku lun luk matar kuan amung pupu Israil. Iko ngalap balaKu, idi ngacing bada'Ku nedeh.
english: So, you human, I have appointed you to be a watchman for the Israeli people MTY. So always listen to what I say and warn the people for me.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan negku, "O lemulun, mada' nelun Israil ratnan luk megéi' beléndeh, kebaladeh, 'Kai meberat niat ngerawé sala' idi kekamen kai luk dat. Kai iuk-iuk melaya'. Kudeng apehké kai miak mulun?'
english: You human, say to the Israeli people, ‘This is what you all are saying: “The guilt that we have for disobeying God’s laws and sinning is like a heavy weight on us, and it is hurting us, and we are slowly dying. So what can we do to continue to remain alive?”’

lun_bawang: Kudeng Ui mala kuan lemulun luk dat, Iko miak maté, idi ieh uleg ratnan sala' idi nganau' luk matu,
english: And if I say to some wicked person, ‘You will surely die because of your sins,’ that person may turn away from his sinful behavior and do what is just and right DOU.

lun_bawang: "Idi pupumu pebala luk inau'Ku na matu! Setuneh kekamendeh luk na matu.
english: Your fellow Israelis say, ‘What Yahweh does is not fair.’ But it is your behavior that is not fair.

lun_bawang: Israil, iko pebala, Ui na nganau' luk matu, iamo' Ui ngukum namu maya' kekamenmu.”
english: But you Israeli people still say, ‘What Yahweh does is not fair.’ But I will judge each of you for what you do.”

lun_bawang: Limeh aco, bulan pulu' bang lak luk kepulu' dueh muci ratnan kai tiban, seburur lemulun luk neburo rat Yerusalim iné' mada' negku ratnan tabpa bawang ineh.
english: Almost twelve years after we had been taken to Babylonia, on the fifth day of the tenth month of that year, a man who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me in Babylon and said, “Jerusalem has been captured!”

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, lun luk tudo bang bawang Israil luk inusag pebala, 'Ibrahim ineh seburur lemulun mo', idi aput bawang ini biré neneh, iamo' kai ini mula', kali' rungen tana' ini kai kuan.'
english: “You human, the people who are living in the ruins in Israel are saying, ‘Abraham was only one person, but Yahweh promised him that he and his descendants would possess this land. But we are many; so surely this land has been given to us by Yahweh to continue to possess.’

lun_bawang: "Mada' nedeh, kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Muyuh kuman dara' perapu dengan uang. Muyuh sembayang inan akang idi ngaté lemulun. Kudeng apehké muyuh ngerawé tana' ini muyuh kuan?
english: So send a message to them. Say, ‘This is what Yahweh the Lord says: You eat meat that still has the animal’s blood in it. You still worship idols. And you still murder others MTY. So, ◄should this land belong to you?/this land should certainly not belong to you!► RHQ

lun_bawang: Iamo' kareb amung balamu mangun — idi amung ineh na miak na mangun — idi ideh miak kali' seburur nabi idi arangdeh."
english: The terrible things that I have said will happen to them will surely happen. And then they will know that a prophet has been among them, and that you are that prophet.”

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, ngadu' nelun luk matar nelun Israil, ieh ineh dumbaKu. Mada' nedeh. Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Muyuh miak kumin, O muyuh lun luk matar nelun Israil! Muyuh ngasa' burur muyuh sebuleng, iamo' na muyuh ngasa' dumba ineh.
english: “You human, prophesy about theleaders of Israel. They should be taking care of my people like MET shepherds take care of their sheep. Say to them, ‘This is what Yahweh the Lord says: Terrible things will happen to you leaders MET of Israel who only take care of yourselves! You should certainly RHQ take care of your people like MET a shepherd takes care of his flock of sheep!

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku ineh, O muyuh lun luk matar, ninger bala Tuhan.
english: Therefore, you who should be acting like shepherds, listen to what I, Yahweh the Lord say:

lun_bawang: "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Ui ini nakap dumbaKu idi ngasa' nedeh,
english: This is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say to you leaders: I myself will search for my sheep and take care of them.

lun_bawang: "O dumbaKu, kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Ui miak ngukum anid burur muyuh pelé ngatad luk do' ratnan luk dat, ieh ineh Ui ngatad dumba ratnan amék.
english: And as for you who are like MET my sheep, this is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: I will judge between each of you; and I will separate those that are peaceful like sheep from those that are always trying to dominate others like goats.

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku ineh, kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Ui ngukum nemuyuh, pad ngatad dumba luk melamu ratnan dumba luk merugu'.
english: Therefore, this is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say to you: I myself will judge between those of you who are like MET the fat sheep and those of you who are like the thin sheep.

lun_bawang: Ui nganau' aceh jani' kuandeh luk maré ulun kuandeh. Ui nala' amung pung luk mesangit rat bang bawang ineh, pelé dumbaKu mulun dengan do' bang laman idi rudap bang pulung pana'.
english: I will make a peace agreement with the people of Israel. In this agreement I will promise to get rid of all the wild animals in Israel, in order that my people may live safely, even in the desert and in the forests.

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, ngadu' bawang Edom.
english: “You human, turn toward Edom and prophesy what will happen to its people. Say that this is what Yahweh says to them:

lun_bawang: Mada' pupu ineh. Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Ui ini bunu'mu, O pegkung Edom! Ui nganau' namu mangun ku su luk ali-ali.
english: ‘You who live near Seir Mountain in Edom, I am opposed to you, and I will use my power MTY to strike you and cause your country to become a wasteland.

lun_bawang: "Iko bunu' Israil luk meruked idi nemaré pupuneh pitayen kareb susa'neh kareb ukumneh luk kekiped.
english: You have always been enemies of the Israeli people. You rejoiced when they experienced a great disaster: their enemies attacked them with swords, when I punished them for the sins that they had committed.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh — idi Ui ini Tuhan Allah luk mulun — kali' rungen iko na miak mepuit ratnan ukum maté. Iko mesala' ngaceku ngaté lemulun, idi até miak ngerada' namu.
english: Therefore, I, Yahweh the Lord, declare that as surely as I am alive, I will allow your enemies to slaughter MTY you and continue to slaughter you. You were happy when LIT others were slaughtered;

lun_bawang: "O Edom, kebalamu, 'Dueh pupu, ieh ineh Yahuda idi Israil, idi bawang didueh ui kuan, idi tau miak ngalap bawang-bawang ineh,' sagan pana' Tuhan idi arangdeh.
english: You people said, “Israel and Judah will become ours. We will take over their territory!” You said that even though I, Yahweh, was still there and protecting them.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Ui nganau' namu dat ali, pad aput tana' mawang niat ku tabpamu, mepad kudeng iko mawang niat ku susa' Israil luk pupuKu. Pegkung Sir idi tana' Edom mangun dat ali, pad amung lemulun kali' Ui ini Tuhan."
english: So this is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: You people who live on Seir Mountain and in all the other places in Edom, when I cause your land to become desolate, everyone in the entire world will rejoice.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O lemulun, do' mada' amung pegkung Israil.
english: You human, prophesy about the mountains in Israel. Say to them, “You mountains in Israel, listen to what Yahweh says.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah nemuyuh: Dengan medita' niat bunu' lun Israil nepebala, 'Nekini pegkung ineh luk mon tau kuan!'
english: This is what Yahweh the Lord says: Your enemies happily said about you, ‘Aha! The mountains in Israel that have existed for a long time have become ours!’ ”

lun_bawang: "Ui ini Tuhan Allah pebulung. Pupu baken luk pekelibut Israil miak uen ngigu'.
english: I ◄am concerned about/will take care of► you, and I will bless you. I will enable farmers to plow the ground and plant seed there.

lun_bawang: Iamo' luun amung pegkung Israil, lawa kayuh miak nginulih idi kebua' kuan muyuh pupuKu lun Israil. Na mio teh muyuh muli'.
english: I will cause the number of people who live on you mountains and everywhere else in Israel to greatly increase. People will live in the towns and rebuild houses where there are now only ruins.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Lemulun neten pegkung-pegkung ineh 'Kuman Lemulun', kebaladeh, pegkung ineh mano anak ratnan pupu ineh.
english: No longer will the people of other nations ridicule you; no longer will they laugh at you; no longer will the armies of other nations conquer you. That will surely happen because I, Yahweh, have declared that it will happen.”

lun_bawang: pad pegkung ineh na ninger kuyo lun luk na manu idi bala pupu baken luk situnga. Pegkung ineh na mano anak ratnan pupu ineh. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.”
english: “You human, when the Israeli people were living in their own land, they ◄defiled it/caused it to become unacceptable to me► by the things that they did. I considered that their behavior was disgusting, like SIM the rags/cloths that women use during their monthly menstrual periods.

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, kareb lun Israil tudo bang bawangdeh atun, ideh nengelutak neneh ku lawédeh idi kekamendeh. SirenKu kekamendeh melutak mepad kudeng kibung decur luk macing bulan.
english: I caused them to be scattered among many nations DOU. I punished MTY them like they deserved to be punished because of their very evil behavior DOU.

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku ineh do' mada' nelun Israil. Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah nedeh: Luk ruenKu muci, baken ngaceku muyuh lun Israil, iamo' ngaceku ngadanKu luk meligan, luk inigu' muyuh bang anid bawang.
english: What I will do is to bring you back from those nations. I will gather you from all the countries to which you were forced to go, and bring you back to your own land.

lun_bawang: Ui miak ngalap nemuyuh rat arang anid pupu idi rat bang anid bawang, idi nguit nemuyuh muli' amé' bang bawang muyuh sebuleng.
english: I will give you a completely new way of thinking IDM. I will enable you to stop being stubborn IDM, and I will enable you to obey me from your inner beings IDM.

lun_bawang: Muyuh miak ngerawé kekamen muyuh luk dat idi sala' luk inau' muyuh, pad muyuh megateh inan burur muyuh sebuleng ngaceku sala' idi dat muyuh.
english: This is also what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: At the time that I forgive you for all the sins that you have committed, I will enable you to live in your towns again and to build houses where there are now only ruins.

lun_bawang: O Israil, kudeng ini bala Tuhan, Ui na nganau' ini ngaceku muyuh. Do' muyuh migu' ku kekamen muyuh. Ui ini Tuhan Allah pangeh nepebala.”
english: People who walk through your country will see that your land is again cultivated instead of ◄being desolate/having nothing growing in it►.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Kareb Ui ngeligan nemuyuh ratnan amung-amung sala' muyuh, Ui miak nima' nemuyuh tudo bang bawang muyuh, pad muyuh mudut baruh luk inusag ineh.
english: They will say, “This land that was ruined has become very fertile/productive like SIM the garden of Eden! The cities that were piles of ruins, empty and destroyed, now have walls around them, and people live in those cities.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan negku, "O lemulun, miakké tulang ini mulun baruh?" Idi kebalaku, "O Tuhan Allah, Iko sebuleng mo' luk kali' ineh.”
english: He asked me, “You human, do you think that these bones can become living people again?” I replied, “Yahweh my Lord, only you know if that can happen.”

lun_bawang: KebalaNe, "Do' mada' bala luk barénKu kuan tulang ini. Ngecuk nedeh ninger bala Tuhan.
english: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to these bones. Say to them, ‘You dry bones, listen to what Yahweh says.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah kuandeh: Ui nganau' niat bang nemuyuh, pad muyuh mulun.
english: This is what Yahweh the Lord says to you bones: I will put my breath into each of you, and you will become alive again.

lun_bawang: Kebala Allah negku, "O lemulun, mada' bala luk barénKu kuan bui. Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Amé' rat anid lidung tana' idi nginiat kuan butung- butung ini, pad ideh mulun.”
english: Then he said to me, “You human, prophesy to the wind. Say to the wind, ‘Wind APO, Yahweh says to you, blow from all four directions. Breathe into these people who have been killed, in order that they can become alive again!’ ”

lun_bawang: Kebala Allah negku, "O lemulun, lun Israil mepad kudeng tulang ini. Kebaladeh, 'Kai tekering, idi na luk inan merapet, idi na kekiped kai.'
english: Then he said to me, “You human, these bones represent all the Israeli people MTY. The people say, ‘It is as though our bones are dried up; there are no more good things that we can ◄hope for/confidently expect to happen to us►; our nation is destroyed/finished.’

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh mada' nelun Israil. Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Ui ngukab tanemdeh idi nguit nedeh remuat, pad ideh muli' amé' bawang Israil.
english: So prophesy and say to them, ‘This is what Yahweh the Lord says: My people, it will be as though I will open your graves and cause your corpses to become alive again. I will bring you back to Israel.

lun_bawang: Pupumu miak ngecuk namu mada' ilungneh nedeh.
english: When your fellow Israelis ask you, ‘What does ◄this action/what you just did► mean?’,

lun_bawang: Mada' nedeh, Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Ui ngalap nelun Israil rat bang bawang luk ulekdeh ineh, idi ngamung nedeh, idi nguit nedeh amé' bawangdeh sebuleng.
english: Say to the people, ‘This is what Yahweh the Lord says: I will take you Israeli people out of the countries to which you have been forced to go. I will gather you from all those nations and bring you back to your own land.

lun_bawang: DemulunKu Daud mangun ku raca'deh idi sebuleng Lun Matar miak ngimet nedeh, idi ideh miak maya' ukumKu.
english: Someone who will be like MET King David who served me well will be the king of your descendants, and it will be as though MET he will be their shepherd. They will carefully obey all my laws DOU.

lun_bawang: "O lemulun, do' ngadu' ni Gog rat bawang Magog. Ieh ineh raca' rayeh bang bawang Misek idi Tubal. Ngadu' neneh.
english: “You human, turn and face Magog, the country where Gog is the king. He is also the ruler of the nations of Meshech and Tubal. Prophesy about the terrible things that will happen to him,

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Ui ni bunu'mu.
english: and say, ‘This is what Yahweh the Lord says: Gog, you who rule Meshech and Tubal, I am opposed to you.

lun_bawang: Do' iko temina' dengan amung bawehmu luk maya' ukummu.
english: Tell Gog, ‘Get ready and be prepared to be the commander of all those groups of soldiers.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah ni Gog: "Kareb ineh iko inan aceh terawé luk dat.
english: But this is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: On that day, you will have an idea about DOU doing an evil thing.

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan Allah nengecuk negku pebala ni Gog, "Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Kareb pupuKu lun Israil do' udeng iko miak nalan,
english: Therefore, you human, prophesy about Gog and say to him, ‘This is what Yahweh the Lord says: At that time, when my people of Israel are living safely, you will certainly think about that.

lun_bawang: Ui nepebala ratnan iko dengan tang demulunKu nabi-nabi lun Israil luk atun, kebalaKu, Ui miak nguit seburur lemulun munu' Israil." Tuhan Allah pangeh nepebala.
english: This is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say to Gog: In past years, when I gave messages to my servants, the prophets in Israel, there were messages RHQ about you. At that time, they prophesied for many years that I would bring your armies to attack my people.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Kareb Gog munu' Israil, Ui megateh niat.
english: So this is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say will happen: When your army attacks Israel, I will be very angry with you.

lun_bawang: Ui miak ngatot ni Gog ku tuda'-tuda' susa'. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala. Bawehneh sebuleng pad-pad pepaté ku pelapetdeh.
english: Gog, on all the mountains in the country that belongs to me I will cause your soldiers to fight against each other with their swords.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "O lemulun, ngadu' ni Gog, raca' luk rayeh bang bawang Misek idi Tubal, idi mada' neneh. Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Ui ini bunu'mu.
english: Yahweh said to me, “You human, prophesy about more terrible things that will happen to Gog, and say this to him: ‘Gog, I am opposed to you who rule Meshech and Tubal.

lun_bawang: Ui nganau' apui bang bawang Magog idi maya' tangeb abpa' rayeh su luk inan lemulun do' udeng, pad amung-amung lemulun kali' Ui ini Tuhan.
english: I will cause many fires to burn in Magog and among all those who live safely in the areas along their coasts, and they will know that it is I, Yahweh, who have the power to do what I say that I will do.

lun_bawang: Idi kali' rungen pupuKu lun Israil miak kali' ngadanKu luk meligan idi Ui na nima' ngadanKu uen ngigu' teh, pelé amung pupu miak kali' Ui ini Tuhan Allah lun Israil luk Meligan.”
english: I will enable my Israeli people to know that I am holy. I will no longer allow people to damage my reputation, and people in other nations will know that I, Yahweh the Lord, am the Holy One in Israel.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Kali' rungen tarekneh luk bida'Ku miak macing.
english: I, Yahweh the Lord, declare that it will soon be the day that those things will happen. It will be the day that I have spoken to you about.

lun_bawang: Lun Israil nanem butung idi ngeligan bawang tudu' bulan kinioneh.
english: For seven months the people of Israel will be burying those corpses. It will be necessary to bury all of them, in order that the land will not be ◄defiled/considered unacceptable to me► because of any unburied corpses.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ui miak nima' pupu baken nier rayehKu, idi Ui ngegala' laludKu, kareb Ui ngacing ukumKu luk mesiri.
english: I will show people of many nations that I am glorious, and all those nations will see how I punish them DOU.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Nekini, Ui miak mé' nan inul Yakub, lun Israil, pelé ideh uen ngeperuan. Ui matar ngadanKu luk meligan.
english: Therefore, this is now what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: I will now bring back from exile/Babylonia the descendants of Jacob; I will pity all the Israeli people, and I will also jealously protect my reputation.

lun_bawang: Kebala lemulun ineh negku, "Takep luk petutup pa kabing busat aco kuan imam-imam luk ngakem bang Ruma' Allah.
english: The man said to me, “The room whose door faces south is for the priests who are in charge of the work in the temple.

lun_bawang: Ieh nenari takep ineh idi pinangneh pekelibut limeh depeh mela. Idi kebalaneh negku, "Ini Su luk Meluun Ligan.”
english: Then he measured the inner room: It was ◄35 feet/10.7 meters► long and ◄35 feet/10.7 meters► wide. He said to me, “This is the Very Holy Place.”

lun_bawang: bubpun luk ratnan kayuh. Dita'neh lélé medepeh idi pipangneh setangal depeh. Diri lidungneh, alenneh, idi iringneh inau' ratnan kayuh. Kebala lemulun ineh negku, "Ini méja luk idi pa kiung Tuhan.”
english: The Holy Place and the Very Holy Place had double doors.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Tuhan, "O lemulun, do' mada' nelun Israil ratnan Ruma'Ku, idi nima' nedeh sibada' ratnan ayuneh, pad ideh migu' ngaceku kekamendeh luk dat.
english: You human, describe to the Israeli people what this temple that I have shown you in a vision is like, in order that they will be ashamed of the sins that they have committed which resulted in their temple in Jerusalem being destroyed.

lun_bawang: Ini ukum ratnan Ruma' Allah: Amung tana' libut-libutneh ineh meluun ligan.”
english: And this is the supreme law about the temple DOU: All of the area on top of the hill where the temple will be built must be kept sacred and holy.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah negku, "O lemulun, ninger balaKu. Kareb bubpun ineh pangeh pinudut, do' iko ngeseb baré luunneh pad ieh uen ngeligan idi ngisak dara' pung luk kereten luunneh.
english: Then the man said to me, “You human, this is what Yahweh the Lord says: These are the regulations for sacrificing offerings that will be completely burned and for sprinkling the blood against the sides of the altar when it is built:

lun_bawang: Kenebpa do' iko ngalap aceh amék deléi luk do' idi maré neneh ku baré ngaceku sala'. Ngaligan bubpun ku dara'neh mepad kudeng luk inau'mu ku dara' sapi' ineh.
english: The next day, you must offer a male goat that has no defects, to be an offering to cause the altar to be acceptable to me. Then you must purify the altar again, like you did with the bull that was sacrificed.

lun_bawang: Bang tudu' aco do' iko maré amék, sapi', idi dumba ku baré ngaceku sala'. Amungdeh deléi luk na luk mét.
english: Then, each day for seven days, you must bring to the priest a male goat to be sacrificed for an offering to cause the altar to be acceptable to me. You must also sacrifice a young bull and a ram, each without any defect.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan negku, "Tanga' ini mitek idi na miak kabin. Seburur lemulun pana' nateh luk miak semuet maya' tanga' ineh, ngaceku Ui ini Tuhan Allah lun Israil pangeh nesemuet maya' ineh. Na miak na ieh mitek.
english: Yahweh said to me, “This entrance must remain shut. It must not be opened by anyone; no one will be permitted to enter it. It must remain shut because I, Yahweh, the God of Israel, have caused it to be sacred by entering through it.

lun_bawang: "Mada' nelun Israil luk sikal metueh ineh. Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: O lun Israil, do' muyuh ugka' ratnan kekamen muyuh luk dat.
english: Say this to the rebellious Israeli people: ‘This is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: You Israeli people, I will no longer endure the detestable things that you do!

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku ineh kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: Lun pupu baken luk na sinunat bang burur idi niatdeh na miak semuet bang Ruma'Ku, sagan tu pana' ieh tudo arang lun Israil.
english: But this is what I, Yahweh, have said: No foreigners, no men who are not circumcised, no godless people are permitted to enter my temple, not even foreigners who live among you Israelis permanently.

lun_bawang: "Lun Liwi luk nenecan Negku kareb lun Israil neraruh idi nesembayang inan akang, miak kumin.
english: Most of the descendants of Levi abandoned me along with most of the Israeli people, and started to worship idols. They must be punished for their sin.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ideh nengakem kuan lun Israil pa kiung akangdeh, pad ngeraruh nelun mula', Ui ini Tuhan Allah pebulung, na miak na imam-imam ineh kumin.
english: But because they helped the people to worship idols and caused many of the Israeli people MTY to sin by worshiping idols, I have lifted up my arm and solemnly declared that they must be punished for their sin.

lun_bawang: Ideh luk miak semuet bang Ruma'Ku, ngakem iring bubpunKu, idi nguyut sembayang bang Ruma' Allah!
english: They are the only ones who are permitted to enter my temple. They are the only ones who are permitted to come near my altar to serve me and do what I tell them to do.

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh maya' tanga' semuet nan natad luk uned Ruma' Allah, ideh ngayung ku kibung pu. Ideh na miak ngayung ku ayung luk inau' ratnan buluh dumba kareb ideh ngakem luun natad luk uned, idi bang Ruma' Allah.
english: When they enter one of the entrances into the inner courtyard, they must wear linen clothes. They must not wear any clothes made of wool while they do their work at the entrances of the inner courtyard or inside the temple.

lun_bawang: "Abpuk imam na miak uen ngiki idi na miak mekadang. Abpukdeh mepad kudeng luk pekalai mo'.
english: The priests must not shave their heads or allow their hair to become long; but they must regularly trim the edges of their hair.

lun_bawang: Kudeng inan besara', do' imam-imam mutut besara' ineh maya' ukumKu. Do' ideh ngimet amung aco rayeh maya' ukum idi lawéKu Idi do' ideh ngeligan Aco luk inan Mudeng.
english: When there are disputes between people, the priests are the ones who must be the judges and decide according to my laws what must be done. They must obey all my laws and decrees concerning the sacred festivals, and they must keep my Sabbath days ◄holy/set apart►.

lun_bawang: "Imam-imam na miak ngelutak bururdeh ku butung, kudeng baken ratnan butung taman-tinanneh, anakneh, kinanakneh deléi, idi kinanakneh decur luk na awan.
english: A priest is permitted to go near the corpse of his father or his mother or his son or his daughter or his brother or his unmarried sister; but he is still defiled by doing that. But a priest must not defile himself by going near a corpse of anyone else.

lun_bawang: "Babpat inul lun imam ratnan luk biréKu nelun Israil luk barén kuan anid- anid inul, ieh ineh kekamen imam. Na ideh miak ngalap tana' bang bawang Israil. Ui ini babpat imam-imam ineh.
english: The priests are not permitted to own any property. They will have only what I provide for them.

lun_bawang: Do' ngeletep aceh tana' kuan bawang rayeh, kikadangneh pulu' batu idi pipangneh dueh batu. Bawang ineh pelengit su luk meligan idi mangun ku bawang amung lun Israil.
english: Alongside that sacred area will be a section of land that is ◄8.3 miles/13.3 km.► long and ◄1.7 miles/2.65 km.► wide. It will be for a city where anyone in Israel MTY will be permitted to live.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Muyuh pelaba io nganau' sala', O muyuh lun luk ngimet bawang Israil. Do' muyuh ugka' ngedereh idi ngaté lemulun. Nganau' luk matu idi luk mesiri. Aleg ngusu pupuKu ratnan tana'deh. Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah.
english: This is what I, Yahweh the Lord, say: You kings of Israel must stop acting violently and oppressing the people! You must do what is fair and right DOU. Stop taking land from the people!

lun_bawang: "Do' muyuh makai uad idi tari luk matu.
english: And you must use accurate scales, and accurate containers for measuring things.

lun_bawang: -15"Kudeng ini lawé muyuh maré baré muyuh: Padé: 1/60 amung luk perinien muyuh Ikun: 1/60 amung luk perinien muyuh Umau saitun: 1/100 amung bua' muyuh. (Do' ieh uen nguad maya' bat, ieh ineh iwa' gatang. 10 bat = 1homer = 1kor.) Dumba: 1dumba rat arang 200 "Do' muyuh nguit baré akan, pung luk sabpen teburur, idi pung ku baré luk nguit pedo', pad muyuh ngalap do' ratnan sala' muyuh. Ui ini Tuhan Allah luk ngecuk ineh.
english: “ ‘You must present to the king one bushel of wheat or barley for every 60 that you harvest.

lun_bawang: "Amung lemulun bang bawang ineh nguit baré ineh kuan lun luk ngimet Israil.
english: All the Israeli people must join in bringing those offerings to the king of Israel.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Aceh aco bulan aceh do' iko maré aceh sapi' deléi luk do', pad ngeligan Ruma' Allah.
english: This is also what I, Yahweh the Lord, declare: On the first day of the first month of each year you must take one young bull that has no defects and sacrifice it to cause the temple to be acceptable to me.

lun_bawang: "Pulu' apat aco bulan aceh do' muyuh ngimun Irau Paska. Tudu' aco kinioneh muyuh kuman ruti luk na linamud.
english: In the first month of each year, on the 14th day of the month, you must start to celebrate the Passover Festival. The festival will last for seven days. During that time you must not eat bread made with yeast.

lun_bawang: "Kareb Irau Lepo luk ngimun pulu' limeh aco bulan tudu', do' lun luk ngimet ineh maré baré ngaceku sala' luk mepad mo' tudu' aco kinioneh, baré luk mepad luk sabpen teburur, idi baré akan idi umau saitun luk mepad teh."
english: During the seven days of the festival of Living in Temporary Shelters, which starts on the fifteenth day of the seventh month of each year, the king must provide the same things for offerings for the people’s sins, for offerings to be completely burned, for grain offerings, and the same amount of olive oil that he provided each day during the Passover Festival.’ ”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Anid-anid pekak do' maré kuan Tuhan sebuleng anak dumba luk ulun selak idi luk na luk mét. Ini miak barén anid-anid aco.
english: Every day, during the morning, someone must provide a one-year-old lamb with no defects to be an offering to me that will be completely burned.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ini bala Tuhan Allah: "Kudeng lun luk ngimet maré sebabpat tana'neh kuan sebuleng anakneh, tana' ineh mangun ku babpat anak ineh ratnan binaweh tetek ruma'neh ineh.
english: This is what I, Yahweh the Lord, declare: If the king gives some of his land to one of his sons, to belong to him permanently, it will then belong to his son’s descendants forever.

lun_bawang: Kebala lemulun ineh negku, "Ini dapur-dapur su luk inan lun duken bang Ruma' Allah nanek baré luk barén lun mula'."
english: The man said to me, “These are the kitchens where the descendants of Levi who work in the temple must cook the sacrifices that the people bring.”

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh negku, "O lemulun, ngerawé do'-do' ratnan ini." Idi lemulun ineh nenguit negku amé' tangeb arur ineh,
english: Then he said to me, “You human, think carefully about what you have seen.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Ini lakan-lakan tana' luk uen mabpat kuan pulu' dueh pupu. Idi pupu Yusup mo' ngalap dueh babpat.
english: In the vision, Yahweh also said this to me: “Here is a list of the twelve tribes of Israel and the territory that each tribe must receive. The descendants of Joseph will receive two portions; the tribe of Levi will not receive any.

lun_bawang: "Lakan tana' luk pa tinueh busat aco maya' pa busat aco rat Abpa' Rayeh macing nan bawang Hetlon, Ruan Hamat, bawang Sedad,
english: These will be the boundaries of the land: On the north side, it will extend from the Mediterranean Sea east along the road to Hethlon, past Lebo-Hamath to Zedad,

lun_bawang: "Lakan tana' luk pa busat aco maya' rat arang bawang Damsik dengan bawang Hauran. Abpa' Yarden mangun ku lakan tana' arang tana' Israil pa acep aco, idi Giliad pad busat aco, macing nan Bawang Piasau déi' Abpa' luk Mepaci'.
english: On the east side, the boundary will extend between Hauran and Damascus, south along the Jordan River between the Gilead region and the land of Israel, along the Dead Sea as far as the town of Tamar. That will be the eastern boundary.

lun_bawang: "Lakan tana' luk pa kabing busat aco amé' pa lod busat aco rat Bawang Piasau macing nan takung Kadis, idi amé' pa dayeh busat aco maya' lakan tana' Masir macing nan Abpa' Rayeh.
english: On the south side, the boundary will extend from Tamar southwest to the springs near the town of Meribah-Kadesh. Then the boundary will extend west along the dry riverbed at the border of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea. That will be the southern boundary.

lun_bawang: "Lakan tana' luk pa acep aco, ieh ineh Abpa' Rayeh macing pa tinueh busat aco, ieh ineh inan aceh bawang luk pa acep aco Ruan Hamat.
english: On the west side, the boundary will be the Mediterranean Sea, north to near Lebo-Hamath.

lun_bawang: "Do' mabpat tana' ini kuan pupu muyuh;
english: You must distribute this land among yourselves, among the tribes of Israel.

lun_bawang: Kikadang babpat tana' ini luk linigan kuan Tuhan pulu' batu, idi pipangneh ualuh batu.
english: It must be ◄8.3 miles/13.3 km.► long and ◄6.7 miles/10.6 km.► wide.

lun_bawang: Lun Liwi miak ngalap aceh babpat tana' muneng ku tana' lun imam. Kikadangneh muneng ku tana' lun imam. Kikadangneh pulu' batu idi pipangneh apat batu.
english: The land that will be allotted to the other descendants of Levi will be the same size as the land allotted to the priests. So together, those two portions of land will be ◄8.3 miles/13.3 km.► long and ◄6.6 miles/10.6 km.► wide.

lun_bawang: Tana' luk ketecan na meligan, kikadangneh pulu' batu idi pipangneh dueh batu. Tana' ineh kuan lun mula' mo'. Ideh miak tebawang su ineh. Bawang rayeh piduten unedneh.
english: The rest of that sacred area, a strip of land ◄8.3 miles/13.3 km.► long and ◄1.7 miles/2.65 km.► wide will be allotted for other people to use. It will be land where they will be permitted to build homes and have pasturelands. There will be a city at the center.

lun_bawang: -27Pa kabing busat aco babpat ineh, anid-anid pupu Israil luk baken miak ngalap aceh babpat tana' rat lakan tana' luk pa busat aco macing lakan tana' luk pa acep aco, maya' kudeng luk pa beneh ini, rat pa tinueh busat aco macing pa kabing busat aco: Beniamin, Simion, Iskar, Sebulon, Gad.
english: South of that special area, each of the other tribes must be allotted one portion of land that extends from the eastern boundary of Israel west to the Mediterranean Sea. Beginning at the north will be land for the tribe of Benjamin.

lun_bawang: Pa kabing busat aco babpat luk biré kuan pupu Gad, lakan tana' amé' pa lod busat aco rat Bawang Piasau macing takung Kadis, idi amé pa dayeh busat aco maya' lakan tana' Masir macing Abpa' Rayeh.
english: The southern boundary of the tribe of Gad will extend south from Tamar to the springs at Meribah-Kadesh, and from there to the west along the dry riverbed at the border of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "Kudeng ineh lawéneh tana' uen mabpat kuan pupu Israil, pad ideh ngalap tana' luk ku babpat inuldeh.”
english: That is the land that you must allot to the tribes of Israel, to belong to them permanently. That is what I, Yahweh the Lord, declare.”

lun_bawang: -34Ini amung tanga' bawang ineh. Kikadang anid libung na macing dueh batu, idi anid libung ineh inan teluh tanga', idi anid tanga' inan ngadan aceh pupu Israil. Tanga' luk pa tinueh busat aco titen Rubin, Yahuda, idi Liwi. Tanga' luk pa busat aco titen Yusup, Beniamin, idi Dan. Tanga' luk pa kabing busat aco titen Simion, Iskar, idi Sebulon. Idi tanga' luk pa acep aco titen Gad, Aser, idi Naptali.
english: These will be the exits from the city: On the north side, which will be ◄1.5 miles/2.4 km.► long,

lun_bawang: Kidakang libung luk libut-libut bawang lélé ualuh batu. Ngadan bawang ineh rat pad sineh, "Tuhan Idi Su Ini!"
english: So the distance around the city will thus be ◄6 miles/9.6 km.►. And from that time on, the name of the city will be ‘Yahweh Is There’.’

lun_bawang: "Nutun nekai kinio pulu' aco," kebala Daniel. "Maré nekai kikid irin idi abpa' talang.
english: So I said to this guard: “Please test us for ten days. During that time give us only vegetables to eat and water to drink.

lun_bawang: idi kebalaneh nedeh, "Ui inan nupi luk ngagau negku. Ui pian kali' ratnan ineh.”
english: he said, “I had a dream last night  that worries me. Tell me what I dreamed, because I want to know what the dream means.”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengor bala raca' bang buri' Arami, kebaladeh, "Do' raca' mipu ulun! Mada' nupimu nekai, idi kai miak mada' ilungneh.”
english: The men who studied the stars replied to the king, speaking in the Aramaic language. They said, “King Nebuchadnezzar, we hope that you will live a long time! Tell us what you dreamed, and then we will tell you what it means!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' nelun luk nawar ada', "Kudeng muyuh na miak mada' nupiku idi ilungneh, na miak na ui ngecuk nelun natek nemuyuh idi ngusag ruma' muyuh.
english: But the king replied, “I have firmly decided that you must tell me the dream, and also tell me what it means. If you do not do that, I will order my soldiers to cut you into pieces, and to cause your houses to become only piles of stones!

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh inan raca', "Kudeng raca' mada' nupimu nekai, idi kai miak mada' ilungneh.”
english: But again they said, “Tell us what you dreamed, and then we will tell you what it means.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' nedeh, "Mo, muyuh pian ngiuk balaku, ngaceku muyuh kali' luk pangeh pinututku na miak misu'.
english: The king replied, “I know that you are just trying to get more time, because you know that I will do to you what I said that I would do.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun luk nawar ada' ineh, "Seburur pana' bang aput-aput tana' ini nateh luk miak mada' luk initun raca'. Seburur raca' pana' luk meluun rayeh idi melalud nateh luk nengitun luk kudeng ineh inan lun luk mileh nier, lun luk melalud ratnan gimet, idi lun luk nawar ada'.
english: The men who studied the stars replied, “There is no one on the earth who can do what you ask! There is no king, even a great and mighty king, who has ever asked his men who work magic or his fortune-tellers or men who study the stars to do something like that!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daniel ni Ariuk, "Ngudehké raca' nemutut aceh ukum luk meberat kudeng ineh?" Idi Ariuk nemada' ni Daniel ratnan luk pangeh nangun ineh.
english: I asked Arioch, “Why has the king made such a harsh/terrible decree?” So Arioch told me all that had happened because of the king’s dream.

lun_bawang: "Do' ngubur ngadan Allah macing ruked-ruked, ngaceku Ieh luk mileh idi melalud.
english: saying, “We should praise God MTY forever, because only he truly is wise and powerful.

lun_bawang: Idi Ariuk nenguit ni Daniel dengan mesaget amé matun raca' ineh. Idi kebalaneh ni raca', "Ui pangeh nekali' seburur lun luk tiban rat Yahuda luk miak mada' kuan raca' ratnan ilung nupimu ineh.”
english: So Arioch quickly took me to the king. He said to the king, “I have found this man, one of the men whom we brought from Judah who says he can can tell you what your dream means!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca' ni Daniel (luk titen Beltesasar), "Miakké iko mada' nupiku idi ilungneh negku?”
english: The king said to me, whose new name was Belteshazzar, “Is this true? Can you tell me what I dreamed and what it means?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daniel, "O raca', seburur lun luk nawar ada', seburur lun luk mangun, seburur lun luk mileh nier, idi seburur lun luk mileh kali' gituen nateh luk miak mada' luk kudeng ineh.
english: I replied, “There are no wise men or fortune-tellers or men who work magic or men who work sorcery who can tell such things to you.

lun_bawang: "O raca', kareb iko rudap, iko nenginupi ratnan luk mangun muci, idi Allah luk ngelio luk inalum nemada' namu ratnan luk miak mangun ineh.
english: O King, while you were sleeping, you dreamed about events that will happen in the future. The one who reveals mysteries has shown you what is going to happen.

lun_bawang: "O raca', bang luk siniermu ineh, iko nenier aceh ayu lemulun luk rayeh luk netuped pa kiungmu, luk merasat idi luk mesilo, idi luk inan matot.
english: O King, in your vision you saw in front of you a huge and terrifying statue of a man. It was shining very brightly, and it was frightening and awesome.

lun_bawang: "Ieh ineh nupimu. Nekini ui miak mada' ilungneh namu.
english: That was what you dreamed. Now I will tell you what it means.

lun_bawang: Muci rat namu inan aceh imet luk baken, iamo' na ieh mepad rayeh kudeng imetmu. Idi muci ratnan ineh inan aceh imet luk keteluh luk ratnan tekaling, luk miak ngimet aput tana'.
english: But after your kingdom/rule ends, there will be another great kingdom, but it will not be as great as yours. The silver parts of the statue represent that kingdom. Then there will be a third great kingdom whose king  will rule over the whole earth. The bronze parts of the statue represent  that kingdom.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Allahmu ineh meluun rayeh ratnan amung-amung allah, idi Ieh luk Tuhan amung-amung raca', idi luk ngelio luk inalum, ngaceku iko luk miak ngelio luk inalum ineh.”
english: The king said to me, “Your God has enabled  you to tell me the meaning of this dream/mystery, so now I truly know that your God is greater than all the other gods and all other kings. He reveals to people things that they cannot know.”

lun_bawang: Idi seburur lun luk nated bala raca' nengitang, kebalaneh, "O muyuh luk rat anid-anid bawang idi pupu, idi teh luk manid-manid buri'!
english: Then an announcer shouted, “You people who come from many countries and many people-groups and who speak many languages, listen to what the king has commanded!

lun_bawang: Idi kebaldeh ni Raca' Nebukadnesar, "Do' raca' mipu ulun!
english: They reported to him, “We hope that you, O king, will live a long time!

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nediteluh, "Sadrak, Misak, idi Abednego, matuké meteluh ara' sembayang inan allahku idi na tekeradung pa kiung akang luk inau'ku ineh?
english: Nebuchadnezzar said to them, “Is it true that you three men have refused to worship my gods or the gold statue that I have set up?

lun_bawang: Idi Sadrak, Misak, idi Abednego nengor bala raca', kebala diteluh, "O raca', na ulekneh kai ngor balamu.
english: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego replied, “Nebuchadnezzar, we do not need to defend our actions to you in this matter.

lun_bawang: Idi Nebukadnesar negagap. Idi ieh nengitun nelun mileh ineh. "Naké tau nengabet teluh burur lemulun idi nenala' nediteluh bang tetel apui?" Idi kebaladeh, "Matu, O raca'.”
english: But as Nebuchadnezzar was watching, he was amazed. He suddenly jumped up and shouted to his advisors, “Did we tie up three men and throw them into the flames, or not?” They replied, “Yes, O king, we did.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala raca', "Ngudehké ui nier apat burur lemulun nalan bang apui ineh? Na ideh inabet idi na ideh neseb — idi luk keapat ineh mepad kudeng aceh allah ayuneh.”
english: Nebuchadnezzar shouted, “Look! I see four men in the fire! They have no ropes on them, they are walking around, and the flames are not hurting them! And the fourth man looks like a divine being!”

lun_bawang: Kebalaku neneh: O Beltesasar, luk lun rayeh amung lun luk mileh nier, ui kali' Roh Allah luk Meligan idi bang namu, idi iko kali' amung-amung luk inalum. Ini nupiku. Mada ilungneh negku.
english: So, using the name that had been given to him, I said, ‘Belteshazzar, you are the most important of all my fortune-tellers. I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you, and that you can reveal all mysteries. There is none that is too difficult for you. So, tell me what my dream means.

lun_bawang: "Kareb ui uned ngerawé luk sinierku ineh, idi ui nekali' aceh melaikat luk megéi' matar netemurun rat surga.
english: While I was still lying on my bed, I saw another vision. In the vision I saw a holy angel coming down from heaven.

lun_bawang: "O raca', ini ilung nupimu. Kebala Allah luk Meluun Rayeh: Ini luk miak mangun kuanmu.
english: ◄Your Majesty/O King►, that is what your dream means. That is what the Supreme God has declared will happen to you.

lun_bawang: idi kebalaneh, "Siruh kudeng apeh rayeh bawang Babil! Ui nemudut ineh mangun ku bawangku luk rayeh, pad ui ngegala' lalud idi tuehku, rayeh idi uburku.”
english: As he looked out over/across the city, he said to those around him, “I have built this great city of Babylon to be the place where I rule! I have built it to display my own power, in order to show people my glory, to show them that I am very great!”

lun_bawang: Kareb uned ieh pebala, idi inan tang rat déi' langit, "O Raca' Nebukadnesar, ninger balaKu. Nekini imetmu pangeh ilap rat namu.
english: While he was still saying this, God MTY spoke from heaven and said, “King Nebuchadnezzar, this is what I am saying to you: You are no longer the ruler of this kingdom!

lun_bawang: Idi tinan raca' neninger ria' raca' idi lun rayehneh ineh, idi ieh iné' sikang. Kebalaneh, "Do' raca' mipu ulun! Ngudeh iko megagau idi mebudi kiung?
english: But when the mother of the king (OR, of the previous king) heard the king and his officials talking loudly about what had happened, she entered the room where they were having the feast. She said to Belshazzar, “◄Your majesty/O King►, I hope you will live for a long time! But do not be pale and afraid about this.

lun_bawang: Idi petacu ideh nenguit ni Daniel amé' pa kiung raca'. Idi kebala raca' neneh, "Matuké iko ini Daniel, seburur lun Yahudi luk tiban tamanku luk raca' rat bawang Yahuda.
english: So they went and brought me in. The king asked me, “You must be Daniel RHQ! They told me that you are one of those who was brought here from Judah by the previous king.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daniel, "Na ui pian ku barému ineh. Do' maré ineh kuan dulun. Iamo' ui miak maca' luk inayud ineh idi mada' ilungneh kuan raca'.
english: I replied, “I do not want your gifts; keep them, or give them to someone else. But I will read for you the writing on the wall, and I will tell you what it means.

lun_bawang: "Allah luk Meluun Rayeh nengeletep tamanmu Nebukadnesar mangun ku raca' luk rayeh. Idi Ieh nengedita' neneh idi nemaré ubur kuanneh.
english: ◄Your Majesty/O king►, the Supreme God caused the man who was king before you, Nebuchadnezzar, to become a great ruler, who was greatly praised and honored.

lun_bawang: "Idi iko ini luk anakneh na nengebeneh bururmu, sagan pana' iko pangeh nekali' amung-amung ini.
english: Now, Belshazzar, you have become the king. You also knew all those things, but you have not made yourself humble.

lun_bawang: "Ini luk inayud; 'Ngiap, ngiap, nimang, mabpat.'
english: This is the message that it wrote: ‘Mene, mene, tekel, parsin.’

lun_bawang: Idi ini ilungneh: ngiap, Allah pangeh nengiap amung-amung aco imetmu idi nengagka' namu;
english: This is what those words mean: Mene means ‘numbered/counted’. That means that God has been counting the days that you will rule, and he has now decided that you will not rule any more.

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh, "Na tau miak ngadu' ni Daniel ratnan kekamenneh. Kian, ratnan sembayangneh lek miak tau ngadu' neneh.”
english: They concluded, “The only way we can find something for which we can criticize Daniel will be something concerning the laws that his god his given him.”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh iné' matun raca', kebaladeh, "O Raca' Darius, do' iko mipu ulun!
english: So the administrators and governors went as one group to the king and said, “◄Your Majesty/O king►, we wish that you will live a long time!

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh ni raca', "Seburur lun luk tiban rat Yahuda, ieh ineh Daniel, na ngerayeh raca', idi ieh ngelaba ukummu. Ieh sembayang teluh kua' seaco.”
english: Then they said to the king, “Well, that man Daniel, one of the men who were brought from Judah, is not paying any attention to you or the law that you signed. He prays to his god three times each day!”

lun_bawang: Idi lemulun ineh nacing sekua' teh idi kebaladeh ni raca', "O raca', iko kali', maya' ukum lun Midi idi lun Parsi, ukum raca' na miak uen ngisu'.”
english: In the evening, many of HYP the officials went together to the king and said, “◄Your Majesty/O king►, you know that our governments of Media and Persia have declared that no law that the king signs can be canceled/changed. So Daniel must be thrown to the lions!”

lun_bawang: Idi raca' nengecuk nala' ni Daniel bang lubang balang. Idi kebala raca' ni Daniel, "Do' Allah luk inanmu merapet tu-tu ngulun namu.”
english: So the king gave the order, and his servants brought me and threw me into a pit where the lions were. Before they threw me in, the king said to me, “I hope/wish that your God, whom you worship regularly, will rescue you!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Daniel, "Do' raca' mipu ulun!
english: I answered, “◄Your Majesty/O king►, I hope that you will live a long time!

lun_bawang: Idi Raca' Darius nengayud aceh surat kuan amung-amung lemulun ratnan anid-anid bawang, pupu, idi luk ratnan manid-manid buri' bang tana' ini. Kebalaneh: "Tabi'!
english: Then King Darius wrote this message and sent it throughout his kingdom to the people of every people-group and nation and from all language groups: “I wish/hope that everything is going very well with you!

lun_bawang: luk ratnan luk sinierku bang dacem ineh: Inan bui rat iapeh-iapeh luk nenganau' ribut déi' abpa rayeh.
english: I, Daniel, had a vision last night. In the vision I saw that strong winds were blowing from all four directions, stirring up the water in the ocean.

lun_bawang: Idi ui nenier pung luk kedueh ineh. Idi ayuneh mepad kudeng beruang luk tuped kudeng lemulun. Idi inan teluh tulang sigarang bang tangneh, idi inan aceh tang luk nepebala neneh, "Kuman uang pung pad iko mebor.”
english: The second beast resembled a bear. It was crouching, and it held between its teeth three ribs from another animal that it had killed and eaten. Someone said to it {It was told}, “Stand up and eat as much meat as you want!”

lun_bawang: Kareb ui nutong teh, idi teh ui nekali' aceh pung luk baken. Ayuneh mepad kudeng kuir. Idi luun ketedneh inan apat ilad, luk mepad kudeng ilad suit. Idi teh inan apat uluhneh! Idi ieh inan lalud ngimet.
english: Then I saw in front of me the third of those beasts. It resembled a leopard, but it had four wings protruding from its back. The wings were like a bird’s wings. It had four heads. It was given the power/authority to rule people.

lun_bawang: Kareb ui nenier, inan tuda'-tuda' kerusi raca' luk rireng. Idi Seburur luk mulun ruked-ruked tudo luun sebuleng kerusi ineh. AyungNeh mebuda' mepad kudeng salju, idi abpukNeh mepad kudeng buluh dumba luk do'. KerusiNeh mebudung ku apui, kudeng ineh teh rodaneh;
english: Then while I watched, thrones were put in the places where they belonged, and God, the one who had been living forever, sat on one of the thrones. His clothes were as white as snow, and his hair was as white as pure/clean wool. His throne had wheels that were blazing with fire, and his throne was also blazing.

lun_bawang: Kareb ui nenutong, ui neninger unga luk isuut ineh pebala dengan medita' niat, idi pung luk keapat ineh pinaté, idi butungneh tila' bang apui idi neseb.
english: While I was watching, I could hear the little horn speaking very boastfully. As I continued to watch, the fourth beast was killed. Its corpse was thrown into a fire and completely burned.

lun_bawang: Bang luk sinierku kareb medacem ineh, idi ui nenier luk kudeng ayu lemulun. Idi Ieh amé'-amé' muneng bang laput, idi Ieh iné' matun Neneh luk mulun ruked-ruked, idi Ieh kinuyut amé' pa kiungNeh.
english: While I continued to see the vision that night, I saw someone who resembled a human being. He was coming closer to me, surrounded by clouds. Then he was taken to God, the one who had been living forever.

lun_bawang: Luk sinierku ineh nengagap negku, pad ui mengagau.
english: As for me, Daniel, I was very terrified by what I had seen in that vision, and I did not know what to think about it.

lun_bawang: Ui iné' mutuh seburur lun luk tuped su ineh ngegala' ratnan ineh. Idi ieh nemada' ilungneh negku.
english: I went to one of those who were standing in front of the throne of God, and I asked him to tell me what it meant. So he told me the meaning of it.

lun_bawang: Ini ilung luk bida' negku: "Pung luk keapat, ieh ineh imet luk keapat luk miak mangun bang tana' ini, idi luk baken ratnan amung-amung imet. Ieh miak ngareg amung tana' ini, idi ngeradu' neneh.
english: Then the man who was standing there said to me, “The fourth beast represents an empire that will exist on the earth; that empire will be different from all other empires. The army of that empire will crush/kill people all over the world and trample on their bodies.

lun_bawang: Idi besara' ineh miak ngimun, idi ngagka' laludneh idi ngaté neneh.
english: But there will be a session/meeting of the court/judges in heaven, and that king’s authority/power will be taken away, and he will be completely destroyed.

lun_bawang: Idi ini kekiped balaneh. Ui ini Daniel pelaba tot pad kiungku mebudi, iamo' ui nenganug bala ini bang niatku.
english: That is what I saw in my vision/dream. I, Daniel, was terrified, with the result that my face became pale. But I did not tell anyone about the vision that I had seen.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh, "Pangeh 2,300 malem idi pekak, Ruma' Allah miak uen ngedo'.”
english: The other angel replied, “It will continue for 1,150 days. During all of that time, people will not be permitted to offer sacrifices in the morning or in the evening. After that, the temple will be purified.”

lun_bawang: Idi ui neninger aceh tang lemulun luk nawar rat déi' dipar Abpa' Ulai, kebalaneh, "O Gabriel, mada' neneh ratnan ilung luk sinierneh ineh.”
english: And I heard a man call out from the other side of the Ulai Canal, saying, “Gabriel, explain to him the meaning of the vision that he saw!”

lun_bawang: Idi Gabriel iné' tuped iringku, idi ui pelaba tot, pad ui neluka'. Kebala Gabriel negku, "O lemulun, do' iko kali' ilungneh. Luk siniermu ineh ngegala' ratnan luk kekiped.”
english: So Gabriel came and stood beside me. I was very terrified, with the result that I fell onto the ground. But he said to me, “You human, it is necessary for you to understand that the events that you saw in the vision will occur near the time that the world will end.”

lun_bawang: kebalaneh, "Ui ngegala' kuanmu ratnan luk mangun ngaceku useh Allah. Luk siniermu ineh ratnan kekipedneh.
english: Then he said, “I have come here to tell you what will happen because of God being angry. These things will happen near the time when the world will end.

lun_bawang: "Kareb kekiped imet ineh malé macing, idi ideh pelaba dat, pad ideh na miak na kumin, idi aceh raca' luk dat luk naluk idi luk metueh niat miak ngimet.
english: The people in those kingdoms will become very wicked, with the result that it will be necessary for them to be punished. But near the time when those kingdoms will end, one of those kingdoms will have a king who will be very proud/defiant IDM. He will also be very fierce and very deceitful.

lun_bawang: Luk siniermu ineh ratnan baré pa malem idi pa pekak luk pangeh linio namu kali' rungen matu. Do' ngalum ineh, ngaceku mio teh luk siniermu ineh mangun.”
english: What you saw in the vision about priests being prevented from making sacrifices in the morning and in the evening, which I explained to you, will surely happen. But for the present time, do not reveal the vision to others, because it will be many years before those things happen.”

lun_bawang: Ui nesembayang inan Tuhan Allahku idi nengamo amung sala' pupuku. Kesembayangku, "O Tuhan Allah, Iko luk rayeh idi luk buren kai. Iko luk lutep maya' jani'Mu, idi megéi ngegala awaMu luk lutep kuan lemulun luk mawa Namu idi luk maya' amung-amung ukumMu.
english: I confessed the sins that we had committed, and this is what I prayed: Lord, you are great and awesome! You have faithfully done what you said that you would do for us. You faithfully love those who love you and who do what you have commanded that they should do.

lun_bawang: "O Tuhan Allah kai, Iko nengegala' laludMu kareb Iko nenguit pupuMu remuat rat bang bawang Masir, idi macing nekini kai ngerawé laludMu. Kai pangeh nenganau' sala'. Kai pangeh nenganau' luk dat.
english: O Lord our God, you brought your people out of Egypt by your great power MTY, and by doing that you have caused people from that time until the present time to know that you are great IDM even though we have sinned and done wicked things.

lun_bawang: O Allah, ninger sembayang idi putuhku. Ngedo' rama'Mu luk pangeh unusag. Ngedo' neneh pad amung-amung lemulun kali' idi Iko luk Allah.
english: O Lord our God, listen to what I am praying and pleading for you to do. ◄For your own sake/In order that people will know that you are very great►, act kindly IDM concerning your temple, which was destroyed by the armies of Babylonia.

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "O Daniel, ui iné ngedengan namu, pad iko kali' ilung bada' luk biré ineh.
english: He said to me, “Daniel, I have come to you to enable you to understand DOU clearly the message that God gave to Jeremiah.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh negku, "O Daniel, Allah mawa namu. Do' tuped idi ninger do'-do' amung-amung luk belénKu. Ui luk icuk amé namu." Kareb Ieh pangeh nepebala kudeng ini, idi ui netuped dengan megegker teh.
english: The man said to me, “Daniel, God loves you very much. Stand up and listen to what I am going to say to you, because God sent me to you.” When he said that, I stood up, but I was still trembling.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh, "O Daniel, aleg matot. Allah neninger sembayangmu bang aco luk pun-pun kareb iko nengebeneh bururmu, pad iko miak kali' ilungneh. Idi Ui luk iné' ngua' sembayangmu.
english: Then he said to me, “Daniel, do not be afraid. God has heard what you have prayed ever since the first day that you determined to humble yourself in order to understand the vision. I have come to you because of what you prayed.

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "Allah mawa namu, aleg megagau idi matot. Do' iko mekuu'." Kareb Ieh pangeh nepebala, idi ui metueh, idi kebalaku, "O Tuhan, anunké luk belénMu. Ngaceku ui do' inau'Mu.”
english: He said to me, “You human, God loves you very much. So do not be afraid. I desire/want things to go well for you and that you will be encouraged.” When he had said that, I felt even stronger, and I said, “Sir, tell me what you want to tell me. You have enabled me to feel stronger.”

lun_bawang: -21Idi kebalaNeh, "Kali'mu, amé' ngudeh Ui namu? Ui pian mada' namu ratnan luk inayud bang Surat luk Matu. Nekini Ui lemubed amé' munu' melaikat luk dat luk matar imet Parsi. Pangeh ineh melaikat luk dat luk matar imet Grika miak macing. Idi seburur pana' nateh luk ngedengan Negku, iamo' Mikail mo' sebuleng, ieh ineh melaikat luk matar bawang Israil.
english: Then he said, “◄Do you know why I came to you?/I will tell you why I came to you.► RHQ It is to reveal to you what is written in the book which reveals/contains God’s truth.
