But now I must return to fight against the evil spirit who rules the kingdom of Persia. After I have defeated him, the evil angel who guards Greece will appear and I must defeat him. Michael, who guards you Israeli people, will help me, but there is no one else to help me.”

lun_bawang: "Mikail ineh luk ngedengan negku idi luk matar negku.
english: “As for me, during the first year that Darius was king, I helped and encouraged Michael.”

lun_bawang: "Idi raca' Masir ineh metueh. Iamo' seburur lun rayeh bawehneh miak meluun tueh pad ieh mangun ku raca' aceh imet luk meluun rayeh.
english: Then the King of Egypt MTY will become very powerful. But one of his army generals will become more powerful than he is, and he will rule a bigger area.

lun_bawang: Idi mula' lemulun sikal metueh ratnan raca' Masir. Idi tuda'-tuda' burur lemulun luk mesangit ratnan pupu Daniel sebuleng sikal metueh ngaceku aceh luk sinierdeh, iamo' ideh miak uen ngelaya'.
english: At that time, many people in Egypt will rebel against their king. In order to fulfill a vision that one of their leaders had seen, some violent/lawless people from your country of Israel will also rebel in order to not be controlled by Egypt any more, but they will be defeated.

lun_bawang: "Seburur raca' luk baken miak ngelibal neneh, idi ieh miak ngecuk lemulun ngamung pupuk pad ieh ngula' binaweh imetneh. Iamo' na mio teh raca' ineh pana' miak pitayen, iamo' baken bang bunu'.
english: Then another man will ◄succeed him/become king►. That king will send one of his officers to oppress the people in Jerusalem by forcing them to pay big taxes, in order to get more money for his kingdom. But after a few years HYP that king will die, but he will not die as a result of people being angry with him or in a battle.

lun_bawang: "Idi raca' luk nengelibal raca' Siria ineh seburur lemulun luk dat luk na petulu mangun ku raca'. Iamo' denak-denak ieh ngalap lalud dengan naluk.
english: The next King of Syria will be an evil man who, because he will not be the son of the previous king, will not have the right to become king. But he will come when people do not expect it, and he will become king by tricking the people.

lun_bawang: "Muci ieh miak amé' munu' bawang Masir sekua' teh, iamo na ieh mangun kudeng luk atun.
english: When it is the time that God has decided, the King of Syria and his army will invade Egypt again. But this time he will not be successful like he was before.

lun_bawang: Tuda'-tuda' babpat bawehneh miak ngelutak Ruma' Allah idi libungneh. Ideh ngagka' baré luk pekalai anid-anid aco, idi naped Akang luk Nguyo ineh.
english: Some of his soldiers will do things to ◄defile the temple/cause the temple to become unholy for them►. They will prevent the priests from offering sacrifices each day, and they will put in the temple something that is disgusting/abominable.

lun_bawang: Lun luk mileh miak mada' mula' lun baken. Iamo' na mio sebuang miak pitayen bang bunu' idi apui. Idi binaweh sebuang miak pinawen lun luk mano, idi ideh pana' tebanen.
english: And wise Israeli leaders will teach others also. But for a while, some of those wise leaders will be killed in battles, and some will be burned to death, and some will be robbed, and some will be put in prison.

lun_bawang: Idi seburur nepebala nan lemulun luk ngayung ku kibung luk do', luk tuped pa dayeh sesuut, "Tuda' ioké pad macing kekiped amung luk inan mawa ini?”
english: One of them called to the other one, who was wearing linen/white clothes, who was now standing further up (OR, above) the river, “How long will it be until these amazing/frightening events end?”

lun_bawang: Ui neninger balaneh ineh, iamo' na kali' ilungneh. Idi ui nengitun, kebalaku, "O tuan, kudeng apehké kekipedneh?”
english: I heard what he said, but I did not understand it. So I asked, “Sir, what will be the result when these things end?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh, "Amé iko Daniel, ngaceku amung bala ini uen ngalum macing kareb luk kekiped.
english: He replied, “Daniel, you must leave now. I cannot answer your question because what it means must ◄be kept secret/not be revealed► DOU until the time when everything ends.

lun_bawang: "Rat kareb ideh nugka' maré baré luk pekalai, ieh ineh rat kareb Akang luk Nguyo, inan 1,290 aco.
english: But I can tell you that before everything ends, there will be 1,290 days, from the time that people are prevented from offering sacrifices each day, that is, from the time that the abominable/disgusting thing is put in the temple.

lun_bawang: "O Daniel, do' iko lutep macing kareb luk kekiped. Idi iko miak maté, iamo' iko miak tumui idi ngalap tabparmu kareb aco luk kekiped ineh."
english: So now I say to you, continue to faithfully trust God until your life on earth ends. You will die EUP, but when everything ends, you will receive your reward from God.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Tuhan pun-pun pebala nelun Israil dengan tang Hosia, idi kebalaNeh neneh, "Pupu bang bawang ini na lutep Negku idi ideh sembayang inan allah baken. Ngaceku ineh do' iko ngaweh aceh decur luk na lutep namu muci; pad iko inan anak rat neneh.”
english: When Yahweh first began to give messages to me to tell to the people of Israel, he said to me, “Go and marry a prostitute. But some of her children will be born as a result of her having sex with men to whom she is not married. That will illustrate how the people of Israel have turned away from me and worship ◄idols/other gods►.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Hosia, "Do' nganau' ngadanneh, 'Yesril' ngaceku na mio teh ui miak ngukum raca' Israil ngaceku tepunneh Yihu nengaté tuda'-tuda' lemulun déi' Yesril. Idi Ui miak ngagka' imet inul Yihu déi' Israil.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Give him the name Jezreel, which means ‘God scatters’, because I will soon punish the descendants MTY of King Jehu by scattering them, because he killed many of my people at Jezreel town. Some day I will end the kingdom of Israel,

lun_bawang: Sekua' teh Gomer mali' idi ieh nenganak aceh anak decur. Idi kebala Tuhan ni Hosia, "Do' nganau' ngadanneh, 'Na Inan Méi',' ngaceku Ui na miak méi' idi maré do' nelun Israil teh.
english: Later Gomer became pregnant again, and she gave birth to a daughter. Yahweh said to me “Give her the name Lo-ruhamah, which means ‘not loved,’ because I will no longer show that I love the people MET of Israel, and I will not forgive them for the sins that they have committed.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan ni Hosia, "Do' nganau' ngadanneh, 'Baken PupuKu,' ngaceku muyuh ini, Israil, baken pupuKu, idi Ui ini baken Allah muyuh.”
english: Yahweh said “Give him the name Lo-ammi, which means 'not my people', because the people of Israel are no longer my people, and I am not their God.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh do' neten kinanakmu lun Israil "Pupu Allah" idi "Luk Inan Tuhan Méi'.”
english: At that time, you will say to your fellow-Israeli men, “You are God’s people,” and you will say to your fellow-Israeli women, “You are ones whom God loves.”

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh Ui pian nguit neneh amé' déi' su luk ali-ali teh, pad Ui ngubuk neneh dengan awaKu.
english: But listen! Some day I will persuade my people to worship me again; I will lead them out into the desert and speak kindly to them there.

lun_bawang: Sekua' teh ieh neten Negku awanneh, idi na ieh neten Negku akang Baalneh.
english: At that time, they will say to me, ‘It is as though MET you are our husband.’ They will not say that I am their master, like they considered that Baal was.

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh Ui ngua' sembayang pupuKu Yesril. Ui maré udan luun tana',
english: At that time, when they request me to do things for them, I will do those things. When they request clouds and rain to fall on their land, I will speak to the clouds, and rain will fall on the earth,

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Tuhan negku, "Do' iko amé' sekua' teh inan awanmu luk inanmu mawa, sagan tu pana' ieh pasét. Do' mawa neneh mepad kudeng Ui mawa nelun Israil, sagan tu pana' ideh maya' allah baken luk inandeh maré kireng bua' anggur.”
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Go and show to your wife that you still love her, even though she has been committing adultery with another man who loves her. That will show that I still love the people of Israel, even though they worship other gods/idols and eat raisin cakes in feasts that honor those gods.”

lun_bawang: Kebalaku neneh ieh miak tudo mio denganku. Ieh na miak pasét. Idi na ui pamung rudap denganneh teh.
english: Then I said to her, “You must wait for many days before we sleep together EUP. During that time, you must not be a prostitute, and you must not have sex with any other man; but I will live with you.”

lun_bawang: Tuhan ngesala' nelun luk tudo bang bawang ini. O Israil, ninger balaNeh. Ini adu'Neh: "Lemulun bang bawang ini na lutep maya' jani'deh, idi na mawa. Ideh na ngamo Negku ini Allahdeh.
english: You Israeli people, listen to this message from Yahweh! He is accusing you people who live in this country, saying “The people are not faithfully doing what pleases me, they are not kind to others, and they do not even know me!

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Aleg ngadu' idi periteteng nelun mula', ngaceku adu'Ku ini nelun imam.
english: But no one should accuse someone else and say it is his fault. It is you priests whom I am accusing.

lun_bawang: "Sagan tu pana' pupu Israil na lutep maya' Negku, aleg lun Yahuda mesala' bang luk kudeng ineh. Aleg amé' sembayang déi' Gilgal idi Baitel, idi aleg pejani' su ineh bang ngadan Tuhan luk mulun.
english: You Israeli people have abandoned me like MET those who commit adultery have abandoned their spouses. But do not cause the people of Judah to sin also. Do not go to Gilgal or go up to Beth-Aven towns to worship idols there. Do not make solemn promises there, saying ‘Just as surely as Yahweh lives, I will do what I am promising.’

lun_bawang: "O muyuh lun imam, ninger bala ini! O muyuh lun Israil, ninger do'-do'! O muyuh luk tetek ruma' raca', ninger! Petulu muyuh ngukum nelun baken, iamo' muyuh sebuleng miak kumin.
english: “Listen, you priests! And you other Israeli people, you also pay attention! And you who are members of the king’s family, you also need to listen, because I am going to judge you! Your worshiping idols has been like MET a trap for the people at Mizpah town; it has been like MET a net spread out to catch people at Tabor Mountain.

lun_bawang: Nateg tawak déi' Gibia idi déi' Rama pana'! Ngitang déi' Baitel! Amé' pebunu', O lun Beniamin!
english: Blow the rams’ horns in Gibeah town and blow the trumpets in Ramah town! Warn the people at Beth-Aven town; you warriors of the tribe of Benjamin, lead the troops into the battle.

lun_bawang: "Kareb Israil nekali' étneh, idi Yahuda nenier uratneh, idi Israil iné' déi' Asur mutuh raca' rayeh ngedengan nedeh, iamo' na ieh miak ngedo' étdeh idi uratdeh ineh.
english: When the leaders of Israel and Judah saw that the people were suffering because of what their enemies were doing to them MET, they sent messages to the great King of Assyria requesting his help. But he cannot help you; he cannot cause you to stop suffering, because I am the one who is punishing Israel and Judah.

lun_bawang: Do' tau lumi inan Tuhan. Ieh nengeramit netau, iamo' kali' rungen Ieh miak ngedo' netau. Ieh pangeh nengurat netau, iamo' naké Ieh ngabet urat tau lek?
english: The Israeli people say, “Come, let’s return to Yahweh! He has caused us to be injured, but he will heal us. He has caused us to be wounded, but it is as though he will put bandages on our wounds MET.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Tuhan, "O Israil idi Yahuda, anunké luk ruenKu kuan muyuh? Awa muyuh Negku saget buro mepad kudeng laput pa pekak. Ieh ineh mepad kudeng ipup luk buro kareb mét idang.
english: But Yahweh knows they are insincere; so he says to them, “You people of Israel, and you people of Judah, I do not know RHQ what I should do to you. Your being faithful to me will disappear as quickly as SIM the morning mist disappears, like SIM the dew on the ground that disappears quickly when the sun shines.

lun_bawang: "O lun Yahuda, Ui pangeh nengeletep aceh kareb ngukum nemuyuh ngaceku kekamen muyuh luk dat.
english: And you people of Judah, I have appointed a time when I will punish MET you, too. Whenever I wanted to enable my people to prosper again,”

lun_bawang: Israil mepad kudeng suit limun luk mebacé; pun-pun ieh mutuh pedengan rat ni Masir. Pangeh ineh ieh temulud amé' Asur!
english: The people of Israel have become foolish and stupid like SIM doves. First they called out to Egypt to help them, and then they sought help from Assyria.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Nateg tawak! Bunu'-bunu' ngerieng bawangKu mepad kudeng kanui! PupuKu pangeh nengelaba jani' luk inau'Ku nedeh, idi ideh ara' maya' bada'Ku.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Blow MTY your trumpet to warn the people! My people have rejected the agreement that I made with them, and they have rebelled against obeying my laws. Therefore, their enemies are swooping down on my people’s country like SIM an eagle.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Amung kekamendeh luk dat nengimun déi' Gilgal. Su ineh Ui nengimun megateh nedeh. Ngaceku amung kekamendeh luk dat, Ui miak ngusu nedeh rat bang bawangKu. Idi Ui na miak mawa nedeh peh; amung lun luk ngimet nedeh sikal metueh rat Negku.
english: Yahweh says, “Because of all the wicked things that my people did at Gilgal, that is where I started to hate them. And now, because of all the sinful things that they have done, I will expel them from my country. I will not love them any longer; all their leaders rebel against me.

lun_bawang: Na mio pupu ini miak pebala, "Tau na raca', ngaceku na tau matot inan Tuhan. Iamo' anunké luk miak ruen raca' kuan tau.
english: Then they will say, ‘It is because we did not revere Yahweh that we no longer have a king. But even if we had a king, he certainly could not RHQ do anything to help us.’

lun_bawang: Bubpun luk dat su luk inan lun Israil sembayang inan akang miak uen ngusag. Tabpa' idi uduh miak mulun luun bubpundeh. Lun Israil miak pebala inan pegkung, "Ngapung nekai!" idi inan surud, "Mebpeh luun kai!”
english: The altars on the tops of hills where the people worshiped idols will be destroyed; those have been the places where the people of Israel sinned greatly. Thorns and weeds will grow and cover those altars. Then the people will plead to the mountains and hills, ‘Fall down and cover us to protect us from God punishing us!’

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Lun Israil na ugka' nganau' sala' pa kiungKu rat kareb ideh nenganau' sala' déi' Gibia. Idi ideh miak pebunu' déi' Gibia teh.
english: You people of Israel, ever since your ancestors did evil things at Gibeah, you have continued to sin. When the people at PRS Gibeah did evil things, the result was a war in which thousands of people died.

lun_bawang: "Kareb Israil anak, Ui mawa neneh; kareb ieh nenalan rat Masir, Ui neneten neneh anakKu,
english: “Before the Israeli people became a nation MET, I loved them like a man loves his son, and I called them out of Egypt.

lun_bawang: "Ideh ara' lumi Negku. Ngaceku ineh na miak na ideh lemubed amé' Masir, idi Asur miak ngimet nedeh.
english: But the people of Israel will become slaves again, like they were in Egypt, and the people of Assyria will RHQ rule over them, because the people of Israel refused to repent.

lun_bawang: "O Israil, kudeng apehké Ui miak nala' nemuyuh? Kudeng apehké' Ui miak necan nemuyuh? Miakké Ui ngusag nemuyuh mepad kudeng Ui nengusag Adam, idi ngedereh nemuyuh, mepad kudeng Ui nengedereh Seboim? Na Ui mawang niat nganau' luk kudeng ineh! Ui méi' nemuyuh.
english: You people of Israel, I certainly do not want to RHQ abandon you and allow your enemies to capture you. I do not RHQ want to act toward you like I acted toward Admah and Zeboiim, cities that I completely destroyed when I destroyed Sodom. I SYN have changed my mind about punishing you; my desire to pity you has increased.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebaladeh, 'Kai lun do'. Kai pangeh nengalap mula' binaweh. Seburur pana' nateh luk miak ngadu' nekai ratnan ngalap binaweh dengan naluk.'
english: The people of Israel boast, saying “We are very rich DOU; and we got all that money by our own efforts, and without committing any sin.”

lun_bawang: Ui ini Tuhan Allah muyuh luk nguit nemuyuh remuat rat bang bawang Masir. Idi Ui miak nganau' nemuyuh tudo bang lepo kibung sekua' teh, mepad kudeng kareb Ui iné' ngikak nemuyuh déi' su luk ali-ali.
english: “I am Yahweh your God, the one who brought your ancestors out of Egypt. And some day I will force you to live in tents again like your ancestors did when they celebrated the Festival of Living in Temporary Shelters.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ui ini Tuhan Allah muyuh luk nenguit nemuyuh remuat rat bang bawang Masir. Kareb ineh muyuh na ngiti Allah baken rat Negku. Ui ini sebuleng Lun Nengulun nemuyuh.
english: But Yahweh says to his people, “I am Yahweh, your God, the one who brought your ancestors out of Egypt. You must believe that only I am God and that there is no other God, and that there is no one else who can save you!

lun_bawang: Ui na pian muit pupu ini ratnan su luk inan até, idi ngulun nedeh ratnan lalud até ineh. O até, do' amé' nedeh dengan galihmu! O su luk inan até, do' amé' nedeh dengan usagmu! Na Ui méi' inan pupu ini.
english: I certainly will not RHQ save you from being killed and from going to the place where the dead people are. I will RHQ cause you to be afflicted by plagues and to die and be buried in graves. I will not be merciful to you.

lun_bawang: Do' lumi inan Tuhan, idi nima' sembayang ini mangun ku aceh baré kuanNeh: "Maré do' ratnan amung-amung sala' kai, idi ninger sembayang kai, pelé kai ngubur Namu mepad kudeng luk pijani' kai.
english: So now return to Yahweh and say MTY this to him: “Forgive us for all the sins that we have committed, and kindly accept ◄us/our sacrifices► in order that we may thank/praise you IDM.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, Ui miak nguli' pupuKu. Ui miak mawa nedeh dengan amung niatKu, ngaceku na Ui museh nedeh nekini.
english: Yahweh says, “If they say that to me, I will forgive them for having ◄turned away from/abandoned► me, and I will love them with all my inner being, because I PRS will have stopped being angry with them.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Do' uren nekini, idi lemubed maya' Negku dengan niat luk matu, idi nangi' dengan mawa'
english: But Yahweh says, “In spite of these disasters that you have experienced, you can return to me with all your inner beings. Weep, and mourn, and ◄fast/abstain from eating food► to show that you are sorry for having abandoned me.

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nengua' sembayangdeh: KebalaNeh, "Nekini Ui maré padé nemuyuh, dengan abpa' anggur idi umau, pad muyuh mebor, idi pad lun pupu baken na situnga nemuyuh peh.
english: When the people prayed, Yahweh answered and said, “I will give you plenty of grain and wine and olive oil, and you will be satisfied. And I will no longer allow other nations to insult you.

lun_bawang: "Muci Ui miak ngutang RohKu luun amung-amung lemulun: anak muyuh luk deléi idi decur miak mada' bala luk barénKu, idi deléi muyuh luk mengered miak nginupi, idi anak adi' deléi muyuh miak nier luk sirendeh.
english: “Some time later, I will give my Spirit to many HYP people. Your sons and daughters will proclaim messages that come directly from me. Your old men will have dreams that come from me, and your young men will have visions that come from me.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Kareb ineh Ui miak nuneb bawang Yahuda idi Yerusalim.
english: Yahweh says this: “At that time DOU, I will enable the people of Jerusalem and other places in Judah to prosper again.

lun_bawang: "Anun luk ruen muyuh kuanKu, O Sur, Sidon, idi amung babpat Pilistin? Muyuh pian ngua' Negkuké? Kudeng muyuh nganau' kudeng ineh, Ui miak ngua' kuan muyuh dengan mesaget!
english: You people of APO Tyre and Sidon cities and you people of the Philistia region, I certainly have not RHQ done anything to harm you! So if you are trying to get revenge on me, I will very quickly get revenge on you.

lun_bawang: "Maré kali' kuan amung-amung pupu: 'Do' temina' pebunu', nawar lun luk mesangit, idi ngamung lun luk amé' pebunu', idi nalan!
english: Proclaim to the people of all nations, “Prepare for a war! Summon your soldiers, and tell them to stand in their battle positions.

lun_bawang: "Do' amung pupu temina', idi amé' Ruan Yosapat. Idi su ineh Ui ini Tuhan miak tudo, idi ngukum amung-amung pupu.
english: The people in the nations near Judah must get ready and come to the Valley of Judgment. There Yahweh will sit and judge and punish them.

lun_bawang: "Kareb ineh, O Israil, iko miak kali' Ui ini Tuhan Allahmu. Ui tudo déi' Sion, pegkungKu luk meligan. Yerusalim miak mangun ku bawang luk meligan; pupu baken na miak ngalap ineh baruh peh.
english: Yahweh says, “At that time, you Israeli people will know that I am Yahweh, your God. I live on Zion, my sacred hill. Jerusalem will be a sacred city, and soldiers from other countries will never conquer it again.

lun_bawang: Kebala Amos, "Allah ngarod rat Pegkung Sion; idi arodNeh pedingeren rat Yerusalim, pad amung laman tekering, idi uduh luun buduk Pegkung Karmel luk mebata' amé' mesia'.”
english: This is what Yahweh said: “I will roar like a lion MET; when I speak from Zion Hill in Jerusalem DOU, my voice will resemble the sound of thunder. When that happens, the pastures where you shepherds take care of your sheep will dry up, and the grass on top of Carmel Mountain will ◄wither/become brown► because I will cause that no rain will fall.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Lun Damsik megéi' nganau' sala'. Kali' rungen Ui ngukum nedeh, ngaceku ideh ucet ngedereh nelun Giliad.
english: This is also what Yahweh said to me: “I will punish the people of Damascus, the capital of Syria, because of the many sins that they have committed; I will not change my mind about punishing them MTY, because the cruel things that they did to the people of the Gilead region were like MET people threshing grain using sledges that have ◄iron teeth/sharp iron nails► in them.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Lun Gasa megéi' nganau' sala'. Kali' rungen Ui ngukum nedeh, ngaceku ideh nenaban aceh pupu, pad ideh barén kuan lun Edom.
english: Yahweh also said this to me: “I will punish the people of the cities in Philistia: I will punish the people of Gaza city because of the many sins that they have committed; I will not change my mind about punishing them, because they captured large groups of people and took them to Edom and sold them to become the slaves of the people of Edom.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Lun Sur megéi' nganau' sala'. Kali' rungen Ui ngukum nedeh ngaceku ideh nenaban aceh pupu amé' bawang Edom. Na ideh nemaya' jani' luk inau'deh inan kinanakdeh.
english: Yahweh also said this to me: “I will punish the people of Tyre city because of the many sins that they have committed; I will not change my mind about punishing them, because they also captured large groups of our people and took them to Edom, disregarding the treaty of friendship that they had made with your rulers.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Lun Amon megéi' nganau' sala'. Kali' rungen Ui ngukum nedeh, ngaceku ideh muer batek decur Giliad luk mali', ngaceku ideh melili ku tana'.
english: Yahweh also said this to me: “I will punish the people of Ammon because of the many sins that they have committed; I will not change my mind about punishing them, because their soldiers even ripped open the bellies of pregnant women when their army attacked the Gilead region to gain more territory.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Lun Moab megéi' nganau' sala'. Kali' rungen Ui ngukum nedeh ngaceku ideh nengeseb tulang raca' Edom mangun ku kapur.
english: Yahweh also said this: “I will punish the people of Moab because of the many sins that they have committed; I will not change my mind about punishing them, because they dug up the bones of the king of Edom and burned them completely, with the result that the ashes became as white as lime.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Lun Israil megéi' nganau' sala'. Kali' rungen Ui ngukum nedeh, ngaceku ideh masui nelun luk na mesala' ngaceku na mayar balehdeh, idi ideh masui lun masi' luk na miak mayar raga kasut pana' mangun ku demulun.
english: Yahweh also said this: “I will punish the people of Israel because of the many sins that they have committed; I will not change my mind about punishing them, because they sell righteous people to get a small amount of silver; they sell poor people, causing them to become slaves, getting for each of them only the amount of money with which they could buy a pair of sandals.

lun_bawang: Iamo' muyuh nengecuk nelun Nasiri ngirup abpa' anggur, idi nemebpeng nelun nabi na mada' balaKu.
english: But you commanded the prophets to not speak the messages that I gave to them, and you persuaded the Nazir-men to drink wine, which I told them never to do.

lun_bawang: Rat arang pupu bang tana' ini muyuh sebuleng mo' luk initiKu idi luk isa'Ku. Ngaceku ineh Ui ngukum nemuyuh ngaceku sala' muyuh.”
english: From all the people-groups on the earth, I chose and took care of only you. That is the reason that I will punish you for the sins that you have committed.”

lun_bawang: Mada' lemulun luk tudo bang ruma' raca' déi' Asdod idi Masir, kebala muyuh, "Do' muyuh mepamung déi' Samaria pelé muyuh nier ria' luk su ineh, idi sala' luk kikemdeh bang bawang ineh.”
english: I said this to the leaders of Samaria (OR, Yahweh said this to me): Send this message to the leaders MET in Ashdod city and to Egypt: “Come to the hills of Samaria and see the way that their ◄leaders/wealthy people► are causing people in that city to be terrified, and the way that they are causing the people to suffer!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Lemulun ini manu' ruma'deh ku binaweh luk uendeh ngaro dengan kekamen luk dat. Ideh na kali' dalan luk mesiri.
english: Yahweh says that the people there do not know how to do things that are right. Their homes are filled with valuable things that they have stolen or taken violently from others.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh bunu' miak ngelibut bawangdeh, idi ngusag libungdeh, idi ngaro ruma'deh.”
english: So Yahweh our God says that soon their enemies will come and tear down their ◄defenses/high city walls► and take away those valuable things.

lun_bawang: Do' muyuh ninger idi mada' inul Yakub," kebala Tuhan Allah luk Melalud.
english: The Commander of the armies of angels said this: “Proclaim this message about the descendants MTY of Jacob:

lun_bawang: "Kareb Ui ngukum pupu Israil ngaceku sala'deh, Ui ngusag amung bubpun Baitel. Lidung bubpun pana' uen nangal idi mebpeh luun tana'.
english: When I, Yahweh, punish the people of Israel because of the sins that they have committed, I will cause the altars at Bethel town to be destroyed; even the projections at the corners of the altars will be cut off and fall to the ground.

lun_bawang: Ninger do'-do', O muyuh decur Samaria, luk melamu mepad kudeng sapi' luk mebor, luk ngedereh lemulun luk melaya' idi lemulun luk masi', idi luk pebala inan awan muyuh, "Do' maré luk rupen!”
english: You wealthy women of Samaria have grown fat like MET the fat cows of the Bashan region. You oppress poor people and you cause needy people to suffer. And you say to your husbands, “Bring us more wine to drink!”

lun_bawang: Ui ini Tuhan luk meligan idi Ui pangeh nepejani', "Tarekneh macing idi muyuh miak riden ku od, pad anid burur muyuh mepad kudeng lawid luun keluit.
english: But Yahweh our God has said this: “Because I am holy, I solemnly promise this: It will soon be the time when you all will be taken to another country; your enemies will take you away as though they are using sharp hooks DOU to grab you.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah, "O muyuh lun Israil, amé' nganau' sala' déi' Baitel idi Gilgal! Idi nguit pung luk kereten anid-anid pekak, idi babpat pulu' muyuh bang anid teluh aco.
english: Go to Bethel and Gilgal towns where many people worship me and sin more and more SAR! I say that not because I want you to do it, but because it is what you have always been doing! Offer sacrifices on the morning after you arrive, and bring me ◄a tithe/one tenth► of your crops the next day.

lun_bawang: "Ui ini luk ngacing lau kuan amung bawang muyuh, pad muyuh na akan. Iamo' na muyuh lumi Negku.
english: I am the one who caused there to be no food in any of your cities and towns DOU, but you rejected me in spite of that.

lun_bawang: "Ui nemaré uled idi bangas luk nengaté padé muyuh. Kato nekuman kabun irin, anggur, gita', idi saitun muyuh. Iamo' na muyuh lumi Negku, kebala Tuhan.
english: I caused your grain fields to dry up; I caused your gardens and vineyards to be struck/destroyed by ◄blight/hot winds► and mildew. I sent locusts to eat the leaves on your fig trees and olive trees, but in spite of that, you rejected me. That is certainly true because I, Yahweh, have said it!

lun_bawang: "Ui nengukum sebuang muyuh mepad kudeng Ui nengukum Sodom idi Gemora. Muyuh mepad kudeng luten luk ilap ratnan apui. Iamo' na muyuh lumi Negku," kebala Tuhan.
english: I got rid of many of you, like I got rid of the people in Sodom and Gomorrah. Those of you who did not die were like SIM a burning stick that was snatched from a fire so that it would not burn completely. But in spite of that, you rejected me. That is certainly true, because I, Yahweh, have said it!

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku ineh, O lun Israil, Ui ngacing ukum ini kuan muyuh. Idi ngaceku ineh, do' muyuh temina' kumin Allah!”
english: So now, you people of Israel, I am going to punish you. Prepare to stand in front of me, your God, when I judge you!

lun_bawang: Israil ineh anak luk pun mebaruh luk pangeh nebpeh idi na miak tumui teh. Ieh telubid luun tana', idi na lun pian ngiding neneh.
english: “You are like MET a young woman, but in spite of that, you will certainly be struck down and you will never get up again! You will lie on the ground, abandoned, and there will be no one to help you stand up.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Aceh bawang lun Israil! Nengeruat 1,000 lun pebunu', iamo'
english: This is what Yahweh the Lord says to the people MTY of Israel: “When your enemies attack you, and when 1,000 of your soldiers will go to a battle, there will be only 100 who will survive. When 100 soldiers march out from a city to fight, there will be only ten who will remain alive.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan nelun Israil, "Amé' Negku, pad muyuh mulun.
english: Yahweh continues to say to the people MTY of Israel: “You Israeli people, return to me! If you do that, you will continue to remain alive.

lun_bawang: Pelaba susa' kuan muyuh luk nginulat aco Tuhan ineh. Anunké ulek aco Tuhan ineh kuan muyuh? Ieh ineh aco dacem, idi baken acang.
english: Terrible things will happen to you who desire that it will soon be the day when Yahweh will punish your enemies, because that will be a day of darkness, not of light.

lun_bawang: "O muyuh lun Israil, ruked apat ngepulu' lak kareb muyuh tudo déi' su luk ali-ali, muyuh na nguit luk kereten idi luk barén kuanKu.
english: You Israeli people MTY, your ancestors wandered through the desert for 40 years; and during that time, they never brought any sacrifices and offerings to me!

lun_bawang: Tuhan sebuleng pangeh nepebulung. Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud, "Ui megateh ku dita' niat lun Israil. Ui megateh ku ruma' raca'deh. Ui maré bawangdeh idi amung uangneh kuan bunu'deh.”
english: Yahweh the Lord has solemnly declared this: “I hate the people of Israel because they are very proud; I detest their fortresses. I will enable their enemies to capture their capital city and everything in it.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Tuhan ngecuk, amung ruma' luk rayeh idi luk isuut uen ngareg.
english: Terrible things like that will happen because Yahweh has commanded that large houses in Israel must be smashed into pieces, and small houses must be smashed into tiny bits.

lun_bawang: Tuhan Allah luk Melalud ngor bala muyuh, "Ui ngecuk aceh pupu ngerieng nemuyuh lun Israil. Ieh miak ngedereh nemuyuh rat Ruan Hamat luk pa tinueh busat aco macing Raked Araba luk pa kabing busat aco."
english: But the Commander of the armies of angels declares, “I will cause another nation to attack you people MTY of Israel; they will ◄oppress you/cause you to suffer► all the way from Hamath Pass in the northwest to the Dead Sea in the southeast.”

lun_bawang: Bang luk sinierku ineh, ui nekali' kato ineh kuman amung luk mebata' bang bawang ineh macing mabud. Idi kebalaku, "O Tuhan, maré do' kuan pupuMu! Kudeng apehké ideh mulun, ngaceku ideh pelaba isuut idi melaya'?”
english: And in the vision I saw those locusts come, and they ate everything that was green. Then I cried out, “Yahweh our Lord, please forgive us! We Israeli people are very helpless; ◄how will we be able to survive RHQ?/we will not be able to survive!►”

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nenginuud, kebalaNeh, "Luk siniermu ineh na mangun.”
english: So Yahweh changed his mind and said, “That will not happen.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaku, "O Tuhan do' ugka'! Kudeng apehké pupuMu mulun? Ideh pelaba isuut idi melaya'.”
english: Then I cried out again, “Yahweh our Lord, I plead with you, please stop this! We Israeli people are very helpless; how will we be able to survive RHQ?”

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nenginuud, kebalaNeh, "Luk siniermu ini pana' na mangun.”
english: So Yahweh changed his mind again, and said, “That also will not happen.”

lun_bawang: Amasia, imam Baitel nemada' ni Yerebom, raca' Israil, kebalaneh, "Amos pegayam nelun Israil, sikal metueh rat namu. Bada'neh ngusag bawang ini.
english: Then Amaziah, the priest at Bethel, sent a message to Jeroboam, the King of Israel. In the message he said, “Amos is plotting against you among the Israeli people MTY. I am worried that the people of this country will not be able to refute his words.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Amasia ni Amos, "O nabi, lemubed amé' bawang Yahuda ngalap akanmu idi mada' luk belén Tuhan su ineh.
english: Then Amaziah came to me and said, “You prophet, get out of here! Go back to the country of Judah! Earn money to buy food to be able to live there, and do your prophesying there!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Amos, "Ui baken nabi — baken ini kekamenku. Ui ini lun matar dumba, idi teh ui ngasa' gita'.
english: I replied to Amaziah, “I was previously not a prophet, and my father was not a prophet; I was a shepherd. I also took care of sycamore-fig trees.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan, "O Amos, anunké luk sirenmu?" Idi kebalaku, "Aceh tayen luk mepanu' ku bua'." Idi kebala Tuhan negku, "Tarekneh pangeh nacing kuan pupuKu lun Israil. Idi Ui na nginuud. Kali' rungen Ui ngukum nedeh.
english: He asked me, “Amos, what do you see?” I replied, “A basket of very ripe fruit.” He said, “That indicates that it almost the end for my Israeli people. I will not change my mind again about punishing them.

lun_bawang: Bang aco sineh amung nani déi' ruma' raca' mangun ku tido. Iapeh-iapeh pana' inan butung. Sebuleng uni pana' nateh luk pedingeren.”
english: Soon, instead of singing in the temple, they will be wailing. There will be corpses everywhere HYP. So, remain silent (OR, Everyone will be silent). These things will surely happen because I, Yahweh, have said it!”

lun_bawang: Tuhan, Allah lun Israil nepebulung, "Ui na mekelupan kekamendeh luk dat.
english: Yahweh has declared, “Although you are very proud of being descendants MTY of Jacob, I solemnly declare that I will not forget the evil things that you have done.

lun_bawang: Bang aco sineh Ui nganau' aco macep kareb muned aco, idi luun tana' medacem kareb maco. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: On the day when I punish my people, I will cause the sun to set at noontime, and the entire earth will be dark in the daytime.

lun_bawang: "Tarekneh macing idi Ui maré lau bang tana'deh. Lemulun miak melau, baken ku ruti, idi meparing, baken ku abpa'. Iamo' ideh melau ku bala Tuhan. Ui ini Tuhan pangeh nepebala.
english: And Yahweh our God says this: “It will soon be the time when I will cause something to be very scarce MET throughout the country. But it will not be a time when there is no food or water; it will instead be a time when there will be no messages from me for anyone to hear.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "O muyuh lun Israil, Ui nganau' luk mepad kuan muyuh idi kuan lun Sudan. Ui nenguit nelun Pilistin rat Kaptor, idi lun Siria rat Kir, mepad kudeng Ui nguit nemuyuh rat Masir.
english: And Yahweh says, “You people of Israel, you are certainly RHQ now no more important to me than the people of Ethiopia. I brought your ancestors here from Egypt, but I also brought the people of Philistia from Crete Island, and I brought the people of Syria from the Kir region.

lun_bawang: "Ui maré ukum idi ngagag nelun Israil mepad kudeng padé bang agag. Ui ngagag nedeh arang amung pupu pad nala' luk na ulek.
english: When I command it, it will be as though I will shake you Israeli people who are living in various nations, like MET a farmer shakes a sieve to separate the stone pebbles from the grain, in order that they do not fall on the ground with the grain.

lun_bawang: "Tarekneh macing," kebala Tuhan, "kareb lun ngeradu perapu lun luk ngeranih; idi lun baken temina' nganau' abpa' anggur, kareb lun nibu anggur ineh. Amung pegkung ngeruat abpa' anggur luk mepaci', idi ieh manud ratnan amung surud.
english: There will be a time when your crops will grow very well. Very soon after the crops are harvested, farmers will plow the ground to plant more crops in it again, and soon after the vineyards are planted, farmers will harvest grapes and tread on them to make wine. And because there will be a lot of wine, it will seem as though wine is flowing down from the hills DOU.

lun_bawang: Ini bada' luk biré kuan Obadia: ini bala Tuhan Allah ratnan bawang Edom.
english: This is a message that Yahweh our God gave to me, Obadiah, about the Edom people-group. Yahweh our God has told me this about the people of Edom: “I, Yahweh, have sent a messenger to other nations, telling them to prepare to go and attack Edom.”

lun_bawang: "Kareb lun mano macing kareb medacem, ideh ngalap luk piandeh mo'. Kareb lun ngalap bua' anggur, ideh necan sebuang. Iamo' bunu'mu pangeh nengabud namu.
english: When thieves break into someone’s house during the night, they certainly RHQ steal only the things that they want. And people who pick grapes always RHQ leave a few grapes on the vines. But your country will be completely destroyed!

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Kareb Ui ngukum Edom, Ui miak ngaté nedeh luk mileh, idi nala' amung ileh rat Pegkung Esau.
english: I, Yahweh, declare that at the time that I destroy Edom, I will punish the men who live in those cliffs who thought that they were wise.

lun_bawang: "Do' iko amé' Ninewé, bawang luk rayeh ineh, idi mada' neneh; ngaceku Ui pangeh nekali' amung-amung lemulun luk bang bawang ineh pelaba dat.”
english: “I have seen how wicked the people of MTY the great city of Nineveh are. Therefore go there and warn the people that I am planning to destroy their city because of their sins.”

lun_bawang: Idi lun luk ngimet kapal ineh iné' neneh, idi keburi'neh neneh, "Ngudeh iko rudap? Tumui iko idi nawar allahmu mutuh pedengan; kian lek ieh miak méi' netau, pad tau na maté.”
english: Then the captain went down to where Jonah was sleeping soundly. He awoke him and said to him, “◄How can you sleep during a storm like this?/You should not be sleeping during a storm like this► RHQ! Get up and pray to your god! Perhaps he will pity us and save us, in order that we will not drown!” But Jonah refused to do that.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' lun luk ngakem bang kapal ineh, "Do' tau nala' udi, pad tau kali' idé luk mesala', idi ieh luk nengacing susa' ini kuan tau." Idi ideh nenganau' kudeng ineh, idi Yunus luk nekaneh.
english: Then the sailors said to each other, “We need to ◄cast lots/shake from a container small objects that we have all marked►, to determine who has caused all  this trouble!” So they did that, and the object with Jonah’s mark fell out of the container.

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh neneh, "Do' iko mada' nekai, idé luk nengacing susa' ini! Iné ngudeh iko tungé'? Rat iapeh iko? Iapeh bawangmu, idi lun anun iko?”
english: So various ones of them asked him, “Are you the one who has caused us all this trouble?” “What work do you do?” “Where are you coming from?” “What country and what people-group do you belong to?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yunus, "Ui ini lun Iberani, ui sembayang inan Tuhan Allah déi' Surga, luk nenganau' abpa' idi tana'.”
english: Jonah replied, “I am a Hebrew. I worship Yahweh God, who lives in heaven. He is the one who made the sea and the land. I am trying to escape from doing what Yahweh told me to do.”

lun_bawang: Idi lun luk ngakem bang kapal ineh pelaba tot, idi keburi'deh neneh, "Pelaba dat luk inau'mu!" (Ideh kali' ieh neburo rat pa kiung Tuhan, ngaceku ieh nemala nedeh.)
english: After the sailors heard that, they were terrified. So they asked him, “Do you realize what trouble you have caused?”

lun_bawang: Idi ribut ineh iuk amé' mula', idi ideh nengitun neneh, "Anun luk ruen kai namu, pad ribut ini ugka'?”
english: The storm kept getting worse and the waves kept getting bigger. So one of the sailors asked Jonah, “What should we do in order to make the sea become calm?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yunus, "Do' nala' negku bang abpa', pad ribut ini miak ugka' kuan muyuh. Ui kali' ribut ini mangun ngaceku sala'ku.”
english: He replied, “Pick me up and throw me into the sea. If you do that, it will become calm. I know that this terrible storm is the result of my not doing what Yahweh told me to do.”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengitang nawar Tuhan, kesembayangdeh, "O Tuhan, kai mutuh Namu, aleg nima' nekai maté, ngaceku kai nala' lemulun ini. Aleg ngukum nekai mepad kudeng lun luk ngaté; ngaceku iko, O Tuhan luk nemada' nekai ratnan luk miak ruen kai.”
english: Therefore they prayed to Yahweh, and one of them prayed, “O Yahweh, please do not let us drown because of our causing this man to die. O Yahweh, you have done what you wanted to do. We do not know if this man has sinned. If he has not sinned, do not consider that we are guilty of sinning when we cause him to die!”

lun_bawang: "O Tuhan, bang susa'ku ui nenawar Namu, idi Iko nengua' sembayangku. Rat bang su luk inan até ui nenawar mutuh pedengan, idi Iko neninger tawarku,
english: Jonah said, “Yahweh, when I was greatly distressed here, I prayed to you, and you heard what I prayed. When I was about to descend way down into the place where dead people go, you heard me when I called out for you to help/save me.

lun_bawang: Kareb niatku lélé meputut, idi ui nengerawé Namu O Tuhan, idi sembayangku nacing Namu, bang Ruma'Mu luk meligan.
english: When I was almost dead EUP, Yahweh, I ◄thought about/prayed to► you. You heard my prayer, up there where you are, in your holy temple.

lun_bawang: "Do' iko amé' Ninewé, bawang luk rayeh ineh idi mada' nedeh ratnan bala luk bilaKu namu.”
english: “Go to that great city of Nineveh, and tell them the message that I gave you previously.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yunus pangeh nenalan, seaco kinioneh bang bawang ineh, ieh nemada' nedeh, keburi'neh, "Apat ngepulu' aco teh rat aco sini bawang Ninewé ini miak uen ngusag!”
english: On the first day after Jonah arrived, he began walking through the city. He was proclaiming (OR, At the end of that day he started proclaiming) to the people, “Forty days from now, Nineveh will be destroyed {God will destroy Nineveh}!”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nemaré kali' kuan amung lun Ninewé: "Ini aceh ukum ratnan raca' idi lun rayeh-rayeh teh: Seburur pana' nateh miak kuman anun-anun; do' lemulun, idi sapi', idi dumba pana', na miak kuman idi ngirup.
english: Then he sent messengers to proclaim to the people in Nineveh: “My advisors and I have decreed that no one may eat or drink anything. Do not even allow your animals to eat or drink.

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan nengua' sembayangneh, kebalaNeh, "Ngudeh iko museh?”
english: Yahweh replied, “◄Why is it right for you to be angry about my not destroying the city?/It is not right for you to be angry about my not destroying the city!► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Allah neneh, "Ngudeh iko pelaba useh ku tabuh ineh!" Idi Yunus nengor balaneh, "Kali' rungen ui pelaba useh, ngaceku ui geregan ku tabuh ineh!”
english: But God asked Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about what happened to the vine?” Jonah replied, “Yes, it is right! Now I am very angry and I want to die!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Tabuh ini netemubu' bang sedacem idi mekarang bang seaco. Na iko nengasa' neneh, idi na iko nenganau' neneh temubu' — iamo' iko méi' ku idi!
english: But Yahweh said to him, “You have been concerned about my causing that vine to wither, even though you did not take care of it, and you did not make it grow. It just grew up during one night, and it completely withered at the end of the next night.

lun_bawang: Amung ini miak mangun ngaceku pupu Israil pangeh nenganau' sala', idi sikal metueh ratnan Allah. Idéké luk uen ngesala' ratnan dat lun Israil? Lun Samaria mo'! Idéké luk nguit nelun Yahuda sembayang inan akang? Lun Yerusalim mo'!
english: Those things will happen because of the terrible sins DOU that the people MTY of Israel, the descendants of Jacob, have committed. But it was RHQ the people of Samaria city who persuaded all the people of Israel to sin, and it was RHQ because the people of Jerusalem set up altars to worship their gods that the other people of Judah were persuaded to worship idols on their hilltops.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh kebala Tuhan, "Ui ngacing susa' nemuyuh, pad muyuh na miak mepuit, pelé muyuh na mulun dengan medita' niat, ngaceku muyuh pelaba susa' kareb ineh.
english: Therefore, this is what Yahweh says: “I will cause you people to experience disasters, and you will not be able to escape MTY from them. You will no longer walk around proudly, because when those things happen, it will be a time of much trouble for you.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun Israil negku, "Aleg mada' nekai. Aleg mada' ratnan amung ineh. Allah na pian ngigu' nekai.
english: The people who heard me say that replied to me, “Do not prophesy such things! Do not say that Yahweh is going to humiliate us by causing us to experience disasters!”

lun_bawang: Inanké lun Israil kidiman Tuhan? Inanké Tuhan mawer niat? Miakké Tuhan nganau' luk kudeng ineh? Naké Ieh pebala luk do' kuan lemulun luk nganau' luk matu?”
english: But you people MTY of Israel should not RHQ talk like that! The Spirit of Yahweh will certainly not RHQ be patient with people who say such things! People who continually do things that are righteous will certainly RHQ like/appreciate what I say.

lun_bawang: "Pupu ini pian ku nabi luk mepanu' ku balih idi saluk, luk lawé-lawé mada', kebaladeh, 'Mula' abpa' anggur idi arak miak barén nemuyuh.'
english: You people want a prophet who will lie to you, saying ‘I will preach that you should drink plenty of wine and other alcoholic drinks!’ That is the kind of prophet who would please you.”

lun_bawang: O muyuh luk lun rayeh lun Israil! Petulu muyuh pian ku ukum luk mesiri,
english: Then I said, “You Israeli MTY leaders, listen to what I say! You should certainly RHQ know what things are right to do and what things are wrong,

lun_bawang: Pupu ini sinaluk nabi-nabi luk pejani' ngacing luk do' kuan lemulun luk mayar tabpardeh, iamo' ngacing bunu' kuan lemulun luk na mayar nedeh. Kebala Tuhan kuan nabi-nabi ini,
english: This is what Yahweh says about your false prophets who are deceiving the people: “If someone gives them food, those prophets say that things will go well for him. But they declare war against anyone who does not give them food.

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku muyuh ngeraruh pupuKu, idi muyuh na miak nier luk siren teh, idi teh muyuh na miak mada' ratnan luk mangun muci. O nabi-nabi, tarek muyuh lélé macing. Idi aco mangun medacem kuan muyuh kidi-kidi.”
english: So now it is as though MET night will descend on you prophets; you will not receive any more visions. It is as though MET the sun will set for you; the time when you are greatly honored will end.

lun_bawang: Lun rayeh-rayeh luk ngimet bawang ngalap suap, imam-imam luk ngelio ukum Tuhan ngalap tabpar, idi nabi-nabi pana' luk mada' luk sirendeh ngalap usin ku ineh. Idi kebaladeh, Tuhan idi dengandeh. Idi teh ideh pebala, "Naké Tuhan idi dengan kai? Na susa' macing nekai.”
english: Your leaders make favorable decisions only if they receive bribes. Your priests teach people only if those people pay them well. Your false prophets require people to pay them to tell people what will happen to them in the future. Those prophets say, “Yahweh is telling us what we should say, and we say that we will not experience any disasters.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Karebneh malé macing, idi Ui miak ngamung pupuKu luk medereh ngaceku tiban, ieh ineh lemulun luk inukumKu atun.
english: Yahweh says, “There will soon be a time when I will gather the people whom I have punished, who have been ◄exiled/forced to go to other countries►, all those whom I have caused to suffer much.

lun_bawang: Mula' pupu nepamung pian munu' nemuyuh. Kebaladeh, "Do' Yerusalim uen ngusag! Kai miak kali' bawang ini musag!”
english: Now the armies of many nations have gathered to attack you. They are saying, ‘Jerusalem must be destroyed! We want to see this city when it becomes ruins!’

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Kareb ineh Ui miak ngalap kuda muyuh idi ngusag keréta muyuh.
english: Yahweh says, “At that time, I will destroy you Israeli people’s horses that your soldiers use in war and your chariots.

lun_bawang: Do' ninger adu' Tuhan pa kiung lun Israil. O Tuhan, miket mada' adu'Mu. Pegkung mangun ku lun luk nekali'. Nima' amung surud ninger luk belénMu.
english: Pay attention to what Yahweh says to you Israeli people: “Stand up in court and state what you are accusing me about. And allow the hills and mountains to hear what you will say.

lun_bawang: Mileh lemulun luk matot inan Tuhan. Tuhan ngitang-ngitang bang bawang rayeh, "O muyuh luk bang bawang rayeh ini, do' muyuh ninger.
english: “I am Yahweh, so if you are wise, you should revere me. I am calling out to you people of Jerusalem, ‘The armies MET that will destroy your city are coming, so pay careful attention to me, the one who is causing them to punish you with my rod.

lun_bawang: Idi bunu'ku miak nier pad ideh migu', ieh ineh bunu' luk situnga negku, kebaladeh, "Iapehké Tuhan Allahmu?" Ui miak nier laya'deh, idi ngeradu' nedeh mepad kudeng buri.
english: Our enemies will also see that, and they will be disgraced because they ridiculed us, saying “Why is RHQ Yahweh, that God of yours, not helping you?” But with our own eyes we will see them when they are defeated; we will see them trampled like SIM mud in the streets.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan, "Ui miak nganau' kekamen luk melalud kuandeh, mepad kudeng luk inau'Ku, kareb iko remuat rat bang bawang Masir.”
english: Yahweh says/replies, “Yes, I will perform miracles for you like the miracles that I performed when I rescued your ancestors from being slaves in Egypt.”

lun_bawang: Ini luk belén Tuhan kuan pupuNeh, "Sagan pana' lun Asur mula' idi metueh, bawehdeh miak uen ngusag pad ideh na idi peh. O pupuKu, muyuh nedereh inau'Ku, iamo' na Ui pian nganau' kudeng ineh sekua' teh.
english: But this is what Yahweh says about you Israeli people: “Although the people of Assyria have very many people and their army is very powerful, they will be destroyed and will disappear. I say to my people in Judah, ‘ have already punished you, but I will not punish you again.

lun_bawang: Ini luk bila Tuhan ratnan lun Asur: "Na lun ngerawé nedeh peh. Ui miak ngusag amung akang luk bang ruma' allahdeh. Ui nganau' aceh lengutan kuan lun Asur, ngaceku na ideh petulu mulun bang tana' ini.”
english: And this is what Yahweh also declares about you people of Nineveh: “You will not have any descendants who will continue to have your family names. And I will destroy all the statues of your gods that were carved or formed in molds. I will cause you to be killed and sent to your graves, because you are vile/despicable!”

lun_bawang: Mepad kudeng abpa' rat bang leleng, lun buro rat Ninewé! "Ugka'-Ugka'!" kebala lun baken. Iamo' seburur pana' nateh luk lemubed.
english: The people will rush from Nineveh like SIM water rushes from a broken dam. The officials will shout, “Stop! Stop!” but the people will not even look back as they run away.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud, "Ui miak ngukum namu, O Ninewé! Ui miak ngelebpa namu, pad iko migu' siren amung pupu baken.
english: So the Commander of the armies of angels says to the people of Nineveh: “I am your enemy, and I will cause the people in other nations to see you completely humiliated like MET women who have committed adultery are humiliated by having their skirts lifted high, with the result that people can see their naked bodies.

lun_bawang: O Tuhan, tuda' ioké ui miak nawar Namu mutuh pedengan kareb nateh Iko ninger, idi ngulun nekai rat nelun luk ngedereh nekai?
english: I said, “Yahweh, how long must I continue to call to you for help before you respond? I cry out to you for help, saying that people are acting violently everywhere, but you do not rescue us!

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan kuan pupuNeh, "Do' nier amung-amung pupu luk libut-libut muyuh, idi muyuh miak mawa ratnan luk siren muyuh. Ui sikal nganau' aceh luk inan muyuh na manu kareb muyuh ninger bala ineh.
english: Yahweh replied to me, “I know that what you say is true, but look around at what is happening in the other nations; if you look, you will be amazed, because I am doing something during this time that you would not believe would happen, even if someone told you about it.

lun_bawang: Tuhan nemaré or ini negku, "Do' ngayud luun balad tana' salit, luk ruenKu ngelio namu, pad ineh malé uen maca'!
english: Then Yahweh replied to me, “Write plainly on tablets what I am revealing to you in this vision, and then read it to a messenger in order that he can run with it to tell it to other people.

lun_bawang: Muyuh miak kumin! Mesusa' kuan lemulun luk nguit nelun denganneh ngirup, luk ngutang luk megalih pad ideh mabuk, pad ideh nganau' kekamen luk na tabpen.
english: Terrible things will happen to you people of Babylonia who cause people who live in nearby countries to become drunk. You force them to drink a lot of wine from wineskins until they are drunk and then they walk around naked, in order that you can see that.

lun_bawang: Anunké ulek akang ineh? Ieh luk inau' lemulun mo', idi na ineh mada' luk matu kuan muyuh. Anunké do' luk ruenneh kuan lun luk mudut ineh, pad ieh merapet ku ineh. Ieh ineh aceh allah luk na miak pebala!
english: You people of Babylonia need to know that your idols are completely RHQ useless, because it is people who made them. Statues that have been carved or made in a mold deceive you. Those who trust in idols are trusting in things that they themselves created, things that cannot speak!

lun_bawang: "Kareb ineh Ui miak ngalap aceh lapung idi ngilu' Yerusalim do'-do'. Ui miak ngukum lemulun luk metalang niat, idi luk lutep maya' piandeh sebuleng, luk pebala bang niatdeh, 'Allah na nganau' anun-anun, luk do' idi luk dat pana'.'
english: It will be as though I will light lanterns to search in dark places in Jerusalem for those who have become very satisfied with their behavior and complacent about their sins. They think that I, Yahweh, will do nothing to them, neither good things nor bad things.

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh Ui nengerawé pupuKu ineh sikal matot Negku, idi ngalap bada'Ku. Ui nengerawé nedeh na mekelupan luk bida'Ku nedeh. Iamo' na mio teh ideh mepad dat kudeng luk atun.”
english: So I thought to myself, ‘Because of what I have done to those other nations, surely the people of Jerusalem will revere me now, and they will accept ◄my correcting them/my telling them to quit doing what is wrong►. If they do that, I will not destroy their houses; I will not punish them like I said that I would do.’ But in spite of knowing how I punished those other nations, they were still eager to get up early each morning and continue to do evil things.

lun_bawang: Karebneh miak macing idi ideh miak pebala kuan Yerusalim, "O bawang Sion, aleg matot! Aleg nima' ticu'mu melaya'!”
english: At that time, other people will say to us people of Jerusalem, “You people of APO Jerusalem, do not be afraid; do not become afraid or discouraged,

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan luk Melalud, "Lemulun ini pebala, ini baken kareb luk petulu mudut Ruma' Allah baruh.”
english: Yahweh, the Commander of the armies of heaven, told me that the people were saying that it was not yet time for them to rebuild Yahweh’s temple.

lun_bawang: "O pupuKu, ngudehké muyuh tudo bang ruma' luk do', iamo' Ruma'Ku sebuleng nusag?
english: “It is not right RHQ for you to be living in luxurious houses while my temple is only ruins!

lun_bawang: Siruh luk mangun kuan muyuh!
english: So this is what Yahweh, the Commander of the armies of heaven, says: “Think about what is happening to you.

lun_bawang: Idi Hagai nemada' bala Tuhan nelun mula'. KebalaNeh, "Ui idi dengan muyuh --ini jani'Ku.”
english: Then I, Haggai, who was Yahweh’s messenger, gave this message from Yahweh to the people: “I, Yahweh, declare that I am with you.”

lun_bawang: Ieh nengecuk ni Hagai nepebala kuan Serubabel, lun rayeh Yahuda, idi kuan Yosua luk Imam Rayeh, idi teh kuan lemulun bang bawang ineh. KebalaNeh nedeh,
english: The message was that I should say this to Zerubbabel, Jeshua, and to the other people who were still alive in Jerusalem:

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "Ngitun amung imam ratnan ukum ini:
english: This is what the Commander of the armies of angels said to me: “Ask the priests this question about what is written in the laws of Moses about sacrifices:

lun_bawang: Kudeng seburur lemulun nguit sesuut uang pung luk linigan ratnan aceh baré, linulun bang kayu'neh, idi kudeng kuyu' ineh mekaneh ku ruti, nuba', abpa' anggur, umau saitun, kian akan luk baken lek, miakké akan ineh mangun meligan?" Idi amung imam nengor bala Tuhan, kebaladeh, "Na miak.”
english: ‘If one of you priests takes from the altar some meat that was sacrificed and is carrying it in his robes, if his robe touches some bread or stew or wine or olive oil or some other food, does that food also become ◄holy/acceptable for a sacrifice►?’” When he said that to the priests, they replied, “No.”

lun_bawang: Idi Hagai nengitun imam-imam ineh, kebalaneh, "Kudeng seburur lemulun melutak ngaceku ieh pangeh nengakem butung, idi kudeng ieh ngakem sesuut ratnan akan ini, miakké akan ineh mangun melutak?" Idi imam ineh nengor balaneh, kebaladeh, "Miak.”
english: Then Haggai asked them, “If someone becomes unacceptable to God by touching a corpse, and then he touches any of those foods, will the food also become unacceptable to God?” The priests replied, “Yes.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Hagai, "Tuhan pebala, 'Kudeng ineh teh pupu ini, idi amung- amung luk ruendeh, pad amung-amung luk baréndeh luun bubpun pana' melutak.' “
english: Then Haggai replied, “Yahweh says this: ‘It is the same with you people and with this nation. Everything that you do and all the sacrifices that you all offer are unacceptable to me because of the sins that you have committed.

lun_bawang: "Mada' ni Serubabel, lun rayeh Yahuda ineh, kebalamu, 'Ui malé nguyu' langit idi tana'.
english: He said, “Tell Zerubbabel the governor of Judah that I am going to shake the sky and the earth.

lun_bawang: Tuhan luk Melalud nengecuk ni Sekaria pebala kuan pupuneh, "Ui ini Tuhan pelaba useh inan tepun muyuh.
english: “I was very angry with your ancestors.

lun_bawang: Ui nenier aceh melaikat Tuhan luk maya' kuda luk mesia'. Ieh pangeh nucu' liang kayuh hadas luun raked, idi pa puetneh inan kuda baken—mesia', mebuda' idi meburit.
english: During the night I had a vision. In the vision I saw an angel who was on a red horse. He was in a narrow valley among some myrtle trees. Behind him were angels on red, brown, and white horses.

lun_bawang: Idi ui nengitun neneh, kebalaku, "Anunké ilung kuda ini?" Idi kebalaneh, "Ui miak mada' ilungneh namu.
english: I asked the angel who had been talking to me, “Sir, who are those angels on the horses?” He replied, “I will show you who they are.”

lun_bawang: Tuhan luk nengecuk nelun luk maya' kuda ini amé' nier bang tana' ini.”
english: Then the angel who had been under the myrtle trees explained. He said, “They are the angels whom Yahweh sent to ◄patrol/see what is happening in► the entire world.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun luk maya' kuda ineh kuan melaikat, "Kai pangeh nenalan aput-aput tana' ini, idi lun luk bang tana' ini melaya' idi na pebunu'.”
english: Then those angels reported to the angel who was there among the myrtle trees, “We have traveled throughout the world, and we have found out that the army of the emperor of Persia has conquered nations throughout the world, and that those nations are now ◄helpless/unable to resist his army►.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala melaikat ineh, "O Tuhan luk Melalud, Iko museh inan Yerusalim idi bawang-bawang Yahuda kinio tudu' ngepulu' lak. Tuda' ioké idi Iko mada' éi'Mu nedeh?”
english: Then the angel asked, “Commander of the armies of angels, how long will you continue to not be merciful to Jerusalem and the other towns in Judah? You have been angry with them for 70 years!”

lun_bawang: idi melaikat ineh nengecuk negku mada' luk bila Tuhan luk Melalud ineh, kebalaNeh, "Ui mawa tu-tu idi méi' kuan Yerusalim, bawangKu luk meligan ineh. Idi Ui museh inan pupu baken luk mulun dengan na susa'.
english: Then the angel who had been talking with me said to me, “Proclaim this to the people of Jerusalem: The Commander of the armies of angels says that he is very concerned about the people who live on Zion Hill and in the other parts of Jerusalem.

lun_bawang: Idi nekini Ui amé' Yerusalim, pad Ui mada' éi'Ku kuan bawang ineh Ruma'Ku miak piduten baruh, idi bawang ineh pana'.”
english: Therefore, this is what he says: ‘I will again be merciful to the people of Jerusalem, and they will rebuild my temple. Men will measure all the land in the city before they start rebuilding the houses.’

lun_bawang: Idi melaikat ineh nengecuk negku mada', kebalaneh, "Tuhan luk Melalud nepejani' idi bawang-bawangNeh ini miak uen ngeperuan, idi Ieh miak ngubuk Yerusalim sekua' teh, pad ieh mangun ku bawangNeh luk pinili'.”
english: The Commander of the armies of angels also said this: ‘Tell the people that the people in my towns in Judah will soon be very prosperous again, and I will encourage the people of Jerusalem, and their city will again be my chosen city.’”

lun_bawang: Idi ui nemutuh melaikat ineh mada' ilungneh. Idi kebalaneh, "Ieh ineh apat imet bang tana' ini luk pangeh nematad nelun Yahuda, lun Israil, idi lun Yerusalim.”
english: I asked the angel who had been speaking to me, “What are those horns?” He replied, “Those horns represent the armies that forced the people of Jerusalem and other places in Judah and Israel to go to other countries.”

lun_bawang: Kebalaku, "Amé' iapeh iko?" Idi kebalaneh, "Ui pian nari Yerusalim pad ui kali kikadangneh idi kirayehneh.”
english: I asked him, “Where are you going?” He replied, “I am going to measure Jerusalem, to determine how wide it is and how long it is.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala melaikat luk pun-pun ineh inan melaikat luk baken, "Do' upun amé' mada' anak adi' luk ngimet luk pinari ineh, kebalamu, 'Aleg nganau' alad bawang Yerusalim, ngaceku mula' lemulun idi sapi' pana' miak macing bang bawang neh.
english: That other angel said to him, “Run and tell that young man that some day there will be very many people and livestock in Jerusalem, with the result that there will be too many to live inside the city walls; many will live outside the walls.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala melaikat Tuhan kuan Sétan ineh, "Do' Tuhan ngukum namu O Sétan. Do' Tuhan luk mawa inan Yerusalim ngukum namu. Lemulun ini mepad kudeng aceh kayuh luk ilap rat bang apui.”
english: But Yahweh said to Satan, “Satan, I am rebuking you! I am the one who has chosen Jerusalem to be my special city, and I am rebuking you! This man, Joshua, has been brought back from Babylonia; he is surely like MET, RHQ a burning stick that has been snatched from a fire.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala melaikat kuandeh luk ngedengan neneh déi' Surga, "Ngelengu kuyu' lemulun ini luk melutak." Idi kebalaneh ni Yosua, "Ui pangeh nenala' sala'mu, idi miak maré kuyu' luk mebaruh namu.”
english: The angel said to those other angels who were standing in front of him, “Take off his filthy clothes!” After they did that, the angel said to Joshua, “Look! I have taken away the guilt of your sins, and I will put beautiful clothes on you.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengecuk nedeh luk ngedengan neneh nganau' aceh sigar luk meligan luun uluh Yosua. Idi ideh nenganau' luk icuk ineh idi nengayung neneh kareb melaikat Tuhan tuped su ineh.
english: Then I said to them, “Put a clean turban on his head!” So they put a clean turban on his head and put new clothes on him, while the angel sent by Yahweh was standing there.

lun_bawang: Idi ui nemutuh melaikat ineh mada' ilungneh.
english: I asked the angel who was talking with me, “Sir, what are these?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh, "Naké iko kali'?" Idi ui nengor balaneh, "Na!”
english: He replied, “Surely you know RHQ what they are?” I replied, “No, I do not know.”

lun_bawang: 'Melaikat ineh nengecuk negku maré ni Serubabel bala ini luk ratnan Tuhan: "Baken ratnan lalud baweh, idi baken ratnan tuehmu sebuleng, iamo' ratnan RohKu, ieh ineh miak mangun.
english: Then he said to me, “This is the message that Yahweh says that you should give to Zerubbabel the governor of Judah: ‘You will do what I want you to do, but it will not be by your own strength or power. It will be done by the power of my Spirit, says the Commander of the armies of angels.

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "Serubabel nengimun mudut Ruma' Allah, idi ieh miak mangeh neneh. Idi kareb amung ini mangun, pupuKu miak kali' idi Ui luk nengecuk namu amé' nedeh.
english: He said to me, “Zerubbabel SYN laid the first stone in the foundation of the temple, and he will put the last stone in its place. When that happens, the people will know that it is I, the Commander of the armies of angels, who have sent you to them.” And he said, “The seven bowls represent the eyes of Yahweh, who looks back and forth at everything that happens on the earth.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaku neneh, "Anunké ilung dueh kayuh saitun luk pekop iring kukud dawan ineh?
english: Then I asked the angel, “What is the meaning of the two olive trees, one on each side of the lampstand?

lun_bawang: Idi anunké ilung dueh angat saitun luk iring dueh turuk luk ratnan amas luk mangun ku dalan umau saitun?”
english: And what isthe meaning of the two olive branches, one alongside each of the gold pipes from which olive oil flows to the lamps?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh negku, "Na kali'mu?" Kebalaku, "Na!”
english: He replied, “Surely RHQ you know what they are?” I replied, “No, sir, I do not know.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala melaikat ineh, "Ieh ineh dueh burur lemulun luk pinili' idi inumau Allah luk tuped pa kiung Tuhan luk ngimet aput tana'."
english: So he said, “They represent the two men who have been appointed MTY to serve the Lord who rules the entire earth.”

lun_bawang: Idi melaikat ineh nengitun negku ratnan luk sinierku. Idi kebalaku neneh, "Ui nier aceh surat luk temulud, luk kikadang limeh depeh, idi pipangneh dueh depeh setangal.”
english: The angel asked me, “What do you see?” I replied, “I see a flying scroll that is huge, ◄10 yards/9 meters► long and ◄5 yards/4.5 meters► wide.”

lun_bawang: Idi melaikat ineh nesilagan sekua' teh, kebalaneh, "Nier luk miak macing nekini!”
english: Then the angel who had been talking to me came closer to me and said, “Look up and see what is appearing!”

lun_bawang: "Anun ineh?" kebalaku. Idi kebalaneh, "Ieh ineh aceh buan, idi ieh mangun ku pinginud sala' luk aput tana' ini!”
english: I asked him, “What is it?” He replied, “It is a big basket for measuring grain. But it represents the sins that everyone in this nation has committed.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala amelaikat ineh, "Decur ini, ieh ineh pinginud sala'!" Idi ieh nengeranek neneh bang buan ineh teh idi nengakeb neneh.
english: The angel said, “She represents the wicked things that people do.” Then the angel pushed her back into the basket and closed the very heavy lid again.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaku kuan melaikat ineh, "Iten didueh amé' iapeh buan ineh?”
english: I asked the angel who had been talking to me, “Where are they taking that basket?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh, "Ideh pian mudut aceh ruma' sembayang kuanneh déi' Babil. Kareb ieh pangeh pinudut, buan ineh miak uen ngerareng bang ruma' ineh pad ieh inan sembayang."
english: He replied, “They are taking it to Babylonia to build a temple for it. When the temple is finished, they will set the basket there on a pedestal for people to worship it.”

lun_bawang: Idi ui nemutuh melaikat ineh mada' ilung ratnan keréta ineh?
english: I asked the angel who had been speaking to me, “Sir, what do those chariots mean?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh, "Ieh ineh apat bui, luk pangeh nacing rat pa kiung Tuhan amung tana' ini.”
english: The angel replied, “They have come from standing in the presence of the Lord who controls/rules the entire earth. They will go across the sky in four directions.

lun_bawang: Kareb kuda luk mabuh neremuat, ideh pian miket nalan amé' nier tana' ini. Idi kebala melaikat nedeh, "Amé' nier tana' ini." Idi ideh nenalan.
english: When those powerful horses left, their chariot-drivers were eager to go throughout the world. As they were leaving, the angel said to them, “Go throughout the world and see what is happening!” So that is what they did.

lun_bawang: Idi melaikat nengitang negku, "Kuda-kuda luk iné' Babil luk pa tinueh busat aco ineh pangeh nengagka' useh Allah.”
english: Then the angel called to me and said, “Look/Listen, the drivers of the chariots that have gone north will do what the Spirit of Yahweh wants them to do there.”

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "Ngalap amung baré luk biré Heldai, Tobia, idi Yedaya, lun luk tiban ineh. Idi bang aco sineh teh do' amé' ruma' Yosia Sepania. Amung lemulun ineh pangeh nuli' rat Babil, bawang luk inandeh tiban ineh.
english: He said, “Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah will be bringing some silver and gold from the people who were ◄exiled in/forced to go to► Babylon. As soon as they arrive, go to the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah.

lun_bawang: Mada' neneh ratnan luk bila Tuhan luk Melalud, kebalaNeh, Lemulun luk titen Angat miak temubu' su luk inanNeh, idi mudut Ruma' Tuhan baruh.
english: Tell him that I, the Commander of the armies of angels, say that the man who is called the Branch will come. He will leave the place where he is now, and he will supervise those who build my temple.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengitun imam-imam idi nabi-nabi, kebaladeh, "Petuluké kai temido ngaceku usag Ruma' Allah, idi mawa' na kuman bang bulan limeh, mepad kudeng luk inau' kai bang tuda'-tuda' lak kinioneh?”
english: They also asked the priests at Yahweh’s temple and the prophets this question: “For many years, during the fifth month and during the seventh month of each year, we have mourned and ◄fasted/abstained from eating food►. Should we continue to do that?”

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "Mada' nelun luk bang bawang ini dengan imam-imam, ieh ineh kareb ideh mawa' na kuman idi temido bang bulan limeh idi bulan tudu', kinio tudu' ngepulu' lak, idi na ideh nengubur Negku.
english: He said, “Tell RHQ the priests and all the other people of Judah that during the past 70 years, when they mourned and fasted during the fifth and seventh months of each year, it was not really RHQ me, Yahweh, whom they were honoring.

lun_bawang: "Ui pangeh nengecuk nemuyuh mutut ukum luk matu. 'Do' muyuh méi' seburur inan seburur.
english: “Tell the people that this is what the Commander of the armies of angels says: ‘Do what is just/right, and act kindly and mercifully toward each other.

lun_bawang: Mepad kudeng barui. Ui nemalid nedeh, pad ideh tudo bang bawang pupu baken. Ideh nenganau' bawang pupu baken. Ideh nenganau' bawang ini luk do' dat ali', pad seburur pana' nateh luk tudo su ini."
english: And I caused them to be scattered among many nations, where they were strangers. It was as though MET a whirlwind picked them up and carried them away from their country. The country/land that they were forced to leave was ruined, with the result that no one could live there or even  travel through it. It was previously a delightful land, but they caused it to become ◄desolate/like a desert►.”

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "Ui geregan nengan Yerusalim ngaceku awaKu luk pelaba rayeh inan pupuneh. Idi awa ineh nenganau' Negku megateh inan bunu'neh.
english: “This is what I, the Commander of the armies of angels, say: ‘I love the people of Jerusalem; I love them very much, and I am very angry with their enemies.’

lun_bawang: Ui miak lemubed amé' Yerualim, bawangKu luk meligan, idi tudo su ineh. Yerusalim miak tetanen bawang luk matu, idi pegkung Tuhan luk Melalud miak tetanen pegkung luk meligan.
english: So this is what I say: ‘Some day I will return to Zion Hill and I will live there. At that time, Jerusalem will be called the city where people ◄are faithful to/faithfully obey► me, and people will say that Zion  Hill is holy because it is where the Commander of the armies of angels dwells.’”

lun_bawang: Sekua' teh deléi idi decur luk mengered idi luk nalan makai rukud, miak tudo iring dalan idi luun natad Yerusalim.
english: The Commander of the armies of angels also says this: “Some day old men and old women will again sit along the streets of Jerusalem, each of them holding a cane because of their being very old.

lun_bawang: "Pupu luk ketecan nekini ngerawé amung ini na miak mangun. Iamo' Ui kali' amung ini mangun.
english: The Commander of the armies of angels also says this: “When those things happen, it will seem marvelous to the people who are still alive, but it certainly will not RHQ seem marvelous to me!”

lun_bawang: Ui miak ngulun pupuKu luk rat bawang luk pa busat aco idi pa acep aco,
english: The Commander of the armies of angels also says this: “I will rescue my people from countries to the northeast and to the southwest to which they were forced to go.

lun_bawang: Ideh miak nibu dengan na susa'. Anggurdeh miak ngeruat bua', tana' miak ngeruat padé idi petap udan. Ui miak maré amung peruan ini kuan pupuKu luk ketecan.
english: From now on, it will be peaceful when you plant your seeds, and your grapevines will produce grapes, and good crops will grow in your fields. There will be rain. I will give all those things to you people who are still alive.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud, "Kareb tepun muyuh nenganau' Negku museh, Ui pian ngacing luk dat kuandeh, idi na terawéKu nisu'.
english: The Commander of the armies of angels also says this: “When your ancestors caused me to become very angry, I decided to punish them. And I did not change my mind.

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "Aco luk inan mawa' na kuman bang bulan apat, limeh, tudu', idi bulan pulu' miak mangun ku aco rayeh luk inan mawang niat idi do' ria' kuan lun Yahuda. Iamo' do' muyuh mawa inan luk matu idi pedo'.”
english: This is what he said: “The times when you people of Judah ◄fast/abstain from food► during the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months of each year will become good and very happy/joyful DOU festivals. But you must want to speak truthfully and be peaceful.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan luk Melalud, "Karebneh miak macing, idi lemulun ratnan imet luk rayeh idi bawang luk rayeh miak amé' Yerusalim.
english: The Commander of the armies of angels also says this: “Some day people from many people-groups and foreign cities will come here to Jerusalem.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allahku negku, "Do' mangun ku lun luk matar sengeriudan dumba luk malé pitayen.
english: This is what Yahweh my God said to me: “I want you to become a shepherd for a flock of sheep that are about to be slaughtered.

lun_bawang: Lemulun luk pebelih dumba ineh nenabpar negku, idi ui mangun ku lun luk matar dumba luk malé pitayen. Idi ui nengalap dueh rukud. Sebuleng titenku "Ei'", idi sebuleng titenku "Rurum." Idi ui nematar dumba ineh.
english: So I became the shepherd of a flock of sheep that were about to be slaughtered for their meat to be sold to the dealers. I took good care of the sheep, even the ones that were the weakest sheep. Then I took two shepherds’ ◄staffs/walking sticks►. I named the one staff ‘Kindness’ and the other staff ‘Union’. And I took good care of the sheep.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaku kuan sengeriudan ineh, "Na ui mangun ku lun luk matar nemuyuh peh. Luk pian maté, do' ideh maté. Luk miak pitayen, do' ideh pitayeh. Idi luk ketecan miak pepaté.”
english: So I said to the dealers, “I will no longer be the shepherd. I will allow the ones that are dying to die. I will allow the ones that are getting lost to get lost. And I will not prevent those that remain from destroying each other.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaku nedeh, "Kudeng petulu kuan muyuh, do' maré tabparku negku. Kudeng na, aleg maré." Idi ideh nemaré negku teluh ngepulu' balad pirak ku tabparku.
english: I told them, “If you think it is what you should do, pay me for taking care of the sheep. If you do not think that is what you should do, do not pay me.” So they paid me only 30 pieces of silver.

english: Then Yahweh said to me, “That is a ridiculously small amount of money that they have paid you! So throw it to the man who makes clay pots!” So I took the silver to the temple of Yahweh, and I threw it in the chest where the offerings/money is kept.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan negku, "Do' iko mangun ku lun luk matar dumba sekua' teh, iamo' sekua' ini ieh lun luk matar dumba luk na mayu.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Take again the things that a foolish shepherd uses,

english: At that time it will be as though MET there will be a fountain from which water flows continually to cleanse the descendants MTY of King David and all the other people in Jerusalem from the guilt of the sins that they have committed, especially from becoming unacceptable to me by worshiping idols.

english: The Commander of the armies of angels says, “My sword APO must strike the one who is like MET my shepherd, the man who is ◄my companion/very <close/dear> to me►. lun_bawang: idi aput-aput tana' dueh babpat ratnan teluh babpat lemulun miak pitayen.
english: Yahweh also says, “Two-thirds of the people in Judah will die DOU. Only one-third of the people in Judah will remain alive.

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh icung kuda miak uen ngarit dengan bala ini, "Linigan kuan Tuhan." Idi lacang bang Ruma' Allah pana' mepad ligan kudeng ligan luk pa atun bubpun.
english: At that time, the words ‘Dedicated to Yahweh’ will be written on the bells that are fastened to the horses. The cooking pots in the courtyard of the temple will be sacred, like the bowls that are near the altar.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan nan pupuNeh, "Ui pangeh mawa nemuyuh rat mon." Iamo' kebaladeh, "Kudeng apehké Iko nengegala' awaMu nekai?" Kebala Tuhan, "Sagan pana' Esau idi Yakub denganak, Ui mawa ni Yakub idi inulneh,
english: Yahweh says, “I have always loved you Israeli people.”

lun_bawang: Pupu Israil miak nier ini dengan matehdeh sebuleng, idi ideh miak pebala, "Tuhan ineh melalud, sagan pana' mado rat bawang Israil!”
