lun_bawang: Idi kebala Malaki, "Kudeng muyuh lun imam nutun mutuh Allah ngedengan netau nekini, kali' rungen Ieh na ninger sembayang muyuh, ngaceku dat muyuh.
english: And he also says, “You plead with me to be merciful to you. But you bring to me sacrifices that are not acceptable to me, so why should I be kind to you RHQ?”

lun_bawang: Iamo' muyuh ngedat Negku, kareb muyuh mala bubpunKu na ulek, idi ngedat akan luk barén muyuh Negku.

lun_bawang: Kediman kuan lun luk naluk luk maré pung luk na ulek kuanKu, kareb ieh pangeh nepejani' maré luk do' rat arang aya'neh kuanKu. Ngaceku Ui ini aceh Raca' luk rayeh idi amung-amung pupu matot Negku, kebala Tuhan luk Melalud."

If anyone does that, I will punish him, because I am a great king; I am the Commander of the armies of angels and people of the other nations revere me MTY, but you do not!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud kuan imam-imam, "Ini aceh ukum kuan muyuh:
english: You priests, I will say something to warn you.

lun_bawang: "Ui nepejani' maré ulun luk do' nedeh, idi amung ini pangeh biréKu nedeh, pad ideh miak ngerayeh Negku. Idi kareb ineh ideh matot Negku pad ideh nengerayeh Negku.
english: My agreement with your ancestor Levi was because I wanted the priests to live prosperously and peacefully. And that is what I have done for them. I required that they greatly respect me and revere DOU me.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh Ui pana' miak nganau' nelun Israil ngedat nemuyuh, ngaceku muyuh na maya' badaKu, idi kareb muyuh mada' ratnan luk pianKu, muyuh na nganau' luk mepad kuan amung lemulun.”
english: Therefore I have caused all the people to despise you, and I have caused you to be humiliated, because you have not obeyed me. When you teach people my commands, you do not treat all people equally.”

lun_bawang: Idi ini aceh kekamen luk inau' muyuh. Muyuh nangi' idi ngarod iring bubpun Tuhan, ngaceku Ieh na ngalap baré muyuh.
english: This is another thing that you do: You cover Yahweh’s altar with your tears. You wail because he no longer pays attention to your offerings; but he is not pleased with them.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan Allah lun Israil, "Ui megateh inan lemulun luk patad ratnan awanneh. Ui megateh inan deléi luk nganau' kudeng ineh kuan awanneh. Ngaceku ineh matar do'-do', pad muyuh na ngelaba jani' muyuh inan awan muyuh.”
english: Yahweh, the God to whom we Israelis belong, says, “I hate divorce!” So if you men divorce your wives, you are overwhelming them by being cruel to them. So be sure that you are ◄not disloyal/remain united► to your wives. That is what the Commander of the armies of angels says.

lun_bawang: Idi Tuhan luk Melalud ngor bala muyuh, "Ui miak ngecuk nelun dukenKu nganau' temina' dalan kuanKu. Idi denak-denak Tuhan luk tekapen muyuh miak macing bang Ruma'Neh. Idi lun duken luk inan muyuh mawang niat miak macing idi mada' jani'Ku.”
english: The Commander of the armies of angels says this: “Listen! I am about to send my messenger who will prepare the people to receive me when I come. You claim that IRO you are wanting to see me, and I will suddenly come to my temple. The messenger who will tell you about a new agreement, the one whom you are eagerly SAR awaiting, is certainly going to come to you.”

lun_bawang: Idé luk tuman kareb Ieh macing? Idé luk na matot kareb Ieh melagan? Ieh mepad kudeng apui luk ngederuno amas idi pirak, idi mepad kudeng sabun.
english: But will anyone RHQ be able to survive when he comes? Will anyone RHQ be able to remain standing in front of him? Certainly not, because he will be like SIM a blazing fire that refines/purifies metal/gold. He will be like SIM a very strong soap that bleaches clothes.

lun_bawang: "Ui ini Tuhan luk na misu'. Ngaceku ineh muyuh luk inul Yakub nateh inukum.
english: “I am Yahweh, and I never change. And although you deceive people like your ancestor Jacob did, I have not yet gotten rid of you.

lun_bawang: Muyuh mepad kudeng tepun muyuh ngaceku muyuh nelemubed rat Negku idi na nengimet ukumKu. Do' muyuh lumi amé' Negku, idi Ui miak lumi nemuyuh. Iamo' kebala muyuh, 'Anun luk miak ruen kai, pad kai lumi amé' Namu?'
english: You and your ancestors have ignored my commands and you have not obeyed them. Now return to me; and when that happens, I will ◄return/do good► to you. That is what I, the Commander of the armies of angels, say.” But you ask, “We have never gone away from you, so how can we return to you?”

lun_bawang: Idi amung pupu miak mala nemuyuh pelaba samal, ngaceku tana' muyuh do' inan mulun.”
english: When that happens, the people of all nations will say that I have blessed you, because your country will be delightful. That is what I, the Commander of the armies of angels, say.

lun_bawang: "Muyuh nengedat Negku," kebala Tuhan. "Iamo' keburi' muyuh, 'Kudeng apeh kai nengedat Namu?'
english: I, Yahweh, have something else to say to you. You have said terrible things about me.” But you reply, “What terrible things have we said about you?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Tuhan luk Melalud, "Ideh miak mangun ku pupuKu. Idi kareb aco luk inan ngukum, Ui miak ngalap nedeh. Ngaceku Ui méi' nedeh, mepad kudeng aceh taman luk méi' inan anakneh luk do' baya' bala.
english: The Commander of the armies of angels says this about those people: “They will be my people. At the time that I judge people, they will be like MET a special treasure to me. I will be kind to them, like SIM fathers are kind to their sons who obey them.

lun_bawang: "Do' ngerawé bada' demulunKu Musa, ieh ineh amung ukum luk biréKu neneh déi' luun Pegkung Sinai, luk miak bén amung pupu lun Israil.
english: Be sure to obey the laws that I gave to Moses, who served me well. Obey all the commandments and regulations that I gave him on Sinai Mountain, for all you people of Israel to obey.

lun_bawang: "Aceh decur luk pun mebaruh, miak mali' pad ieh nenganak aceh anak deléi. Idi Ieh miak tetanen 'Immanuel'." (luk ilungneh, "Allah dengan tau").
english: “Listen, a virgin will become pregnant and will give birth to a son. They will call him Emmanuel.” Emmanuel means ‘God is with us’.

lun_bawang: keburi'deh, "Su apehké Raca' lun Yahudi luk tinganak mebaruh? Ngaceku kai pangeh nenier gituenNeh luk pa busat aco. Idi kai macing sikal sembayang Neneh.”
english: They asked people, “Where is the one who has been born in order that he might be the king of you Jews? We believe that your new king has been born, because we have seen the star that we believe indicated that he has been born. We saw it while we were in our country east of here. So we have come to worship him.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "Déi' Baitlahim luk bang bawang Yudia. Kudeng ineh luk inayud nabi, kebalaneh,
english: They said to him, “He will be born in Bethlehem, here in Judea province, because it was written by the prophet Micah {the prophet Micah wrote} long ago what God said:

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengecuk nedeh amé' déi' Baitlahim, keburi'neh, "Amé' muyuh nakap do'-do' anak luk isuut ineh. Kareb muyuh kali' Neneh, do' muyuh mada' negku, pad ui pana' miak amé' sembayang Neneh.”
english: Then he concealed what he really planned to do and said to them, “Go to Bethlehem and inquire thoroughly where the infant is. When you have found him, come back and report to me so that I, myself, can go there and worship him, too.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh netudo déi' pad macing Herodés naté, pad ngacing luk bila Tuhan dengan tang nabi, kebalaNeh, "Ui pangeh nenawar AnakKu lu deléi rat Masir.”
english: They stayed there until King Herod died, and then they left Egypt. By doing that, it was {they} fulfilled what the prophet Hosea wrote, which had been said by the Lord {which the Lord had said}, I have told my son to come out of Egypt.

lun_bawang: "Inan aceh tang pindenger déi' Rama, inan luk nangi' idi temido teh. Rakel nangi' ku anakneh; na ieh mia buken, ngaceku amung anakneh luk isuut pangeh naté.”

Even though people tried to comfort them, they would not be comforted {stop mourning}, because their children were dead.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' melaikat neneh, "Tumui iko idi nated anak luk isuut ineh dengan tinanNeh, idi muli' amé' bawang Israil; ngaceku ideh luk sikal ngaté anak ineh pangeh naté.”
english: He said to Joseph, “Take the child and his mother and go back to Israel to live, because the people who were looking for the child in order to kill him have died.”

lun_bawang: kebalaneh, "Do' muyuh uren ratnan sala' muyuh, ngaceku Imet surga pangeh muneng.”
english: He was preaching to the people who came there. He kept saying, “You need to turn away from your sinful behavior, because God MET will soon begin to rule over people, and he will reject you if you do not turn away from your sinful life.”

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ini ieh luk pangeh bila Nabi Yesaya, keburi'neh, "Seburur lemulun ngitang déi' su luk ali-ali, kebalaneh, 'Nganau' temina' dalan Tuhan, idi ngesiri lisangen-lisangenNeh.' “
english: John was the person who fulfilled what was said by Isaiah the prophet {what Isaiah the prophet predicted when he said}, long ago: In a desolate area ◄people will hear someone/someone will be heard► shouting to the people who pass by, Prepare yourselves to receive the Lord when he comes! Make yourselves ready so that you will be prepared when he comes MET, DOU, just like people improve and straighten out the road for an important official!

english: After John noted that many men of the Pharisee religious group and of the Sadducee religious group were coming to him to be baptized {in order that he would baptize them}, he said to them, “You people are evil like poisonous snakes MET! I warn you that God will some day punish MTY everyone who sins. ◄And do not think that you can escape from his punishing you MTY if you do not turn from your sinful behavior!/Did someone tell you that you can escape from his punishing you MTY if you do not turn from your sinful behavior?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Ui ngerereb nemuyuh bang abpa', mangun ku tanu' muyuh pangeh nuren, iamo' Ieh luk macing muci rat negku ngerereb nemuyuh ku Roh Meligan idi apui. Ieh meluun lalud ratnan ui, idi ngiding kasutNeh pana' ui na mayu.
english: “As for me, I am not very important, because I baptize you only with water. I baptize you because of your feeling sorry that you have sinned. But someone else will come soon who is very great; he will do powerful deeds (OR, act powerfully). Because he is superior to me, I am not worthy even to do a menial task for him, such as to carry his sandals. He will put his Holy Spirit within you to truly change the way you live MET, and he will judge others of you and punish you in the fire in hell.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yahya nemebpeng Neneh, kebalaneh, "Do' ui rerebpenMu, ngudehké Iko amé' mutuh negku ngerereb Namu?”

Since you are not a sinner, ◄you(sg) should not come to me to be baptized by me {to ask that I baptize you(sg)}!/why do you come to me to be baptized by me {ask that I baptize you(sg)} RHQ?►”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus, "Aganeh nekini, ngaceku do' tau maya' amung-amung luk pian Allah." Idi Yahya nemaya' balaNeh.
english: But Jesus said to him, “Baptize me at this time, because in this way we two will do everything that God requires.” Then John consented to baptize him.

lun_bawang: Idi inan aceh tang rat bang langit luk nepebala, "Ini AnakKu luk inanKu mawa, idi Ui mawang niat Neneh."
english: Then God SYN spoke from heaven, saying, “This is my Son. I love him. I am very pleased with him.”

lun_bawang: Idi Iblis iné' Neneh, kebalaneh, "Kudeng matu Iko Anak Allah, do' Iko ngisu' batu-batu ini mangun ku ruti kenenMu.”
english: Satan, the tempter, came to him and said, “Because you claim that you have a relationship with God as a son has with his father MET, prove it by commanding these stones to become bread so that you can eat them!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus, "Pangeh inayud bang Surat Allah, 'Baken ratnan ruti mo' lemulun miak mulun, iamo' ratnan anid-anid bala luk bila Allah.' “
english: But Jesus said to him, “No! I will not change stones into bread, because it is written in the Scriptures {in the Scriptures Moses wrote}, ‘Eating food SYN sustains people physically, but it does not sustain them spiritually SYN. Instead, paying attention to everything that God has spoken to them is what sustains people spiritually.’”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Pangeh inayud teh bang Surat Allah, 'Aleg iko nutun Allah Tuhanmu.' “
english: But Jesus said, “No! I will not jump down, because in another place in the Scriptures it is written {there are these words that Moses wrote}: ‘Do not try to test the Lord your God to see if he will prevent something bad from happening to you when you do something foolish!’”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Iblis Neneh, "Amung-amung imet ini barénku Namu, kudeng Iko tekeradung sembayang negku.”
english: And then he said to him, “I will let you rule all these nations and give you the magnificent things in them if you bow down and worship me.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Buro iko, Sétan, ngaceku pangeh inayud bang Surat Allah, 'Do' iko sembayang inan Tuhan Allahmu, idi maya' Neneh mo'.' “
english: But Jesus said to him, “No, I will not worship you, Satan, so go away! It is written in the Scriptures, ‘It is the Lord your God whom you (pl) must worship, and you (pl) must serve only him!’”

lun_bawang: "Tana' Sebulon idi tana' Naptali luk déi' dipar Abpa' Yarden, idi luk muneng ku takung, ieh ineh Galilia, tana' lun pupu baken!
english: “Zebulun region and Naphtali region are on the road which is near Galilee Lake and on the eastern side of the Jordan River. They are the regions in Galilee District where many non-Jews are living.

lun_bawang: Rat kareb idi Yésus nengimun mada', kebalaNeh, "Do' muyuh uren, ngaceku Imet surga pangeh muneng!”
english: From that time, while Jesus was in Capernaum city, he began to preach this to people: “God MTY/EUP will very soon begin to rule, and he will judge you when he rules. So you (pl) need to turn from your sinful ways so that God will not punish you.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedidueh, "Do' medueh amé' maya' Negku, idi Ui nganau' nemedueh ku lun ngerabat lemulun.”
english: He said to them, “Just like you have been gathering fish, come with me and I will teach you how to gather people to become my disciples.” MET

lun_bawang: "Samal kuan lemulun luk kali' asi'deh pa kiung Allah, ngaceku ideh luk kuan Imet surga.
english: God is pleased with people who recognize that they have a spiritual need; he will allow them to be the people whose lives he rules over.

lun_bawang: "Samal kuan muyuh kareb lemulun ngedat nemuyuh idi ngedereh nemuyuh idi nguyo nemuyuh dengan mebalih ngaceku Ui.
english: God is pleased with you when other people insult you, when other people do evil things to you and when other people say falsely that you are evil because you believe in me.

lun_bawang: "Muyuh mepad kudeng tucu' tana' ini. Iamo' kudeng tucu' pangeh metalang, ieh na mepaci' peh. Idi na ulek neh peh. Do' ieh talan idi ricuen lemulun.
english: “You are able to influence evil people MTY and improve the way they live in order that they do not become more evil, just like salt is able to improve the flavor of food and to preserve it MET from spoiling. Salt that no longer tastes salty cannot become salty again RHQ. As a result, that salt becomes useless. It is rejected by people, thrown on the ground, and walked on {People reject it, throw it on the ground and walk on it} MET. Similarly, if the way you live no longer influences people to live in a godly manner, God will reject you.

lun_bawang: "Muyuh ini mepad kudeng acang tana'. Aceh bawang luk luun pegkung na miak melinged.
english: You enable evil people MTY to perceive God’s truth as a light enables people to perceive what is around them. Just like everyone can see LIT the lights of a city on a hill MET, other people can see what you do.

lun_bawang: "Aleg muyuh ngerawé Ui pangeh nacing pian ngusag Ukum Musa idi surat nabi-nabi; baken Ui nacing pian ngusag, iamo' ngaceku sikal mangeh amung ineh.
english: “I came to earth, not to annul the laws that God gave Moses or what the prophets MTY wrote. Instead, I came to cause to happen what the authors of those books predicted would happen. So do not think any longer that I have come to earth in order that I might annul what they wrote.

lun_bawang: "Muyuh pangeh neninger luk paneh bila mon, ieh ineh, 'Aleg iko ngaté, idi idé-idé luk sikal ngaté, ieh miak iten amé' besara'.'
english: “You have heard your religious teachers say that it was said {that Moses said} to your ancestors, ‘Do not murder anyone.’ This implied that if someone murders another person, the judge will condemn that person and sentence him to be executed {say that someone must execute him}.

lun_bawang: Kareb iko maré baré anun-anun luun bubpun kuan Allah, idi su ineh iko kali' kinanakmu mét niat namu,
english: So, when you take your gift for God to the altar, if you remember that you have offended someone,

lun_bawang: "Muyuh pangeh neninger luk pangeh bila, 'Aleg pasét.'
english: “You have heard God’s commandment, ‘Do not commit adultery.’

lun_bawang: "Idi teh pangeh bila, 'Idé-idé luk ngelagkan awanneh, do' ieh maré aceh surat patad neneh.'
english: “It is written {Moses wrote}, ‘If a man is divorcing his wife, he should write a document on which he states that he is divorcing her.’

lun_bawang: "Muyuh pangeh neninger teh luk pangeh bila kuan lun rayeh mon, 'Aleg iko pebulung dengan mebalih; iamo' do' iko ngacing kuan Tuhan amung bulungmu ineh.'
english: “You have also heard your religious teachers say that it was written {that Moses wrote} to your ancestors, ‘Make sure that you do what you promised the Lord that you would do!’ DOU

lun_bawang: "Muyuh pangeh neninger luk pangeh bila, 'Mateh su amateh, idi lipen sua lipen.'
english: “You have heard your religious teachers say that it is written {Moses wrote}, ‘Retaliate like this: If someone damages one of your eyes, someone should damage one of that person’s eyes. If someone damages one of your teeth, someone should damage one of that person’s teeth.’

lun_bawang: "Muyuh pangeh neninger luk pangeh bila, 'Do' iko mawa nelun denganmu, idi megateh inan bunu'mu.'
english: “You have heard your religious teachers say that it is written that Moses wrote, ‘Love the citizens of your country and hate your enemies.’

lun_bawang: "Matar do'-do', pad muyuh na nganau' kekamen muyuh luk matu pa kiung lemulun mo', idi ngaceku sikal sirendeh; ngaceku kudeng muyuh nganau' kudeng ineh, muyuh na miak ngalap tabpar ratnan Taman muyuh luk bang surga.
english: “When you do your good deeds, make certain that you do not do them when other people are watching so that they may see you and think highly of you. If you do good deeds merely in order that other people may think highly of you, God, your Father who is in heaven, will not give you any reward.

lun_bawang: Do' muyuh sembayang kudeng ini: 'O Taman kai luk bang surga, do' ngadanMu uen ngerayeh
english: So pray things like this: Father, you who are in heaven, we (exc) desire that you be honored/revered {that people honor/revere you}.

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku kudeng muyuh maré do' ratnan sala' dulun, Taman muyuh luk bang surga pana' sikal maré do' kuan muyuh.
english: “Forgive the people who sin against you, because, if you forgive other people, God, your Father who is in heaven, will forgive your sins.

lun_bawang: "Idi teh, kareb muyuh mawa', aleg tekedamut kiung mepad kudeng lun luk siayu, ngaceku ideh siisu' kiungdeh, pad lun baken ngerawé nedeh mawa'. Ngerawé do'-do'! Ideh pangeh nengalap tabpardeh.
english: “When you abstain from eating food in order to please God, do not look sad as the hypocrites look. They make their faces appear sad in order that people will see that they are abstaining from food and will think highly of them. Keep this in mind: People will think highly of those people for that, but that is the only reward those people will get!

lun_bawang: "Aleg nganug binaweh bang tana' ini, su luk inan kutang idi tugor luk ngerapuk neneh, idi lun mano luk ngurak ruma' idi mano.
english: “Do not selfishly accumulate large quantities of money and material goods for yourselves on this earth, because the earth is where everything is destroyed. For example, on earth termites ruin things, and things rust, and thieves enter buildings and steal things.

lun_bawang: "Mateh ineh mepad kudeng lapung. Kudeng matehmu do', amung buburmu pana' macang.
english: “Your eyes are like a lamp MET for your body, because they enable you to see things. So if your eyes are healthy, you are able to see everything well MET. Similarly, if you are generous with your money and other possessions, you will be able to know much of what God wants you to know MET.

lun_bawang: "Na selemulun luk miak ngakem kuan dueh tuan' ngaceku na miak na seburur inanneh megateh idi luk baken ineh inanneh mawa, idi ieh lutep inan seburur idi megateh inan seburur. Muyuh na miak mangun ku demulun Allah, idi demulun binaweh tana' ini teh.
english: “No one is able to serve two different bosses at the same time. If he tried to do that, he would dislike one of them and love the other one, or he would be loyal to one of them and despise the other one DOU. Similarly, you cannot devote your life to worshipping God and worshipping money and material goods at the same time.”

lun_bawang: Idéké rat arang muyuh miak ngekadang ulunneh sesuut pana' ngaceku merapang?
english: ◄None of you can, just by worrying, add time to your life./Can any of you, just by worrying, add time to your life?► RHQ You cannot add even one minute to your life! So you should not worry about things such as food and clothing!

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh, aleg muyuh merapang idi pebala: 'Anunké luk kenen kai? Anunké luk rupen kai? Anunké luk miak lungen kai?'
english: Because of God’s caring for you, do not worry and say, ‘Will we have anything to eat?’ or ‘Will we have anything to drink?’ or ‘Will we have clothes to wear?’ RHQ

lun_bawang: "Aleg ngesala' nelun baken, pad muyuh pana' na uen ngesala' teh.
english: “Do not talk about how sinfully others have acted, in order that God will not say how sinfully you have acted.

lun_bawang: "Aleg maré luk meligan kuan uko'-uko', idi aleg mepet bau mutiara muyuh pa kiung barek, pad ideh na ngeradu' neneh pa liang kukuddeh, idi lemubed amé' musing nemuyuh.
english: “You do not give holy things to dogs that would ignore those things and attack you CHI. You do not throw pearls in front of hogs, because they would just ignore them and trample them. Similarly, do not give precious spiritual truth to people you know will not value it but instead will do evil things to you.”

lun_bawang: "Do' mutuh, idi miak barén nemuyuh; do' nakap, idi muyuh miak ngalap; nateg tanga', idi tanga' ineh miak kabin kuan muyuh.
english: “Keep asking God for what you need. If you do that, he will give it to you. Confidently keep expecting God to give you the things that you need, and he will give them to you. It will be like MET looking for what you need and finding it. Keep on praying persistently to God. Then God will answer you. It will be like MET knocking on a door in order to enter a room. And the way will be opened {God will open the way} for you to get what you pray for.

lun_bawang: "Do' muyuh semuet maya' tanga' luk meperi'; ngaceku rayeh tanga' idi rayeh pipang dalan luk nguit amé' bang luk ngaté, idi mula' lemulun luk semuet bang ineh.
english: “Going to where people live eternally with God in heaven is difficult. It is like going along a narrow road PRS, MET that leads to a narrow gate. Not many people find that way. The way that most people take is easy, but it results in their being punished {God punishing them} in hell. That way is like a wide road that people walk on PRS, MET until they reach the wide gate, but that road and that gate lead to where they will be destroyed {God will destroy them}. Many people enter that gate. So I am telling you to leave the wide road and enter the narrow gate to heaven.”

lun_bawang: "Do' muyuh matar do'-do' ratnan nabi luk mebalih luk amé nemuyuh, dengan ngayung ku buluh dumba, iamo' bang niatdeh mepad kudeng bungalé luk mesangit.
english: So how will you know that they are false? Well, by seeing what plants produce, you know what kind of plants they are MET. For example, thornbushes cannot produce grapes, so ◄no one can pick grapes from thornbushes./can anyone pick grapes from thornbushes?► RHQ And thistles cannot produce figs, so ◄no one can pick figs from thistles./can anyone pick figs from thistles?► RHQ

lun_bawang: "Baken anid-anid lemulun luk pebala Negku, 'Tuhan, Tuhan,' miak semuet bang Imet surga; iamo' lemulun luk maya' pian TamanKu luk bang surga.
english: On the day MTY that God judges everyone, many people, trying to tell me that they deserve to go to heaven, will say to me, ‘Lord, we(exc) spoke God’s message as your representatives MTY, RHQ! As your representatives we(exc) expelled demons from people RHQ! And as your representatives, many times we(exc) performed miracles RHQ!’

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku ineh anid-anid lemulun luk ninger balaKu ini, idi maya' ineh, ieh mepad kudeng lun mileh luk nemudut ruma'neh luun batu.
english: Even though the rain came down and the river flooded, and the winds blew and beat against that house, it did not fall down because it had been built {he built it} on a solid foundation.

lun_bawang: Idi inan aceh lemulun luk mét susud iné' Neneh, idi ieh netekeradung pa kiungNeh, keburi'neh, "Tuhan, kudeng Iko pian, miak Iko ngedo' negku.”
english: After he left the crowds, a man who had the skin disease called leprosy unexpectedly came and knelt before him. He said to Jesus, “Lord/Sir, please heal me, because I know you are able to heal me if you are willing to.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nenatang ticu'Neh idi nengakem neneh, kebalaNeh, "PianKu; do' iko meligan peh!" Idi petacu susudneh ineh nepali'.
english: Then Jesus, disregarding the religious law that forbade people to come close to lepers, stretched out his hand and touched the man. He said to him, “I am willing to heal you, and I heal you now!” Immediately the man was healed from his leprosy {he was no longer a leper}.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Ngerawé do'-do'! Aleg mada' kuan seburur lemulun pana', iamo' do' iko amé' mada' bururmu siren lun imam, idi maré baré luk icu Musa, pad miak mangun ku sebuleng luk nekali' kuandeh.”
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Go and show yourself to a nearby priest so that he can examine you and verify that you no longer have leprosy. Then, after he tells the local people, they will know that you no longer have leprosy, and you will be able to associate with them again. Make sure that now you do not report about my healing you to anyone other than the priest. Then go to the Temple in Jerusalem and give the priest the offering that Moses commanded that people who have been healed from leprosy should offer as a sacrifice to God.”

lun_bawang: keburi'neh, "O Tuhan, demulunku telubid bang ruma' idi ieh mét naté urat, idi ieh pelaba dereh.”
english: He said to him, “Sir, my servant is lying in bed at home and is paralyzed, and he has severe pain.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Ui pian amé' ngedo' neneh.”
english: Jesus said to him, “I will go to your house and heal him.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun rayeh lun pebunu' ineh, "O Tuhan, ui na mayu uenMu ngikak bang ruma'ku; iamo' do' Iko mala sebila' bala mo', idi demulunku miak do' peh.
english: But the officer said to him, “Lord/Sir, do not bother to go. I am a non-Jew, so I am not worthy for you, a Jew, to come into my house MTY and associate with me. Instead, just command that my servant be healed, and he will be healed.

lun_bawang: Idi kareb Yésus neninger luk kudeng ineh, Ieh mawa idi kebalaNeh kuan lemulun luk nemaya' Neneh, "Ui pebala nemuyuh, rat arang lun Israil pana' nateh Ui nekali' anu luk kudeng ineh rayeh.
english: When Jesus heard this, he marveled. He said to the crowd that was walking with him, “Listen to this: I have never before found anyone who has as firm a faith in me as this non-Jewish man has. Not even in Israel, where I would expect people to believe in me, have I found anyone who has the kind of faith in me that he has!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nelun rayeh lun pebunu', "Muli' iko, idi miak mangun kuanmu mepad kudeng luk iko pangeh nemanu." Idi kareb ineh teh demulun ineh do' peh.
english: Then Jesus said to the officer, “Go home. What you believed would happen, that I would heal your servant from a distance, will happen.” Then the officer went home and found out that his servant became well at the exact time that Jesus told him that he would heal him.

lun_bawang: pad ngacing luk bila Nabi Yesaya, kebalaneh, "Ieh sebuleng nengalap amung-amung laya' tau, idi nemabeh amung-amung luk kadan tau.”
english: By doing this he fulfilled the words that had been said by the prophet Isaiah {that the prophet Isaiah had said} about the Messiah: “He healed people who had sicknesses and he cured them of their diseases.” DOU

lun_bawang: Idi inan seburur guru Ukum iné' Neneh, keburi'neh, "O Guru, ui sikal maya' Namu pad iapeh luk suetMu.”
english: As they were walking toward the boat, a man who taught the Jewish laws came to him and said, “Teacher, I will go with you wherever you go.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Bungalé inan lubangdeh, idi suit-suit déi' arang gawa' pana' inan arardeh; iamo' Anak-Lemulun na luk inanNeh ngerareng uluhNeh.”
english: In order that the man might know what he could expect if he went with him, Jesus said to him, “Foxes have holes in the ground in which to live, and birds have nests, but even though I am the one who came from heaven, I do not have a home where I can sleep MTY.”

lun_bawang: Idi seburur anak sekola' nepebala Neneh, "O Tuhan, nima' negku amé' nanem tamanku atun.”
english: Another man who was one of Jesus’ disciples said to him, “Sir/Lord, permit me first to go home. After my father dies I will bury him, and then I will come with you.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus neneh, "Maya' Negku, idi nima' lun naté nanem lun dengandeh luk naté.”
english: But Jesus said to him, “Come with me now. God considers that people who do not have eternal life are dead MET. Let those people do the work of burying people who die.”

lun_bawang: Idi anak-anak sekola'Neh iné' Neneh idi nengalat Neneh, keburi'deh, "Ngulun nekai, O Tuhan, ngaceku kai lélé maté.”
english: They went and woke him up, and said to him, “Sir/Lord, rescue us! We are about to drown!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Ngudehké muyuh matot, O muyuh luk na petap anu?" Idi Ieh netumui idi nengagka' barui idi ribut abpa', pad ieh melitong peh.
english: He said to them, “◄You should not be terrified!/Why are you terrified?► RHQ I am disappointed that in spite of all you have seen me do, ◄you do not believe very much that I can rescue you./do you not believe that I can rescue you?► RHQ” Then he got up and rebuked the wind and told the waves to calm down. And the wind stopped blowing and the lake became calm.

lun_bawang: Idi amungdeh mawa, keburi'deh, "Kudeng apehké lemulun ini, ngaceku barui idi ribut abpa' pana' maya' balaNeh?”
english: As a result, they were amazed, and they said to one another, “This man is certainly an extraordinary person RHQ! All things are under his control! Even the winds and the waves obey him PRS!”

lun_bawang: Idi didueh nengitang, keburi' didueh, "Anunké luk pianMu nekai, O Anak Allah? Iko macing sikal ngedereh nekaiké kareb nateh tarekneh macing?”
english: Suddenly they shouted to Jesus, “You are the Son of God! Because you have nothing in common with us IDM, RHQ, leave us alone Have you come here RHQ to torture us before the time MTY God has appointed to punish us?”

lun_bawang: Idi ada'-ada' ineh nemutuh Yésus, keburi'deh, "Kudeng Iko sikal nala' nekai, do' Iko ngecuk nekai semuet bang burur barek-barek ineh.”
english: So the demons begged Jesus, saying, “You are going to cast us out of the men, so send us into the herd of pigs!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Do' muyuh amé'." Idi ideh pana' neremuat, idi nesemuet bang burur barek-barek ineh, idi amungdeh ineh nupun musul maya' irang pegkung ineh, idi nubpa bang abpa' rayeh. Idi ideh naté nened bang abpa' ineh.
english: Jesus said to them, “If that is what you want, go!” So the demons left the men and entered the pigs. Suddenly the whole herd of pigs rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nenguit seburur lemulun luk mét naté urat amé' Neneh, luk telubid luun birirneh. Idi Yésus nekali' rayeh anudeh ineh, idi Ieh nepebala inan lemulun luk mét naté urat ineh, "O anakKu, do' iko lutep niat; iko lun mesala', iamo' Ui maré do' namu.”
english: Some men brought to him a man who was paralyzed and who was lying on a sleeping pad. When Jesus perceived that they believed that he could heal the paralyzed man, he said to him, “Young man, be encouraged! I forgive your sins.”

lun_bawang: Idi sebuang rat arang guru-guru Ukum ineh nengerawé bang niatdeh, "Lemulun ini nguyo Allah.”
english: Some of the men who taught the Jewish laws said among themselves, “He claims that he can forgive sins! That means that he claims to be equal with God He is insulting God!”

lun_bawang: Yésus nekali' terawédeh, idi kebalaNeh, "Ngudehké muyuh ngerawé luk dat bang niat muyuh?
english: Jesus knew what they were thinking. So he said, “◄You should not think evil thoughts, accusing me because I claim that I am God!/Why do you think evil thoughts, saying that it is wrong for me to claim that I am God?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Iamo' nekini muyuh miak kali' Anak-Lemulun ngimet lalud maré do' ratnan sala' bang tana'." Idi kebalaNeh kuan lemulun luk mét naté urat, "Tumui iko idi ngiding luk inanmu rudap, idi muli' amé' ruma'mu.”
english: So I am going to do something in order that you may know that God has authorized me, the one who came from heaven, to forgive the sins of people while I am on the earth, as well as to heal people.” Then he said to the paralyzed man, “Get up, pick up your sleeping pad, and go home!”

lun_bawang: Yésus nenecan bawang ineh, idi kareb Ieh nenalan, Ieh nenier selemulun, ngadanneh Matius, luk tudo bang ruma' luk inan ngamung usin pupuk. Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Do' maya' Negku." Idi Matius netuped idi nemaya' Yésus.
english: As Jesus was going away from there, he saw me, a man named Matthew. I was sitting at a table where I collected taxes for the Roman government. He said to me, “Come with me and become my disciple!” So I got up and went with him.

lun_bawang: Idi kareb lun Parisi nenier ineh, idi kebaladeh kuan anak-anak sekola'Neh, "Ngudehké Guru muyuh kuman dengan lun luk ngamung usin pupuk, idi lun mesala' teh?”
english: When the Pharisees saw that, they came to us disciples and said, “◄It is disgusting that your teacher, who claims to be righteous, eats and associates with tax collectors and other sinners!/Why is it that your teacher, who claims to be righteous, eats and associates with tax collectors and other sinners?►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus neninger bala ineh, idi kebalaNeh, "Lemulun luk do' burur na ulek kuan lun ngubat, iamo' lemulun luk mét mo'.
english: Jesus heard what they said, so he told them this parable: “It is people who are sick who need a doctor MET, not people who are well.” What he meant by that was that it was people who knew that they were sinners who were coming to him in order to be helped spiritually.

lun_bawang: Idi anak-anak sekola' Yahya iné matun Yésus, keburi'deh, "Ngudehké kai idi lun Parisi pana' megéi' mawa', iamo' anak-anak sekola'Mu na mawa'?”
english: Later, the disciples of John the Baptizer came to Jesus and asked him, “We (exc) and the Pharisees often abstain from food to show that we want to please God, but your disciples do not do that. Why do they not?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Miakké lun rurum deléi luk sikal ngaweh ineh mesusa' niat kareb ieh idi dengandeh? Na tu! Iamo' aconeh miak macing kareb deléi luk sikal ngaweh ineh miak lapen rat arangdeh, kareb ineh ideh mawa'.
english: Jesus wanted to show them and the Pharisees that it was not appropriate for his disciples to abstain from food and mourn while he was still with them. So he gave them this illustration: “When a bridegroom is with his friends at the time of the wedding, ◄his friends certainly do not mourn, do they?/do his friends mourn?► RHQ No, they do not mourn, because they are not sad at that time. But when the bridegroom is taken {someone takes the bridegroom/his enemies take the bridegroom} from them, they will abstain from food, because then they will be sad.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus pebala kudeng ini kuandeh, idi inan seburur lun rayeh lun Yahudi nacing idi netekeradung sembayang Neneh, keburi'neh, "Anakku luk decur pangeh naté; do' Iko amé' ngerareng ticu'Mu luun bururneh, pad ieh mulun.”
english: While Jesus was saying that, a leader of the Jewish meeting place came and bowed down before him to show respect. Then he said, “My daughter just died! But if you come and lay your hand on her, she will live again!”

lun_bawang: Ieh nengerawé bang niatneh, "Kudeng ui ngakem kuyu'Neh mo, ui miak do' peh.”
english: Then Jesus turned around to see who had touched him. And when he saw the woman, he said to her, “Be encouraged, dear woman. Because you believed PRS that I could heal you, I have healed you.” The woman was healed at that very moment.

lun_bawang: Yésus nelumi idi nenier neneh, kebalaNeh, "O anakKu, do' iko lutep niat, anumu pangeh nengedo' namu." Idi petacu decur ineh do' peh.
english: Then Jesus and some of us disciples came to the Jewish leader’s house. Jesus heard the flute players playing funeral music and the crowd that had gathered wailing loudly because the girl had died.

lun_bawang: idi kebalaNeh, "Buro muyuh, anak ini na naté, ieh rudap mo'." Idi ideh meriruh idi nesitunga Neneh.
english: But Jesus told them to get out of the house. Then he went into the room where the girl was lying. He took hold of her hand and she became alive again and got up.

lun_bawang: Yésus nenecan bawang ineh, idi kareb Ieh nenalan, inan dueh lun mebuser nemaya' Neneh, idi nengitang, kebala didueh, "O Anak Daud, mé' nekai!”
english: Jesus went into the house, where he was staying, and then the blind men went in, too. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to heal your eyes?” They said to him, “Yes, Lord!”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb Ieh pangeh nesemuet bang ruma', lemulun luk mebuser ineh iné' matun Neneh. Idi kebala Yésus nedidueh, "Manuké medueh Ui melalud nganau' kekamen ini?" Idi kebala didueh, "Manu, Tuhan.”
english: Then he touched their eyes and he said to them, “Because you believe that I can heal your eyes, I am healing them right now!”

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nengakem mateh didueh, kebalaNeh, "Do' mangun kuan medueh mepad kudeng luk medueh pangeh manu.”
english: And they were able to see IDM! Then Jesus told them sternly, “Be sure IDM that you do not tell anybody what I did for you!”

lun_bawang: Idi mateh didueh nekulat, idi Yésus neperiteteng tu-tu nedidueh, kebalaNeh, "Ngerawé do'-do', aleg mada' seburur lemulun pana' ratnan ini.”
english: But they went out and reported it throughout that whole region.

lun_bawang: Idi kareb ada' ineh tila' rat neneh, idi lun mebegkeh ineh nepebala; idi lun mula' ineh pana' mawa, keburi'deh, "Rat mon nateh kekamen luk kudeng ini sinier arang lun pupu Israil.”
english: But the Pharisees said, “It is Satan, who rules the demons, who enables this man to expel demons from people.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala lun Parisi, "Ieh nala' ada' dengan lalud lun rayeh ada'.”
english: Then we went with Jesus through many of HYP the cities and towns in Galilee district. He was teaching ◄in the synagogues/in the Jewish meeting places►, and preaching the good message about how God rules over people’s lives. He also was healing the people who had various diseases and illnesses.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nan anak-anak sekola'Neh, "Matu, mula' luk perinien, iamo' pawa' lun luk ngeranih.
english: So pray and ask the Lord God to send more workers who will gather people together and teach them my message, just like a landowner sends workers into his field to gather the MET harvest.”

lun_bawang: Yésus nengecuk pulu' dueh rasul ini,idi Ieh neperiteteng nedeh, kebalaNeh, "Aleg muyuh semuet bang bawang lun pupu baken, idi aleg semuet bang bawang-bawang Samaria.
english: When Jesus was about to send us twelve apostles to tell his message to people in various places, he gave us these instructions: “Do not go where the non-Jews live MTY or into the towns where the Samaritans live, because they hate you.

lun_bawang: "Ngerawé do'-do'! Ui ngecuk nemuyuh kudeng dumba arang uned bungalé. Do' muyuh mileh mepad kudeng menipeh, idi do' niat mepad kudeng suit sukur.
english: And because you teach about me, you will be taken {the religious leaders will take you} to governors and kings in order that they may put you on trial and punish you. As a result, you will testify to those rulers and to other non-Jews about what I have done.

lun_bawang: "Kinanak miak maré kinanakneh pitayen, idi taman miak maré anakneh; anak-anak sikal metueh ratnan taman-tinandeh, pad ideh maré nedeh pitayen.
english: When people in one town cause you to suffer, escape to another town and tell the people there about me. Note this: I, the one who came down from heaven, will certainly return to earth before you have finished going from one town to another town throughout Israel and telling people about me.

lun_bawang: "Seburur anak sekola' na meluun rayeh ratnan guruneh, idi seburur demulun na meluun rayeh ratnan tuanneh.
english: “Do not be afraid of people who insult you and do evil things to you. God wants everything that is unknown now to be revealed {God wants you to reveal everything that is unknown now}. He does not want his truth to remain hidden MET and kept secret DOU.

lun_bawang: Suit pirit luk dueh pisuen lemulun aceh sin mo'. Iamo' sebuleng pana' na miak mebpeh luun tana', kudeng na pian Taman muyuh.
english: God values you much more than he values sparrows LIT. So, do not be afraid of people who threaten to kill you

lun_bawang: "Aleg ngerawé Ui pangeh nacing pad maré pedo' luun tana'; baken Ui nacing pad nguit pedo', iamo' aceh pelapet.
english: This shows that sometimes a person’s enemies will be members of his own household.

lun_bawang: "Lemulun luk nganak nemuyuh, ieh teh luk nganak Negku, idi lemulun luk nganak Negku, ieh teh luk nganak Neneh luk nengecuk Negku.
english: Note this: Suppose people see that you are thirsty  MTY and  give you a drink of cold water because they know that MTY you are one of my disciples. God  will certainly reward people who do that. They might consider that what they did  is insignificant, but God will consider it very significant” LIT.

lun_bawang: ngitun Yésus, keburi'deh, "Iko iniké luk miak macing ineh, kian petulu kai nginulat nelun baken lek?”
english: to ask him, “Are you the Messiah who the prophets prophesied would come, or is it someone else that we should expect to come?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Amé' muyuh idi mada' kuan Yahya ratnan anun-anun luk pindenger idi sinier muyuh,
english: After they asked Jesus that question, he answered them, “Go back and report to John what you hear me telling people and what you see me doing.

lun_bawang: Idi litaddeh nenalan, Yésus nengimun pebala kuan lun mula' ineh ratnan Yahya, kebalaNeh, "Anunké luk iné' muyuh sira' déi' su luk ali-ali? Selawa bulu'ké luk megio ku bui?
english: When John’s disciples had gone away, Jesus began to talk to the crowd of people about John. He said to them, “Think about what sort of person you went to see in the desolate area when you went there to see John. ◄You did not go there to listen to a man who constantly changed his message, like a reed that is blown {blows} back and forth in the wind MET!/Did you go there to listen to a man whose message changes continually like long grass that is blown {blows} back and forth in the wind changes its direction?► MET, RHQ

lun_bawang: "Iamo' dengan anunké Ui miak maad inul luk bang kareb ini? Ieh ineh mepad kudeng anak-anak luk tudo déi' kadai, idi luk ngitang kuan lun dengandeh,
english: “◄I will illustrate what you people who have heard what John the Baptizer and I have taught are like./Do you know what you people who have heard what John and I have taught are like?► RHQ You are like children who are playing games in an open area. Some of the children are calling to the others, saying,

english: But to show that she believed that non-Jews could also receive help from God, the woman said to Jesus, “Lord/Sir, what you say is correct, but even the little dogs eat the crumbs that fall to the floor when their masters sit at their tables and eat!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "O decur, anumu rayeh tu-tu. Miak mangun kuanmu kudeng luk pianmu." Idi petacu anakneh dino' peh.
english: Then Jesus said to her, “O woman, because you believe firmly in me, I will heal your daughter as you desire!” At that moment the demon left her daughter, and she became well.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala anak-anak sekola'Neh Neneh, "Rat iapehké tau miak ngalap petap ruti tungé' su luk ali-ali kuan lemulun luk kinula' ini?”
english: We disciples said to him, “In this place where nobody lives, ◄we cannot possibly obtain enough food to feed such a large crowd!/how can we obtain a large enough amount of food to feed such a large crowd?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Tuda' ruti luk idi nemuyuh?" Idi keburi'deh, "Tudu' balad, idi sesuut lawid luk medari.”
english: Jesus asked us, “How many small loaves do you have?” We said to him, “We have seven small loaves and a few cooked fish.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus, "Kareb aco macep muyuh pebala, 'Merikan ini lek, ngaceku langit ini mesia'.'
english: He answered them, “In this country, in the evening you say, ‘It will be good weather tomorrow, because the sky is red.’

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Ngerawé do'-do'' muyuh, idi matar do'-do' ratnan lamud lun Parisi idi lun Saduki.
english: Then Jesus said to us, “Beware that you do not accept the yeast MET that the Pharisees and Sadducees distribute.”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nepegayam arangdeh sebuleng, keburi'deh, "Tau' na nenguit ruti.”
english: Then, not realizing that he was speaking figuratively, we said to one another, “He must have said that because we forgot to bring any bread!”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus nekali' baladeh, idi kebalaNeh, "O muyuh luk na petap anu, ngudeh muyuh pegayam arang muyuh sebuleng, ngaceku na luk idi ruti nemuyuh?
english: Because Jesus knew what we were saying, he said to us, “◄I am disappointed that you are discussing among yourselves, thinking that it was because you did not bring any bread that I talked about the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees./Why are you discussing among yourselves thinking that it was because you did not bring any bread that I talked about the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees?► RHQ You believe only a little what I am able to do for you.

lun_bawang: Idi pangeh Yésus nacing bang tana' Kaisaria Pilipi, Ieh nengitun anak-anak sekola'Neh, keburi'Neh, "Maya' buri' dulun, idéké Anak-Lemulun?”
english: When Jesus came with us disciples to the region near Caesarea Philippi town, he asked us, “Who do people say that I, the one who came from heaven, really am?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh, "Sebuang pebala, Yahya luk Ngerereb; inan teh luk pebala, Elia' inan teh luk pebala, Yeremia, kian, seburur nabi luk baken lek.”
english: We answered, “Some people say that you are John the Baptizer, who has come back to life again. Others say that you are the prophet Elijah, who has returned from heaven as God promised. Still others say that you are the prophet Jeremiah or one of the other prophets who lived long ago, who has come back to life again.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Idéké Ui ini bang terawé muyuh?”
english: Jesus said to us, “What about you? Who do you say that I am?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Simun Pétrus, "Iko Keristus, Anak Allah luk mulun.”
english: Simon Peter said to him, “You are the Messiah! You are the Son of the all-powerful God.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Samal kuanmu, O Simun, anak Yunus! Ngaceku baken lemulun luk ngelio ini kuanmu, iamo' TamanKu luk bang surga.
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Simon, son of Jonah, God is pleased with you. What you just said was not SYN revealed to you by any human. Instead, it was my Father who lives in heaven who revealed this to you.

lun_bawang: Idi Pétrus nenguit Yésus iné' setau', idi ieh nemebpeng Neneh, keburi'neh, "Do' amung ineh uen Allah ngado rat Namu, O Tuhan! Dereh ineh na miak macing Namu.”
english: Because Peter assumed that the Messiah would not suffer and die, he took Jesus aside and began to rebuke him for talking about suffering and dying. He said, “Lord, may God never permit that to happen to you! That must certainly not happen!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus nelumi, idi nepebala ni Pétrus, "Amé' pa ketedKu, O Sétan! Iko luk ngesabeng Negku, ngaceku iko baken ngerawé luk ratnan Allah, iamo' lu ratnan lemulun mo'.”
english: Then Jesus turned to look at Peter, and he said to him, “Stop talking to me like that MTY! Stop saying what Satan MET would say, and stop trying to prevent from happening what God has planned! You are a hindrance to me, because you are not thinking like God thinks. Instead, you are thinking like people think!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus kuan anak-anak sekola'Neh, "Idé-idé luk sikal maya' Negku, do' ieh na ngerawé bururneh sebuleng, iamo' maan salibneh idi maya' Negku.
english: Then Jesus said to us disciples, “If any one of you wants to be my disciple, you must not do only what you yourself want to do. You must be willing to let people hurt you and disgrace you. That is like what they do to criminals whom they force to carry a cross MET to the place where the criminals will be executed. That is what anyone who wants to be my disciple must do.

lun_bawang: Idi Pétrus nepebala inan Yésus, "O Tuhan, do' tau tudo ieni; kudeng Tuhan pian, ui sikal mudut teluh lepo ieni; sebuleng kuanMu, sebuleng kuan Musa, idi sebuleng kuan Elia teh.”
english: Peter saw them and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is wonderful for us to be here! If you want me to, I will make three shelters, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

lun_bawang: Idi uned ieh pebala, inan aceh laput luk merasat iné' ngelungung nedeh; idi inan aceh tang rat bang laput ineh luk nepebala, "Ini AnakKu luk inanKu mawa; idi Ui mawang niat Neneh; do' muyuh ninger balaNeh.”
english: While Peter was speaking, a bright cloud appeared and covered them. They heard God speaking about Jesus from inside the cloud. He said to them, “This is my Son. I love him. He pleases me very much. So you must listen to him!”

lun_bawang: idi Yésus iné' ngakem nediteluh, keburi'Neh, "Do' meteluh tumui, aleg matot.”
english: But Jesus went to them and touched them and said to them, “Stand up! Do not be afraid any more!”

lun_bawang: Idi laba' ideh temurun rat luun pegkung ineh, Yésus neperiteteng nediteluh, keburi'Neh, "Aleg mada' luk sinier meteluh kuan seburur lemulun pana', pad Anak-Lemulun pangeh tumui rat arang lun naté.”
english: When they were walking down the mountain, Jesus commanded them, “Do not tell anyone what you saw on the mountain top until God has caused me, the one who has come from heaven, to become alive again after I die.”

lun_bawang: Idi anak-anak sekola'Neh nengitun Yésus, keburi' diteluh, "Ngudehké guru- guru Ukum pebala, na miak na Elia macing atun?”
english: Those three disciples had just seen Elijah and he did not do anything to prepare people for the coming of the Messiah, so they asked Jesus, “If what you say is true, why do the men who teach the Jewish laws say that it is necessary for Elijah to come back to earth before the Messiah comes?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Matu, Elia macing atun, pad nganau' temina'.
english: Jesus answered them, “It is true that God promised that Elijah would come to prepare many HYP people for the Messiah’s coming.

lun_bawang: "O Tuhan, do' Iko méi' kuan anakku luk deléi. Ngaceku ieh mét meruai, idi ieh pelaba dereh, ngaceku ieh megéi' meluka' bang apui idi bang abpa' pana'.
english: He said to him, “Sir/Lord, have mercy on my son and heal him! He has epilepsy and suffers very much. Because of this illness, he has fallen in the fire and in the water many times.

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus, "O inul luk na manu idi luk neraruh ini, tuda' ioké Ui tudo dengan muyuh? Tuda' ioké Ui mekadang niat nemuyuh? Do' nguit neneh amé' Negku.”
english: Jesus responded by saying to everyone who had gathered there, “You who have seen how I help people do not believe that you can do anything! Your minds are distorted! How long do I have to be with you before you are able to do what I do RHQ? How long do I have to endure your not believing RHQ? Bring the boy here to me!”

lun_bawang: Idi anak-anak sekola' ineh iné' lulem matun Yésus idi keburi'deh, "Ngudehké ada' ineh na metala' kai?”
english: Later, some of us disciples approached Jesus. We asked him privately, “Why were we (exc) not able to expel the demon?”

lun_bawang: Kareb amung anak sekola' ineh nepamung déi' Galilia, idi Yésus nepebala nedeh, "Anak-Lemulun miak barén bang palad lemulun.
english: They will kill me. But God will cause me to become alive again on the third day after I am killed.” When we heard that, we became very sad.

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh nacing Kapernaum, idi lemulun luk ngamung usin pupuk luk kinula'neh limeh ngepulu' sin iné' ni Pétrus, keburi'deh, "Naké Gurumu mayar limeh ngepulu' sin pupuk?”
english: He answered them, “Yes, he does pay it.” When we came into the house where Jesus was saying, before Peter began to talk about paying taxes, Jesus said to him, “Simon, from whom do you think rulers collect revenue or taxes? Do they collect taxes  from the citizens of their own country, or from citizens of countries they have conquered?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Pétrus, "Mayar!" Kareb Pétrus nesemuet bang ruma', Yésus nengitun neneh atun, kebalaNeh, "Kudeng apehké terawému, Simun? Ratnan idéké amung raca' tana' ini nengalap acam idi usin pupukdeh? Ratnan anak itindehké, kian ratnan lun sakai lek?”
english: Peter answered him, “From citizens of other countries.” Then Jesus said to him, “So citizens of their own country do not need to pay taxes.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Pétrus Neneh, Rat nelun sakai." Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Ngaceku ineh anak-anakneh na mayar ineh.
english: But even though the Temple is mine, pay the tax for us so that the Temple tax collectors will not become angry with us. In order to get the money to pay it, go to the lake. Cast your fish line and hook, and take the first fish that you catch. When you open its mouth, you will find a silver coin that is worth enough to pay the tax for you and me. Take that coin and give it to the Temple tax collectors.”

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh anak-anak sekola' ineh iné' matun Yésus, keburi'deh, "Idéké luk meluun rayeh bang Imet surga?”
english: About that time we disciples approached Jesus and said, “Who among us will be the most important when God MTY/EUP makes you king?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus, "Ngerawé do'-do'! Kudeng muyuh na misu' niat, idi mangun mepad kudeng anak luk isuut ini, na tu muyuh miak semuet bang Imet surga.
english: He said, “Think about this: If you (pl) do not change the way you(pl) think and become as humble as little children, you (pl) will surely not go to the place where God MTY/EUP rules.

lun_bawang: Mesusa' kuan tana' ini ngaceku sabeng. Ngaceku na miak na sabeng ineh macing, iamo' mesusa' kuan lemulun luk ngacing sabeng ineh.
english: It will be terrible for those MTY who cause others to stop believing in me. God will punish them eternally. It is inevitable that there will be those who cause others to stop believing in me. But it will be horrible for everyone who does that.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng apehké terawé muyuh? Kudeng inan aceh lemulun luk inan meratu dumba, idi kudeng sebuleng neraruh, naké ieh necan luk iwa' ngepulu' iwa' dumba ineh, idi amé' luun pegkung-pegkung idi nakap neneh luk neraruh ineh?
english: If you found it, I affirm to you (pl) that you would rejoice very much. You would be happy that 99 sheep did not stray away, but you would rejoice even more because you had found the sheep that had strayed away.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng kinanakmu mesala' namu, do' iko amé' mada' neneh ratnan sala'neh buleng-buleng; kudeng ieh sikal ninger balamu, pangeh iko nengalap kinanakmu.
english: If that person will not listen to you nor feel sorry that he has sinned against you, go get one or two other people who will listen to what you both have to say. Have them go with you so that what is written {Moses wrote} in the Scriptures might happen: ‘When one person accuses another in some matter, it should be confirmed by at least two or three people {at least two or three people should confirm it} before that person can be declared guilty {before they declare that person guilty}.’

lun_bawang: Pétrus iné' matun Yésus idi keburi'neh, "O Tuhan, tuda' kua'ké ui miak maré do' nan kinanakku luk mesala' negku? Macing tudu' kua'ké?”
english: Jesus said to him, “I tell you that the number of times you must forgive someone is not just up to seven, but you must ◄forgive him 77 times/never stop forgiving him►.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Na Ui pebala namu, macing tudu' kua' mo', iamo' tudu' ngepulu' kua' tudu'.
english: In order to illustrate why you should do this, I will tell you a story in which God MTY/EUP, who cares for the people whose lives he rules over, is compared {I compare God, who cares for the people whose lives he rules over} to a king and his officials. That king told some of his servants that he wanted his officials to pay what they owed him.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' lun tebarin ineh neremuat, idi ieh nepapu' lun denganneh luk inan baleh neneh tuda'-tuda' rigit. Idi ieh nengakem neneh, idi nemarek dierneh, keburi'neh, 'Ngua' balehmu negku.'
english: That official fell on his knees and begged him saying, ‘Be patient with me, and I will pay you all of it, eventually.’

lun_bawang: Idi lun denganneh netekeradung idi nemutuh neneh, keburi'neh, 'Do' iko mulai niat negku. Kali' rungen ui ngua' namu.'
english: But this official kept refusing to cancel that small debt that the man owed him. Instead, he caused that official to be put in prison and to stay there until he could pay back all the money that he owed him.

lun_bawang: Idi lun Parisi nacing sikal nutun Neneh, keburi'deh, "Miakké seburur deléi ngelagkan awanneh ngaceku anun-anun?”
english: Some Pharisees approached Jesus and said to him, “Does our Jewish law permit a man to divorce his wife for any reason whatever?” They asked that in order to be able to criticize Jesus, whether he answered “Yes” or “No.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Naké muyuh nemaca' Surat Allah, 'Idi Ieh luk pangeh nenganau' lemulun pun-pun, nenganau' nedeh ku deléi idi decur?'
english: Jesus said to them, “Because you have read RHQ the Scriptures, you should know that at the time God first created people, ‘he made one man, and he made one woman to be that man’s wife.’

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' lun Parisi Neneh, "Kudeng matu balaMu, anunké punneh Musa nengecuk maré surat patad, pad ngelagkan neneh?”
english: The Pharisees then said to him, “If that is true, why did Moses command that a man who wanted to divorce his wife should give her a paper stating his reason for divorcing her, and then send her away?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Musa nenima' nemuyuh ngelagkan awan muyuh ngaceku muyuh metueh niat. Iamo' rat pun-pun na ieh kudeng ineh.
english: He said to them, “It was because your ancestors  stubbornly wanted their own way  that Moses allowed them to divorce their wives, and you are no different from them. But when God first MTY created a man and a woman, he did not intend for them to separate.

lun_bawang: Idi anak-anak sekola'Neh nepebala Neneh, "Kudeng matu lawé ini ratnan deléi idi awanneh, na ulekneh paweh.”
english: We disciples said to him, “If that is true, it is better for men never to marry!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' keburi'Neh nedeh, "Bala ini baken kuan amung lemulun, iamo' barén Allah kuan sebuang lemulun mo'.
english: Then he said to us, “Not every man is able to accept this teaching. Only the men whom God enables to accept it are able to do so.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Nima' anak-anak luk isuut amé' Negku idi aleg mebpeng nedeh, ngaceku lemulun luk kudeng ini luk kuan Imet surga.”
english: But when Jesus saw us scolding them, he said to us, “Let the children come to me! Do not stop them! It is people who are humble and trusting like they are, who can experience God’s rule in their lives.”

lun_bawang: Inan aceh lemulun luk iné' matun Yésus, keburi'neh, "O Guru, anunké kekamen luk do' luk miak ruenku pad ui miak ngalap ulun luk meruked?”
english: As Jesus was walking along, a young man approached him and said to him, “Teacher, what good deeds must I do in order to live with God eternally?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Ngudehké iko ngitun Negku ratnan luk do'? Inan Sebuleng mo' luk do'; iamo' kudeng iko sikal semuat bang ulun luk meruked, do' iko maya' ukum-ukum ineh.”
english: Jesus said to him, “◄Consider what you are implying about who I am when you ask me about what is good./Do you realize what you are implying about who I am when you ask me about that which is good?► RHQ Only one being is good and really knows what is good. That being is God. But in order to answer your question about desiring to live with God eternally, I will say to you, ‘Keep the commandments that God gave Moses’.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengitun Yésus, keburi'neh, "Ukum-ukum anunké ineh?" Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Aleg iko ngaté, aleg iko pasét, aleg iko mano, aleg iko mangun ku lun nekali' luk mebalih;
english: The man asked Jesus, “Which commandments must I keep?” Jesus answered him, “Do not murder anyone, do not commit adultery, do not steal things, do not testify falsely,

lun_bawang: Idi kebala anak adi' ineh, "Amung-amung ukum ini ui pangeh nemaya'; anunké luk nateh inau'ku?”
english: Thinking that he might not be able to live with God eternally even though he had kept those commandments, the young man said to Jesus, “I have always obeyed all those commandments. What else must I do in order to live with God eternally?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus neneh, "Kudeng iko sikal mangun meriput, muli' iko, masui binawehmu, maré kuan lun masi', pad iko ngalap binaweh déi' surga: idi amé' maya' Negku.”
english: Jesus said to him, “If you desire to be all that God intends you to be, go home, sell everything that you have and give the money to poor people. The result will be that you will have spiritual riches in heaven. Then come and be my disciple!”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nepebala kuan anak-anak sekola'Neh, "Matu, Ui pebala nemuyuh, mikat tu-tu kuan lemulun luk mula' binaweh semuet bang Imet surga.
english: Then Jesus said to us disciples, “Keep this in mind: It is very difficult for rich people to decide to let God MTY/EUP rule their lives.

lun_bawang: Idi kareb anak-anak sekola'Neh neninger balaNeh, idi ideh pelaba awa, keburi'deh, "Kudeng pieh kudeng ineh, idéké luk miak ngalap ulun?”
english: When we disciples heard this, we were astounded. We thought that rich people were the ones whom God blesses the most. So we said to him, “◄If that is so, it does not seem likely that anyone will be saved!/Who then will God will save?►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nenier nedeh, kebalaNeh, "Kuan lemulun ini na miak mangun iamo' kuan Allah amung-amung miak mangun.”
english: When Jesus heard us say that, he looked intently at us, and then he said to us, “Yes, it is impossible for people to save themselves. But God can save them, because God is able to do anything!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Pétrus, "Siruh, kai pangeh nenecan luk amung-amung pad maya' Namu; anunké luk lapen kai teh?”
english: Then Peter said to him, “You know that we (exc) have left everything behind and we have become your disciples. So what benefit will we get for doing that?”

lun_bawang: "Imet surga mepad kudeng aceh tuan ruma' luk neremuat pekak uka-uka, pad nabpar lemulun pelé ideh ngakem bang kabun anggurneh.
english: “In order to illustrate how God rewards people, I will compare the way God MTY/EUP rules his people with what the owner of an estate did. Early in the morning the owner of the estate went to the market where people who wanted work gathered. He went there to hire laborers to work in his vineyard.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh neneh, 'Ngaceku na luk idi lemulun nabpar nekai.' Keburi'neh nedeh, 'Amé' muyuh teh ngakem bang kabun anggurku.'
english: They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ He said to them, ‘I will hire you. Go to my vineyard as other men have done, and work there.’ So they went.

lun_bawang: "Idi kareb malem aco, tuan kabun ineh nepebala inan lun matar kabunneh, 'Do' nawar lemulun luk pangeh nengakem, idi maré tabpardeh, ngimun ratnan lemulun luk muci pad macing nedeh luk atun.'
english: When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Tell the men to come so that you can give them their wages. First, pay the men who started working last, and pay the men last who started working first.’

lun_bawang: Kareb lemulun luk nesemuet malem aco ineh nacing, ideh nengalap tabpardeh anid-anid burur aceh rigit.
english: The manager paid the standard daily wage to each of the men who did not start working until five o’clock in the afternoon.

lun_bawang: Iamo' tuan nengor bala seburur, keburi'neh, 'O aca'ku, na ui naluk namu. Naké iko nengamo negku ngalap aceh rigit?
english: The owner of the vineyard said to one of those who complained, ‘Friend, I did not treat you unfairly. You agreed with me to work the whole day for the standard wage RHQ.

lun_bawang: "Ninger muyuh, nekini tau amé' déi' Yerusalim; idi Anak-Lemulun miak barén bang palad imam-imam rayeh, idi guru-guru Ukum teh; idi ideh sikal ngaté Neneh.
english: “Listen carefully! We are now going up to Jerusalem. While we are there, someone will enable the chief priests and the men who teach the Jewish laws to seize me, the one who came from heaven, and they will put me on trial. They will condemn me and say that I should be killed {the authorities should kill me}.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Anunké luk pianmu?" Idi keburi' decur ineh Neneh, "Do' Iko ngecuk dueh anakku ini tudo denganMu bang ImetMu, sebuleng pa tinueh idi sebuleng pa kabingMu.”
english: Jesus said to her, “What do you want me to do for you?” She said to him, “Permit these two sons of mine to sit next to you (OR, Permit these two sons of mine to sit next to you at your right side and at your left side) and rule with you MTY when you become king.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus nenawar nedeh amé' matun Neneh, kebalaNeh, "Muyuh kali' lun luk ngimet lun pupu baken metueh ngimet nedeh, idi lun rayeh-rayehdeh inan lalud pa luundeh.
english: So Jesus called all of us together and said to us, “You know that those who rule the non-Jews enjoy showing them that they are powerful. Their chief rulers enjoy commanding the people under them.

lun_bawang: Idi inan dueh burur lun mebuser luk tudo iring dalan; idi kareb didueh neninger Yésus lemaba, didueh nengitang, keburi' didueh, "O Tuhan, Anak Daud, méi' nekai!”
english: As we walked along, we saw two blind men sitting alongside the road. When they heard that Jesus was passing by, they yelled to him, “Lord, Descendant of King David, you are the Messiah Take pity on us!”

lun_bawang: Idi lun mula' nemebpeng nedidueh, idi nengecuk nedidueh pirud, iamo' didueh meluun rayeh tang, keburi' didueh, "O Tuhan, Anak Daud, méi' nekai!”
english: People in the crowd scolded them and told them to be quiet. But the blind men yelled even louder, “Lord, Descendant of King David, you are the Messiah Have pity on us!”

lun_bawang: Yésus nugka' idi nenawar nedidueh, kebalaNeh, "Anunké luk piar, medueh Ui miak nganau' kuan medueh?”
english: Jesus stopped and called them to come to him. Then he said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' didueh, "O Tuhan, kai mutuh kulat mateh!”
english: They said to him, “Lord, heal our eyes IDM so that we can see!”

lun_bawang: "Amé medueh semuet bang bawang luk pa atun medueh, idi petacu medueh miak papu' aceh keladai luk inabet dengan anakneh; do' neka dingetineh idi nguit amé' Negku.
english: If anyone says anything to you about your doing that, tell him, ‘The Lord needs them.’ He will then allow you to lead them away.”

lun_bawang: "Do' mada' bawang Sion, Nekini Raca'mu amé' namu. Ieh mebeneh niat, Ieh tudo luun keted keladai, luun keladai luk isuut, ieh ineh anak keladai.”
english: They brought the donkey and its colt to Jesus. They placed their cloaks on them to make something for him to sit on. Then Jesus mounted the colt and sat on the cloaks.

lun_bawang: Idi lun mula' luk nenalan pa atunNeh idi pa ketedNeh nengitang, keburi'deh, "Ngubur Anak Daud! Samal kuanNeh luk macing bang ngadan Tuhan! Ngubur Allah!”
english: The crowd that was already following him said, “This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee!”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus nesemuet bang bawang Yerusalim, idi amung-amung lemulun meria' peh, keburi'deh, "Idéké lemulun ini?”
english: Then Jesus went into the Temple courtyard and chased out all of those who were buying and selling things there. He also overturned the tables of those who were giving Temple tax money in exchange for Roman coins, and he overturned the seats of those who were selling pigeons for sacrifices.

lun_bawang: Idi lun mula' nepebala, "Ieh ineh seburur nabi, Yésus lun Nasarét, luk bang bawang Galilia.”
english: Then he said to them, “It is {◄Jeremiah/A prophet► has} written in the Scriptures that God said, ‘I want my house to be called a place where people pray’, but you bandits have made it MET your hideout!”

lun_bawang: kebalaNeh nedeh, "Pangeh inayud bang Surat Allah, 'Ruma'Ku tetanen ruma' luk inan sembayang,' iamo' muyuh nganau' ineh mangun ku su luk inan lun mano.”
english: The high priests and the men who taught the people the Jewish laws saw the wonderful deeds that Jesus did. They also saw and heard the children shouting in the Temple, “We praise the Messiah, the descendant of King David!” The religious leaders were indignant because they did not believe that Jesus was the Messiah.

lun_bawang: Imam-imam rayeh idi guru'-guru' Ukum ineh megateh niat kareb ideh nenier kekamen Yésus luk melalud, idi nekali' anak-anak luk bang Ruma' Allah ineh nengitang idi nepebala, "Ngubur Anak Daud!”
english: Then Jesus left the city. We disciples went with him to Bethany town, and we slept there that night.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh kuan Yésus, "Iko kali' baladehké?" Idi Yésus nepebala nedeh, "Mo' Ui kali'. Naké muyuh nemaca' ayat ini bang Surat Allah? 'Ratnan tang anak-anak luk isuut idi anak-anak luk niti' pana' uburMu pangeh meriput.' “
english: Early the next morning, when we were returning to the city, Jesus was hungry.

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nenier aceh lawa gita' luk iring dalan, idi Ieh iné' matun ineh. Idi Ieh nenier na luk idi anun-anun pana', iamo' don sebuleng. Idi kebalaNeh neneh, "Do' iko na kebua' rat nekini macing ruked-ruked peh." Idi lawa gita' ineh petacu melayuh peh.
english: Jesus said to us, “Think about this: If you believe that God has power to do what you ask him to and you do not doubt that, you will be able to do things like what I have done to this fig tree. You will even be able to do marvelous deeds like saying to a nearby hill, ‘Uproot yourself and throw yourself into the sea’, and it will happen!

lun_bawang: Kareb anak-anak sekola' ineh nekali' ratnan ini, ideh pelaba awa, keburi'deh, "Kudeng apehké lawa gita' ini petacu melayuh?”
english: In addition to that, whenever you ask God for something when you pray to him, if you believe that he will give it to you, you will receive it from him.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus nesemuet bang Ruma' Allah, imam-imam rayeh idi lun rayeh ratnan pupu ineh, iné' Neneh kareb Ieh mada', idi keburi'deh, "Dengan lalud anunké Iko nganau' kekamen ini? Idi idéké luk nemaré lalud ini kuanMu?”
english: Where did John the Baptizer get his authority to baptize those who came to him? Did he get it from God or from people? MTY/EUP” The chief priests and elders debated among themselves about what they should answer. They said to each other, “If we say, ‘It was MTY/EUP from God’, he will say to us, ‘Then ◄you should have believed his message!/why did you not believe John’s message?► RHQ’

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Ui pana' sikal ngitun aceh itun rat nemuyuh; idi kudeng muyuh ngor balaKu, Ui teh miak mada' nemuyuh dengan lalud idéké Ui nganau' kekamen ini.
english: If we say, ‘It was from people’, we are afraid that the crowd will react violently, because all the people believe that John was a prophet sent by God.”

lun_bawang: Rat iapehké rereb Yahya: rat surgaké, kian ratnan lemulun lek?" Idi ideh pesaad arangdeh sebuleng, keburi'deh, "Kudeng tau mala', Rat surga,' idi Ieh miak pebala netau, 'Ngudehké muyuh na manu neneh?'
english: So they answered Jesus, “We do not know where John got his authority.” Then he said to them, “Because you did not answer my question, I will not tell you who authorized me to do the things I did here yesterday.”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengor bala Yésus, kebaladeh, "Kai na kali'." Idi Yésus nepebala nedeh teh, "Ui pana' na sikal mala kuan muyuh dengan lalud idéké Ui nganau' kekamen ini.
english: But the son said to his father, ‘I do not want to go and work in your vineyard today!’ But later he changed his mind, and he went to the vineyard and worked.

lun_bawang: Sapehké rat arang dueh anak ineh luk nemaya' pian tamanneh?" Idi keburi'deh Neneh, "Seluk atun." Idi Yésus nepebala nedeh, "Ui pebala nemuyuh, lemulun luk ngamang usin pupuk idi decur-decur luk mesawa' semuet bang Imet Allah pa atun muyuh.
english: “Listen to another parable that I will tell you. There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He built a fence around it. He dug a hole in the ground inside the fence. He placed in the hole a stone tank to collect the juice that would be pressed out of the grapes. He also built a tower inside that fence that someone would sit in to guard that vineyard. He arranged for some men to care for the vineyard and to give him some of the grapes in return. Then he went away to another country.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh Neneh, "Dengan até luk pelaba dereh, ieh sikal ngaté lemulun luk dat ineh, idi kabun anggur ineh pana' barén uen lemulun baken ngacam, ieh ineh luk miak maré usag bua'neh bang anid-anid karebneh kebua'.”
english: So, because you reject me, I am going to tell you this: God will no longer let you Jews be the people over whom he rules. Instead, he will let non-Jews be the people over whom he rules, and they will do IDM what he asks them to do.

lun_bawang: Yésus nepebala nedeh, "Naké muyuh nemaca' ayat ini bang Surat Allah? 'Batu luk tila' lun luk mudut ruma' ineh pangeh mangun ku batu lidung. Ieh ineh inau' Tuhan, idi pelaba do' siren mateh tau.' “
english: The important stone in the building represents me, the Messiah, and those who reject me are like people who fall on this stone. Anyone who falls on this stone will be broken into pieces {This cornerstone will break into pieces anyone who falls on it}, and it will crush anyone on whom it falls.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus, "Ngaceku ineh Ui pebala nemuyuh, Imet Alla miak lapen rat nemuyuh, idi barén kuan aceh pupu luk ngeruat bua' luk petulu. ( 44Idé-idé lemulun luk mebpeh luun batu ini ieh miak mareg peh, iamo' lemulun luk ritapin batu ini miak mekareg.)”
english: When the chief priests and the elders who were Pharisees heard this parable, they realized that he was accusing them because they did not believe that he was the Messiah.

lun_bawang: "Imet surga mepad kudeng aceh raca' luk nenganau' irau paweh kuan anakneh.
english: “God MTY/EUP is like a king SIM who told his servants that they should make a wedding feast for his son.

lun_bawang: Sekua' teh ieh nengecuk demulunneh luk baken, keburi'neh, 'Do muyuh mada' lemulun luk pangeh tinawar, "Ui pangeh netemina' luk kenen; sapi'- sapi' idi pung-pung baken teh luk melamu pangeh kirat, idi amung-amung pangeh temina'; amé' iko ku irau paweh ineh." '
english: So he sent other servants to again tell the people whom he had invited that they should come to the feast. He said to those servants, ‘Say to the people whom I invited to come to the feast, “The king says that he has prepared the food. The oxen and the fattened calves have been butchered and cooked. Everything is ready. It is time now for you to come to the wedding feast!’ ”’

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nenawar demulun-demulunneh, kebalaneh, 'Irau paweh pangeh inau' temina', iamo' lun sakai luk tinawar na mayu.
english: After his soldiers had done that, the king said to his other servants, ‘I have prepared the wedding feast, but the people who were {whom I} invited do not deserve to come to it because they did not consider it an honor to have been invited.

lun_bawang: "Kareb raca' nesemuet sikal nier lemulun luk pangeh nepamung, ieh nenier aceh lemulun luk na nengayung ku ayung lun paweh.
english: But when the king went into the hall to see the guests who were there, he saw someone who was not wearing clothes that had been provided for the guests to wear at a wedding feast.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengecuk anak-anak sekola'deh dengan lun Herodiani teh amé' matun Neneh. Idi kebaladeh Neneh, "Guru, kai kali' Iko seburur lemulun luk matu, idi Iko mada' dalan Allah dengan luk matu, idi na Iko mili' ayu lemulun; ngaceku na Iko ngerawé taga burur lemulun.
english: They sent to him some of their disciples, who thought that the Israelites should pay only the tax that the Jewish authorities required them to pay. They also sent some members of the party that supported Herod. The members of that party thought that the Israelites should pay only the tax that the Roman government required them to pay. Those who were sent came and said to Jesus, “Teacher, we know that you are truthful and that you teach the truth about what God wants us to do. We also know that you do not change what you teach because of what someone says about you, even if it is an important person who does not like what you IDM teach.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus kali' niatdeh luk dat, idi keburi'Neh, "Ngudehké muyuh nutun Negku, O muyuh lun luk siayu?
english: But Jesus knew that what they really wanted to do was evil. They were wanting him to say something that would get him in trouble with either the Jewish authorities or the Roman authorities. So he said to them, “You are ◄hypocrites/pretending to ask a legitimate question►, but you are just wanting RHQ me to say something for which you can accuse me.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Ayu idéké ini idi ngadan idéké ini teh?”
english: He said to them, “Whose picture is on this coin? And whose name is on it?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh Neneh, "Ini raca' kuan." Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Ngaceku ineh, do' muyuh maré kuan raca' anun-anun luk raca' kuan; idi kuan Allah anun-anun luk Allah kuan.”
english: They answered, “It has the picture and name of Caesar, the head of the Roman government.” Then he said to them, “Okay, give to the government what they require, and give to God what he requires.”

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh, "O Guru, Musa pangeh nepebala, 'Kudeng aceh deléi maté, idi na anakneh, do' kinanakneh ngaweh tinula'neh, idi nginul anak kuan kinanakneh.'
