english: In order to discredit the idea that dead people will live again, they said to him, “Teacher, Moses wrote in the Scriptures, ‘If a man dies who did not have any children, his brother must marry the dead man’s widow in order that she can have a child by him. The child will be considered the descendant of the man who died, and in that way the dead man will have descendants.’

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus nedeh, "Muyuh sala' ngerawé ngaceku muyuh na kali' Surat idi lalud Allah.
english: Jesus replied to them, “You are certainly wrong in what you are thinking. You do not know what is written in the Scriptures. You also do not know that God has the power to make people alive again.

lun_bawang: "O Guru, sapehké ukum luk meluun rayeh ratnan Ukum Musa?”
english: “Teacher, which commandment in the laws that God gave Moses is the most important?”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nepebala neneh, "Do' iko mawa inan Tuhan Allahmu dengan amung niatmu, idi amung ulunmu, idi amung terawému.
english: Jesus quoted the Scriptures as he replied, “‘You must love the Lord your God with all IDM your ◄inner being/heart►. Show that you love him in all that you desire, in all that you feel, and in all that you think.’

lun_bawang: "Kudeng apehké terawé muyuh ratnan Keristus? Anak idéké Ieh?" Idi keburi'deh Neneh, "Anak Daud.”
english: “What do you think about the Messiah? Whose descendant is he?” They said to him, “He is the descendant of King David.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Kudeng pieh kudeng ineh, kudeng apehké Roh nengegio niat Daud pad ieh neten Neneh Tuhan? Ngaceku Daud nepebala,
english: Jesus said to them, “If the Messiah is King David’s descendant, then ◄David should not have called him ‘Lord’ when David was saying what the Holy Spirit prompted him to say./Why did David call the Messiah ‘Lord’ when David was speaking what the Holy Spirit prompted him to say?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Kudeng Daud neten Neneh Tuhan, kudeng apehké Keristus mangun ku Anakneh?”
english: So, since King David called the Messiah ‘my Lord’, ◄the Messiah cannot be just someone descended from David!/how can he be only the descendant of King David?► RHQ He must be much greater than David!”

lun_bawang: "Guru-guru Ukum idi lun Parisi luk ngegala' bala Ukum Musa.
english: “Moses was the renowned teacher who taught the people the laws that God gave him MTY. Now, the Pharisees and the men who teach our Jewish laws have made themselves the ones who interpret those laws IDM.

lun_bawang: "Mesusa' kuan muyuh guru-guru Ukum idi lun Parisi, lun luk siayu! Muyuh ngitek tanga' Imet surga kuan lun baken, ngaceku muyuh sebuleng na sikal semuet, idi muyuh mebpeng nelun baken luk sikal semuet teh.
english: Then Jesus said to the religious leaders, “You men who teach the Jewish laws and you Pharisees are hypocrites! There will be terrible punishment for you, because by teaching what is false, you prevent people MTY/HYP who are thinking about letting God rule their lives from doing that MET. What you are doing is like closing a gate MET so that people who are wanting to enter a city cannot go in. As for you, you do not let God rule your lives. Neither do you allow other people to let God rule their lives. What you do is like not going into a house yourselves, and not allowing others to enter it either MET.”

lun_bawang: "Mesusa' kuan muyuh guru-guru Ukum idi lun Parisi, lun luk siayu! Muyuh ngabud ruma' decur tinula', idi teh muyuh sibala mo'-mo' bang sembayang luk mekadang! Ngaceku ineh, meluun rayeh ukum muyuh peh.
english: “You are hypocrites, you men who teach the Jewish laws and you Pharisees! Your punishment will be terrible, because you exert yourselves very much to get even one person to believe what you teach. For instance, you travel across seas and lands to distant places in order to do that. And as a result, when one person believes what you teach, you make that person much more deserving to go to hell than you yourselves deserve to.”

lun_bawang: "Mesusa' kuan muyuh lun nguyut luk mebuser, luk pebala, 'Idé-idé luk pebulung ku Ruma' Allah ineh, aganeh mo', iamo' idé-idé luk pebulung ku amas luk bang Ruma' Allah, ieh luk mabeh bulung ineh peh.'
english: You are fools, and you are like people who are blind MET! The gold that is in the Temple is important, but the Temple is even more important RHQ, because it is the Temple that the gold is in that sets the gold apart for a special use for God.

lun_bawang: "Mesusa' kuan muyuh guru-guru Ukum idi lun Parisi! Lun luk siayu! Muyuh maru' luun sangkir idi bigan, iamo' bang lubangneh mepanu' ku pano idi lili.
english: You blind Pharisees! First you must stop being greedy and selfish. Then you will be able to do what is righteous. That will be like cleaning the inside of a cup first. Then when you clean MET the outside of the cup, the cup will truly be clean.”

lun_bawang: "Mesusa' kuan muyuh guru-guru Ukum idi lun Parisi! Lun luk siayu! Muyuh mepad kudeng tanem batu luk sinat ku apur, sagan pana' do' ayu luunneh, iamo' bang lubang mepanu' ku tulang-tulang lun naté idi puar-puar luk nan megeni'.
english: You are like those tombs. When people look at you, they think that you are righteous, but in your ◄inner beings/hearts► you are hypocrites and you disobey God’s commands.”

lun_bawang: "Mesusa' kuan muyuh guru-guru Ukum idi lun Parisi! Lun luk siayu! Muyuh nganau' tanem nabi-nabi, idi ngayung tanem lemulun luk matu,
english: You say, ‘If we had lived when our ancestors MET lived, we would not have helped MET those who killed MTY the prophets.’

lun_bawang: "O Yerusalim, Yerusalim! Iko ngaté nabi-nabi, idi mitung lemulun luk icuk amé' namu ku batu-batu. Tuda' kua' Ui sikal ngamung anak-anakmu mepad kudeng aceh tineh lal luk ngerukub anak-anakneh liang iladneh, iamo' na muyuh sikal!
english: So listen to this: Your city SYN will soon  become an uninhabited place.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus, "Muyuh nier amung iniké? Ui pebala nemuyuh, na miak ketecan sebuleng batu ieni luk na miak uen ngusag peh.”
english: He said to us, “These buildings that you are looking at RHQ are wonderful, but I want to tell you something about them. They will soon be completely destroyed {Foreign invaders will completely destroy them}. Every stone in these buildings will be thrown down {they will throw down every stone in these buildings}. Not one stone will be left {They will not leave one stone} on top of another stone.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus tudo luun Pegkung Saitun, amung-amung anak sekola'Neh iné' lulem matun Neneh, keburi'deh, "Ngelio kuan kai idanké amung ini miak mangun. Anunké tanu' luk mada' ratnan acingMu idi kekiped tana'?”
english: Later, as Jesus was sitting alone on the slope of Olive Tree Hill, we disciples went to him and asked him, “When will this happen to the buildings of the Temple? Also, tell us what will happen to indicate that you are about to come again, and to indicate that this world is ending?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Matar do'-do' pad lemulun na naluk nemuyuh.
english: Jesus replied, “All that I will say is, be sure that no one deceives you about what will happen

lun_bawang: "Idi muyuh miak kamen idi ruen ngedereh, idi pitayen pana'. Amung lemulun miak megateh nemuyuh ngaceku ngadanKu.
english: At that time people who oppose you will take you to the authorities, who will mistreat you and kill you. You will be hated by people who live in all nations PRS {People who live in all nations PRS will hate you} because you believe in me MTY.

lun_bawang: "Muyuh miak nier 'Dat luk Ngacing Tot' tuped bang su luk meligan, maya' kudeng luk bida' Nabi Daniel. (Do' lemulun luk maca' kali' ilungneh!)
english: “But before the world ends, the disgusting person who will defile the holy Temple and cause people to abandon it will stand in the Temple. Daniel the prophet spoke and wrote about that long ago. May everyone who reads this pay attention to the following warning from me:

lun_bawang: "Idi kudeng seburur lemulun pebala nemuyuh bang kareb ineh, 'Siruh, ini Keristus!' idi 'Ineh Keristus!'—aleg muyuh manu.
english: “At that time people will appear who will falsely say that they are the Messiah or that they are prophets. They will perform many kinds ◄of miracles/of things that ordinary people cannot do►, in order to deceive people. They will even try to see if it is possible to deceive you people whom God has chosen. So, at that time, if someone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or if someone says, ‘Over there is the Messiah!’ do not believe it!

lun_bawang: Ngerawé do'-do'! Ui pangeh nemada' nemuyuh atun.
english: So if someone says to you, ‘Look, the Messiah is in the desolate area!’ do not go there. Likewise, if someone says to you, ‘Look, he is in a secret room!’ do not believe that person,

lun_bawang: "Kudeng lun pebala nemuyuh, 'Siruh, Ieh idi déi' su luk ali-ali!'—aleg muyuh amé' déi'; idi kudeng ideh pebala, 'Siruh, Ieh idi bang takep!'—aleg muyuh manu ku baladeh.
english: because just like lightning flashes from the east to the west and people everywhere can see it SIM, when I, the one who came from heaven, return again, everyone will see me.

lun_bawang: "Idi kareb pangeh dereh ineh, petacu mateh aco medacem, bulan pana' na maré acangneh, gituen-gituen merurug rat bang langit, idi amung-amung lalud luk déi' langit ineh pana' mebubuh teh.
english: After that, something will be seen {people will observe something} in the sky that indicates that I, the one who came from heaven, am returning to the earth. Then unbelieving people from all ethnic groups of the earth will mourn because they will be afraid of God punishing them. They will see me, the one who came from heaven, coming on the clouds with power and great glory as I return to the earth.

lun_bawang: "Do' muyuh sibada' ratnan pinginud aceh lawa gita'. Kareb angatneh mebata' idi donneh pun mua', muyuh kali' kareb melau' pangeh muneng.
english: Similarly, when you see all these things that I have just described happening, you will know that the time for me to return is very close MET.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' ratnan aconeh idi karebneh seburur pana' nateh kali', sagan pana' melaikat luk déi' surga, idi Anak ineh pana' nateh kali', iamo' Taman sebuleng.
english: It will be like what happened when Noah lived. Until the flood came, the people did not know that anything bad would happen to them. Before the flood waters covered the earth, the people were eating and drinking as usual. Some men were marrying women and some parents were giving their daughters to men to marry them. They were doing all this until the day that Noah and his family entered the big boat. And then the flood came and drowned all those who were not in the boat. Similarly, the unbelieving people will not know when I, the one who came from heaven, will return, and they will not be expecting me.

lun_bawang: "Idéké demulun luk lutep idi mileh, luk icuk tuanneh matar uang ruma'neh, pad maré luk kenendeh bang kareb luk petulu?
english: But a wicked servant might say to himself, ‘The owner has been away for a long time, so he probably will not return soon and find out what I am doing.’

lun_bawang: "Kareb ineh Imet surga mepad kudeng pulu' burur decur luk pun mebaruh, luk nenguit lapungdeh, idi iné' ngapu' deléi luk sikal ngaweh.
english: Jesus continued by saying, “I will tell you something else about the time when I return from heaven as king MET. What will happen to many people who say that they know me will be like what happened to ten virgins who took their lanterns and went to the place where they would meet a bridegroom and go to his wedding celebration.

lun_bawang: "Imet surga mepad kudeng selemulun luk sikal amé' ngarang bang bawang baken, idi ieh nenawar amung-amung demulunneh, idi nemaré binawehneh bang paladdeh.
english: “When I return from heaven as king, I will deal with those who say that they have been serving me like a man who was about to go on a long journey dealt with his servants. He called them together and gave them each some of his wealth to invest and gain more money for him.

lun_bawang: "Idi mio-mio tuan demulun ineh nuli' peh idi ieh nengiap uli'deh.
english: After a long time the servants’ boss returned. He called them together to find out what they had done with his money.

lun_bawang: Idi tuanneh nepebala neneh, 'Do' luk inau'mu, O demulun luk do' idi lutep niat. Iko pangeh nelutep ratnan luk isuut, pad ui sikal nganau' namu ngimet luk mula'. Do' iko ngalap awang pad-pad denganku.
english: His boss replied, ‘You are a very good and faithful servant! You have done very well! You have faithfully handled a small amount of money, so I will put you in charge of a lot of things. Come and be happy with me!’

lun_bawang: Idi ieh luk nengalap dueh ngeribu rigit iné' teh, idi keburi'neh, 'Tuan, iko nemaré negku atun dueh ngeribu rigit. Siruh, ui pangeh nengalap uli'neh dueh ngeribu rigit teh.'
english: The servant who had received 2,000 dollars also came and said, ‘Boss, you gave me 2,000 dollars to take care of. Look, I have gained 2,000 more!’

lun_bawang: Idi tuanneh nepebala neneh, 'Do' luk inau'mu, O demulun luk do' idi lutep niat. Iko pangeh nelutep ratnan luk isuut, pad ui sikal nganau' namu ngimet luk mula'. Do' iko ngalap awang pad-pad denganku.'
english: His boss replied, ‘You are a very good and faithful servant! You have done very well! You have faithfully handled a small amount of money, so I will put you in charge of a lot of things. Come and be happy with me!’

lun_bawang: Idi ieh luk nengalap meribu rigit iné' teh,k idi keburi'neh, 'Tuan, ui kali' iko aceh lemulun luk metueh niat, idi iko ngeranih ratnan su luk inan iko na nengisak; idi iko ngamung teh rat su luk inan iko netunap.
english: Then the servant who had received 1,000 dollars came. He said, ‘Boss, I was afraid of you. I knew that you are a man who does not do foolish things with his money. You even take from others money that does not really belong to you, like a farmer who harvests grain from another man’s field where he did not even plant the seeds.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala tuanneh, 'Iko demulun luk dat idi mekupé, iko kali' ui ngeranih rat su luk inanku na nengisak, idi ngamung rat su luk inanku na netunap.
english: His boss replied, ‘You wicked, lazy servant! ◄You knew that I take from others money that does not really belong to me, like a farmer who harvests grain from another man’s field where I did not even plant the seeds!/Did you not know that I take from others money that does not really belong to me, like a farmer who harvests grain from another man’s field where I did not even plant the seeds?► RHQ

lun_bawang: "Kareb Anak-Lemulun macing mangun ku raca' dengan amung melaikatNeh, idi Ieh miak tudo luun kerusiNeh,
english: “When I, the one who came from heaven, come again, I will be very radiant and bring all my angels with me. Then I will sit as a king on my wonderful throne to judge people.

lun_bawang: Idi lemulun luk matu miak ngor, keburi'deh, 'O Tuhan, idanké kai nenier Iko melau, idi nemaman Namu, Iko meparing, idi kai nemaré Namu luk rupen?
english: Then the righteous people will reply, ‘Lord, when were you hungry and we saw you and gave you something to eat? When were you thirsty and we gave you something to drink?

lun_bawang: Idi Raca' ineh sikal ngor, kebalaNeh, 'Ui pebala nemuyuh, ngaceku muyuh nenganau' kudeng ini kuan seburur kinanakKu lun dat, ieh ineh luk inau' kuanKu teh.'
english: I will reply, ‘The truth is that whatever you did for any one of your fellow believers, even an unimportant one, it was as though you did it for me.’

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh ideh miak ngor balaNeh, keburi'deh, 'O Tuhan, idanké kai nenier Iko melau, meparing, lun sakai, lubpa, mét, bang tutup, idi na kai nengasa' Namu?'
english: They will answer, ‘Lord, when were you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or needing clothes or sick or in prison, and we did not help you?’

lun_bawang: Idi Raca' ineh sikal ngor baladeh, keburi'Neh, 'Setuneh, Ui pebala nemuyuh, ngaceku muyuh na nenganau' kudeng ini kuan seburur kinanakKu lun dat, muyuh na nenganau' kuanKu teh.'
english: I will reply, ‘The truth is that whenever you did not do anything to help any one of my people, even if they were unimportant people, it was as though you did not do anything to help me.’

lun_bawang: "Muyuh kali', kareb pangeh dueh aco, inan Irau Paska idi Anak-Lemulun barén pad Ieh uen nalib.”
english: “You know that two days from now we will celebrate the Passover festival. At that time I, the one who came from heaven, will be handed over to {they will put me, the one who came from heaven, into the hands of} those who will nail me to a cross.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' keburi'deh, "Aleg kareb irau, pad na luk idi ria' arang lun mula'.”
english: But they said, “We must not do it during the Passover festival, because if we do it then, the people might riot.”

lun_bawang: Kareb anak-anak sekola'Neh nekali' ratnan ineh, idi ideh museh, keburi'deh, "Anunké punneh umau ineh uenneh nuso mo'?
english: When we disciples saw that, some of us were angry. One of us said, “◄It is terrible that this perfume was wasted!/Why was this perfume wasted?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Yésus nekali' baladeh, idi Ieh nepebala nedeh, "Ngudehké muyuh ngesusa' decur ineh? Ieh nenganau' luk do' kuanKu.
english: Jesus knew what we were saying. So he said to us, “◄You should not be bothering this woman!/Why are you bothering this woman?► RHQ She has done a beautiful thing to me.

lun_bawang: keburi'neh, "Anunké luk barén muyuh negku kudeng ui maré Yésus nemuyuh?" Idi ideh nemaré neneh teluh ngepulu' balad pirak.
english: He asked them, “If I enable you to seize Jesus, how much money are you willing to give me?” They agreed to give him 30 silver coins. So they counted out the coins and gave them to him.

lun_bawang: Kareb aco luk pun-pun ratnan Irau Ruti luk Na Lamud, anak-anak sekola' ineh iné' matun Yésus, keburi'deh, "Su apehké luk pianMu inan kai nganau' temina' pad Iko miak kuman Irau Paska?”
english: On the first day of the week-long festival ◄when we Jews ate bread which had no yeast in it/of Unleavened Bread►, we disciples went to Jesus and asked, “Where do you want us to prepare the meal for the Passover celebration so that we can eat it with you?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'Neh nedeh, "Amé' muyuh bang bawang rayeh, matun seburur lemulun luk netemina' idi pebala neneh, 'Keburi' Guru, tarekKu pangeh muneng; idi bang ruma'Mu Ui sikal kuman Irau Paska dengan anak-anak sekola'Ku.' “
english: In reply, he gave instructions to two disciples about where they should go. He said to them, “Go into the city to a man with whom I have previously arranged this. Tell him that the teacher says, ‘The time MTY that I told you about is near. I am going to celebrate the Passover meal with my disciples at your house, and I have sent these two to prepare the meal.’”

lun_bawang: Idi uneddeh kuman, Yésus nepebala nedeh, "Ui pebala nemuyuh, inan sebuleng rat arang muyuh luk sikal masui Negku.”
english: While we were eating, he said to us, “Listen carefully to this: One of you is going to enable my enemies to seize me.”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh mesusa' tu-tu niat, idi anid-aniddeh nengimun pebala Neneh, keburi'deh, "Uiké ieh, O Tuhan?”
english: We were very sad. We began to say to him, one after the other, “Lord, ◄it is surely not I!/I’m not the one, am I?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Ieh luk ngerereb ruti bang bigan pad-pad denganKu, ieh ineh luk masui Negku.
english: He replied, “The one who will enable my enemies to seize me is one of you who is dipping bread MTY into the sauce in the dish along with me.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yudas luk nemasui Neneh, "Uiké ieh lek, O Guru?" Idi keburu' Yésus neneh, "Mepad kudeng luk bilamu.”
english: Then Judas, the one who was going to betray him, said, “Teacher, ◄surely it is not I!/I’m not the one, am I?► RHQ” Jesus replied, “Yes, you are the one.”

lun_bawang: Laba' ideh kuman, Yésus nengalap ruti idi nesembayang, idi nemuri' neneh, idi Ieh nemaré kuan anak-anak sekola'Neh, kebalaNeh, "Ngalap idi kuman' ini bururKu.”
english: While we were eating, Jesus took a small loaf of bread and thanked God for it. He broke it into pieces and gave it to us disciples, and said, “Take this bread and eat it. It represents my body.”

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nengiding aceh sangkir, idi nemaré ubur, idi nemaré nedeh, kebalaNeh, "Ngirup muyuh amung ratnan sangkir ini,
english: Later he took a cup of wine and thanked God for it. Then he gave it to us, saying, “Drink some of the wine in this cup, all of you.

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Amung-amung muyuh miak buro necan Negku bang dacem ini, ngacem pangeh inayud, 'Allah miak ngaté Lun Matar dumba, idi amung-amung dumba luk sengeriudan ineh mepatad.'
english: On the way, Jesus told us, “This night all of you will desert me because of what will happen to me! This is certain to happen because these words that God said are written in the Scriptures: ‘I will cause the shepherd to be killed, and all the sheep will be scattered {scatter}.’

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Pétrus Neneh, "Sagan pana' amung-amungdeh necan Namu, ui sebuleng na tu sikal necan Namu.”
english: Peter replied, “Perhaps all the other disciples will desert you when they see what happens to you, but I certainly will never leave you!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Ngerawé do'-do', bang dacem ini, kareb nateh lal ngekook, iko ngalum Negku teluh kua'.”
english: Jesus replied to him, “The truth is that this very night, before the rooster crows, you will say three times that you do not know me!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Pétrus Neneh, "Sagan pana' ui pitayen pad-pad denganMu, na tu ui sikal ngalum Namu." Kudeng ineh teh bala amung-amung anak sekola' ineh.
english: Peter said to him, “Even if they kill me while I am defending you, I will never say that I do not know you!” All the rest of us disciples also said the same thing.

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh Yésus nemaya' anak sekola'Neh macing su luk ngadanneh Getsémani, idi kebalaNeh nedeh, "Do' muyuh tudo ieni laba' Ui amé' sembayang pa déi'.”
english: Then Jesus went with us to a place that is called {that people call} Gethsemane. There he said to most of us, “Stay here while I go over there and pray.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh nedeh, "Mesusa' tu-tu niatKu, malé maté ayuKu; tudo ieni muyuh denganKu idi matar pad muyuh na rudap.”
english: Then he said to them, “I SYN am very sorrowful, so much so that I feel as if I were about to die! Remain here and stay awake with me!”

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nenalan pa atun sesuut, idi Ieh netekeradung idi sembayang, kesembayangNeh, "O Ama', kudeng miak, do' sangkir ini labén Negku; iamo' baken maya' pianKu, iamo' maya' pianMu.”
english: After going a little further, he threw himself face down on the ground. He prayed, “My Father, if it is possible MTY, do not make me have to endure the suffering that is coming now. But do not do as I want. Instead, do as you want!”

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh iné' matun anak-anak sekola' ineh idi Ieh nenier nedeh rudap, idi kebalaNeh ni Pétrus, "Adui, naké muyuh miak matar bang sejam mo' denganKu?
english: Then he returned to the three disciples and saw that they were sleeping. He woke Peter and said to him, “◄I am disappointed that you men fell asleep and were not able to stay awake with me for just a short time!/Why were you men not able to stay awake with me for just one hour?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi sekua' teh Ieh iné' sembayang, kesembayangNeh, "O Ama', kudeng sangkir ini na miak buro pad Ui ngirup ineh, aganeh pianMu miak mangun.”
english: He went away a second time. He prayed, “My Father, if it is necessary for me to suffer LIT, may what you want happen!”

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh iné' matun anak-anak sekola'Neh, idi keburi'Neh nedeh, "Do' muyuh rudap nekini idi ngato erur muyuh. Siruh, karebneh malé macing idi Anak- Lemulun miak barén bang palad lun mesala'.
english: Then he returned to us disciples. He woke us up and said to us, “◄I am disappointed that you are still sleeping and resting!/Why are you still sleeping and resting?► RHQ Look Someone is about to enable sinful men to seize me, the one who came from heaven!

lun_bawang: Lemulun luk nemasui Yésus pangeh nemaré aceh tanu' kuandeh, keburi'neh, "Lemulun luk ui muen, Ieh ineh Yésus; do' muyuh ngakem Neneh.”
english: Judas had previously arranged to give them a signal, saying, “The man whom I will kiss is the one you want. Seize him!”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yudas nacing, idi ieh petacu iné' matun Yésus, keburi'neh, "Bulé' Guru," idi ieh nemuen Neneh.
english: He immediately went to Jesus and said, “Greetings, Teacher!” Then he kissed Jesus on the neck/cheek.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "O Aca', do' mesaget nganau' luk pianmu." Idi ideh iné' ngakem Yésus, idi nengimet Neneh ét-ét.
english: Jesus replied, “Friend, is it to kiss me that you are here?” (OR, “Do what you have come for!”) Then the men who came with Judas stepped forward and seized Jesus.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yésus neneh, "Do' ngusong pelapetmu bang binanneh, ngaceku lemulun luk ngaté ku pelapet miak pitayen ku pelapet teh.
english: Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back in its sheath! All those who try to kill others with a sword will themselves be killed with a sword!

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nepebala kuan lun mula', "Muyuh remuat ayu-ayu sikal pebunu' dengan lun manoké, dengan pelapet idi kayuh pad ngakem Negku? Anid-anid aco Ui netudo mada' ago déi' bang Ruma' Allah, idi nateh muyuh nengakem Negku.
english: At that time Jesus said to the crowd that was seizing him, “◄It is ridiculous that you have come here to seize me with swords and clubs, as if I were a bandit!/Have you come here to seize me with swords and clubs, as if I were a bandit?► RHQ Day after day I sat in the Temple courtyard, teaching the people. Why did you not arrest me then?

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' didueh, "Lemulun ini pangeh pebala, 'Ui miak ngusag Ruma' Allah idi mudut neneh bang teluh aco kinioneh.' “
english: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy God’s Temple and to rebuild it within three days.’”

lun_bawang: Idi Imam Rayeh netuped, idi kebuli'neh nan Yésus, "Naké Iko ngor adu'deh Namu ineh?”
english: Then the high priest stood up and said to Jesus, “Are you not going to reply? What do you say about these things that they are saying to accuse you?”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus pirud mo'. Idi keburi' Imam Rayeh Neneh, "Ui ngecuk Namu pebulung ku ngadan Allah luk mulun, idi mada' nekai kudeng matu Iko Keristus Anak Allah.”
english: But Jesus remained silent. Then the high priest said to him, “I command you to tell us the truth, knowing that the all-powerful God is listening to you: Are you the Messiah, ◄the Son of God/the man who is also God►?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus neneh, "Mepad kudeng luk bilamu. Iamo' Ui pebala nemuyuh, rat pad sini muyuh miak nier Anak-Lemulun tudo pa tinueh Luk Melalud, idi amé' luun iaput rat surga.”
english: Jesus replied, “Yes, it is as you say. But I will also say this to all of you: Some day you will see me, the one who came from heaven, sitting beside MTY Almighty God, and ruling. You will also see me coming on the clouds from heaven!”

lun_bawang: Idi Imam Rayeh nenarak ayungneh, keburi'neh, "Ieh pangeh nenguyo! Anunké ulekneh lun nekali' kuan tau teh? Nekini muyuh pangeh neninger kuyoNeh.
english: Then the high priest tore his outer garment. That was the custom to show that he was shocked to hear Jesus say that he was equal to God. Then he said, “This man has insulted God! He claims to be equal with God! ◄We certainly do not need anyone else to testify against this man!/Why should we seek any more people who will testify against this man?► RHQ You heard what he said!

lun_bawang: Anunké terawé muyuh?" Idi kebaladeh, "Do' Ieh pitayen peh.”
english: What have you decided?” The Jewish leaders replied, “According to our laws, he is guilty and deserves to be executed!”

lun_bawang: keburi'deh, "Do' Iko mada' nekai, O Keristus, idéké lemulun luk nemepag Namu?”
english: and said, “Since you claim that IRO you are the Messiah, tell us who hit you!”

lun_bawang: Idi Pétrus netudo setau' déi' sikang; idi seburur anak adi' decur iné' matun neneh, keburi'neh, "Iko ini teh luk dengan Yésus, lun Galilia ineh.”
english: Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard. A servant girl came up to him and looked at him. She said, “You also were with Jesus, that man from Galilee district!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Pétrus nengena pa kiung amung-amungdeh, keburi'neh, "Na ui kali' ilung balamu.”
english: But while everyone there was listening, he denied it. He said, “I do not know what you are talking about!”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh iné' munung tanga' sikang ineh, idi seburur anak adi' decur luk baken teh nenier neneh, idi keburi'neh nedeh luk tuped déi', "Lun ini pangeh perurum dengan Yésus, lun Nasarét teh.”
english: Then he went out to the gateway of the courtyard. Another servant girl saw him and said to the people who were standing nearby, “This man was with Jesus, the man from Nazareth.”

lun_bawang: Idi sekua' teh ieh nengena dengan pebulung, keburi'neh, "Na ui miti lemulun ineh.”
english: But Peter again denied it. He said, “May God punish me if I am lying! I tell you, I do not even know that man!”

lun_bawang: Idi segageh teh lemulun luk tuped déi' iné' ni Petrus, kebaladeh, "Matu iko seburur rat arangdeh, ngaceku buri'mu miti kai.”
english: After a little while, one of the people who were standing there approached Peter and said to him, “It is certain that you are one of those who were with that man. We can tell from your accent that you are from Galilee.”

lun_bawang: Idi Pétrus nengimun ngediman idi pebulung, keburi'neh, "Na tu ui miti lemulun ineh." Idi lal pana' petacu nengekook peh.
english: Then Peter began to proclaim loudly that God should curse him if he was lying. He asked God in heaven to witness that he was telling the truth and said, “I do not know that man!” Immediately a rooster crowed.

lun_bawang: Idi Pétrus nengerawé bala Yésus atun, keburi'Neh, "Kareb nateh lal ngekook, iko miak ngalum Negku teluh kua'." Idi ieh neremuat idi nenangi' dengan singap-singap.
english: Then Peter remembered the words that Jesus had spoken to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will say three times that you do not know me.” And Peter went out of the courtyard, crying because he was very sad about what he had done.

lun_bawang: Keburi'neh, "Ui mesala' ngaceku ui nemasui dara' aceh lemulun luk na mesala'!" Iamo' keburi'deh, "Mekudeh ieh? Baken kai, iamo' iko luk mabeh ini.”
english: He said, “I have sinned. I have ◄betrayed/enabled you to seize► a man who ◄is innocent/has not done anything wrong►.” They replied, “◄That means nothing to us!/What does that mean to us?► RHQ That is your problem!”

lun_bawang: Imam-imam rayeh nengamung balad pirak ineh, keburi'deh, "Na tau miak nipa ini bang pati' rigit pupuk ngaceku ini tabpar dara'.”
english: Later the high priests found the coins. They picked them up and said, “This is money that we paid to have a man killed MTY, and our law does not allow such money to be put {us to put such money} into the Temple treasury.”

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh tana' ineh titendeh Tana' Dara', macing aco sini pana'.
english: That is why that place is still called {why they still call that place} ‘The field of blood’.

lun_bawang: Kareb idi pangeh mangun luk bila Nabi Yeremia, kebalaneh, "Idi ideh nenguit teluh ngepulu' balad pirak, ieh ineh ragaNeh luk imo lun Israil.
english: By buying that field, they fulfilled these words that the prophet Jeremiah wrote long ago: They took the 30 silver coins; That was what the leaders of Israel decided that he was worth;

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus netuped pa kiung Lun luk Ngimet Bawan gineh; idi ieh nengitun Yésus, keburi'neh, "Ikoké Raca' lun Yahudi?" Idi keburi' Yesus neneh, "Mepad kudeng balamu.”
english: Jesus stood in front of Pilate, the governor. The governor asked Jesus, “Do you claim to be the king of the Jews?” Jesus replied, “It is as you have just said.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Pilatus Neneh, "Naké Iko ninger mula' adu'deh Namu?”
english: So Pilate said to him, “You hear how many things they are saying to accuse you; are you not going to reply?”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb lun mula' nepamung, Pilatus nengitun nedeh, "Sapehké luk pian muyuh ui muit kuan muyuh? Barabaské, kian Yésus luk titen Keristus?”
english: So when the crowd gathered, Pilate asked them, “Which prisoner would you like me to release for you: Barabbas, or Jesus, whom some of you claim to be the Messiah?”

lun_bawang: Laba' Pilatus tudo bang ruma' besara', awanneh nengecuk mada' neneh, keburi'neh, "Aleg iko nganau' anun-anun pana' kuan lemulun luk matu ini; ngaceku aco sini pelaba susa' niatku ku nupiku Neneh.”
english: While Pilate was sitting on the platform where he made judicial decisions, his wife sent him this message: “Early this morning I had a bad dream because of that man. So do not condemn that righteous man!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Lun luk Ngimet Bawang, "Sapehké rat arang didueh luk pian muyuh ui muit kuan muyuh?" Idi keburi'deh neneh, "Barabas.”
english: So when the governor asked them, “Which of the two men do you want me to release for you?” They replied, “Barabbas!”

lun_bawang: Pilatus nepebala nedeh, "Kudeng pieh kudeng ineh anunké luk ruenku kuan Yésus luk titen Keristus?" Idi keburi'deh neneh, "Do' Ieh uen nalib.”
english: Pilate, very astonished, asked, “So what shall I do with Jesus who some of you say is the Messiah?” They all answered, “Command that he be crucified! {Command your soldiers ◄to crucify him/to nail him to a cross►}!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Pilatus, "Ngudeh, sala' anunké luk pangeh inau'Neh?" Iamo' ideh nengitang, keburi'deh, "Do' Ieh uen nalib.”
english: Pilate replied, “Why? What crime has he committed?” But they shouted even louder, “Have him crucified {Command that your soldiers crucify him}!”

lun_bawang: Idi amung-amung lemulun ineh nengor balaneh, keburi'deh, "Aganeh kai idi anak-anak kai mabeh dara'Neh.”
english: And all the people answered, “The guilt for causing him to die MTY will be on us, and it will be on our children, too!”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengapid tabpa' ku pataNeh idi nengerareng ineh luun uluhNeh, idi ideh nemaré rukud bang paladNeh, idi ideh netekeradung pa kiungNeh idi nesitunga Neneh. Keburi'deh, "Tabi' Raca' lun Yahudi.”
english: They took some branches with thorns and wove them to make a crown and put it on his head. They put in his right hand a reed like a staff that a king would hold. Then they knelt in front of him and made fun of him, saying, “Hooray for the king of the Jews IRO!”

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh nacing su luk inan ngadanneh Golguta, ilungneh, Su luk inan Perupuk Uluh,
english: They came to a place called Golgotha. That name means ‘the place like a skull’.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nenganau' aceh adu Neh luk inayud pa luun uluhNeh, "Ini Yésus luk Raca' lun Yahudi.”
english: They fastened to the cross above Jesus’ head a sign on which had been {they had} written why they were nailing him to the cross. But all it said was, ‘This is Jesus, the King of the Jews’.

lun_bawang: Keburi'deh, "Neh! Iko luk ngusag Ruma' Allah idi mudut neneh teh bang teluh aco mo' kinioneh, do' ngulun bururMu sebuleng. Kudeng matu Iko Anak Allah, temurun ratnan salib ineh.”
english: They said, “You said you would destroy the Temple, and then you would build it again within three days! So if you could do that, you should be able to save yourself! If you are the man who is also God (OR, If you are the Son of God), come down from the cross!”

lun_bawang: "Ieh pangeh nengulun lun baken, iamo' na Ieh melalud ngulun bururNeh sebuleng. Kudeng Ieh Raca' pupu Israil, do' Ieh temurun nekini ratnan salib idi tau miak manu Neneh.
english: “He claims that he saved others IRO from their sicknesses, but he cannot help himself!” “He says that he is IRO the King of Israel. So he should come down from the cross. Then we would believe him!”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb lélé tangal musul aco Yésus nengitang, kebalaNeh, "Eli, Eli, lema Sabaktani?" ilungneh, "AlahKu, AllahKu, anunké punneh Iko necan Negku?”
english: At about three o’clock Jesus shouted loudly, “Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani?” That means, ‘My God, my God, why have you deserted me?’

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh neninger tangNeh, idi sebuang rat arang lemulun luk tuped déi' nepebala, "Lun ini nawar Elia.”
english: When some of the people standing there heard the word ‘Eli’, misunderstanding it, they said, “He is calling for the prophet Elijah!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' keburi' lun baken, "Aganeh, do' tau nier kudeng Elia sikal amé' ngulun Neneh.”
english: But the other people there said, “Wait! Let’s see if Elijah comes to save him!”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb lun rayeh lun pebunu' idi lemulun luk tudo denganneh matar Yésus nekali' tana' meruyuh, dengan amung-amung luk pangeh mangun, ideh pelaba tot, idi keburi'deh, "Matu, Ieh Anak Allah.”
english: The officer who supervised the soldiers who nailed Jesus to the cross was standing nearby. His soldiers who had been on guard so that no one would rescue Jesus were also there. When they felt the earthquake and saw all the other things that happened, they were terrified. They exclaimed, “Truly he was both man and God! (OR, a Son of God).”

lun_bawang: keburi'deh, "O Tuan, kai ngerawé bala lun naluk ineh kareb Ieh mulun, keburi'Neh, 'Pangeh teluh aco idi Ui sikal tumui teh.'
english: They said, “Sir, we remember that while that deceiver was still alive, he said, ‘Three days after I die I will become alive again.’

lun_bawang: Idi Pilatus nepebala nedeh, "Muyuh pana' inan lun matar, do' muyuh amé' idi ngeraben tanemneh maya' amung-amung ileh muyuh.”
english: Pilate replied, “You can take some soldiers. Go to the tomb and make it as secure as you know how.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala melaikat nan decur-decur ineh, "Aleg muyuh matot, ngaceku ui kali' muyuh nakap Yésus luk pangeh sinalib ineh.
english: The angel said to the two women, “You should not be afraid! I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was {whom they} ◄nailed to a cross/crucified►.

lun_bawang: Denak-denak Yésus nepapu' nedeh, keburi'Neh, "Awang kuan muyuh." Idi ideh iné' ngapel kukudNeh idi netekeradung sembayang Neneh.
english: Suddenly, as they were running, Jesus appeared to them. He said, “Greetings!” The women came close to him. They knelt down and clasped his feet and worshipped him.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Aleg matot, do' muyuh amé' idi ngecuk kinanak- kinanakKu semuet bang bawang Galilia, idi napeh Ui miak sirendeh déi.”
english: Then Jesus said to them, “Do not be afraid! Go and tell ◄all my disciples/all those who have been accompanying me► that they should go to Galilee. They will see me there.”

lun_bawang: keburi'deh, "Do' muyuh mada', 'Anak-anak sekola'Neh nelulem kareb medacem idi nemano Neneh, laba' kai rudap.'
english: They said, “Tell people, ‘His disciples came during the night and stole his body while we were sleeping.’

lun_bawang: Yésus iné' nedeh, kebalaNeh, "Amung-amung lalud bang surga idi bang tana' pana' pangeh biré Negku.
english: Then Jesus came close to us and said, “My Father has given me all authority over everything and everyone in heaven and on earth.

lun_bawang: Mepad kudeng luk inayud bang surat Nabi Yesaya, kebalaneh; "Matu, Ui ngecuk lun dukenKu amé' pa atunMu, pad nganau' temina' dalanMu.
english: He will call out to people who pass by where he is in the desolate area, “As people improve and straighten out pathways before an important official arrives MET, make yourselves ready DOU in order that you will be prepared when the Lord comes.”

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh nelun mula', "Muci rat negku ini miak macing Seburur Lemulun teh luk meluun lalud rat negku. Neka abet kasutNeh pana' ui na mayu.
english: I used only water when I baptized you because you said that you wanted to change your lives, but he will put his Holy Spirit within you to truly change your lives.”

lun_bawang: Idi inan aceh tang rat bang langit, "Iko ini AnakKu luk inanKu mawa, idi Ui mawang niat Namu!”
english: ◄Then/Right away► the Spirit of God sent Jesus into the desolate area.

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "Karebneh pangeh macing, idi Imet Allah pangeh muneng. Do' muyuh uren idi manu ku Bala luk Do' ini.”
english: One day, while Jesus was walking along by Galilee Lake, he saw two men, Simon and Simon’s younger brother, Andrew. They were casting their fishing net into the lake. They earned money by catching and selling fish.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yésus nedidueh, "Amé' medueh maya' Negku, idi Ui nganau' nemedueh mangun ku lun ngerabat lemulun.”
english: Immediately they abandoned the work that they were doing with their nets, and they went with him.

lun_bawang: keburi'neh, "O Yésus lun Nasarét, anunké luk pianMu nekai? Iko macing sikal ngaté nekaiké? Ui kali' Namu ini, ieh ineh Lemulun luk Meligan luk nacing ratnan Allah.”
english: Jesus rebuked the evil spirit, saying, “Be quiet! And come out of the man!”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nemebpeng neneh, keburi'Neh, "Pirud! Remuat iko ratnan lemulun ini!”
english: The evil spirit shook the man hard. He screamed loudly, and then he came out of the man and left.

lun_bawang: Idi lun mula' ineh mawa pad ideh nengitun seburur dengan seburur, keburi'deh, "Anunké ini? Bada' luk mebaruhké? Ngaceku amung-amung ada' pana' icukNeh dengan lalud, pad ideh maya' balaNeh.”
english: The people very soon told many others throughout the whole Galilee district what Jesus had done.

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh nepapu' Neneh, idi ideh nepebala Neneh, "Amung-amung lemulun nakap Namu!”
english: He said to them, “No, let’s go on to the neighboring towns in order that I can preach there also, because the reason that I came into the world was to preach to people in many places!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus nepebala nedeh, "Do' tau amé' bang bawang luk bake luk muneng rat ieni, pad Ui mada' déi' teh, ngaceku ini punneh Ui nacing.”
english: So they went throughout Galilee district. As they did so, each ◄Sabbath/Jewish rest day► he preached in ◄synagogues/Jewish meeting places►. He was also expelling evil spirits from people.

lun_bawang: Inan aceh lemulun luk mét susud iné' matun Yésus, idi netekeradung pa kiungNeh mutuh pedengan, keburi'neh, "Kudeng Iko pian, Iko miak ngedo' negku.”
english: Jesus felt very sorry for him. So he ignored the religious laws about coming close to people who had that disease. He reached out his hand and touched the man. Then he said to him, “Since I am willing to heal you, be healed {I heal you} now!”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus pelaba éi' neneh, idi Ieh nenatang ticu'Neh idi nengakem neneh, kebalaNeh, "Ui pian ngedo' namu, do' iko meligan peh!”
english: Immediately the man was healed! He was no longer a leper!

lun_bawang: kebalaNeh, "Ngerawé do'-do', aleg iko mala anun-anun kuan seburur lemulun pana'. Iamo' do' iko petacu amé' mada' bururmu siren lun imam, idi maré baré maya' kudeng luk icuk Musa, pad ngegala' liganmu kuan amung- amung lemulun.”
english: The man went and presented himself to the priest. But then he began to tell many people about how Jesus had healed him DOU. As a result, Jesus was no longer able to enter any town publicly because the crowds would surround him. Instead, he remained outside the towns in places where no people lived. But people kept coming to him from all over that region.

lun_bawang: Yésus nenier anudeh ineh, idi kebalaNeh nan lemulun luk naté urat ineh, "O anakKu, iko pangeh nengalap do' ratnan sala'mu.”
english: After Jesus perceived that the men believed that he could heal this man, he said to the paralyzed man, “My friend, I forgive your sins!”

lun_bawang: "Ngudehké lemulun ini mekuu' nguyo Allah kudeng ineh? Idéké miak maré do' ratnan sala'? Inan Sebuleng mo', Ieh ineh Allah.”
english: “◄Who does this man think he is, talking like that/This man shouldn’t talk like that!► RHQ? ◄He is insulting God!/Does he think he is God?► RHQ ◄No person can forgive sins!/Who can forgive sins?► RHQ Only God can forgive sins!”

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh teh Yésus nekali' ratnan ideh ngerawé kudeng ineh bang niatdeh, idi kebalaNeh nedeh, "Ngudehké muyuh ngerawé kudeng ineh bang niat muyuh?
english: Jesus sensed that they were deliberating like that within themselves. So he said to them, “◄You should not question within yourselves whether I have the right to forgive this man’s sins!/Why do you question whether I have the right to forgive this man’s sins?► RHQ

lun_bawang: "Ui pebala namu, Tumui iko, ngiding luk inanmu rudap ineh idi muli'.”
english: “To you I say, ‘Get up! Pick up your sleeping pad! And then go home!’”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh netumui, petacu nengiding luk inanneh rudap ineh idi neremuat siren lun mula', pad amung-amungdeh pana' mawa idi nengerayeh Allah, keburi'deh, "Nateh kai nekali' luk kudeng ini atun!”
english: The man stood up immediately! He picked up the sleeping pad, and then he went away, while all the people there were watching. They were all amazed, and they praised God and said, “We have never before seen anything like what happened just now!”

lun_bawang: Kareb Ieh nelemaba, idi Ieh nenier Liwi Alpius tudo bang ruma' luk inan ngalap usin pupuk. Kebala Yésus neneh, "Do maya' Negku." Idi Liwi netuped idi nemaya' Neneh.
english: As he walked on further, he saw a man named Levi, whose other name was Matthew, and whose father’s name was Alpheus. He was sitting in his office where he collected taxes for the Roman government. Jesus said to him, “Come with me and become my disciple!” So he got up and went with Jesus.

lun_bawang: Kareb guru-guru Ukum idi lun Parisi nenier Yésus kuman dengan lun mesala' idi lun luk ngamung usin pupuk ineh teh, idi kebaladeh nan anak- anak sekola'Neh, "Ngudehké Yésus kuman dengan lemulun luk kudeng ineh?”
english: The men who taught the Jewish laws who were there and who were members of the Pharisee sect saw that Jesus was eating with men who collected taxes and others who were considered {whom they considered} to be sinners. So they said to his disciples, “◄It is disgusting that he eats with such disgusting men as those who collect taxes, and with other sinners!/Why is it that he eats with such disgusting men as those who collect taxes, and with other sinners?►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus neninger baladeh, idi kebalaNeh nedeh, "Lemulun luk do' ulun na ulek uen ngubat, iamo' lemulun luk mét. Baken Ui macing nawar lemulun luk matu, iamo' lemulun luk mesala'.”
english: After Jesus heard what they were saying, he said to the men who taught the Jewish laws, “People who consider that they are well do not seek a doctor. On the contrary, it is those who are sick who seek a doctor MET!” This he said to indicate that it was those who knew that they had sinned who were coming to him in order that he might help them spiritually. And he said, “I did not come to invite people who think that IRO they are righteous to come to me and turn from their sinful behavior. On the contrary, I came from heaven to invite people who know that they are sinners, in order that they might turn from their sins and come to me.”

lun_bawang: Idi anak-anak sekola' Yahya idi lun Parisi pana' uned mawa', idi ideh nacing ngitun Yésus, "Ngudehké anak-anak sekola' Yahya idi anak-anak sekola' lun Parisi pana' mawa', iamo' anak-anak sekola'Mu na mawa'?”
english: The disciples of John the Baptizer and some men who belonged to the Pharisee sect used to abstain from food to show that they wanted to please God. One day, some people came to Jesus and asked him critically, “The disciples of John and the Pharisees ◄fast/abstain from food► from time to time, but your disciples do not. We think they should abstain from food also. What do you say about that RHQ?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Miakké lun rurum deléi luk sikal ngaweh mawa' kareb ieh idi dengandeh? Kareb deléi luk sikal ngaweh ineh idi dengandeh na ideh mawa'.
english: Jesus wanted them to understand that it was not appropriate for his disciples to show sorrow by abstaining from food while he was still with them. So he said to them, “When a man is marrying a woman, his friends will certainly not abstain from food while he is still with them, will they RHQ? No. During the time that he is with them, they will not abstain from food because they are happy together.

lun_bawang: Idi lun Parisi nepebala kuan Yésus, "Siruh anak-anak sekola'Mu nganau' luk bibpeng kareb Aco luk inan Mudeng?”
english: Some of the Pharisees saw them doing what they considered to be work. So they said to him, “Look! ◄They should not be doing on our ◄Sabbath day/day of rest► work that our laws forbid!/Why are they doing on our ◄Sabbath day/day of rest► work that our laws forbid?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Natehké muyuh nemaca' luk inau' Daud kareb na luk kenenneh? Idi ieh dengan anak itinneh melau,
english: Jesus wanted to show them that the record in the Scriptures indicated that God permitted people to disobey certain religious laws when they needed food. So he said to them, “It is written in the Scriptures what our revered ancestor, King David, did when he needed food, and both he and the men with him were hungry. You have read about that, but ◄you do not think about what it implies./why do you not think about what it implies?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Aco luk inan Mudeng inau' ngaceku lemulun, baken lemulun inau' ngaceku Aco luk inan Mudeng.
english: Jesus said to them further, “God established ◄the day of rest/the Sabbath day► to help people! He did not create people to obey rules about ◄the Sabbath/the day of rest►!

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yésus kuan lemulun luk naté ticu' ineh, "Amé' iko pa atun.”
english: Jesus said to the man whose hand was shriveled, “Stand up here in front of everyone!” So the man stood up.

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nengitun nelun mula', kebalaNeh, "Miakké bang Aco luk inan Mudeng nganau' luk do', kian luk dat? Ngulun burur, kian ngaté?" Idi ideh pirud.
english: Then Jesus said to the Pharisees, “Do the laws that God gave Moses permit people to do good ◄on the Sabbath/on the Jewish rest day►, or do they permit people to do evil? Specifically, do his laws permit us to save a person’s life ◄on the Sabbath/on the Jewish rest day►, or do they permit us to let him die by refusing to help him?” But they did not reply.

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nenier libut-libutdeh dengan museh idi mesusa' niat, ngaceku niatdeh metueh, idi kebalaNeh kuan lemulun luk mét ineh, "Natang ticu'mu!" Idi ieh nenatang ticu'neh, idi ticu'neh pana' nedo'.
english: He looked around at them angrily. He was very distressed that they were stubbornly not wanting to help the man. So he said to the man, “Reach out your hand!” When the man reached out his withered hand, his hand became all right again!

lun_bawang: Kareb lemulun luk sineut ada' nenier Yésus, idi dieh neluka' pa kiungNeh idi nengitang, keburi'deh, "Iko ineh Anak Allah.”
english: He commanded the evil spirits strongly that they should not tell anyone who he was.

lun_bawang: Kareb bala ineh pangeh nekali' lun bang ruma' Yésus, idi ideh pian amé' ngalap Neneh muli' ngaceku lemulun mala', "Ieh meruden!”
english: Around that time some men who taught the Jewish laws came down from Jerusalem city. They heard that Jesus was expelling demons. So they were telling people, “Beelzebub, who rules the evil spirits, controls him. He is the one who enables this man to expel evil spirits from people!”

lun_bawang: Kudeng ineh teh amung guru-guru Ukum luk pangeh nacing rat Yerusalim nepebala, "Ieh sinuet Balsebul." Idi kebala lun baken, "Ieh nala' ada' dengan lalud lun rayeh ada'.”
english: Jesus summoned those men. Then he spoke to them in parables to enable them to realize that Satan would not oppose his own evil spirits. He also wanted them to realize that by expelling evil spirits, he was demonstrating that he was much more powerful than Satan. So he said, “◄It is ridiculous to suggest that Satan would expel his own evil spirits!/Why would Satan expel his own evil spirits?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nengamung nelun mula' idi nemada' nedeh dengan luk pinginud, kebalaNeh, "Kudeng apehké Sétan miak nala' Sétan?
english: If people who live in the same country are fighting one another, they will cease to be a single group under one ruler.

lun_bawang: "Ngerawé do'-do'! Lemulun miak ngalap do' ratnan amung-amung sala', kudeng ineh teh ratnan amung-amung kuyo ineh.
english: But if anyone speaks evil words about what the Holy Spirit does, God will never forgive that. That person’s guilt will remain with him forever.”

lun_bawang: Idi lun mula' pana' netudo libut-libut Yésus,idi kebaladeh Neneh, "Siruh, tinan idi kinanak-kinanakMu tuped déi' liang nakap Namu!”
english: Jesus replied to them, “◄I will tell you something about my mother and my brothers./Do you know whom I consider to be like my mother and my brothers?►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus, "Idéké luk tinanKu idi idéké luk kinanak-kinanakKu?”
english: After he looked around at the disciples who were sitting around him in a circle, he said, “Look here! I love these men as much as I love my mother and my brothers.

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nelumi idi nenier amung-amung lemulun luk libut-libutNeh, idi nepebala, "Siruh, ini tinanKu idi kinanak-kinanakKu!
english: Those who habitually do what God wants are as dear to me MET as my brother, my sister, or my mother!”

lun_bawang: "Ninger muyuh! Inan selemulun luk iné' ngisak padé pimara.
english: “Consider well the meaning of this illustration: A man/farmer went out to his field to sow some seeds.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Idé-idé luk inan lalid miak ninger, do' ieh ninger.”
english: Then Jesus said, “If you want to understand this MTY, you should consider carefully what I have just said.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Kuan muyuh pangeh biré luk inalum ratnan Imet Allah, iamo' kuan amung-amung lemulun luk déi' liang ineh pangeh biré amung-amung ini dengan luk pinginud,
english: He said to them, “People have not understood before the new message about how God wants to rule people’s lives. It is to you that this is being made known {that I am making this known}. But I tell about this only ◄in parables/figuratively► to those who have not yet invited God to rule their lives.

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Naké muyuh kali' ilung luk pinginud ini? Kudeng apehké muyuh miak kali' ilung maung-amung pinginud luk baken teh?
english: He also said to them, “◄I am disappointed that you do not understand this illustration!/Can you not understand this illustration?► RHQ If you do not understand this, ◄you will certainly not understand any of the other illustrations!/how will you understand any of the other illustrations?► RHQ Nevertheless, I will explain it to you.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Yésus, "Inanké lemulun nguit aceh lapung idi ngerareng neneh pa liang gatang, kian pa liang bitaran lek? Naké ieh nganau' neneh luun kukud dawan?
english: He also told them another parable, saying, “◄People certainly do not light an oil lamp and then bring it in the house in order that it may be put {someone may put it} under a container or under a bed./Would anyone light an oil lamp and then bring it in the house in order that it may be put {someone may put it} under a container or under a bed?► RHQ ◄No, they light it in order that it may be put {someone may put it} in a place where it lights the house./Wouldn’t they light it in order that it may be put {someone may put it} in a place where it lights the house?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebalaNeh, "Ngerawé do'-do' ratnan luk pedingeren muyuh. Allah ngukum nemuyuh maya' uad luk muyuh nguad kuan lun baken. Iamo' ukum Allah meluun berat kuan muyuh.
english: Then he said to them, “Consider carefully what you hear me say to you, for God will let you understand to the same degree that you consider what I say. He will let you understand even more than that.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Yésus, "Imet Allah mepad kudeng seburur lemulun luk ngisak ilung luun tana'.
english: Jesus also said, “God has the power to change people who let him rule their lives. I will illustrate how that can happen MET. A man planted seeds in the ground.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, 'Kudeng apehké luk pian tau maad Imet Allah, idi dengan pinginud luk kudeng apehké miak tau ngegala' ratnan ineh?
english: Jesus told them another parable. He said, “I will tell you RHQ how the number of people whose lives God rules in a new way will continue to grow (OR, each continue to have more and more influence in this world). I hope RHQ that this illustration will show this to you.

lun_bawang: Bang aco sineh teh, kareb malem, idi kebala Yésus kuan ana-anak sekola'Neh, "Do' tau guta amé' déi' dipar.”
english: On that same day, when the sun was setting, Jesus said to his disciples, “Let’s cross over to the opposite side of Lake Galilee in the boat.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus déi' pa puet alud uned rudap luun laga. Ideh nengalat Neneh, keburideh, "O Guru! naké Iko ngerawé netau lélé mekarem?”
english: Jesus was in the back part of the boat. He was sleeping, with his head on a cushion. So they woke him up and said to him, “Teacher! ◄You ought to be concerned that we are about to die!/Are you not concerned that we are about to die?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Yésus netumui, idi nemebpeng barui ineh idi kebalaNeh kuan ribut ineh, "Ugka' iko!" Idi barui ineh nugka' peh, pad abpa' ineh melino peh.
english: So Jesus got up and rebuked the wind. Then he said to the lake, “Be quiet! Be still! DOU” The wind immediately stopped blowing and then the lake became very calm.

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nepebala nan anak-anak sekola'Neh, "Ngudehké muyuh matot? Natehké muyuh manu?”
english: He said to the disciples, “◄I am disappointed that you are afraid like that!/Why are you afraid like that?► RHQ Do you not yet believe that I can protect you?”

lun_bawang: Iamo' ideh pelaba tot idi nepebala seburur kuan seburur, "Idéké lemulun ini, pad barui idi ribut pana' maya' balaNeh?"
english: They were very awestruck. They said to one another, “Not only do the demons obey this man, but  even the wind and the waves obey him! “◄What kind of man is he?/This man is not like ordinary  people!► RHQ”

lun_bawang: idi nengitang, keburi'neh, "Anunké luk pianMu negku, O Yésus Anak Allah luk Meluun Dita'? Ui mutuh Namu bang ngadan Allah, aleg Iko ngedereh negku!" ( 8Ngaceku pangeh bila Yésus kuanneh, "O ada', remuat iko ratnan lemulun ini!")
english: Jesus said to the evil spirit, “You evil spirit, come out of this man!” But the demon did not leave quickly. It shouted very loudly, “Jesus, I know that you are the ◄Son of/man who is also► God, so ◄we have nothing in common./what do we have in common?► IDM, RHQ So leave me alone I ask you to promise, knowing God is listening, that you will not torture me now!”

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nengitun neneh, "Idéké ngadanmu?" Idi ieh nengor balaNeh, keburi'neh, "Ngadanku 'Baweh' ngaceku kai mula'.”
english: Then the evil spirits fervently kept begging Jesus that he not send them out of the region.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala ada'-ada' ineh inan Yésus, "Nima' nekai semuet bang burur barek ineh!”
english: He permitted them to do that. So the evil spirits left the man and entered the pigs. The herd, which numbered about 2,000, rushed down the cliff into the lake, and drowned in the lake.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus na nima' neneh maya' Neneh. KebalaNeh neneh, "Do' iko muli' idi mada' nelun bang tetek ruma'mu ratnan kekamen luk rayeh luk pangeh inau' Tuhan kuanmu, idi ratnan éi'Neh namu.”
english: So the man left and traveled around the Ten Towns district. He told people how much Jesus had done for him. All the people who heard what the man said were amazed.

lun_bawang: idi ieh mesaad mutuh, keburi'neh, "Anak decurku luk isuut lélé maté, do' Iko amé' idi ngerareng ticuMu luunneh pad ieh do' idi mulun teh.”
english: So Jesus and the disciples went with him. A large crowd followed Jesus and many pushed close to him.

lun_bawang: Idi keterawéneh, "Kudeng ui ngakem kuyu'Neh mo', kali' rungen ui miak do' peh.”
english: At once her bleeding stopped. At the same time, she sensed that she had been cured of {that he had cured} her illness.

lun_bawang: Petacu Yésus nekali' inan lalud neremuat rat Neneh, idi Ieh nelumi nelun mula' ineh idi nepebala, "Idéké luk nengakem kuyu'Ku?”

lun_bawang: Kareb Ieh numak idi kebalaNeh nedeh, "Ngudeh muyuh megagau idi nangi'? Na anak ini naté, iamo' ieh rudap.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Seburur nabi kali' rungen ruen ngedita', iamo' bang bawangneh sebuleng idi tetek ruma'neh sebuleng na lun ngedita' neneh.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Herodés neninger bala ineh, idi kebalaneh, "Yahya ini luk pangeh kilebku pangeh tumui teh!”

lun_bawang: Yahya luk Ngerereb megéi' mada' ni Herodés, "Bibpeng kuanmu na miak ngalap awan kinanakmu.”

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh anak decur Herodia nesemuet idi nengalai. Idi ieh nengawang niat Herodés dengan lun luk tinawarneh. Idi kebala raca' kuan anak decur ineh, "Do' iko mutuh anun-anun luk pianmu, pad ui miak maré ineh kuanmu.”
english: He said to her, “Whatever you ask, I will give it to you! I will give you up to half of what I own and rule, if you ask for it. May God punish me if I do not do what I have promised!”

lun_bawang: Idi Herodés nepebulung neneh, keburi'neh, "Anun-anun pana' luk pituenmu rat negku, ui miak maré kuanmu, macing sebuang imetku pana'.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Tuda' balad ruti muyuh? Do' amé' nier." Kareb ideh nekali', idi kebaladeh Neneh, "Inan ruti limeh balad, idi dueh lawid mo'.”

lun_bawang: Kareb amungdeh nenier Yésus idi ideh megagap. Iamo' petacu Yésus nepebala nedeh, "Aleg muyuh merapang, Ui ini, aleg matot!”

lun_bawang: Lun Parisi idi guru-guru Ukum nengitun Neneh, "Ngudehké anak-anak sekola'Mu na nganau' mepad kudeng bada' lun rayeh, iamo' ideh kuman ruti dengan na sibaru'?”
english: It is useless for them to worship me, because they teach only what people have commanded as if I myself had commanded them.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Matu amung-amung luk pangeh bida' Nabi Yésaya ratnan muyuh lemulun luk siayu, mepad kudeng luk inayud: 'Pupu ini ngedita' Negku ku bibir tangdeh, iamo' niatdeh mado rat Negku.

lun_bawang: "Idi ukum Allah muyuh necan, iamo' bada' lemulun muyuh ngimet.”
english: For example, our ancestor Moses wrote God’s command, ‘Honor your fathers and your mothers’. He also wrote, ‘The authorities must execute a person who speaks evil about his father or mother.’

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Yésus, "Muyuh mileh ngarung ukum Allah, pad muyuh miak maya' bada' tepun muyuh.

You teach people that it is all right if people give their things to God instead of giving them to their parents. lun_bawang: Iamo' keburi' muyuh, 'Do' kudeng seburur lemulun pebala kuan taman kian tinanneh, Idi anun-anun luk inan ulek kuanmu rat negku pangeh mangun ku Kurban,' (ilungneh, barén inan Allah).

english: Nothing that people eat causes God to consider them to be unacceptable. On the contrary, it is that which comes from people’s ◄inner beings/hearts► that causes God to reject them.”

lun_bawang: Yésus nenawar nelun mula' amé' matun Neneh teh, idi nepebala kuandeh, "Ninger muyuh, amung-amung luk rat Negku, do' muyuh kali' ilungneh.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Muyuh na meluun ileh rat nelun baken. Naké muyuh kali', anun luk semuet bang burur lemulun luk rat pa luun na miak ngelutak neneh?
english: They commit adultery, they are greedy, they act maliciously, they deceive people. They act indecently, they envy people, they speak evil about others, they are proud, and they act foolishly.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebalaNeh, "Anun luk remuat rat bang nait lemulun ineh luk ngelutak neneh.
english: After Jesus and his disciples left Galilee district, they went to the region around Tyre. While he stayed at a certain house, he desired that no one know it, but people soon found out that he was there.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus, "Nima' anak-anak uen ngebor atun, ngaceku na do' ngalap ruti ratnan anak-anak idi nala' kuan uko'.”
english: Jesus and his disciples left the region around Tyre city and went north through Sidon city, then toward the east through the district of the Ten Towns, and then south to the towns near Lake Galilee.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala decur ineh, "Matu, O Tuhan, iamo' uko' luk pa liang méja ine pana' kuman areg-areg luk kenen anak ineh.”
english: There, people brought to him a man who was deaf and who could hardly talk. They begged Jesus to lay his hands on him in order to heal him.

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus neneh, "Ngaceku ratnan bala luk kudeng ini, do' iko muli' pangeh ada' ineh neremuat rat bang burur anakmu.”
english: So Jesus took him away from the crowd in order that the two of them could be alone. Then he put one of his fingers into each of the man’s ears. After he spat on his fingers, he touched the man’s tongue with his fingers.

lun_bawang: "Ui mé' nelun mula' ini, ngaceku pangeh teluh aco ideh tudo denganKu, idi na luk kenendeh.

english: Knowing that he was suggesting that they give the people something to eat, one of his disciples replied, “◄We cannot possibly find food to satisfy this crowd, here in this place where no people live!/How can we find food to satisfy this crowd, here in this place where no people live?►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nengitun nedeh, "Tuda' ruti luk inan nemuyuh?" Idi keburi'deh, "Tudu' balad mo'.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus negarod kebalaNeh, "Ngudehké inul ini nakap tanu'? Ui pebala nemuyuh, sebuleng tanu' pana' na miak barén kuan inul ini.”

english: when I broke only five loaves and fed the 5.000 people RHQ? Not only was everyone satisfied, but there was food left over How many baskets full of pieces of bread that were left over did you collect?” They replied, “We collected twelve baskets full.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Naké muyuh kali' ilungneh?”
english: Then he kept saying to them, “◄I am disappointed that you do not understand yet that you should never worry that you do not have enough food!/Why do you not understand yet that you should never worry that you do not have enough food?►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Yésus nengecuk neneh muli', keburi'Neh, "Aleg iko lemubed amé' bang bawang.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Do not go into the town! First go straight home and tell the people there about what I did!” Then he sent the man to his home.

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus neremuat dengan anak-anak sekola'Neh iné' bawang-bawang Kaisaria Pilipi. Kareb uned Ieh nalan, idi kebalaNeh inan anak-anak sekola'Neh, "Maya' buri'dulun, idéké Ui ini?”
english: Jesus and the disciples left Bethsaida town and went to the villages near Caesarea Philippi town. On the way he questioned them, “Who do people say that I really am?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' anak-anak sekola'Neh, "Inan luk nemala Yahya luk Ngerereb, inan luk nemala Elia, idi inan teh luk nemala seburur lemulun rat arang nabi.”

english: Then a shining cloud appeared that covered them. God EUP spoke to them from the cloud saying, “This is my Son. I love him. Therefore, listen to him!”

english: The three disciples had just seen Elijah, but Elijah had not done anything to prepare people to accept Jesus. lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Matu Elia macing atun pad nganau' amung-amung temina'. Iamo' kudeng apehké luk inayud ratnan Anak-Lemulun, idi Ieh miak mabeh mula' dereh idi talan lemulun?

english: So they brought the boy to Jesus. As soon as the evil spirit saw Jesus, it shook the boy severely, and the boy fell on the ground. He rolled around, and he foamed at the mouth.

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nengitun taman anak ineh, "Tuda' ioké ini pangeh nangun neneh?" Idi keburi'neh, "Rat ieh isuut.
english: The spirit does not only do this, but he also often throws him into the fire or into the water in order to kill him. But, pity us and help us, if you can!”

english: Immediately the child’s father shouted, “I believe that you can help me, but I do not believe strongly. Help me to believe more strongly!”

lun_bawang: Idi taman anak ineh nengitang idi nangi', kebalaneh, "Ui inan anu sen, iamo' na petap. Ngedengan anuku ineh!”
english: Because Jesus wanted to heal the boy before the crowd got bigger, he rebuked the evil spirit, saying, “You evil spirit, you who are causing this boy to be deaf and unable to talk! I command you to come out of him and never enter him again!”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nenier lun mula' luk nupun pamung déi', idi Ieh nemebpeng ada' ineh idi nepebala, "O ada' luk mebegkeh idi mebengel, Ui ngecuk namu remuat rat neneh, idi aleg iko semuet baruh teh.”
english: The evil spirit shouted, it shook the boy violently, and then it left the boy. The boy did not move. He seemed like a dead body. So many of the people there said, “He is dead!”
