lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus pangeh nesemuet bang ruma' idi anak-anak sekola'Neh nengitun Neneh dengan lulem, keburi'deh, "Anunké punneh kai ini na miak nala' ada' ineh?”
english: He said to them, “You can expel this kind of evil spirit only by your praying that God will give you the power to do it. There is no other way that you can expel them.”

lun_bawang: Kebala' Yésus, "Ada' luk kudeng ineh na miak ruaten dengan anun-anun imao' dengan sembayang.”
english: After Jesus and his disciples  left that district, they traveled through Galilee district. Jesus did not want anyone else  to know that he was in their area; he did not want

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nacing déi' Kapernaum. Kareb Yésus nacing déi' ruma', idi Ieh nengitun anak-anak sekola'Neh, "Anunké luk inan muyuh pesaad kareb muyuh maya' dalan?”
english: But they did not reply. They were ashamed to reply because, while they were traveling, they had been arguing with each other about which one of them would be the most important when Jesus became king.

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus netudo idi nenawar pulu' dueh anak sekola' ineh, kebalaNeh, "Idé- idé luk sikal amé' pa atun, do' ieh amé' pa muci lun baken, idi mangun ku lun ngasa' amung-amung lemulun.”
english: Then he took a child and placed him among them. He took the child in his arms and then he said to them,

lun_bawang: "Idé-idé luk nganak seburur anak luk isuut mepad kudeng anak ini bang ngadanKu, idi ieh luk nganak Negku; idi idé-idé luk nganak Negku ini, setuneh baken ieh nganak Negku iamo' Ieh luk pangeh nengecuk Negku.”
english: John said to Jesus, “Teacher, we saw someone who was expelling demons, ◄claiming he had authority from you to do that/while telling people that you have told him to do it►. So we told him to stop doing it because he was not one of us disciples.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yahya Neneh, "O Guru, kai pangeh nenier seburur lemulun luk nala' ada' dengan ngadanMu, idi kai nemebpeng neneh ngaceku na ieh maya' netau.”
english: Jesus said, “Do not tell him not to do that! For no one will speak evilly about me just after he performs a miracle while saying that I have told him to do it.

lun_bawang: Iamo' keburi' Yesus, "Aleg mebpeng neneh, ngaceku na luk idi seburur pana' nganau' kekamen luk melalud dengan ngadanKu, idi petacu ngedat Negku.
english: Furthermore, those who are not opposing us are trying to achieve the same goals that we are.

lun_bawang: "Idé-idé luk ngesabeng seburur rat arang anak luk isuut luk manu Negku ini, meluun do' kuanneh kudeng aceh batu tekalan luk rayeh betin i dierneh idi ieh miak talan bang abpa' rayeh.
english: So, if you are wanting to use one of MTY, PRS your hands to sin, stop using your hand! Even if you have to cut your hand off and throw it away to avoid sinning, do it HYP! It is good that you not sin and that you live eternally, even though you lack one of your hands while you are here on earth. But it is not good that you sin and as a result God throws your whole body into hell. There the fires never go out!

lun_bawang: Lun Parisi nacing sikal nutun Neneh, idi ideh nengitun Neneh, "Miakké seburur lemulun ngelagkan awanneh?”
english: While he was teaching them, some Pharisees approached him and asked him, “Does our Jewish law permit a man to divorce his wife?” They asked that in order to be able to criticize him whether he answered “yes” or “no”.

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nengor baladeh dengan aceh itun, "Anunké luk pangeh icuk Musa nemuyuh?”
english: He answered them, “What did Moses command your ancestors about a man divorcing his wife?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh, "Musa nenima' lemulun ngayud surat patad, pad miak ngelagkan awan.”
english: One of them replied, “Moses permitted that a man may write on paper his reason for divorcing his wife, give this paper to her, and then send her away.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Ngaceku ratnan tueh niat muyuh idi Musa nengayud ukum ini kuan muyuh.
english: Jesus said to them, “It was because your ancestors stubbornly wanted just what they desired that Moses wrote that law for your ancestors, and you are just like them!

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh nedeh, "Idé-idé luk ngelagkan awanneh idi ngaweh decur baken, ieh ineh pasét pa kiung awanneh,
english: He said to them, “God considers that a marriage lasts until either the husband or the wife dies, so he considers that any man who divorces his wife and marries another woman is committing adultery, even if he divorces his first wife.

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus nekali' ratnan ineh, idi Ieh museh, kebalaNeh, "Nima' anak- anak luk isuut amé' Negku, idi aleg mebpeng nedeh, ngaceku lemulun luk kudeng ini luk kuan Imet Allah.
english: When Jesus saw that, he became angry. He said to the disciples, “Allow the children to come to me! Do not forbid them DOU! It is people who are humble and trust as they do who can experience ◄God’s rule in their lives/God taking care of them► MET.

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus negugkang nalan, inan seburur lemulun luk nupun idi netekeradung pa kiungNeh, idi nengitun Neneh keburi'neh, "O Guru luk do', anunké luk miak ruenku, pelé ui miak ngalap ulun luk meruked?”
english: As Jesus was starting to travel again with his disciples, a young man ran up to him. He knelt before Jesus and then he asked him, “Good teacher, what must I do to have eternal life/in order to live with God eternally?”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nepebala neneh, "Anunké punneh iko mala Negku do'? Seburur pana' na luk do', inan Sebuleng mo', ieh ineh Allah.
english: Jesus said to him, “◄You should consider carefully what you are implying (OR, that you are implying that I am God) by calling me good, because only God is good!/Do you realize what you are implying (OR, that you are implying that I am God) by calling me good, because only God is good?► RHQ No other person is good

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nepebala nan Yésus, "O Guru, amung ini ui pangeh nemaya' rat kareb ui suut.”
english: The man said to him, “Teacher, I have obeyed all those commandments ever since I was young. So is ◄that enough/there something else that I have not done►?”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nenutong lemulun ineh dengan mawa neneh, kebalaNeh, "Sebuleng mo' luk nateh inau'mu, muli' iko idi masui amung binawehmu, idi maré kuan lun masi', pad iko miak ngalap binaweh déi' surga; idi amé' maya' Negku.”
english: Jesus looked at him and loved him. He said to him, “There is one thing that you have not yet done. You must go home, sell all that you possess, and then give the money to poor people. As a result, you will be spiritually rich in heaven. After you have done what I have told you, come with me and be my disciple!”

lun_bawang: Yésus nenier libut-libutNeh idi nepebala kuan anak-anak sekola'Neh, "Mikat tu-tu kuan lemulun luk mula' binaweh semuet bang Imet Allah!”
english: Jesus looked around at the people. Then he exclaimed to his disciples, “It is very difficult for people who are wealthy to decide to let God rule their lives!”

lun_bawang: Idi anak-anak sekola'Neh mawa ngaceku bala ineh. Iamo' kebala Yésus kuandeh teh, "O anak-anakKu, miak tu-tu semuet bang Imet Allah!
english: The disciples were surprised at what he said. They thought that God favored the rich people, so if God did not save them, he would not save anyone. So Jesus replied again to them, “My dear friends, it is very difficult for anyone to decide to let God rule his life.

lun_bawang: Idi anak sekola' Yésus pelaba awa idi nengitun seburur dengan seburur, "Kudeng pieh kudeng ineh, idéké luk miak ngalap ulun?”
english: The disciples were very astonished. So they said to each other, “If that is so, ◄it will be unlikely that anyone will be saved {that God will save anyone}!/will God save anyone?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nenutong nedeh idi nepebala, "Kuan lemulun ini na miak mangun, iamo' baken kudeng ineh kuan Allah, ngaceku kuan Allah luk amung-amung miak mangun.”
english: Jesus looked at them and then he said, “Yes, it is impossible for people to save themselves! But God certainly can save them, because God can do anything!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Pétrus Neneh, "Kai ini, panegh nenecan luk amung-amung pad maya' Namu.”
english: Peter exclaimed, “You know that we have left behind everything and we have become your disciples. So, ◄what about us/will God <accept us/reward us>►?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Ui pebala nemuyuh, na luk idi seburur lemulun pana' luk pangeh nenecan ruma'neh, kinanakneh deléi idi decur, taman-tinanneh, anak-anakneh, idi tana'neh, ngaceku Ui idi ngaceku Bala luk Do' ineh teh,
english: Jesus replied, “I want you to know this: Those who have left their houses, their brothers, their sisters, their father, their mother, their children, or their plots of ground, to be my disciples and to proclaim the good news,

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "Nekini tau amé' déi' Yerusalim, idi Anak-Lemulun miak barén bang palad imam-imam rayeh idi guru-guru Ukum. Ideh miak ngukum Neneh pitayen, idi miak maré Neneh bang palad lun pupu baken.
english: “Listen carefully! We are going up to Jerusalem. There the chief priests and the men who teach the Jewish laws will be enabled {someone will help the chief priests and those who teach our Jewish laws} to seize me. Then they will declare that I must die, even though I am the one who came from heaven. Then they will take me to the Roman authorities.

lun_bawang: Yakub idi Yahya luk anak Sabdi nacing Neneh, idi nepebala, "O Guru, inan luk pian kai Namu.”
english: Along the way, James and John, who were the two sons of Zebedee, approached Jesus and they said to him, “Teacher, please do for us what we will ask you to do!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedidueh, "Anunké luk pian medueh Negku?”
english: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala didueh, "Do' maré nekai tudo seburur pa tinueh idi seburur pa kabing bang ImetMu luk rayeh.”
english: They said to him, “When you rule gloriously, let us rule with you. Let one of us sit at your right side and one sit at your left side.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus nedidueh, "Medueh na kali' luk pinutuh medueh. Miakké medueh ngirup ratnan sangkir derehKu ini? Idi miakké medueh rerebpen maya' lawé rerebKu?”
english: But Jesus said to them, “You do not understand what you are asking for.” Then he asked them, “Can you endure suffering MTY like I am about to suffer? Can you endure being killed MTY as I will be killed {people killing you as they will kill me}?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' didueh, "Miak." Idi Yésus nepebala nedidueh, "Matu medueh miak ngirup ratnan sangkir derehKu, idi medueh miak rerebpen maya' lawé rerebKu teh.
english: They said to him, “Yes, we are able to do that!” Then Jesus said to them, “It is true that you will endure suffering MTY like I will suffer, and you will endure being killed as I will be killed {people killing you as they will kill me}.

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nenawar nedeh amé' Neneh, idi kebalaNeh, "Muyuh kali' lemulun luk titen lun luk ngimet lun pupu baken meteh ngimet nedeh, idi lun rayeh- rayehdeh ngimet lalud arangdeh.
english: Then, after Jesus called them all together, he said to them, “You know that those who rule the non-Jews enjoy showing that they are powerful. You also know that officials enjoy commanding others.

lun_bawang: Kareb ieh neninger ratnan Yésus lun Nasarét idi, ieh nengitang, keburi'neh, "O Yésus Anak Daud, méi' negku!”
english: When he heard people say that Jesus from Nazareth was passing by, he shouted, “Jesus! You who are the Messiah descended from King David, ◄be merciful to/help► me!”

lun_bawang: Idi lun mula' ineh museh neneh idi nengecuk neneh pirud, iamo' meluun rayeh tangneh keburi'neh, "O Anak Daud, méi' negku ini!”
english: Many people rebuked him and told him that he should be quiet. But he shouted even more, “You who are the Messiah descended from King David, ◄be merciful to/help► me!”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nugka', kebalaNeh, "Nawar neneh." Idi ideh nenawar lun mebuser ineh, keburi'deh, "Do' iko mawang niat idi tumui. Ieh nawar namu.”
english: Jesus stopped and said, “Call him to come over here!” They summoned the blind man, saying, “Jesus is calling you! So cheer up and get up and come!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Anunké luk pianmu Negku?" Idi keburi' lun mebuser ineh Neneh, "O Guru, ui mutuh miak nier.”
english: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Sir, I want to be able to see again!”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nepebala neneh, "Nalaniko, anumu pangeh nengedo' namu." Idi petacu ieh miak nier peh, idi nemaya' Yésus bang lawéNeh.
english: Jesus said to him, “I am healing you because you believed in me. So you may go home!” He could see immediately. And he went with Jesus along the road.

lun_bawang: kebalaNeh nedidueh, "Amé' medueh semuet bang bawang luk pa atun medueh. Kareb medueh macing déi', medueh miak papu' sebuleng anak keladai luk inabet, idi seburur lemulun nateh netudo luun katedneh. Do' neka abetneh, idi nguit neneh amé' Negku.
english: He said to them, “Go to that village just ahead of you. As soon as you enter it, you will see a donkey that no one has ever ridden, that has been tied {people have tied} up. Untie it, and then bring it to me.

lun_bawang: Idi lemulun luk tuped déi' nepebala nedidueh, "Ngudeh medueh muit anak keladai ineh?”
english: Some of the people who were there said to them, “Why are you untying the donkey?”

lun_bawang: Idi lemulun luk nalan pa atun idi luk pa muci pana' nengitang, keburi'deh, "Ngubur Allah! Samal kuanNeh luk macing bang ngadan Tuhan!
english: The people who were going in front of him and behind him were all shouting things like, “Praise God!” “May God bless this one who comes ◄with his authority/as his representative► MTY.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Aleg seburur lemulun pana' kuman bua' rat namu rat nekini macing ruked-ruked peh." Idi anak-anak sekola'Neh neninger bala ini.
english: But to illustrate how God would punish the nation of Israel, he said to the tree, “No one shall ever eat from you again because you will no longer bear figs.” The disciples heard what he said.

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nemada' nelun mula' kebalaNeh, "Pangeh inayud, 'Ruma'Ku miak tetanen ruma' luk inan sembayang kuan amung-amung pupu.' Iamo' muyuh pangeh nenganau' neneh mangun ku lubang lun mano.”
english: Then as he taught those people, he said to them, “It is written {One of the prophets wrote} in the Scriptures that God said, ‘I want my house to be called {people to call my house} a house where people from all nations may pray’, but you bandits have made it like a cave where you can hide! ◄You know that!/Do you not know that?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi Pétrus nengerawé ratnan ini, idi ieh nepebala kuanNeh, "O Guru, siruh, lawa gita' luk kidimanMu pangeh naté.”
english: Peter remembered what Jesus had said to the fig tree and he exclaimed to Jesus, “Teacher, look! The fig tree that you cursed has withered!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Manu inan Allah.
english: Jesus replied, “You should not be surprised that God did what I asked! You must trust that God will do whatever you ask him to do!

lun_bawang: idi nengitun Neneh, "Dengan lalud anunké Iko nganau' kekamen ini? Idéké luk nemaré lalud ini kuanMu, pad Iko nganau' ineh?”
english: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. If you answer me, I will tell you who authorized me to do those things.

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nengor baladeh, "Ui pana' sikal ngitun nemuyuh, idi kudeng muyuh ngor balaKu, idi Ui teh miak mada' nemuyuh dengan lalud idéké Ui nganau' kekamen ini.
english: Did God MTY or people authorize John to baptize those who came to him?”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh pegayam seburur dengan seburur, keburi'deh, "Kudeng tau mala, 'Rat surga,' Ieh miak pebala, 'Ngudehké muyuh na manu neneh?'
english: On the other hand, if we say that it was people who authorized John, then what will happen to us?” They were afraid to say that about where John got his authority, because they knew that the people would be very angry with them. They knew that all the people truly believed that John was a prophet whom God had sent.

lun_bawang: Yésus nengimun pebala nedeh dengan aceh luk pinginud, "Inan seburur lemulun luk nenibu aceh kabun anggur, ieh nengar libut-libutneh, ieh nengukat luk inanneh misak bua' anggur ineh, idi ieh nemudut aceh lepo luk medita'. Idi ieh nemaré kabun ineh icam tuda'-tuda' lun matar kabun, idi ieh iné' bawang baken.
english: Then Jesus told those Jewish leaders a parable. He wanted to show what God would do to those who rejected the former prophets and himself. He said, “A certain man planted a vineyard. He built a fence around it in order to protect it. He made a stone tank to collect the juice that they would press out of the grapes. He also built a tower for someone to sit in to guard his vineyard. Then he leased the vineyard to some men to care for it and to give him some of the grapes in return. Then he went away to another country.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus kali' nedeh siayu, idi Ieh nengitun nedeh, "Ngudehké muyuh nutun Negku? Do' nguit aceh sin amé' Negku, pad Ui miak nier ineh.”
english: Jesus knew that they did not really want to know what God wanted them to do. So he said to them, “◄I know that you are just trying to make me say something wrong for which you can arrest me./Why are you just trying to make me say something wrong for which you can arrest me?► RHQ But I will answer your question anyway. Bring me a coin so that I might ask you something after I look at it.”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nenguit sesin sirenNeh. Idi Yésus nepebala nedeh, "Ayu idéké ini idi ngadan idéké ini?" Idi keburi'deh Neneh, "Ini raca' kuan.”
english: After they brought him a coin, he asked them, “Whose picture is on this coin? And whose name is on it?” They replied, “It is a picture and the name of Caesar, the man who rules the Roman government.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nepebala nedeh, "Do' maré kuan raca' anun-anun luk raca' kuan, idi kuan Allah anun-anun luk Allah kuan." Idi ideh mawa ku balaNeh.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “That is correct, so give to the government MTY what they require, and give to God what he requires.” They were frustrated at his answer but amazed at what he said, because they were not able to accuse him of anything because of what he said.

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh, "Guru, Musa pangeh nengayud ukum ini kuan tau: 'Kudeng kinanak seburur lemulun maté idi necan awanneh, iamo' na luk idi anak, do' kinanakneh ngalap awanneh ineh, idi nginul anak kuan kinanakneh.'
english: “Teacher, Moses wrote for us Jews that if a man who has no children dies, his brother should marry the dead man’s widow. Then if those two bear children, everyone will consider that those children are the children of the man who died, and in that way the dead man will continue to have descendants.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Sala' terawé muyuh! Anun punneh? Ngaceku na muyuh kali' Surat Allah idi lalud Allah.
english: Jesus replied to them, “You are certainly wrong RHQ. You do not know what they have written in the Scriptures about this. You also do not understand God’s power to make people alive again.

lun_bawang: Inan seburur guru Ukum luk neninger nedeh pesaad. Ieh kali' or Yésus nelun Saduki pelaba do'. Idi ieh pana' nengitun Neneh, keburi'neh, "Ukum sapehké luk atun?”
english: A man who taught the Jewish laws heard their discussion. He knew that Jesus answered the question well. So he stepped forward and asked Jesus, “Which commandment is the most important?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus, "Ukum luk meluun rayeh, ieh ineh, 'Ninger muyuh do'-do', O Israil! Allah Tuhan tau, Ieh ineh Tuhan luk Sebuleng.
english: Jesus answered, “The most important commandment is this: ‘Listen, you people of Israel! You must worship the Lord, our God, our only Lord.

lun_bawang: Idi guru Ukum ineh nepebala nan Yésus, "Matu, Guru, matu balaMu ineh, idi Allah ineh Sebuleng, idi na luk idi luk baken iamo' Allah.
english: The man said to Jesus, “Teacher, you have answered well. You correctly said that he is the only God and that there is no other God we must worship/obey.

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus nenier idi ieh pangeh, nengor balaNeh dengan ileh, idi Ieh nepebala neneh, "Iko na mado ratnan Imet Allah." Idi na lemulun mekuu' ngitun Neneh peh.
english: Jesus realized that this man had answered wisely. So he said to him, “I perceive that you will soon decide to let God rule your life.” After that, the Jewish leaders were afraid to ask him any more questions like that to try to trap him.

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus nemada' bang Ruma' Allah, Ieh nengitun, "Kudeng apehké guru-guru Ukum mala idi Keristus ineh Anak Daud?
english: Later, while he was teaching in the Temple courtyard, Jesus said to the people, “These men who teach the Jewish laws, ◄they must be wrong when they say that the Messiah is merely a descendant of King David!/why do they say that the Messiah is merely a descendant of King David?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Ngaceku Daud nepebala bang Roh Meligan, 'Tuhan nepebala kuan Tuhanku, Tudo Iko pa tinuehKu, pad Ui nganau' bunu'-bunu'Mu mangun ku tapin kukudMu.'
english: The Holy Spirit caused David himself to say about the Messiah, God said to my Lord, ‘Sit here beside me at the place where I will highly honor you! Sit here while I completely defeat your enemies! MTY’

lun_bawang: Idi bang bada'Neh Yésus nepebala nedeh, "Matar burur muyuh ratnan guru- guru Ukum luk sikal nalan-nalan dengan kuyu' luk mekadang, idi sikal buren lemulun déi' kadai,
english: While Jesus was teaching the people, he said to them, “Beware that you do not act like the men who teach our Jewish laws. They like people to honor them, so they put on long robes and walk around in order to show people how important they are. They also like people to greet them respectfully in the marketplaces.

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nenawar anak-anak sekola'Neh idi nepebala nedeh, "Matu, Ui pebala nemuyuh, decur tinula' luk masi' ini pangeh nenipa meluun ratnan amung-amung lemulun luk nenipa usin bang pati' ineh.
english: He gathered his disciples around him and said to them, “The truth is that these other people have a lot of money, but they gave only a small part of it. But this woman, who is very poor, has put in all the money that she had to pay for the things she needs. So God considers that this poor widow has put more money into the box than all the other people!”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus neremuat rat bang Ruma' Allah idi seburur anak sekola'Neh nepebala Neneh, "O Guru, siruh kudeng apeh do' ayuneh batu-batu idi pudut ini!”
english: While Jesus was leaving the Temple area, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, look at how marvelous these  huge stones in the walls are  and how wonderful these buildings are!”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yésus, "Iko nier amung-amung pudut luk rayeh iniké? Na miak ketecan sebuleng batu luk buun-buun ieni, luk na miak uen ngusag peh.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Yes, these buildings that you are looking at RHQ are wonderful, but I want to tell you something about them. They will soon be destroyed {Foreign invaders will destroy them} completely, with the result that no stone here in this Temple area will be left on top of another stone.”

lun_bawang: "Do' mada' kuan kai, idanké amung-amung ini miak mangun, idi anunké tanu'neh kareb amung-amung ini malé macing?”
english: “Tell us, when will that happen to the buildings of the Temple? Tell us what will happen that will show us that all these things that God has planned are about to be finished {that God is about to finish all these things that he has planned}.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Matar do'-do', pad lemulun na naluk nemuyuh.
english: Jesus replied to them, “I cannot give you a simple answer to your questions. All I will say is, beware that no one deceives you concerning what will happen!

lun_bawang: Kareb muyuh ninger uni lun pebunu' idi bala ratnan pebunu', aleg muyuh megagap, ngaceku na miak na amung-amung ini mangun peh; iamo' nateh ineh kekipedneh.
english: Whenever people tell you about wars that are close or wars that are far away, do not be troubled. God has said that those things must happen. But when they do happen, do not think that God will finish all that he has planned at that time!

lun_bawang: "Iamo' do' muyuh matar do'-do'. Muyuh miak kamen idi iten amé' besara'. Muyuh miak bebalen bang ruma' sembayang. Idi teh muyuh miak tuped pa atun lun luk ngimet bawang idi raca'-raca' teh ngaceku Ui, pad muyuh mada' Bala luk Do' nedeh.
english: Be ready for what people will do to you at that time. Because you believe in me, they will arrest you and put you on trial before the religious councils. ◄In the synagogues/In the Jewish meeting places►, you will be beaten {others will beat you}. You will be put {People will put you} on trial in the presence of high government authorities. As a result, you will be able to tell them about me.

lun_bawang: Idi kinanak miak maré kinanakneh pitayen, idi taman miak maré anakneh, idi anak-anak ineh sikal metueh ratnan taman-tinandeh, idi maré nedeh pitayen.
english: Other evil things will happen: People who do not believe in me will ◄betray/help others seize► their brothers and sisters in order that the government can execute them. Parents will betray their children, and children will betray their parents so that the government will kill their parents.

lun_bawang: "Muyuh miak nier 'Dat luk Ngacing Tot' ineh tuped su luk na petulu." (Idi do' lemulun luk maca' kali' ilungneh!) "Kareb ineh do' lemulun luk ang tana' Yudia buro amé' luun pegkung.
english: During that time the disgusting thing/person that the prophet Daniel described will enter the Temple. It/He will defile the Temple when he enters it and will cause people to abandon it. When you see it/him standing there where it/he should not be, you should run away quickly (May everyone who is reading this pay attention to this warning from Jesus!) At that time those people who are in Judea district must flee to higher hills.

lun_bawang: Matar do'-do'! Ui pangeh nemada' nemuyuh atun ratnan amung-amung ini.
english: the stars will fall from the sky, and all things in the sky will be shaken {God will cause all things in the sky to shake}.

lun_bawang: "Do' muyuh ngalap aceh luk pinginud ratnan lawa gita'. Kareb angatneh mebata', idi donneh pun mua', muyuh kali' kareb melau' pangeh muneng.
english: Keep this in mind: You have observed the things that I have done and said, but all of those events that I have just told you about will happen before all of you will die.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' ratnan aconeh idi karebneh seburur pana' nateh kali, sagan pana' melaikat luk déi' surga, idi Anak ineh pana' nateh kali', iamo' Taman sebuleng mo'.
english: When a man who wants to travel to a distant place is about to leave his house, he tells his servants that they should manage the house. He tells each one what he should do. Then he tells the doorkeeper to be ready for his return.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh mepad kudeng seburur lemulun luk amé' ngarang idi necan ruma'neh bang palad demulunneh. Ieh maré kekamen kuan anid-anid bururdeh, idi periteteng kuan luk matar tanga' ineh, pad ieh matar do'-do'.
english: May it not happen that when I come suddenly, I will find that you are not ready!

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh, "Aleg ngakem Neneh kareb irau, pad na luk idi ria'.”
english: But they were saying to one another, “We must not do it during the celebration, because, if we do it then, the people will be very angry with us and riot!”

lun_bawang: Idi inan lemulun luk megateh nenier neneh, keburi'deh, "Anunké punneh umau luk do' buen ini uenneh nuso mo'?
english: One of the people who were present became angry and said to the others, “◄It is terrible that she wasted that perfume!/Why did she waste that perfume?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Iamo' keburi' Yésus, "Nima neneh, ngudehké muyuh ngesusa' neneh? Ieh nganau' luk do' kuanKu.
english: But Jesus said, “Stop scolding her! She has done to me what I consider to be very appropriate/delightful. So ◄you should not bother her!/why do you bother her?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Bang aco rayeh luk pun-pun ratnan Aco Rayeh Ruti luk Na Lamud, ieh ineh kareb anak duma Paska ineh miak kereten, idi anak-anak sekola'Neh nepebala Neneh, "Iapehké luk pianMu kai amé' nganau' Irau Paska ineh kuanMu?”
english: Two days later, when they killed the lambs for the festival at the beginning of the week when people ate bread that had no yeast in it, Jesus’ disciples said to him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare the meal for the Passover celebration in order that you can eat it with us?”

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nengecuk dueh burur anak sekola'Neh, kebalaNeh, "Amé' medueh bang bawang, idi seburur deléi luk nguit aceh sidangur abpa' miak papu' nemedueh, idi do' amé' maya' neneh,
english: So he chose two of his disciples to prepare everything. He said to them, “Go into Jerusalem city. A man will meet you, who will be carrying a large jar full of water. Follow him.

lun_bawang: macing nan ruma' luk ulekneh. Idi do' medueh ngitun tuan ruma' ineh, 'Keburi' Guru, Iapehké takep luk inanKu miak kuman Irau Paska dengan anak-anak sekola'Ku?'
english: When he enters a house, say to the man who owns the house, ‘Our teacher wants us to prepare the meal of the Passover celebration so that he can eat it with us his disciples. ◄Please show us the room that he arranged with you about./Where is the room that he arranged with you about?► RHQ’

lun_bawang: Idi uned ideh tudo kuman, idi Yésus nepebala, "Ui pebala nemuyuh, seburur rat arang muyuh luk tudo kuman denganKu sikal masui Negku.”
english: As they were all sitting there and eating, Jesus said, “Listen carefully to this: One of you will enable my enemies to seize me. Specifically, it is one of you who will do this in spite of the fact that he is eating with me right now!”

lun_bawang: Idi petacu ideh mesusa' niat idi nepebala sua-sua, "Uiké ieh?”
english: The disciples became very sad and they said to him one by one, “Surely ◄it is not I!/I am not the one, am I?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yésus, Ieh seburur rat arang muyuh luk pulu' dueh, luk ngerereb ruti bang bigan pad-pad denganKu.
english: Then he said to them, “It is one of you twelve disciples, the one who is dipping bread into the sauce in the dish along with me.

lun_bawang: Idi uned ideh kuman, Yésus nengalap ruti idi Ieh nesembayang maré ubur, idi nemuri'-muri' ruti ineh, idi nemaré ineh kuan anak sekola'Neh, kebalaNeh, "Lapen muyuh ini idi kuman, ini bururKu.”
english: While they were eating, he took a flat loaf of bread and thanked God for it. Then he broke it into pieces and gave it to them and said to them, “This bread represents MET my body. Take it and eat it.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Ini dara'Ku, ieh ineh dara' pejani' Allah luk inutang kuan lun mula'.
english: he said to them, “This wine represents MET my blood, which is about to be shed {which is about to flow from my body} when my enemies kill me. With this blood I will sign the agreement that God has made to forgive the sins of many people.

lun_bawang: Yésus nepebala nedeh, "Amung-amung muyuh miak buro necan Negku, ngaceku pangeh inayud, 'Allah miak ngaté Lun Matar dumba, idi amung- amung dumba luk sengeriudan ineh miak mepatad.'
english: While they were on their way, Jesus said to them, “It has been {The prophets have} written in the Scriptures that God said about me, ‘I will kill the shepherd and his sheep will scatter.’ Those words will come true. When they are about to capture me, all of you will leave me and run away.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Pétrus, "Sagan pana' amung-amungdeh necan Namu, iamo' ui na sikal necan Namu.”
english: Then Peter said to him, “Perhaps all the other disciples will leave you, but not I! I will not leave you!”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nepebala neneh, "Ngerawé do'-do', bang aco sini, ieh ineh kareb malem, kareb nateh lal ngekook dueh kua', iko miak ngalum Negku teluh kua'.”
english: Then Jesus said to him, “The truth is that this very night, before the rooster crows a second time, you yourself will deny three times that you know me!”

lun_bawang: Idi Pétrus meluun tueh nepebala, "Sagan pana' ui maté pad-pad denganMu, na tu-tu ui miak ngalum Namu." Kudeng ini teh bala amung-amungdeh.
english: But Peter replied strongly, “Even if they kill me as I defend you, I will never deny that I know you!” And all the other disciples said the same thing.

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh nacing su luk titen Getsémani, idi Yésus nepebala kuan anak- anak sekola'Neh, "Tudo muyuh ieni laba' Ui amé' sembayang.”
english: On the way, Jesus and the disciples came to the place that people call Gethsemane. Then he said to some/eight of his disciples, “Stay here while I pray!”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'Neh nedeh, "Mesusa' tu-tu niatKu, malé maté ayuKu, do' muyuh tudo ieni idi matar do'-do'.”
english: “I SYN am very sorrowful. It is as if I were about to die. You men remain here and stay awake!”

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "Ama', O Ama', luk amung-amung inan bang laludMu, idi do' ngatad sangkir ini rat Negku, iamo' ratnan ineh pana' baken maya' pian Dui, iamo' pian Diko.”
english: He said, “O my Father, because you are able to do everything, rescue me so that I do not have to suffer now MTY! But do not do what I want. Instead, do what you want!”

lun_bawang: Kareb Ieh nelemubed, Ieh nenier nedeh rudap, idi kebalaNeh ni Pétrus, "O Simun, rudapké iko? Naké iko miak matar bang sejam mo' kinioneh?
english: Then he returned and found his disciples sleeping. He woke them up and said, “Simon! ◄I am disappointed that you fell asleep and that you were not able to stay awake for just a short time!/Why is it that you fell asleep and that you were not able to stay awake for just one hour?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Ieh nelemubed seketeluh kua', idi kebalaNeh nedeh, "Rudapké muyuh teh idi ngato erur muyuh? Nekini pangeh petap. Karebneh pangeh nacing. Nekini Anak-Lemulun miak barén bang palad lun mesala'.
english: Then he went and prayed again. He returned a third time; and he found them sleeping again. He woke all of them and said to them, “◄I am disappointed that you are sleeping again!/Why are you sleeping again?► RHQ You have slept enough. The time for me to suffer is about to begin. Look! Someone is about to enable sinful men to seize me, the one who came from heaven.

lun_bawang: Idi lemulun luk nemasui Yésus ineh pangeh nemaré tanu' kuandeh, keburi'neh, "Lemulun luk ui muen, Ieh ineh Yésus. Do' muyuh ngakem Neneh idi matar Neneh do'-do'.”
english: Judas, who was ◄betraying Jesus/helping Jesus’ enemies to seize him►, had previously told this crowd, “The man whom I kiss is the one whom you want. When I kiss him, seize him and lead him away while you guard him carefully.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yudas macing idi petacu ieh iné' matun Yésus, idi kebalaneh, "O Guru," idi ieh nemuen Neneh.
english: So, when Judas arrived, he immediately went to Jesus and said, “My teacher!” Then he kissed Jesus on his neck/cheek.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Petuluké muyuh macing dengan pelapet idi kayuh pad ngakem Negku?
english: Jesus said to them, “◄It is ridiculous that you come here to seize me with swords and clubs, as if I were a bandit!/Have you come here to seize me with swords and clubs, as if I were a bandit RHQ?► Day after day I was with you in the Temple courtyard teaching the people Why did you not seize me then? But this is happening in order that what the prophets have written in the Scriptures about me may be fulfilled {may happen}.”

lun_bawang: "Kai pangeh neninger lemulun ini pebala, 'Ui sikal ngusag Ruma' Allah ini, luk pinudut lemulun, idi bang teluh aco Ui miak mudut Ruma' Allah luk baken ruen lemulun.' “
english: But, what some of these men said also did not agree with what others of them said.

lun_bawang: Idi Imam Rayeh ineh netuped arang uneddeh, idi nengitun Yésus, "Naké Iko ngor adu'deh amu?”
english: But Jesus was silent and did not reply DOU. Then the supreme priest tried again. He asked him, “Are you the Messiah? Do you say that you are ◄the Son of God/the man who is also God►?”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus pirud, idi na Ieh nengor sebila' bala pana'. Idi sekua' teh Imam Rayeh ineh nengitun Neneh, "Matuké Iko Keristus, Anak Allah luk buren ineh?”
english: Jesus said, “I am. Furthermore, you will see me, the one who came from heaven, ruling beside God, who is completely powerful. You will also see me coming down through the clouds in the sky!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Ui ini Ieh, idi muyuh miak nier Anak-Lemulun tudo pa tinueh Luk Meluun Lalud, idi macing dengan laput luk rat déi' langit.”
english: In response to Jesus’ words, the supreme priest tore his outer garment. That was their custom to show that he was shocked that Jesus had said that he was equal to God. Then he said, “We certainly do not RHQ need any more people who will testify against this man,

lun_bawang: Idi Imam Rayeh ineh pana' nenarak ayungneh idi nepebala, "Na ulekneh tau nakap luk nekali' peh?
english: because you have heard what he said against God! He claimed to be equal with God Therefore, what have you decided?” They all said that Jesus was guilty and deserved ◄to be executed/that they should kill him►.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengimun ngelica' Neneh, idi ideh nengakeb kiungNeh, idi nemukut Neneh, kebaladeh, "Do' Iko mada' idé luk mukut Namu!" Idi lun pulis ineh pana' nengakem Neneh Idi nemepag kiungNeh.
english: While Peter was outside in the courtyard of the supreme priest’s house, one of the girls who worked for the supreme priest came near him.

lun_bawang: Kareb ieh nenier Pétrus singidu, idi ieh pana' nenutong neneh idi nepebala, "Iko ini teh luk dengan Yésus lun Nasarét ineh.”
english: But he denied it by saying, “I do not know or understand DOU what you are talking about!” Then he went away from there to the gate of the courtyard.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Pétrus pana' nengena idi nepebala, "Na kali'ku ilung balamu ineh." Kareb ieh neremuat iné' munung tanga', idi lal pana' nengekook.
english: The  servant girl saw him there and said to the people who were standing nearby, “This man is one of those who have been with that man they arrested.”

lun_bawang: Idi anak adi' decur ineh nenier neneh teh idi nepebala nelun luk netuped déi', "Ieh ini teh seburur rat arangdeh ineh.”
english: But he denied it again. After a little while, one of those who were standing there said to Peter again, “The way you speak shows that you also are from Galilee district. So it is certain that you are one of those who accompanied Jesus!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Pétrus nengena teh. Segageh teh idi keburi' lemulun luk tuped déi' kuan Pétrus, "Matu iko seburur rat arangdeh ineh, ngaceku iko seburur lun Galilia teh.”
english: But he began to exclaim, “I do not know the man that you are talking about! Because God knows that I am speaking truthfully, may he punish me if I am lying!”

lun_bawang: Idi Pétrus nepebulung, keburi'neh, "Na tu ui miti lemulun luk belén muyuh ineh.”
english: Immediately the rooster crowed a second time. Then Peter remembered what Jesus had said to him before, “Before the rooster crows a second time, you will deny three times that you know me.” When he realized that he had denied it three times, he started crying.

lun_bawang: Idi Pilatus nengitun Neneh, "Ikoké Raca' lun Yahudi?" Idi kebala Yésus, "Kudeng luk bilamu.”
english: Pilate asked Jesus, “Do you claim to be the king of the Jews?” Jesus answered him, “You yourself have said so.”

lun_bawang: Idi Pilatus nengitun Neneh teh, keburi'neh, "Naké Iko pian ngor sekua' pana'? Do' ngerawé inan mula' tu-tu adu'deh Namu.”
english: So Pilate asked him again, “Don’t you have anything to say? Listen to how many bad things they are saying that you have done!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Pilatus nedeh, "Sikalké muyuh ui muit Raca' lun Yahudi ineh kuan muyuh?”
english: Pilate answered them, “Would you like me to release for you the man whom you Jewish people say is your king?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Pilatus nelun mula'. "Anunké luk ruenku kuan lemulun luk bila muyuh Raca' lun Yahudi ineh?”
english: Pilate said to them again, “If I release Barabbas, what do you want me to do with the man whom some of you Jews say is your king?”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengitang teh, "Nalib Neneh!”
english: Then they shouted again, “Command that your soldiers crucify him!”

lun_bawang: Idi Pilatus nepebala kuandeh, "Ngudeh, sala' anunké luk pangeh inau'Neh?" Idi meluun metueh ideh nengitang, "Nalib Neneh!”
english: Then Pilate said to them, “Why? What crime has he committed?” But they shouted even louder, “Command your soldiers to crucify him!”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nemaré tabi' kuanNeh, keburi'deh, "Tabi' Raca' lun Yahudi!”
english: Then they greeted him like they would greet a king, in order to ridicule him, saying, “Hooray for the King who rules the Jews!”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nenguit Yésus amé' déi' Golguta, luk ilungneh, Su luk inan Perupuk Uluh.
english: They brought them both to a place that they call Golgotha. That name means, ‘a place like a skull’.

lun_bawang: Idi surat luk nengadu' Neneh pangeh inayud pa luunNeh, ieh ineh, "Raca' lun Yahudi.”
english: They attached to the cross above Jesus’ head a sign on which it had been written {someone had written} the reason why they were nailing him to the cross. But all that it said was, “The King of the Jews.”

lun_bawang: Kudeng ineh luk pangeh mangun luk bila bang Surat Allah, keburi'neh, "Ieh inukum pad-pad dengan lemulun luk dat.”
english: The people who were passing by insulted him by shaking their heads as if here were an evil man. They said, “Aha! You said that you would destroy the Temple and then you would build it again within three days.

lun_bawang: Lemulun luk lemaba nenguyo Neneh idi uluhdeh tuka'-tuka', keburi'deh, "Neh! Iko luk ngusag Ruma' Allah idi mudut neneh bang teluh aco kinioneh!
english: If you could do that, then rescue yourself by coming down from the cross!”

lun_bawang: Kudeng ineh teh imam-imam rayeh idi guru-guru Ukum nesitunga Neneh, keburi'deh seburur dengan seburur, "Ieh nengulun lun baken, iamo' na Ieh melalud ngulun bururNeh sebuleng!
english: He said, ‘I am the Messiah, I am the King who rules the people of Israel.’ If his words are true, he should come down now from the cross! Then we will believe him!” The two men who were crucified beside him also insulted him.

lun_bawang: Kareb tangal musul aco, idi Yésus nengitang, kebalaNeh, "Eloi, Eloi lema sabaktani?" luk ilungneh, "AllahKu, AllahKu, anunké punneh Iko necan Negku?”
english: When some of the people who were standing there heard the word ‘Eloi’, misunderstanding it, they said, “Listen! He is calling for the prophet Elijah!”

lun_bawang: Idi sebuang lemulun luk tuped déi' neninger tangNeh, idi ideh nepebala, "Ninger, Ieh nawar Elia.”
english: One of them ran and filled a sponge with sour wine. He placed it on the tip of a reed, and then he held it up for Jesus to suck out the wine that was in it. While he was doing that, someone said, “Wait! Let’s see whether Elijah will come to take him down from the cross!”

lun_bawang: Idi sebururdeh, nupun nguit lemut batu, idi ngerereb neneh bang abpa' luk malam. Idi ieh nenganau' ineh nan paped kayuh, idi nemaré ineh luun bibir Yésus, keburi'neh, "Aganeh, do' tau nier kudeng Elia sikal amé' nurun Neneh.”
english: And then, after Jesus shouted loudly, he stopped breathing and died.

lun_bawang: Kareb lun rayeh lun pebunu' luk netuped pa atun salib ineh nenier kudeng apeh lawé Yésus naté, idi ieh nepebala, "Matu lemulun ini Anak Allah.”
english: There were also some women there, watching these events from a distance. They had accompanied Jesus when he was in Galilee district, and they had provided what he needed. They had come with him to Jerusalem. Among those women was Mary from Magdala town. There was another Mary, who was the mother of the younger James and of Joses. There was also Salome.

lun_bawang: -4Idi ideh nepebala arangdeh sebuleng, "Idéké luk miak ngedengan netau ngelubid batu ineh rat munung tanem ineh?" Ngaceku batu ineh pelaba rayeh. Idi ideh nenier batu ineh pangeh linubid.
english: While they were going there, they were saying to each other, “Who will roll away for us the stone that blocks the entrance of the tomb?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' anak adi' ineh nedeh, "Aleg matot! Muyuh nakap Yésus lun Nasarét luk pangeh sinalib ineh. Na Ieh idi tungé' — Ieh pangeh netumui. Siruh, su luk inandeh nengerareng Neneh.
english: The young man said to them, “Do not be astonished! I know that you are looking for Jesus, the man from Nazareth, who was nailed to a cross {whom they nailed to a cross}. But he has become alive again! He is not here! Look! Here is the place where they placed his body.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh, "Do' muyuh amé' aput-aput tana' idi mada' Bala luk Do' ini kuan amung-amung lemulun.
english: Later he said to them, “Go into the whole world and preach the good message to everyone!

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala melaikat neneh, "Aleg matot, O Sekaria, Allah pangeh neninger putuhmu, idi awanmu Elisabet ineh miak nenganak aceh anak deléi kuanmu. Idi do' iko nganau' ngadanneh Yahya.
english: He will cause you to be very happy, and many other people will also be happy because he is born.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Sekaria kuan melaikat ineh, "Kudeng apehké ui miak kali' kudeng ini matu? Ngaceku ui mengered, idi awanku pana' pelaba ngered teh.”
english: Then the angel said to him, “I am God’s chief angel, Gabriel! I do what God tells me, because I constantly am in God’s presence! I was sent {He sent me} to tell you (sg) something good that is going to happen to you.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala melaikat neneh, "Ui ini Gabriel luk tuped pa kiung Allah. Ui pangeh icuk pebala namu idi ngacing bala luk do' ini.
english: What I have told you will certainly happen at the time God decides, but you did not believe what I told you. So now God will make you will be unable to talk until the day your son is born”!

lun_bawang: "Nekini Tuhan pangeh nengedengan negku kudeng ini. Ieh pangeh nenala' igu'ku pa kiung lemulun.”
english: When Elizabeth had been pregnant EUP for almost six months, the angel Gabriel was sent by God {God sent the angel Gabriel} again.

lun_bawang: Melaikat ineh iné' neneh, kebalaneh, "Awang kuanmu! Tuhan idi denganmu, idi pangeh nengeperuan namu.”
english: But Mary was very confused when she heard that. She wondered what the angel meant by these words.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala melaikat neneh, "O Mariam, aleg matot! Iko pangeh nengalap katu ratnan Allah.
english: You will become pregnant and bear a son, and you must name him Jesus.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Mariam nan melaikat ineh, "Kudeng apehké amung ini miak mangun, ngaceku ui nateh nekali' deléi'?”
english: The angel replied, “The Holy Spirit will come to you; the power of God MTY/EUP will overshadow you and enable you to become pregnant. So the child you will bear will be completely set apart {give himself completely} to obey God, and he will be called {people will say that he is} ◄the Son of God/the man who is also God►.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala melaikat ineh, "Roh Meligan miak temurun luunmu, idi lalud Allah miak nucung namu. Ngaceku ineh anak luk meligan ineh miak tetanen Anak Allah.
english: I also need to tell you something else. Your cousin Elizabeth is very old, and it was thought {people said} that she could not bear any children. But she has been pregnant EUP for almost six months, and will bear a son!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Mariam neneh, "Ui ini demulun Tuhan; do' nganau' kuanku maya' kudeng luk bilamu." Idi melaikat ineh neburo rat iringneh.
english: Very soon after that, Mary got ready and went quickly to a town in the highlands of Judea district where Zechariah lived.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengitang kebalaneh, "Iko luk inan samal rat arang amung-amung decur, idi samal kuan anak luk uenmu nenganak ineh.
english: ◄I am not worthy that God would allow you to visit me!/Why is God allowing you to visit me?► RHQ You will be the mother of my Lord!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Mariam, "Niatku ngerayeh Tuhan,
english: I am happy because God is the one who saves me.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala tinanneh, "Na! Ngadanneh Yahya.”
english: Then they made motions with their hands to Zechariah, for him to indicate what name he wanted to be given {to give} to his son.

lun_bawang: Iamo' keburi'deh neneh, "Na luk idi seburur pana' rat arang pupumu luk kudeng ini ngadan!”

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku na luk idi lawa kayuh luk do', luk ngeruat bua' luk dat, idi lawa kayuh luk dat, luk ngeruat bu'a luk do'.

english: “Because people should obey what their masters tell them, ◄it is disgraceful that you say that I am your master but you do not do what I tell you!/why do you say that I am your master but you do not do what I tell you?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Ideh nacing inan Yésus, idi ideh nemutuh tu-tu Neneh, keburi'deh, "Mayu ieh ruenMu ngedengan.

english: When the officer’s friends arrived and told that to Jesus, he marveled at what the officer had said. Then he turned and said to the crowd that was going with him, “I tell you, I have never before found anyone who trusted in me like this non-Jewish man does. lun_bawang: Kareb Tuhan nenier decur ineh, idi Ieh méi' neneh, kebalaNeh, "Aleg iko nangi'.”

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh iné ngakem lungun ineh, idi lemulun luk nemirir ineh nugka'. Idi kebala Yésus, "O anak adi', Ui pebala namu, do' iko tumui!”
english: Then, ignoring the Jewish laws about not coming near a corpse, he came close and touched the stretcher on which the body was lying. So the men carrying it stood still. He said, “Young man, I say to you, get up!”

lun_bawang: Idi lun mula' ineh pelaba tot idi nengerayeh Allah, keburi'deh, "Aceh nabi luk rayeh pangeh nacing arang tau," idi "Allah pangeh nengikak pupuNeh.”
english: Then everyone there was amazed/awestruck. They praised God, saying, “A great prophet has come among us!” They also said, “God has come to help his people!”

lun_bawang: Kareb didueh nacing inan Yésus idi didueh nepebala, "Yahya luk Ngerereb nengecuk nekai amé' inan Tuhan idi ngitun, 'Iko iniké Luk miak macing ineh, kian, miak kai nginulat seburur lun baken?' “
english: When those two men came to Jesus, they said, “John the Baptizer sent us to ask you (sg) this: Are you the Messiah that we are expecting God to send, or shall we (exc) expect someone else?”

lun_bawang: Kareb lun duken Yahya ineh nenalan, idi Yésus nengimun pebala kuan lun mula' ratnan Yahya, keburi'Neh, "Anunké luk amé muyuh sira' déi' su luk ali- ali? Selawa bulu'ké luk megio ku bui?
english: When the men whom John had sent left, Jesus began to talk to the crowd of people about John. lun_bawang: Ui pebala nemuyuh, idi rat arang amung-amung lemulun luk tinganak ratnan decur, na luk idi seburur pana' luk meluun rayeh ratnan Yahya, iamo' luk isuut tu bang Imet Allah, ieh ineh luk meluun rayeh rat neneh.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus, "Dengan anunké Ui miak maad inul ini, idi anunké luk mepinud nedeh ineh?
english: Then Jesus also said, “Many of you people have heard what John and I have taught. ◄I will illustrate what you are like./Do you know what many of you people who have heard what John and I have taught are like?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Kareb lun Parisi nenier ineh, idi ieh nepebala bang niatneh, "Kudeng lemulun ini seburur nabi, kali' rungen Ieh kali' idé' decur luk ngakem Neneh ineh, idi Ieh kali' neneh mesala'!”
english: When the Pharisee who had invited Jesus saw that, he thought, “Prophets know about other people’s lives, so if Jesus were a prophet, he would have known who this woman is who is touching him, and what kind of a person she is. He would have known that she is a prostitute! EUP”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nengor balaneh, keburi'Neh, "O Simun, inan luk balénKu namu." Idi keburi' Simun, O Guru, do' mada' negku nekini.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Simon, there is something I want to tell you (sg).” He replied, “Teacher, what is it?”

lun_bawang: "Inan dueh burur lemulun luk pebaleh nan seburur luk nemaré usin kebiten, idi luk kuan seburur baleh limeh ngeratu rigit, idi luk baken limeh ngepulu'.
english: Jesus replied, “Two people owed some money to a man who earned money by lending it to others. One owed him 500 silver coins, and the other owed him 50 silver coins.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Simun, "Ui ngerawé lemulun luk pinuit ratnan baleh luk meluun ula'." Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Matu terawému ineh.”
english: Simon replied, “I think that the one who owed the most money and did not have to pay it back will love him more.” Jesus said to him, “That is correct.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus kuan decur ineh, "Iko pangeh nengalap do' ratnan sala'mu.”
english: Then he said to the woman, “You have been forgiven {I have forgiven you} for your sins.”

lun_bawang: Idi lemulun luk tudo kuman denganNeh nengimun pebala bang niatdeh sebuleng, "Idéké lemulun ini luk miak maré do' ratnan sala' peh?”
english: Then those who were eating with him said among themselves, “◄This man must think that he is God!/Who does this man think that he is RHQ►, saying that he can forgive people for their sins?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nan decur ineh, "Anumu pangeh nengulun namu, nalan iko dengan awang."
english: But Jesus said to the woman, “Because you have trusted PRS in me, God has saved you from the guilt of your sins. May God give you inner peace as you go!”

lun_bawang: "Inan selemulun luk iné ngisak padé pimaraneh; idi kareb ieh nengisak, sebuang padé ineh nebpeh iring dalan, idi ridu'-ridu' lemulun, pad suit-suit nekuman ineh.
english: “A man went out to his field to sow some seeds. As he was scattering them over the soil, some of the seeds fell on the path. Then people walked on those seeds, and birds ate them.

lun_bawang: idi inan teh luk nebpeh luun tana' luk mebaleng, idi mulun pad macing nengeruat bua' meratu ula'neh." Idi kebala Yésus, "Lemulun luk inan lalid miak ninger, do' ieh ninger!”
english: But some of the seeds fell on good soil and grew well. Each seed later produced 100 grains.” Then Jesus called out to them, “If you want to understand MTY this, you must consider carefully what I have just said!”

lun_bawang: Idi anak-anak sekola' Yésus nengitun ilung luk pinginud ini.
english: Jesus’ disciples later asked him about the meaning of the parable he had just told.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Pangeh biré nemuyuh do' kali' bala luk inalum ratnan Imet Allah, iamo' kuan lemulun luk baken ineh dengan luk pinginud, pelé kareb ideh nier, na luk sinierdeh, idi kareb ideh ninger pana' na ideh kali' ilungneh.”
english: He said, “God is revealing to you what he did not reveal before, about how he wants to rule MET over people’s lives. But when I am telling other people about these things, I tell them only in parables. The result will be like a prophet predicted long ago: They will see what I am doing, but will not perceive what it means. They will hear what I am saying, but will not understand it.

lun_bawang: "Idi ini ilung pinginud ineh: idi ilung padé ineh bala Allah.
english: So this is the meaning of that parable: The seeds represent God’s message.

lun_bawang: "Na luk idi seburur pana' luk nutud ilu', idi ngakeb neneh ku gatang, kian ngerareng neneh pa liang bitaran, iamo' ieh ngerareng neneh luun dawan, pad lemulun luk semuet miak nier acang ineh.
english: “After people light a lamp, they do not cover it with a basket or put it under a bed. Instead, they put it on a lampstand, so that those who enter their house can see things from its light MET. Similarly, you must tell God’s truth to others so that they can know what I can do for them.

lun_bawang: Kebala seburur lemulun Neneh, "Tinan idi kinanak-kinanakMu tuped déi' liang sikal papu' Namu.”
english: Someone told him, “Your mother and your younger brothers are standing outside, wanting to see you.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus nedeh, "Tinan idi kinanak-kinanakKu, ieh ineh luk ninger idi maya' bala Allah.”
english: He replied, “Those who hear God’s message and obey it are as dear to me MET as my mother and my brothers.”

lun_bawang: Idi bang seaco Yésus dengan anak-anak sekola'Neh netemaleb bang aceh alud, idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Do' tau guta amé' déi' dipar takung ineh." Idi ideh nenalan.
english: One day Jesus got into a boat with his disciples. He said to them, “Let’s go around to the other side of the lake.” So they started to go.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh iné' matun Yésus, idi nengalat Neneh, keburi'deh, "O Tuhan! O Tuhan! Tau lélé maté." Idi Yésus netumui idi nengagka' barui idi ribut ineh, pad ieh melitong peh.
english: Jesus’ disciples woke him up. They said to him, “Master! Master! We (inc) are going to drown!” He got up and rebuked the wind and told the waves to be calm. The wind immediately  stopped blowing and the waves calmed down. The lake became calm.

They said to each other, “◄What kind of man is this?/This man is not like ordinary men!► RHQ He not only commands people, but when he commands the wind and the water, they also obey him!”

Chains were fastened {They fastened chains} on his hands and shackles on his feet, but he would break the chains and shackles. Then he would be sent away by the demons {the demons would send him away} to some desolate area. When Jesus stepped out of the boat onto the shore, the man saw him. He ran to Jesus and prostrated himself before him. Then Jesus commanded, “You evil spirit, come out of that man!” But it did not leave immediately. Instead, it caused the man to shout very loudly, “Jesus, Son of the great God in heaven, since we (inc) have nothing in common, leave me alone RHQ! I beg you, do not torture me now!”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nengitun neneh, "Idéké ngadanmu?" Idi keburi'neh, "Baweh," ngaceku mula' ada' pangeh nesemuet bang bururneh.
english: The demons kept begging Jesus that he would not command them to go into the deep place where God punishes demons.

lun_bawang: "Muli' iko, idi mada' kudeng apeh rayeh luk inau' Allah kuanmu." Idi lemulun ineh pana' iné', idi nemada' libut-libut bawang ineh, kudeng apeh rayeh luk pangeh inau' Yésus kuanneh.
english: When Jesus and the disciples returned to Capernaum, a crowd of people who had been waiting for him welcomed him.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Idéké luk nengakem Negku?" Idi lun mula' nengena, idi kebala Pétrus, "O Tuhan, lun mula' ngeperi' idi ngerieng Namu!”
english: But Jesus said, “I know that someone deliberately touched me, because my power has healed someone who touched me.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus nepebala, "Inan seburur lemulun pangeh nengakem Negku; ngaceku Ui nekali' sebuleng lalud neremuat rat Negku.”
english: When the woman realized that she could not prevent Jesus (OR, people) from knowing that she was healed, her body began to shake. She was afraid that because she had disobeyed the law that a woman with such a condition should not touch others, Jesus might scold her for doing that. She prostrated herself before Jesus. lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "O anakKu, anumu pangeh nengedo' namu, nalan iko dengan awang.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus neninger bala ineh, idi Ieh nengor neneh, "Aleg matot, manu mo', pad ieh miak mulun.”

lun_bawang: Idi amung-amung lemulun pana' nangi' idi temido neneh; iamo' keburi Yésus, "Aleg nangi', baken ieh naté, iamo' rudap.”
english: The people laughed at him, because they knew that the girl was dead.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus nengimet ticu' anak ineh idi nengitang, kebalaNeh, "O anak decur, tumui iko.”
english: At once her spirit returned to her body and she got up. Jesus immediately said, “Give her something to eat!”

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh nedeh, "Aleg muyuh nguit anun-anun kareb muyuh nalan; rukud pana' na, luk inan balu' pana' na, ruti pana' na, usin pana' na, kuyu' luk dueh pana' na.
english: he said to them, “Do not take things for your journey. Do not take a walking stick or a traveler’s bag or food or money. Do not take ◄an extra shirt/extra clothes►.

english: But Herod said, “It cannot be John who is doing these things, because I commanded my soldiers to cut off his head. So who is this man that I am hearing these things about?” And he kept wanting to see Jesus.

lun_bawang: Iamo' keburi' Yésus nedeh, "Do' muyuh maré nedeh kuman." Idi keburi' anak-anak sekola' ineh, "Na luk idi ruti nekai luk meluun ratnan limeh balad, idi dueh lawid mo'. PianMu kai amé' melih luk kenen kuan amungdeh iniké?”

english: There were about 5,000 men there. He replied to the disciples, “No, just tell the people to sit down. Tell them to sit in groups, with about 50 people in each group.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus nesetau', idi nesembayang, idi anak-anak sekola'Neh iné' Neneh. Idi Ieh nengitun nedeh, keburi'Neh, "Idéké Ui ini, maya' terawé lun mula'?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh Neneh, "Yahya luk Ngerereb." Iamo' inan luk pebala, "Elia." Idi inan teh luk pebala, "Seburur rat arang nabi luk mon pangeh netumui.”
english: They replied, “Some people say that you are John the Baptizer, who has come back to life again. Others say that you are the prophet Elijah, who has returned from heaven as God promised. Others say that you are one of the other prophets who lived long ago, who has come back to life again.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'Neh nedeh, "Iamo' maya' terawé muyuh ini, idéké Ui?" Idi kebala Pétrus Neneh, "Keristus luk ratnan Allah.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh nelun mula', "Idé-idé luk sikal maya' Negku, do' ieh ngalum bururneh idi maan salibneh anid-anid aco, idi maya' Negku.
english: Then he said to all of them, “If any one of you wants to be my disciple, you must not do only what you yourself desire to do. Specifically, you must be willing each day MET to let others hurt you and disgrace you. That is like what is done to criminals who are forced to carry MET crosses to the place where they will be executed. That is what anyone who wants to be my disciple must do.

lun_bawang: Kareb dueh burur lemulun ineh sikal patad rat Neneh, keburi' Pétrus kuan Yésus, "O Guru, do' tau tudo ieni; nima' nekai mudut teluh lepo, sebuleng kuanMu, sebuleng kuan Musa, idi sebuleng kuan Elia." Iamo' na ieh kali' anun luk pangeh bilaneh ineh.

lun_bawang: Inan aceh, tang rat bang laput ineh luk nepebala, "Ini AnakKu luk pinili'. Do' muyuh ninger Neneh.”
english: After God MTY/EUP finished saying that, the three disciples saw that only Jesus was there. They did not tell anyone what they had seen until much later.

lun_bawang: Rat arang lun mula' ineh inan seburur lemulun nengitang, keburi'neh, "O Guru, ui mutuh Namu amé' nier anakku luk deléi; ngaceku ieh luk anak bulengku.
english: At various times an evil spirit suddenly seizes him and causes him to scream. The evil spirit shakes him violently and causes him to foam at the mouth. It does not leave until my child is completely exhausted.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "O inul luk na manu idi luk neraruh ini. Tuda' ioké Ui tudo dengan muyuh idi mekadang niat nemuyuh? Do' nguit anakmu ineh amé' tungé'.”
english: While they were bringing the boy to Jesus, the demon attacked the boy, threw him to the ground, and shook him severely. But Jesus rebuked the evil spirit and healed the boy. Then he returned him to his father’s care.

lun_bawang: "Aleg kelupan luk belénKu nemuyuh, ngaceku Anak-Lemulun miak barén bang palad lemulun.”

lun_bawang: kebalaNeh nedeh, "Idé-idé luk nganak anak luk isuut ini bang ngadanKu, ieh ineh nganak Negku; idi idé-idé luk nganak Negku, ieh ineh nganak Neneh luk nengecuk Negku. Ngaceku luk pelaba isuut rat arang amung-amung muyuh, ieh ineh luk meluun rayeh.”
