lun_bawang: Idi Yahya nepebala, "O Guru, kai pangeh nenier seburur lemulun luk nala' ada' bang ngadanMu; idi kai nemebpeng neneh ngaceku na ieh maya' nekai.”
english: But Jesus said to him and the other disciples, “Do not tell him not to do that! Remember that those who are not opposing you are trying to achieve the same goals that you are!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' keburi' Yésus ni Yahya, idi kuan anak sekola'Neh luk baken, "Aleg mebpeng neneh, ngaceku lemulun luk na sikal metueh rat nemuyuh, ieh ineh lun dengan muyuh.”
english: When it was almost time for God to take Jesus up to heaven, he firmly resolved to go to Jerusalem.

lun_bawang: Kareb anak sekola'Neh Yakub idi Yahya nekali' ratnan ineh, idi kebala didueh, "O Tuhan, pianké Iko kai ngecuk apui temurun rat bang langit pad ngeseb nedeh?”
english: But Jesus turned and rebuked them for saying that.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus nelumi idi nemebpeng nedidueh,
english: So they went to a different village.

lun_bawang: Uned ideh nalan, idi seburur lemulun nepebala Neneh, "Ui sikal maya' Namu pad iapeh luk suetMu.”
english: In order that the man might know what he could expect if he went with Jesus, Jesus said to him, “Foxes have holes in the ground in which to live, and birds have nests, but even though I am the one who came from heaven, I do not have a home where I can sleep!”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yésus neneh, "Bungalé inan lubangdeh, idi suit-suit déi' arang gawa' inan arardeh, iamo' Anak-Lemulun na luk idi luk inan Neh ngerareng uluhNeh.”
english: Jesus told another man, “Come with me!” But the man said, “Lord/Sir, let me go home first. After my father dies I will bury him, and then I will come with you.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus kuan seburur luk baken, "Do' maya' Negku." Iamo' keburi' lemulun ineh, "O Tuhan, nima' negku amé' nanem tamanku atun.”
english: But Jesus said to him, “God considers that those who do not have eternal life are dead MET. Let those people do the work of burying people who die. As for you, go and tell people about how God wants ◄to rule/to have complete control over► people’s lives!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' keburi' Yésus neneh, Nima' lun naté nanem lun dengandeh luk naté; iamo' iko ini amé' mada' Imet Allah.”
english: Someone else said, “Lord, I will come with you and be your disciple, but first let me go home to say goodbye to my relatives.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' selemulun luk baken teh, "Ui sikal maya' Tuhan; iamo' nima' negku muli' amé' mala, "Do' tudo', kuan lun uang ruma'ku.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Anyone who is plowing his field should not look back to see what he has done. He must look forward to what is ahead. Similarly, anyone who continues to be concerned about his family and other things he has left behind is not fit to serve me and tell others about how God wants to rule MTY people’s lives.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh nedeh, "Mula' luk perinien, iamo' pawa' lun luk ngeranih. Do' mutuh ratnan Tuhan luk kuan perinien ineh, pad Ieh ngecuk lemulun amé' ngeranih uli' luk tinibuNeh ineh.
english: He said to them, “The people who are ready to receive my message are like a field of MET grain that is ready for people to harvest {to be harvested}. But there are not many people to bring them to God. So pray and ask the Lord God to send more workers who will gather people together and teach them my message, just like a landowner sends workers into his fields to gather the harvest.

lun_bawang: "Mesusa' kuanmu, O Korasin! Mesusa' kuanmu, O Baitsaida! Ngaceku kudeng kekamen luk melalud pangeh inau' bang bawang Sur idi Sidon, kudeng luk pangeh inau' bang nemedueh, kali' rungen ideh pangeh nuren mon dengan tudo bang abuh idi inayung ku guni.
english: “There will be terrible punishment for you people who live in MTY Chorazin and Bethsaida cities. I did great miracles in your cities to show God’s power, but you did not turn from your sinful behavior. If the miracles that I performed in your cities had been done in Tyre and Sidon cities, the wicked people who lived there would have long ago shown that they were sorry for their sins by sitting on the ground wearing coarse cloth and putting ashes on their heads.

lun_bawang: Tudu' ngepulu' dueh anak sekola' ineh nelemubed dengan mawang niat idi nepebala, "O Tuhan, amung-amung ada' pana' maya' ukum kai bang ngadanMu.”
english: The 72 people whom Jesus appointed went and did as he told them to. When they returned, they were very joyful. They said, “Lord, people did what we(exc) told them to do! Demons also obeyed us when by your (sg) authority MTY we commanded them to leave people!”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yésus nedeh, "Ui nenier Sétan nebpeh mepad kudeng kilep rat bang langit.
english: Jesus replied, “When those demons were obeying you, because God had enabled you to defeat them, it was as though MET I saw Satan fall from heaven as suddenly and quickly as lightning strikes.

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nelumi inan anak-anak sekola'Neh idi nepebala lulem, "Samal kuan muyuh luk nier amung-amung luk siren muyuh.
english: Then when Jesus’ disciples were alone with him, he turned toward them and said, “God is pleased with you SYN who have seen the things that I have done!

lun_bawang: Idi inan seburur guru Ukum netuped sikal nutun Neneh, keburi'neh, "O Guru, anunké luk ruenku, pelé ui miak ngalap ulun luk meruked?”
english: One day as Jesus was teaching people, a man was there who had studied carefully the laws that God gave Moses. He wanted to ask Jesus a difficult question. So he stood up and asked, “Teacher, what shall I do in order to live with God forever?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yésus neneh, "Anunké luk inayud bang Ukum Musa? Kudeng apehké luk bica'mu?”
english: Jesus said to him, “You (sg) have read RHQ what Moses has written in the laws that God gave him. What did Moses write about living forever?”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nepebala, "Do' iko mawa inan Tuhan Allahmu dengan amung-amung niatmu, amung-amung ulunmu, amung-amung tuehmu, idi amung-amung terawému; idi mawa inan lun denganmu mepad kudeng bururmu sebuleng.”
english: The man replied, “He wrote that we (inc) must love the Lord our God. We must show that by what we feel and by what we do and by what we think. He also wrote that we must love people that we come in contact with as much as we love ourselves.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Matu balamu ineh. Nganau' kudeng ini, idi kali' rungen iko miak mulun.”
english: Jesus replied, “You (sg) have answered your question correctly. If you do all that continually, you will live with God forever.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' guru Ukum ineh sikal ngamo bururneh mesiri, idi keburi'neh kuan Yésus, "Idéké lun denganku ineh?”
english: But the man wanted to defend the way he acted toward people that he came in contact with (OR, to defend why he had asked a question that Jesus answered so simply). So he said to Jesus, “Which people that I come in contact with should I love?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Inan selemulun luk netemurun rat Yerusalim amé' Yeriko; idi ieh nepapu' lun mano, idi ideh nengalap ayungneh idi nemebal neneh lélé maté, idi ideh nenalan necan neneh.
english: Jesus replied by telling him this illustration: “A Jewish man was once going down along the road from Jerusalem to Jericho. Bandits attacked him. They took away most of the man’s clothes and everything else that he had, and they beat him until he was almost dead. Then they left him.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala guru Ukum ineh, "Ieh luk nemada' éi' kuanneh." Idi kebala Yésus kuanneh, "Amé' iko, nganau' luk kudeng ineh teh.”
english: The man who studied the Scriptures replied, “The one who acted mercifully toward him.” Jesus said to him, “You (sg) go and act like that toward everyone whom you can help!”

lun_bawang: Marta ineh megagau ku mula' kekamen bang ruma' ineh; idi ieh iné' matun Yésus idi kebalaneh, "O Tuhan, naké Iko ngerawé ratnan kinanakku nima' negku ngakem sebuleng mo'? Ngecuk neneh ngeruyung negku.”
english: But Martha was very much concerned about preparing a meal. She went to Jesus and said, “Lord, ◄you do not seem to care that my sister has left me to prepare everything by myself!/do you not care that my sister has left me to prepare everything by myself?► RHQ Tell her that she should help me!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Marta, Marta, iko mesusa' idi merapang ratnan mula' kekamen;
english: But the Lord replied, “Martha, Martha, you (sg) are very worried about many things.

lun_bawang: Idi bang seaco Yésus nesembayang su luk inanNeh sembayang. Kareb Ieh nugka', idi seburur anak sekola'Neh nepebala Neneh, "O Tuhan, mada' nekai ratnan sembayang, mepad kudeng Yahya nemada' anak sekola'neh.”
english: One day Jesus was somewhere praying. When he finished praying, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us what to say when we (exc) pray, as John the Baptizer taught his disciples!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Kareb muyuh sembayang, do' muyuh mala, 'O Ama' luk bang surga: Do' ngadanMu uen ngerayeh; idi ImetMu uen ngacing bang tana'.
english: He said to them, “When you pray, say things like this: ‘Father, we want you (sg) MTY to be honored/revered. We want people to let you(sg) MTY, MET rule over their lives.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nan anak-anak sekola'Neh, "Idéké rat arang muyuh luk inan aceh lun rurum, idi amé' neneh kareb tangal dacem idi pebala neneh, 'O lun rurum, maré teluh balad ruti kebitenku;
english: Then he said to them, “Suppose that one of you goes to the house of a friend at midnight. Suppose that you (sg) stand outside and call out to him, ‘My friend, please lend me three buns!

lun_bawang: Idi Ui pebala nemuyuh teh: Do' mutuh, idi miak barén nemuyuh; do' nakap, idi muyuh miak ngalap; nateg tanga', idi tanga' miak kabin kuan muyuh.
english: So I tell you this: Keep asking God for what you need. If you do that, he will give it to you (pl). Confidently keep expecting God to give you the things that you need, and he will give them to you MET. It will be like looking for what you need and finding it. Keep on praying urgently to God. Then God will answer you. It will be like knocking on a door so that God will open the way for you to get what you pray for.

lun_bawang: Taman sapehké rat arang muyuh, kudeng anakneh mutuh ruti, ieh maré batu kuanneh? Idi kudeng ieh mutuh lawid, ieh maré menipeh?
english: If one of you had a son who asked you (sg) for a fish to eat, ◄you (sg) certainly would not give him a poisonous snake instead!/would you give him a poisonous snake instead?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Iamo' inan tuda'-tuda' lemulun rat arangdeh nepebala, "Lemulun ini nala' ada' dengan lalud Balsebul, lun rayeh ada'.”
english: But some of them said, “It is Beelzebub, the ruler of the demons, who enables this man to expel demons!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus nekali' terawédeh, idi kebalaNeh nedeh, "Anid-anid bawang luk sikal metueh sebuleng ratnan sebuleng na miak lutep; idi anid-anid tetek ruma' luk sikal metueh sebuleng ratnan sebuleng miak musag peh.
english: But Jesus knew what they were thinking. So he said to them, “If the people in one nation fight against each other, their nation will be destroyed {they will destroy their nation}. If the people in MTY one house are divided, they will cease to remain as one family.

lun_bawang: "Kareb lemulun luk metueh pangeh netemina' ku ayung pebunu' matar ruma'neh sebuleng, idi amung-amung binawehneh miak uen ngasa'.
english: Then, to show that by expelling evil spirits he was making it clear that he was much more powerful than Satan, Jesus said MET, “When a strong man who has many weapons guards his own house, no one can steal the things in his house.

lun_bawang: "Lemulun luk na perurum Negku, ieh ineh sikal metueh rat Negku; idi lemulun luk na ngedengan Negku ngamung, ieh ineh luk ngatad.”
english: No one can be neutral. Those who do not help me are opposing me, and those who do not gather people to become my disciples are causing those people to go away from me.”

lun_bawang: Pangeh Yésus nepebala kudeng ineh, idi seburur decur luk arang lun mula' nengitang, keburi'neh Neneh, "Samal kuan batek luk nemali' Namu, idi iti' luk neniti' Namu!”
english: When Jesus said that, a woman who was listening called out to him, “God is pleased with the woman who gave birth to you (sg) and let you nurse at her breasts!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus, "Meluun teh, samal kuan lemulun luk ninger bala Allah idi ngimet neneh.”
english: But he replied, “God is much more pleased with those who hear his message and obey it!”

lun_bawang: Kareb lun mula' nepamung Neneh, idi Yésus nepebala kudeng ini, "Inul ini pelaba dat. Ideh nakap aceh tanu', iamo' na miak barén kuandeh tanu' luk baken, iamo' tanu' Nabi Yunus mo'.
english: When the group of people around Jesus got larger, he said, “Many of you people who have been observing my ministry are evil. You want me to perform a miracle to prove that I have come from God, but the only miracle that I will perform for you is one like happened to Jonah.

lun_bawang: "Na luk idi seburur pana' luk nutud ilu', idi ngapung ineh, idi ngakeb neneh ku gatang, iamo' ieh nganau' neneh luun dawan, pad lemulun luk semuet miak nier acang ineh.
english: Then, to show them that they did not need more miracles, but that they needed only to understand better what he had already told them, he said to them MET, “People who light a lamp do not then hide it, or put it under a basket. Instead, they put it on a lampstand so that those who enter their house can see things from its light. Similarly, I have not concealed God’s truth. I have revealed it to you.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "O muyuh lun Parisi, luk maru' luun sangkir idi bigan, iamo' niat muyuh mepanu' ku pano' idi luk dat.
english: The Lord Jesus said to him, “You Pharisees are concerned about things that are outside your bodies, not with what is in your ◄inner beings/hearts► MET. You wash the outside of cups and dishes before you eat because you think that doing that will make you acceptable to God, but within yourselves you are very greedy and wicked.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala seburur guru Ukum Neneh, "O Guru, dengan bala luk kudeng ineh Iko ngedat nekai teh.”
english: One of those who taught the Jewish laws replied, “Teacher, by saying this you (sg) are criticizing us also!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Mesusa' kuan muyuh teh, O guru-guru Ukum! Muyuh ngerareng pa luun lemulun babeh luk meberat idi luk mikat baben, iamo' muyuh sebuleng dengan sebuleng bua' ticu' muyuh pana' na sikal ngakem babeh ineh.
english: Jesus said, “It will be terrible also for you who teach the Jewish laws! You require people to obey many rules that are difficult to obey MET. That is like making them carry heavy burdens on their backs. But you yourselves do not obey the laws that you require others to obey. (OR, you do not do anything to help others to obey the laws.)

lun_bawang: Kareb tuda'-tuda' ngeribu lemulun nepamung, padideh meradu' seburur dengan lun baken, idi Yésus nepebala kuan anak-anak sekola'Neh atun, "Matar burur muyuh ratnan lamud lun Parisi, ieh ineh siayu.
english: While they were doing that, many thousands of people gathered around Jesus. There were so many that they were stepping on each other. Then Jesus said to his disciples, “Beware of becoming hypocrites like the Pharisees. Their evil influence MET spreads to others like yeast spreads its influence in dough.

lun_bawang: "Ui pebala nemuyuh, O Lun rurumKu, aleg matot nedeh luk ngaté burur mo', idi muci sebuleng pana' na miak ruendeh teh.
english: “My friends, listen carefully. Do not be afraid of people who are able to kill you, but after they kill you, there is nothing more that they can do to hurt you.

lun_bawang: "Bakenké suit pirit pisuen lemulun limeh buleng dueh sin? Idi pa kiung Allah sebuleng pana' na miak mekelupan.
english: Think about the sparrows. They are worth so little  that you can RHQ buy five of them for only two small coins. But not one of them is ever forgotten by God {God never forgets one of them}!

lun_bawang: "Ui pebala nemuyuh, anid-anid lemulun luk ngamo Negku pa kiung lemulun, idi Anak-Lemulun pana' sikal ngamo neneh pa kiung melaikat-melaikat Allah.
english: I want to tell you also that if people, without being afraid, are willing to tell others that they are my disciples, I, the one who came from heaven, will acknowledge before God that they are my disciples. I will do that while God’s angels listen.

lun_bawang: Inan seburur rat arang lun mula' ineh nepebala Neneh, "O Guru, do' ngecuk kinanakku mabpet binaweh luk tican taman kai kuan kai.”
english: Then one of the people in the crowd said to Jesus, “Teacher, tell my older brother to divide my father’s property and give me the part that belongs to me!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus neneh, "O Aca', idéké luk nenganau' Negku mangun ku lun luk mutut besara' idi lun mabpat binaweh muyuh?”
english: But Jesus replied to him, “Man, ◄no one appointed me in order that I would settle matters when people are disputing about property!/did anyone appoint me in order that I would settle matters when people are disputing about property?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebalaNeh nedeh, "Ngerawé do'-do', matar burur muyuh ratnan amung-amung lili, ngaceku ulun lemulun luk matu na macing ratnan ula' binawehneh, sagan tu pana' ieh lun do'.”
english: Then he said to the whole crowd, “Guard yourselves very carefully, in order that you do not desire other people’s things in any way! No one can make his life secure by obtaining many possessions.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nemada' aceh luk pinginud kuandeh, keburi'Neh, "Inan aceh tana' seburur lun do' luk nengeruat mula' bua'.
english: Then Jesus told the people this illustration: “There was a certain rich man whose crops grew very well.

lun_bawang: Idi ui sikal pebala kuan bururku sebuleng, Samal kuanmu! Iko inan mula' binaweh dinug kuan tuda'-tuda' lak. Do' ngato erurmu, kuman, ngirup, idi ngalap mawang niat.'
english: Then I will say to myself SYN, “Now I have plenty of goods stored up. They will last for many years. So now I will take life easy. I will eat and drink all that I want to and be happy for a long time!”’

lun_bawang: Iamo' Allah nepebala neneh, 'O bacé! Malem ini teh ulunmu miak lapen rat namu; idéké luk ngalap amung binaweh luk dinugmu ineh?”
english: But God said to him, ‘You foolish man! Tonight you will die! ◄Then all the goods you have saved up for yourself will belong to someone else, not to you!/Do you think that you will benefit from all that you have stored up for yourself?► RHQ’”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus kuan anak-anak sekola'Neh, "Ngaceku ineh Ui pebala nemuyuh, Aleg merapang ratnan ulun muyuh ieh ineh anunké luk miak kenen muyuh; idi ratnan burur muyuh, ieh ineh anunké luk miak iungen muyuh.
english: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “So I want to tell you this: Do not worry about things you need in order to live. Do not worry about whether you will have enough food to eat or enough clothes to wear.

lun_bawang: Idi aleg megagau ratnan luk kenen, idi luk rupen muyuh, idi aleg muyuh merapang.
english: Do not always be concerned about having enough to eat and drink, and do not be worrying about those things.

lun_bawang: "Aleg matot, O sengeriudan dumba luk isuut ini, ngaceku Taman muyuh pian maré Imet ineh nemuyuh.
english: You who are my disciples are like a small flock of sheep, and I am like your shepherd. So you should not be afraid. Your Father in heaven wants to let you rule with him in heaven.

lun_bawang: "Do' awa' muyuh uen ngabet idi lapung muyuh mebudung;
english: “Be always ready for doing God’s work MET, like people who have put on their work clothes and are ready during the day, with their lamps burning all night.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Pétrus, "O Tuhan, Iko mada' luk pinginud ini kuan kaiké, kian kuan amung-amung lemulun lek?”
english: Peter said, “Lord, are you (sg) speaking this illustration only for us or for everyone else also?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan, "Idéké demulun luk lutep idi mileh, luk ruen tuanneh ngecuk matar uang ruma'neh, pad mabpat luk kenendeh bang kareb luk petulu?
english: The Lord replied, “I am saying it for you and for anyone else MET, RHQ who is like a faithful and wise manager in his master’s house. His master appoints him to supervise affairs in his house and to give all the other servants their food at the proper time. Then he leaves on a long trip.

lun_bawang: "Ui nacing pad nganau' apui luun tana' ini; Ui pelaba pian kudeng apui ineh pangeh mebudung!
english: “I came to earth to cause there to be trials MET, which will purify you as fire purifies metal (OR, to cause judgment/divisions among you). I wish that the time when you will be purified {when God will purify you} (OR, when divisions will be caused {to cause divisions among people}) had already begun.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Yésus kuan lun mula', "Kareb muyuh nier inan laput umak pa acep aco, muyuh petacu pebala, 'Udan sikal mebpeh,' idi mangun kudeng ineh teh.
english: He also said to the crowds, “In this country, when you see a dark cloud forming in the west, you immediately say ‘It is going to rain!’ and that is what happens.

lun_bawang: "Ngudehké muyuh na miak mutut luk matu kuan burur muyuh sebuleng?
english: ◄Each of you ought to determine now what is the right thing for you to do, while you still have time to do that!/Why cannot each of you determine what is the right thing for you to do now while you still have time to do that?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Inanké muyuh ngerawé idi lun Galilia ini meluun rayeh sala'deh ratnan sala' amung lun Galilia luk baken ineh, ngaceku ideh pinaté kudeng ineh?
english: Jesus replied to them, “Do you think that this happened to those people from Galilee because they were more sinful than all the other people from Galilee?

lun_bawang: Yésus nemada' kuandeh luk pinginud ini, "Inan selemulun luk inan aceh lawa gita' luk tinibu bang kabun anggurneh. Idi ieh nacing sikal nakap bua' ratnan lawa ineh, iamo' sebuleng pana' nateh luk ilapneh.
english: Then Jesus told them this illustration to show what God would do to the Jews, whom he continually blessed, but who did not do things that please him: “A man planted a fig tree on his farmland. ◄Each year/Many times► he came to it looking for figs, but there were no figs.

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus nenier neneh, idi Ieh nenawar decur ineh, kebalaNeh, "O decur, mepuit iko ratnan étmu ineh.”
english: When Jesus saw her, he called her over to him. He said to her, “Woman, I am freeing you (sg) from your illness!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Tuhan nengor balaneh, keburi'Neh, "O lun luk siayu, bakenké bang Aco luk inan Mudeng anid-anid burur muyuh muit sapi' idi keladaineh rat bang libungneh, sikal nguit neneh amé' ngirup?
english: Then the Lord replied to him, “You (sg) and your fellow religious leaders are hypocrites! ◄On the Sabbath/On our Jewish day of rest►, just like on every other day, ◄each of you unties his ox or donkey, and then leads it from the food trough to where it can drink water./does not each of you untie his ox or donkey, and then lead it from the food trough to where it can drink water?► RHQ That is work, too!

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus, "Anunké luk mepad kudeng Imet Allah, idi dengan anunké miak Ui maad neneh?
english: Then Jesus said, “◄I will tell you how the number of people who let God rule MET their lives will increase./Do you know how the number of people who let God rule MET their lives will increase?► RHQ I will tell you what I can compare it to.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebala Yésus, "Dengan anunké Ui miak maad Imet Allah?
english: Then he said, “I will tell RHQ you something else, to illustrate how the people who let God rule MET their lives can influence their society more and more.

lun_bawang: Idi seburur lemulun nepebala Neneh, "O Tuhan, pawa'ké lemulun luk ngalap ulun?" Idi kebala Yésus nedeh,
english: Someone asked him, “Lord, will there be only a few people who are saved {whom God saves}?” He replied to them, “There will not be many, because the way to heaven MET is like a narrow door.

lun_bawang: "Do' ngekél burur muyuh semuet maya' tanga' luk meperi', ngaceku mula' lemulun luk sikal semuet iamo' na miak.
english: Therefore, try hard to enter that narrow doorway, because I tell you that many people will try to enter heaven by some other way, but they will not be able to get in.

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh teh tuda'-tuda' lun Parisi iné' matun Yésus, idi kebaladeh, "Do' Iko buro rat ieni idi amé' bawang baken, ngaceku Herodés sikal ngaté Namu.”
english: At that very time, some Pharisees came and said to Jesus, “Leave this area, because the ruler Herod Antipas wants to kill you (sg)!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Amé' muyuh mala kuan bungalé ineh, 'Ui nala' ada', idi ngedo' lemulun bang aco sini idi nebpa, idi aco luk keteluh Ui miak mangeh kekamenKu.'
english: He replied to them, “Herod is MET as cruel as a fox, but also as insignificant as a fox. So I do not worry about him. But to show him that no one can harm me until it is the time and place God has determined, go tell him this message from me: ‘Listen! I am expelling demons and performing miracles today, and I will continue doing it for a short time. After that, I will finish my work.

lun_bawang: "O Yerusalim, Yerusalim! Iko nengaté nabi-nabi, idi nemitung lemulun luk icuk amé' namu ku batu! Tuda' kua' Ui sikal ngamung anak-anakmu mepad kudeng aceh tineh lal luk ngerukub anak-anakneh liang iladneh, iamo' na muyuh sikal!

lun_bawang: "Kareb iko darin lemulun amé' ku irau paweh, aleg tudo su luk meluun do', ngaceku kian inan teh lemulun luk meluun buren rat namu darinneh,
english: “When one of you (sg) is invited by someone {someone invites one of you (sg)} to a wedding feast, do not sit in a place where important people sit. Perhaps the man giving the feast has invited a man more important than you (sg).

lun_bawang: Kareb seburur rat arangdeh luk kuman ineh neninger luk kudeng ini, idi ieh nepebala kuan Yésus, "Samal kuan lemulun luk kuman ruti bang Imet Allah.”
english: One of those who were eating with Jesus heard him say that. He said to Jesus, “God has truly blessed us Jews who will eat with the Messiah when he starts to rule!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus neneh, "Inan seburur lemulun nenganau' aceh irau luk rayeh, idi ieh nenawar tuda'-tuda' ula' lemulun.
english: But to show that many Jews whom God had invited would not accept God’s invitation MET, Jesus replied to him, “One time a man decided to prepare a large feast. He invited many people to come.

lun_bawang: Iamo' amung-amungdeh dengan sebuleng niat nemutuh do', keburi' seburur luk pun-pun kuanneh, 'Ui pangeh nemelih tana' idi ui sikal amé' nier neneh, ui mutuh do'.'
english: But when the servant did that, all of the people whom he had invited began to say why they did not want to come. The first man the servant went to said, ‘I have just bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please ask your master to forgive me for not coming!’

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' luk baken, 'Ui pangeh nemelih pulu' sapi', idi ui sikal amé' nutun nedeh, ui mutuh do'.'
english: Another person said, ‘I have just bought five pair of oxen, and I must go to examine them. Please ask your master to forgive me for not coming!’

lun_bawang: Idi seburur luk baken nepebala, 'Ui pangeh nengaweh baruh, ngaceku ineh ui na miak macing.'
english: Another person said, ‘I have just been married. So I cannot come.’

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' demulun ineh kuanneh, 'O tuan, anun luk icukmu ineh ui pangeh nenganau', iamo' inan teh su luk inan ketecan.'
english: After the servant went and did that, he came back and said, ‘Sir, I have done what you (sg) told me to do, but there is still room for more people.’

lun_bawang: Idi kebala tuan ineh kuan demulunneh, 'Remuat iko amé' inan dalan-dalan ratis idi su luk mapet, idi ngubuk lemulun semuet pad ruma'ku mepanu'.
english: So his master said to him, ‘Then go outside the city. Search for people along the highways. Search also along the narrow roads with hedges beside them where homeless people may be staying. Strongly urge the people in those places to come to my house. I want it to be full of people!’”

lun_bawang: "Lemulun luk amé' Negku na miak mangun ku anak sekola'Ku kudeng ieh na megateh inan tamanneh, tinanneh, awanneh, anakneh, kinanakneh luk deléi, kinanakneh luk decur, idi bururneh sebuleng pana'.
english: “If anyone comes to me who loves his father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters more than HYP he loves me, he cannot be my disciple. He must even love me more than he loves his own life!

lun_bawang: "Tucu' ineh do'; iamo' kudeng tucu' ineh metalang, kudeng apehké ieh mepaci' baruh?
english: Jesus also said, “You are like MET salt, which is useful to put on food. But ◄salt certainly cannot be made {you certainly cannot make salt} to taste salty again if it stops tasting salty!/can salt be made {can you make salt} to taste salty again if it quits tasting salty?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi lun Parisi idi guru-guru Ukum ngedureng, kebaladeh, "Lemulun ini nawar lun mesala' idi pamung kuman dengandeh.”
english: The Pharisees and men who taught the Jewish laws who were there SYN began to grumble, saying, “This man welcomes sinners and he also defiles himself by eating with them!”

lun_bawang: "Kudeng seburur lemulun rat arang muyuh inan meratu dumba, idi sebuleng rat arangdeh metutu', naké ieh necan iwa' ngepulu' iwa' dumba bang laman idi amé' nakap luk metutu' ineh pad macing ieh ngalap neneh?
english: “Suppose that one of you had 100 sheep. If one of them were lost, ◄you (sg) would certainly leave the 99 sheep in the pasture, and go and search for the one lost sheep until you found it./would you not leave the 99 sheep in the pasture, and go and search for the one lost sheep until you found it?► RHQ

lun_bawang: "Kudeng seburur decur inan pulu' balad pirak, idi sebalad metutu', anunké luk ruenneh? Ieh nutud lapung idi ngapuh ruma'neh idi nakap do'-do' pad macing ieh ngalap ineh?
english: Or, suppose that a woman has ten very valuable silver coins. If she loses one of them, ◄she will certainly light a lamp and sweep the floor and search carefully until she finds it!/will she not light a lamp and sweep the floor and search carefully until she finds it?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus teh, "Inan selemulun luk inan dueh anak deléi.
english: Then Jesus told them this parable to compare what the Pharisees and teachers of the Jewish law thought about those who turn from their sinful behavior with what God thinks about such people. He said, “A certain man had two sons.

lun_bawang: Ui sikal lemubed amé' inan tamanku idi pebala neneh, O Ama', ui pangeh nenganau' sala' pa kiung Allah idi pa kiungmu pana'.
english: So I will leave here and go back to my father. I will say to him, “Father, I have sinned against God MTY, EUP and against you (sg).

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nenalan idi iné' inan tamanneh. "Iamo' kareb ieh mado, tamanneh pangeh nekali' neneh, idi niatneh sigio ngaceku méi' neneh, idi tamanneh nupun nengapel dierneh idi nemuen neneh.
english: So he left there and went back to his father’s house. But while he was still some distance from the house, his father saw him. He pitied him. He ran to his son and embraced him and kissed him on the cheek.

lun_bawang: Iamo' tamanneh nenawar demulun-demulunneh, kebalaneh, 'Do' nguit dengan mesaget kuyu' buyor luk do' tu-tu idi ngayung neneh, idi ngebpul aceh susing luun bua' ticu'neh idi kasut luun kukudneh.
english: But his father said to his servants, ‘Go quickly and bring to me the best robe in the house! Then put it on my son. Put a ring on his finger to show that I am honoring him again as my son! Put sandals on his feet to show that I do not consider him to be a slave!

lun_bawang: "Idi anakneh luk rayeh ineh déi' lati'. Kareb ieh muli' idi muneng ku ruma' ineh, idi ieh neninger uni suling idi lun ngalai.
english: While all that was happening, the man’s older son was out working in the field. When he came near to the house, he heard people playing music and dancing.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala tamanneh, 'O anakku, iko megéi' idi denganku, idi amung-amung babpatku ineh mangun ku babpatmu.
english: But his father said to him, ‘My son, you have always been with me, and all my property that I did not give to your brother has been yours.

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus kuan anak-anak sekola' ineh, "Inan seburur lun do' luk inan selemulun luk ngasa' binawehneh; idi lemulun ineh inadu' lun baken inan tuanneh ngaceku nengebura' binaweh tuanneh.
english: Jesus also said to his disciples, “Once there was a rich man who had a household manager. One day he was told {someone told him} that the manager was managing the rich man’s money badly.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' lun luk ngasa' binawehneh ineh bang niatneh, 'Anunké luk miak ruenku? Ngaceku tuanku nala' negku ratnan kekamen ngasa' binaweh ini? Idi ngukat tana' ui na metueh, idi mutuh usin mo'-mo' pana' ui migu'.
english: Then the manager thought to himself, ‘My master is going to fire me, so ◄I do not know what to do./what shall I do RHQ?► I am not strong enough to work by digging ditches, and I am ashamed to beg for money.’

lun_bawang: Idi tuanneh ineh pana' nengubur lun luk ngasa' binawehneh luk na matu ineh, ngaceku ratnan luk inau'neh ineh dengan ilehneh; ngaceku anak-anak tana' ini meluun ileh ratnan anak-anak acang.”
english: When his master heard what the manager had done, he admired the dishonest manager for the clever thing he had done. The truth is that the ungodly people in this world act more wisely toward other people than godly people MET act.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus nedeh, "Muyuh luk ngatu burur muyuh sebuleng pa kiung lemulun, iamo' Allah kali' niat muyuh; ngaceku anun-anun luk siren medita' pa kiung lemulun, na ulekneh pa kiung Allah.
english: But he said to them, “You try to make other people think that you are righteous, but God knows your ◄inner beings/hearts►. So he will reject you. Keep in mind that many things that people think are important, God thinks are detestable.

lun_bawang: "Ukum Musa ineh idi surat nabi-nabi lutep pad macing kareb Yahya; idi rat kareb ineh pana' Imet Allah bida' peh, idi anid-anid lemulun singaro semuet bang ineh.
english: The laws that God gave Moses and what the prophets MTY wrote were ◄in effect/what you needed to obey► until John the Baptizer came. Since then I have been preaching about how God wants to rule people’s lives in a new way, and many people are accepting that message and very eagerly asking God to control their lives. But that does not mean that God has abolished the laws that he established previously.

lun_bawang: "Idé-idé luk ngelagkan awanneh, idi ngaweh lun baken teh, ieh pasét peh; idi lemulun luk ngaweh decur luk ligkan deléi ineh idi ieh pana' pasét teh.
english: For example, because God considers that a marriage lasts until either the husband or the wife dies, he considers that any man who divorces his wife and marries another woman is committing adultery. He also considers that any man who marries a woman who has been divorced by her husband {whose husband has divorced her} is also committing adultery.”

lun_bawang: "Inan seburur lun do'; idi ieh ngayung ku kibung luk sia' merirem idi kibung luk mesalud, idi mulun dengan do' anid-anid aco.
english: Jesus also said MET, “Once there was a rich man who wore expensive purple linen garments. He ate luxuriously every day.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Ibrahim, 'O anakku, do' ngerawé, iko pangeh nengalap luk do' kareb iko mulun, idi Lasarus ini nengalap dereh; iamo' nekini ieh inubuk peh, iamo' iko pidereh peh.
english: But Abraham replied, ‘Son, remember that while you (sg) were alive on earth you enjoyed many good things. But Lazarus was miserable. Now it is fair that he is happy here, and you are suffering.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' lun do' ineh, 'Ngaceku ineh, ui mutuh namu ngecuk neneh amé' ruma' tamanku,
english: Then the rich man said, ‘If that is so, father Abraham, I ask you (sg) to send Lazarus to my father’s house.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Ibrahim, 'Ideh inan surat Musa idi nabi-nabi pana', do' ideh maya' ineh.'
english: But Abraham replied, ‘No, I will not do that, because your brothers are able to go to the Jewish meeting places where the priests read what Moses and the prophets wrote. They should listen to what Moses and the prophets MTY wrote!’

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' lun do' ineh, 'Na ineh petap, O tamanku Ibrahim, iamo' kudeng seburur lemulun rat arang lun naté amé' nedeh, kali' rungen ideh uren.'
english: But the rich man replied, ‘No, father Abraham, that will not be enough But if someone from those who have died goes back to them and warns them, they will turn from their sinful behavior.’

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Ibrahim, 'Kudeng ideh na sikal ninger surat Musa idi nabi- nabi, meluun teh ideh na miak mubuk kudeng seburur lemulun tumui rat arang lun naté pana'.' "
english: Abraham said to him, ‘No! If they do not listen to what MTY Moses and the prophets MTY wrote, even if someone would become alive again and go and warn them, they would not be convinced {he could not convince them} that they should turn from their sinful behavior.’”

lun_bawang: Yésus nepebala kuan anak-anak sekola'Neh, "Na miak na inan sabeng luk ngebpeh lemulun, iamo' mesusa' kuan lemulun luk ngacing sabeng ineh!
english: One day Jesus said to his disciples, “Things that will tempt people to sin are certain to happen, but it will be terrible for anyone who causes them to happen!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala rasul-rasul ineh kuan Yésus, "Do' ngerayeh anu kai!”
english: One day the apostles said to the Lord, “Help us to trust in you (OR, in God) more strongly!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Kudeng muyuh inan anu luk kirayeh aceh ngilung sesawi' pana', idi miak muyuh pebala kuan lawa gita' ini, 'Mebubput iko idi uen nibu bang abpa' rayeh!' Idi ieh pana' maya' balamu teh.'
english: The Lord replied, “Mustard seeds are very small, but in this area they grow and produce large MET plants. Similarly, if your faith grows until you truly believe that God will do what you ask him to, you will be able to do anything. You could even say to this mulberry tree, ‘Pull yourself out with your roots and plant yourself in the sea!’ and it would obey you!”

lun_bawang: idi ideh pana' nengitang, keburi'deh, "O Yésus, O Guru, méi' nekai.”
english: and called out, “Jesus, Master, pity us and heal us!”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus nenier nedeh, idi Ieh nepebala kuandeh, "Amé' muyuh mada' burur muyuh siren lun imam-imam." Idi uned ideh nalan, idi ideh nedo' peh.
english: When he saw them, he said to them, “Each of you should go and show yourself to a priest in Jerusalem so that he can see if you are healed.” As they were going there, they were healed.

lun_bawang: Idi inan dueh burur luk déi' lati', seburur miak lapen idi seburur tacin.”

lun_bawang: kebalaNeh, "Idi bang aceh bawang inan seburur lun luk mutut besara' luk na matot inan Allah, idi luk na ngerawé lemulun pana'.
english: He said, “In a certain city there was a judge who did not revere God, and did not care about people, either.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan, "Do' ninger luk bila lun luk mutut besara' luk na matu ineh!
english: Then the Lord Jesus said, “Even though the judge was not a righteous man, think carefully about what he said!

lun_bawang: KebalaNeh, "Inan dueh burur lemulun nesemuet bang Ruma' Allah sikal sembayang, ieh ineh seburur lun Parisi, idi seburur lun luk ngamung usin pupuk.
english: He said this: “Two men went up to the Temple in Jerusalem to pray. One was a Pharisee. The other was a tax collector.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus nenawar anak-anak ineh amé' Neneh, kebalaNeh, "Nima' anak- anak luk isuut amé' Negku, aleg mebpeng nedeh, ngaceku lemulun luk kudeng ini luk kuan Imet Allah.
english: But Jesus called the children to come to him. He said to his disciples, “Let the children come to me! Do not stop them! It is people who are humble and trusting like they are who can experience God ruling their lives.

english: A Jewish leader asked Jesus, “Good teacher, what shall I do in order to have eternal life?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus neneh, "Anunké punneh iko mala Negku do'? Seburur pana' na luk do', inan Sebuleng mo', Ieh ineh Allah.
english: Jesus said to him, “Only God is good! No one else is good! ◄So you(sg) should consider carefully what you are implying by calling me good!/Do you realize that you are implying that I am God by calling me good?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'neh, "Amung ini ui pangeh nemaya' rat kareb ui suut.”
english: The man said, “I have obeyed all those commandments ever since I was young. So ◄there must be something else I have not done./is that enough?►”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus neninger balaneh, idi Ieh nepebala neneh, "Sebuleng mo' luk nateh inau'mu. Masui amung-amung binawehmu idi maré kuan lun masi', pad iko ngalap binaweh déi' surga, idi amé' maya' Negku.”
english: When Jesus heard him say that, he replied to him, “There is one thing that you (sg) have not done yet. Sell all that you own. Then give the money to poor people. The result will be that you will have spiritual riches in heaven. Then come and be my disciple!”

lun_bawang: Yésus nekali' neneh mesusa' niat, idi ieh nepebala, "Mikat tu-tu kuan lemulun luk mula' binaweh semuet bang Imet Allah!
english: Jesus looked at the man as he left, and said, “It is very difficult for those who are wealthy to decide to let God rule MET their lives.

lun_bawang: Lemulun luk neninger ineh nepebala, "Kudeng pieh kudeng ineh, idéké luk miak ngalap ulun?”
english: The Jews thought that God favored rich people, so they thought that if God did not save rich people, he would not save others, either. So one of the disciples who heard him say that replied, “If that is so, it seems that no one will be saved {that God will not save anyone} RHQ!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus, "Anun-anun luk na miak mangun kuan lemulun miak mangun kuan Allah.”
english: But Jesus said, “It is impossible for people to save themselves. But God can save them, because God can do anything!”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Pétrus, "Kai ini pangeh nenecan ruma' kai pad maya' Namu.”
english: Then Peter said, “You know that we(exc) have left everything we had and have become your disciples RHQ. So what about us? (OR, So will God accept/save us?”)

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yésus kuandeh, "Matu, Ui pebala nemuyuh, na luk idi seburur pana' luk nenecan ruma', awan, kinanak, taman-tinan, idi anak-anak, ngaceku ratnan Imet Allah,
english: He said to them, “Keep this in mind: Those who have left their homes, their wives, their brothers, their parents, their children, or any other family members, to tell others about how God wants to rule MET people’s lives,

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nenguit pulu' dueh anak sekola' ineh, idi nepebala nedeh, "Nekini tau amé' déi' Yerusalim, idi amung-amung luk inayud nabi-nabi miak uen ngacing kuan Anak-Lemulun.
english: Jesus took the twelve disciples to a place by themselves and said to them, “Listen carefully! We (inc) are now going up to Jerusalem. While we are there, everything that has been written by the prophets {that the prophets have written} about me, the one who came from heaven, will be fulfilled {will occur}.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengitang, keburi'neh, "O Yésus, Anak Daud, méi' negku!”
english: He shouted, “Jesus, you who are descended from King David, the Messiah, pity me!”

lun_bawang: Idi lemulun luk pa atun nemebpeng neneh, idi nengecuk neneh pirud, iamo' meluun rayeh arodneh, "O Anak Daud, méi' negku!”
english: Those who were walking at the front of the crowd scolded the man and told him to be quiet. But he shouted more loudly, “You who are descended from King David, the Messiah, pity me!”

lun_bawang: "Anunké luk pianmu Ui nganau' kuanmu?" Kebalaneh, "O Tuhan, ui mutuh miak nier.”
english: “What do you (sg) want me to do for you?” He replied, “Lord, enable me to see again!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Do' iko nier! Anumu pangeh nengedo' namu.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Then see! Because you have trusted PRS in me, I have healed you!”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus nacing su luk inanneh ineh, idi Yésus pana' nenier déi' dita' idi nepebala neneh, "O Sakius, remurut iko dengan mesaget, ngaceku bang aco sini na miak na Ui umak ruma'mu.”
english: When Jesus got there, he looked up and said to him, “Zacchaeus, come down quickly, because God wants me to go with you(sg) to your house and stay there tonight”!

lun_bawang: Amung lemulun luk nenier ratnan ineh dureng-dureng, idi nepebala, "Ieh iné' tudo dengan lun luk mesala'.”
english: The people who saw Jesus go there grumbled saying, “He has gone to be the guest of a man who is a sinner!”

lun_bawang: Sakius netuped idi nepebala inan Tuhan, "Sebuang ratnan binawehku, O Tuhan, ui maré kuan lemulun luk masi', idi kudeng ui pangeh nengalap binaweh dulun dengan naluk, ui maré lemubed apat kua' kinula'neh.”
english: Then Zacchaeus stood up while they were eating and said to the Lord Jesus, “Lord, I want you (sg) to know that I am going to give half of what I own to poor people. And as for the people whom I have cheated, I will pay them back four times the amount I have gotten from them by cheating.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Bang aco sini ulun nacing kuan uang tetek ruma' ini, ngaceku lemulun ini teh luk iniap ku anak Ibrahim.
english: Jesus said to him, “Today God has forgiven PRS you and the other people in MTY this house, because you (sg) also have shown that you have trusted in God as your ancestor Abraham did.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh kebala Yésus, "Inan seburur lun do' luk nenalan iné' bawang luk mado, pad ieh miak mangun ku raca'. Pangeh ineh ieh miak lemubed.
english: So he told them this parable: “A prince prepared to go to a distant country in order that the Emperor would make him a king. He intended to return later.

lun_bawang: "Lun do' ineh kinikit mangun ku raca', idi ieh nuli'. Ieh petacu nawar amung-amung demulun luk inanneh nemaré balad amas ineh, pad ieh miak kali' tuda' luk ilapdeh.
english: But the Emperor made him king anyway. Later the new king returned. Then he commanded that the servants to whom he had given the coins should be summoned {that someone should summon the servants to whom he had given the coins}. He wanted to know how much they had gained by doing business with the coins.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' tuan ineh neneh, 'Do' luk inau'mu, O demulun luk do'! Ngaceku iko pangeh nelutep bang luk isuut, iko miak ngimet pulu' bawang.'
english: He said to this man, ‘You are a good servant! You have done very well! Because you have handled faithfully a small amount of money, I will give you authority to rule ten cities.’

lun_bawang: Idi luk kedueh iné' neneh, keburi'neh, 'O tuan, sebalad amasmu ineh pangeh mangun ku limeh balad.'
english: Then the second servant came and said, ‘Sir, with your one coin I have earned five more coins!’

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' tuan kuan demulun ineh teh, 'Iko miak ngimet limeh bawang.'
english: He said to that servant similarly, ‘Good! I will give you authority to rule five cities.’

lun_bawang: Idi kebala tuan ineh neneh, 'O demulun luk dat, dengan balamu ineh ui ngukum namu. Pangeh iko kali', idi ui ini selemulun luk metueh niat, luk ngalap anun-anun luk na ui kuan, idi ngeranih anun-anun luk na tinibuku.
english: The king said to that servant, ‘You wicked servant! I will condemn you by the very words MTY that you have just now spoken. ◄You know that I do not do foolish things with my money./Did you not know that I do not do foolish things with my money?► RHQ You said that I even take from others money that does not really belong to me, like a farmer who harvests grain from another man’s field where he did not even do the planting.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh neneh, 'O tuan, ieh inan pulu' balad.'
english: They protested, ‘But Sir, he already has ten coins!’

lun_bawang: kebalaNeh, "Amé' medueh bang bawang luk pa atun medueh, kareb medueh semuet bang bawang ineh, medueh miak papu' aceh anak keladai inabet, luk na tupu inan lun netudo luunneh atun. Do' neka abetneh, idi nguit neneh amé' tungé'.
english: he said to two of his disciples, “Go to the village just ahead of you. As you two enter it, you will see a young animal that no one has ever ridden, that has been {someone has} tied up. Untie it and bring it to me.

lun_bawang: Uned didueh neka abet anak keladai ineh, idi lemulun luk kuan anak keladai ineh nepebala nedidueh, "Anunké punneh medueh neka anak keladai ineh?”
english: As they were untying it, its owners said to them, “Why are you two untying that young animal?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' didueh, "Tuhan pian ku ieh.”
english: They replied, “The Lord needs it.” So the owners said that they could take it.

lun_bawang: kebaladeh, "Samal kuan Raca' luk macing bang ngadan Tuhan; awang déi surga, idi ubur kuan Allah!”
english: They were saying things like, “May the Lord God bless our king who comes representing MTY him!” “May there be peace between God in heaven and us his people!” “May everyone praise God!”

lun_bawang: Idi arang lun mula' ineh inan tuda'-tuda' lun Parisi luk nepebala Neneh, "O Guru, mebpeng anak-anak sekola'Mu ineh.”
english: Some of the Pharisees who were in the crowd said to Jesus, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples for saying things like that!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Ui pebala nemuyuh, kudeng ideh pirud, kali' rungen batu- batu miak ngitang.”
english: He replied, “I tell you this: If these people would be silent, the stones themselves would shout to praise me!”

lun_bawang: kebalaNeh, "Pelaba do' kudeng aco sini iko kali' ratnan luk miak nguit awang! Iamo' nekini iko na miak nier ineh.
english: He said, “My disciples know what they need to do to have peace with God; I wish that even today the rest of you people knew it. But now you are unable to know MTY it.

lun_bawang: kebalaNeh, "Pangeh inayud, 'Ruma'Ku miak tetanen ruma' luk inan sembayang.' Iamo' muyuh ini nganau' neneh mangun ku lubang lun mano.”
english: and he began to chase them out. He said to them, “It has been written {A prophet wrote} in the Scriptures that God said, ‘I want my house to be a place where people pray’; but you bandits have made it a cave where you can hide!”

lun_bawang: kebaladeh, "Mala kuan kai dengan lalud anunké Iko nganau' kekamen ini? Idéké luk nemaré lalud ini kuanMu?”
english: They asked him, “Tell us, by what authority are you doing these things? Who authorized you to do things like you did here yesterday?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Ui pana' sikal ngitun nemuyuh. Mada' Negku,
english: He replied, “I will also ask you a question. Tell me,

lun_bawang: Idi ideh pegayam seburur dengan seburur, keburi'deh, "Kudeng tau mala, 'Rata surga,' Ieh miak pebala, "Ngudehké muyuh na manu neneh?'
english: They discussed this among themselves. They said, “If we(inc) say, ‘It was from God MTY/EUP,’ he will say to us, ‘Then ◄you should have believed John’s message!/why did you not believe what John preached?► RHQ’

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Ui pana' na sikal mala kuan muyuh dengan lalud idéké Ui nganau' kekamen ini.”
english: Then Jesus said to them, “Because you did not answer my question, I will not tell you who authorized me to do those things here yesterday.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nemada' aceh luk pinginud kuan lun mula', "Inan seburur lemulun luk nenganau' aceh kabun anggur; idi ieh nemaré kabun ineh uen tuda'-tuda' lun matar kabun ngacam. Idi ieh nenalan tuda'-tuda' io bang bawang baken.
english: Then Jesus told the people this parable to illustrate what God would do to the Jews who rejected the former prophets and himself: “A certain man planted a vineyard. He rented the vineyard to some men to care for it and to give him some of the grapes in return. Then he went to another country and stayed there several years.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kareb lun matar kabun nenier anakneh ineh, idi ideh nepegayam seburur dengan seburur, keburi'deh, 'Ini inulneh, do' tau ngaté neneh, pad babpatneh mangun ku binaweh tau.'
english: So he sent his son, but when the men who were caring for the vineyard saw him coming, they said to each other, ‘Here comes the man who will some day inherit the vineyard. Let’s kill him so that this vineyard will be ours!’

lun_bawang: Kali' rungen ieh macing sikal ngaté amung-amung lun matar kabun ineh idi maré kabun anggur ineh kuan lun baken teh." Kareb ideh neninger bala luk kudeng ineh, idi ideh nepebala, "Na tu kudeng ineh!”
english: He will come and kill those men who were taking care of the vineyard. Then he will arrange for other people to take care of it.” When the people listening to Jesus heard that, they said, “We would not do anything like those wicked men did!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus nenier nedeh idi nepebala, "Anunké ilung ayat luk inayud bang Surat Tuhan ini, 'Batu luk tila' lun luk mudut ruma', pangeh mangun ku batu lidung.'
english: But Jesus looked directly at them and said, “You can say that, but think about the meaning of these words that are written {which a prophet wrote} RHQ in the Scriptures, The men who were building a house rejected a certain stone. But others put that same stone in its proper place, and it has become the most important stone in the building MET.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh Neneh, "O Guru, kai kali' Iko luk mala idi mada' dengan niat luk matu, idi na mili' ayu lemulun, iamo' dalan Allah bida'Mu dengan matu.
english: So one of them asked Jesus, “Teacher, we (exc) know that you (sg) speak and teach what is right. You tell the truth even if important people do not like it. You teach truthfully what God wants us to do.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus nekali' ilehdeh, idi Ieh nepebala nedeh,
english: But Jesus knew that they were trying to trick him to get him into trouble, either with the Jews, who hated to pay those taxes, or with the Roman government. So he said to them,

lun_bawang: "Maré aceh sin sirenKu. Ayu idéké idi ngadan idéké ieh?" Idi keburi'deh, "Ini raca' kuan.”
english: “Show me a Roman coin. Then tell me whose picture is on it. And tell me whose name is on it.” They showed him a coin and said, “It has the picture and name of Caesar, the head of the Roman government.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Kudeng pieh kudeng ineh, do' maré kuan raca' anun-anun luk raca' kuan, idi kuan Allah anun-anun luk Allah kuan.”
english: He said to them, “In that case, give to the government MTY what they require, and give to God what he requires.”

lun_bawang: keburi'deh, "O Guru, Musa pangeh nengayud ukum kuan tau: 'Kudeng kinanak seburur lemulun maté, idi kudeng ieh inan awan iamo' na luk idi anakneh, do' kinanakneh ngalap awanneh ineh idi nginul anak kuan kinanakneh.'
english: They wanted to ask Jesus a question in order to discredit the idea that dead people will live again. One of them said to Jesus, “Teacher, Moses wrote for us Jews about situations where a man who has a wife but no children. If the man dies, his brother should marry the dead man’s widow so that she can have a child by him. People will consider that the child is the descendant of the man who died, and in that way the dead man will have descendants.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yésus nedeh, "Anak-anak tana' ini ngaweh;
english: Jesus replied to them, “Men who live here in this world take wives, or are given wives by their parents {their parents choose wives for them}.

lun_bawang: Tuda'-tuda' guru Ukum nengor balaNeh, keburi'deh, "O Guru, matu balaMu ineh.”
english: Some of the men who taught the Jewish laws replied, “Teacher, you (sg) have answered very well!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Kudeng apehké lemulun mala Keristus ineh Anak Daud?
english: Then Jesus said to them, “I will show you (OR, prove to you) that people are wrong who say that the Messiah is merely a descendant of King David! RHQ

lun_bawang: Ngaceku Daud sebuleng nemala bang surat Nani Ubur, 'Tuhan nepebala nan Tuhanku: Tudo Iko pa tinuehKu,
english: Because David himself wrote about the Messiah in the book of Psalms, God said to my Lord, Sit here beside me on my right, where I will highly honor you(sg) MTY.

lun_bawang: Kudeng pieh kudeng ineh Daud neneten Neneh, 'Tuhan,' idi kudeng apehké Ieh mangun ku anakneh teh?”
english: King David calls the Messiah ‘my Lord’! So ◄the Messiah cannot be just someone descended from King David!/how can the Messiah be just someone descended from King David?► RHQ What I just said proves that he is much greater than David, isn’t that right?”

lun_bawang: "Matar burur muyuh ratnan guru-guru Ukum, luk sikal nalan dengan kuyu' buyor, idi teh sikal buren lemulun déi' kadai, idi pian ku kerusi luk meluun do' bang ruma' sembayang, idi su luk meluun do' kareb irau,
english: “Beware that you do not act like the men who teach our Jewish laws. They like to put on long robes and walk around to make people think that they are very important. They also like people to greet them respectfully in the marketplaces. They like to sit in the most important places in the Jewish meeting places. At dinner parties they like to sit in the seats where the most honored people sit.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Ui pebala nemuyuh, decur tinula' luk masi' ini pangeh nenipa meluun ratnan amung-amungdeh.
english: He said to his disciples, “The truth is that these rich people have a lot of money, but they gave only a small part of it. But this woman, who is very poor, has put in all the money that she had to pay for the things she needs! So God considers that HYP this poor widow has put more money into the box than all the others.”

lun_bawang: "Muyuh nier amung-amung ini. Sebuleng batu pana' luk buun-buun ieni na miak ketecan muci. Amungdeh miak musag.”
english: Later his disciples asked him, “Teacher, when will that happen? What will happen to the temple to indicate that the things you(sg) just told us are about to happen?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "O Guru, idanké susa' ini miak mangun? Idi anunké tanu'neh ratnan dereh ini malé mangun?”
english: He said, “All that I will say is, be sure that you are not deceived {that they do not deceive you} about these things! Many people will come and say ◄that I sent them/that they have my authority► MTY. They will say, ‘I am the Messiah!’ They will also say ‘It is now the time when God will begin to rule!’ Do not follow them to become their disciples

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus, "Matar do'-do', aleg muyuh saluken. Ngaceku mula' lemulun macing bang ngadanKu, keburi'deh, 'Ui ini Ieh,' idi teh, 'Karebneh pangeh muneng!' Aleg muyuh maya' nedeh.
english: Also, whenever you hear about wars and riots, do not be terrified. Keep in mind that God has said that those things must happen. But when they happen, it will not mean that the world will end right away!”

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebalaNeh, "Papu sikal metueh ratnan pupu, idi imet sikal metueh ratnan imet baken.
english: There will be big earthquakes, and in various places there will be famines and plagues. People will see things that will terrify them. There will also be unusual things happening in the sky.

lun_bawang: Do' muyuh lutep, pad muyuh miak ngalap ulun.
english: “But when you see that Jerusalem has been surrounded by the armies of your enemies, you will know that it is time for this city to be completely destroyed {them to completely destroy this city}.

lun_bawang: "Kareb muyuh nier Yerusalim linibut tuda'-tuda' baweh, idi muyuh kali' tabpaneh pangeh muneng.
english: At that time those of you who are in Judea district must flee to the higher hills. Those who are in this city must leave quickly. Those who are in the nearby countryside must not go back into the city to get any of their possessions before they flee.

lun_bawang: "Idi miak mangun tuda'-tuda' tanu' luun mateh aco idi bulan idi gituen- gituen pana'. Idi luun tana' inan susa' kuan amung-amung pupu dengan gagau ngaceku beri abpa' rayeh idi ereb teh.
english: People will faint because they will be afraid as they wait for what will happen. They will be afraid because the powerful objects in the sky will be shaken {shake}.

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nemala kuandeh aceh luk pinginud, "Ngerawé lawa gita' idi lawa amung-amung luk baken teh.
english: As soon as you see their leaves beginning to sprout, you know that summer is near.

lun_bawang: "Matar burur muyuh pad niat muyuh na barén kuan luk manga idi mabuk idi rapang ratnan ulun tana' ini, pad aco ineh macing luun muyuh denak- denak mepad kudeng abpung.
english: You need to know that my return will surprise everyone all over the earth.

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nengecuk Pétrus idi Yahya, kebalaNeh, "Amé' medueh nganau' temina' Irau Paska kuan tau, pad tau miak kuman.”
english: So Jesus said to Peter and John, “Go and prepare the meal for the Passover celebration.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala didueh Neneh, "Su apehké pianMu kai nganau' temina' Irau Paska ineh?”
english: They replied to him, “Where do you (sg) want us to prepare it?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedidueh, "Kareb medueh semuet bang bawang, inan aceh deléi luk nguit aceh sidangur abpa' miak papu' nemedueh; do' maya' neneh umak ruma' luk inanneh umak.
english: He said to the two of them, “Listen carefully. When you two enter the city, a man who is carrying a large jar of water will meet you. Follow him. When he enters a house,

lun_bawang: Idi mala kuan tuan ruma' ineh, 'Keburi' Guru namu, Su apehké takep luk inanKu miak kuman Irau Paska dengan anak-anak sekola'Ku?
english: tell the owner of the house, ‘Our teacher says that we(exc) should ask you(sg) to please show us the room that he arranged with you where he can eat the Passover meal with us, his disciples RHQ.’

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nepebala nedeh, "Ui pelaba pian kuman Irau Paska ini pad-pad dengan muyuh, kareb nateh Ui ngalap dereh!
english: He said to them, “I have greatly desired to eat this Passover meal with you before I suffer and die.

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nengalap aceh sangkir, idi kareb Ieh pangeh nemaré ubur, Ieh nepebala, "Lapen muyuh ini, idi nganid arang muyuh sebuleng.
english: Then he took a cup of wine and thanked God for it. Then he said, “Take this, and each of you drink some of it.

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nengalap ruti, idi nemaré ubur, idi nemuri' neneh, idi nemaré neneh kuandeh, keburi'Neh, "Ini bururKu luk biré ngaceku muyuh; nganau' kudeng ini mangun ku sebuleng terawé rat Negku.”
english: Then he took some bread and thanked God for it. He broke it into pieces and gave it to them to eat. He said, “This bread represents my body, which I am about to sacrifice for you. Keep on eating bread this way regularly to remember what I have done for you.”

lun_bawang: Idi kudeng ineh teh, pangeh ideh nekuman, Ieh nemaré sangkir ineh nedeh, keburi'Neh, "Sangkir ini, ieh ineh pejani' Allah luk mebaruh bang dara'Ku, luk pangeh inutang ngaceku muyuh.
english: Similarly, after they had eaten the meal, he took another cup of wine. He said, “The wine in MTY this cup represents my blood, which will soon flow from my body when I die. With this blood I will sign the new agreement that God is making with you.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Raca'-raca' lun pupu baken ngimet nedeh; idi lemulun luk ngimet lalud pa luundeh titen lun ngedengan.
english: So Jesus said to them, “The kings of the non-Jews enjoy showing that they are powerful. Yet they give themselves the title, ‘ones who help the people.’

lun_bawang: "Iamo' muyuh luk megéi' idi denganKu bang amung-amung tutunKu,
english: You are the ones who have stayed with me during all my troubles.

lun_bawang: "O Simun, Simun! Siruh! Sétan pangeh nemutuh nutun nemuyuh, pad ieh tunap nemuyuh mepad kudeng padé.
english: “Simon, Simon, listen! Satan has asked God to let him test you, and God has permitted him to do it. Satan wants to cause you to suffer distress (OR, distress you) so that you will not believe/trust in me any more/longer. He wants to shake you, just like a man shakes wheat in a sieve to sift it MET.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Pétrus Neneh, "O Tuhan, ui temina' tetupin idi maté denganMu!”
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you (sg) if they put you in prison, or even to die with you!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus, "O Pétrus, Ui pebala namu, kareb nateh lal ngekook aco sini iko miak ngalum Negku teluh kua', idi mala iko na miti Negku.”
english: Jesus replied, “Peter, I want you (sg) to know that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will say three times that you do not know me!”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yésus kuan anak-anak sekola' ineh, "Kareb Ui ngecuk nemuyuh remuat dengan na nguit kapil, tabpung, idi kasut, inanké muyuh masi'?" Idi keburi'deh, "Na.”
english: Then Jesus asked all of them, “After I sent you out to other villages, and you went without taking any money or a traveling bag or extra sandals, you did not lack anything, did you?” They replied, “That’s right, we(exc) did not lack anything.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh nedeh, "Iamo' nekini lemulun luk inan kapil do' ieh nguit neneh, idi luk inan tabpung kudeng ineh teh; iamo' lemulun luk na luk idi anun-anun, do' ieh masui kuyu'neh idi melih pelapet.
english: Then, to show them that now many people would oppose them, (OR, to show them that they needed to be prepared to protect themselves,) he said to them, “Now things will be different. So whoever among you has some money should take it with him. Likewise, he should take a carrying bag. Whoever does not have a sword should sell his coat and buy a sword.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh, "O Tuhan, siruh, tungé' inan dueh pelapet!" Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Petap gayam ini peh!”
english: One of the disciples said, “Lord, look! We (exc) have two swords!” Realizing that they did not understand the meaning of what he said, he replied to them, “That is enough talk about swords”!

lun_bawang: Kareb Ieh nacing su luk inan ineh, Ieh nepebala nedeh, "Do' muyuh sembayang pad muyuh na tetunin!”
english: When he came to the place where he often spent the night, he said to them, “Pray that God will help you whenever something tempts you.”

lun_bawang: kesembayangNeh, "O Ama', kudeng petulu dengan pianMu, ngatad sangkir ini rat Negku, iamo' baken pianKu, iamo' pinianMu mo' miak mangun.”
english: “My Father, if you are willing to do it, force me to have to undergo these terrible things that are about to happen to me MTY. But do not do what I want. Instead, do what you want.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh nedeh, "Anunké punneh muyuh rudap? Do' muyuh tumui idi sembayang, pad muyuh na tetunin.”
english: He woke them and said to them, “◄I am disappointed that you are sleeping!/Why are you sleeping?► RHQ Get up! Pray that God will help you whenever you are tempted {when something like this tempts you}!”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yésus neneh, "O Yudas, iko sikal masui Anak-Lemulun dengan muenké?”
english: Jesus said to him, “Judas, ◄I am disappointed that it is by kissing me that you are enabling my enemies to seize me, the one who came from heaven!/is it by kissing me as though you loved me that you are enabling my enemies to seize me, the one who came from heaven?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Kareb lemulun luk iring Yésus nenier ratnan luk sikal mangun ineh, idi keburi'deh, "O Tuhan, do'ké ai ngaté dengan pelapet ini?”
english: When the disciples who were around Jesus realized what was going to happen, they said, “Lord, shall we (exc) strike them with our swords?”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus nengor baladeh, "Miak ineh peh!" Idi Ieh nengakem lalidneh ineh idi nengedo' neneh.
english: But Jesus said, “Do not do any more of that!” He touched the servant’s ear and healed him.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus kuan imam-imam rayeh idi lun rayeh Ruma' Allah idi amung-amung lun rayeh luk nacing Neneh, "Petuluké muyuh macing dengan pelapet idi kayuh pad ngakem Negku, ayu-ayuneh Ui ini lun luk dat?
english: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, the officers of the Temple guards, and the Jewish elders who had come to seize him, “◄It is ridiculous that you have come here with swords and clubs to capture MTY me, as if I were a bandit!/Why have you come here with swords and clubs to capture MTY me, as if I were a bandit?► RHQ Day after day I was with you in the Temple courtyard, and you did not seize me! But this is the time MTY when God is allowing you to do what you want. It is also the time MTY when God is allowing Satan, who rules MTY in the darkness, to do what he wants.”

lun_bawang: Kareb seburur anak adi' decur nenier neneh muneng ku apui ineh, idi ieh nenutong neneh idi nepebala, "Lun ini teh pad-pad dengan Yésus!”
english: But Peter denied it, saying, “Woman, I do not know him!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Pétrus nengena, keburi'neh, "O decur, ui na miti Neneh.”
english: A little later someone else saw Peter and said, “You (sg) also are one of those who were with the man they arrested!” But Peter said, “Man, I am not one of them!”

lun_bawang: Idi na mio ratnan ineh seburur lun baken teh nenier neneh, idi nepebala, "Iko pana' seburur lemulun rat arangdeh teh." Iamo' keburi' Pétrus, "Na ieh ui.”
english: About an hour later someone else said emphatically about Peter, “The way that this man speaks shows that he is from Galilee district. Certainly this man was also with the man whom they arrested, who is from Galilee!”

lun_bawang: Kareb lélé sejam muci ratnan ineh seburur lun baken teh mesaad idi nepebala, "Matu lemulun ini teh luk denganNeh, ngaceku ieh ini pana' seburur lun Galilia.”
english: But Peter said, “Man, I do not know what you (sg) are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

lun_bawang: Iamo' keburi' Pétrus, "Ui na kali' ilung anun luk bilamu." Idi kareb ineh teh uned ieh pebala, lal pana' nengekook.
english: The Lord Jesus turned around and looked right at Peter. Then Peter remembered what the Lord had said to him, “This night, before the rooster crows, you (sg) will deny three times that you know me.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nelumi idi nenier Pétrus; idi Pétrus nengerawé ratnan bala Tuhan, mepad kudeng luk bilaNeh neneh atun, "Idi kareb nateh lal ngekook aco sini, iko miak ngalum Negku teluh kua'.”
english: And Peter went out of the courtyard and cried very sorrowfully.

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh ideh nengakeb kiung Yésus, idi nengitun Neneh, keburi'deh, "Do' Iko mada', idéké lemulun luk nemepag Namu?”
english: They said many other evil things about him, insulting him.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh, "Kudeng matu Iko Keristus, do' mala kuan kai." Iamo' kebala Yésus nedeh, "Kudeng Ui mala nemuyuh, muyuh na manu Negku;
english: If I ask you what you think about the Messiah, you will not answer me.

lun_bawang: Idi amungdeh nepebala, "Kudeng pieh kudeng ineh, Iko ini Anak Allahké?" Idi keburi'Neh kuandeh ineh, "Mepad kudeng bala muyuh sebuleng, Ui ini Ieh!”
english: Then they said to each other, “◄We (inc) certainly do not need anyone else to testify against him!/Why should we ask for any more people to testify against him?► RHQ” We ourselves have heard him say MTY that he is equal with God!

lun_bawang: idi amung-amungdeh nengimun ngadu' Neneh, keburi'deh, "Kai nekali' lemulun ini nengeraruh pupu kai, idi nemebpeng lemulun na maré acam kuan raca' Rum, idi nemala bururNeh Keristus, seburur raca'.”
english: They began to accuse Jesus, saying, “We (exc) have determined that this fellow has caused political trouble in our country. He has been telling people that they should not pay taxes to the Roman government MTY. Also, he says that he is the Messiah, a king!”

lun_bawang: Idi Pilatus pana' nengitun Neneh, keburi'neh, "Ikoké Raca' lun Yahudi?" Idi Yésus nengor balaneh, keburi'Neh, "Mepad kudeng balamu.”
english: Pilate asked him, “Do you (sg) claim that you are the King of the Jews?” He replied, “It is as you have just now said.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Pilatus kuan imam-imam rayeh idi lun mula' ineh teh, "Ui kali' lemulun ini na sala' anun-anun pana'!”
english: Pilate said to the chief priests and the rest of the crowd, “I do not conclude that this man is guilty of any crime.”

lun_bawang: Idi meluun tueh lun mula' mesaad, keburi'deh, "Ieh ngagau pupu ini idi mada' lemulun libut-libut tana' Yudia rat Galilia macing su ini.”
english: But they kept insisting, “He is inciting the people to riot! He has been teaching his ideas throughout all of Judea district. He started doing it in Galilee district and now he is doing it here!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' lun mula' nengitang, keburi'deh, "Ngaté lemulun ini, idi muit Barabas kuan kai!”
english: Barrabas was a man who had tried to persuade people in the city to rebel against the Roman government. While doing that, he had murdered someone. So he had been put {they had put him} in prison, where he was waiting to be executed.

lun_bawang: Iamo' ideh nengitang, keburi'deh, "Nalib Neneh! Nalib Neneh!”
english: He spoke to them a third time and asked them, “Why? What crime has he committed? I have concluded that he has done nothing for which he deserves to die. So I will have my soldiers flog him and then release him.”

lun_bawang: Idi keteluh kua' Pilatus nengitun nedeh, "Dat anunké luk inau'Neh? Ui na kali' sebuleng sala'Neh pana', pad Ieh ngalap ukum maté. Ui miak ngecuk nelun mebal Neneh idi muit Neneh.”
english: But they kept insisting. They shouted loudly that Jesus should be nailed {that Pilate should have his soldiers nail Jesus} to a cross. Finally, because they continued to shout PRS so loudly,

lun_bawang: Iamo' Yésus nelumi nedeh idi nepebala, "O anak decur Yerusalim, aleg muyuh nangi' Negku, iamo' do' muyuh nangi' burur muyuh sebuleng idi anak- anak muyuh teh.
english: I want you to know that there will soon be a time when people will say, ‘Women SYN who have never borne children or nursed babies are fortunate!’

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh nacing su luk inan ngadanneh Perupuk Uluh, idi ideh nenalib Yésus pad-pad dengan dueh burur lemulun luk dat ineh, sebuleng pa tinuehNeh idi sebuleng pa kabing.
english: Jesus prayed, “My Father, forgive them, because they do not realize whom they are doing this to!” Then the soldiers divided Jesus’ clothing by gambling with something like dice, to decide which piece of clothing each one would get.

lun_bawang: Idi kesembayang Yésus, "O Ama', maré do' kuan lemulun ineh ngaceku na ideh kali' luk inau'deh. Idi ideh nenala' udi idi nemabpat ayungNeh arangdeh.
english: Many people stood nearby, watching. And the Jewish leaders ◄made fun of/ridiculed► Jesus, saying, “He said IRO that he saved other people! If he is the Messiah, the one God has chosen, he should save himself!”

lun_bawang: Lun mula' ineh netuped nier. Iamo' lun rayeh lun Yahudi nesitunga Neneh, keburi'deh, "Ieh pangeh nengulun lun baken, nekini nima' Neneh ngulun bururNeh sebuleng, kudeng matu Ieh Keristus Allah luk pinili'.”
english: The soldiers also ridiculed him because he claimed to be a king. They came up to him and offered him some sour wine.

lun_bawang: kebaladeh, "Kudeng Iko Raca' lun Yahudi, do' ngulun bururMu sebuleng!”
english: They also fastened on the cross a sign that stated why they were nailing him to the cross. But all it said was, ‘This is the King of the Jews’.

lun_bawang: Idi inan aceh bala inayud pa luunNeh kudeng ini, "Ini Raca' lun Yahudi.”
english: One of the criminals who was hanging on a cross began to insult Jesus, saying, “You (sg) said that you are the Messiah, so you must be powerful! So save yourself, and save us, too!”

lun_bawang: Idi seburur ratnan lemulun luk dat luk tekito denganNeh ineh nenguyo Neneh, "Bakenké Iko ini Keristus? Ngulun bururMu sebuleng idi kai pana'!”
english: But the other criminal rebuked him, saying, “◄You (sg) should be afraid of God punishing you!/Are you not afraid of God punishing you?► RHQ They are punishing him and us similarly.

lun_bawang: Iamo' luk baken ineh nemebpeng neneh, keburi'neh, "Naké iko matot inan Allah? Amung tau pangeh inukum maté.
english: They have justly decided that we (inc) two must die. They are punishing us as we deserve for the evil things that we did. But this man has done nothing wrong!”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'neh nan Yésus, "O Yésus, do' ngerawé negku kareb Iko macing mangun ku Raca'.”
english: Jesus replied, “I want you (sg) to know that today you (sg) will be with me in the place where everyone is happy!” (OR, that today you will be with me in Paradise!)

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Ui pebala namu, aco sini teh iko idi pad-pad denganKu bang Pirdaus.”
english: Then it was about noontime. It became dark over the whole land, and it stayed dark until three o’clock in the afternoon.

lun_bawang: Yésus nengitang, kesembayangNeh, "O Ama', Ui maré rohKu bang paladMu." Pangeh Ieh nemala kudeng ineh, idi niatNeh neputut.
english: When the officer who supervised the soldiers who were executing Jesus saw what happened, he praised God for the way Jesus died, saying, “I am sure that this man had done nothing wrong!”

lun_bawang: Kareb lun rayeh lun pebunu' nenier luk mangun ineh, idi ieh pana' nengerayeh Allah, keburi'neh, "Matu lemulun ini seburur lemulun luk matu.”
english: When the crowd of people who had gathered to see those events saw what happened, they returned to their homes, beating their chests to show that they were sorrowful.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh pelaba tot dengan netekunal macing kiungdeh luun tana', idi dueh burur lemulun ineh nepebala nedeh, "Anunké punneh muyuh nakap luk mulun arang luk naté?
english: The women were frightened. As they prostrated themselves on the ground, the two men said to them, “◄You should not be seeking someone who is alive in a place where they bury dead people!/Why are you seeking in a place where they bury dead people someone who is alive?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nengitun nedidueh, "Anunké bala luk bila medueh kareb medueh nalan?" Idi didueh nugka' dengan dat niat.
english: Jesus said to them, “What have you two been talking about while you were walking?” They stopped, and their faces looked very sad.

lun_bawang: Idi sebuleng didueh luk ngadanneh Kliopas, nepebala Neneh, "Iko sebuleng mo' luk tudo déi' Yerusalim, luk nateh nekali' ratnan amung-amung luk pangeh nangun déi' bang kareb iniké?
english: One of them, whose name was Cleopas, said, “◄You (sg) must be the only person who is visiting Jerusalem for the Passover festival who does not know the events that have happened there in recent days!/Are you the only person who is visiting Jerusalem for the Passover festival who does not know the events that have happened there in recent days?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedidueh, "Ratnan anunké ineh?" Idi keburi' didueh Neneh, "Ratnan Yésus lun Nasarét, ieh ineh seburur Nabi luk melalud bang kekamenNeh idi balaNeh pa kiung Allah idi lun mula' pana'.
english: He said to them, “What events?” They replied, “The things that happened to Jesus, the man from Nazareth, who was a prophet. Many people saw him perform great miracles, and God enabled him to teach wonderful messages!

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nepebala nedidueh, "O lemulun luk mebacé. Muyuh mulai maya' amung-amung bala nabi-nabi ineh!
english: He said to them, “You two foolish men! You are so slow to believe all that the prophets have written about the Messiah!

lun_bawang: Iamo' didueh ineh sikal ngimet Neneh, keburi' didueh, "Do' Iko tudo dengan kai dueh, ngaceku aco pangeh malem idi aco pangeh macep." Idi Ieh pana' numak pad-pad dengan didueh.
english: but they urged him to not do that. They said, “Stay with us tonight, because it is late in the afternoon and it will soon be dark.” So he went in the house to stay with them.

lun_bawang: Idi didueh nepebala seburur kuan seburur, "Bakenké niat kiteh nesigio kareb Ieh nepebala kuan kiteh maya' dalan, idi nengelio rat bang Surat Allah kuan kiteh?”
english: The two men said to each other, “While we were walking along the road and he talked with us and enabled us (inc) to understand the Scriptures, we became so excited that it was as though MET a fire was burning within us RHQ!
