We should not stay here; we should go tell the others what happened!”

lun_bawang: idi kebaladeh, "Matu, Tuhan pangeh netumui idi Ieh nesilagan kuan Simun.”
english: who told those two men, “It is true that the Lord has become alive again, and he has appeared to Peter!”

lun_bawang: Uned ideh pebala-pebala ratnan amung-amung ineh, idi denak-denak Yésus netuped arang uneddeh, idi nepebala kuandeh, "Awang kuan muyuh!”
english: As they were saying that, Jesus himself suddenly appeared among them. He said to them, “May God give you inner peace!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus nedeh, "Anunké punneh muyuh megagap, idi anunké punneh muyuh merapang?
english: He said to them, “◄You should not be alarmed!/Why are you alarmed?► RHQ And ◄you should not be doubting that I am alive/Jesus!/why are you doubting that I am alive/Jesus?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kareb ideh na manu ngaceku mawang niat idi mawa, idi Ieh nengitun nedeh, "Inanké luk kenen muyuh ieni?”
english: They were joyful and amazed, but they still did not believe that he was really alive (OR, that Jesus was the one that they were seeing). So he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nepebala kuandeh, "Ini balaKu luk pangeh bilaKu kuan muyuh kareb Ui idi dengan muyuh atun, idi na miak na uen ngacing amung-amung luk pangeh inayud ratnan bururKu rat bang Ukum Musa, surat nabi-nabi, idi Nani Ubur ineh teh.”
english: Then he said to them, “I will repeat what I told you while I was still with you: Everything that was written about me by Moses and the other prophets MTY and in the Psalms must be fulfilled!”

lun_bawang: idi kebalaNeh nedeh, "Pangeh inayud, Keristus na miak na medereh, idi Ieh miak tumui teh rat arang lun naté bang aco luk keteluh;
english: He said to them, “This is what they wrote: That the Messiah would suffer and die, but on the third day after that he would become alive again.

lun_bawang: Yahya nemare kali' ratnan Yésus, idi nengitang, kebalaneh, "Ini Lemulun luk bilaku miak macing muci rat negku. Iamo' Ieh meluun rayeh rat negku, ngaceku Ieh pangeh idi kareb nateh ui tinganak.”
english: One day when John was telling people about him, he saw Jesus. Then he shouted to them, “I told you previously that someone will come later who is more important than I am, since he existed long before me. This is the man I was talking about!”

lun_bawang: Lun rayeh-rayeh lun Yahudi déi' Yerusalim nengecuk imam-imam idi lun Liwi amé' ngitun Yahya, kebaladeh, "Idéké iko ini?”
english: The Jewish leaders SYN in Jerusalem city sent some Jewish priests and ◄Levites/men who worked in the temple► to where John was, to ask him some questions. They said to him, “What do you claim about yourself?”

lun_bawang: Yahya na nengalum, iamo' ieh nengamo dengan megala', kebalaneh, "Ui ini baken Keristus.”
english: So John told them the truth, and he told them clearly DOU. He said, “I am not ◄the Messiah/God’s chosen king►!”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengitun neneh teh, "Kudeng pieh kudeng ineh, idéké iko? Iko Eliaké?" Idi keburi'neh, "Baken." "Iko nabi inehké?" Idi keburi'neh, "Baken.”
english: Then they asked him, “Then what do you say about yourself? Are you the prophet Elijah that was prophesied to return {◄someone/another prophet► prophesied would return} before the Messiah?” He replied, “No, I am not.” Then they asked him, “Are you the prophet like Moses that ◄we are waiting for/God promised to send►?” He replied, “No.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh neneh, "Idéké iko ini? Ai na miak na ngor bala lemulun luk nengecuk nekai. Anunké luk belénmu ratnan bururmu sebuleng?”
english: So they asked him, “Then who do you claim to be? Tell us so that we can go back and report to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yahya (maya' kudeng bala Nabi Yesaya): " 'Ui ini tang lemulun luk ngitang déi' su luk ali-ali: Ngesiri dalan Tuhan!' “
english: John replied, “I am the one the prophet Isaiah said would proclaim this new message loudly to the people who would pass by in this desolate area: ‘Prepare yourselves to receive the Lord when he comes MET, just like people prepare a road for an important official.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengitun ni Yahya, keburi'deh, "Kudeng iko ini baken Keristus, idi baken Elia, idi baken nabi ineh, anunké punneh iko ngerereb lemulun?”
english: They asked John, “Since you say you are not the Messiah, nor the prophet Elijah, nor the prophet like Moses, what authority do you have? Furthermore, why are you baptizing Jews, treating them as though they were non-Jews who wanted to become Jews?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yahya, "Ui ini ngerereb dengan abpa' mo', iamo' arang uned muyuh inan Seburur Lemulun luk na muyuh miti,
english: John replied, “I am just baptizing people with water to prepare them to welcome the Messiah. But right now someone is among you whom you people do not know.

lun_bawang: Kenebpa Yahya nenier Yésus macing neneh, idi keburi'neh, "Siruh, Anak Dumba Allah luk mabeh sala' amung uang tana' ini.
english: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him. He said to the people, “Look! Here is the man whom God has appointed to be a sacrifice MET, like the lambs that the people of Israel sacrificed! By sacrificing himself he will make it possible for everyone in the world to be no longer guilty for having sinned.

lun_bawang: Idi Yahya pana' nemaré kali' keburi'neh, "Ui nenier Roh Allah temurun rat déi' langit, mepad kudeng aceh suit sukur, idi Ieh tudo luun Yésus.
english: John spoke clearly what God had shown him about Jesus. He said, “I saw God’s Spirit as he was descending from heaven in the form of a dove. The Spirit remained on Jesus.

lun_bawang: Kareb ieh nenier Yésus nalan, idi ieh nepebala, "Siruh, Anak Dumba Allah.”
english: When he saw Jesus passing by, he said, “Look! There is the man God has appointed to be a sacrifice, like the lambs MET the people of Israel have sacrificed!”

lun_bawang: Yésus nelumi, idi nenier nedidueh luk maya' Neneh ineh, idi kebalaNeh nedidueh, "Anunké luk tekapen medueh?" Idi keburi' didueh Neneh, "O Rabi!" (Ilung Rabbi, ieh ineh Guru), "Iapehké inanMu tudo?”
english: Jesus turned around and saw us/them coming behind him. So he asked us/them, “What do you want?” We/They replied, “Teacher, tell us where you are staying, because we want to talk with you.”

lun_bawang: Idi kealaNeh nedidueh, "Amé' tungé' idi nier." Idi didueh nemaya' Neneh idi nenier su luk inanNeh tudo. Idi didueh netudo dengan Yésus aco sineh. (Kaerb ineh pelaba tangal musul aco.)
english: He replied, “Come with me, and you will see where I am staying!” So we/they went with him and saw where he was staying. We/They stayed with him until about 4 o’clock (OR, from about 4 PM until the next day).

lun_bawang: Idi Andrias nepapu' kinanakneh Simun, idi nepebala neneh, "Kai pangeh nepapu' Mesias" (luk ilungneh Keristus).
english: After Andrew left Jesus, the first thing he did was to find his own older brother Simon and say to him, “We have found the Messiah!”

lun_bawang: Ieh nenguit Simun amé' matun Yésus. Idi Yésus nenier neneh idi nepebala, "Iko ini Simun, anak Yahya, iko miak tetanen Képas." (Ini mepad kudeng Pétrus, idi ilungneh "Batu.")
english: Then he took Simon to Jesus. Jesus looked intently at him, and then said, “You are Simon. Your father’s name is John. You will be given {I will give you} the name Cephas.” Cephas is an Aramaic name that means ‘solid rock’. It means the same in Greek as the name Peter.

lun_bawang: Kenebpa Yésus sikal amé' déi' Galilia. Ieh nenakap ni Pilipus, idi nepebala neneh, "Maya' Negku." ( 44Pilipus ineh lun Baitsaida, luk pamung bawang dengan Andrias idi Pétrus.)
english: The next day Jesus decided to leave the Jordan River valley. He went to Galilee district and (OR, on the way there he) found a man named Philip. Jesus said to him, “Come with me!”

lun_bawang: Pilipus nenakap Nataniel, idi nepebala neneh, "Kai pangeh nepapu' Yésus, luk pangeh ginala' Musa bang Surat Ukum idi nabi-nabi pana', ieh ineh Yésus, anak Yusup lun Nasarét.”
english: Then Philip searched for Nathaniel and found him, and said to him, “We have met the Messiah, the one Moses wrote about! The prophets also prophesied that he would come. He is Jesus, from Nazareth town. His father’s name is Joseph.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Nataniel neneh, "Miakké Nasarét ngacing anun-anun luk do'?" Idi keburi' Pilipus neneh, "Amé' iko idi nier.”
english: Nathaniel replied, “Nazareth? ◄Nothing good can come from such an unimportant place!/Can anything good come from such an unimportant place?► RHQ” Philip replied, “Come and see!”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus nenier Nataniel macing Neneh, idi Ieh nepebala ratnan ieh, "Siruh, seburur lun Israil luk matu, idi luk na naluk teh!”
english: When Jesus saw Nathaniel approaching, he said about Nathaniel, “Here is an example of a good Israelite! He never deceives anyone!”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Nataniel Neneh, "Kudeng apehké Rabbi ngiti negku?" Idi Yésus nengor balaneh, keburi'Neh, "Kareb nateh Pilipus nenawar namu, kareb iko pa liang lawa gita' ineh, pangeh Ui nekali' namu.”
english: Nathaniel asked him, “How do you know what I am like?” Jesus replied, “I saw you before Philip called you, when you were by yourself under the fig tree.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Nataniel Neneh, "O Guru, Iko Anak Allah! Iko luk Raca' lun pupu Israil!”
english: Then Nathaniel declared, “Teacher, you must be ◄the Son of God/the person who is both God and man►! You are the King of Israel we have been waiting for!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Manuké iko ngaceku Ui mala kuanmu Ui nenier namu pa liang lawa gita' ineh? Iko miak nier luk meluun rayeh ratnan ini.”
english: Jesus replied to him, “You RHQ believe those things about me because I told you I saw you when you were under the fig tree. I was able to see you supernaturally even though I was far away from you. But you will see me do things that are more surprising than that!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh nedeh teh, "Matu Ui pebala nemuyuh, idi muyuh miak nier langit mukab, idi amung-amung melaikat Allah umak idi temurun luun Anak- Lemulun."
english: Then Jesus said to him, “This is the absolute truth: Just like what your ancestor Jacob saw long ago in a vision, some day you (pl) will see heaven opened up, and you will see God’s angels ascending from me and descending on me, the one who came from heaven.”

lun_bawang: Kareb abpa' anggur pangeh mabud, idi tinan Yésus nepebala Neneh, "Abpa' anggurdeh mabud.”
english: When the guests had drunk all the wine that was there, Jesus’ mother said to him, “The wine is all gone; can you do something about that?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, O Ina', aleg ngecuk Negku nganau' kudeng ineh. KarebKu ngegala' rayehKu nateh nacing.”
english: Jesus said to her, “Ma’am/Woman, ◄do not tell  me what to do!/why do you tell  me what to do?► RHQ It is not yet time MTY to show  that I am the Messiah by working miracles.”

lun_bawang: Idi tinanNeh nepebala inan amung-amung demulun, "Nganau' muyuh anun- anun luk dukenNeh nemuyuh.”
english: Then Jesus’ mother said to the servants, “Do whatever he tells you!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nelun duken ineh, "Do' manu' amung rubi ini ku abpa'." Idi ideh nenganau' abpa' pad macing mepanu'.
english: Jesus said to the servants, “Fill the jars with water!” So they filled the jars to the brim.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh nedeh, "Ngook nekini, idi nguit kuan lun rayeh irau ineh." Idi ideh nenguit ineh iné' neneh.
english: Then he told them, “Now, ladle out some of it and take it ◄to the head waiter/to the master of ceremonies►.” So the servants did that.

lun_bawang: idi keburi'neh neneh, "Anid-anid lemulun pekalai maré abpa' anggur luk do' atun, idi kareb lemulun pangeh musam ngirup, idi ieh maré luk na do' tu; iamo' iko nenganug abpa' anggur luk meluun do' macing nekini!”
english: and said to him, “Everyone else serves the best wine first. Then when the guests have drunk so much that they cannot tell the difference, they serve the cheap wine. But you have not done what others do. You have kept the best wine until now!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh nelun luk masui sukur ineh, "Iten muyuh amung ini rat ieni. Aleg muyuh nganau' ruma' TamanKu ini mangun ku luk inan masui idi melih.”
english: He said to those who were selling doves, “Take these doves away from here! Stop defiling my Father’s Temple by making it a market!”

lun_bawang: Idi anak-anak sekola'Neh nengerawé ratnan luk pangeh inayud, "Geriguen ngaceku ruma'Mu ngegio niatKu.”
english: Then we disciples remembered that these words had been written {that someone/David had written these words} in the Scriptures prophesying what the Messiah would say: “Others PRS will strongly oppose me because I greatly desire that people respect your Sacred Tent.”

lun_bawang: Idi lun rayeh-rayeh Yahudi nengedaluh Yésus, kebaladeh, "Anunké tanu' luk miak ruenMu pad ngegala' laludMu kuan kai?”
english: So one of the Jewish leaders SYN replied to him, “What miracle will you perform to show us that you have authority from God to do these things?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Ngusag Ruma' Allah ini, idi Ui sikal mudut neneh teh bang teluh aco kinioneh.”
english: Jesus replied to them, “If/When you destroy this temple, I will build it again within three days.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh, "Apat ngepulu' anem lak kinioneh lemulun mudut Ruma' Allah ini. Miakké Iko mudut neneh bang teluh aco mo'?”
english: So the Jewish leaders SYN said, “We have been building this Temple for 46 years and it is not finished yet! So ◄there is no way you will build it within three days!/how will you build it within three days?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Ieh iné' papu' Yésus kareb malem, idi nepebala Neneh, "O Guru, kai kali' Iko ini Guru luk nacing ratnan Allah. Ngaceku na luk idi seburur pana' miak nganau' amung tanu', mepad kudeng luk ianu'Mu, kudeng na Allah idi denganneh.”
english: He went to see Jesus at night, to talk to him about God’s kingdom. He said to Jesus, “Teacher, we believe that you are a teacher who has come from God. We believe this because we know that someone could perform the miracles you are doing only if God were helping him.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Matu, Ui pebala namu, kudeng selemulun na tinganak baruh, na ieh miak nier Imet Allah.”
english: Jesus replied to him, “Listen to this carefully: Unless people are born again and have a new life from God, they cannot even see the place where God rules MET!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Nikodimus, "Kudeng apehké seburur lemulun miak ruen nenganak kareb ieh pangeh rayeh? Miakké ieh semuet baruh bang nakan tinanneh, idi ruen nenganak teh?”
english: Then Nicodemus said to him, “◄No one can be born when he is old!/How can anyone be born when he is old?► RHQ ◄There is no way he can enter his mother’s womb and be born a second time!/How can he enter his mother’s womb and be born a second time?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Matu, Ui pebala namu, kudeng selemulun na tinganak ratnan abpa' idi Roh, na ieh miak semuet bang Imet Allah.
english: Jesus answered, “Note this: Being born naturally is not enough; people need to also be born spiritually by God’s Spirit. If that does not happen, they cannot experience God ruling MET their lives.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Nikodimus, "Kudeng apehké amung ineh miak mangun?”
english: Nicodemus replied to him, “How can that happen?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus, "Iko guru lun Israilké, idi na iko kali' ilung amung-amung ini?
english: Jesus replied to him, “You (sg) are a well-known teacher among us Israelite people, so ◄I am surprised that you do not understand these things!/how is it that you do not understand these things?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi ideh iné' ni Yahya idi nepebala neneh, "O Guru iko ngerawé lemulun ineh luk denganmu dipar Abpa' Yarden, luk pangeh bilamu? Ieh ngerereb lemulun nekini idi amung-amung lemulun amé' Neneh.”
english: Then those disciples went to John and said to him, “Teacher, do you remember the man who was with you when you were baptizing people on the other side of the Jordan River? He is the one you were telling us about. Well, now he is baptizing people, and many people are going to him instead of coming to us!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yahya, "Seburur pana' na miak ngalap anun-anun kudeng na barén Allah neneh.
english: John replied, “A person can become important only if God MTY permits it. So we should not be jealous about Jesus being popular!

lun_bawang: Ieh luk macing rat déi' dita', Ieh ineh luk meluun rayeh ratnan amung- amung. Lemulun luk ratnan tana' ini iniap kuan tana' ini teh idi pebala ratnan tana' ini. Ieh luk macing rat suraga, Ieh ineh pa luun amung-amung.
english: Jesus came from heaven. He is more important than anyone else. Those who are born from parents here on earth MTY are just humans, and they speak about things that happen here on the earth. But since Jesus came from heaven, his words are more important than anyone else’s.

lun_bawang: Idi seburur decur lun Samaria nacing sikal ngalap abpa' ineh; idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Ui mutuh ngirup." ( 8Ngaceku anak-anak sekola'Neh pangeh iné' melih luk kenen déi' bang bawang.)
english: Jesus replied to her, “If you (sg) knew what God wanted to give you, and if you knew who I am, the one who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked me, and I would have given you water that gives life.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala decur lun Samaria Neneh, "Kudeng apehké Iko ini seburur lun Yahudi mutuh luk rupen rat negku, seburur decur lun Samaria?" Ngaceku lun Yahudi na pamung akan dengan lun Samaria.
english: Our ancestor Jacob left us this well. He drank water from it, and there was enough good water so that his sons and his flocks of sheep and goats drank from it also. Do you claim that you are greater than Jacob, and because of that you can give us life-giving water?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, 'Kudeng iko kali' katu Allah idi idé Lemulun luk mutuh namu maré luk rupen, na miak na iko mutuh rat Neneh, pad Ieh maré abpa' luk mulun kuanmu.”
english: Jesus replied to her, “Everyone who drinks water from this well will later become thirsty again.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' decur ineh, "O Tuan, Iko na luk ku ngook abpa', idi subuk ini medalem. Rat iapehké Iko ngalap abpa' luk mulun ineh?
english: But those who drink the water that I will give them will never be thirsty again. On the contrary, the water that I give them will become in their inner beings like a spring of water that will enable them to have eternal life.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus, "Idé-idé luk ngirup abpa' ini, ieh miak meparing teh:
english: Jesus knew that she did not understand, but he wanted to show her by his God-given knowledge of her personal life that because he was the Messiah he could supply her spiritual need. So he said to her, “Woman, go and call your husband, and bring him here!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala decur ineh, "O Tuan, maré negku abpa' ineh, pad ui na meparing idi na merur amé' tungé ngook abpa'.”
english: It is also true that you have had five husbands one by one. And the man you are living with now is not your husband! What you have said is very true.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus neneh, "Amé' iko nawar awanmu, idi lemubed amé' tungé'.”
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive you must be a prophet because you are able to know people’s secrets.

lun_bawang: Kebala decur ineh, "Ui na awan." Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Matu balamu, iko na awan.
english: But let me ask you a different question: Our ancestors worshipped God here on Gerizim Mountain, but you Jews say that Jerusalem is the place where we must worship God. So who is right?”

lun_bawang: Kebala decur ineh, "O Tuan, ui kali' Iko seburur nabi.
english: You people from Samaria do not know the one you are worshipping. But we (exc) Jews know whom we worship, because it is from us Jews that God has sent the one who will save people from the guilt of their sins.

lun_bawang: Keburi' Yésus neneh, O decur, do' iko manu Negku, karebneh miak macing idi lemulun na miak sembayang inan Taman ineh luun surud ini idi déi' Yerusalim pana'.
english: God is a spiritual being. So it is necessary that those who worship him must worship him as his Spirit directs and according to God’s truth.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' decur ineh Neneh, "Ui kali' Mesias luk titen Keristus miak macing. Kareb Ieh macing, Ieh miak mada' netau ratnan luk amung-amung.”
english: The woman left her water jar there and went into the town. She said to the people there,

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus neneh,"Ui ini Ieh luk pegayam denganmu.”
english: “Come and see a man who was able to tell me all about my past life HYP, even though I never met him before Could this man be the Messiah?”

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh teh anak-anak sekola'Neh nacing; idi ideh mawa, ngaceku Yésus nepegayam dengan seburur decur. Iamo' seburur pana' na nengitun Neneh, "Anunké luk tekapenMu?" idi "Ngudehké Iko pebala neneh?”
english: So many people left the town and started going to where Jesus was.

lun_bawang: "Amé' muyuh nier lemulun luk mada' negku ratnan amung-amung luk inau'ku. Bakenké Ieh ini Keristus?”
english: But he said to us, “I have food to eat that you do not know anything about!”

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh teh kebala anak-anak sekola' ineh nan Yésus, "O Guru, kuman Iko.”
english: Jesus said to us, “Doing what my Father who sent me wants me to do and finishing the work he gave me to do is ◄what sustains me/like my food► MET.

lun_bawang: Iamo' keburi'Neh nedeh, "Ui inan luk kenen luk Ui sikal kuman luk na kali' muyuh.”
english: At this time of the year you are saying (OR, your ancestors used to say), ‘There are four months left before we harvest the crops.’ But I say to you, look carefully at the non-Jewish people around here. God says, ‘They are ready to accept my message MET, like crops in fields that are ready for people to harvest.

lun_bawang: Idi anak-anak sekola' nepebala seburur dengan seburur, "Inanké lemulun nenguit luk kenen kuanNeh?”
english: If you help them to accept my message, I will reward you MET, as an owner of a field pays those who harvest the crops. Because of your work, people will gain eternal life.’ I have been telling people God’s message. That is like MET a man who plants seeds. You will help people to accept my message. That will be like MET harvesting crops. When that happens, both you and I will rejoice.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "AkanKu, ieh ineh nganau' luk pianNeh luk nengecuk Negku, idi ngeriput kekamenNeh.
english: As a result, this saying will become true: One person plants seeds, but others harvest the crops.

lun_bawang: Mula' lun Samaria bang bawang ineh manu inan Yésus, ngaceku ratnan bala decur luk nepebala, "Ieh nemada' negku ratnan amung-amung luk inau'ku.”
english: They told the woman, “We believe in Jesus now, but not just  because of what you told us. Now we have heard him ourselves. And now we know that this man truly is the one who can  save people MTY from the guilt of their sins.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh nan decur ineh, "Nekini kai manu, baken ngaceku luk bilamu mo', iamo' kai sebuleng pangeh neninger balaNeh idi kai nekali', idi Ieh ineh Lun Nengulun tana' ini.”
english: Jesus went again to Cana in Galilee district. That was where he previously turned water into wine. There was one of the king’s officials who lived in Capernaum, whose son was very sick.

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus neneh, "Kudeng na muyuh nier tanu' idi kekamen luk nan mawa, na tu muyuh manu.”
english: He asked them, “At what time did my son start to become well?” They said to him, “His fever ceased yesterday afternoon at one o’clock.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun tareh raca' ineh, "O Tuan, amé' Iko kareb nateh anakku maté.”
english: Then the boy’s father realized that this was the time Jesus told him, “Your son will ◄live/not die►.” So he and all the people in his house believed that Jesus was the Messiah.

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus neneh, "Amé' iko, anakmu ineh mulun." Idi lemulun ineh manu ku bala Yésus ineh, idi ieh iné'.
english: That was the second miracle that Jesus performed in Galilee district, after he had returned from Judea district.

lun_bawang: Idi déi' Yerusalim muneng ku "Tanga' Dumba" inan aceh takung, maya' buri' Iberani titen Betesda, idi takung ineh inan limeh tadur.
english: At one of the gates into the city called the Sheep Gate, there is a pool. In our language we call it Bethzatha. Around the pool were five open areas with roofs over them.

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus nenier nedeh telubid déi', idi nekali' ieh pangeh mét mio kudeng ineh, idi Ieh nepebala neneh, "Sikalké iko do' ratnan étmu?”
english: The paralyzed man replied to him, “Yes, sir, I want to get well, but there is no one to help me get down into the pool when the water is stirred {stirs}. While I am trying to get to the pool, someone else always gets there before me.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun luk mét ineh, "O Tuan, na lemulun luk miak nguit negku semuet bang takung ini kareb abpa'neh melipu', iamo' kareb ui macing, lun baken pangeh netemurun nengili negku.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Get up! Then pick up your mat and walk!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus neneh, "Tumui iko idi nguit ugammu idi nalan!”
english: The man immediately was healed. He picked up his mat and started walking! The day on which this happened was a Jewish day of rest.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh lun Yahudi nepebala kuan lemulun luk dino' ineh, "Aco sini Aco luk inan Mudeng, bibpeng kuanmu na miak nguit ugammu ineh.”
english: The man replied to them, “The man who healed me, he himself said to me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk!’”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebalaneh, "Kebala lemulun luk nengedo' negku ini, 'Nguit ugammu idi nalan.' “
english: They asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Pick it up and walk!’?”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengitun neneh, keburi'deh, "Idéké lemulun ineh luk nemala kuanmu, 'Nguit ugammu idi nalan'?”
english: But since Jesus had disappeared in the crowd without telling the man his name, the man did not know who it was who had healed him.

lun_bawang: Muci ratnan ineh Yésus nepapu' neneh bang Ruma' Allah, idi nepebala neneh, "Nekini iko pangeh do'. Aleg nganau' sala' peh, pad iko na mekaneh luk meluun dat.”
english: The man went away and told the Jewish leaders SYN that it was Jesus who had healed him.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus nedeh, "TamanKu ngakem kidi-kidi, idi Ui pana' ngakem teh.”
english: The Jewish leaders SYN considered that he was disobeying their rules about ◄the Sabbath/the day of rest►, and that by saying that God was his Father, he was making himself equal with God. And they considered that both these things were grounds for killing him. So they tried even harder to find a way to kill him.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Matu, Ui pebala nemuyuh, Anak ineh na miak nganau' anun-anun luk maya' pianNeh sebuleng, iamo' Ieh nier luk ruen Taman ineh. Anun-anun luk inau' Taman, ineh teh luk ruen Anak ineh.
english: My Father loves me, and he shows me everything that he is doing. He will show me the miracles that he wants me to do that will be greater than the ones that you have already seen me do, so that you may be amazed.

lun_bawang: "Matu, Ui pebala nemuyuh, lemulun luk ninger balaKu idi manu inan Luk nengecuk Negku, ieh ineh ngalap ulun luk meruked, idi na semuet bang ukum, iamo' ieh pangeh pinuit ratnan até amé' inan ulun.
english: Listen to this carefully: There will be a time when those who are ◄spiritually dead/separated from God► will hear the voice of me, ◄the Son of God/the man who is also God►. In fact, it is that time already. Those who hear and pay attention to my message will have eternal life.

lun_bawang: "Kudeng Ui maré kali' ratnan bururKu sebuleng, idi luk nekali'Ku ineh na matu.
english: But there is someone else who tells people about me. And I know that what he tells people about me is true.

lun_bawang: Muyuh ngelio Surat Allah, ngaceku bang terawé muyuh bang ineh muyuh miak ngalap ulun luk meruked. Idi Surat ineh teh maré kali' ratnan Ui.
english: But you refuse ◄to come to me/to believe my message► in order that you may have eternal life.

lun_bawang: Aleg muyuh ngerawé Ui ini sikal ngadu' nemuyuh pa kiung Taman ineh. Inan selemulun luk ngadu' nemuyuh, ieh ineh Musa luk inan muyuh merapet.
english: Moses wrote about me, so if you had believed what he wrote, you would have believed what I said

lun_bawang: Yésus nenier libut-libutneh idi nekali' mula' lemulun amé' Neneh, idi kebalaNeh ni Pilipus, "Rat iapehké tau melih ruti, pad lun mula' ini kuman?" ( 6Idi Yésus nepebala kudeng ineh ngaceku sikal nutun neneh, ngaceku Ie sebuleng kali' luk miak ruenNeh.)
english: He said to Philip, “Where will we buy food for all these people to eat?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Pilipus Neneh, "Ruti luk dueh ngeratu rigit raganeh na petap kuan lemulun ini, sagan pana' panid sesuut.”
english: Philip replied to him, “Even if we had the amount of money a man earns in eight months, that would not be enough to buy bread so that each person could have a little bit!”

lun_bawang: "Tungé' inan aceh anak luk inan limeh balad ruti ikun idi dueh lawid; iamo' anunké ulekneh ineh kuan lun mula' ini?”
english: “There is a boy here who has five small barley loaves and two cooked fish. But ◄they will not help much among so many people!/what good will that do among so many people?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yésus, "Ngecuk lun mula' ineh tudo." Ngaceku su luk inandeh ineh mula' uduh; idi kinula' deléi luk netudo lélé limeh ngeribu burur.
english: Jesus said, “Tell the people to sit down!” There was plenty of grass there, so they all sat down comfortably. There were about 5,000 men among the crowd.

lun_bawang: Kareb amung-amungdeh mebor, idi Yésus nepebala inan anak-anak sekola'Neh, "Ngamung amung-amung tecehneh, pad sesuut pana' na talan.”
english: When everyone had all the food they wanted, he said to us disciples, “Gather up the pieces that are left over. Do not let anything be wasted!”

lun_bawang: Kareb lun mula' pangeh nenier tanu' luk inau' Yésus, idi keburi'deh, "Matu Ieh ini nabi luk macing bang tana' ini.”
english: After the people saw that miracle that Jesus had performed, many of them started to say, “Surely this is the prophet like Moses that God promised to send to the world!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus nedeh, "Ui ini, aleg matot.”
english: But he said to us, “Do not be afraid! It is I!”

lun_bawang: Kareb lun mula' nepanu' Yésus dipar takung ineh, idi ideh nepebala Neneh, "O Guru, idanké Iko nacing tungé?”
english: When they found him in Capernaum further around the lake, they asked him, “Teacher, since you(sg) did not come in a boat, when and how did you get here?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Matu, Ui pebala nemuyuh, muyuh ini nakap Negku baken ngaceku muyuh kali' ilung kekamenKu luk melalud, iamo' ngaceku muyuh nekuman ruti pad macing mebor.
english: Jesus replied to them, “Listen to this carefully: Do you know why you are looking for me? It is not because you saw me perform miracles and as a result have realized who I really am. No! You are looking for me only because you had plenty of bread to eat after I provided it for you by performing a miracle.

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh Neneh, "Anunké luk miak ruen kai pad kai nganau' kekamen Allah?”
english: Then the people asked him, “What things should we do to please God?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Ini luk pian Alah ruen muyuh, do' muyuh manu Neneh luk icuk Allah ineh.”
english: Jesus replied, “What God wants you to do is this: He wants you to believe that I am the one he has sent.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh Neneh, "Anunké tanu' luk ruenMu, pad kai miak nier idi manu Namu? Anunké luk ruenMu?
english: So they said to him, “Then perform another miracle so that we may see it and believe that you came from God. What miracle would you like to perform?

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Matu, Ui pebala nemuyuh, baken Musa luk nemaré ruti rat déi' surga ineh, iamo' TamanKu luk nemaré kuan muyuh Ruti luk matu ineh rat surga.
english: So Jesus said to them, “The truth is that it was not Moses who gave your ancestors that food from heaven. No, it was my Father who gave it to them. And my Father is the one who gives you the true food from heaven.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh Neneh, "O Tuan, do' megéi' maré Ruti ini kuan kai.”
english: Not understanding what he meant, they said to him, “Sir, give us that kind of bread all the time!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Ui ini Ruti Ulun ineh; lemulun luk macing Negku, na ieh miak melau peh, idi lemulun luk manu Negku, na ieh miak meparing teh.
english: Jesus said to them, “Just like food MET sustains physical life, I am the one who enables you to have spiritual life. Those who eat ordinary food and drinks will later be hungry and thirsty. But those who come to me to receive that life will never again lack anything spiritually.

lun_bawang: Idi lun Yahudi ngedureng Neneh, ngaceku Ieh nepebala, "Ui ini Ruti luk netemurun rat surga.”
english: The Jewish leaders SYN began to grumble about him because he said, “I am the one who is like true bread who came down from heaven.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh, "Bakenké lun ini Yésus, anak Yusup? Kai kali' taman- tinanNeh. Kudeng apehké Ieh pebala, 'Ui temurun rat déi' surga'?”
english: They said, “◄This man is Jesus, the son of Joseph!/Isn’t this man the son of Joseph?► RHQ We know the names of both his father and his mother. He certainly did not come from heaven, so ◄he is lying by saying ‘I came from heaven.’/why is he now saying, ‘I came from heaven?’► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Aleg muyuh dureng-dureg arang muyuh sebuleng!
english: Jesus replied to them, “Stop grumbling among yourselves about what I just said!

lun_bawang: Idi lun Yahudi nepekedaluh arangdeh sebuleng idi nepebala, "Kudeng apehké lun ini miak amré bururNeh kenen kai?”
english: Then the Jewish leaders SYN began to argue among themselves. They said, “◄There is no way this man can give us his flesh to eat!/How can this man give us his flesh to eat?►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Matu, Ui pebala nemuyuh, kudeng muyuh na kuman burur Anak-Lemulun idi ngirup dara'Neh, na muyuh miak ngalap ulun bang burur muyuh.
english: So, speaking figuratively of the need for them to accept for themselves the benefits of his sacrificing himself and shedding his blood to atone for their sins MET, Jesus said to them, “Listen carefully to this: Although I am the one who came from heaven, if you do not eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will not have eternal life.

lun_bawang: Mula' Anak sekola'Neh neninger bala ineh kudeng ini, idi kebaladeh, "Mikat kali' ilung bala ini. Idéké luk miak ninger ineh?”
english: After they heard him say that, many of his disciples said, “What he is teaching is hard to understand; ◄it is very difficult for anyone to accept it!/how can anyone accept it?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Yésus kali' anak-anak sekola'Neh dureng-dureng ratnan bala ini, idi kebalaNeh nedeh, "Muyuh mesabeng ku bala iniké?
english: Jesus was aware that his disciples were grumbling about it, so he said to them, “◄I am sorry that this is offending you./Is this offending you?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'Neh, "Ini punneh Ui nepebala nemuyuh, idi seburur pana' na miak macing Negku kudeng na ratnan Taman.”
english: Then he continued by saying, “That is why I told you that only those whom my Father has enabled to believe in me will come to me and receive eternal life.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nan pulu' dueh anak sekola'Neh ineh, "Inanké muyuh pian necan Negku?”
english: So he said to us twelve apostles, “You do not want to leave me also, do you?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Simun Pétrus Neneh, "O Tuhan, amé' nidéké kai? BalaMu mo' luk maré ulun luk meruked.
english: Simon Peter replied to him, “Lord, we will not leave you, because ◄there is no other person like you to whom we can go!/what other person is there like you to whom we can go?► RHQ You have the message about eternal life!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Bakenké Ui nemili' nemuyuh luk pulu' dueh burur ini? Iamo' inan seburur rat arang muyuh luk mangun ku sétan.”
english: Then Jesus replied to us, “You are saying that as though all you twelve men whom I have chosen RHQ believe that. But one of you is under the control of Satan!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala kinanak-kinanakNeh Neneh, "Nalan rat ieni, idi amé' tana' Yudia, pad anak-anak sekola'Mu miak nier amung-amung kekamen luk ruenMu.
english: Jesus’ younger brothers said to him, “Since many people here have left you, you should leave and go to Judea province and perform some miracles there, so that your disciples may see them!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "KarebKu ngegala' rayehKu nateh nacing; iamo' kareb muyuh ineh idi kidi-kidi.
english: So Jesus said to them, “It is not yet time for me MTY to go to the celebration. For you, any time is right to go to the celebration.

lun_bawang: Lun Yahudi nenakap Neneh bang irau ineh idi nepebala, 'Iapehké Ieh?”
english: At the celebration, the Jewish leaders were looking for him. They were asking people, “Has Jesus come?”

lun_bawang: Idi lun mula' pelaba dureng ratnan Yésus. Idi inan luk pebala, "Ieh lemulun luk do'," idi lun baken nepebala, 'Baken, iamo' Ieh naluk nelun mula' ineh.”
english: Among the crowds, many people were whispering about Jesus. Some were saying, “He is a good man!” But others were saying instead, “No! He is deceiving the crowds!”

lun_bawang: Idi lun Yahudi mawa, keburi'deh, "Kudeng apehké lemulun ini kali' surat dengan na nesibada'?”
english: The Jewish elders were amazed at what he was saying. They said, “This man never studied in one of our religious schools! So ◄how can he have learned so much about Scripture?/it is difficult for us to believe that he has learned so much about Scripture!► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Bada'Ku ineh baken rat Negku, iamo' ratnan Allah luk nengecuk Negku.
english: Jesus replied to them, “What I teach does not come from myself. It comes from God, the one who sent me.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun mula', "Iko sinuet ada'. Idéké nakap dalan sikal ngaté Namu?”
english: Someone in the crowd answered, “By saying this you show that you are crazy (OR, A demon is controlling you)! Certainly no one is trying to kill you!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Ui nenganau' aceh kekamen luk melalud, idi amung muyuh mawa ku ineh.
english: Jesus replied to them, “Because I did a miracle of healing someone ◄on the Sabbath/on the Jewish rest day►, you are all shocked.

lun_bawang: Inan tuda'-tuda' lemulun rat Yerusalim luk nepebala, "Bakenké Ieh ini luk tekapen lun Yahudi, pad Ieh pitayendeh?
english: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “◄This is the man that they are trying to kill!/Isn’t this the man that they are trying to kill?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus nemada' bang Ruma' Allah, idi Ieh nengitang, kebalaNeh, "Matuké muyuh ngiti Negku; inanké muyuh kali' rat iapeh iratKu? Ui na macing maya' pianKu sebuleng. Ieh luk nengecuk Negku ineh matu, idi muyuh na ngiti Neneh.
english: They said that because they thought Jesus was born in Nazareth. So while Jesus was teaching people in the Temple courtyard, he shouted, “Yes, you say that you know me, and you think you know IRO where I am from. But I have come here not ◄because I appointed myself/with my own authority►. Instead, God is the one who truly sent me. You do not know him.

lun_bawang: Iamo' mula' lemulun rat arang lun mula' ineh manu Neneh, idi nepebala, "Kareb Keristus macing, miakké Ieh nganau' tanu' meluun ula' ratnan luk inau' lemulun ini?”
english: But many of the crowd believed that he had come from God. They said, “When the Messiah comes, he certainly will not do more miracles than this man has done, will he?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Segageh mo' kinioneh Ui tudo dengan muyuh, idi Ui amé' Neneh luk nengecuk Negku.
english: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you for only a short time. Then I will return to the one who sent me.

lun_bawang: Idi lun Yahudi nepebala arangdeh sebuleng, "Iapehké ulek lemulun ini pad tau na miak ngalap Neneh? Sikalké Ieh amé' bawang lun Grika su luk inan lun Yahudi tebawang pad Ieh mada' nelun Grika?
english: So the Jewish leaders SYN said to themselves, “Where is this man about to go with the result that we will not be able to find him? Some Jewish people have dispersed and live among Greek people. He is not intending to go and live among them and teach them, is he?

lun_bawang: Aco luk kekiped bang irau ineh, ieh ineh aco luk meluun rayeh. Bang aco sineh Yésus netuped idi nengitang, kebalaNeh, "Kudeng idé lemulun luk meparing, do' ieh macing Negku idi ngirup.
english: On each of the seven days of the celebration, the high priest poured out some water on the altar in the Temple to remember how God provided water for the people in the desolate area long ago. But the water he poured did not help anyone who was thirsty. So on the last day of the festival, which was the most important day, Jesus stood up in the Temple courtyard and said with a loud voice, “Those who are thirsty should come to me to drink what I will give them.

lun_bawang: Mula' lemulun neninger bala ini, idi ideh nepebala, "Matu Ieh ini nabi ineh!”
english: When some of the crowd heard those words, they said, “Surely this man is the prophet whom God promised to send who would be like Moses!”

lun_bawang: Lun baken nepebala, "Ieh ini Keristus." Inan teh lun baken nepebala, "Keristus na miak macing rat Galilia!
english: Others said, “He is the Messiah!” But others, thinking Jesus was born in Galilee, said, “The Messiah will not come from Galilee province, will he?

lun_bawang: Idi lun pulis ineh nelemubed iné' inan imam-imam rayeh idi lun Parisi luk nengitun nedeh, kebaladeh, "Ngudehké muyuh na nenguit Neneh?”
english: So the Temple guards returned to the chief priests and the Pharisees, the ones who had sent them to arrest Jesus. They said to the guards, “Why did you not seize him and bring him here?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' lun pulis ineh, "Nateh lemulun nepebala mepad kudeng lemulun ini.”
english: They replied, “No one ever spoke such amazing things as this man does!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun Parisi nedeh, "Pangehké muyuh rinaruhNeh?
english: Then the Pharisees replied, “Have you been deceived {Has he deceived you}, too?

lun_bawang: "Maya' Ukum tau, tau na miak ngukum selemulun kareb nateh neninger luk inau' idi luk belénneh.”
english: “We have not listened to what he says to find out what he is doing. ◄It is not permitted in our Jewish law PRS for us to say, before questioning someone, that we must punish him!/Is it permitted in our Jewish law PRS for us to say, before questioning someone, that we must punish him?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "Iko rat Galilia teh? Ngelio bang Surat Allah! Inanké nabi luk macing rat Galilia?"
english: They replied to him, “◄Are you another disgusting person from Galilee?/You talk like another disgusting person from Galilee!► RHQ Read what is written in the Scriptures You will find that no prophet comes from Galilee province, like he does!”

lun_bawang: idi nepebala nan Yésus, "O Guru, decur ini kikem uned pasét.
english: Then they said to Jesus, “Teacher, this woman was seized {we seized this woman} while she was having sex with a man who is not her husband.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kareb ideh ngitun Neneh, Ieh netuped idi nepebala nedeh, "Idé-idé rat arang muyuh luk na nenganau' sala' do' ieh mitung decur ini ku batu atun.”
english: While they continued to question him, he stood up and said to them, “Whichever one of you has never sinned can be the first one to start throwing stones at her.”

lun_bawang: Yésus netuped, idi nepebala neneh, "O decur, iapehké ideh? Naké seburur neketecan teh luk ngukum namu?”
english: Jesus stood up and asked her, “Woman, where are they? Has no one said you must die for your sin?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' decur ineh, "Seburur pana' nateh, O Tuhan." Idi keburi' Yésus neneh, "Ui ini pana' nateh sikal ngukum namu. Muli' iko, idi aleg nganau' sala' peh."]
english: She said, “No, sir, no one.” Then Jesus said, “I do not condemn you either. Go home now, and do not continue your sinful life any longer!”

lun_bawang: Yésus nemada' nedeh teh, kebalaNeh, "Ui ini Acang Tana'. Idé-idé luk maya' Negku miak ngalap acang luk maré ulun, idi na ieh miak nalan bang dacem.”
english: Jesus spoke to the people again. He said, “I am like a light MET for all the people in MTY the world. Just like a light reveals what has been in the darkness MET, I reveal God’s truth to them. Those who walk in the darkness are unaware of what is around them. But those who become my disciples will always be aware of God’s truth MET. They will have my light which shows them how to have eternal life.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' lun Parisi Neneh, "Iko maré kali' ratnan bururMu sebuleng; luk nekali'Mu ineh na matu.”
english: So the Pharisees said to him, “You are just telling about yourself! Since there is no one else to verify these things that you say about yourself, we do not need to accept that what you say is true.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Sagan pana' Ui maré kali' ratnan bururKu sebuleng, matu teh luk nekali'Ku ineh, ngaceku Ui kali' rat iapeh Ui nacing idi iapeh ulekKu, iamo' muyuh ini ka kali' rat iapeh Ui nacing idi iapeh ulekKu.
english: Jesus replied, “Even if I were the only one to say these things about myself, what I say is true, because I know that I came from heaven, and I know that I am going back to heaven. But you do not know where I came from or where I am going.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh Neneh, "Iapehké TamanMu?" Idi kebala Yésus, "Muyuh na miti Negku idi TamanKu pana' muyuh na miti. Kudeng muyuh miti Negku, kali' rungen muyuh miti TamanKu teh.”
english: Then they asked him, “If you have a father whom we can question about you, where is he?” Jesus replied, “You do not know who I really am. If you knew who I really am, you would know who my Father is also.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh teh, "Ui ini amé', idi muyuh sikal nakap Negku, iamo' muyuh miak maté bang sala' muyuh. Muyuh na miak macing su luk inanKu amé'.”
english: Jesus also said to them, “I will soon be going away. Then at the end of your life you will seek me, but you will die without God forgiving your sins. Where I will go, you will not be able to come.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' lun Yahudi, "KebalaNeh, 'Muyuh na miak macing su luk inanKu amé'.' Ieh sikal peripatéké?”
english: So the Jewish leaders said among themselves, “Is he going to kill himself? Is that the reason that he said, ‘Where I go, you will not be able to come’?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Muyuh ini rat pa liang, Ui ini rat déi' dita'. Muyuh ini ratnan tana' ini, Ui ini baken ratnan tana' ini.
english: But Jesus continued by saying to them, “You were born here in this world, but I came from heaven. You belong to those who are opposed to God MTY. I do not belong to them.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh Neneh, "Idéké Iko ini?" Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Anunké ulekneh Ui pebala kuan muyuh teh.
english: So they said to him, “You! Who do you think you are?” Jesus said to them, “Ever since I began teaching, I have been telling you who I am!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Kareb muyuh ngikit Anak-Lemulun, idi muyuh miak kali' Ui ini Ieh, idi teh muyuh miak kali' idi sebuleng pana' na Ui nganau' maya' pianKu sebuleng, iamo' mepad kudeng TamanKu nemada' Negku, kudeng ineh teh luk belénKu.
english: So Jesus said, “I am the one who came down from heaven, but when you lift me up on a cross to kill me, you will know who I am. You will also know that I do not do anything with my own authority. Instead, I say just what my Father has taught me.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nelun Yahudi luk manu Neneh, "Kudeng muyuh maya' balaKu, idi dengan matu muyuh mangun ku anak-anak sekola'ku,
english: Then Jesus said to the Jews who now said they believed in him, “If you continue to live in accordance with my message, you will truly be my disciples.

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "Kai ini mupun Ibrahim, idi nateh kai mangun ku demulun seburur pana', kudeng apehké balaMu, 'Muyuh miak mepuit'?”
english: They replied to him, “We are descendants of Abraham. We have never been anyone’s slaves. So why do you say we will be freed from being someone’s slaves?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Matu, Ui pebala nemuyuh, idé-idé luk nganau' sala', ieh ineh luk demulun sala'.
english: Jesus replied, “Listen carefully to what I am going to tell you. All those who continue to sin are forced to obey their sinful desires MET, just like a slave is forced to obey his master.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengor balaNeh, keburi'deh, "Ibrahim, ieh luk taman kai." Idi keburi' Yésus nedeh, "Kudeng muyuh anak Ibrahim, kali' rungen muyuh sikal nganau' teh amung-amung kekamen Ibrahim.
english: They replied to him, “Abraham is our ancestor.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s descendants, your character would be like Abraham’s character, and you would do good things like Abraham did.

lun_bawang: Muyuh ini nganau' kekamen taman muyuh." Idi keburi'deh Neneh, "Baken kai tinganak ratnan sét. Inan sebuleng Taman kai, ieh ineh Allah.”
english: No! You are doing the things that your real father does.” They said to him, “We do not know about you, but we are not illegitimate children. And spiritually, we have only one Father. That is God, and you do not know who your father is!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Kudeng Allah ineh Taman muyuh, kali' rungen muyuh mawa Negku, ngaceku Ui pangeh nacing ratnan Allah, idi nekini Ui idi ieni. Na Ui nacing maya' pianKu sebuleng, iamo' Ieh luk nengecuk Negku.
english: Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, because I came from God, and now I have come here to this world. My coming was not ◄because I appointed myself/with my own authority►. He sent me.

lun_bawang: Idi lun Yahudi nengor bala Yésus, keburi'deh, "Bakenké matu luk bila kai, Iko seburur lun Samaria, idi Iko sinuet ada'?”
english: The Jewish leaders SYN replied to him, “◄We are certainly right by saying that you believe what is false as the Samaritans do!/Are we not right by saying that you believe what is false as the Samaritans do?► RHQ And that ◄a demon/an evil spirit► controls you!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Ui na sinuet ada'. Ui ngedita' TamanKu, iamo' muyuh ngedat Negku.
english: Jesus replied, “A demon does not control me! I honor my Father, and you do not honor me!

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' lun Yahudi Neneh, "Nekini kai kali' idi Iko sinuet ada'. Ibrahim idi amung-amung nabi pangeh naté. Iamo' Iko ini pebala, 'Kudeng idé lemulun maya' balaKu na ieh miak maté.'
english: Then the Jewish leaders SYN, thinking that he was talking about ordinary death and not about spiritual death, said to him, “Now we are sure that a demon controls you! Abraham and the prophets died long ago! But you say that anyone who obeys what you teach will never die!

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus, "Kudeng Ui ngerayeh bururKu sebuleng, kali' rungen rayehKu na ulek. Iamo' luk ngerayeh Negku, ieh ineh TamanKu luk belén muyuh Allah muyuh.
english: Jesus replied, “If I were honoring myself, that would be worthless. My Father is the one who you say is your God. He is the one who honors me.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' lun Yahudi Neneh, "UlunMu nateh limeh ngepulu' lak, idi Iko pangeh nenier Ibrahimké?”
english: Then the Jewish leaders SYN said to him, “You are not 50 years old yet! So ◄you certainly did not see him!/how could you have seen him?► RHQ Because he died long ago!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Matu, Ui pebala nemuyuh, kareb nateh Ibrahim tinganak, Ui ini pangeh idi.”
english: Jesus said to them, “The truth is that I existed before Abraham was born!”

lun_bawang: Idi anak-anak sekola'Neh nengitun Neneh, keburi'deh, "O Guru, idéké luk nenganau' sala', lemulun iniké kian taman-tinanneh lek, pad ieh mebuser rat bang batek tinanneh?”
english: We disciples asked him, “Teacher, was this man blind from when he was born because his parents sinned or because he himself sinned?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Baken lemulun ini nebuser ngaceku sala'neh sebuleng idi sala' taman-tinanneh, iamo' pad lalud Allah miak uen ngegala' bang ulunneh.
english: Jesus replied, “His being blind was not because he or his parents sinned. Instead, he has been blind in order that people can see the power of God {the power of God can be seen} as a result of what will now happen to him.

lun_bawang: idi nepebala neneh, "Amé' iko sibaru' déi' bang Takung Siloam!" (Ilung Siloam bang buri' Iberani, ieh ineh "Icuk.") Idi ieh iné' sibaru', idi nelemubed dengan matehneh nedo.'
english: Then he said to him, “Go and wash in Siloam pool!” (That name means ‘sent;’ just like they sent the water by a channel into the pool, God sent Jesus). So the man went and washed in the pool, and when he went home he was able to see!

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' lun bang bawangneh idi lun baken pana' luk nekali' neneh atun mutuh mo', "Bakenké ieh ini lun luk tudo mutuh mo'?”
english: His neighbors and others who previously had seen him when he was begging said, “He is the man who used to sit here and beg, isn’t he?”

lun_bawang: Inan luk nepebala, "Ini ieh." Inan teh luk nepebala, "Baken, iamo' ayuneh mepad kudeng ieh." Lemulun ineh sebuleng nepebala, "Ui ini ieh.”
english: Some said, “Yes, he is.” Others said, “No, he is not. It is just a man who looks like him!” But the man himself said, “Yes, I am that man!”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh neneh, "Kudeng apehké matehmu nedo'?”
english: So they said to him, “How is it that now you can see?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh, "Inan selemulun ngadanNeh Yésus nenganau' tana' ineh mesalit, idi nemiid luun matehku idi nepebala, 'Amé' iko sibaru' déi' Takung Siloam.' Idi ui pana' iné' sibaru' déi', idi ui miak nier.”
english: He replied, “The man whose name is Jesus made some mud and put it on my eyes. Then he told me to go to Siloam pool and wash. So I went there and washed, and then I could see.”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengitun neneh, keburi'deh, "Iapehké lemulun ineh?" Idi keburi'neh, "Ui na kali'.”
english: They said to him, “Where is that man now?” He said, “I do not know.”

lun_bawang: Idi lun Parisi nengitun neneh sekua' teh, kudeng apehké ieh nier. Idi keburi'neh nedeh, "Ieh nenganau' tana' salit luun matehku, idi ui nesibaru' idi nenier.”
english: So the Pharisees also asked that man, “How did you become able to see?” He said to them, “The man put mud on my eyes. Then I washed, and now I can see!”

lun_bawang: Idi sebuang lun Parisi ineh nepebala, "Lemulun ini baken ratnan Allah, ngaceku Ieh na maya' ukum Aco luk inan Mudeng." Idi inan teh lemulun luk pebala, "Kudeng apehké seburur lun mesala' miak nganau' tanu'-tanu' luk kudeng ineh?" Idi ideh pekedaluh arangdeh sebuleng.
english: So some of the Pharisees said, “Since this man Jesus disobeys our rules about working ◄on the Sabbath/on the Jewish rest day►, he is not from God.” But others said, “If he was a sinner, ◄he could certainly not do such miracles!/how could he do such miracles?► RHQ” So they were divided.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh ideh nengitun neneh sekua'teh, "Anunké luk belénmu ratnan Ieh? Ngaceku Ieh pangeh nengedo' matehmu?" Idi ieh nengor baladeh, keburi'neh, "Ieh ineh nabi.”
english: So one of them said to the blind man again, “You are the man whom he enabled to see. What do you yourself say about him?” The man said, “I think he is a prophet!” So they told him to go.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengitun nedidueh, keburi'deh, "Matuké, ieh ini anak medueh, luk bila medueh nebuser rat bang batek? Kudeng apehké ieh miak nier nekini?”
english: When they got there, one of the Jewish leaders asked them, “Is that man your son? Do you say that he was blind when he was born? If that is true, how is he now able to see?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala taman-tinanneh, "Kai miti neneh idi ieh ini luk anak kai, idi teh ieh nebuser rat bang batek.
english: His parents replied, “We know that he is our son. We know that he was blind when he was born.

lun_bawang: Ineh punneh taman-tinanneh nepebala, "Ieh pangeh rayeh, do' ngitun neneh sebuleng.”
english: That is the reason that they said, “He is old enough to answer questions, so ask him!”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nenawar lun luk nebuser ineh sekua' teh, idi nepebala neneh, "Do' iko mada' luk matu pa kiung Allah! Kai ini kali', idi lemulun ineh lun mesala'.”
english: So they sent someone to bring back to them the man who had been blind. When he got there, the Jewish leaders said to him, “Knowing that God is listening IDM, tell the truth! We know that the man who healed you is a sinner.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengor baladeh, keburi'neh, "Kudeng Ieh seburur lun mesala' ui na kali', iamo' sebuleng mo' luk ui kali', idi atun ui nebuser, idi nekini ui nier.”
english: He replied, “I do not know if he is a sinner or not. But one thing I do know is that I was blind, but now I can see!”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh neneh, "Anunké luk inau'Neh kuanmu? Kudeng apehké Ieh nengedo' matehmu?”
english: So they said to him, “What did he do to you? How did he enable you to see?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'neh nedeh, "Pangeh ui nemala kuan muyuh, iamo' na muyuh neninger. Anunké punneh muyuh sikal ninger sekua' teh? Sikalké muyuh mangun ku anak sekola'Neh?”
english: He replied, “I told you that already, but you did not RHQ pay attention! Why do you want to hear me tell you again? ◄Do you also want to become his disciples?/You talk as though IRO you also want to become his disciples RHQ►.”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengedat neneh, kebaladeh, "Iko ini luk anak sekola'Neh, iamo' kai ini anak sekola' Musa.
english: Then they insulted him angrily. They said, “You are that man’s disciple, but we are Moses’ disciples!

lun_bawang: Idi lemulun ineh nengor baladeh, keburi'neh, "Ui mawa ku ineh, muyuh na kali' rat iapeh Ieh nacing sagan pana' Ieh nengedo' matehku.
english: The man replied, “That is very surprising! You say that you do not know where he gets any authority. But he enabled me to see!

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengor balaneh, keburi'deh, "Matu iko ini tinganak bang sala', idi iko sikal mada' nekaiké?" Idi ideh nenala' neneh rat bang ruma' sembayang.
english: They replied to him, “You ◄were born as a result of your parents’ sin EUP/bastard►! ◄Do you think you are qualified to teach us?/You are not qualified to teach us!► RHQ” Then they threw him out of the synagogue.

lun_bawang: Yésus neninger ratnan lemulun ineh pangeh tila'deh. Idi Ieh nenakap neneh kebalaNeh, "Manuké iko inan Anak Allah?”
english: Jesus heard people say that they had thrown that man out. He found the man and said to him, “Do you believe that the one who came down from heaven is the Messiah?”

lun_bawang: Idi lemulun ineh nengor balaNeh, "Idéké Ieh ineh, O Guru,pad ui miak manu Neneh?”
english: The man answered, “Sir, who is he? Tell me, in order that I may believe in him.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Yésus neneh, "Iko pangeh nenier Neneh, idi luk pebala denganmu, ieh ineh Ieh.”
english: Jesus said to him, “You have seen him. In fact, it is I, the one who am speaking to you.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'neh, "O Tuhan, ui manu." Idi ieh netekeradung pa kiung Yésus.
english: The man said, “Lord, I believe that you are the Messiah!” Then he knelt down before Jesus and worshipped him.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Ui macing bang tana' ini pad mutut ukum luk matu, pad lemulun luk na nier miak nier, idi lemulun luk nier ineh mangun mebuser.”
english: Jesus said, “I have come into this world to judge the people in the world. The result will be that those who realize that they do not know God’s truth will perceive it. That is like MET enabling those who are blind to see. But the result will also be that people who falsely think IRO that they understand God’s truth will never understand it. That is like MET people who are blind remaining blind permanently.”

lun_bawang: Tuda'-tuda' lun Parisi luk idi denganNeh déi' neninger bala ini idi nepebala Neneh, "Iko ngerawé kai mebuserké?”
english: Some of the Pharisees who were with him heard him say that, and said to him, “You are not suggesting that we are like blind people, are you?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Kudeng muyuh mebuser, na muyuh mesala', iamo' ngaceku muyuh pebala, 'Kai nier,' sala' muyuh ineh idi teh.
english: Jesus said to them, “If you realized that you did not yet know God’s truth, but you wanted to, then you would be like blind people who wanted to see. God would be able to forgive your sins. But you are now falsely claiming that you know God’s truth, so you are like people who are blind who claim that they can see. Because of that, God is not able to forgive your sins.”

lun_bawang: "Matu, Ui pebala nemuyuh, idé-idé luk na semuet bang libung dumba maya' tanga', iamo' manad maya' dalan luk baken, ieh ineh lemulun luk mano idi lun ngaro.
english: Jesus continued by saying to us, “Listen carefully to what I say. Anyone who does not enter the sheep pen through the gate, if he climbs in some other way, he is a thief or a bandit.

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nepebala nedeh teh, "Matu, Ui pebala nemuyuh, Ui ini Tanga' kuan dumba ineh.
english: So Jesus spoke to them again. He said, “Listen carefully to what I am saying. I am like MET a gate for the sheep to enter the sheepfold, because I am the one who allows people to enter God’s presence.

lun_bawang: "Ui ini Lun Matar luk Do'; idi Lun Matar luk Do' ineh maré ulunNeh ku libal dumba-dumba ineh.
english: I am like a good shepherd. A good shepherd is willing to die to save the sheep MET. Similarly, I am ready to sacrifice myself to save those who belong to me.

lun_bawang: Idi mula' rat arangdeh nepebala, "Ieh sinuet ada'! Ieh meruden! Ngudehké muyuh ninger balaNeh?”
english: Many of them said, “A demon is controlling him and has caused him to become crazy. ◄It is useless to listen to him!/Why should we listen to him?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Inan teh luk baken nepebala, "Lemulun luk sinuet ada' na miak pebala kudeng ini. Kudeng apehké ada' miak ngedo' mateh lun mebuser?”
english: But others said, “What he is saying is not something a man whom a demon is controlling would say. ◄No demon could enable a blind man to see like he did!/ How could a demon enable a blind man to see like he did?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi lun Yahudi nepamung libut-libutNeh idi kebaladeh, "Anunké kinioneh teh Iko ngagau niat kai? Kudeng Iko ini Keristus, mala kuan kai dengan megala'.”
english: The Jewish leaders SYN gathered around him and said, “How long will you keep us from knowing for sure if you are the Messiah? If you are the Messiah, tell us clearly!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Ui pangeh nemada' nemuyuh, idi na muyuh manu. Kekamen luk inau'Ku dengan ngadan TamanKu, ieh ineh maré kali' ratnan Ui.
english: Jesus answered them, “I have told you that I am the Messiah, but you do not believe me! You should know who I am because of the miracles I do with my Father’s authority MTY.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus nedeh, "Mula' kekamen luk do' pangeh inau'Ku kuan muyuh dengan ngadan TamanKu; ratnan kekamen anunké muyuh sikal mitung Negku?”
english: But Jesus said to them, “You have seen me perform many miracles that my Father told me to do. You should realize from seeing them that I am equal with God. So, because of which of these miracles IRO are you wanting to kill me by throwing stones at me?”

lun_bawang: Idi lun Yahudi nengor balaNeh, keburi'deh, "Baken ngaceku kekamen luk do' kai mitung Namu, iamo' ngaceku Iko nguyo Allah. Iko lemulun mo' iamo' Iko maad bururMu dengan Allah.”
english: The Jewish leaders SYN replied, “We are wanting to throw stones at you not because you performed a great miracle. Instead, we are wanting to do it because you are dishonoring God. You are just a man, but you are saying that you are God!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Bakenké bang Ukum muyuh inan luk pangeh inayud kudeng ini, 'Ui pangeh nepebala, muyuh allah-allah'?
english: Jesus replied to them, “In the Scriptures it is written {◄someone/the Psalmist► has written} RHQ what God said to the rulers whom he had appointed, ‘I have said that you are like gods.’

lun_bawang: Idi mula' lemulun nacing Neneh idi nepebala, "Kali' rungen Yahya na nenganau' sebuleng tanu', iamo' amung-amung bala luk bila Yahya ratnan lemulun ini matu peh.”
english: Many people came to Jesus. They were saying, “John never performed a miracle, but this man has performed many miracles! Everything that John said about this man is true!”

lun_bawang: Idi dueh kinanakneh ineh nemaré bala kuan Yésus, kebala didueh, "O Tuhan, lemulun luk inanMu mawa ineh mét.”
english: So the two sisters sent someone to tell Jesus about Lazarus, saying, “Lord, the one you love very much is very sick.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus neninger bala ineh, keburi'Neh, "Et ini na miak ngacing até kuan Lasarus. Iamo' ini miak ngegala' rayeh Allah, pad Anak Allah pana' uen ngerayeh ngaceku ineh.”
english: They hoped that Jesus would come, but when Jesus heard the message, he said, “His being sick will not end in his dying. Instead, it will result in people realizing how great God is, and that I, God’s son, may be honored {that people may honor me, God’s son}, because of what I will do.”

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh Yésus nepebala inan anak-anak sekola'Neh, "Do' tau lemubed amé' bawang Yudia.”
english: But Jesus wanted to see Lazarus. So he said to us disciples, “Let’s go back to Judea.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala anak-anak sekola'Neh, "O Guru, ina lun Yahudi nakap dalan sikal mitung Namu, idi nekini Iko sikal lemubed amé' déi' teh?”
english: We said, “Teacher, just a short while ago the Jewish leaders SYN wanted to kill you by throwing stones at you. So ◄we think that you should not go back there again!/are you sure that you want to go back there again?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Bakenké bang seaco pulu' dueh jam? Kudeng selemulun nalan kareb acang aco na ieh matuk, ngaceku ieh nier acang tana' ini.
english: To show us that nothing bad could happen to him until the time that God had chosen MET, Jesus replied, “There are RHQ twelve hours in the daytime, which is enough time to do what God wants us to do. People who walk in the daytime will not stumble over things they cannot see, because they see things by the light from the sun.

lun_bawang: Yésus nepebala kudeng ini, idi teh keburi'Neh nedeh, "Lun rurum tau Lasarus pangeh nerudap, iamo' Ui amé' nui neneh.”
english: After he said that, he told us, “Our friend Lazarus has gone to sleep. But I will go there so that I can wake him up.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' anak-anak sekola'Neh, "O Tuhan, kudeng ieh rudap, miak ieh do' lek.”
english: So we said to him, “Lord, if he is sleeping, he will get well. So you do not need to risk your life by going there.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nepebala nedeh dengan megala', "Lasarus pangeh naté.
english: So then he told us plainly, “Lazarus is dead.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Tomas (luk titen Anak Rapid) kuandeh luk pad-pad anak sekola' Yésus, "Do' tau amé' teh, pad tau maté denganNeh.”
english: Then Thomas, who was {whom they} called ‘The Twin’, said to the rest of us disciples, “Let’s all go, so that we may die with Jesus when his enemies kill him.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Marta inan Yésus, "O Tuhan, kudeng Iko idi tungé', kali' rungen kinanakku na naté!
english: When Martha got to where Jesus was, she said to him, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died because you would have healed him!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus ni Marta, "Kinanakmu ineh miak tumui teh.”
english: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will become alive again!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Marta inan Yésus, "Ui kali' ieh miak tumui kareb aco luk kekiped.”
english: Martha said to him, “I know that he will become alive again when all people become alive again on the Judgment day.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus ni Marta, "Ui ini Tui ratnan até idi Ulun. Idé-idé luk manu Negku, sagan pana' pangeh naté, ieh miak mulun teh;
english: Jesus said to her, “I am the one who enables people to become alive again and who causes people to live eternally. Those who believe in me, even if they die, will live again.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Marta, "Mo, Tuhan, ui manu idi Iko ineh Keristus, Anak Allah, luk macing bang tana' ini.”
english: She said to him, “Yes, Lord! I believe that you are the Messiah, ◄the Son of God/the man who is also God►. You are the one God promised to send into the world!”

lun_bawang: Pangeh Marta nepebala kudeng ini, idi ieh iné' nawar kinanakneh Mariam dengan ayen-ayen, keburi'neh, "Guru idi tungé', idi Ieh nawar namu.”
english: After she said that, she returned to the house and took her younger sister, Mary, aside and said to her, “The Teacher is close to our village, and he wants to talk to you.”

lun_bawang: Lun Yahudi luk idi dengan Mariam bang ruma', idi luk nengubuk neneh, nemaya' neneh kareb ideh nenier neneh nudur dengan mesaget. Ideh nengerawé Mariam amé' inan tanem idi nangi' déi'.
english: The Jews who were in the house with Mary, consoling her, saw Mary get up quickly and go outside. So they followed her, thinking that she was going to the tomb where they had buried Lazarus, in order to cry there.

lun_bawang: Kareb Mariam nacing su luk inan Yésus ineh idi ieh nenier Neneh, idi ieh netekeradung iring kukudNeh, idi kebalaNeh, "O Tuhan, kudeng Iko idi tungé', na kinanakku ineh naté.”
english: When Mary got to where Jesus was and saw him, she prostrated herself at his feet and said, “Lord, if you had been here, my younger brother would not have died!”

lun_bawang: idi kebalaNeh "Iapehké ihe inau' muyuh?" Idi keburi'deh Neneh, "O Tuhan, amé' tungé' idi nier.”
english: He said, “Where have you buried ◄him/his body►?” They said to him, “Lord, come and see.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun Yahudi ineh, "Siruh, kudeng apeh Ieh mawa neneh!”
english: Then some of the Jews said, “Look how much he loved Lazarus!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' arangdeh inan luk nepebala, "Ieh negedo' mateh lun mebuser ineh. Ngudehké Ieh na nengedo' ni Lasarus pad ieh na naté?”
english: But some others said, “He enabled a blind man to see. So ◄he should have been able to heal this man so that he did not die!/why did he not heal this man so that he did not die?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Ngelubid batu ini." Idi kebala Marta, kinanak lun luk naté ineh, "O Tuhan, nekini ieh pangeh mebuen, ngaceku pangeh apat aco kinioneh.”
english: Jesus said, “Take away the stone!” Martha, who, as I mentioned before, was an older sister of the man who had died, said, “Lord, his body has been in the tomb for four days, so now there will be a bad smell!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Bakenké Ui nepebala namu, kudeng iko manu iko miak nier rayeh Allah?”
english: Jesus said to her, “I told RHQ you that if you believed in ◄me/what I can do►, you would see how great God is! Have you forgotten that?”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengelubid batu ineh. Idi Yésus netengook, kesembayangNeh, "O Ama', Ui maré ubur kuanMu ngaceku Iko neninger balaKu.
english: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus looked up toward heaven and said, “My Father, I thank you that you heard me when I prayed about this earlier.

lun_bawang: Kareb Ieh pangeh nepebala kudeng ini, Ieh nengitang, kebalaNeh, "O Lasarus, remuat iko!”
english: After he said that, he shouted, “Lazarus, come out!”

lun_bawang: Idi lun luk naté ineh neremuat, dengan abet kukud idi ticu'neh ratnan kibung luk mebuda', idi kiungneh ibpu ku belaca. Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Neka neneh idi nima' neneh nalan.”
english: The man who had been dead came out! The strips of cloth were still wrapped around his hands and feet, and a cloth was still around his face, but he came out! Jesus said to them, “Take off the cloths so that he can walk easily!” So they did that.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh imam-imam rayeh idi lun Parisi nengamung lun rayeh-rayeh netebubpun, idi nepebala, "Anunké luk ruen tau, ngaceku lemulun ineh nganau' mula' tanu'?
english: So the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered all the members of the Jewish Council together. They started saying to each other, “What are we going to do about Jesus? He is performing many miracles!

lun_bawang: Idi rat arangdeh inan selemulun ngadanneh Kayapas, ieh ineh Imam Rayeh bang lak ineh, nepebala nedeh, "Muyuh na kali' anun-anun.
english: One of the Jewish Council members was Caiaphas. He was the Jewish high priest that year. Hinting that they should get rid of Jesus, he said to them, “You talk as though you do not know anything HYP!

lun_bawang: Ideh nenakap Yésus idi nepebala seburur inan seburur karebdeh nepamung bang Ruma' Allah, "Anunké terawé muyuh? Miakké Ieh macing kareb irau ini?”
english: The Jewish chief priests and Pharisees issued an order that if anyone found out where Jesus was, that person should report it to them, in order that they could seize him. So the people thought that Jesus would probably not dare to come to the celebration. But they kept looking for him, and as they were standing in the Temple courtyard they were saying to each other, “What do you think? He will not come to the celebration, will he?”

lun_bawang: "Ngudehké umau ini na pisuen dengan raga teluh ngeratu rigit, idi usin ineh barén kuan lun masi'?”
english: He said, “◄We should have sold this perfume and given the money to poor people!/Why did we not sell this perfume and give the money for it to the poor people?► RHQ We could have gotten 300 days’ wages for it!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Aleg ngesabeng decur ineh! Nima' neneh nganug luk idi neneh kuan aco luk inanKu tinamen.
english: Then Jesus said, “Do not bother her! She bought this perfume in order to save it until the day when they will bury me after I die.

lun_bawang: Ideh nengalap angat-angat piasau idi iné' ngalap Yésus. Ideh nengitang, "Ngubur Allah! Samal kuanNeh luk macing bang ngadan Tuhan, ieh ineh Raca' Israil!”
english: So they cut branches from some palm trees and took the branches out of the city to wave them when they met him. Some of them were shouting things like, “Hooray!” “May the Lord God bless the one who is coming with his authority MTY!” Some other people were shouting, “May God bless the King of Israel!”

lun_bawang: "Aleg matot, anak decur rat Sion! Siruh Raca'mu macing, idi tudo lun keted anak keladai!”
english: You people of Jerusalem, do not be afraid! Look! Your king is coming! He is riding on a donkey’s colt!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala lun Parisi seburur nan seburur, "Siruh, amung uang tana' ini pangeh nemaya' Neneh. Kekamen tau na ulek!”
english: So the Pharisees said to each other, “It is obvious that we are making no progress in trying to stop him! It looks like HYP everyone MTY is becoming his disciple!”

lun_bawang: Lemulun ineh iné' ni Pilipus, lun Baitsaida déi' tana' Galilia, idi nemutuh neneh, keburi'deh, "Tuan, kai sikal nier Yésus.”
english: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida town in Galilee province. They wanted him to do something for them. They said, “Sir, we would like to talk with Jesus.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Tarekneh pangeh nacing kareb Anak-Lemulun miak uen ngerayeh.
english: Then, to show them that he must die in order to give eternal life to non-Jews like those Greeks, Jesus replied to them, “It is time for God to honor me, the one who came from heaven. That will happen when I die.

lun_bawang: "Nekini niatKu mesusa'. Anunké luk belénKu? Miakké Ui pebala, 'O Ama', ngado Negku ratnan kareb ini'? Na! Ngaceku ineh punneh Ui pangeh nacing inan kareb luk medereh ini.
english: Now I am deeply disturbed. ◄I do not know what to say./What shall I say?► RHQ Should I say, ‘My Father, save me from this time when I will suffer and die!’? No, I should not say that, because the reason I came ◄into this world/from heaven► was that I would suffer MTY now.

lun_bawang: O Ama', ngerayeh ngadanMu!" Idi aceh tang rat bang langit nepebala, "Ui pangeh nengerayeh Neneh, idi Ui sikal ngerayeh Neneh teh.”
english: My Father, show how great you are!” John 12:28b-36a Then God spoke EUP from heaven, saying, “I have already shown how great I am, and I will do it again!”

lun_bawang: Lun mula' luk tuped déi' neninger tang ineh idi nepebala, "Ini uni lalam." Inan teh lun baken nepebala, "Seburur melaikat nepebala Neneh.”
english: The crowd that was there heard it but they did not understand the words. Some said it was thunder. Others said an angel had spoken to him.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yésus nedeh, "Baken ngaceku Ui, bala ini pindenger, iamo' ngaceku muyuh.
english: Jesus replied to them, “The voice that you heard speaking was God’s voice, but it was not for my benefit. It was for your benefit!

lun_bawang: Kebala lun mula' nedeh, "Surat Ukum kai mada' ratnan Keristus ineh mulun ruked-ruked. Kudeng apehké Iko pebala, idi na miak na Anak-Lemulun ineh uen ngikit? Idéké Anak-Lemulun ineh?”
english: Someone in the crowd answered him, “We understand from the Scriptures that the Messiah will live forever. So why do you say that the one who came from heaven, who is the Messiah, will be lifted up {that men will lift up the one who came from heaven, who is the Messiah,} on a cross? What kind of man who came from heaven are you talking about? (OR, That’s not the kind of Messiah we are expecting!)”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Acang ineh idi arang muyuh segageh mo'. Do' muyuh nalan kareb acang ineh idi arang muyuh, pad dacem na ngili nemuyuh. Lemulun luk nalan bang dacem, na ieh kali' iapeh luk suetneh.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “My message is like MET a light for you. I will be with you for only a little while longer. Live and act as you should while I am still with you, because suddenly you will have no more opportunity to hear my message! You do not want to be like MET someone who cannot see where he is going any more when it suddenly becomes dark!

lun_bawang: pad ngacing bala Nabi Yésaya luk nemala, "O Tuhan, idéké luk pangeh manu ku bala kai? Idi kuan idéké ticu' Tuhan pangeh ginala'?”
english: Their stubbornness and refusal to believe was similar to the stubbornness of the people that the prophet Isaiah wrote about long ago: Lord, ◄hardly anyone has believed our message!/who has believed our message?► RHQ Most people refused to accept it, even though you showed them your power!

lun_bawang: "Allah nengebuser matehdeh idi nengetueh terawédeh, pad ideh na nier dengan matehdeh, idi na kali' dengan terawédeh, pelé ideh na lumi Negku, uenKu ngedo'.”
english: They have refused to understand; they acted as though they were blind people! They were insensible in their inner beings! As a result, they have not perceived my truth! They have not understood it in their inner beings! They have not turned from their sinful lives, and because of that I cannot help them!

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nengitang, kebalaNeh, "Idé-idé luk manu Negku, baken ieh manu Negku mo', iamo' inan Allah teh luk nengecuk Negku.
english: Another day, when Jesus was teaching the people, he shouted, “Those who believe in me, they are not believing in me alone. Instead, it is as though they also believe in the one who sent me.

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus nacing ni Simun Pétrus, idi keburi' Pétrus Neneh, "O Tuhan, pianké Iko maru' kukudku?”
english: When he came to Simon Peter, Peter said to him, “Lord, it is not right for you RHQ to humble yourself by washing my feet!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus, "Anun-anun luk ruenKu, iko na kali' nekini, iamo' muci iko miak kali'.”
english: Jesus replied to him, “Now you do not understand the meaning of what I am doing, but you will understand later.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Pétrus Neneh, "Aleg tu-tu Iko maru' kukudku." Iamo' kebala Yésus neneh, "Kudeng Ui na maru' kukudmu iko na miak ngalap babpat denganKu.”
english: Peter said, “I will never, ever, allow you to wash my feet!” Jesus replied to him, “If I do not wash you, you cannot continue ◄to be my disciple/to belong to me►.”
