lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Simun Pétrus Neneh, "O Tuhan, kudeng pieh kudeng ineh, aleg maru' kukudku sebuleng mo', iamo' do' maru' ticu' idi uluhku teh.”
english: So Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, in that case, do not wash only my feet. Wash my hands and my head, too!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus neneh, "Idé-idé luk pangeh nediu', amung bururneh pana' malét; lemulun ineh maru' kukudneh mo'. Amung muyuh pana' malét, iamo' sebuleng mo' luk na." ( 11Ngaceku Yésus panegh nekali' idé luk sikal masui Neneh; ineh punneh Ieh nepebala, "Amung muyuh pana' malét, iamo' sebuleng mo' luk na.")
english: Then, to show him that after God had cleansed people from being guilty for sin, they needed only for God to forgive their daily sins MET, Jesus said to him, “Those who have recently bathed need only to have their feet washed, because they get dirty very quickly on the dusty roads. The rest of their bodies are clean. Similarly, I have made you disciples free/clean from the guilt of your sins, although not all of you are free from guilt.”

lun_bawang: Pangeh Yésus nemaru' kukud amung-amung anak sekola'Neh idi nenuet kuyu'Neh, idi Ieh netudo iring méja idi nepebala nedeh, "Muyuh kali' luk inau'Ku kuan muyuhké?
english: After he finished washing our feet, he put his cloak back on. Then he sat down and said to us, “Do you understand what I have done for you?

lun_bawang: Pangeh Yésus nepebala kudeng ini, idi Ieh mesusa' niat idi nemaré kali', kebalaNeh, "Matu, Ui pebala nemuyuh, idi seburur rat arang muyuh sikal masui Negku.”
english: After Jesus said this, he was very troubled. He solemnly declared, “Listen to this carefully: One of you is going to enable my enemies to seize me.”

lun_bawang: Simun Pétrus nenawar neneh, kebalaneh neneh, "Ngitun idé luk bilaNeh ineh.”
english: Simon Peter motioned to me to indicate that I should ask Jesus whom he was talking about.

lun_bawang: Idi anak sekola' ineh iné' muneng nan Yésus idi nengitun Neneh, "O Tuhan, idéké ieh?”
english: So I leaned close to Jesus and asked him, “Lord, who is it?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Ui miak ngerereb aceh picut ruti idi maré kuanneh. Ini ieh." Idi Ieh nengalap ruti ineh, idi nengerereb neneh, idi nemaré kuan Yudas anak Simun Iskariot ineh.
english: Jesus answered, “It is the one to whom I will give this piece of bread after I dip it in the sauce in the dish.” Then, to show us that he knew who would enable his enemies to seize him, after he dipped the bread in the sauce, he gave it to Judas Iscariot (OR, Judas, the man from Kerioth Town).

lun_bawang: Pangeh Yudas nengalap ruti ineh, idi Sétan nesemuet bang niatneh. Idi keburi' Yésus neneh, "Do' iko nganau' dengan mesaget anun luk ruenmu!”
english: As soon as Judas ate the bread, Satan took control of him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you are going to do, do quickly.”

lun_bawang: Ngaceku Yudas ineh ngimet usin, inan luk ngerawé Yésus nepebala neneh, "Do' tau melih anun-anun luk pian tau kuan irau," kian, pad ieh maré kuan lun masi' lek.
english: Since Judas took care of the money people gave us to help us, some thought Jesus was telling him to go and buy some things we needed for the Passover celebration. Some thought he was telling him to give some money to poor people.

lun_bawang: Kareb Yudas pangeh neremuat, idi Yésus nepebala, "Nekini rayeh Anak- Lemulun ginala', idi rayeh Allah pana' ginala' bang Neneh.
english: After Judas left, Jesus said, “Now it will be shown {my Father will show} how wonderful I, the one who came from heaven, am. And by what I do it will be seen {people will see} how great God is.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Simun Pétrus Neneh, "O Tuhan, iapehké luk inanMu amé'?" Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Iko na miak maya' Negku amé' su luk inanKu amé' nekini. Iamo' muci iko miak maya' Negku.”
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus replied, “The place where I am going, you cannot come with me now, but you will come there later.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Pétrus, "O Tuhan, ngudehké ui na miak maya' Namu nekini? Ui temina' maté ngaceku Iko.”
english: Peter said, “Lord, why can I not come with you now? I am ready to die for you!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Matuké Iko temina maté ngaceku Ui? Matu, Ui pebala namu, kareb nateh lal ngekook, iko miak ngalum Negku teluh kua'."
english: Jesus answered, “You say RHQ that you are ready to die for me. But the truth is that before the rooster crows early tomorrow morning, you will say three times that you do not know me!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Aleg muyuh megagau niat; do' manu inan Allah, idi manu inan Negku teh.
english: Jesus continued by saying to us, “Stop being anxious/worried. Keep on trusting in God (OR, You are trusting in God); also keep trusting in me.

lun_bawang: Kebala Tomas Neneh, "O Tuhan, kai na kali' su apeh luk inanMu amé' kudeng apehké kai kali' dalan ineh?”
english: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we do not know where you are going. So how can we know the road?”

lun_bawang: Keburi' Yésus neneh, "Ui ini dalan idi Luk Matu idi Ulun. Seburur pana' na macing inan Taman, kudeng na ratnan Negku.
english: Jesus said to him, “I am the road MET to where my Father is. I am the one who reveals MET the truth about God and the one who gives eternal life to people. I am the only one who can enable people to come to my Father. There is no other way.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Pilipus Neneh, "O Tuhan, mada' Taman ineh siren kai, pad kai mawang niat.”
english: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us your Father and that will be enough for us!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "O Pilipus, tuda'-tuda' io Ui tudo dengan muyuh, idi nateh iko miti Negku? Lemulun luk pangeh nenier Negku, ieh pangeh nenier Taman teh. Kudeng apehké balamu, 'Mada' Taman ineh siren kai'?
english: Jesus said to him, “Philip, I have been with you for a long time. So ◄surely you should know who I really am!/why have you not come to know who I really am?► RHQ Those who have seen me, it is as though they have seen my Father. So ◄why do you say ‘Show us your Father’?/you should not say ‘Show us your Father’!► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi Yudas (baken Yudas Iskariot ineh) nepebala Neneh, "O Tuhan, kudeng apehké dalanneh Iko sikal ngegala' bururMu kuan kai idi baken kuan uang tana' ini?”
english: Then Judas spoke to him. He was not Judas Iscariot (OR, Judas, the man from Kerioth Town), but instead a disciple whose other name was Thaddeus. He said, “Lord, what has happened so that you can fully reveal to us what you are like, and not reveal that to those who do not belong to God MTY?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Kudeng idé-idé luk mawa Negku, kali' rungen ieh maya' balaKu, idi TamanKu ineh mawa neneh, idi Kai sikal macing neneh idi tudo denganneh.
english: Jesus replied to him, “Those who love me will obey what I have told them. My Father will also love them. It is those people whom my Father and I will be able to come to and ◄live with/have a personal relationship with►.

lun_bawang: "Ui pangeh nemala amung ini kuan muyuh selaba' Ui tudo dengan muyuh.
english: I have told you all these things while I am still with you.

lun_bawang: "Ui ini Lawa Anggur luk matu, idi TamanKu, Ieh ineh luk ngasa' neneh.
english: Jesus talked to us as we were walking along. Speaking figuratively of the need for us to live in a way that God wants us to, he said, “I am like MET a genuine vine, not like those Jewish leaders who do not teach the truth. My father is like MET a gardener who works to take care of a vineyard.

lun_bawang: Bang amung ini rayeh TamanKu uen ngegala', ieh ineh kudeng muyuh kebua' mula', idi muyuh miak mangun ku anak-anak sekola'Ku.
english: The way my Father is honored is by your {The way you honor my Father is by} doing much that pleases him MET, and by doing that, you will show that you are my disciples.

lun_bawang: Ini ukumKu, ieh ineh do' muyuh mawa seburur inan seburur mepad kudeng Ui pangeh mawa nemuyuh.
english: What I am commanding you is this: Love each other just like I have loved you.

lun_bawang: Ini luk dukenKu nemuyuh, pad muyuh mawa seburur inan seburur.
english: I repeat what I have commanded you: Love each other.”

lun_bawang: "Iamo' Lun Ngedengan ineh miak macing, ieh ineh Roh luk matu luk macing ratnan Taman. Ui ngecuk Neneh amé' nemuyuh ratnan Taman ineh, idi Ieh miak maré kali' ratnan Ui.
english: Later I will send to you from my Father the one who will ◄encourage/be like a legal counsel for► you. He is the Spirit who will teach you God’s truth. He will come from my Father. He will tell people about me.

lun_bawang: "Ui pangeh nemala amung ini kuan muyuh, pad anu muyuh na mesabeng.
english: Jesus continued by saying to us, “I have told you these things in order that you will not stop trusting in me when people ◄cause you to suffer/persecute you►.

lun_bawang: "Inan teh mula' bala luk Ui sikal mala kuan muyuh, iamo' nekini muyuh na miak tuman ratnan ineh.
english: I have many more things that I would like to tell you, but you are not able to accept them now.

lun_bawang: "Segageh mo' idi muyuh na miak nier Negku teh, idi segageh mo', idi muyuh miak nier Negku.”
english: “After a short time I will leave you, and you will not see me. Then a short time after that you will see me again.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh, "Anunké ilungneh, 'Segageh teh'? Na tau kali' ilung luk bilaNeh ineh.”
english: We kept asking each other, “What does he mean by saying ‘After a little while’? We do not understand what he is saying.”

lun_bawang: "Kareb aco sineh muyuh na miak mutuh anun-anun rat Negku peh. Matu, Ui pebala nemuyuh, Taman ineh miak maré nemuyuh anun-anun luk pituen muyuh bang ngadanKu.
english: When that happens, you will not ask me any questions about anything. Listen to this carefully: After that happens, my Father will do for you anything you ask, because of his relationship with me MTY.

lun_bawang: "Amung-amung ini pangeh bida'Ku nemuyuh dengan luk pinginud. Iamo' karebneh miak macing idi Ui na pebala kuan muyuh teh dengan luk pinginud, iamo' dengan megala' Ui miak mada' nemuyuh ratnan Taman ineh.
english: Although I have been speaking these things using figurative language, there will soon be a time when I will no longer use that kind of language. Instead, I will tell you plainly ◄about my Father/what my Father wants►.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala anak-anak sekola'Neh Neneh, "Siruh, nekini Iko pebala dengan megala' idi na pebala dengan luk pinginud.
english: Then we, his disciples, said, “Now you are speaking plainly, without using figurative language.

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Manuké muyuh nekini?
english: Jesus replied, “Now you RHQ say that you believe that I came from God.

lun_bawang: Pangeh Yésus nepebala, idi Ieh netengook déi' langit, kebalaNeh, "O Ama' karebneh pangeh macing. Ngegala' rayeh AnakMu, pad AnakMu pana' miak ngegala' rayehMu.
english: After Jesus said those things, he looked up toward heaven. Then he prayed, “My Father, it is now the time MTY for me to suffer and die. Honor me as I do that, in order that I may honor you.

lun_bawang: "Ui pangeh nengegala' ngadanMu kuan lemulun bang tana' ini luk biréMu kuanKu. Ideh kuanMu, idi Iko nemaré nedeh kuanKu, idi ideh pangeh nemaya' balaMu.
english: “I have revealed what you are like to the people whom you brought to me from among those who do not belong to you MTY. Those who came to me belonged to you, and you brought them to me. Now they have obeyed your message.

lun_bawang: "Ui mutuh baken kuandeh mo', iamo' kuan idé-idé pana' luk manu Negku ngaceku ratnan bada'deh.
english: “I am praying not only for these eleven disciples. I am praying also for those who will believe in me as a result of hearing their message.

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus luk nekali' amung-amung luk miak mangun kuanNeh, neremuat idi nepebala nedeh, "Idéké luk tekapen muyuh?”
english: Jesus knew everything that was about to happen to him. So as they approached, he stepped forward and asked them, “Who are you looking for?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "Yésus lun Nasarét." Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Ui ini Ieh." Idi Yudas luk nemasui Neneh tuped dengandeh.
english: They replied to him, “Jesus, the man from Nazareth.” He replied, “That is who I am.” Judas, the one who was enabling his enemies to seize him, was with them.

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus nepebala, "Ui ini Ieh," idi ideh nelemubed idi neluka' luun tana'.
english: When Jesus told them, “That is who I am,” they lurched backward and fell down on the ground because of his power.

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nengitun nedeh teh, "Idéké luk tekapen muyuh?" Idi kebaladeh, "Yésus lun Nasarét.”
english: He asked them again, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus, the man from Nazareth.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Ui pangeh nepebala nemuyuh, 'Ui ini Ieh.' Ngaceku ineh, kudeng muyuh nakap Negku, nima' lun baken ini nalan." ( 9Ieh nemala kudeng ini pad ngacing bala luk bilaNeh ineh, "Ratnan amung- amung lemulun luk biréMu Negku ineh, seburur pana' na Ui ngetutu'.")
english: Jesus replied, “I told you that I am Jesus. So since I am the one you are looking for, allow these disciples of mine to go.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus ni Pétrus, "Do' ngusong pelapetmu bang binanneh. Naké Ui miak ngirup ratnan sangkir luk biré Taman kuanKu?”
english: Jesus said to Peter, “Put your sword back into its sheath! ◄I must endure what my Father wants me to suffer./Do you not think that I must endure what my Father wants me to suffer?► MET, RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' decur luk matar tanga' ineh ni Pétrus, "Bakenké iko pana' seburur anak sekola' lemulun ineh?" Idi kebala Pétrus, "Baken.”
english: The servant girl who was guarding the doorway said to Peter, “Surely you are not another disciple of that man they have arrested, are you?” He said, “I am not.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Ui ini pangeh nepebala dengan megala' kuan uang tana' ini; megéi Ui mada' bang ruma' sembayang idi bang Ruma' Allah, ieh ineh su luk inan amung lun Yahudi pamung. Idi sebuleng pana' na Ui nemala dengan ngalum.
english: Jesus replied, “I have always spoken where many people MTY, HYP could hear me. I have taught them in ◄the synagogues/their meeting places► and in the Temple courtyard, in places where many HYP Jews come together. I have spoken nothing secretly.

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus pangeh nemala ini, seburur lun matar luk tuped déi' nemepag kiungNeh kebalaneh, "Ngudehké Iko mekuu' pebala kudeng ini nelun Imam Rayeh?”
english: After Jesus said that, one of the Temple guards standing near him slapped him on his face. He said, “◄That is not the way you should answer the high priest!/Is that the way you should answer the high priest?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Kudeng balaKu ini sala', do' ngegala' ineh nelun mula' luk idi ieni. Iamo' kudeng balaKu matu, ngudehké iko mepad Negku?”
english: Jesus replied to him, “If I said something that was contrary to your laws, you could tell me that what I said that was wrong. But because I said only what was right, ◄you should not be striking me!/why are you striking me?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Simun Pétrus tuped sigidu teh. Idi keburi' seburur neneh, "Bakenké iko pana' seburur anak sekola'Neh?" Idi ieh nengalum, keburi'neh, "Baken.”
english: As Simon Peter was standing warming himself at the fire, someone else said to him, “You are not one of that man’s disciples, are you?” He denied that he was, and said, “I am not.”

lun_bawang: Idi seburur rat arang demulun Imam Rayeh, luk dingkanid dengan lemulun luk tirad Pétrus lalid ineh, nepebala, "Naké ui nenier namu bang kabun denganNeh?”
english: Later one of the high priest’s servants, a man who was a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off before, said to him, “I saw you with that man in the grove of olive trees, did I not?”

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh Pilatus iné' ngitun nedeh, keburi'neh, "Anunké adu' muyuh kuan lemulun ini?”
english: So Pilate came out to talk to them. He said, “What law do you say that this man has disobeyed?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh, "Kudeng lemulun ini baken selemulun luk mesala', nateh kai nemaré Neneh kuan tuan.”
english: They knew that Jesus had not disobeyed any Roman law, so they did not want to answer him. Instead, they said, “If this man were not a criminal, we would not have brought him to you!”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Pilauts nedeh, "Do' muyuh ngalap Neneh idi ngukum Neneh maya' Ukum muyuh." Keburi' lun Yahudi neneh, "Kai ini na miak ngaté seburur lemulun pana'." ( 32Ini mangun pad ngacing luk pangeh bila Yésus ratnan lawé atéNeh.)
english: Then Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your own laws!” Then the Jewish leaders SYN said, “No! We want him executed, but we want you Romans to execute him, because we Jews have no right to execute anyone!”

lun_bawang: Pangeh Pilatus nesemuet bang ruma' Lun luk Ngimet Ukum ineh, idi ieh nenawar Yésus, idi ieh nengitun, "Ikoké Raca' lun Yahudi?”
english: Pilate then went back inside his headquarters. He summoned Jesus. Because the Jewish leaders had said that Jesus claimed to be a king, Pilate said to Jesus scornfully, “Are you the king of the Jews?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "Inanké bala ini ratnan Tuan sebuleng, kian, lun baken nemala kuanmu ratnan Ui lek?”
english: Jesus replied, “Are you asking that because you yourself want to know if I claim to be a king, or because ◄someone else/Caiaphas► said that I claim to be their king?”

lun_bawang: Kebala Pilatus, "Ui ini lun Yahudiké? PupuMu sebuleng idi imam-imam rayeh luk nemaré Namu kuanku. Anunké luk inau'Mu?”
english: Pilate replied, “I am not a Jew, so ◄I cannot understand these matters!/how can I understand these matters?► RHQ It was your fellow Jews and your chief priests who brought you to me! What have you done to make them want to execute you?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus, "ImetKu ineh baken ratnan tana' ini. Kudeng ImetKu ratnan tana' ini, kali' rungen demulun-demulunKu miak pebunu' pad Ui na barén kuan lun Yahudi. Iamo' ImetKu ineh baken ratnan tana' ini!”
english: Jesus replied, “It is not people in MTY this world who are making me king. If it was people in this world who were making me a king, my disciples would have fought in order that the Jewish leaders SYN would be prevented {to prevent the Jewish leaders SYN} from seizing me. But it is not someone here in this world who is making me a king.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Pilatus Neneh, "Anunké luk matu ineh?" Idi Pilatus neremuat iné' nelun Yahudi, idi keburi'neh nedeh, "Ui na kali' anun punneh ui ngukum Neneh.
english: Pilate said to him, “How can anyone know what the truth is?” After he said that, he went outside and talked to the Jewish leaders SYN again. He said to them, “I do not find that he has done anything at all for which I should punish him.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nengitang, keburi' deh, "Baken Ieh, iamo' Barabas!" (Barabas ineh seburur lun mano.)
english: They shouted again, “No, do not release this man! Instead, release Barrabas!” But Barrabas was in prison because he was a revolutionist!

lun_bawang: idi ideh iné' Neneh, kebaladeh, "Tabi' Raca' lun Yahudi!" Idi ideh nemepag Neneh.
english: Then they kept coming to him and saying, “Hooray for the King of the Jews IRO!” and slapping him on his face.

lun_bawang: Idi Pilatus neremuat idi nepebala nedeh, "Siruh, ui nguit Neneh kuan muyuh, pad muyuh kali' negku na kali' anun punneh ui ngukum Neneh.”
english: Once more Pilate came outside and said to the crowd, “Look! I am bringing him out to you so that you may know that I do not find that he has done anything for which we should punish him any more.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus neremuat, dengan pata luk metabpa' idi kuyu' luk sia' merirem. Idi keburi' Pilatus kuan amung-amungdeh, "Siruh, lemulun ineh!”
english: When Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, “Look at this wretched man!”

lun_bawang: Kareb imam-imam rayeh idi lun pulis pana' nenier Neneh, idi ideh nengitang, keburi'deh, "Nalib Neneh, nalib Neneh!" Idi keburi' Pilatus nedeh, "Do' muyuh ngalap Neneh, idi nalib Neneh! Ngaceku na ui kali' anun punneh ui ngukum Neneh.”
english: When the chief priests and Temple guards saw him, they shouted, “Command your soldiers to kill him by nailing him to a cross! Crucify him!” Pilate, knowing that they could not legally do it themselves, said to them, “You yourselves take him and nail him to a cross! As for me, I do not find that he has done anything for which we should punish him.”

lun_bawang: Idi lun Yahudi nengor balaneh, keburi'deh, "Maya' Ukum kai do' Ieh mate, ngaceku Ieh nemala bururNeh Anak Allah.”
english: The Jewish leaders SYN replied, “Our ancestor Moses gave us the law that says we must kill anyone who claims to be God. This man claims that he is ◄the Son of/the man who is also► God, so you must have him killed {command your soldiers to kill him}.”

lun_bawang: Ieh nesemuet bang ruma' Lun luk Ngimet Ukum ineh sekua' teh, idi nepebala inan Yésus, "Rat iapehké iratMu?" Iamo' Yésus na nengor balaneh.
english: So he took Jesus back inside the headquarters. He said to Jesus, “Where do you really come from?” But Jesus did not answer him.

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Pilatus Neneh, "Naké Iko sikal pebala negku? Naké Iko kali' ui melalud muit Namu, idi melalud nalib Namu?”
english: So Pilate said to him, “Are you refusing to answer me? Do you not know that I have authority to release you, and I also have authority to have you crucified {command my soldiers to crucify you}?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Iko na melalud pa luunKu, kudeng na biré namu ratnan Allah. Ngaceku ineh lemulun luk nemaré Negku kuanmu meluun rayeh sala'.”
english: Jesus replied, “The only authority you have is what has been given to you by God MTY {what God MTY has given you}. The high priest put me into your hands. He has done to me what he wanted to do, and you do not really want to do it. So he is guilty of committing a greater sin than you are.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Pilatus neninger bala ineh, idi ieh nenakap dalan sikal muit Yésus. Iamo' lun Yahudi nengitang, keburi'deh, "Kudeng Tuan muit lemulun ini, baken Tuan lun dengan raca' Rum. Idé-idé luk ngamo bururneh raca', ieh luk sikal metueh ratnan raca' Rum.”
english: Because of that, Pilate kept trying to release Jesus. But the Jewish leaders SYN, threatening to report to the Emperor that Pilate was not going to punish a man who claimed he was a king, continued to shout, “Anyone who claims that he is a king is opposing the Emperor! So if you release this man, we will make sure that the Emperor learns about it, and then he will not consider you as his friend!”

lun_bawang: Pangeh Pilatus neninger bala ini, idi ieh neguit Yésus remuat, idi netudo luun kerusi besara', idi su ineh titen "Batu luk Mebalad." (Bang buri' Iberani ieh ineh, "Gabata".)
english: When Pilate heard that, he brought Jesus out again. He sat down at the place where he made decisions about punishing people. The place was called {People called it} The Stone Pavement. In the Aramaic language its name was Gabbatha.

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh lélé muned aco, idi kenebpa Irau Paska. Idi kebala Pilatus nelun Yahudi, "Siruh, Raca' muyuh!”
english: It was almost noontime, on the day that they prepared things for the Passover celebration (OR, the day before the Sabbath during the Passover celebration). Pilate said to the Jewish leaders SYN, ridiculing them, “Look at your king!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' ideh nengitang, keburi'deh, "Ngaté Neneh! Ngaté Neneh! Nalib Neneh!" Idi keburi' Pilatus nedeh, "Do'ké ui nalib Raca' muyuh?" Idi imam- imam rayeh nengor balaneh, keburi'deh, "Na luk idi raca' kai luk baken ratnan raca' Rum.”
english: They shouted, “Take him away! Take him away! Have him crucified {Command your soldiers to nail him to a cross}!” Pilate said to them, “He is your king! Do you really want me to tell my soldiers to nail him to a cross?” The chief priests replied, “The Emperor is our king! We do not have any other king!”

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh neremuat idi nemaan salibNeh sebuleng amé' matun. Su luk inan Perupuk Uluh (Bang buri' Iberani ieh ineh "Golgota.")
english: As they left, he himself was carrying the cross on which they were going to nail him. They went to a place called The Place of a Skull. In the Aramaic language it is called {they call it} Golgotha.

lun_bawang: Pilatus nengayud aceh surat, idi ieh nengerareng ineh pa luun salib ineh. Ieh nengayud kudeng ini, "Yésus, lun Nasarét, Raca' lun Yahudi.”
english: Pilate also had them write on a board a notice that stated why they were executing him, and fasten it to the cross. But all they wrote was ‘Jesus from Nazareth, the King of the Jews’.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala imam-imam rayeh lun Yahudi kuan Pilatus, "Aleg iko ngayud 'Raca' lun Yahudi,' iamo', 'Ui ini Raca' lun Yahudi,' mepad kudeng luk bilaNeh ineh.”
english: So the Jewish priests went back to Pilate and protested, saying to him, “Change what they have written from ‘The King of the Jews’ to ‘This man said that he is the King of the Jews’!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Pilatus, "Luk pangeh inayudku pangehneh ineh.”
english: Pilate replied, “What I told them to write is what they have written, and I will not change it.”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus nenier tinanNeh idi anak sekola' luk inanNeh mawa ineh tuped muneng, idi Ieh nepebala inan tinanNeh, "O Ina', siruh, anakmu!”
english: Jesus saw his mother standing there. He also saw me standing nearby. Then he said to his mother, “This man will now be like your son.”

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh Ieh nepebala inan anak sekola' ineh, "Siruh, tinanmu!" Idi rat kareb ineh anak sekola' ineh nengalap neneh tudo bang ruma'neh sebuleng.
english: And he said to me, “Treat this woman as MET your mother.” So from that time I took her to my home and took care of her.

lun_bawang: Pangeh neh Yésus nekali' idi amung-amung pangeh riniput, idi Ieh nepebala, "Ui meparing," pad ngacing bala bang Surat Allah ineh.
english: Later, Jesus knew that everything that God sent him to do had now been completed {that he had now completed everything that God sent him to do}, but he knew that something else that was written in the Scriptures had to be fulfilled {that he had to fulfill something else that they had written in the Scriptures}. So he said, “I am thirsty!”

lun_bawang: Kareb Yésus pangeh nengalap abpa' luk malam ineh, kebalaNeh, "Pangeh meriput!" Idi Ieh nemunel idi niatNeh neputut.
english: When Jesus tasted the sour wine, he shouted, “I have finished all that I came to do!” Then he bowed his head and ◄died/handed over his spirit to God►.

lun_bawang: Ini punneh ini mangun, pad ngacing bala bang Surat Allah ineh, "Sebuleng tulangNeh pana' na miak pitulen.”
english: These things happened in order that these words would be fulfilled {to fulfill these words} that are written in Scripture: “Not one of his bones will be broken {No one will break any of his bones}.”

lun_bawang: Idi inan teh ayat bang Surat Allah luk mala, "Ideh miak nier Neneh luk pangeh tibpekdeh.”
english: And they fulfilled another Scripture passage that has these words: ‘They will look on the one whom they have pierced’.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nupun iné' nakap Simun Pétrus, idi anak sekola' luk baken luk inan Yésus mawa, idi nepebala nedidueh, "Lemulun pangeh nengalap Tuhan rat bang tanem, idi na kai kali' iapeh inandeh nengerareng Neneh.”
english: So Mary ran to where Simon Peter and I were staying in Jerusalem. She said to us, “They have taken the Lord’s body out of the burial cave, and we do not know where they have put it!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala didueh ni Mariam, "O decur, anunké punneh iko nangi'?" Idi keburi' Mariam nedidueh, "Ngaceku lemulun pangeh nengalap Tuhanku, idi ui na kali' iapeh inandeh nengerareng Neneh.”
english: They said to her, “Woman, why are you crying?” She said to them, “They have taken away the body of my Lord, and I do not know where they have put it!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus neneh, "Mariam!" Idi Mariam nelumi idi nepebala bang buri' lun Iberani, "Rabbuni!" (Ilungneh "Guru.")
english: Jesus said to her, “Mary!” She turned toward him again and recognized him. Then she exclaimed in Aramaic, “Rabboni!” which means ‘Teacher’.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Aleg iko ngakem Negku, ngaceku nateh Ui numak iné' inan TamanKu, iamo' amé' iko inan amung-amung kinanakKu, idi mala kuandeh, 'Ui umak amé' inan TamanKu idi Taman muyuh, idi inan TuhanKu idi Tuhan muyuh.' “
english: Jesus said to her, “Stop clinging to me, because I have not yet returned to my Father. Go to my disciples and tell them, ‘I am about to return to my Father and your Father, to the one who is my God and your God’.”

lun_bawang: Idi Yésus nemala kuandeh sekua' teh, "Awang kuan muyuh! Mepad kudeng Taman pangeh nengecuk nemuyuh.”
english: Jesus said to us again, “May God give you peace! Just like my Father sent me, now I am sending you to proclaim my message.”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb Ieh pangeh nemala kudeng ini, idi Ieh nenginiat kuandeh idi nepebala nedeh, "Lapen muyuh Roh Meligan.
english: After saying that, he breathed on us and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit!

lun_bawang: Pangeh seminggu, idi anak-anak sekola' Yésus nepamung bang ruma' teh, idi Tomas pana' idi dengandeh. Kareb tanga' ruma' ineh initek, idi Yésus nacing netuped arangdeh idi nepebala, "Awang kuan muyuh!”
english: A week later we were in the house again. This time Thomas was with us. Although the doors had been locked {we had locked the doors}, Jesus again appeared miraculously and stood among us. He said, “May God give peace to you!”

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nepebala ni Tomas, "Ngerareng bua' ticu'mu su ini idi nier paladKu, idi natang ticu'mu idi ngerareng neneh bang sigarangKu, idi aleg iko merapang, iamo' manu.”
english: Then he showed Thomas his hands and said to him, “Put your finger here! Look at the wounds in my hands! Reach out your hand and put it in the wound in my side! Stop doubting LIT/DOU! Instead, believe that I am alive again!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tomas Neneh, "O Allah, O Tuhanku!”
english: Thomas answered him, “You are truly my Lord and my God!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus neneh, "Manuké iko ngaceku iko nenier Negku? Samal kuan lemulun luk manu, sagan pana' na nenier Negku!”
english: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed that about me. But God is truly pleased with those who have believed that about me, even though they have not seen me!”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Simun Pétrus nedeh, "Ui amé' ngerabat." Idi keburi'deh neneh, "Kai pana' sikal maya' namu." Idi ideh nesemuet bang alud idi nenalan; idi kareb malem ineh sebuleng pana' nateh luk ilapdeh.
english: Simon Peter said to us, “I am going to try to catch some fish.” We said, “We will go with you.” So we went down to the lake and got into the boat. But that night we caught nothing.

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "O lun rurumKu, inanké lawid muyuh?" Idi kebaladeh, "Na luk idi.”
english: He called out to us, “My friends, you have not caught any fish, have you?” We answered, “You are correct, we have not caught any.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Mepet rabat muyuh pa tinueh alud ineh, kali' rungen muyuh ngalap." Idi ideh nemepet rabatdeh, idi ideh na miak ngeruid neneh ngaceku pelaba ula' lawid.
english: He said to us, “Throw your net out from the right-hand side of the boat! Then you will find some!” We did that, and we caught so many fish in the net that we were unable to pull the net into the boat!

lun_bawang: Idi anak sekola' luk inan Yésus mawa nepebala ni Pétrus, "Ieh ineh Tuhan!" Kareb Simun Pétrus neninger idi Ieh ineh Tuhan, idi ieh nengabet kuyu'neh i awa'neh, ngaceku ieh lungu, idi ieh nubpa bang abpa'.
english: But I knew that it was Jesus, so I said to Peter, “It is the Lord!” Peter had taken off his cloak while he was working, but as soon as he heard me say “It is the Lord!” he wrapped his cloak around himself and jumped into the water and swam to shore.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus nedeh, "Do' muyuh nguit sesuut lawid luk ilap muyuh ina.”
english: Jesus said to us, “Bring some of the fish that you have just caught!”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Amé' tungé idi kuman." Iamo' seburur anak sekola' pana' nateh luk mekuu' ngitun Neneh, "Idéké Iko?" ngaceku ideh kali' Ieh ineh Tuhan.
english: Jesus said to us, “Come and eat some breakfast!” None of us dared to ask him, “Who are you?” because we knew that it was the Lord.

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh nengitun neneh luk kedueh kua', "O Simun, anak Yahya, mawaké iko Negku?" Idi keburi' Pétrus Neneh, "O Tuhan, Iko kali' idi ui mawa Namu." Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Do' iko maman dumba-dumbaKu.”
english: Jesus said to him again, “John’s son Simon, do you love me?” He replied, “Yes, Lord, you know that you are dear to me (OR, that I love you).” Jesus said to him, “Take care of those who belong to me, like MET a shepherd takes care of his sheep.”

lun_bawang: Dengan bala ini Yésus nengegala' ayu até Pétrus luk miak ngerayeh Allah. Kareb Ieh pangeh nepebala kudeng ini, idi kebalaNeh ni Pétrus, "Do' iko maya' Negku.”
english: Jesus said this to indicate how Peter would die ◄violently/on a cross► in order to honor God. Then Jesus said to him, “Keep being my faithful disciple until you die.”

lun_bawang: Pétrus nelumi, idi nenier anak sekola' luk ina Yésus mawa maya' pa puetdeh, idi ieh ineh luk iné' muneng nan Yésus kareb irau malem idi nengitun, "Idéké luk miak masui Tuhan?”
english: Peter turned around and saw that I was following them. I was the one who leaned close to Jesus during the Passover meal and said, “Lord, who is going to enable your enemies to seize you?”

lun_bawang: Idi kareb Pétrus nenier anak sekola' ineh, idi ieh nepebala nan Yésus, "O Tuhan, kudeng apehké lemulun ini?”
english: When Peter saw me, he asked, “Lord, what is going to happen to him?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yésus neneh, "Kudeng pianKu lemulun ini ketecan pad Ui macing baruh, bala ini baken kuanmu. Do' iko maya' Negku.”
english: Jesus said to him, “If I want him to remain alive until I return, ◄that is not your concern!/what is that to you?► RHQ You be my faithful disciple!”

lun_bawang: Idi bala ini nepiar arang uned amung-amung kinanak, idi anak sekola' ineh na miak maté. Iamo' baken kudeng ineh bala Yésus, idi anak sekola' ineh na miak maté, iamo', "Kudeng pianKu idi lemulun ini ketecan pad Ui macing baruh, bala ini baken kuanmu.”
english: Some of the other believers heard a report of what Jesus had said about me, and they thought that Jesus meant that I would not die. But Jesus did not say that I would not die. He said only, “If I want him to remain alive until I return, ◄that is not your concern!/what is that to you?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh nepamung, idi Ieh nemebpeng nedeh na necan Yerusalim, kebalaNeh, "Do' muyuh nganét baré luk pijani' TamanKu, luk bilaKu nemuyuh.
english: One time while he was with them, he told them, “Do not leave Jerusalem yet. Instead, wait here until my Father sends his Spirit MTY to you, as he promised to do. You have heard me speak to you about that.

lun_bawang: Kareb rasul-rasul nepamung dengan Yésus, idi ideh nengitun Neneh, keburi'deh, "O Tuhan, miakké Iko ngelubed Imet kuan Israil nekini?”
english: One day when the apostles met together with Jesus, they asked him, “Lord, will you (sg) now become the King MET over us Israelite people like King David, who ruled long ago?” (OR, “Lord, will you (sg) now defeat the Romans and restore the kingdom to us Israelite people?”)

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus nedeh, "Na muyuh miak kali' aconeh idi karebneh, luk litep TamanKu maya' laludNeh sebuleng.
english: He replied to them, “You do not need to know the time periods and days when that will happen. My Father alone has decided when he will make me king.

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "O kinanak-kinanakku, na miak na bala bang Surat Allah uen ngacing, maya' kudeng luk bila Roh meligan dengan dila' Daud ratnan Yudas, luk mangun ku lun nguyut lemulun luk nengakem Yésus.
english: “My fellow believers, there are words that King David wrote MTY in the Scriptures long ago that needed to be fulfilled {to happen as he said they would}. The Holy Spirit, who knew that Judas would be the one who would fulfill those words, told David what to write.

lun_bawang: -22"Ngaceku ineh, do' seburur lemulun maya' netau mangun ku lun nekali' ratnan tui Tuhan Yésus. Do' ieh pilin rat arangdeh luk bang rurum tau, ruked Yésus idi dengan tau, ngimun rat kareb Yahya nemada' ratnan rerebneh, macing aco luk inan Yésus kinikit rat arang tau iné' surga.”
english: “So it is necessary for us apostles to choose a man to replace Judas. He must be one who accompanied MTY us all the time when the Lord Jesus was with us.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nesembayang, kesembayangdeh, "O Tuhan, Iko luk kali' niat amung-amung lemulun, do' mada' rat arang dueh burur ini, idéké luk pinili'Mu,
english: Then they prayed like this: “Lord Jesus, Judas stopped being an apostle. He died and went to the place where he deserved to be EUP. So we(exc) need to choose someone to replace Judas in order that he can serve you(sg) by becoming an apostle. You (sg) know what everyone is really like. So please show us which of these two men you have chosen.”

lun_bawang: Lun mula' ineh lingo-lingo idi mawa, keburi'deh, "Siruh, bakenké lemulun luk pebala ini lun Galilia?
english: They were completely amazed, and they said to each other, “All these men who are speaking have RHQ always resided in Galilee district, so they would not know our languages.

lun_bawang: Idi amung-amungdeh lingo-lingo idi megagau idi pebala seburur inan seburur, "Anunké ilungneh ini?”
english: All those people were amazed, and did not know what to think about what was happening. So they asked one another, “What does this mean?”

lun_bawang: Iamo' lun baken situnga, keburi'deh, "Lun ini mabuk.”
english: But some of them ◄made fun of/laughed at► those who believed in Jesus. They said, “These people are talking like this because they are drunk!”

lun_bawang: Idi Pétrus netuped dengan pulu' aceh rasul luk baken idi nemada' nelun mula' dengan rayeh bala, kebalaneh, "O lun Yahudi idi amung muyuh luk tudo déi' Yerusalim, ninger balaku ini idi nima' negku ngelio ilung ini.
english: So Peter stood up with the other eleven apostles and spoke loudly to the crowd of people, saying, “My fellow Jews and you others who are staying in Jerusalem, listen to me, all of you, and I will explain to you what is happening!

lun_bawang: "O lun Israil, ninge muyuh bala ini: Yésus lun Nasarét ineh pangeh imo Allah. Amung ini ginala'Neh kuan muyuh dengan kekamen luk melalud, kekamen luk nan mawa, idi tanu'-tanu' pana' luk inau' Allah dengan ticu' Yésus arang muyuh. Muyuh sebuleng kali' amung ineh.
english: Peter continued, “My fellow  Israelites, listen to me! When  Jesus from Nazareth town lived  among you, God proved to you that he had sent him  by enabling him to do many amazing miracles. You yourselves know that this is true.

lun_bawang: "O kinanak-kinanakku, ui mekuu' pebala nemuyuh ratnan tepun tau Daud. Ieh naté idi tinanem, idi teh tanemneh arang tau macing aco sini teh.
english: Peter continued, “My fellow Jews, I can tell you confidently that our royal ancestor, King David, died, and that his body was buried {that people buried his body}. And the place where they buried his body is still here today.

lun_bawang: Daud sebuleng na numak iné' surga; iamo' ieh nepebala: 'Tuhan pangeh nepebala kuan Tuhanku: Tudo Iko pa tinuehKu,
english: We(inc) know that David was not speaking about himself because David did not go up into heaven as Jesus did. Besides that, David himself said this about the Messiah: The Lord God said to my Lord the Messiah, ‘Reign here beside me,

lun_bawang: "Ngaceku ineh do' amung-amung lun Israil kali' dengan megala' ratnan Allah pangeh nenganau' Yésus luk sinalib muyuh ineh mangun ku Tuhan idi Keristus.”
english: Peter concluded, “So I want you and all other Israelites MTY to acknowledge that God has caused this Jesus to be both our Lord/Ruler and the Messiah. But God considers that you are the ones who nailed Jesus to a cross.”

lun_bawang: Kareb lun mula' neninger bala ineh, idi niatdeh nesigio idi mesusa', idi kebaladeh ni Pétrus idi rasul-rasul luk baken ineh, "O kinanak-kinanak, anunké luk miak ruen kai?”
english: When the people heard what Peter said, they felt very guilty IDM. So they asked him and the other apostles, “Fellow-countrymen, what should we (exc) do so that God will forgive us?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Pétrus nedeh, "Do' amung-amung muyuh uren, idi rerebpen bang ngadan Yésus Keristus, pelé muyuh ngalap do' ratnan sala' muyuh; idi muyuh miak ngalap baré Allah, ieh ineh Roh Meligan.
english: Peter answered them, “Each of you should turn away from your sinful behavior. Then we(exc) will baptize you, if you now believe in Jesus Christ. Then God will give you the Holy Spirit.

lun_bawang: Idi Pétrus nengubuk nedeh idi nemada' nedeh dengan mula' bala luk baken, keburi'neh, "Ngulun burur muyuh ratnan ukum luk macing kuan pupu luk tekilu' ini!”
english: Peter spoke much more and spoke strongly/forcefully to them. He pleaded with them, “Ask God to save you so that he will not punish you when he punishes these evil people who have rejected Jesus!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Pétrus idi Yahya nenier neneh idi nepebala, "Nier nekai do'-do'.”
english: As Peter and John looked directly at him, Peter said to him, “Look at us!”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Pétrus neneh, "Amas idi pirak na luk idi negku, iamo' anun luk inan negku, ineh ui miak maré kuanmu: dengan ngadan Yésus Keristus, lun Nasarét ineh, nalan iko!”
english: Then Peter said to him, “I do not have any money MTY, but what I can do, I will do for you. Jesus Christ, who was from Nazareth town, has authorized MTY me to heal you! So get up and walk!”

lun_bawang: "Idi nekini, O kinanak-kinanakku, ui kali' idi muyuh nenganau' kudeng ini ngaceku na muyuh kali', idi lun luk ngimet nemuyuh pana' kudeng ineh teh.
english: “Now, my fellow-countrymen, I know that you and your leaders did that to Jesus because you and they did not know that he was the Messiah.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh do' muyuh uren idi lumi inan Allah pad Ieh ngiu' sala' muyuh,
english: So, turn away from your sinful behavior and ask God to help you do what pleases him, in order that he may completely forgive you for your sins.

lun_bawang: Ideh nenganau' rasul-rasul ineh tuped arangdeh, idi ideh nengitun nedidueh, "Kudeng apehké muyuh nengedo' lun luk meliai ineh? Lalud anunké idi ngadan idéké luk pikai muyuh?”
english: They commanded guards to bring Peter and John into the courtroom MTY and have them stand in front of them. Then one of the leaders questioned the two of them, saying, “Who do you two claim gave you the power to heal this man? And who authorized MTY you to do this DOU?”

lun_bawang: Idi pangeh ineh Pétrus luk mepanu' ku Roh Meligan nengor baladeh, keburi'neh, "O muyuh lun ngimet idi lun rayeh teh,
english: So as the Holy Spirit completely controlled Peter, he said to them, “You fellow Israelites who rule us and all of you other elders, listen!

lun_bawang: keburi'deh, "Anunké luk miak ruen tau kuan lemulun ineh? Amung-amung lemulun luk tudo déi' Yerusalim pangeh nekali' kekamen luk inan mawa ini luk inau' didueh. Tau na miak ngalum ineh.
english: Being frustrated, one after another, they said, “◄There is really nothing that we can do to punish these two men!/How can we (inc) do anything to punish these two men?► RHQ Almost everyone HYP who is living in Jerusalem knows that they have done an amazing miracle, so we cannot tell people that it did not happen!

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Pétrus idi Yahya, "Do' muyuh ngerawé sapehké luk matu pa kiung Allah, maya' pian muyuh kian maya' pian Allah lek.
english: But Peter and John replied, “Would God think that it is right for us two to obey you and not to obey him? We(exc) will let you decide which of those you think is proper.

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh neninger bala didueh, idi ideh nengitang kuan Allah dengan sebuleng niat idi sembayang, kesembayangdeh, "O Tuhan, Iko luk nemudut langit idi tana' idi abpa' rayeh idi amung uangdeh,
english: The Holy Spirit caused our ancestor, King  David MTY, who served you, to write these words: It is ridiculous  RHQ that the non-Jews became angry and the Israelite people planned uselessly to oppose God.

lun_bawang: Matu bang bawang ini Herodés idi Pontius Pilatus nepamung dengan lun pupu baken idi pupu Israil pana' sikal metueh ratnan Yésus DemulunMu luk meligan ineh, luk inumauMu mangun ku Keristus.
english: Because you (sg) are all-powerful, those people did only what you SYN allowed them to do. It was what you decided long ago would happen.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Pétrus neneh, "O Ananias, ngudehké Iko nenima' Sétan ngimet niatmu, pad iko mebalih inan Roh Meligan idi nenganug sebuang raga tana' ineh?
english: Then Peter said, “Ananias, you (sg) let Satan completely control you MTY so that you (sg) tried to deceive the Holy Spirit and us(exc). ◄That was terrible!/Why did you do such a terrible thing?► RHQ You have kept for yourself some of the money you (sg) received for selling the land, pretending that you(sg) were giving us all of it.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Pétrus neneh, "Do' iko mada' negku, matuké tana' ineh muyuh pangeh nemasui dengan raga kinula' ineh?" Idi kebalaneh, "Mo, ini amung raganeh.”
english: As Peter showed her the money that Ananias had brought, he asked her, “Tell me, is this the amount of money you two received for the land you sold?” She said, “Yes, that’s what we(exc) received.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Pétrus neneh, "Anunké punneh medueh pangeh perurum sikal nutun Roh Tuhan? Siruh, lemulun luk nenanem awanmu ineh idi munung tanga', idi ideh miak mirir namu remuat teh.”
english: So Peter said to her, “You both did a terrible thing! You two agreed RHQ to try to determine if you could do that without the Spirit of the Lord God revealing to anyone that you two tried to deceive them! Listen! Do you(sg) hear the footsteps SYN of the men who buried your husband? They are right outside this door, and they will carry your corpse out to bury it, too!”

lun_bawang: "Amé' muyuh tuped bang Ruma' Allah idi mada' nelun mula' ratnan Ulun luk mebaruh ineh.”
english: Then the angel said to the apostles, “Go to the Temple courtyard, stand there, and tell the people all about how God can give them eternal life!”

lun_bawang: "Kai kali' tutup ineh pangeh initek do'-do' idi lun luk matar ineh pana' tuped munung amung-amung tanga' ineh; iamo' pangeh kai nengukab tanga' ineh idi kai nenier na luk idi seburur pana' bang tutup ineh.”
english: “We (exc) saw that the jail doors were very securely locked, and the guards were standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in to get those men, none of them was inside the jail!”

lun_bawang: Idi nacing selemulun nepebala kuandeh, "Siruh, lemulun luk sinuet muyuh bang tutup ineh tuped bang Ruma' Allah idi mada' pupu ineh.”
english: Then someone came from the Temple courtyard and excitedly reported to them, “Listen to this! Right now the men whom you put in jail are standing in the Temple courtyard and they are teaching the people about Jesus!”

lun_bawang: "Kai nemebpeng nemuyuh na mada' dengan ngadan ini, iamo' muyuh pangeh manu' bawang Yerusalim ku bada' muyuh, idi muyuh sikal maré nekai mabeh dara' lemulun ini.”
english: He said to them accusingly, “We (exc) strongly commanded you not to teach people about that man MTY Jesus But you have disobeyed us, and you have taught people all over Jerusalem about him! Furthermore, you are trying to make it seem that we (exc) are the ones who are guilty MTY for that man’s death!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Pétrus idi rasul-rasul, "Tau na miak na maya' Allah meluun ratnan lemulun.
english: But Peter, speaking for himself and the other apostles, replied, “We (exc) have to obey what God commands us to do, not what you people tell us to do!

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh nan tebubpun besara' ineh, "O lun Israil, matar do'-do' muyuh ratnan luk ruen muyuh kuan lemulun ini.
english: After the guards had taken the apostles out, he said to the other Council members, “Fellow Israelites, you need to think carefully about what you are about to do to these men, and I will tell you why.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh pulu' dueh rasul ineh nengamung amung-amung anak sekola' idi nepebala nedeh, "Na kai miak ugka' mada' bala Tuhan idi ngimet usin sidang.
english: So, after the  twelve apostles had heard what they were complaining about, they summoned all the other  believers in Jerusalem to meet  together. Then the apostles said to those other believers, “We (exc) would not be doing right if we stopped preaching and teaching  God’s message about Jesus  in order to distribute food MTY and money to the widows!

lun_bawang: Iamo' tuda'-tuda' lemulun sikal metueh rat neneh. Lemulun ineh ratnan ruma' sembayang, luk titen ruma' sembayang Lun luk Pinuit, ieh ineh lun Yahudi rat Kiréni idi Iskandria. Idi ideh neperurum nelun Yahudi rat Kilikia idi Asia nepesaad ni Stepanus.
english: However, some people opposed Stephen. They were Jews from a group that regularly met together in a Jewish meeting place that was {that people} called the Freedmen’s Meeting Place. Those people were from Cyrene and Alexandria cities and also from Cilicia and Asia provinces. They all began to argue with Stephen.

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nenuap tuda'-tuda' lemulun pad ideh pebala, "Kai pangeh neninger neneh makai bala luk nguyo ni Musa idi Allah pana'.”
english: Then that group secretly persuaded some  men to falsely accuse Stephen. saying, “We (exc) heard him say bad things about Moses and God.”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nenguit tuda'-tuda' lemulun pad ideh mebalih, kebaladeh, "Lemulun ini na ugka' nguyo Ruma' Allah idi Ukum Musa pana'.
english: They also brought in some other men who accused Stephen falsely about several things. They said, “This fellow continually says bad things about this holy Temple and about the laws that Moses received from God.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Imam Rayeh ni Stepanus, "Matuké bala ineh?”
english: Then the high priest asked Stephen, “Are the things that these people are saying about you(sg) true?”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Stepanus, "O lun kinanak idi lun taman-taman, ninger muyuh. Allah luk meluun rayeh nengegala' bururNeh kuan tepun tau Ibrahim, kareb ieh idi déi' bawang Mesopotamia kareb nateh ieh netudo bang bawang Haran,
english: Stephen replied, “Fellow Jews and respected leaders, please listen to me! The glorious God whom we(inc) worship appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still living in Mesopotamia region, before he moved to Haran town.

lun_bawang: "Idi tepun tau mét niat ni Yusup idi nemasui neneh amé' bawang Masir. Iamo' Allah nengedengan neneh,
english: “You know that Jacob’s older sons became jealous because their father favored their younger brother Joseph. So they sold him to merchants/traders who took him MTY to Egypt. There he became a slave of an official who lived there. But God helped Joseph.

lun_bawang: "Iamo' kareb pangeh nacing pejani' luk biré Allah kuan Ibrahim, idi pupu ineh luk amé' mula' déi' Masir.
english: “Our ancestors had become very numerous when it was almost time for God to rescue them from Egypt, as he had promised Abraham that he would do.

lun_bawang: Idi kenebpa teh ieh nacing kareb lemulun pekedaluh, idi sikal ngubuk nedeh pedo', keburi'neh, 'O lun muyuh, muyuh ini denganak, ngudehké muyuh ngedereh seburur dengan seburur?'
english: The next day, Moses saw two Israeli men fighting each other. He tried to make them stop fighting by saying to them, ‘Men, you two are fellow Israelis! So ◄stop hurting each other!/why are you hurting each other?► RHQ’

lun_bawang: "Pangeh apat ngepulu' lak, idi ieh nenier déi' su luk ali-ali muneng ku Pegkung Sinai inan aceh melaikat bang budung apui luk udung aceh kayuh luk mebeneh.
english: “One day 40 years later, the Lord God appeared as an angel to Moses. He appeared in a bush that was burning in the desert near Sinai Mountain.

lun_bawang: "Idi Musa kinarung lun pupu Israil, kebaladeh, Idéké luk nenganau' namu ku lun luk ngimet idi lun luk mutut besara'?' Iamo' ieh luk icuk Allah mangun ku lun luk ngimet idi ku lun luk muit dengan lalud melaikat luk sinierneh bang budung apui luk udung kayuh ineh.
english: “This Moses is the one who had tried to help our Israeli people, but whom they rejected by saying, ‘No one RHQ appointed you to rule and judge us!’ Moses is the one whom God himself sent to rule them and to free them from being slaves. He is the one whom an angel in the bush commanded to do that.

lun_bawang: "Tepun tau inan Lepo su luk inan papu' Tuhan déi' su luk ali-ali. Lepo ineh inau' maya' ayu luk icuk Allah ni Musa idi maya' ayu luk bida' Allah neneh.
english: “While our ancestors were in the desert, they worshipped God at the tent that showed that he was there with them. They had made the tent exactly like God had commanded Moses to make it. It was exactly like the model that Moses had seen when he was up on the mountain.

lun_bawang: "O muyuh luk metueh niat, idi luk na sinunat niat idi lalid, muyuh megéi' sikal metueh ratnan Roh Meligan! Kudeng tepun muyuh, kudeng ineh teh muyuh.
english: Your ancestors caused RHQ every prophet to suffer, including Moses. They even killed those who long ago announced that the Messiah would come, the one who always did what pleased God. And the Messiah has come! He is the one whom you recently turned over to his enemies and insisted that they kill him!

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh, "Siruh, ui nier langit pangeh mukab, idi Anak-Lemulun tuped pa tinueh Allah.”
english: When the Jewish Council members and others heard that, they shouted loudly. They put their hands over their ears so that they could not hear Stephen, and immediately they all rushed at him.

lun_bawang: Idi laba' ideh mitung ni Stepanus idi ieh sembayang, "O Tuhan Yésus, lapenMu rohku.”
english: Then Stephen fell on his knees and cried out, “Lord, do not punish them (OR, forgive them) LIT for this sin!” After he had said that, he died.

lun_bawang: Idi amung lun luk bang bawang ineh, do' lun dat idi lun do' pana' neninger balaneh idi nepebala, "Lun ini, ieh ineh lalud Allah luk titen Lalud Rayeh ineh.”
english: They continued to listen to him carefully, because for a long time he had astonished them by practicing sorcery.

lun_bawang: kebalaneh, "Maré negku lalud ineh, pad ui ngerareng ticu'ku luun idé'-idé', pad ideh ngalap Roh Meligan.”
english: But Peter said to him, “May you (sg) and your money go to hell, because you mistakenly think that you can buy from us what God alone gives to people

lun_bawang: Iamo' keburi' Pétrus neneh, "Do' usinmu idi bururmu pana' amé' bang apui, ngaceku iko ngerawé katu Allah miak belian dengan usin.
english: God has not authorized you to have any part of this ministry of giving the Holy Spirit’s power, because he knows that you are not thinking rightly! (OR, because he knows that you are thinking completely wrongly.)

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Simun nedidueh, "Sembayang kuanku inan Tuhan, pad ui na mekaneh anun-anun luk pangeh bila medueh negku.”
english: After Peter and John told people there what they knew personally about the Lord Jesus and declared to them the message about Jesus, they both returned to Jerusalem. Along the way they preached the good message about Jesus to people in many villages in Samaria province.

lun_bawang: Iamo' aceh melaikat Tuhan nepebala ni Pilipus, "Nalan iko idi amé' pa kabing busat aco maya' dalan rat Yerusalim amé' Gasa." (Na lemulun maya' dalan ineh nekini.)
english: So Philip got ready and went along that road. Suddenly he met a man from Ethiopia. He was an important official who took care of all the funds for the queen of Ethiopia. In his language people called their queen Candace. This man had gone to Jerusalem to worship God,

lun_bawang: Idi Roh Meligan nepebala ni Pilipus, "Amé' iko muneng ku keréta ineh.”
english: So Philip ran to the chariot and kept running close to it. Then he heard the official reading what the prophet Isaiah had written. He asked the man, “Do you (sg) understand what you are reading?”

lun_bawang: Pilipus nupun iné' matun neneh, idi neninger neneh uned maca' surat Nabi Yesaya, idi keburi'neh, "Iko kali' ilung luk bica' muké?”
english: He answered Philip, “No! ◄I cannot possibly understand it if there is no one to explain it to me!/How can I understand it if there is no one to explain it to me?► RHQ” Acts 8:31b-35 Then the man said to Philip, “Please come up and sit beside me.” So Philip did that.

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh, "Kudeng apeh ui kali' kudeng na lemulun mada' negku?" Idi ieh nenawar Pilipus umak tudo iringneh.
english: The part of the Scriptures that the official was reading was this: He will be silent when they lead him away to kill him like when  a sheep is led away to be killed. As a young sheep is silent when its wool is being cut off {someone cuts off its wool}, similarly he will not protest MTY when people cause him to suffer.

lun_bawang: Idi ini ayat-ayat luk bica'neh bang Surat Allah ineh: "Ieh pangeh inuit kudeng aceh dumba luk kereten idi kudeng aceh anak dumba luk mebegkeh pa kiung lun luk muting buluhneh; kudeng ineh teh na Ieh nengukab tangNeh.
english: When he will be humiliated by being accused falsely {people will humiliate him by accusing him falsely}, the rulers ◄will not consider him innocent/will consider him guilty►. No one will possibly be able to tell about his descendants, because he will be killed {people will kill him} without him having any descendants on the earth.

lun_bawang: Idi lemulun luk pinani' ineh nepebala ni Pilipus, "Ui mutuh namu mada' negku ratnan idéké nabi nemada', ratnan bururneh sebulengké, kian ratnan lun baken lek?”
english: So Philip began to explain that Scripture passage. He told him the good message about MTY Jesus. So the official understood and believed in Jesus.

lun_bawang: Kareb didueh uned maya' dalan ineh, idi didueh nacing inan aceh abpa'. Idi lemulun luk pinani' ineh nepebala, "Ieni inan abpa', anunké luk mebpeng negku na rerebpen?" [ 37Idi kebala Pilipus, "Kudeng iko manu dengan amung niatmu miak iko rerebpen." Idi kebalaneh, "Ui manu idi Yésus Keristus, Ieh ineh Anak Allah."]
english: So the official told the driver to stop the chariot. Then both Philip and the official went down into the pond of water, and Philip baptized him.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh neluka' luun tana' idi neninger aceh tang luk pebala neneh, "Saul, Saul, anunké punneh iko ngedereh Negku.”
english: Immediately he fell down to the ground. Then he heard the voice of the Lord say to him, “Saul, Saul, ◄stop causing me to suffer!/why are you causing me to suffer?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'neh, "Idéké Iko ineh, O Tuhan? Idi Ieh nepebala, "Ui ini Yésus, luk pederenmu ineh.
english: Saul asked him, “Lord, who are you?” He replied, “I am Jesus, and you (sg) are causing me to suffer by hurting my followers!

lun_bawang: Déi' Damsik inan aceh anak sekola', ngadanneh Ananias. Idi kebala Tuhan neneh bang aceh luk sinierneh, "O Ananias!" Idi keburi'neh, "Anun idi, Tuhan?”
english: In Damascus there was a Jew named Ananias who believed in Jesus. While Ananias was seeing a vision, the Lord Jesus said to him, “Ananias!” He replied, “Lord, I am listening.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Tuhan neneh, "Nalan iko idi amé' inan aceh dalan ngadanneh Mesiri, idi ngitun déi' ruma' Yudas ratnan seburur lemulun ngadanneh Saul, lun Tarsus, ngaceku nekini ieh sembayang.
english: The Lord Jesus told him, “Go to Straight Street to the house that belongs to Judas. Ask someone there if you(sg) can talk to a man named Saul from Tarsus city, because, surprisingly, at this moment he is praying to me.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Ananias, "O Tuhan, ui pangeh neninger mula' bala ratnan lemulun ini. Ieh pangeh nenganau' tuda'-tuda' kekamen luk dat kuan lun manu déi' Yerusalim.
english: But Ananias protested, saying, “But Lord, many people have told me about this man! He has done many evil things to the people in Jerusalem who believe in you!

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Tuhan neneh, "Amé iko, ngaceku ieh luk pinili'Ku, ngakem kuanKu, pad ieh ngegala' ngadanKu kuan lun pupu baken idi raca'-raca', idi kuan lun pupu Israil pana'.
english: But the Lord Jesus told Ananias, “Go to Saul! Do what I say, because I have chosen him to serve me in order that he might speak about me MTY both to non-Jewish people and their kings and to the Israeli people.

lun_bawang: Idi amung lemulun luk neninger balaneh mawa idi nepebala, "Naké ieh ineh lemulun luk ngaté lemulun luk neten ngadan ini déi' Yerusalim? Idi ieh nacing tungé' ngaceku ieh pian nguit nedeh kitem abetdeh pa kiung imam- imam rayeh.”
english: And all the people who heard him preach were amazed. Various ones of them were saying, “◄We(inc) can hardly believe that this is the same man who persecuted the believers in Jerusalem!/Is this really the same man who persecuted the believers in Jerusalem?► RHQ, MTY And we (inc) know that he has RHQ come here to seize us and take us to the chief priests in Jerusalem!”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi' Pétrus neneh, "O Anias, Yésus Keristus ngedo' namu. Tumui iko, idi ngelepi' luk inanmu rudap." Idi petacu ieh netumui peh.
english: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you (sg) right now! Get up and roll up your mat!” Right away Aeneas stood up.

lun_bawang: Pétrus nengecuk amung-amung lemulun remuat, idi ieh netekeradung nesembayang. Idi ieh nelumi inan butung ineh, keburi'neh, "O Tabita, tumui iko!" Idi Tabita nekulat. Kareb ieh nenier Pétrus, idi ieh netumui.
english: But Peter sent them all out of the room. Then he got down on his knees and prayed. Then, turning toward Tabitha’s body, he said, “Tabitha, stand up!” Immediately she opened her eyes and, when she saw Peter, she sat up.

lun_bawang: Bang seaco kareb nateh tangal musul aco, ieh nenier dengan megala' bang aceh luk sinierneh aceh melaikat Allah nacing neneh idi nepebala neneh, "O Kornilius!”
english: One day at about three o’clock in the afternoon Cornelius saw a vision. He clearly saw an angel whom God had sent. The angel came into his room and said to him, “Cornelius!”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nenier melaikat ineh dengan matot, kebalaneh, "Anun idi, O Tuhan?" Idi kebala melaikat neneh, "Amung sembayangmu idi éi'mu pangeh kali' Allah mangun ku aceh terawé pa kiungNeh.
english: Cornelius stared at the angel and became terrified. Then he asked fearfully, “Sir, what do you (sg) want?” The angel answered him, “You (sg) have pleased God because you have been praying regularly to him and you often give money to help poor people. Those things have been like a sacrifice to God.

lun_bawang: Idi inan aceh tang luk pebala neneh, "O Pétrus, mudur iko, keretenmu idi kenenmu pung ineh!”
english: Then he heard God SYN say to him, “Peter, stand up, kill and cook some of these and eat their meat!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Pétrus nepebala, "Ara' ui Tuhan, ngaceku ui nateh nekuman anun- anun luk dat idi melutak.”
english: But Peter replied, “Lord, surely you (sg) do not really want me to do that! I have never eaten any meat that our Jewish law says is unacceptable to God or something that we(exc) must not eat!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' tang ineh nepebala sekua' teh, "Luk pangeh biru' Allah aleg iko mala neneh dat.”
english: Then Peter heard MTY God talk to him a second time. He said, “I am God, so if I have made something acceptable to eat, do not say that it is not acceptable to eat!”

lun_bawang: Laba' Pétrus ngerawé ratnan luk sinierneh ineh, idi Roh nepebala neneh, "Siruh, inan teluh burur lemulun nakap namu.
english: While Peter was still trying to understand what the vision meant, God’s Spirit said to him, “Three men are here who want to see you.

lun_bawang: Idi Pétrus netemurun iné' matun lemulun ineh, kebalaneh, "Ui ini luk tekapen muyuh. Anunké punneh muyuh macing tungé'?”
english: So Peter went down to the men and said to them, “Greetings! I am the man you are looking for. Why have you come?”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Pétrus nenaped neneh, keburi'neh, "Tuped iko; ui ini pana' lemulun teh.”
english: But Peter grasped Cornelius by the hand and lifted him to his feet. He said, “Stand up! Do not revere/worship me I myself am only human, like you!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Kornilius, "Teluh aco luk pangeh nepelaba, kareb tangal musul aco kudeng ini, ui nesembayang bang ruma'ku. Denak-denak selemulun netuped pa kiungku dengan ayung luk merasat,
english: Cornelius replied, “About this time four days ago I was praying to God in my house, as I regularly do at three o’clock in the afternoon. Suddenly a man whose clothes shone brightly stood in front of me,

lun_bawang: Idi Pétrus nepebala, "Dengan matu ui nier, idi Allah na mili' ayu lemulun,
english: So Peter began to speak MTY to them. He said, “Now I understand that it is true that God does not favor only certain groups of people.

lun_bawang: "Miakké seburur lemulun mebpeng abpa' pad na miak ngerereb lemulun ini luk pangeh nengalap Roh Meligan mepad kudeng kai ini?”
english: Then Peter said to the other Jewish believers who were there, “God has given them the Holy Spirit just like he gave him to us Jewish believers, so ◄surely all of you would agree that we(exc) should baptize these people!/would any of you forbid that these people should be baptized?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: "Iko pangeh iné' inan lemulun luk na sinunat idi nekuman dengandeh.”
english: They said to him, “Not only was it wrong for you(sg) to visit non-Jewish people, you even ate with them!”

lun_bawang: "Kareb unedku sembayang déi' bawang Yopa, idi ui nenier aceh luk sinierku, idi inan aceh luk kudeng tarub luk rayeh luk inimet anid lidungneh, inurur rat déi' langit macing negku.
english: He said, “I was praying by myself in Joppa town, and in a trance I saw a vision. I saw that something like a large sheet was being lowered from heaven. It was tied with ropes at its four corners, and it came down to where I was.

lun_bawang: Pangeh ideh neninger kudeng ini idi amung-amungdeh pirud, idi nengerayeh Allah, kebaladeh, "Kudeng pieh kudeng ineh, kuan lun pupu baken teh Allah pangeh nemaré dalan uren luk nguit amé' inan ulun.”
english: After those Jewish believers heard what Peter said, they stopped criticizing him. Instead, they praised God, saying, “Then it is clear to us that God has also accepted the non-Jews so that they will have eternal life, if they turn from their sinful behavior and believe in Jesus!”

lun_bawang: Denak-denak aceh melaikat Tuhan netuped déi', idi aceh acang merasat bang takep ineh. Idi melaikat ineh nengegio tudung Pétrus idi nengalat neneh, kebalaneh, "Tumui iko dengan mesaget." Idi kaling ineh pana' netaka ratnan ticu'neh.
english: Suddenly an angel from the Lord God stood beside Peter, and a bright light shone in his cell. The angel poked Peter in the side and woke him up and said, “Get up quickly!” While Peter was getting up, the chains fell off from his wrists. However, the soldiers were not aware of what was happening.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala melaikat ineh teh, "Do' iko ngabet awe'mu, idi muet kasutmu." Idi Pétrus nenganau' kudeng ineh. Idi kebala melaikat neneh, "Do' iko ngayung ku kuyuh'mu idi maya' negku.”
english: Then the angel said to Peter, “Put on your clothes and sandals!” So Peter did. Then the angel said to him, “Fasten your belt/girdle around you(sg) and put on your sandals!” So Peter did that. Then the angel told him, “Wrap your cloak around you and follow me!”

lun_bawang: Idi Pétrus nekali' ratnan luk nangun kuanneh, idi keburi'neh, "Nekini ui kali' dengan matu idi Tuhan pangeh nengecuk melaikatNeh muit negku rat bang palad Herodés idi ratnan pian luk Yahudi ineh.”
english: Then Peter finally realized that what had happened to him was not a vision, but it had really happened. So he said to himself, “Now I really know that the Lord God sent an angel to help me. He rescued me from what Herod planned to do MTY to me, and also from all the things that the Jewish leaders SYN expected that Herod would do to me.”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'deh neneh, "Iko meruden." Iamo' decur ineh mesaad mala bala luk bilaneh ineh. Idi keburi'deh, "Ada'neh ineh!”
english: But one of them said to her, “You (sg) are crazy!” But she continued saying that it was really true. Then they repeatedly said, “No, it cannot be Peter. It is probably the angel who was guarding him who has come (OR, It is the angel who has guarded/protected him, and he has come to tell us that Peter has died.)”

lun_bawang: Idi lun mula' ineh nengitang, keburi'deh, "Baken ini bala lemulun, iamo' ini aceh bala allah.”
english: Those who were listening to him shouted repeatedly, “This man who is speaking is a god, not a man!”

lun_bawang: Idi laba' ideh sembayang inan Tuhan idi mawa', idi kebala Roh Meligan, "Uen ngatad kuanKu Barnabas idi Saul, pad didueh miak nganau' kekamen luk icukKu nedidueh.”
english: While they were worshipping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said to them, “Appoint Barnabas and Saul to serve me and to go and do the work that I have chosen them to do!”

lun_bawang: idi keburi'neh, "O iko luk mepanu' ku amung-amung balih idi luk dat, anak Iblis, bunu' amung-amung luk matu'! Megéi' iko ngekilu' dalan Tuhan luk mesiri!
english: “You (sg) are serving the devil and you oppose everything that is good! You are always lying to people and doing other evil things to them. ◄You must stop saying that the truth about the Lord God is a lot of lies!/When will you stop changing what is true about the Lord God and saying what is not true about him?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Kareb ideh pangeh nemaca' surat Ukum Musa idi surat nabi-nabi, idi lun rayeh-rayeh ruma' sembayang ineh nengecuk lemulun amé' matun rasul-rasul ineh, keburi'deh, "O kinanak-kinanakku, kudeng inan rat arang muyuh luk sikal mala aceh bala luk miak ngubuk pupu ineh, do' mala nekini.”
english: Someone read aloud from what Moses had written. Then someone read from what the other prophets had written MTY. Then the leaders of the Jewish meeting place gave someone this note to take to Paul and Barnabas: “Fellow Jews, if one of you wants to speak to the people here to encourage them, please speak to us(exc) now.”

lun_bawang: Paulus netuped, idi nengayep nedeh, idi nepebala: "O muyuh lun Israil, idi muyuh luk matot inan Allah, ninger muyuh.
english: So Paul stood up and motioned with his right hand so that the people would listen to him. Then he said, “Fellow Israelis and you non-Jewish people who also worship God, please listen to me!

lun_bawang: "O kinanak-kinanakku, luk inul Ibrahim, idi amung-amung pupu baken luk idi ieni luk sembayang nan Allah; kuan tau bala ulun ini pangeh nacing.
english: “Fellow Israelis, you who are descendants of Abraham, and you non-Jewish people who also worship God, please listen! It is to all of us that God has sent the message about how he saves people.

lun_bawang: Idi ini luk bila Allah ratnan ieh nenui Neneh rat arang lun naté, pad Ieh na lemubed amé' inan luk melu, 'Ui sikal maré kuanMu peruan luk matu idi luk meligan, luk pijani'Ku ni Daud.'
english: God has ◄raised the Messiah from the dead/caused the Messiah to live again after he had died► and will never let him die again. Concerning that, God said to our Jewish ancestors, ‘I will surely help you, as I promised David that I would do.’

lun_bawang: Iamo' Paulus idi Barnabas meluun mekuu' mada', kebala didueh, "Setuneh bala Allah ineh na miak na belén atun kuan muyuh, iamo' ngaceku muyuh pangeh nengarung balaNeh idi ngerawé burur muyuh na mayu ngalap ulun luk meruked, idi kai necan nemuyuh idi amé' nelun pupu baken.
english: We are doing that also because the Lord God has commanded us to do it. He said to us, ‘I have appointed you to reveal things about me to non-Jewish people MET that will be like a light to them. I have appointed you to tell people everywhere MTY in the world about the one who came to save them.’ ”

lun_bawang: idi kebala Paulus dengan bala luk rayeh, "Tuped iko!" Idi ieh nesikau'-sikau' idi petacu nalan.
english: So Paul called out to him, “Stand up!” When the man heard that, he immediately jumped up and began to walk normally.

lun_bawang: Kareb lun mula' nekali' luk inau' Paulus, idi ideh nengitang dengan buri' lun Likonia, "Allah-allah pangeh netemurun kuan tau nemaya' ayu lemulun.”
english: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they thought that Paul and Barnabas ◄were/must be► the gods that they worshipped. So they shouted excitedly in their own Lycaonia language, “Look! These people are the gods that we(inc) worship! They have made themselves look like people and have come down from the sky/heaven to help us!”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh neneten Barnabas ineh Sius, idi Paulus ineh Hermis ngaceku ieh luk megéi' pebala.
english: They began to say that Barnabas was probably the chief god, whose name was Zeus. And they began to say that Paul was Hermes, the messenger/spokesman for the other gods. They mistakenly thought that because Paul was the one who had been speaking.

lun_bawang: Tuda'-tuda' burur lemulun nacing rat Yudia idi nemada' kinanak-kinanak ineh, keburi'deh, "Kudeng na muyuh uen nunat maya' Ukum Musa, na muyuh miak ngalap ulun.”
english: Then some Jewish believers went down from Judea province to Antioch. They started teaching the non-Jewish believers there, and said, “You ◄must be circumcised/must have God’s mark put on you► to indicate you belong to God, as Moses commanded in the laws that he received from God. If you do not do that, you will not be saved {God will not save you}.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' tuda'-tuda' lun manu ratnan babpat lun Parisi, netuped idi nepebala, "Meluun do' nunat amung lemulun ineh, idi ngecuk nedeh maya' Ukum Musa.”
english: But some of the Jewish believers who belonged to the Pharisee sect stood up among the other believers and said to them, “The non-Jews who have believed in Jesus must be circumcised, and they must be told to obey the laws that God gave to Moses.”

lun_bawang: Kareb didueh pangeh nepebala idi Yakub nengor bala didueh, kebalaneh, "O Kinanak-kinanakku, ninger muyuh balaku!
english: When Barnabas and Paul had finished speaking, James, the leader of the group of believers there in Jerusalem, spoke to all of them. He said, “Fellow believers, listen to me.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ineh bala Tuhan, luk pangeh nengelio ineh rat pun-pun.' “
english: I caused my people to know about them long ago.”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh nemaré sebuleng surat ini itendeh: "Tabi' ratnan rasul-rasul, lun rayeh-rayeh idi kinanak-kinanak muyuh kuan kinanak-kinanak rat nelun pupu baken déi' Antiokia, Siria, idi Kilikia.
english: Then they wrote the following letter that they asked Judas and Silas to take to the believers at Antioch: “We(exc) apostles and other leaders who are your fellow believers send our greetings to you as we write this to you non-Jewish believers who live in Antioch and other places in Syria and Cilicia provinces.

lun_bawang: Paulus idi Barnabas tudo tuda'-tuda' io déi' Antiokia, idi nemada' idi nengelio bala Tuhan dengan tuda'-tuda' lun baken teh.
english: After some time Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s go back and visit the fellow believers in every city where we previously proclaimed the message about the Lord Jesus. In that way, we will know how well they are continuing to believe in the Lord Jesus.”

lun_bawang: Idi malem ineh Paulus nenier aceh luk sinierneh; ieh ineh inan seburur lun Makedonia netuped nenawar neneh, keburi'neh, "Amé' tungé' Makedonia idi ngedengan nekai!”

english: because the Lord will punish completely and speedily the people who live on  this earth, as he said that he would do.

lun_bawang: Maya' kudeng luk bila Yesaya atun, "Kudeng na Tuhan luk melalud maré inul kuan tau, kali' rungen tau pangeh mangun mepad kudeng Sodom idi Gemora.”
english: We must conclude this: RHQ Although non-Jews did not search out a way by which God would erase the record of their sins, they actually found that way because they trusted in what Christ did for them.

lun_bawang: Musa nengayud, idi lemulun luk nganau' luk matu rat bang Ukum ineh miak mulun ratnan ineh.
english: In regard to the old way, Moses wrote concerning people who obey God’s laws, “It is the people who have done perfectly the things that the laws require who will gain eternal life by doing them.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' ini luk bila ratnan luk matu luk macing ratnan anu, "Aleg pebala bang niatmu, 'Idéké miak semuet surga?' (ilungneh nguit Keristus temurun),
english: But those whose record of sins God has erased as a result of their believing in Christ can say to anyone PRS as Moses said, “You should not critically think inwardly, ‘◄Someone will have to go up and enter heaven!/Who will go up and enter heaven?►’ RHQ” That is to say, someone will have to go up and bring Christ down to bring the message of salvation to us!

lun_bawang: Ini luk bilaneh, "Bala ineh muneng namu peh, ieh ineh bang tangmu, idi bang niatmu pana'," (ieh ineh bala manu luk badén kai).
english: But instead, those who believe in Christ PRS can say what RHQ Moses also said, “You (sg) can find out about God’s message very easily. You can speak MTY about it; you can think MTY about it.” This is the message that we proclaim, that people must believe in Christ.

lun_bawang: Surat Allah pebala, "Idé-idé luk manu Neneh na miak migu' peh.”
english: It is written {Isaiah wrote} in the Scriptures PRS about the Messiah, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”

lun_bawang: Ngaceku "anid-anid lemulun luk nawar ngadan Tuhan miak uen ngulun.”
english: This is just like what the prophet Joel wrote: “All those who ask the Lord God to save them will be saved {The Lord God will save all those who ask him to save them}.”

lun_bawang: Idi kudeng apehké bala ineh miak badén, kudeng lun luk mada' na icuk? Maya' kudeng luk inayud, "Kudeng apeh do' ayu lengayan amung-amung lemulun luk nguit Bala luk Do'.”
english: And those who preach to them about Christ, ◄certainly cannot preach if they are not sent by God {if God does not send them} to preach!/how can they preach if they are not sent by God {if God does not send them} to preach?► RHQ His sending messengers to them would be just like it is written {like someone wrote} in the Scriptures, ‘The arrival MTY of those who preach the good message is wonderful!’ ”

lun_bawang: Iamo' baken amung-amungdeh nemaya' Bala luk Do' ineh. Kebala Yesaya, "O Tuhan, idéké luk manu inan luk bida' kai?”
english: I would reply in this way to people who say such things: God has indeed sent people to preach the message about Christ. But not all the people of Israel have paid attention to the good message! It is like what Isaiah said when he felt very discouraged, “Lord, it seems as if hardly anyone believed what they heard us (exc) preach! RHQ”

lun_bawang: Iamo' ui ngitun: Naké lemulun ineh neninger teh? Mo, neninger! Ngaceku maya' kudeng luk inayud: "Bada'deh pangeh nepiar aput tana', Idi baladeh pana' nacing iring tana'.”
english: But if someone were to ask, “Have not the people of Israel heard the message about God?” I would reply that they certainly have heard it! It is like what is written in the Psalms, People living all over the world PRS, MTY have seen the stars, and what they indicate about God’s character has reached people living in the most remote places in the world DOU!

lun_bawang: Iamo' ui ngitun: Naké pupu Israil kali'? Pun-pun Musa sebuleng pebala, "Kebala Allah: 'Ui nganau' nemuyuh mét niat inan pupu luk baken aceh imet luk matu; Ui nganau' nemuyuh museh nan aceh pupu luk mebacé.' “
english: But someone might ask, “Is it true that the people of MTY Israel understood the message about Christ?” I would reply that certainly they understood it, but they rejected it! Remember that Moses was the first one who warned the people of Israel about disobeying God. He told them that God said, You consider that non-Jewish groups are not nations at all CHI.
