But some of them will believe in me, and I will bless them. Then you will envy them. I will cause you to be angry with those people whom you Jews think do not understand my ways IRO.

lun_bawang: Idi Yesaya meluun kuu' kareb ieh pebala, "Kebala Allah, 'Ui ilap lemulun luk na nenakap Negku, Ui nesilagan kuan lemulun luk na nengitun Negku.' “
english: Remember also what God said very boldly to Isaiah: Non-Jews who did not ◄try to know/seek► me will surely find me DOU! I will surely reveal what I am like to those who did not ask for me!

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebala Yesaya ratnan pupu Israil, "Kebala Allah, 'Tebaco-tebaco Ui nengurur ticu'Ku kuan pupu luk na maya' bala idi luk pekedaluh.' "
english: But concerning the people of Israel, Isaiah tells us that God said: For a long time I have held out my arms to people who disobeyed and rebelled against me, in order to invite them to return to me.

lun_bawang: "O Tuhan, nabi-nabiMu pangeh pinatédeh, idi amung-amung bubpunMu pangeh tibpa, pad ui mo' luk ketecan, idi ideh nutun ngaté negku.”
english: “Lord, they have killed the rest of your (sg) prophets, they have destroyed your altars. I am the only one who believes in you who remains alive, and now they are trying to kill me!”

lun_bawang: Anunké or Allah neneh? "Ui pangeh nenecan kuanKu tudu' ngeribu lun deléi luk nateh netekeradung inan akang Baal.”
english: God answered him like this: “You(sg) are not the only one who believes in me! I have protected for myself not just you, but 7,000 other men who have not worshipped the false god Baal. ◄Remember that!/Do you not remember that?► RHQ”

lun_bawang: Maya' kudeng luk inayud, "Allah nenganau' niat idi terawédeh meberat pad macing aco sini ideh na miak nier dengan matehdeh, idi ninger dengan laliddeh.”
english: Our fellow Jews are just like the ones about whom Isaiah wrote, God ◄caused their senses to be dull/made them unable to think clearly►. Up to this very day, they have eyes but they cannot see spiritually MET. They have ears, but they cannot understand spiritually what they hear.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ineh teh bala Daud, "Nima' iraudeh mangun ku aceh abpung; pad ideh mebpeh idi kumin!
english: And they remind me of what King David said, when he asked God to cause his enemies’ senses to be dull MET, Make them stupid MTY, like animals that are caught in snares! May they feel secure because of the things that they enjoy but which will catch them like a trap DOU, MET, with the result that you will destroy them.

lun_bawang: Iamo' iko sikal pebala, "Angat-angat ineh pangeh neputul, pad ui ini miak uen ngawin luunneh.”
english: If one of you then says, “God rejected the Jews MET like branches MET that are broken {that people broke} off a tree and rejected, in order that he might accept us non-Jews, as branches MET of a tree are grafted in {as people graft in branches of a tree},”

lun_bawang: Kudeng ineh lawéneh amung pupu Israil miak uen ngulun, maya' kudeng luk inayud, "Lun Ngulun ineh miak macing rat Sion. Ieh sikal ngado luk dat ratnan inul Yakub.
english: And then all HYP the people of Israel will be saved {God will save all HYP the people of Israel}. Then these words that are written {that a prophet wrote} in the Scriptures will ◄become true/be fulfilled►: The one who sets his people free will originate from the place where God dwells (OR, from the Jews) MTY. Then he will remove the guilt of the Israelite people (OR, descendants of Jacob) MTY.

lun_bawang: Maya' kudeng luk inayud: "Idéké luk kali' terawé Tuhan? Idéké luk miak mada' Neneh?
english: I remember the Scriptures that say, ◄No one has known what the Lord thinks./Who has known what the Lord thinks?► RHQ ◄Absolutely no one has given him advice about what he should do!/Who has advised him about what he should do?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Idéké luk pangeh nemaré anun-anun kuanNeh, pad Ieh miak ngua'?”
english: And, ◄No one has given anything to God that he did not previously receive from God!/Has anyone given anything to God that he did not previously receive from God?► RHQ So God ◄is not obligated to/does not have to► pay back anything to anyone!

lun_bawang: O lun rurumku, aleg muyuh sebuleng ngua', iamo' nima' Allah ngua'. Ngaceku pangeh inayud, "Ui ini luk ngua'; Ui ini sikal ngua', kebala Tuhan.”
english: My fellow believers whom I love, do not do something evil in return when people do something evil to you! Instead, allow God to punish them MTY, because it is {someone has} written in the Scriptures that the Lord said, “‘It is my responsibility to take revenge; I am the one who will punish people who do something something evil to you DOU,’ says the Lord.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' maya' kudeng luk inayud, "Kudeng bunu'mu melau, do' maré luk kenenneh, kudeng ieh meparing, do' maré luk rupenneh. Ngaceku dengan kekamen luk kudeng ineh iko ngamung bareh apui pa luun uluhneh.”
english: Instead of doing something evil to those who have done something evil to you, do as the Scriptures teach: “If your (sg) enemies are hungry, feed them! If they are thirsty, give them something to drink! By doing that, you (sg) will cause them to feel ashamed and perhaps they will change their attitude toward you IDM.”

lun_bawang: Ngaceku pangeh inayud, "Ratnan ulunKu ini, kebala Tuhan, idi anid-anid aleb miak tekeradung pa kiungKu, idi anid-anid dila' miak ngamo Ui ini Tuhan.”
english: We know this because it is written {a prophet/Isaiah wrote} what God has said: Everyone will bow down before me! That is as certain as the fact that I live IDM! Everyone SYN will acknowledge that because I am God, I have the right to judge and punish people.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku Keristus pana' na nengerawé bururNeh sebuleng, iamo' kudeng luk pangeh inayud, "Idi amung-amung adu' lemulun luk ngilang Namu, pangeh mebpeh luun bururku.”
english: We should please our fellow believers, since Christ has set us an example. He did not do things to please himself. On the contrary, he tried to please God even when others insulted him. That was as it is written {as ◄someone/the Psalmist► wrote} in Scripture that the Messiah said to God: “When people insulted you (sg), it was as though they were also insulting me.”

lun_bawang: pelé lun pupu baken pana' miak ngerayeh Allah ngaceku éi'Neh, maya' kudeng luk pangeh inayud, "Idi ini punneh ui ngubur Namu arang lun pupu baken, idi menani ngubur ngadanMu.”
english: And by acting mercifully to them, he also caused non-Jews to praise him. What he has done for non-Jews fulfills what is written in the Scriptures that David said to God: “So I will praise you (sg) when I am among the non-Jews, and I will sing to you MTY.”

lun_bawang: Idi teh keburi'neh, "Mawang niat, O lun pupu baken, dengan pupu luk pinili' Allah.”
english: David also wrote, “You non-Jews, rejoice with us who are God’s people.”

lun_bawang: Idi teh, "Ngubur Tuhan ineh, O amung lun pupu baken. Ngubur neneh, O amung-amung pupu,”
english: And Moses wrote in the Scriptures, “Praise the Lord, all you non-Jews, and may everyone praise him DOU.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala Yesaya teh, "Idi inul Isai ineh miak macing teh, idi Ieh miak uen ngikit pad ngimet lun pupu baken, idi ideh miak merapet Neneh.”
english: And Isaiah wrote in the Scriptures, “There will be a descendant MET of King David who will begin to rule the non-Jews. They will confidently expect him to fulfill what he has promised.”

lun_bawang: Maya' kudeng luk pangeh inayud, "Lemulun luk na nekali' bala ratnan Ieh miak nier, idi lemulun luk na neninger ineh miak kali'.”
english: On the contrary, I teach non-Jews, so that what happens may be like what was written {the prophet Isaiah wrote} in the Scriptures about the Messiah: “Those who did not hear about him previously will know the truth about him. Truly, those who have not heard about him will hear and understand his message DOU.”

lun_bawang: Ini ilung balaku: Anid-anid burur muyuh baken bala. Sebuang pebala, "Ui ini Paulus kuan," idi inan luk pebala, "Ui ini Apolos kuan," idi inan teh luk pebala, "Ui ini Pétrus kuan," idi inan teh luk pebala, "Ui ini Keristus kuan.”
english: That is, some of you say, “Paul is the one to whom we are loyal,” and others say, “Peter is the one to whom we are loyal,” and still others say, “Christ is the one to whom we are loyal.”

lun_bawang: Ngaceku pangeh inayud, "Idi Ui sikal nala' ileh lemulun luk mileh ineh, idi terawé lemulun luk ngerawé ineh Ui sikal ngagka'.”
english: It is like what God said that a prophet wrote long ago, By the things that I will do, I will show that the ideas of those who think IRO they are wise are completely useless. I will ignore the ideas that they think are IRO so smart.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh maya' kudeng luk inayud, "Idé-idé luk mesido' niat, nima' neneh mesido' niat ngaceku luk inau' Tuhan."
english: So, it is the Lord whom we should boast about, not about one spiritual leader being better than another. We should do as ◄a prophet/Jeremiah► wrote in the Scriptures that we should do: Those who boast should boast only about what the Lord has done.

lun_bawang: Iamo' maya' kudeng luk inayud, "Luk na sinier mateh, idi luk na pindenger lalid, luk na megala' bang niat lemulun, ieh ineh luk inau' Allah temina' kuan lemulun luk mawa Neneh.”
english: But we believers need to remember these words that a prophet wrote in the Scriptures: Things that no one has ever seen, things that no one ever heard, things that no one ever thought could happen, those are the things that God has prepared for those who love him.

lun_bawang: Maya' kudeng luk inayud, "Idéké luk kali' terawé Tuhan? Idéké miak mada' Neneh?" Iamo' tau ini inan terawé Keristus.
english: As one of our prophets wrote: No human RHQ has known what the Lord is thinking. No human RHQ is able to instruct him. But we believers are able to think about things MTY in the way that Christ thinks about them.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku kareb lemulun pebala, "Ui ini Paulus kuan," idi luk baken pebala, "Ui ini Apolos kuan," bakenké muyuh lemulun luk maya' ulun tana' ini?
english: By some of you saying, “I am loyal to Paul,” and others saying, “I am loyal to Apollos,” ◄you show that you are acting like unbelievers./does not it show that you are acting like unbelievers?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ileh tana' ini mangun ku bacé kuan Allah. Ngaceku pangeh inayud, "Idi Tuhan ngakem lemulun luk mileh ineh bang ilehneh sebuleng,”
english: You should do that because things that unbelievers consider to be IRO wise, God considers to be foolish. We can learn from the Scriptures what God says about that: Those who think that they are IRO wise, he messes up their plans by the mistakes they make!

lun_bawang: idi teh pangeh inayud, "Tuhan kali' ratnan terawé lemulun luk mileh ineh na ulek.”
english: And we can learn from these words of Scripture, The Lord considers as useless the thoughts of humans who think that they are IRO wise.

lun_bawang: Inan luk pebala, "Ui miak nganau' anun-anun luk pianku." Matu! Iamo' baken amung ineh inan ulek kuanmu. Ui pana' miak pebala, "Ui miak nganau' anun-anun luk pianku." Iamo' ui ini na sikal mangun ku demulun anun-anun pana'.
english: Some of you may say, “God allows us to do anything that he does not forbid.” But I would reply, “That is true, but not everything that God permits us to do helps us.” Yes, as some of you say, God permits us to do anything that he does not forbid. But as for me, I will not let anything make me its slave; that is, I will not do anything that will gain control over me in such a way that I will not be able to stop doing it.

lun_bawang: Inan teh luk pebala, "Akan ineh kuan batek, idi batek ineh kuan akan." Matu! Iamo' dueh-duehneh ineh miak uen Allah ngusag. Iamo' burur ineh baken kuan pasét, iamo' kuan Tuhan, idi Tuhan ineh kuan burur.
english: Some of you may also say, “Food is just for us to put in the stomach, and the stomach is just for us to put food in. And since God will do away with food and stomachs when he gives us our new bodies, what we do with our bodies sexually does not affect us any more than eating food does.” But what you have concluded is wrong, because the Lord does not want us to use our bodies to do sexually immoral things. Instead, the Lord wants us to use our bodies in ways that please him. Also, the Lord wants us to do what is good for our bodies.

lun_bawang: Naké muyuh kali' idi luk pamung nan decur luk mesawa' mangun ku sebuleng burur denganneh? Ngaceku kebala Tuhan, "Idi didueh ineh miak mangun ku sebuleng burur.”
english: When a man has sexual relations EUP with a prostitute, it is as though their two bodies become one body. ◄You should never forget that!/Do you not know that?► RHQ What Moses wrote about people who join together sexually is, “The two of them will become as though they are one body.”

lun_bawang: Ngado burur muyuh ratnan pasét! Anid-anid sala' baken luk inau' lemulun, ieh ineh baken ratnan bururneh. Iamo' lemulun luk pasét ineh, ieh ineh mesala' kuan bururneh sebuleng.
english: Always ◄run away from/avoid► committing sexually immoral acts. Other sins that people commit do not affect their bodies, but those who commit sexually immoral acts sin against their own bodies.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku kudeng inan luk titen "allah-allah" pana', do bang langit idi bang tana', idi sagan pana' inan mula' luk titen "Allah" idi "lalud",
english: It is true that there are gods whom people think live in the heavens or whom they think live on earth. Truly, there are many beings that people call gods, and whom they call lords.

lun_bawang: Pangeh inayud, "Idi aleg iko ngabet tang sapi' luk uned rumik ineh." Inanké Allah ngerawé sapi' ineh?
english: Moses wrote in one of those laws, “While an ox is threshing grain, you must not tie its mouth shut so that it cannot eat the grain.” ◄God was not only concerned about oxen when he gave that law./Was God only concerned about oxen when he gave that law?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Aleg muyuh sembayang inan akang, mepad kudeng tuda'-tuda' rat arangdeh ineh. Ngaceku pangeh inayud, "Idi pupu ineh paneh netudo kuman idi ngirup, idi ngalai.”
english: We should not worship idols as many of those people did. Remember that Moses wrote, “The people sat down. They ate and drank to honor the golden calf that they had just made. Then they got up to dance immorally.”

lun_bawang: Inan luk pebala, "Ui miak nganau' anun-anun luk pianku." Matu! Iamo' baken amung-amung ineh inan ulek kuanmu. "Kai miak nganau' anun-anun." Iamo' baken amung-amung ineh inan ulek.
english: Some people say, “God permits believers to do anything.” But I say that not everything that people do benefits those who do it! Yes, some people say, “God permits believers to do all things.” But not everything that people do helps them to become spiritually mature.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku kebala Tuhan, "Tana' ini idi amung uangneh, ieh ineh Tuhan kuan.”
english: Remember that the Psalmist wrote, “Everything on the earth belongs to the Lord God because he created it!” So, food that has been offered to idols belongs to the Lord, not to the idols, and you may eat it.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kudeng selemulun pebala kuan muyuh, "Akan ini pangeh biré inan akang," aleg muyuh kuman ineh, pad na ngesabeng lemulun ineh, idi teruayen niat.
english: But if someone says to you, “This is food that was sacrificed to an idol,” do not eat it, for the sake of the person who told that to you, and also because someone there may think that it is wrong to eat such food.

lun_bawang: idi pangeh Ieh nemaré ubur, idi Ieh nemuri' ruti, kebalaNeh, "Ini bururKu luk biré ngaceku muyuh. Nganau' kudeng ini mangun ku aceh terawé ratnan Ui.”
english: Similarly, after they ate their meal, he took a cup MTY of wine. He thanked God for it. Then he gave it to his disciples, saying, “The wine in MTY this cup represents MET (OR, is) my blood that will flow from my body ◄to put into effect/to establish► the new agreement that God is making with people. Whenever you drink wine in this way, do it to remember that my blood flowed for you.”

lun_bawang: Kudeng ineh teh kareb pangeh nekuman, idi Ieh nengalap sangkir, kebalaNeh, "Sangkir ini, ieh ineh pejani' Allah luk mebaruh luk itu ku dara'Ku. Anid-anid kareb muyuh ngirup, nganau' kudeng ineh mangun ku aceh terawé ratnan Ui.”
english: Remember that until the Lord Jesus returns to the earth, whenever you eat the bread that represents his body and drink the wine MTY that represents his blood, you are telling other people that he died for you.

lun_bawang: Petulu muyuh kali, idi seburur pana' luk kinuyut Roh Allah, na miak pebala, "Yésus ineh kidiman!" Idi seburur pana' na miak mala, "Yésus ineh Tuhan," kudeng ieh na kinuyut Roh Meligan.
english: So the first thing that I will tell you now is that it is not the Spirit of God who would cause anyone to say, “Jesus deserved to die,” and that the Holy Spirit is the only one who can enable anyone to say, “Jesus is truly the Lord.”

lun_bawang: Kudeng kukud pebala, "Ngaceku ui baken ticu', na ui aceh babpat ratnan burur," idi baken ngaceku bala ineh kukud ineh na aceh babpat ratnan burur.
english: If our foot could talk and say to us, “Because I am not your hand, I am not a part of your body,” it would still be a part of our body.

lun_bawang: Idi kudeng lalid pebala, "Ngaceku ui baken mateh, na ui aceh babpat ratnan burur," idi baken ngaceku bala ineh lalid ineh na aceh babpat ratnan burur.
english: If our ear could talk and say, “Because I am not your eye, I am not a part of your body,” it would still be a part of our body.

lun_bawang: Idi mateh na miak pebala inan ticu', "Iko na ulek kuanku." Idi uluh na miak pebala inan kukud, "Medueh na ulek kuanku.”
english: That is why if our eye could talk, it should never say to our hand, “I do not need you!” And if our head could talk, it should not say to our feet, “I do not need you!”

lun_bawang: Kareb iko maré ubur dengan roh, kudeng apehké lemulun luk na baré ineh miak pebala "Amin" ratnan bala uburmu, ngaceku ieh na kali' ilung anun luk bilamu.
english: You may be thanking God very well, but you are not helping them.

lun_bawang: Idi bang Surat Allah pangeh inayud, "Kebala Tuhan, Ui sikal pebala kuan pupu ini dengan tang lemulun luk baken buri', idi bibir lun pupu baken. Sagan pana' kudeng ineh, idi nateh ideh sikal ninger balaKu.”
english: If we speak in languages MTY that we have not learned, unbelievers who are there will realize that the Spirit of God is truly among us. That will warn them that they need to fear God. But believers do not need such a warning.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ideh sikal sibada' anun-anun, nima' nedeh ngitun ratnan awandeh sebuleng déi' ruma', ngaceku na petulu decur-decur pebala bang sidang ineh.
english: If you do not agree with these things that I have been telling you, remember that RHQ the message from God did not first come from you people in Corinth. Also, you are not RHQ the only ones who have heard it! Many others have heard it and accepted it, so you should not act as though you are the only believers who have heard the message from God.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku pangeh inayud bang Surat Allah, "Luk amung-amung pangeh rireng pa liang kukud Keristus." Iamo' megala' idi baken Allah sinuet dengan "luk amung-amung" ineh, ngaceku Allah luk ngebeneh luk amung-amung ineh pa liang Keristus.
english: In the Scriptures the Psalmist wrote that God will cause everything to be under Christ’s authority MTY. But it is clear that the word ‘everything’ here does not include God, because God is the one who will cause everything to be under Christ’s authority MTY.

lun_bawang: Anunké ulekneh kuanku kudeng ui dengan terawé lemulun mo' pangeh pekakem dengan pung luk meliput déi' Epesus? Kudeng lun naté na tuyen, "Do' tau kuman idi ngirup, ngaceku nebpa tau maté.”
english: If God will not cause us believers to become alive again after we die, ◄I will receive no benefit at all from having opposed those who attacked me so strongly in Ephesus city./what will I gain from having opposed those who attacked me so strongly in Ephesus city?► RHQ They were fighting me like wild beasts! If we believers will not be raised from the dead {If God will not cause us believers to live again}, we might as well say as people often say: “Tomorrow we are going to die, so we might as well enjoy now everything that we can. We might as well feast and get drunk!”

lun_bawang: Aleg muyuh uen naluk, ngaceku "Rurum luk dat ngusag kekamen luk do'.”
english: Do not let yourselves be deceived by those who say that God will not cause believers to live again {Do not let people who say that God will not cause believers to live again deceive you}. If you associate with evil people who say such things, they will ◄influence you to do evil things/destroy your good moral way of living►.

lun_bawang: Inan luk pebala, "Kudeng apehké lun naté miak tuyen? Idi kudeng apehké ayu burur lemulun luk tuyen ineh?”
english: But some of you are asking, “How will dead people be raised {How will God cause dead people to become alive} again? What kind of bodies will they have?”

lun_bawang: Ngaceku pangeh inayud, "Idi lemulun luk pun-pun, ieh ineh Adam, mangun ku seburur luk mulun." Idi Adam luk kekiped ineh mangun ku Roh luk ngulun.
english: In the Scriptures it is written {we read} that when the first man, Adam, was created, he became a living human being. Christ later also became a human being. But he is different from Adam, because he became a person who gives us spiritual life.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kareb luk pinudut luk miak melu ini pangeh nengayung ku luk pinudut luk na miak melu, idi luk miak maté ini pangeh nengayung ku luk na miak maté, pangeh ineh miak macing bala luk pangeh inayud ini: "Idi até pangeh tilen ratnan tueh.”
english: When that happens, what is written {what ◄a prophet/Isaiah► wrote} in the Scriptures will come true/happen: God will completely get rid of MET death. Our dying will no longer have any power to defeat us;

lun_bawang: "O até, iapehké tuehmu? O até, iapehké galihmu?”
english: Death APO will not win a victory over us. Death will not be able to hurt us.

lun_bawang: Kareb ui nengerawé kudeng ineh, perapid niatkuké? Inanké ui ngerawé maya' pianku sebuleng, pad "Mo" idi "Na" ineh mepad kuanku?
english: Just as surely as God always does what he says he will do, it is true that I have never said, “Yes, I will do this” when I really meant “No.”

lun_bawang: Dengan ngadan Allah luk lutep maya' jani', idi balaku nemuyuh ineh baken "Mo'" idi "Na".
english: I follow the example of God’s Son, Jesus Christ. When I, along with Silas and Timothy, taught you about Christ, we told you that he was not someone who said that he would do something and then did not do it. Jesus Christ never said to anyone, “Yes, I will do what you desire,” and then did not do it.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku Yésus Keristus Anak Allah, luk bida' kai arang muyuh ieh ineh Siluanus, Timotius, idi ui, baken "Mo" idi "Na". Iamo' bang Keristus ineh inan "Mo" mo'.
english: We(inc) know that is true, because everything that God promised to do for his people, he has done completely by sending Christ to save us. That is why we say, “Yes, it is true! God has done everything that he promised to do!” And we praise him for that!

lun_bawang: Ngaceku Keristus, Allah pebala, "Mo" kuan amung-amung jani'Neh. Ineh punneh tau mala "Amin" teh ratnan Yésus Keristus, pad Allah uen ngerayeh.
english: Now it is only God himself who causes us (exc), as well as you, to keep on believing strongly in Christ. God is the one who chose us (inc) to belong to him and to have a close relationship with Christ.

lun_bawang: Allah luk pangeh nepebala, "Do' acang ineh merasat rat bang dacem," Ieh ineh teh luk merasat bang niat kai, pad ngacang netau ku ileh ratnan rayeh Allah luk merasat nan kiung Yésus Keristus.
english: When God created the world, he commanded the light to shine where there was nothing but darkness. He is the one who has made his message about Jesus to be like MET a light shining into our (inc) minds. God has done that for all of us who believe in Jesus. He has done that so that we will understand that when people saw Christ, they saw how awesome God himself was.

lun_bawang: Pangeh inayud, "Ui pangeh manu, idi ini punneh ui nepebala." Kai inan teh roh anu, idi kai ini pana' pebala ngaceku kai manu.
english: We are not discouraged. We are like the person who wrote in the Scriptures, “God, I trusted in you and so I continue speaking your message.” We (exc) also trust in God, so we continue speaking his message.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku Allah pebala, "Kareb aco luk petulu Ui neninger balamu. Idi kareb aco ulun Ui nengedengan namu." Setuneh nekini karebneh luk petulu ineh, idi matu aco ulun pangeh macing.
english: For God said long ago in the Scriptures: When it is the right time for me to help you, you will ask me to help you, and I will hear you. Then I will send a Savior to help you. So listen to what I am telling you: God has sent his Savior, so now is the time when God is ready to save people from the guilt of their sins.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh, kebala Tuhan, "Remuat muyuh rat arangdeh, idi patad rat nedeh. Aleg ngakem anun-anun luk melutak, idi Ui sikal ngalap nemuyuh.
english: In another place in the Scriptures we read that the Lord said: Get away from those who do evil things; keep yourselves separated from them. Do nothing sinful that would make you unacceptable to me. Then I will welcome you as members of my family.

lun_bawang: Maya' kudeng luk inayud, "Lemulun luk nengalap mula' ineh na mela, idi luk nengalap sesuut na masi'.”
english: If that happens, the result will be like it is written {like someone/Moses wrote} in the Scriptures about the time when God provided manna for his people, If someone gathered a lot of manna, he still did not have more than he needed, because he gave some to someone who did not have enough. And those who gathered only a little manna still had all that they needed LIT, because others who gathered more than they needed gave some manna to them.

lun_bawang: Maya' kudeng luk inayud, "Ieh mekatu maré kuan lun masi'; idi éi'Neh meruked.”
english: Those who give willingly and cheerfully will be rewarded like the man about whom it is written {about whom ◄someone/the Psalmist► wrote} in the Scriptures, He generously helps others, he gives to those who are poor. God will remember the good things that he did, and reward him with good things forever.

lun_bawang: Inan luk sikal pebala teh, "Suratneh ineh meberat idi metueh, iamo' ayu bururneh melaya', idi balaneh na ulekneh!”
english: I say that because some people are saying, “When Paul writes letters, he says severe things in order to make you obey him, but when he is here with you, people look at him and say he is weak, and he certainly is not a skillful speaker.”

lun_bawang: Pangeh inayud, "Idé luk ngedita' bururneh, nima' neneh ngedita bururneh ratnan kekamen Tuhan.”
english: I try to do according to what someone/Jeremiah wrote in the Scriptures, If anyone wants to boast about something, he should boast only about what the Lord God has done.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku muyuh ngalap idé-idé luk macing mada' Yésus luk baken, idi luk na bida' kai, idi teh muyuh ngalap roh luk baken ratnan Roh luk pangeh ilap muyuh atun, idi bada' luk baken ratnan Bala luk Do' luk ilap muyuh.
english: I say that because some people have come among you who are teaching their own thoughts about Jesus. They are saying about him things that are entirely different from what I taught you. They are urging you to receive a powerful spirit who would come to live in you, but it is not the same Spirit that you received from God when you believed in Christ. They preach what they call a good message, and you accept their message, even though it is not the same as the good message about Christ that you heard from me. And you have gladly accepted them and their message!

lun_bawang: Idi balaNeh kuanku, "KatuKu petap kuanmu, ngaceku laludKu uen ngegala' bang laya'." Ngaceku ineh dengan pelaba awang niat ui ngedita' bururku bang amung-amung laya'ku, pad lalud Keristus temurun luunku.
english: For that reason, whenever I am weak, or when people insult me, or when I have to endure hardships, or when I am persecuted {people cause me to suffer}, or when I am in situations that distress me, I am content because I am serving Christ. I can say that because at any time when I myself am weak, that is the very time when Christ powerfully helps me.

lun_bawang: Ini luk keteluh kua' ui macing nemuyuh. "Idi kudeng inan luk ngadu' nelun, na miak na inan dueh, teluh burur lun nekali'"—maya' kudeng luk pangeh inayud.
english: In the Scriptures it is stated that when one person accuses another of wrongdoing, you must not believe his accusation right away. First, you must listen to at least two or three people who actually saw what happened. So keep in mind that this will be the third time that I will visit you!

lun_bawang: Ui mawa ngaceku muyuh mesaget maya' bala luk baken, idi teketed ratnan Allah luk nenawar nemuyuh bang katu Keristus.
english: I am very disappointed IRO that so soon after you trusted in Christ you have turned away from God. He chose you in order that you might have what Christ freely/kindly gives. I am also disappointed that so soon you are believing a different message which some say is “good news.”

lun_bawang: Setuneh na luk idi Bala luk Do' luk baken; iamo' inan sebuang lemulun luk ngagau nemuyuh, idi luk sikal ngisu' Bala luk Do' ratnan Keristus.
english: Their message is not a true message. What is happening is that certain persons are confusing your minds. They are desiring to change the good message ◄that Christ revealed/about Christ► and are creating another message.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kudeng kai ini idi seburur melaikat rat surga pana' miak mada' kuan muyuh bala luk baken ratnan luk kai pangeh nemada' kuan muyuh, nima' neneh uen ngediman!
english: But even if we (exc) apostles or an angel from heaven would tell you a message that is different from the good message that we told you before, I appeal to God that he punish such a person forever.

lun_bawang: Kai pangeh nemala atun, nekini pana' ui mala teh, idi kudeng idé lemulun mada' bala kuan muyuh luk baken ratnan luk pangeh ilap muyuh ineh, nima' neneh uen ngediman.
english: As I told you previously, so now I tell you this once more: Someone is telling you what he says is a good message, but it is a message that is different from the good message that I gave you. So I appeal to God that he severely punish that person.

lun_bawang: Ideh nekali' luk bila lemulun mo', "Lemulun luk nengedereh netau atun, nekini mada' Bala luk Do' ratnan anu luk piderehneh atun.”
english: They only heard others say about me repeatedly, “Paul, the one who was formerly doing harmful things to us, is now telling the same message which we believe and which formerly he was trying ◄to destroy/to cause people to stop believing►!”

lun_bawang: Kali' rungen tau tinganak lun Yahudi idi baken tinganak lun pupu baken luk mesala'.
english: Some of us believers were born as Jews. We (exc) were not born as non-Jews. We Jews have always considered non-Jews to be ‘sinners’ because they do not obey the Jewish rituals and laws.

lun_bawang: Mepad kudeng luk inayud ratnan Ibrahim, "Ieh pangeh manu inan Allah, idi ngaceku anuneh ineh ieh imo Allah matu.”
english: What you have experienced is as Moses wrote in the Scriptures about Abraham. He wrote that Abraham trusted God, and as a result, he was considered as being righteous {God erased the record of his sins}.

lun_bawang: Surat Allah nekali' atun, idi Allah sikal nganau' lun pupu baken matu ngaceku anu, idi Ieh nemada' Bala luk Do' atun kuan Ibrahim, kebalaNeh, "Idi bang namu amung-amung lun pupu baken miak ngalap peruan.”
english: Furthermore, God planned beforehand that it was when non-Jews trusted him that he would erase the record of their sins. Moses wrote in the Scriptures PRS this good message that God told Abraham: “Because of what you did, I will bless people in MTY all nations.”

lun_bawang: Lemulun luk merapet sikal maya' Ukum, ideh pa liang kediman, ngaceku pangeh inayud, "Idi kediman kuan anid-anid burur lemulun luk na lutep nganau' amung-amung luk inayud bang surat Ukum ineh.”
english: That is, God will eternally punish all those who mistakenly think that God will erase the record of their sins as a result of their obeying the laws that God gave to Moses. What is written in the Scriptures is that God will eternally punish everyone who does not continuously and completely obey all the laws that Moses wrote.

lun_bawang: Megala' pa kiung Allah, idi seburur pana' na miak ruen matu ngaceku ratnan Ukum; ngaceku pangeh inayud, "Lemulun luk matu miak ngalap ulun ngaceku anu.”
english: But God has declared that if he erases the record of anyone’s sins, it will not be as a result of their obeying the laws God gave Moses. This is evident because the Scriptures say, “Every person whose record of sins God erases because that person trusts God will live spiritually.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' Ukum ineh baken ratnan manu, iamo' maya' kudeng luk inayud, "Lemulun luk maya' amung Ukum ineh miak mulun ngaceku Ukum ineh teh.”
english: But when God gave his laws to the Jews, he did not say that a person must trust him. Instead, God said that it is those who obey all God’s laws, continuously and completely, who will live.

lun_bawang: Imao' Keristus pangeh nenguli' netau ratnan kediman Ukum ineh dengan mangun ku aceh kediman kuan tau, ngaceku pangeh inayud, "Kediman kuan anid-anid lemulun luk tekito luun kayuh.”
english: Even though we humans have not continuously and completely obeyed God’s laws, Christ rescued us from God punishing us eternally. Christ rescued us by his being the one God condemned instead of God condemning us. What is written {someone/Moses wrote} in the Scriptures shows that this is true. It is written {He wrote}, “God has cursed anyone whom people have executed for his crimes and whose body they have hung on a tree.”

lun_bawang: Allah nenganau' jani'-jani'Neh kuan Ibrahim idi inulneh. Surat Allah na pebala, "idi kuan amung inulneh," ilungneh mula' lemulun. Kebalaneh, "Idi kuan sebuleng inulmu," ilungneh seburur mo', ieh ineh Keristus.
english: God declared to Abraham and his descendant that he was promising to give blessings to Abraham. The words that God spoke were not “and your descendants.” He was not referring to many persons. Instead, he was referring to one person, who is Christ, because the words that God spoke were, “and your descendant.”

lun_bawang: Ngaceku muyuh mangunku anak-anak, idi Allah pangeh nengecuk Roh AnakNeh semuet bang niat tau luk nawar, "Ama', O Ama'!”
english: Furthermore, we know that we are God’s children because God sent the Spirit, who is intimately related to Jesus, to live in our ◄inner beings/hearts►. The Spirit enables us to pray fervently, “Daddy, Father!” This shows that we are God’s children.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku pangeh inayud, "Do' iko mawang niat, O decur luk na anak! Do' iko mawang niat idi ngitang, O decur luk na nekali' mét nenganak! Ngaceku decur luk tican ineh meluun ula' anakneh ratnan decur luk inan awan.”
english: Our new city will have more people than those who live in Jerusalem now. It will be just like Isaiah foretold about the people whom he expected would come back to Jerusalem from exile. He expected that they would be more numerous than those who were taken into exile. He wrote: You who live in Jerusalem, you will rejoice! Now you have no children, like a barren woman who does not give birth to children! But some day you will shout joyfully, ◄without restraint/as loudly as you can►, even though now you are few in number, like a woman who cannot give birth to children, and you feel deserted. You will be very happy because you will have many children who will come to you. Those children will be more than the children any woman with a husband could have borne.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kudeng apehké bala Surat Allah? Kebalaneh, "Nala' demulun luk decur ineh dengan anakneh, ngaceku anak demulun luk decur ineh na miak ngalap babpat pad-pad dengan anak decur luk lun do' ineh.”
english: But these are RHQ the words in the Scriptures PRS: “The son of the woman who was not a slave will inherit what his father has. The female slave’s son will certainly not inherit those things. So send away from this place the female slave and her son MET!” That means that you should certainly expel from your groups those who insist that we obey all the laws God gave Moses MET.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku amung-amung Ukum ineh pangeh pimung dengan sebuleng bala, ieh ineh, "Do' iko mawa kuan lun denganmu mepad kudeng bururmu sebuleng.”
english: Keep in mind that we can sum up all of the laws that God has given us in one law, which is: “You must love each person you come in contact with, just like you love yourself.”

lun_bawang: O muyuh lun luk tinganak pupu baken luk titen lun Yahudi na sinunat, do' ngerawé kudeng apeh ulun muyuh mon. (Iamo' lun Yahudi ngamo bururdeh sebuleng sinunat. Sunat ineh aceh adat luk ruen lemulun kuan bururdeh sebuleng.)
english: You Ephesians have been non-Jews from the time that you were born. The Jews ◄insult you/say that you are not God’s people► by calling you ‘those who are not circumcised’. They proudly call themselves ‘we (exc) who are circumcised’. They have allowed people to circumcise them to indicate that they are God’s people, but that has only changed their bodies, not their ◄inner beings/hearts►.

lun_bawang: Maya' kudeng luk inayud, "Kareb Ieh numak iné' dita' Ieh nenguit mula' lemulun luk tiban; idi Ieh nemaré baré kuan lemulun.”
english: When Christ gave gifts to his people, it was similar to what the Psalmist said about God receiving tribute money from those whom he had conquered, When he ascended to heaven, he gave as gifts to people the things that he had taken from the people whom he captured:

lun_bawang: Anunké ilung bala, "Kareb Ieh numak"? Ilungneh, pun-pun Ieh netemurun — ieh ineh macing nan tana' luk pa liang tu-tu.
english: The words ‘he ascended’ certainly imply/indicate RHQ that Christ had also previously descended to the earth.

lun_bawang: Kudeng muyuh museh, aleg nganau' sala', aleg muyuh nganug useh muyuh pad aco macep.
english: If you get angry, do not sin as a result of getting angry. Before the end of the day MTY, stop being angry;

lun_bawang: Ngaceku anun-anun luk ginala' bang acang, ieh ineh macang. Ini punneh Tuhan pebala, "Kulat, O iko luk rudap, idi tumui rat arang lun naté! Idi Keristus macang luunmu.”
english: Just like something on which a light shines reflects that light MET, whoever has learned God’s truth reveals that truth to others. That is why we believers say this: You who are not aware of your sins, become aware of them MET! It is as though you are sound asleep, so wake up! Be like dead people who are becoming alive again! Christ will cause you to know God’s truth, just like a light MET that shines causes people to know what is in the darkness.

lun_bawang: Maya' kudeng luk inayud, "Ini punneh seburur lemulun sikal necan taman- tinanneh, idi pamung dengan awanneh, idi didueh ineh mangun ku sebuleng uang mo' peh.”
english: However, as for you(pl), each man must love his wife just as he loves himself, and each woman must respect her husband.

lun_bawang: "Ngedita' taman idi tinanmu" (idi ineh ukum luk pun-pun dengan sebuleng pejani'),
english: God commanded in the Scriptures, Greatly respect your father and mother. That is the first law that God commanded in which he also promised something. He promised,

lun_bawang: "pad mangun ku luk do' kuan muyuh, idi muyuh mulun mio bang tana' ini.”
english: If you do that, you will prosper, and you will live a long time.

lun_bawang: Do' muyuh mulai niat bang Tuhan anid-anid kareb, idi sekua' teh ui pebala kuan muyuh: do' muyuh mawang niat.
english: Because you have a relationship with the Lord, always rejoice! I’m saying it again, rejoice!

lun_bawang: Ukum ada', ieh ineh "Aleg ngimet, aleg nila', aleg ngakem.”
english: such as ‘Do not handle certain things’, ‘Do not taste certain things’, ‘Do not touch certain things’, as if you still had to obey such regulations/rules.

lun_bawang: Tabi kuan muyuh rat ni Aristarkus, lun denganku luk pad-pad denganku bang tutup, idi rat ni Markus luk sepupu dengan Barnabas. (Idi rat neneh ineh muyuh pangeh nengalap ukum idi kudeng ieh macing nemuyuh do' ngalap neneh.)
english: Aristarchus, who is in prison with me, and Mark, who is Barnabas’ cousin, ◄say that they are thinking fondly about you/send you their greetings►. I have instructed you about Mark, so if he comes to you, welcome him.

lun_bawang: Idi maré kali' ni Arkipus, "Matar do'-do' ratnan kekamen luk pangeh ilapmu bang Tuhan pad miak ngeriput ineh.”
english: Say to Archippus, “Make sure that you complete the task that God appointed you to do, because you have a close relationship with the Lord Jesus.”

lun_bawang: Kareb lemulun pebala, "Pelaba do' ali idi do' udeng," idi denak-denak até macing kuandeh, mepad kudeng luk mét nenganak kuan seburur decur luk mali'. Idi na tu-tu ideh miak muit bururdeh.
english: At a future time many people will say, “All is peaceful and we are safe!” Then suddenly the Lord Jesus will come to punish people severely! Just like a pregnant woman who experiences birth pains cannot stop those pains, those people will definitely not have any way to escape their punishment.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku kareb kai tudo dengan muyuh, kai neperiteteng nemuyuh kudeng ini: Kudeng idé-idé luk na sikal ngakem, aleg ieh kuman.
english: Remember that when we were there with you, we kept commanding you that if any fellow believer refuses to work, you should not give him food to eat.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku kudeng ini bala Surat Allah, "Aleg iko ngabet tang sapi' luk uned rumik ineh," idi "Anid-anid lemulun lik ngakem kali' rungen ngalap tabparneh.”
english: Long ago Moses wrote in the Scriptures, “While an ox is threshing grain, you must not tie its mouth so that it cannot eat the grain,” and Jesus said, “People should pay those who work for their benefit.” So we know that congregations should support their leaders.

lun_bawang: Idi ini bala luk matu: "Kudeng tau pangeh naté pad-pad denganNeh. tau miak mulun pad-pad denganNeh.
english: Endure everything as you remember that these words that we all say/sing (OR, that we teach people) are trustworthy: Since we have stopped behaving as we did in the past, as though we died when he died, we shall also live with him.

lun_bawang: Iamo' diri Allah luk lutep ineh meraben peh, idi kudeng ini etuneh; "idi Tuhan miti amung-amung pupuNeh," idi teh, "Idé-idé luk neten ngadan Tuhan, do' ieh ngado bururneh ratnan luk dat.”
english: not to continue to believe in Christ. However, the congregations of God are strong MET. They are like a strong foundation on which is written: “The Lord knows the people who really belong to him,” and “Every person who calls Jesus MTY ‘Lord’ must stop doing wicked things”.

lun_bawang: Seburur nabi rat Kriti pangeh nepebala, "Lun Kriti megéi' mebalih. Ideh ineh pung luk dat, lemulun luk mekupé idi manga.”
english: A man from Crete island whom they consider a prophet said, “My fellow Cretan people are always lying to one another! They are like dangerous wild animals MET! They are lazy and always eat too much food SYN!”

lun_bawang: Ngaceku Allah na nepebala nan melaikat-melaikatNeh, "Iko ini AnakKu; Aco sini Ui nenganak Namu." Idi teh, Allah na nepebala inan seburur melaikat, "Ui ini mangun ku TamanNeh, idi Ieh pana' mangun ku AnakKu.”
english: We know that because in the Scriptures no one RHQ ever reported that God said to any angel what he said to his Son, You (sg) are my Son! Today I have declared to all that I am your Father DOU! And he said in another Scripture passage, I will be his Father, and he will be my Son DOU.

lun_bawang: Idi teh kareb Anak buleng ineh inuitNeh iné' bang tana', idi Ieh nepebala, "Do' melaikat-melaikat Allah tekeradung sembayang Neneh.”
english: And we know his Son is greater than the angels because in another Scripture passage someone wrote this about God’s esteemed Son, when God was about to send him into the world: All God’s angels must worship him.

lun_bawang: Idi ratnan melaikat-melaikat ineh, Ieh nepebala, "Ieh mudut melaikat- melaikatNeh mangun ku bui, idi lun dukenNeh ku budung apui.”
english: And in the Scriptures it is written that someone said this about the angels: God makes the angels who serve him to be changeable like MET winds and flames of fire.

lun_bawang: Iamo' ratnan AnakNeh Allah nepebala, "KerusiMu O Allah, inan ruked-ruked, idi rukud luk matu, ieh ineh rukud ImetMu.
english: But on the other hand, in the Scriptures it is written that God said this to his Son: You (sg) who are also God will rule forever MTY, and you will reign righteously over your kingdom MTY.

lun_bawang: Idi teh, kebalaNeh, "Iko ini, O Tuhan nengerareng tana' ini rat pun-pun, idi langit ineh pana' inau' ticu'Mu.
english: And we also know that his Son is superior to angels because in the Scriptures the Psalmist wrote that someone said to God’s Son, Lord, it was you who created the earth in the beginning. You also made the rest of the universe (OR, the things in the sky) MTY.

lun_bawang: Melaikat sapehké luk inanNeh nepebala, "Tudo Iko pa tinuehKu, pad Ui ngebeneh bunu'-bunu'Mu mangun ku tapin kukudMu?”
english: We also know that his Son is superior to angels because no one ever stated RHQ in the Scriptures that God said to any angel what he said to his Son, Sit in the place of honor next to me and rule with me MTY while I put all of your enemies completely under your control MET!

lun_bawang: Iamo' maya' kudeng luk bila bang Surat Allah, kebalaneh, "Anunké lemulun pad Tuhan ngerawé neneh, idi anunké anak Adam, pad Tuhan ngikak neneh?
english: Someone spoke to God about this somewhere in the Scriptures, saying, ◄No one is worthy enough for you to think about him!/Who is worthy enough for you to think about him?► RHQ ◄No human is worthy enough for you to care for him!/Is any human worthy enough for you to care for him?► RHQ

lun_bawang: kebalaNeh, "ui sikal mada' ngadanMu, O Allah, kuan kinanak-kinanakKu; Idi arang sidang Ui miak ngubur Namu.”
english: The Psalmist wrote what Christ said to God about us becoming his brothers, in these words: I will proclaim to my brothers how awesome you are (OR, what you ◄are like/have done►) MTY. I will sing praise to you in the presence of the congregation!

lun_bawang: Idi teh, kebalaNeh, "Ui ini miak merapet Neneh." Idi teh, kebalaNeh, "Siruh, Ui ini dengan anak-anak luk biré Allah kuanKu.”
english: And a prophet wrote in another Scripture passage what Christ said about God, I will trust him. And in another Scripture passage, Christ said about those who are like his children, I and the ones that God has given me are here.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh maya' bala Roh Meligan, "Bang aco sini kudeng muyuh ninger bala Allah,
english: do not stubbornly ◄disobey/refuse to obey him► IDM, as your Jewish ancestors stubbornly disobeyed him when they rebelled against him in the desert. At that time, God said to your ancestors, “They tried to determine how many things that displeased me they could do in the desert without me punishing them.

lun_bawang: Iamo' do' mada' arang muyuh sebuleng anid-anid aco, seruked "Aco Sini" miak tetanen, pad seburur pana' rat arang muyuh na mangun metueh niat ngaceku saluk sala'.
english: We must encourage one another, because we (inc) benefit from all Christ has done only if we firmly keep trusting in him from the time when we first confidently trusted in him until the time when we die EUP.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku pangeh inayud: "Bang aco sini kudeng muyuh ninger balaNeh, aleg muyuh ngetueh niat muyuh mepad kudeng bang kareb muyuh sikal metueh.”
english: ◄You must keep trusting in God because you must remember who it was who rebelled against God although they heard him speaking to them./Do you remember who it was who rebelled against God although they heard him speaking to them?► RHQ It was people who had certainly experienced LIT God’s power. It was all those people whom Moses led miraculously out of Egypt. RHQ

lun_bawang: Ngaceku tau luk pangeh manu ini semuet bang luk inanNeh ucu' maya' kudeng luk panegh bilaNeh, "Mepad kudeng Ui pangeh nepebulung dengan usehKu: 'Idi na tu-tu ideh miak semuet bang luk inanKu ucu'!' " Ieh nepebala kudeng ineh sagan pana' amung-amung kekamen ineh pangeh inau' temina' rat pun-pun tana'.
english: We who have believed in Christ are able to enter the place of resting eternally. We know there is a place where we will rest eternally because God said, Because I was angry with them, I solemnly declared, “They will not enter the land where I would let them rest.” God said that even though he ceased his work of creating things after he created the world.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku inan aceh ayat luk pangeh bilaNeh ratnan aco luk ketudu' mepad kudeng ini, "Idi Allah nucu' bang aco luk ketudu' ratnan amung-amung kekamenNeh.”
english: What someone wrote somewhere in the Scriptures about the seventh day after he had spent six days creating the world, supports that: Then, on the seventh day, God rested from his work of creating everything.

lun_bawang: Sekua' teh Ieh nepebala kudeng ini, "Idi na tu-tu ideh ineh miak semuet bang luk inanKu ucu'.”
english: But note again what God said about the Israelites in the passage that I quoted previously: They will not enter the land where I would let them rest.

lun_bawang: Ini pangeh ginala', ngaceku Allah nengeletep aceh aco luk baken luk titen, "Aco Sini." Allah nepebala ratnan ineh tuda'-tuda' lak muci ratnan ineh bang Nani Ubur Daud, bang ayat luk bila atun ineh, "Bang aco sini, kudeng muyuh ninger bala Allah, aleg muyuh ngetueh niat muyuh.”
english: But God appointed another time when we may enter that place of resting. That time is now! We know that is true because much later than when the Israelites rebelled against God in the desert, he caused King David to write what I have already quoted, Now, when you understand what God is saying to you, do not stubbornly disobey him.

lun_bawang: Kudeng ineh teh Keristus pana', na Ieh nengerayeh bururNeh pad Ieh mangun ku Imanm Rayeh, iamo' Allah luk nepebala Neneh, "Iko ini AnakKu; Aco Sini Ui mangun ku TamanMu.”
english: Similarly, Christ also did not honor himself by appointing himself to become a Supreme Priest. Instead, God appointed him by saying to him what he never said to any other priest, what the Psalmist wrote in the Scriptures, You (sg) are my Son! Today I have declared that I am your Father!

lun_bawang: Idi teh Ieh nepebala bang ayat baken teh, "Iko ini Imam luk ruked-ruked maya' dalan Melkisedek.”
english: And he also said to Christ what the Psalmist wrote in another Scripture passage, You are a priest eternally just like Melchizedek was a priest.

lun_bawang: KebulungNeh, "Ui pejani' ngeperuan namu, idi ngula' inulmu.”
english: He said to Abraham, “I will certainly bless you (sg), and I will certainly increase the number of your descendants SYN.”

lun_bawang: Idi Ibrahim nemaré kuanneh babpat pulu' ratnan luk tibanneh. (Ilung ngadan Melkisedek ineh "Raca' ratnan Luk Matu." Idi ngaceku ieh raca' Salem, ngadanneh teh Raca' Pedo'.")
english: Then Abraham gave to him one tenth of all the spoils he took after winning the battle. Melchizedek’s name means firstly ‘king who rules righteously’, and since Salem means ‘peace’, he was the ‘king who rules peacefully’.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku pangeh inayud, "Iko ini Imam luk ruked-ruked, maya' dalan Melkisedek.”
english: We know this since God confirmed it in the Scripture passage in which he said to his Son, You (sg) are a priest eternally just like Melchizedek was a priest.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Allah ngesala' pupuNeh, kebalaNeh, "Aconeh miak macing, kebala Tuhan, kareb Ui miak nganau' pejani' luk mebaruh kuan pupu Israil idi pupu Yahuda.
english: Because God declared that the Israelites were guilty of not obeying the first covenant, he wanted a new covenant. This is what ◄a prophet/Jeremiah► wrote about that: The Lord says, “Listen! There will soon be a time when I will make a new covenant with the people MTY of Israel and the people MTY of Judah.

lun_bawang: Kareb Ieh pebala ratnan pejani' baruh, Allah pebala luk pun-pun ineh pangeh mangun ku luk mon, idi anun-anun luk amé' mon ineh idi luk amé' mengered lélé miak talan.
english: Since God spoke about a new covenant, he considered that the first covenant was no longer in use, and that it would soon disappear, just like anything that gets old will disappear MET, DOU.

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "Ini dara' pejani' luk bila Allah kuan muyuh.”
english: saying to them, “This is the blood which brings into effect the covenant that God commanded that you obey.”

lun_bawang: Ini punneh kareb Keristus ineh nesemuet bang tana', idi kebalaNeh kuan Allah, "Luk kereten idi baré na Iko pian, iamo' Iko pangeh nenganau' temina' aceh burur kuanKu.
english: So, as Christ was coming into the world, he spoke to his Father about offering himself as a sacrifice for people’s sin. The Psalmist wrote this that Christ said: It is not sacrifices and offerings that you (sg) have wanted, but you have prepared for me a body to serve you.

lun_bawang: Pun-pun Ieh nepebala, "Luk kereten, baré luk baken-baken, baré luk sabpen, idi baré ngaceku sala' na Iko pian idi na petulu kuanMu," sagan pana' barén maya' Ukum.
english: First, Christ said, “It is not sacrifices and offerings and animals that the priests have completely burned up and other offerings to atone for those who have sinned that you have really wanted. They have not pleased you.” Christ said that even though those things were offered {they offered all those things} according to the laws God gave Moses!

lun_bawang: Pangeh ineh Ieh nepebala, "Siruh, Ui pangeh nacing sikal nganau' luk pianMu." Idi baré luk mon pangeh tila' Allah pad até Keristus ngelibal ineh.
english: Then, concerning his offering himself as a sacrifice to atone for people’s sin, he said, “Listen! I have come here to do what you want me to do!” In that way Christ got rid of the first way of atoning for sin, in order to establish the second way of atoning for sin.

lun_bawang: "Ini pejani' luk barénKu nedeh muci, kebala Tuhan: Ui sikal nuet ukumKu bang niatdeh, idi ngayud ukum ineh bang terawédeh.”
english: When the time MTY when the first covenant that God made with my people has ended, I will make a new covenant with them MTY. I will do like this for them: I will cause them to understand my laws and I will cause them to obey them (OR, enable them to know them sincerely).

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaNeh, "Amung-amung sala' idi kekamendeh luk dat na teruayenKu peh.”
english: Then the Lord said: I will forgive them for their DOU sins, and I will consider that they are no longer guilty for having sinned.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku tau ngiti Neneh luk nepebala, "Ui ini miak ngukum, Ui ini miak ngua'." Idi teh, "Tuhan luk miak ngukum pupuNeh.”
english: We can be sure of that (OR, need to think about that carefully) since we know that God said, “I myself will get revenge on those who sinned, and I will punish them as they deserve DOU.” Moses wrote, “The Lord will judge his people.”

lun_bawang: Maya' kudeng luk inayud, "Segageh teh, idi Tuhan luk miak macing sikal macing teh dengan na nginiuk.
english: You must do that since a prophet wrote in the Scriptures that God said about the Messiah, In just a short time the one I promised would come will surely come; he will not delay coming.

lun_bawang: sagan pana' pangeh bila Allah neneh, "Ratnan Isak inulmu miak tetanen.”
english: It was to Abraham that God said, “It is only from Isaac that I will consider your family to descend.”

lun_bawang: Pangehké muyuh nekelupan bala Allah luk ngubuk nemuyuh mepad kudeng anak-anak kebalaNeh, 'O anakKu, aleg iko necan bada' Tuhanmu, idi aleg metalang niat kareb ukumNeh macing namu.
english: Do not forget RHQ these words that Solomon spoke to his son, that are the same as God would exhort you as his children: My child, pay attention LIT when the Lord is disciplining you, and do not be discouraged when the Lord punishes you DOU,

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ideh na miak tuman ku uni tang ineh luk nepebala, "Idi kudeng sebuleng pung pana' ngakem pegkung ineh kali' rungen ieh uen mitung ku batu.”
english: When God commanded them saying, “If a person or even an animal touches this mountain, you must kill him/it by throwing stones at him/it,” they were terrified.

lun_bawang: Ideh pelaba gagap ku luk sinierdeh ineh, pad Musa nepebala, "Ui pelaba tot idi megegker.”
english: Truly, because Moses was terrified after seeing what happened on the mountain, he said, “I am trembling because I am very afraid!”

lun_bawang: Kareb ineh tangNeh nengegio tana' ini, iamo' nekini Ieh pangeh pejani' idi pebala, "Idi sekua' teh Ui miak ngeruyuh baken tana' ini mo' iamo' langit pana'.”
english: The earth shook PRS then when he spoke MTY at Sinai Mountain. But now he has promised, “I will shake the earth again, one more time, but I will shake heaven too.”

lun_bawang: Idi bala ineh, "Sekua' teh," ilungneh, idi amung-amung luk tigio ineh miak buro, ieh ineh amung-amung luk pangeh pinudut, pad luk na sigio ineh miak ketecan.
english: The words “again, one more time” indicate that things on earth will be shaken {that he will shake things on earth}, meaning that he will set aside all that he has created, in order that the things in heaven that cannot be shaken {that nothing can shake} may remain forever.

lun_bawang: Do' muit burur muyuh ratnan mawa ku usin, idi do' muyuh mawang niat ratnan anun-anun luk inan bang palad muyuh; ngaceku Allah pangeh pebala, "Idi na tu-tu Ui miak nima' namu, idi na tu-tu Ui miak necan namu.”
english: Live without constantly coveting money, and be content with the things you possess, remembering what Moses wrote that God has said about supplying what you need, I will never leave you, I will never stop providing for you DOU.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku ineh do' tau mekuu' pebala, "Tuhan ineh Lun Ngedengan negku, idi na ui matot peh. Anunké luk miak ruen lemulun kuanku?”
english: So we can say confidently as the Psalmist said, Since the Lord is the one who helps me, I will not be afraid! People can do nothing to me that will deprive me of God’s blessings RHQ.

lun_bawang: Aleg seburur pebala kareb ieh mekaneh tutun, "Ui nekaneh tutun Allah," ngaceku Allah na tinutun ku luk dat idi Ieh sebuleng na nutun seburur pana' ku luk dat.
english: If people are tempted to do something that is evil, they should not think that it is God who is tempting them, because God is totally/completely good. He never tempts anyone to do what is evil, nor can he ever be tempted to do anything evil.

lun_bawang: Kudeng muyuh ngerayeh lemulun luk nengayung ku luk meraga ineh idi pebala, "Do' iko tudo ieni su luk do'," idi kuan lemulun luk masi' muyuh pebala, "Tuped iko déi'," kian "Tudo su luk inan tapin kukudku,”
english: And suppose that you ◄show special attention to/treat better► the one who is dressed in fine clothes by saying, “Sit here in this good seat!” and you say to the poor one, “Stand there or sit on the floor MTY!”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kudeng muyuh maya' ukum Imet, mepad kudeng ayat bang Surat Allah, "Do' iko mawa inan lun denganmu mepad kudeng bururmu sebuleng," idi kekamen muyuh ineh do' teh.
english: In the Scriptures God has commanded each of you to love other people like you love yourself. That commandment was also given by Jesus our King MTY. If you are loving others, you are doing what is right.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku Ieh luk pangeh nepebala, "Aleg pasét," Ieh ineh teh nepebala, "Aleg ngaté." Kudeng iko pasét, iamo' iko ngaté, iko pangeh nengelaba ukum.
english: For example, God said, “Do not commit adultery,” but he also said, “Do not murder anyone.” So if you (sg) do not commit adultery but you (sg) murder someone, you (sg) have become a person who disobeys God’s laws.

lun_bawang: Anun ulekneh muyuh pebala nedeh, "Do'-do' lawé, do' muyuh ngelau' burur muyuh, idi kuman pad macing mebor," kudeng muyuh na maré kuandeh anun-anun luk petulu barén kuan ulundeh?
english: And suppose that one of you says to them, “May God bless you and supply the clothing and food that you need!” but you (sg) do not give them the things that they need. ◄That would be no help to them!/What help is that to them?► RHQ

lun_bawang: Iamo' inan luk pebala, "Iko inan anu idi ui inan kekamen." Do' mada' anumu ineh sirenku dengan na kekamenmu, idi ui pana' miak mada' kuanmu anuku ratnan kekamenku.
english: But someone may say to me, “God saves some people only because they trust in him, and he saves others because they do good deeds to people.” I would answer that person, “You(sg) cannot prove to me that people truly trust in God if they do not do good things for others. But by doing good things for others I will prove to you that I truly trust in God”

lun_bawang: Ratnan luk kudeng ineh ayat bang Surat Allah pangeh nacing, luk pebala, "Ibrahim pangeh manu inan Allah, idi ineh luk iniap kuanneh mangun ku luk matu." Idi ieh teh bila mangun ku lun rurum Allah.
english: And so it happened as it is written in the Scriptures: “Because Abraham truly trusted in God, he was considered by God to be {God considered that he was} righteous.” And God also said about Abraham, “He is my friend.”

lun_bawang: Idi mo'-mo'ké bang terawé muyuh luk bila bang Surat Allah, "Roh luk tinudo Allah bang netau mepanu' ku lili luk rayeh?”
english: ◄Surely you remember that God told us in the Scriptures that he eagerly desires that his Spirit, who lives in us, will help us to love God only!/Do you think that it is for no reason that God told us in the Scriptures that he strongly desires that his Spirit, who lives in us, will help us to love God only?► RHQ God has a reason for desiring that.

lun_bawang: Iamo' katu luk barén Allah meluun tueh. Maya' kudeng bala bang Surat Allah, "Allah sikal metueh ratnan lemulun luk medita' niat, iamo' Ieh maré katu kuan lemulun luk mebeneh niat.”
english: It is because he is kind to us and he wants very much to help us. That is why ◄someone said/King Solomon wrote► in the Scriptures, “God opposes those who are proud, but he helps those who are humble.”

lun_bawang: O muyuh luk pebala, "Aco sini idi nebpa do' tau amé' bawang keceh idi tudo selak déi', idi pepua' idi nakap binaweh luk do'.”
english: Some of you are arrogantly saying, “Today or tomorrow we will go to a certain city. We will spend a year there and we will buy and sell things and earn a lot of money.” Now, you listen to me!

lun_bawang: Iamo' do' muyuh pebala, "Kudeng pian Tuhan, tau miak mulun nganau' ini idi ineh.”
english: Instead of what you are saying, you should say, “If the Lord wills/desires, we will live and do this or that.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' luk pun-pun, O kinanak-kinanakku, aleg muyuh pebulung, do' ratnan surga idi ratnan tana' pana', idi ratnan bulung luk baken-baken teh. Iamo' do ngamo ratnan luk "mo", idi mala "Na" ratnan luk "na", pad muyuh na mekaneh ukum.
english: Also, my fellow believers, I want to say something important about how you talk. If you say that you will do something, do not say, “If I do not do it, may God in heaven MTY punish me.” Do not even say, “If I do not do it, may someone here on earth MTY punish me.” Do not say anything like that. Instead, if you say “Yes,” then do what you said that you would do. If you say “No,” then do not do it. Otherwise, God will condemn you.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku pangeh inayud, "Do' muyuh meligan ngaceku Ui meligan.”
english: because it is {someone/Moses has} written in the Scriptures that God said, “You must be ◄holy/separate from evil► because I am ◄holy/separate from evil►.”

lun_bawang: Maya' kudeng luk inayud, "Amung-amung lemulun mepad kudeng uduh idi amung rayehdeh mepad kudeng busakneh, Uduh ineh mekarang, idi busakneh merurug,
english: We know that this is true because, as the prophet Isaiah wrote, All people will die SIM, like grass dies. And all the greatness/honor that people have will not last forever, like the flowers SIM that grow up in the grass do not last long. The grass withers and the flowers die,

lun_bawang: Ngaceku pangeh inayud bang Surat Allah, "Ui miak nganau' aceh Batu luk meraga ku Batu Lidung bang bawang Sion; idi lemulun luk manu Neneh na miak migu'.”
english: What Isaiah wrote in the Scriptures shows us that this is true. He wrote these words that God said: Note this well: I am placing in Jerusalem MTY one who is like MET an extremely valuable DOU ◄stone/cornerstone, the most important stone in the structure of a building►, and those who believe in him will never be disappointed.

lun_bawang: Batu ineh inan ulek luk rayeh kuan muyuh luk manu, iamo' kuan lemulun luk na manu: "Batu luk pangeh tila' lun luk mudut ruma' ineh, pangeh mangun ku Batu Lidung.”
english: Therefore, God will honor you who believe in Jesus. But those who refuse to believe in him are like the builders that this Scripture talks about: The stone that the builders rejected has become ◄the cornerstone/the most important stone in the foundation of the building►.

lun_bawang: Idi teh, pangeh inayud, "Ieh ineh aceh Batu luk inan lun metebaceng, idi aceh Batu luk nganau' nedeh mebpeh." Ideh metebaceng ngaceku na maya' bala Allah. Kudeng ineh teh luk pian Allah kuandeh.
english: And it is also written {Isaiah wrote} in the Scriptures: He will be like a stone that causes people to stumble, like a rock that people trip over. Just as people are injured when they stumble over a rock, people who disobey the message about Jesus are injured spiritually, and that is what God determined would happen to them.

lun_bawang: Ieh na nenganau' sala'. Seburur lemulun pana' na neninger balih remuat rat bang tangNeh.
english: Remember how Christ conducted himself: He never sinned, And he never said MTY anything to deceive people.

lun_bawang: Ngaceku pangeh inayud, "Lemulun luk pian ngalap ulun, idi ngalap kareb luk do', do' ieh ngimet dila'neh ratnan pebala luk dat, idi do' ieh ugka' mebalih.
english: Consider what the Psalmist wrote about the proper way of conducting our lives, As for those who want ◄to enjoy life/to live happily► and experience good things happening to them every day, they must not say MTY something that is evil or say MTY something that deceives others.

lun_bawang: Iamo' kudeng muyuh ngalap dereh ngaceku ratnan luk matu, samal kuan muyuh. Aleg matot ku lemulun, idi aleg muyuh merapang.
english: But even if you suffer because of doing what is right, God will bless you. Do as Isaiah wrote: “Do not be afraid of people who ◄threaten you/say things to cause you to be afraid of what they might do to you►, and do not worry about DOU what they might do to you.”

lun_bawang: Maya' kudeng luk inayud, "Idi kudeng mikat kuan lemulun luk matu ngalap ulun, kudeng apeh teh miak mangun kuan lemulun luk dat idi luk mesala' ineh?”
english: That will be as it is written in the Scriptures, Many righteous people will have to suffer many difficult trials before going to heaven. So ungodly and sinful people will surely have to suffer much severe punishment from God!

lun_bawang: Kudeng ineh teh, O muyuh lun luk anak adi', do' muyuh mebeneh ratnan lun rayeh-rayeh ineh. Idi do' amung-amung muyuh dengan niat luk mebeneh ngedengan seburur dengan luk baken, ngaceku "Allah sikal metueh ratnan lemulun luk medita' niat, iamo' Ieh maré katuNeh kuan lemulun luk mebeneh niat.”
english: Now I will say this to you young men and women: Just like married men and women are ◄to be subject/to submit themselves► to their spouses, you must ◄be subject/submit yourselves► ◄to the older men/to the leaders► of the congregation. And all of you believers should act MET humbly toward each other, because this proverb is true: God opposes people who are proud, but he acts kindly toward those who are humble.

lun_bawang: Kai idi kareb Ieh nengalap dita' idi rayeh ratnan Allah Taman kareb Ieh neninger aceh tang rat bang langit ratnan Luk Meluun Rayeh, luk nepebala, "Ini AnakKu luk inanKu mawa, idi Ui mawang niat Neneh.”
english: God, our Father, greatly honored him when God’s great glory/brightness surrounded him, and God MTY said, “This is my Son, whom I love very much; I am very pleased with him.”

lun_bawang: Idi pangeh mangun kuandeh ineh mepad kudeng luk pinginud ineh luk matu, ieh ineh uko' lemubed nila' uta'neh, idi barek luk pangeh diniu' lemubed silusu' bang lisuen.
english: The way they are behaving again is just like ◄the proverbs/what people often say►: They are like dogs that return to eat their vomit, and they are like pigs that have been washed and then roll again in the mud.

lun_bawang: Ideh miak situnga nemuyuh, kebaladeh, "Idanké acingNeh luk pijani' ineh? Tepun tau pangeh naté, iamo' amung-amung mepad kudeng ayuneh rat pun- pun tana' ini pinudut.”
english: They will say, “Although it was promised that Christ will come back, ◄nothing has happened that would indicate that he is coming back./what happened to the promise that he is coming back?► RHQ We say that because ever since the Christian leaders who lived long ago died EUP, everything has remained the same. Things are as they always have been since God created the world!”

lun_bawang: Idi lemulun luk pebala, "Ui miti Neneh," iamo' na maya' ukum-ukumNeh, idi ieh mangun ku lemulun luk mebalih, idi luk matu ineh na idi bang neneh.
english: Those who say, “We ◄know/have a close relationship with► God,” and do not obey what God commands us to do, are liars. They are not conducting their lives according to God’s true message.

lun_bawang: Kudeng idé lemulun luk pebala, "Ui mawa inan Allah," iamo' ieh megateh inan kinanakneh, idi lemulun ineh mebalih, ngaceku lemulun luk na mawa inan kinanakneh luk sirenneh, idi na ieh miak mawa inan Allah luk nateh sinierneh.
english: So those who say “I love God” but hate a fellow believer are lying. Those who do not love one of their fellow believers, whom they have seen, certainly cannot be loving God, whom they have not seen.

lun_bawang: Iamo' Mikail, lun rayeh melaikat ineh pana' na nenganau' kudeng ineh. Kareb ieh nepekedaluh dengan Iblis, idi didueh nepesaad ratnan idé luk miak ngalap butung Musa, idi na Mikail mekuu' ngukum Iblis dengan nguyo neneh, iamo' keburi'neh, "Aganeh Tuhan mebpeng namu!”
english: When ◄the devil/Satan► argued with the chief angel, Michael, about who would take away the body of the prophet Moses to bury it, Michael did not do as these teachers of false doctrine do. Even though Michael has much more authority than they do, he did not disrespectfully ◄revile/say evil things to► Satan and accuse/condemn him. Instead, he only said, “I desire that the Lord God will rebuke you!”

lun_bawang: Idi kuandeh ineh teh Enok, mupun luk keanem ratnan Adam, nemada' atun, keburi'neh, "Siruh, Tuhan macing dengan tuda'-tda' ngepulu' ribu melaikatNeh luk meligan,
english: Enoch, the sixth person in the line of people who descended from Adam, prophesied this about those teachers of false doctrine: “Listen carefully to this: The Lord will certainly come with a countless number of his holy angels in order

lun_bawang: Kebaladeh nemuyuh, "Kareb aco luk kekiped lemulun miak macing situnga nemuyuh, ieh ineh lemulun luk maya' pian bururdeh luk dat ineh.”
english: They told you, “In the final period of time in which we are now living there will be people who will laugh at the truths that God has revealed. They will do the ◄ungodly things/things that are displeasing to God► that their bodies desire.”

lun_bawang: "Ui ini Urup luk Pun-pun idi Urup luk Kekiped," kebala Tuhan Allah luk Meluun Lalud ineh, Luk idi nekini, Luk pangeh idi atun, idi Luk miak macing teh.
english: The Lord God declares, “I am the one who created everything, and I am the one who will cause everything to end MET.” He is the one who exists, who has always existed, and who will always exist. He is the Almighty One.

lun_bawang: Kebalaneh, "Do' iko ngayud luk sirenmu idi maré surat ineh kuan tudu' sidang ini: Epesus, Smirna, Pergamum, Tiatira, Sardis, Piladelpia, idi Laudikia.”
english: At that time, I heard behind me someone speaking to me as loudly and as clearly SIM as a trumpet. He was saying to me, “Write on a scroll what you see, and send it to seven congregations. Send it to the congregations in Ephesus city, in Smyrna city, in Pergamum city, in Thyatira city, in Sardis city, in Philadelphia city, and in Laodicea city.”

lun_bawang: Kareb ui nenier Neneh, ui neluka' iring kukudNeh mepad kudeng lemulun luk naté. Idi Ieh nengerareng ticu'Neh pa tinueh luunku idi nepebala, "Aleg matot, Ui ini Luk Pun-pun idi Luk Kekiped.
english: When I saw him, I fell down at his feet and was unable to move or speak SIM, as though I were dead. But he put his right hand on me and said to me, “Don’t be afraid! I am the one who created all things and the one who will cause all things to end.

lun_bawang: "Kuan melaikat sidang luk déi' Epesus do' ngayud kudeng ini: "Idi ini bala rat Neneh luk ngimet tudu' gituen bang ticu'Neh luk pa tinueh, luk nala-nalan arang tudu' kukud dawan luk ratnan amas ineh.
english: He also said to me, “Write this message to the leader MET of the congregation in Ephesus city: ‘I am saying these things to you: I am the one who firmly holds the seven stars in my right hand. I am the one who walks among the seven golden lampstands.

lun_bawang: Ui kali' kekamenmu, erur, idi ulai niatmu. Ui kali' namu na perurum dengan amung-amung lemulun luk dat, iamo' iko pangeh nenutun amung-amung lemulun luk mala nedeh rasul, iamo' baken, idi pangeh iko nekali' nedeh mebalih.
english: I know what you do: You labor for me intensely, and you continue to serve me steadfastly. I know that you cannot tolerate people who teach what is evil MTY, and that you investigated people who falsely claimed that they are apostles, and you found that they were lying.

lun_bawang: "Kuan melaikat sidang luk déi' Smirna do' ngayud kudeng ini: "Ini bala rat Neneh luk Pun-pun idi luk Kekiped, luk pangeh naté, idi muli' mulun teh.
english: “Write this message to the leader MET of the congregation in Smyrna city: ‘I am saying these things to you. I am the one who caused everything to have a beginning and who will cause all things to end. I am the one who died and became alive again.

lun_bawang: Ui pangeh kali' susa'mu idi asi'mu—iamo' setuneh iko mula binaweh. Ui kali' kuyo ratnan lemulun luk mala nedeh lun Yahudi, iamo' baken, iamo' ideh aceh ruma' sembayang Sétan.
english: I know that you suffer because of what unbelievers do to you, and that you lack material possessions. But I also know that you are spiritually MET rich. I know that people ◄slander/say evil things about► you. They say that they are Jews, but I do not consider that they are Jews. I consider that they belong to the group that Satan controls!

lun_bawang: "Kuan melaikat sidang Pergamum, do' ngayud kudeng ini: "Ini bala rat Neneh luk inan pelapet metadem idi tadem pekop ineh.
english: “Write this message to the leader MET of the congregation in Pergamum city: ‘I am saying these things to you. I am the one who has the sharp two-edged sword.

lun_bawang: "Kuan melaikat sidang déi' Tiatira do' ngayud kudeng ini: "ini bala Anak Allah, luk matehNeh mepad kudeng budung apui, idi kukudNeh mepad kudeng tekaling luk mesilo.
english: “Write this message to the leader MET of the congregation in Thyatira city: ‘I, ◄the Son of God/the one who is also God►, am saying these things to you: I am the one whose eyes shine SIM like a flame of fire, and whose feet shine MET like fine brass.

lun_bawang: Ui kali' kekamenmu. Ui kali' awa, anu, asa', idi ulai niatmu. Ui kali' kekamenmu nekini meluun do' ratnan luk atun.
english: I know that you love me and each other, and that you trust in me. I know that you serve others and that you steadfastly endure a lot of difficulties/trials. I know that you are doing these things more now than you have done them in the past.

lun_bawang: Ui kali' kekamenmu. Siruh, Ui nenganau' pa kiungmu aceh tanga' luk mukab, idi seburur pana' na miak ngitek neneh; ngaceku sagan pana' laludmu sesuut, iamo' iko pangeh nemaya' balaKu dengan na ngalum ngadanKu.
english: I know everything you have done. Be aware that I have opened a door before you, a door that no one can close. I know that although there are not many believers (OR, much spiritual strength) MTY in your congregation, you have obeyed what I say, and you have not denied that you believe in me MTY.

lun_bawang: "Kuan melaikat sidang luk déi' Laudikia, do' ngayud kudeng ini: "Ini bala rat Neneh luk ngadanNeh Amin, ieh ineh Lun Nekali' luk lutep maya' jani' idi luk matu, idi Luk Pun-pun ratnan amung-amung pudut Allah.
english: “Write this message to the leader MET of the congregation in Laodicea city: ‘I am saying these things to you. I am the one who ◄guarantees everything that God’s promises/confirms that he will do all that he has promised► MET. I am the one who testifies about God reliably and accurately. I am the one who God used to create everything.

lun_bawang: Ui kali' kekamenmu, iko ineh meteneb pana' na, melau' pana' na. Ui sikal kudeng iko meteneb kian melau' lek.
english: I know everything that you have done: You neither deny that you trust in me nor love/obey me zealously/wholeheartedly. You are like water that is neither cold nor hot. I wish that you were either cold or hot!

lun_bawang: Idi ui nenier teh seburur melaikat luk metueh mada' dengan tang luk rayeh, kebalaneh, "Idéké petulu miak ngelesad surat ini, idi narak etuneh?”
english: I saw a strong angel who was announcing in a loud voice, “◄The person who is worthy to break the seals of the scroll and then to open it should come to do it!/Who is worthy to break the seals of the scroll and then to open it?►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Idi inan seburur rat arang amung-amung lun rayeh ineh nepebala negku, "Aleg nangi', siruh, Balang luk ratnan pupu Yahuda, ieh ineh Uat Daud ineh, pangeh nengalap tueh pad Ieh miak ngelesad surat idi narak tudu' etu ineh.”
english: But one of the elders said to me, “Do not cry any longer! Look, the one who is called the Lion from the tribe of Judah, the Messiah who is the descendant of King David, has overcome Satan! As a result, he is worthy to break the seven seals on the scroll and open it!”

lun_bawang: Idi ideh menani aceh nani luk mebaruh, unineh, "Iko mayu miak ngalap surat ineh, idi ngelesad etuneh. Ngaceku Iko pangeh kirat, idi dengan dara'Mu Iko nenguli' lemulun kuan Allah ratnan anid-anid babpat, buri', inul, idi pupu.
english: The living creatures and the elders sang a new song. They sang: You are worthy to receive the scroll and to open its seals, because you were killed, and because you redeemed/bought people for God from every tribe, language MTY, people-group, and nation with the blood that flowed from your body when you died.

lun_bawang: Ideh menani dengan uni tang luk rayeh, "Anak Dumba ineh luk kirat ineh mayu miak ngalap lalud idi mula' binaweh, ileh, idi tueh, dita', rayeh, idi ubur!”
english: They were singing in a loud voice: “The one who is like a lamb was killed {whom his enemies killed} but he became alive again. He is worthy that all created beings acknowledge that he is infinitely powerful, infinitely rich, infinitely wise, and infinitely strong! He is worthy of being honored and praised by all created beings!”

lun_bawang: Idi apat pudut luk mulun nepebala, "Amin!" Idi amung-amung lun rayeh netekeradung idi nesembayang.
english: The four living creatures said, “◄Amen!/May it be so!►” Then the elders prostrated themselves and worshipped God and Jesus.

lun_bawang: Idi ui nenier Anak Dumba ineh ngukab sebuleng ratnan luk ketudu' etuneh, idi ui neninger sebuleng rat arang apat pudut luk mulun ineh pebala mepad kudeng uni lalam, "Do' amé' tungé!”
