english: I saw that Jesus, the one who is like a lamb, opened the first of the seven seals of the scroll. Then I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice as loud as SIM thunder, “Come!”

lun_bawang: Idi Anak Dumba ineh nengukab etu luk kedueh ineh idi ui neninger pudut luk mulun luk kedueh ineh pebala, "Do' amé' tungé!”
english: When the one who was like a lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come!”

lun_bawang: Idi Anak Dumba ineh nengukab etu luk keteluh ineh, idi ui neninger pudut luk mulun luk keteluh ineh pebala, "Do' amé' tungé'!" Idi ui nenier, inan aceh kuda luk mitem; idi lemulun luk tudo luunneh ineh inan aceh timang bang paladneh.
english: When the one who is like a lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come!” This time, I saw a black horse come out. The one who sat on it had a pair of scales in his hand.

lun_bawang: Ui neninger uni mepad kudeng tang arang uned apat pudut luk mulun ineh pebala, "Teluh lio setangal bara tabpar seaco. Iamo' matar umau dengan abpa' anggur ineh.”
english: I heard a voice that sounded like it was coming from among the four living creatures. It was saying ◄to the horseman/to the man who was sitting on the black horse►, “A quart of wheat will cost so much that a man must work a whole day to earn enough money to buy it, and three quarts of barley will sell for the same price. But do not cut off the supply of olive oil or the wine MTY!”

lun_bawang: Idi Anak Dumba nengukab etu luk keapat, idi ui neninger uni tang pudut luk mulun luk keapat ineh pebala, "Do' amé' tungé'!”
english: When the one who is like a lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature say, “Come!”

lun_bawang: Ideh nengitang, kebaladeh, "O Tuhan luk Melalud, meligan idi matu! Tuda' io teh kareb nateh Iko ngelio lemulun bang tana' ini idi ngukum nedeh ngaceku ideh nengaté nekai?”
english: They spoke loudly to God saying, “Sovereign/Almighty Lord, you are holy and faithful. How long will it be before you judge and punish the people on earth who murdered us(exc)?”

lun_bawang: Ideh nengitang kuan pegkung-pegkung idi batu-batu ineh, "Do' ngeritep nekai, idi ngelinged nekai ratnan matehNeh luk tudo luun kerusi ineh, idi ratnan useh Anak Dumba ineh!
english: They shouted to the mountains and to the rocks, “Fall on us (exc) and hide us (exc) in order that the one who sits upon the throne will not be able to see us (exc) MTY, and in order that the one who is like a lamb will not be able to punish MTY us (exc).

lun_bawang: Kebala melaikat ineh, "Aleg ngusag tana', abpa' rayeh, idi aceh lawa kayuh pana', pad kai ngetu nan madu' demulun-demulun Allah tau.”
english: to them, “Do not harm the earth or the ocean or the trees until we (exc) have marked the servants of our (inc) God on their foreheads.”

They said, “May it be so! We(exc) praise, thank, and honor you, our (exc) God, forever! We(exc) acknowledge that you are completely wise, the powerful one, who is forever able to accomplish everything he wants to. ◄May everyone acknowlege that it is so!/Amen!►”

lun_bawang: Ideh nengitang, kebaladeh, "Ulun tau ini ratnan Tuhan tau luk tudo luun kerusi raca' ineh, idi ratnan Anak Dumba teh!”
english: They shouted loudly, “O our (exc) God, you who sit on the throne, and Jesus, you who are like a lamb, you two have delivered us(exc) from Satan’s power!”

lun_bawang: kebaladeh, "Amin! Maré ubur, rayeh, ileh, ubur, dita', lalud, idi tueh kuan Tuhan kai, macing ruked-ruked peh! Amin!”
english: They said, “May it be so! We(exc) praise, thank, and honor you, our (exc) God, forever! We(exc) acknowledge that you are completely wise, the powerful one, who is forever able to accomplish everything he wants to. ◄May everyone acknowlege that it is so!/Amen!►”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala seburur rat arang lun rayeh-rayeh ineh negku, "Idéké lemulun luk inayung ku kuyu' mebuda' ineh, idi rat iapehké ideh?”
english: Then one of the elders asked me, “These people who are wearing white robes, do you know who they are, and where they come from?”

lun_bawang: Idi keburi'ku neneh, "Na kali'ku. Iko luk kali' ratnan ineh." Idi kebalaneh negku, "Ini lemulun luk neremuat ratnan susa' luk rayeh ineh. Ideh pangeh nemupu' kuyu'deh idi nengebuda' nedeh ku dara' Anak Dumba ineh.
english: I answered him, “Sir, I do not know. Surely you know who they are!” He said to me, “These are the people ◄whom others have caused to suffer greatly/who have been persecuted►. Because they believed that Jesus, the one who is like a sacrificial lamb, atoned for our sin when his blood flowed from his body when he died, it is as though MET they have washed their robes and have made them clean and white.

lun_bawang: (Idi ngadan gituen, ieh ineh Luk Mepét.) Idi sebabpat ratnan teluh babpat abpa' ineh mangun mepét, idi mula' lemulun naté ku abpa' ineh ngaceku ieh pangeh mangun mepét.
english: The name of the star is Bitterness. As a result, the water in a third of the rivers and springs became bitter, and many people died from drinking the water because it had become bitter.

lun_bawang: Idi raca'deh, ieh ineh melaikat lubang luk na miak teriin kidalemneh ineh. Ngadanneh bang buri' lun Iberani, Abadon, idi bang buri Grika, ngadanneh Apolion, (ilungneh "Luk Ngaté").
english: The king who ruled over them was the angel of the underworld. His name in the Hebrew language is Abaddon. In the Greek language it is Apollyon. Both of those names mean ‘Destroyer’.

lun_bawang: Arod ineh pebala kuan melaikat luk keanem luk ngimet serupit ineh, "Muit apat melaikat luk kiling tangeb abpa' rayeh ineh, ieh ineh Abpa' Pirat.”
english: It was saying to the sixth angel, the one who had the trumpet, “Release the four angels whom I have bound at the great river Euphrates!”

lun_bawang: Kareb tudu' lalam ineh pangeh muni, ui temina' ngayud, idi ui neninger aceh arod rat bang langit, kebalaneh, "Ngetu anun-anun luk pangeh bila tudu' lalam ineh, idi aleg ngayud ineh.”
english: When it thundered like that, I was about to write the words that I heard, but a voice from heaven said to me, “Keep secret what the thunder said! Do not write it down!”

lun_bawang: Idi arod luk pindengerku rat bang langit ineh, nepebala negku sekua' teh, kebalaneh, "Amé' iko, ngalap surat luk lisad luk bang palad melaikat luk tuped luun abpa' rayeh idi luun tana'.”
english: The one whose voice I had heard from heaven spoke to me again. He said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel who is standing on the ocean and on the land.”

lun_bawang: Ui iné' matun melaikat ineh idi nemutuh neneh maré surat luk isuut ineh negku. Idi kebalaneh kuanku, "Do' ngalap idi kuman ineh, idi ieh miak nganau' batekmu mepét, iamo' bang tangmu ieh mepaci' mepad kudeng duru' tebikan.”
english: So I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little scroll. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. In your mouth it will taste sweet like honey, but it will make your stomach bitter.”

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nepebala kuanku, "Do' iko mada' bala Allah sekua' teh ratnan tuda'- tuda' inul idi tuda'-tuda' pupu, inul, buri', idi raca'."
english: The one whose voice spoke from heaven said to me, “You must ◄prophesy again/proclaim again what I will reveal to you► about many people-groups, many nations, speakers of many languages MTY, and many kings.”

lun_bawang: Idi pangeh biré kuanku aceh bulu' luk mepad kudeng rukud ayunneh, idi keburi'neh, "Tumui iko, idi nari ruma' Allah idi bubpun, idi ngiap amung- amung lemulun luk sembayang bang ruma' Allah ineh.
english: An angel gave to me a reed similar to a measuring stick. He said to me, “Christ says this: ‘Go to the temple where people worship God, measure it and the altar in it, and count the people who worship there.

lun_bawang: Idi dueh nabi ineh neninger aceh tang luk rayeh rat bang langit luk nepebala nedidueh, "Umak amé' tungé'!" Idi didueh numak iné' déi'' langit maya' bang laput. Idi amung-amung bunu'deh pana' nenier nedidueh.
english: The two witnesses will hear a loud voice which came from heaven saying to them: “Come up here!” Then they will go up to heaven in a cloud. Their enemies will see them as they ascend.

lun_bawang: Idi melaikat luk ketudu' ineh nengiup serupitneh, idi inan tuda'-tuda' arod déi' surga luk pebala, "Imet tana' ini mangun ku Imet Tuhan tau, idi Imet KeristusNeh, idi Ieh miak ngimet macing ruked-ruked peh.”
english: Then the seventh angel blew his trumpet. Angels in heaven shouted loudly, “Our Lord God and the Messiah whom he has appointed can now govern everyone in MTY the world, and they will continue to rule people forever!”

lun_bawang: idi nepebala, "Kai ngubur Namu, O Tuhan Allah luk Melalud, Luk idi nekini idi Luk pangeh idi atun, ngaceku Iko makai laludMu luk rayeh, idi Iko pangeh ngimun ngimet!
english: They said: Lord God, you are the Almighty One! You are the one who exists now! You are the one who has always existed! We thank you that you have defeated by your power everyone who has rebelled against you, and you now rule over everyone in the world.

lun_bawang: Ideh sembayang inan galau ineh, ngaceku ieh pangeh nemaré laludneh kuan pung ineh. Idi teh ideh nesembayang inan pung ineh, kebaladeh, "Idéké luk mepad kudeng pung ini? Idéké luk miak metueh rat neneh?”
english: They worshipped the dragon, because he had given to the beast authority to rule people. They also worshipped the beast, saying, “No one is as powerful as the beast!/ RHQ ◄No one would dare to fight against it!/Who would dare to fight against it?►” RHQ

lun_bawang: Ieh nengitang, "Do' matot inan Allah idi ngerayeh Neneh, ngaceku pangeh nacing karebNeh ngukum lemulun! Do' sembayang neneh luk nemudut langit, tana', idi abpa' rayeh dengan amung bued abpa' teh!”
english: He said in a loud voice, “Revere God and honor him, because it is now time for him to judge people! Worship God, because he is the one who created the heaven, the earth, the ocean, and the springs of water.”

lun_bawang: Melaikat luk kedueh nemaya' melaikat luk pun-pun ineh, kebalaneh, "Pangeh netabpa, pangeh netabpa bawang Babil luk rayeh, luk nemaré abpa' anggur rupen amung-amung pupu, ieh ineh useh Allah, ngaceku sawa'neh.”
english: A second angel came after him saying, “The very evil cities (OR, city) represented by Babylon are completely destroyed! God has punished their people because they have persuaded people of all the nations to forsake God, just like a prostitute MET persuades men to drink strong wine and as a result commit sexual immorality.”

lun_bawang: Melaikat luk keteluh nemaya' nedidueh luk atun ineh, idi nengitang, "Kudeng idé lemulun luk sembayang inan pung ineh dengan akangneh, idi ngalap tanu' nan madu' idi ticu'neh,
english: A third angel came next, saying in a loud voice, “If people worship the beast and its image and allow its mark to be put {its agent to put its mark} on their foreheads or on their hands,

lun_bawang: Idi ui neninger aceh arod rat bang langit luk nepebala, "Do' ngayud kudeng ini: Samal kuan lemulun luk pangeh naté, ieh ineh luk naté bang Tuhan rat pad sini!" "Matu," kebala Roh ineh, "Ideh miak ucu' ratnan amung erurdeh; ngaceku kekamendeh luk do' maya' nedeh.”
english: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write this: God will now abundantly bless the people who have a close relationship with the Lord Jesus for the rest of their lives.” God’s Spirit says, “Yes, after they die, they will no longer have to work hard. Instead, they will rest, and the record of the good deeds MTY that they have done will go with them (OR, God will reward them for the good deeds that they have done).”

lun_bawang: Idi aceh melaikat luk baken neremuat teh rat bang ruma' Allah, luk nengitang kuan Lemulun luk tudo luun laput ineh, kebalaneh, "Ngeruat alingMu idi ngeranih, ngaceku karebneh ngeranih pangeh nacing, ngaceku perinien tana' ini pangeh melak!”
english: Another angel came out of the temple in heaven. In a loud voice, speaking figuratively about gathering people for God to judge them, he said to the one who was sitting on the cloud, “The time has come to reap the grain on the earth, so with your sickle reap the grain, because the grain on the earth is ripe.”

lun_bawang: Ideh menani ku nani Musa, demulun Allah ineh, idi nani Allah Dumba ineh teh, kenanideh, "Tuhan, Allah luk Melalud, kekamenMu rayeh idi inan mawa! O Raca' amung-amung pupu, amung dalanMu mesiri idi matu!
english: They were singing a song like God’s servant Moses sang long ago. They sang like this to praise Jesus, the one who is like a lamb: Lord God Almighty, whatever you do is powerful and marvelous! You always act righteously and truthfully. You are king forever!

lun_bawang: Idi ui neninger aceh arod rat bang ruma' Allah ineh luk pebala kuan tudu' melaikat ineh, "Do' muyuh amé' idi ngutang tudu' bigan useh Allah ineh luun tana'.”
english: In the vision I heard someone in the temple speak in a loud voice to the angels who had the seven bowls. He said, “Go from here and pour out on the earth the wine/liquid in MTY the seven bowls. This will show that God is angry with rebellious people and will punish them.”

lun_bawang: Idi ui neninger amung-amung melaikat luk ngimet abpa' ineh pebala, "Matu Iko luk idi nekini, idi Luk pangeh idi atun, idi Luk Meligan, ngaceku Iko pangeh nengukum kudeng ineh.
english: I heard the angel who has authority over the waters say to God, “O God, you exist and have always existed. You are the holy one. You judge people justly.

lun_bawang: Idi ui neninger aceh arod rat bubpun ineh luk pebala, "O Tuhan, Allah luk Melalud! Matu idi mesiri amung-amung ukumMu ineh!”
english: Then I heard an angel respond from the altar PRS, “Yes, Lord God, you who are almighty, you punish people rightly and justly!”

lun_bawang: "Do' muyuh matar do'-do'! Ui ini macing mepad kudeng lun mano! Idi samal kuan lemulun luk matar do'-do' idi nginita ayungneh, pad ieh na nalan lubpa idi na migu' siren lemulun.”
english: The evil spirits will gather the rulers at a place that is called in the Hebrew language Armageddon. I heard the Lord Jesus say, “You must listen carefully to me: I am coming unexpectedly SIM, like a thief. So, I will be happy with those who stay alert and keep on living righteously so that they will not be ashamed, just like MET a person keeps his clothes on so that he will not be ashamed like a person who is naked.”

lun_bawang: Idi ada'-ada' ineh nengamung amung-amung raca' ineh tebubpun su luk titen dengan buri' Iberani Armagedon.
english: The seventh angel poured out into the air the wine/liquid that was in MTY his bowl. As a result, someone said with a loud voice from the throne in the temple, “The time for God to finish punishing rebellious people is about to be start.”

lun_bawang: Idi melaikat luk ketudu' ineh pana' nengutang uang biganneh déi' arang gawa', idi inan sebuleng tang luk rayeh neremuat rat bang ruma' Allah, ieh ineh ratnan kerusi ineh luk nepebala, "Amung-amung pangeh meriput!”
english: When the angel emptied his bowl, lightning flashed, there were rumblings and thunder, and the earth shook. It shook more violently than it has ever shaken since people first lived on earth.

lun_bawang: Idi seburur rat arang tudu' melaikat ineh luk nenguit tudu' bigan ineh iné' negku idi nepebala, "Amé' tungé, ui sikal mada' kuanmu ukum kuan decur luk pelaba sawa', ieh ineh bawang rayeh luk pinudut muneng ku abpa' luk mula'.
english: One of the seven angels, who had one of the seven bowls, came to me. He said to me, “Come with me, and I will show you how God will punish the very evil city that is represented by SYM a prostitute, a city in which there are many canals of water.

lun_bawang: Idi luun madu'neh inan aceh ngadan luk inayud, ieh ineh, luk inalum, "Babil luk rayeh, tinan amung-amung sawa' idi amung-amung bebpeng luk bang tana'.”
english: This name, that has a hidden/secret meaning, was written on her forehead: “This woman is Babylon, the very evil city! She acts like the mother of the prostitutes on the earth. She teaches them to act immorally and to worship idols.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala melaikat ineh negku, "Anunké punneh iko mawa? Ui sikal mada' kuanmu luk inalum ratnan decur ineh, idi luk inalum ratnan pung luk nguit neneh ineh, idi luk inan tudu' uluh idi pulu' unga.
english: The angel said to me, “Do not be bewildered RHQ! I will explain to you the hidden/secret meaning of the woman and of the beast on which she rides, the beast that has the seven heads and the ten horns.

lun_bawang: Idi kebala melaikat negku, "Abpa' luk siniermu ineh su luk inan decur luk mesawa ineh tudo, ieh ineh tuda'-tuda' inul, babpat, pupu, idi buri'.
english: Then the angel said to me, “The waters that you saw in the city where the prostitute sits represent people-groups, multitudes of people, nations, and speakers of many languages MTY.

lun_bawang: Idi ieh nengitang, kebalaneh, "Babil bawang rayeh ineh pangeh netabpa. Ieh mangun ku luk inan sétan, ada', idi suit-suit luk melutak idi luk inan megateh.
english: He shouted with a very loud voice, “God is about to completely destroy DOU all the very evil cities (OR, the very evil city) that Babylon represents. As a result, all kinds of evil spirits DOU will live there, and all kinds of foul and detestable DOU birds will live there.

lun_bawang: Idi ui neninger aceh arod luk baken teh rat bang surga luk nepebala, "O pupuKu, do' remuat rat neneh, pad muyuh na perurum bang sala'neh, idi muyuh na kumin pad-pad denganneh!
english: I heard Jesus speak from heaven. He said, “My people, flee from those cities, in order that you do not sin as the people of those cities do. If you sin as they do, I will punish you as I will punish them.

lun_bawang: O surga, do' iko mawang niat ngaceku usagneh ineh! O lun manu, rasul- rasul idi nabi-nabi, do' muyuh mawang niat, ngaceku Allah pangeh nengukum neneh ngaceku luk inau'neh nemuyuh.
english: Then a mighty angel picked up a boulder the size of a large stone for grinding grain, and threw it into the ocean. Then he said, “O you people in APO the awesome/great cities represented by Babylon, your cities will be destroyed so that they will disappear just like that stone disappeared in the ocean! Your cities will be gone forever LIT!

lun_bawang: Idi seburur melaikat luk metueh, nengiding aceh batu luk mepad kudeng batu iung kirayehneh, idi ieh nenala' neneh bang abpa' rayeh idi nepebala, "Dengan bitung luk kudeng ini, Babil bawang luk rayeh ineh miak talan dengan metueh, idi na tu-tu ieh miak siren teh.
english: In your cities there will never again be anyone playing harps, singing, playing flutes, and blowing trumpets. There will no longer be any ◄skilled workers/craftsmen► making things. There will never again be people grinding grain at MTY the mills.

lun_bawang: Muci ratnan ineh ui neninger teh uni mepad kudeng arod lun mula' luk ngitang déi' surga, kebaladeh, "Ngubur Allah! Ulun luk meruked, rayeh idi lalud idi bang palad Allah!
english: After these things I heard what sounded like a huge crowd in heaven. They were shouting things like, “◄Hallelujah!/Praise our God!►” “He has saved us!” “He is glorious and mighty!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebaladeh luk kedueh kua'neh, "Ngubur Allah! Rabpun ratnan bawang luk meseb ineh umak macing ruked-ruked!”
english: The crowd shouted a second time saying: ◄Hallelujah!/Praise God!► The smoke of the fire that is burning the cities will rise forever!

lun_bawang: Idi dueh ngepulu' apat lun rayeh ineh idi apat pudut luk mulun ineh teh netekeradung sembayang inan Allah luk tudo luun kerusi, idi nepebala, "Amin! Ngubur Allah!”
english: The 24 elders and the four living creatures ◄prostrated themselves/knelt down► and worshipped God, who sits on the throne. Then they said, “It is true! ◄Hallelujah!/Praise God!►”

lun_bawang: Idi aceh arod luk rayeh neremuat ratnan kerusi ineh kebalaneh, "Do' ngubur Allah tau, O amung-amung muyuh luk demulunNeh, idi luk matot Neneh, do' luk isuut idi luk rayeh pana'!”
english: Someone spoke from the throne and said, “All you who are our God’s servants, praise him! All you who reverence him, whether you are socially significant or insignificant, praise him! Everyone!”

lun_bawang: pangeh ineh ui neninger aceh arod luk mepad kudeng arod lun luk mula', idi mepad kudeng beri rueb luk medita', idi mepad kudeng uni lalam kebaladeh, "Ngubur Allah! Ngaceku Tuhan tau, Allah luk Melalud, Ieh ineh Raca'!
english: I heard something like the noise of a huge crowd of people, like the sound of a huge waterfall (OR, a great/wide river of rushing water), and like the sound of loud thunder. They were shouting: ◄Hallelujah!/Praise God!► Because the Lord God, the Almighty One, reigns!

lun_bawang: Idi kebala melaikat negku, "Do' ngayud kudeng ini: Samal kuan lemulun luk tinawar amé' ku irau paweh Anak Dumba ineh." Idi teh kebala melaikat ineh, "Ini bala Allah luk matu.”
english: Then the angel said to me, “Write this: God will abundantly bless the people who are {whom he has} invited to the feast that celebrates Jesus, the one who is like a lamb, permanently uniting with his people, like someone MET marrying a wife.” He also said to me: “These words that God declares are true!”

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh inan kuyuh' luk pangeh rireb bang dara'. Idi Ieh tetanen "Bala Allah.”
english: The robe he was wearing was drenched with blood. His name is also “◄The one who expresses what God is like/The Word of God►.”

lun_bawang: Idi luun kuyuh'Neh idi tipanNeh pangeh inayud aceh ngadan, ieh ineh, "Raca' pa luun amung-amung raca' idi Tuhan pa luun amung-amung tuan.”
english: On his cloak close to his thigh a name had been written {he had written a name}, which is “King who rules over all other kings and Lord who rules over all other lords.”

lun_bawang: Idi ui nenier teh aceh melaikat luk tuped nan mateh aco. Ieh nengarod kuan amung-amung suit luk temulud déi' arang gawa', kebalaneh, "Amé' tungé' idi pamung bang irau Allah luk rayeh.
english: I saw an angel who was standing in the light of MTY the sun. He called loudly to all the flesh-eating birds flying high in the sky, “Come and gather for the wonderful feast that God is providing for you!

lun_bawang: Ui neninger aceh arod luk rayeh rat bang kerusi ineh kebalaneh, "Ngerawé do'-do'! Su luk inan Allah mudeng nekini idi pad-pad dengan lemulun! Ieh miak tudo pad-pad dengan lemulun idi ideh miak amngun ku pupuNeh. Allah sebuleng miak tudo dengandeh, idi mangun ku Allahdeh.
english: I heard a loud voice that spoke from the throne of God. It said, “Listen to this! Now God will live with people. He will live right in the midst of them DOU! They will be his people. God himself will be with them, and he will be their God.

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh luk tudo luun kerusi ineh pana' nepebala, "Siruh, Ui nganau' amung- amungneh mebaruh." Idi kebalaNeh teh, "Do' ngayud, ngaceku bala ini lutep idi matu.”
english: Then God, who sits on the throne, said, “Listen to this! I am now making everything new!” He said to me: “Write these things that I have told you, because you can trust that I will certainly cause them to happen.”

lun_bawang: Idi teh kebalaNeh, "Pangeh neriput! Ui ini Urup luk Pun-pun idi Urup luk Kekiped, ieh ineh Luk Pun-pun idi Luk Kekiped. Kuan lemulun luk meparing Ui miak amré neneh ngirup ratnan bued abpa' luk mulun ineh dengan mo'- mo'.
english: He said to me, “I have finished doing all the things I needed to do. I am the one who began all things MET and the one who will cause all things to end MET. To everyone who is spiritually thirsty MET, I will ◄freely give/give as a free gift► water from the spring that causes people to live forever.

lun_bawang: Idi seburur rat arang tudu' melaikat luk ngimet tudu' bigan ineh luk panu' ku tudu' dereh luk kekiped ineh nacing, idi nepebala negku, "Amé tungé', ui miak mada' sirenmu Decur luk sikal ngaweh ineh, ieh ineh awan Anak Dumba ineh.”
english: One of the seven angels who had one of the seven bowls that had been full of the wine/liquid causing MTY the seven last plagues came and said to me, “Come with me and I will show you the people who have permanently united with Christ, the one who is like a lamb! They will be like MET a bride for him.”

lun_bawang: Idi kebala melaikat negku, "Amung-amung bala ini lutep idi matu. Idi Tuhan Allah luk nemaré roh kuan nabi-nabi ineh, pangeh nengecuk melaikat mada' demulun-demulunNeh ratnan luk na miak na macing dengan mesaget.”
english: The angel said to me: “These words that God has revealed to you are true, and he will certainly do what he has promised to do. The Lord God who ◄inspires the prophets/tells the prophets what to say► sent his angel to show the people who serve him the events that must happen soon.”

lun_bawang: Kebala Yésus, "Ngerawé do'-do', Ui macing dengan mesaget." Samal kuan lemulun luk maya' amung-amung bala luk biré bang surat ini.
english: Jesus says to all his people, “Listen to this! I am coming soon; God will abundantly bless everyone who obeys what has been commanded in this book.”

lun_bawang: Iamo' kebalaneh negku, "Aleg nganau' ineh. Ui pana' mepad teh kudeng iko, idi mepad kudeng kinanakmu teh, ieh ineh nabi-nabi ineh, idi mepad kudeng amung-amung lemulun luk maya' bala surat ini. Do' sembayang inan Allah!”
english: But he said to me, “Do not worship me I am just your fellow servant! I am also the fellow servant of your fellow believers who are ◄the prophets/the ones who tell messages that come directly from God►, and I am a fellow servant of those who obey what has been commanded in this book. Instead, worship God!”

lun_bawang: Idi kebalaneh negku, "Aleg iko ngalum amung-amung bala bada' luk bang surat ini, ngaceku karebneh pangeh muneng.
english: He also said to me, “Do not keep secret the message about what God has foretold in this book, because it is almost time MTY for him to what he has promised to do in this message.

lun_bawang: "Ngerawé do'-do'! Ui macing dengan mesaget! Ui nguit tabparKu, pad Ui ngua' kuan anid-anid lemulun maya' kekamenneh.
english: Jesus says this to everyone: “Listen! I am coming soon! And I will pay back everyone according to what each one has done, by punishing or rewarding them.

lun_bawang: Idi Roh dengan Decur luk ngaweh pebala, "Amé' tungé!" Idi lemulun luk ninger ineh pana' do' ieh pebala, "Amé' tungé!" Idi lemulun luk meparing do' ieh macing, idi idé-idé luk sikal, do' ieh ngalap abpa' mulun ineh dengan mo'- mo'.
english: God’s Spirit and his people, who are like MET the bride of Christ, say to each one who desires to believe, “Come!” Whoever hears this should also say to each one who desires to believe, “Come!” Spiritually thirsty people should come MET! Everyone who desires the water that enables people to live forever should take it as a free gift!

lun_bawang: Idi Ieh luk maré kali' ratnan amung-amung ini nepebala, "Matu! Ui macing dengan mesaget!" Amin! Do' Iko macing, O Tuhan Yésus.
english: Jesus, who says that all the things written here are true, says, “Certainly I am coming soon!” I, John, reply, “◄May it be so!/Amen!► Lord Jesus, come!”
